book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: הָעָם֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ רָא֖וּ א֣וֹר גָּד֑וֹל יֹֽשְׁבֵי֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ צַלְמָ֔וֶת א֖וֹר נָגַ֥הּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: h'm hhlkhym bchshkh r'v 'vr gdvl yshby b'rts tslmvt 'vr ngh 'lyhm
verses.translation: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light; they that dwelt in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַגּ֔וֹי (לא) [ל֖וֹ] הִגְדַּ֣לְתָּ הַשִּׂמְחָ֑ה שָׂמְח֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ כְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת בַּקָּצִ֔יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגִ֖ילוּ בְּחַלְּקָ֥ם שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.translit: hrbyt hgvy (l') [lv] hgdlt hshmchh shmchv lpnykh khshmcht bqtsyr kh'shr ygylv bchlqm shll
verses.translation: Thou hast multiplied the nation, Thou hast increased their joy; they joy before Thee according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  אֶת־עֹ֣ל סֻבֳּל֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁכְמ֔וֹ שֵׁ֖בֶט הַנֹּגֵ֣שׂ בּ֑וֹ הַחִתֹּ֖תָ כְּי֥וֹם מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.translit: khy  't'l sblv v't mth shkhmv shbt hngsh bv hchtt khyvm mdyn
verses.translation: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, Thou hast broken as in the day of Midian.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כׇל־סְאוֹן֙ סֹאֵ֣ן בְּרַ֔עַשׁ וְשִׂמְלָ֖ה מְגוֹלָלָ֣ה בְדָמִ֑ים וְהָיְתָ֥ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֖ה מַאֲכֹ֥לֶת אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khy khls'vn s'n br'sh vshmlh mgvllh bdmym vhyth lshrph m'khlt 'sh
verses.translation: For every boot stamped with fierceness, and every cloak rolled in blood, shall even be for burning, for fuel of fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יֶ֣לֶד יֻלַּד־לָ֗נוּ בֵּ֚ן נִתַּן־לָ֔נוּ וַתְּהִ֥י הַמִּשְׂרָ֖ה עַל־שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמ֜וֹ פֶּ֠לֶא יוֹעֵץ֙ אֵ֣ל גִּבּ֔וֹר אֲבִי־עַ֖ד שַׂר־שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: khyyld yldlnv bn ntnlnv vthy hmshrh 'lshkhmv vyqr' shmv pl' yv'ts 'l gbvr 'by'd shrshlvm
verses.translation: For a child is born unto us, a son is given unto us; and the government is upon his shoulder; and his name is called Pele-joez-el-gibbor Abi-ad-sar-shalom;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (לם רבה) [לְמַרְבֵּ֨ה] הַמִּשְׂרָ֜ה וּלְשָׁל֣וֹם אֵֽין־קֵ֗ץ עַל־כִּסֵּ֤א דָוִד֙ וְעַל־מַמְלַכְתּ֔וֹ לְהָכִ֤ין אֹתָהּ֙ וּֽלְסַעֲדָ֔הּ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּבִצְדָקָ֑ה מֵֽעַתָּה֙ וְעַד־עוֹלָ֔ם קִנְאַ֛ת יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּֽאת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: (lm rbh) [lmrbh] hmshrh vlshlvm 'ynqts 'lkhs' dvd v'lmmlkhtv lhkhyn 'th vls'dh bmshpt vbtsdqh m'th v'd'vlm qn't yhvh tsb'vt t'shhz't {p}
verses.translation: That the government may be increased, and of peace there be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it through justice and through righteousness From henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts doth perform this.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּבָ֛ר שָׁלַ֥ח אֲדֹנָ֖י בְּיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְנָפַ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: dbr shlch 'dny by'qb vnpl byshr'l
verses.translation: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ הָעָ֣ם כֻּלּ֔וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב שֹׁמְר֑וֹן בְּגַאֲוָ֛ה וּבְגֹ֥דֶל לֵבָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyd'v h'm khlv 'prym vyvshb shmrvn bg'vh vbgdl lbb l'mr
verses.translation: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in pride and in arrogancy of heart:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְבֵנִ֥ים נָפָ֖לוּ וְגָזִ֣ית נִבְנֶ֑ה שִׁקְמִ֣ים גֻּדָּ֔עוּ וַאֲרָזִ֖ים נַחֲלִֽיף׃
verses.translit: lbnym nplv vgzyt nbnh shqmym gd'v v'rzym nchlyf
verses.translation: ‘The bricks are fallen, but we will build with hewn stones; the sycamores are cut down, but cedars will we put in their place.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֧ב יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־צָרֵ֥י רְצִ֖ין עָלָ֑יו וְאֶת־אֹיְבָ֖יו יְסַכְסֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyshgb yhvh 'ttsry rtsyn 'lyv v't'ybyv yskhskh
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD doth set upon high the adversaries of Rezin against him, and spur his enemies;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲרָ֣ם מִקֶּ֗דֶם וּפְלִשְׁתִּים֙ מֵאָח֔וֹר וַיֹּאכְל֥וּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכׇל־פֶּ֑ה בְּכׇל־זֹאת֙ לֹא־שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'rm mqdm vplshtym m'chvr vy'khlv 'tyshr'l bkhlph bkhlz't l'shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: The Arameans on the east, and the Philistines on the west; and they devour Israel with open mouth. For all this His anger is not turned away, but His hand is stretched out still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעָ֥ם לֹא־שָׁ֖ב עַד־הַמַּכֵּ֑הוּ וְאֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vh'm l'shb 'dhmkhhv v'tyhvh tsb'vt l' drshv {s}
verses.translation: Yet the people turneth not unto Him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכְרֵ֨ת יְהֹוָ֜ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹ֧אשׁ וְזָנָ֛ב כִּפָּ֥ה וְאַגְמ֖וֹן י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvh myshr'l r'sh vznb khph v'gmvn yvm 'chd
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD doth cut off from Israel head and tail, palm-branch and rush, in one day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָקֵ֥ן וּנְשֽׂוּא־פָנִ֖ים ה֣וּא הָרֹ֑אשׁ וְנָבִ֥יא מֽוֹרֶה־שֶּׁ֖קֶר ה֥וּא הַזָּנָֽב׃
verses.translit: zqn vnshv'pnym hv' hr'sh vnby' mvrhshqr hv' hznb
verses.translation: The elder and the man of rank, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ מְאַשְּׁרֵ֥י הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה מַתְעִ֑ים וּמְאֻשָּׁרָ֖יו מְבֻלָּעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhyv m'shry h'mhzh mt'ym vm'shryv mbl'ym
verses.translation: For they that lead this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֨ן עַל־בַּחוּרָ֜יו לֹא־יִשְׂמַ֣ח  אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֶת־יְתֹמָ֤יו וְאֶת־אַלְמְנוֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔ם כִּ֤י כֻלּוֹ֙ חָנֵ֣ף וּמֵרַ֔ע וְכׇל־פֶּ֖ה דֹּבֵ֣ר נְבָלָ֑ה בְּכׇל־זֹאת֙ לֹא־שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'lbchvryv l'yshmch  'dny v'tytmyv v't'lmnvtyv l' yrchm khy khlv chnf vmr' vkhlph dbr nblh bkhlz't l'shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall He have compassion on their fatherless and widows; For every one is ungodly and an evil-doer, And every mouth speaketh wantonness. For all this His anger is not turned away, but His hand is stretched out still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בָעֲרָ֤ה כָאֵשׁ֙ רִשְׁעָ֔ה שָׁמִ֥יר וָשַׁ֖יִת תֹּאכֵ֑ל וַתִּצַּת֙ בְּסִֽבְכֵ֣י הַיַּ֔עַר וַיִּֽתְאַבְּכ֖וּ גֵּא֥וּת עָשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: khyb'rh kh'sh rsh'h shmyr vshyt t'khl vttst bsbkhy hy'r vyt'bkhv g'vt 'shn
verses.translation: For wickedness burneth as the fire; it devoureth the briers and thorns; yea, it kindleth in the thickets of the forest, And they roll upward in thick clouds of smoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֶבְרַ֛ת יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת נֶעְתַּ֣ם אָ֑רֶץ וַיְהִ֤י הָעָם֙ כְּמַאֲכֹ֣לֶת אֵ֔שׁ אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֖יו לֹ֥א יַחְמֹֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: b'brt yhvh tsb'vt n'tm 'rts vyhy h'm khm'khlt 'sh 'ysh 'l'chyv l' ychmlv
verses.translation: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land burnt up; the people also are as the fuel of fire; No man spareth his brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְזֹ֤ר עַל־יָמִין֙ וְרָעֵ֔ב וַיֹּ֥אכַל עַל־שְׂמֹ֖אול וְלֹ֣א שָׂבֵ֑עוּ אִ֥ישׁ בְּשַׂר־זְרֹע֖וֹ יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vygzr 'lymyn vr'b vy'khl 'lshm'vl vl' shb'v 'ysh bshrzr'v y'khlv
verses.translation: And one snatcheth on the right hand, and is hungry; and he eateth on the left hand, and is not satisfied; they eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אֶת־אֶפְרַ֗יִם וְאֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶת־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יַחְדָּ֥ו הֵ֖מָּה עַל־יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּכׇל־זֹאת֙ לֹא־שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mnshh 't'prym v'prym 'tmnshh ychdv hmh 'lyhvdh bkhlz't l'shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh {s}
verses.translation: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together are against Judah. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַחֹֽקְקִ֖ים חִקְקֵי־אָ֑וֶן וּֽמְכַתְּבִ֥ים עָמָ֖ל כִּתֵּֽבוּ׃
verses.translit: hvy hchqqym chqqy'vn vmkhtbym 'ml khtbv
verses.translation: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, And to the writers that write iniquity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְהַטּ֤וֹת מִדִּין֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְלִגְזֹ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיֵּ֣י עַמִּ֑י לִֽהְי֤וֹת אַלְמָנוֹת֙ שְׁלָלָ֔ם וְאֶת־יְתוֹמִ֖ים יָבֹֽזּוּ׃
verses.translit: lhtvt mdyn dlym vlgzl mshpt 'nyy 'my lhyvt 'lmnvt shllm v'tytvmym ybzv
verses.translation: To turn aside the needy from judgment, And to take away the right of the poor of My people, That widows may be their spoil, And that they may make the fatherless their prey!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַֽה־תַּעֲשׂוּ֙ לְי֣וֹם פְּקֻדָּ֔ה וּלְשׁוֹאָ֖ה מִמֶּרְחָ֣ק תָּב֑וֹא עַל־מִי֙ תָּנ֣וּסוּ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה וְאָ֥נָה תַעַזְב֖וּ כְּבוֹדְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vmht'shv lyvm pqdh vlshv'h mmrchq tbv' 'lmy tnvsv l'zrh v'nh t'zbv khbvdkhm
verses.translation: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, And in the ruin which shall come from far? To whom will ye flee for help? And where will ye leave your glory?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֤י כָרַע֙ תַּ֣חַת אַסִּ֔יר וְתַ֥חַת הֲרוּגִ֖ים יִפֹּ֑לוּ בְּכׇל־זֹאת֙ לֹא־שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: blty khr' tcht 'syr vtcht hrvgym yplv bkhlz't l'shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh {p}
verses.translation: They can do nought except crouch under the captives, And fall under the slain. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand is stretched out still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וֹי אַשּׁ֖וּר שֵׁ֣בֶט אַפִּ֑י וּמַטֶּה־ה֥וּא בְיָדָ֖ם זַעְמִֽי׃
verses.translit: hvy 'shvr shbt 'py vmthhv' bydm z'my
verses.translation: O Asshur, the rod of Mine anger, In whose hand as a staff is Mine indignation!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּג֤וֹי חָנֵף֙ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔נּוּ וְעַל־עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ וְלָבֹ֣ז בַּ֔ז (ולשימו) [וּלְשׂוּמ֥וֹ] מִרְמָ֖ס כְּחֹ֥מֶר חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: bgvy chnf 'shlchnv v'l'm 'brty 'tsvnv lshll shll vlbz bz (vlshymv) [vlshvmv] mrms khchmr chvtsvt
verses.translation: I do send him against an ungodly nation, And against the people of My wrath do I give him a charge, To take the spoil, and to take the prey, And to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּא֙ לֹא־כֵ֣ן יְדַמֶּ֔ה וּלְבָב֖וֹ לֹא־כֵ֣ן יַחְשֹׁ֑ב כִּ֚י לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד בִּלְבָב֔וֹ וּלְהַכְרִ֥ית גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א מְעָֽט׃
verses.translit: vhv' l'khn ydmh vlbbv l'khn ychshb khy lhshmyd blbbv vlhkhryt gvym l' m't
verses.translation: Howbeit he meaneth not so, Neither doth his heart think so; But it is in his heart to destroy, And to cut off nations not a few.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֖י יֹאמַ֑ר הֲלֹ֥א שָׂרַ֛י יַחְדָּ֖ו מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy y'mr hl' shry ychdv mlkhym
verses.translation: For he saith: ‘Are not my princes all of them kings?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֥א כְּכַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ כַּלְנ֑וֹ אִם־לֹ֤א כְאַרְפַּד֙ חֲמָ֔ת אִם־לֹ֥א כְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: hl' khkhrkhmysh khlnv 'ml' kh'rpd chmt 'ml' khdmshq shmrvn
verses.translation: Is not Calno as Carchemish? Is not Hamath as Arpad? Is not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ מָצְאָ֣ה יָדִ֔י לְמַמְלְכֹ֖ת הָאֱלִ֑יל וּפְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם מִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וּמִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: kh'shr mts'h ydy lmmlkht h'lyl vpsylyhm myrvshl͏m vmshmrvn
verses.translation: As my hand hath reached the kingdoms of the idols, Whose graven images did exceed them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֗א כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי לְשֹׁמְר֖וֹן וְלֶאֱלִילֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֛ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וְלַעֲצַבֶּֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hl' kh'shr 'shyty lshmrvn vl'lylyh khn ''shh lyrvshl͏m vl'tsbyh {p}
verses.translation: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, So do to Jerusalem and her idols?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־יְבַצַּ֤ע אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־מַֽעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ בְּהַ֥ר צִיּ֖וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם אֶפְקֹ֗ד עַל־פְּרִֽי־גֹ֙דֶל֙ לְבַ֣ב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֔וּר וְעַל־תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת ר֥וּם עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhyh khyybts' 'dny 'tkhlm'shhv bhr tsyvn vbyrvshl͏m 'pqd 'lprygdl lbb mlkh'shvr v'ltp'rt rvm 'ynyv
verses.translation: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed His whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the arrogant heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his haughty looks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר בְּכֹ֤חַ יָדִי֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי וּבְחׇכְמָתִ֖י כִּ֣י נְבֻנ֑וֹתִי וְאָסִ֣יר  גְּבוּלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֗ים (ועתידתיהם) [וַעֲתֽוּדֹתֵיהֶם֙] שׁוֹשֵׂ֔תִי וְאוֹרִ֥יד כַּאבִּ֖יר יוֹשְׁבִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy 'mr bkhch ydy 'shyty vbchkhmty khy nbnvty v'syr  gbvlt 'mym (v'tydtyhm) [v'tvdtyhm] shvshty v'vryd kh'byr yvshbym
verses.translation: For he hath said: By the strength of my hand I have done it, And by my wisdom, for I am prudent; In that I have removed the bounds of the peoples, And have robbed their treasures, And have brought down as one mighty the inhabitants;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּמְצָ֨א כַקֵּ֤ן ׀ יָדִי֙ לְחֵ֣יל הָעַמִּ֔ים וְכֶֽאֱסֹף֙ בֵּיצִ֣ים עֲזֻב֔וֹת כׇּל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲנִ֣י אָסָ֑פְתִּי וְלֹ֤א הָיָה֙ נֹדֵ֣ד כָּנָ֔ף וּפֹצֶ֥ה פֶ֖ה וּמְצַפְצֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vtmts' khqn  ydy lchyl h'mym vkh'sf bytsym 'zbvt khlh'rts 'ny 'spty vl' hyh ndd khnf vptsh ph vmtsptsf
verses.translation: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the peoples; And as one gathereth eggs that are forsaken, Have I gathered all the earth; And there was none that moved the wing, Or that opened mouth, or chirped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִתְפָּאֵר֙ הַגַּרְזֶ֔ן עַ֖ל הַחֹצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ אִם־יִתְגַּדֵּ֤ל הַמַּשּׂוֹר֙ עַל־מְנִיפ֔וֹ כְּהָנִ֥יף שֵׁ֙בֶט֙ וְאֶת־מְרִימָ֔יו כְּהָרִ֥ים מַטֶּ֖ה לֹא־עֵֽץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hytp'r hgrzn 'l hchtsb bv 'mytgdl hmshvr 'lmnypv khhnyf shbt v'tmrymyv khhrym mth l''ts {p}
verses.translation: Should the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? Should the saw magnify itself against him that moveth it? As if a rod should move them that lift it up, Or as if a staff should lift up him that is not wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן יְשַׁלַּ֨ח הָאָד֜וֹן יְהֹוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּמִשְׁמַנָּ֖יו רָז֑וֹן וְתַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּיק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: lkhn yshlch h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt bmshmnyv rzvn vtcht khbdv yqd yqd khyqvd 'sh
verses.translation: Therefore will the Lord, the LORD of hosts, Send among his fat ones leanness; And under his glory there shall be kindled A burning like the burning of fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה אֽוֹר־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְאֵ֔שׁ וּקְדוֹשׁ֖וֹ לְלֶהָבָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֗ה וְאָכְלָ֛ה שִׁית֥וֹ וּשְׁמִיר֖וֹ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'vryshr'l l'sh vqdvshv llhbh vb'rh v'khlh shytv vshmyrv byvm 'chd
verses.translation: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, And his Holy One for a flame; And it shall burn and devour his thorns And his briers in one day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְב֤וֹד יַעְרוֹ֙ וְכַרְמִלּ֔וֹ מִנֶּ֥פֶשׁ וְעַד־בָּשָׂ֖ר יְכַלֶּ֑ה וְהָיָ֖ה כִּמְסֹ֥ס נֹסֵֽס׃
verses.translit: vkhbvd y'rv vkhrmlv mnpsh v'dbshr ykhlh vhyh khmss nss
verses.translation: And the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, He will consume both soul and body; And it shall be as when a sick man wasteth away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֥ר עֵ֛ץ יַעְר֖וֹ מִסְפָּ֣ר יִהְי֑וּ וְנַ֖עַר יִכְתְּבֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'r 'ts y'rv mspr yhyv vn'r ykhtbm {s}
verses.translation: And the remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, That a child may write them down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹא־יוֹסִ֨יף ע֜וֹד שְׁאָ֤ר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפְלֵיטַ֣ת בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֔ב לְהִשָּׁעֵ֖ן עַל־מַכֵּ֑הוּ וְנִשְׁעַ֗ן עַל־יְהֹוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' l'yvsyf 'vd sh'r yshr'l vplytt byty'qb lhsh'n 'lmkhhv vnsh'n 'lyhvh qdvsh yshr'l b'mt
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the remnant of Israel, And they that are escaped of the house of Jacob, Shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; But shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁאָ֥ר יָשׁ֖וּב שְׁאָ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֶל־אֵ֖ל גִּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: sh'r yshvb sh'r y'qb 'l'l gbvr
verses.translation: A remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, Unto God the Mighty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־יִהְיֶ֞ה עַמְּךָ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם שְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּלָּי֥וֹן חָר֖וּץ שׁוֹטֵ֥ף צְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 'myhyh 'mkh yshr'l khchvl hym sh'r yshvb bv khlyvn chrvts shvtf tsdqh
verses.translation: For though thy people, O Israel, be as the sand of the sea, Only a remnant of them shall return; An extermination is determined, overflowing with righteousness. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָלָ֖ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֑ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת עֹשֶׂ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy khlh vnchrtsh 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'shh bqrb khlh'rts {p}
verses.translation: For an extermination wholly determined Shall the Lord, the GOD of hosts, make in the midst of all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת אַל־תִּירָ֥א עַמִּ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן מֵאַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט יַכֶּ֔כָּה וּמַטֵּ֥הוּ יִשָּֽׂא־עָלֶ֖יךָ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'ltyr' 'my yshb tsyvn m'shvr bshbt ykhkhh vmthv ysh''lykh bdrkh mtsrym
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, the GOD of hosts: O My people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of Asshur, though he smite thee with the rod, and lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ע֖וֹד מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֑ר וְכָ֣לָה זַ֔עַם וְאַפִּ֖י עַל־תַּבְלִיתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy'vd m't mz'r vkhlh z'm v'py 'ltblytm
verses.translation: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall be accomplished, and Mine anger shall be to their destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעוֹרֵ֨ר עָלָ֜יו יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שׁ֔וֹט כְּמַכַּ֥ת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּצ֣וּר עוֹרֵ֑ב וּמַטֵּ֙הוּ֙ עַל־הַיָּ֔ם וּנְשָׂא֖וֹ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'vrr 'lyv yhvh tsb'vt shvt khmkht mdyn btsvr 'vrb vmthv 'lhym vnsh'v bdrkh mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up against him a scourge, as in the slaughter of Midian at the Rock of Oreb; and as His rod was over the sea, so shall He lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָס֤וּר סֻבֳּלוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל שִׁכְמֶ֔ךָ וְעֻלּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֑ךָ וְחֻבַּ֥ל עֹ֖ל מִפְּנֵי־שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' ysvr sblv m'l shkhmkh v'lv m'l tsv'rkh vchbl 'l mpnyshmn
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that His burden shall depart from off thy shoulder, And his yoke from off thy neck, And the yoke shall be destroyed by reason of fatness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֥א עַל־עַיַּ֖ת עָבַ֣ר בְּמִגְר֑וֹן לְמִכְמָ֖שׂ יַפְקִ֥יד כֵּלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: b' 'l'yt 'br bmgrvn lmkhmsh ypqyd khlyv
verses.translation: He is come to Aiath, He is passed through Migron; At Michmas he layeth up his baggage;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָֽבְרוּ֙ מַעְבָּרָ֔ה גֶּ֖בַע מָל֣וֹן לָ֑נוּ חָֽרְדָה֙ הָרָמָ֔ה גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל נָֽסָה׃
verses.translit: 'brv m'brh gb' mlvn lnv chrdh hrmh gb't sh'vl nsh
verses.translation: They are gone over the pass; They have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah trembleth; Gibeath-shaul is fled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י קוֹלֵ֖ךְ בַּת־גַּלִּ֑ים הַקְשִׁ֥יבִי לַ֖יְשָׁה עֲנִיָּ֥ה עֲנָתֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: tshly qvlkh btglym hqshyby lyshh 'nyh 'ntvt
verses.translation: Cry thou with a shrill voice, O daughter of Gallim! Hearken, O Laish! O thou poor Anathoth!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָֽדְדָ֖ה מַדְמֵנָ֑ה יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַגֵּבִ֖ים הֵעִֽיזוּ׃
verses.translit: nddh mdmnh yshby hgbym h'yzv
verses.translation: Madmenah is in mad flight; The inhabitants of Gebim flee to cover.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֥וֹד הַיּ֖וֹם בְּנֹ֣ב לַעֲמֹ֑ד יְנֹפֵ֤ף יָדוֹ֙ הַ֣ר (בית) [בַּת־]צִיּ֔וֹן גִּבְעַ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'vd hyvm bnb l'md ynpf ydv hr (byt) [bt]tsyvn gb't yrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: This very day shall he halt at Nob, Shaking his hand at the mount of the daughter of Zion, The hill of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הָאָדוֹן֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְסָעֵ֥ף פֻּארָ֖ה בְּמַעֲרָצָ֑ה וְרָמֵ֤י הַקּוֹמָה֙ גְּדוּעִ֔ים וְהַגְּבֹהִ֖ים יִשְׁפָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: hnh h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt ms'f p'rh bm'rtsh vrmy hqvmh gdv'ym vhgbhym yshplv
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, Shall lop the boughs with terror; And the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, And the lofty shall be laid low.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִקַּ֛ף סִֽבְכֵ֥י הַיַּ֖עַר בַּבַּרְזֶ֑ל וְהַלְּבָנ֖וֹן בְּאַדִּ֥יר יִפּֽוֹל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnqf sbkhy hy'r bbrzl vhlbnvn b'dyr ypvl {s}
verses.translation: And He shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, And Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֥א חֹ֖טֶר מִגֵּ֣זַע יִשָׁ֑י וְנֵ֖צֶר מִשׇּׁרָשָׁ֥יו יִפְרֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts' chtr mgz' yshy vntsr mshrshyv yprh
verses.translation: And there shall come forth a shoot out of the stock of Jesse, And a twig shall grow forth out of his roots.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָחָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֣וּחַ יְהֹוָ֑ה ר֧וּחַ חׇכְמָ֣ה וּבִינָ֗ה ר֤וּחַ עֵצָה֙ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה ר֥וּחַ דַּ֖עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnchh 'lyv rvch yhvh rvch chkhmh vbynh rvch 'tsh vgbvrh rvch d't vyr't yhvh
verses.translation: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, The spirit of wisdom and understanding, The spirit of counsel and might, The spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲרִיח֖וֹ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־לְמַרְאֵ֤ה עֵינָיו֙ יִשְׁפּ֔וֹט וְלֹא־לְמִשְׁמַ֥ע אׇזְנָ֖יו יוֹכִֽיחַ׃
verses.translit: vhrychv byr't yhvh vl'lmr'h 'ynyv yshpvt vl'lmshm' 'znyv yvkhych
verses.translation: And his delight shall be in the fear of the LORD; And he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, Neither decide after the hearing of his ears;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁפַ֤ט בְּצֶ֙דֶק֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ בְּמִישׁ֖וֹר לְעַנְוֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְהִֽכָּה־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔יו וּבְר֥וּחַ שְׂפָתָ֖יו יָמִ֥ית רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: vshpt btsdq dlym vhvkhych bmyshvr l'nvy'rts vhkhh'rts bshbt pyv vbrvch shptyv ymyt rsh'
verses.translation: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, And decide with equity for the meek of the land; And he shall smite the land with the rod of his mouth, And with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֥יָה צֶ֖דֶק אֵז֣וֹר מׇתְנָ֑יו וְהָאֱמוּנָ֖ה אֵז֥וֹר חֲלָצָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhyh tsdq 'zvr mtnyv vh'mvnh 'zvr chltsyv
verses.translation: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, And faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגָ֤ר זְאֵב֙ עִם־כֶּ֔בֶשׂ וְנָמֵ֖ר עִם־גְּדִ֣י יִרְבָּ֑ץ וְעֵ֨גֶל וּכְפִ֤יר וּמְרִיא֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְנַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן נֹהֵ֥ג בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vgr z'b 'mkhbsh vnmr 'mgdy yrbts v'gl vkhpyr vmry' ychdv vn'r qtn nhg bm
verses.translation: And the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, And the leopard shall lie down with the kid; And the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; And a little child shall lead them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָרָ֤ה וָדֹב֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה יַחְדָּ֖ו יִרְבְּצ֣וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן וְאַרְיֵ֖ה כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכַל־תֶּֽבֶן׃
verses.translit: vprh vdb tr'ynh ychdv yrbtsv yldyhn v'ryh khbqr y'khltbn
verses.translation: And the cow and the bear feed; Their young ones shall lie down together; And the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִֽׁעֲשַׁ֥ע יוֹנֵ֖ק עַל־חֻ֣ר פָּ֑תֶן וְעַל֙ מְאוּרַ֣ת צִפְעוֹנִ֔י גָּמ֖וּל יָד֥וֹ הָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vsh'sh' yvnq 'lchr ptn v'l m'vrt tsp'vny gmvl ydv hdh
verses.translation: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, And the weaned child shall put his hand on the basilisk’s den.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יָרֵ֥עוּ וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁחִ֖יתוּ בְּכׇל־הַ֣ר קׇדְשִׁ֑י כִּֽי־מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'yr'v vl'yshchytv bkhlhr qdshy khyml'h h'rts d'h 'tyhvh khmym lym mkhsym {s}
verses.translation: They shall not hurt nor destroy In all My holy mountain; For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ יִשַׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹמֵד֙ לְנֵ֣ס עַמִּ֔ים אֵלָ֖יו גּוֹיִ֣ם יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה מְנֻחָת֖וֹ כָּבֽוֹד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' shrsh yshy 'shr 'md lns 'mym 'lyv gvym ydrshv vhyth mnchtv khbvd {p}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the root of Jesse, that standeth for an ensign of the peoples, Unto him shall the nations seek; And his resting-place shall be glorious.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יוֹסִ֨יף אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שֵׁנִית֙ יָד֔וֹ לִקְנ֖וֹת אֶת־שְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁאֵר֩ מֵאַשּׁ֨וּר וּמִמִּצְרַ֜יִם וּמִפַּתְר֣וֹס וּמִכּ֗וּשׁ וּמֵעֵילָ֤ם וּמִשִּׁנְעָר֙ וּמֵ֣חֲמָ֔ת וּמֵאִיֵּ֖י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' yvsyf 'dny  shnyt ydv lqnvt 'tsh'r 'mv 'shr ysh'r m'shvr vmmtsrym vmptrvs vmkhvsh vm'ylm vmshn'r vmchmt vm'yy hym
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the Lord will set His hand again the second time To recover the remnant of His people, That shall remain from Assyria, and from Egypt, And from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, And from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֥א נֵס֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאָסַ֖ף נִדְחֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּנְפֻצ֤וֹת יְהוּדָה֙ יְקַבֵּ֔ץ מֵאַרְבַּ֖ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vnsh' ns lgvym v'sf ndchy yshr'l vnptsvt yhvdh yqbts m'rb' khnpvt h'rts
verses.translation: And He will set up an ensign for the nations, And will assemble the dispersed of Israel, And gather together the scattered of Judah From the four corners of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָ֙רָה֙ קִנְאַ֣ת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְצֹרְרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹא־יְקַנֵּ֣א אֶת־יְהוּדָ֔ה וִיהוּדָ֖ה לֹא־יָצֹ֥ר אֶת־אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vsrh qn't 'prym vtsrry yhvdh ykhrtv 'prym l'yqn' 'tyhvdh vyhvdh l'ytsr 't'prym
verses.translation: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, And they that harass Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim shall not envy Judah, And Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָפ֨וּ בְכָתֵ֤ף פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ יָ֔מָּה יַחְדָּ֖ו יָבֹ֣זּוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־קֶ֑דֶם אֱד֤וֹם וּמוֹאָב֙ מִשְׁל֣וֹחַ יָדָ֔ם וּבְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'pv bkhtf plshtym ymh ychdv ybzv 'tbnyqdm 'dvm vmv'b mshlvch ydm vbny 'mvn mshm'tm
verses.translation: And they shall fly down upon the shoulder of the Philistines on the west; Together shall they spoil the children of the east; They shall put forth their hand upon Edom and Moab; And the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶחֱרִ֣ים יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵ֚ת לְשׁ֣וֹן יָם־מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהֵנִ֥יף יָד֛וֹ עַל־הַנָּהָ֖ר בַּעְיָ֣ם רוּח֑וֹ וְהִכָּ֙הוּ֙ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה נְחָלִ֔ים וְהִדְרִ֖יךְ בַּנְּעָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhchrym yhvh 't lshvn ymmtsrym vhnyf ydv 'lhnhr b'ym rvchv vhkhhv lshb'h nchlym vhdrykh bn'lym
verses.translation: And the LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; And with His scorching wind will He shake His hand over the River, And will smite it into seven streams, And cause men to march over dry-shod.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֣ה מְסִלָּ֔ה לִשְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׁאֵ֖ר מֵאַשּׁ֑וּר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הָֽיְתָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּי֥וֹם עֲלֹת֖וֹ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhyth mslh lsh'r 'mv 'shr ysh'r m'shvr kh'shr hyth lyshr'l byvm 'ltv m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And there shall be a highway for the remnant of His people, That shall remain from Assyria, Like as there was for Israel In the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אוֹדְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנַ֖פְתָּ בִּ֑י יָשֹׁ֥ב אַפְּךָ֖ וּֽתְנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: v'mrt byvm hhv' 'vdkh yhvh khy 'npt by yshb 'pkh vtnchmny
verses.translation: And in that day thou shalt say: ‘I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD; For though Thou was angry with me, Thine anger is turned away, and Thou comfortest me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֵ֧ל יְשׁוּעָתִ֛י אֶבְטַ֖ח וְלֹ֣א אֶפְחָ֑ד כִּֽי־עׇזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֣הּ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־לִ֖י לִישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh 'l yshv'ty 'btch vl' 'pchd khy'zy vzmrt yh yhvh vyhyly lyshv'h
verses.translation: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid; For GOD the LORD is my strength and song; And He is become my salvation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם־מַ֖יִם בְּשָׂשׂ֑וֹן מִמַּעַיְנֵ֖י הַיְשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vsh'btmmym bshshvn mm'yny hyshv'h
verses.translation: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water Out of the wells of salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֞ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִילֹתָ֑יו הַזְכִּ֕ירוּ כִּ֥י נִשְׂגָּ֖ב שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mrtm byvm hhv' hvdv lyhvh qr'v bshmv hvdy'v b'mym 'lyltyv hzkhyrv khy nshgb shmv
verses.translation: And in that day shall ye say: ‘Give thanks unto the LORD, proclaim His name, Declare His doings among the peoples, Make mention that His name is exalted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י גֵא֖וּת עָשָׂ֑ה (מידעת) [מוּדַ֥עַת] זֹ֖את בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: zmrv yhvh khy g'vt 'shh (myd't) [mvd't] z't bkhlh'rts
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD; for He hath done gloriously; This is made known in all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tshly vrny yvshbt tsyvn khygdvl bqrbkh qdvsh yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion, For great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בָּבֶ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־אָמֽוֹץ׃
verses.translit: msh' bbl 'shr chzh ysh'yhv bn'mvts
verses.translation: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר־נִשְׁפֶּה֙ שְֽׂאוּ־נֵ֔ס הָרִ֥ימוּ ק֖וֹל לָהֶ֑ם הָנִ֣יפוּ יָ֔ד וְיָבֹ֖אוּ פִּתְחֵ֥י נְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'l hrnshph sh'vns hrymv qvl lhm hnypv yd vyb'v ptchy ndybym
verses.translation: Set ye up an ensign upon the high mountain, Lift up the voice unto them, Wave the hand, that they may go Into the gates of the nobles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י צִוֵּ֖יתִי לִמְקֻדָּשָׁ֑י גַּ֣ם קָרָ֤אתִי גִבּוֹרַי֙ לְאַפִּ֔י עַלִּיזֵ֖י גַּאֲוָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ny tsvyty lmqdshy gm qr'ty gbvry l'py 'lyzy g'vty
verses.translation: I have commanded My consecrated ones, Yea, I have called My mighty ones for mine anger, Even My proudly exulting ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֥וֹל הָמ֛וֹן בֶּהָרִ֖ים דְּמ֣וּת עַם־רָ֑ב ק֠וֹל שְׁא֞וֹן מַמְלְכ֤וֹת גּוֹיִם֙ נֶאֱסָפִ֔ים יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְפַקֵּ֖ד צְבָ֥א מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: qvl hmvn bhrym dmvt 'mrb qvl sh'vn mmlkhvt gvym n'spym yhvh tsb'vt mpqd tsb' mlchmh
verses.translation: Hark, a tumult in the mountains, Like as of a great people! Hark, the uproar of the kingdoms Of the nations gathered together! The LORD of hosts mustereth The host of the battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּאִ֛ים מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָ֖ק מִקְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם יְהֹוָה֙ וּכְלֵ֣י זַעְמ֔וֹ לְחַבֵּ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b'ym m'rts mrchq mqtsh hshmym yhvh vkhly z'mv lchbl khlh'rts {s}
verses.translation: They come from a far country, From the end of heaven, Even the LORD, and the weapons of His indignation, To destroy the whole earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵילִ֕ילוּ כִּ֥י קָר֖וֹב י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֑ה כְּשֹׁ֖ד מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: hylylv khy qrvb yvm yhvh khshd mshdy ybv'
verses.translation: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; As destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֖ן כׇּל־יָדַ֣יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְכׇל־לְבַ֥ב אֱנ֖וֹשׁ יִמָּֽס׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn khlydym trpynh vkhllbb 'nvsh yms
verses.translation: Therefore shall all hands be slack, And every heart of man shall melt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽנִבְהָ֓לוּ  צִירִ֤ים וַחֲבָלִים֙ יֹֽאחֵז֔וּן כַּיּוֹלֵדָ֖ה יְחִיל֑וּן אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ יִתְמָ֔הוּ פְּנֵ֥י לְהָבִ֖ים פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vnbhlv  tsyrym vchblym y'chzvn khyvldh ychylvn 'ysh 'lr'hv ytmhv pny lhbym pnyhm
verses.translation: And they shall be affrighted; Pangs and throes shall take hold of them; They shall be in pain as a woman in travail; They shall look aghast one at another; Their faces shall be faces of flame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יוֹם־יְהֹוָה֙ בָּ֔א אַכְזָרִ֥י וְעֶבְרָ֖ה וַחֲר֣וֹן אָ֑ף לָשׂ֤וּם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְחַטָּאֶ֖יהָ יַשְׁמִ֥יד מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: hnh yvmyhvh b' 'khzry v'brh vchrvn 'f lshvm h'rts lshmh vcht'yh yshmyd mmnh
verses.translation: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, Cruel, and full of wrath and fierce anger; To make the earth a desolation, And to destroy the sinners thereof out of it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־כוֹכְבֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּכְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יָהֵ֖לּוּ אוֹרָ֑ם חָשַׁ֤ךְ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ בְּצֵאת֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖חַ לֹא־יַגִּ֥יהַּ אוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khykhvkhby hshmym vkhsylyhm l' yhlv 'vrm chshkh hshmsh bts'tv vyrch l'ygyh 'vrv
verses.translation: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof Shall not give their light; The sun shall be darkened in his going forth, And the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֤י עַל־תֵּבֵל֙ רָעָ֔ה וְעַל־רְשָׁעִ֖ים עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן זֵדִ֔ים וְגַאֲוַ֥ת עָרִיצִ֖ים אַשְׁפִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: vpqdty 'ltbl r'h v'lrsh'ym 'vnm vhshbty g'vn zdym vg'vt 'rytsym 'shpyl
verses.translation: And I will visit upon the world their evil, And upon the wicked their iniquity; And I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, And will lay low the haughtiness of the tyrants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹקִ֥יר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִפָּ֑ז וְאָדָ֖ם מִכֶּ֥תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.translit: 'vqyr 'nvsh mpz v'dm mkhtm 'vpyr
verses.translation: I will make man more rare than fine gold, Even man than the pure gold of Ophir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם אַרְגִּ֔יז וְתִרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ בְּעֶבְרַת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבְי֖וֹם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn shmym 'rgyz vtr'sh h'rts mmqvmh b'brt yhvh tsb'vt vbyvm chrvn 'pv
verses.translation: Therefore I will make the heavens to tremble, And the earth shall be shaken out of her place, For the wrath of the LORD of hosts, And for the day of His fierce anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּצְבִ֣י מֻדָּ֔ח וּכְצֹ֖אן וְאֵ֣ין מְקַבֵּ֑ץ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־עַמּוֹ֙ יִפְנ֔וּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶל־אַרְצ֖וֹ יָנֽוּסוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khtsby mdch vkhts'n v'yn mqbts 'ysh 'l'mv ypnv v'ysh 'l'rtsv ynvsv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that as the chased gazelle, And as sheep that no man gathereth, They shall turn every man to his own people, And shall flee every man to his own land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַנִּמְצָ֖א יִדָּקֵ֑ר וְכׇל־הַנִּסְפֶּ֖ה יִפּ֥וֹל בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: khlhnmts' ydqr vkhlhnsph ypvl bchrb
verses.translation: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; And every one that is caught shall fall by the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֹלְלֵיהֶ֥ם יְרֻטְּשׁ֖וּ לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם יִשַּׁ֙סּוּ֙ בָּתֵּיהֶ֔ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם (תשגלנה) [תִּשָּׁכַֽבְנָה]׃
verses.translit: v'llyhm yrtshv l'ynyhm yshsv btyhm vnshyhm (tshglnh) [tshkhbnh]
verses.translation: Their babes also shall be dashed in pieces before their eyes; Their houses shall be spoiled, And their wives ravished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֛י מֵעִ֥יר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אֶת־מָדָ֑י אֲשֶׁר־כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לֹ֣א יַחְשֹׁ֔בוּ וְזָהָ֖ב לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ־בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnny m'yr 'lyhm 'tmdy 'shrkhsf l' ychshbv vzhb l' ychptsvbv
verses.translation: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, Who shall not regard silver, And as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּקְשָׁת֖וֹת נְעָרִ֣ים תְּרַטַּ֑שְׁנָה וּפְרִי־בֶ֙טֶן֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ עַל־בָּנִ֖ים לֹא־תָח֥וּס עֵינָֽם׃
verses.translit: vqshtvt n'rym trtshnh vprybtn l' yrchmv 'lbnym l'tchvs 'ynm
verses.translation: And their bows shall dash the young men in pieces; And they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; Their eye shall not spare children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה בָבֶל֙ צְבִ֣י מַמְלָכ֔וֹת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּא֣וֹן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־סְדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־עֲמֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyth bbl tsby mmlkhvt tp'rt g'vn khshdym khmhpkht 'lhym 'tsdm v't'mrh
verses.translation: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, The beauty of the Chaldeans’pride, Shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תֵשֵׁ֣ב לָנֶ֔צַח וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁכֹּ֖ן עַד־דּ֣וֹר וָד֑וֹר וְלֹא־יַהֵ֥ל שָׁם֙ עֲרָבִ֔י וְרֹעִ֖ים לֹא־יַרְבִּ֥צוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: l'tshb lntsch vl' tshkhn 'ddvr vdvr vl'yhl shm 'rby vr'ym l'yrbtsv shm
verses.translation: It shall never be inhabited, Neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation; Neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; Neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָבְצוּ־שָׁ֣ם צִיִּ֔ים וּמָלְא֥וּ בָתֵּיהֶ֖ם אֹחִ֑ים וְשָׁ֤כְנוּ שָׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת יַעֲנָ֔ה וּשְׂעִירִ֖ים יְרַקְּדוּ־שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vrbtsvshm tsyym vml'v btyhm 'chym vshkhnv shm bnvt y'nh vsh'yrym yrqdvshm
verses.translation: But wild-cats shall lie there; And their houses shall be full of ferrets; And ostriches shall dwell there, And satyrs shall dance there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָנָ֤ה אִיִּים֙ בְּאַלְמְנוֹתָ֔יו וְתַנִּ֖ים בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי עֹ֑נֶג וְקָר֤וֹב לָבוֹא֙ עִתָּ֔הּ וְיָמֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א יִמָּשֵֽׁכוּ׃
verses.translit: v'nh 'yym b'lmnvtyv vtnym bhykhly 'ng vqrvb lbv' 'th vymyh l' ymshkhv
verses.translation: And jackals shall howl in their castles, And wild-dogs in the pleasant palaces; And her time is near to come, And her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְרַחֵ֨ם יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֗ב וּבָחַ֥ר עוֹד֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם עַל־אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְנִלְוָ֤ה הַגֵּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנִסְפְּח֖וּ עַל־בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: khy yrchm yhvh 'ty'qb vbchr 'vd byshr'l vhnychm 'l'dmtm vnlvh hgr 'lyhm vnspchv 'lbyt y'qb
verses.translation: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land; and the stranger shall join himself with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְקָח֣וּם עַמִּים֮ וֶהֱבִיא֣וּם אֶל־מְקוֹמָם֒ וְהִֽתְנַחֲל֣וּם בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְלִשְׁפָח֑וֹת וְהָיוּ֙ שֹׁבִ֣ים לְשֹׁבֵיהֶ֔ם וְרָד֖וּ בְּנֹגְשֵׂיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlqchvm 'mym vhby'vm 'lmqvmm vhtnchlvm bytyshr'l 'l 'dmt yhvh l'bdym vlshpchvt vhyv shbym lshbyhm vrdv bngshyhm {s}
verses.translation: And the peoples shall take them, and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and for handmaids; and they shall take them captive, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּי֨וֹם הָנִ֤יחַ יְהֹוָה֙ לְךָ֔ מֵֽעׇצְבְּךָ֖ וּמִֽרׇגְזֶ֑ךָ וּמִן־הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַקָּשָׁ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֻבַּד־בָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hnych yhvh lkh m'tsbkh vmrgzkh vmnh'bdh hqshh 'shr 'bdbkh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy travail, and from thy trouble, and from the hard service wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֜אתָ הַמָּשָׁ֥ל הַזֶּ֛ה עַל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְאָמָ֑רְתָּ אֵ֚יךְ שָׁבַ֣ת נֹגֵ֔שׂ שָׁבְתָ֖ה מַדְהֵבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnsh't hmshl hzh 'lmlkh bbl v'mrt 'ykh shbt ngsh shbth mdhbh
verses.translation: that thou shalt take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say: How hath the oppressor ceased! The exactress of gold ceased!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁבַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה מַטֵּ֣ה רְשָׁעִ֑ים שֵׁ֖בֶט מֹשְׁלִֽים׃
verses.translit: shbr yhvh mth rsh'ym shbt mshlym
verses.translation: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, the sceptre of the rulers,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַכֶּ֤ה עַמִּים֙ בְּעֶבְרָ֔ה מַכַּ֖ת בִּלְתִּ֣י סָרָ֑ה רֹדֶ֤ה בָאַף֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם מֻרְדָּ֖ף בְּלִ֥י חָשָֽׂךְ׃
verses.translit: mkhh 'mym b'brh mkht blty srh rdh b'f gvym mrdf bly chshkh
verses.translation: That smote the peoples in wrath with an incessant stroke, that ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that none restrained.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָ֥חָה שָׁקְטָ֖ה כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פָּצְח֖וּ רִנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: nchh shqth khlh'rts ptschv rnh
verses.translation: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet; they break forth into singing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־בְּרוֹשִׁ֛ים שָׂמְח֥וּ לְךָ֖ אַרְזֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן מֵאָ֣ז שָׁכַ֔בְתָּ לֹא־יַעֲלֶ֥ה הַכֹּרֵ֖ת עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: gmbrvshym shmchv lkh 'rzy lbnvn m'z shkhbt l'y'lh hkhrt 'lynv
verses.translation: Yea, the cypresses rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon: ‘Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁא֗וֹל מִתַּ֛חַת רָגְזָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לִקְרַ֣את בּוֹאֶ֑ךָ עוֹרֵ֨ר לְךָ֤ רְפָאִים֙ כׇּל־עַתּ֣וּדֵי אָ֔רֶץ הֵקִים֙ מִכִּסְאוֹתָ֔ם כֹּ֖ל מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: sh'vl mtcht rgzh lkh lqr't bv'kh 'vrr lkh rp'ym khl'tvdy 'rts hqym mkhs'vtm khl mlkhy gvym
verses.translation: The nether-world from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming; the shades are stirred up for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; all the kings of the nations are raised up from their thrones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣ם יַעֲנ֔וּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ גַּם־אַתָּ֛ה חֻלֵּ֥יתָ כָמ֖וֹנוּ אֵלֵ֥ינוּ נִמְשָֽׁלְתָּ׃
verses.translit: khlm y'nv vy'mrv 'lykh gm'th chlyt khmvnv 'lynv nmshlt
verses.translation: All they do answer And say unto thee: ‘Art thou also become weak as we? Art thou become like unto us?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוּרַ֥ד שְׁא֛וֹל גְּאוֹנֶ֖ךָ הֶמְיַ֣ת נְבָלֶ֑יךָ תַּחְתֶּ֙יךָ֙ יֻצַּ֣ע רִמָּ֔ה וּמְכַסֶּ֖יךָ תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃
verses.translit: hvrd sh'vl g'vnkh hmyt nblykh tchtykh yts' rmh vmkhsykh tvl'h
verses.translation: Thy pomp is brought down to the nether-world, And the noise of thy psalteries; the maggot is spread under thee, And the worms cover thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛יךְ נָפַ֥לְתָּ מִשָּׁמַ֖יִם הֵילֵ֣ל בֶּן־שָׁ֑חַר נִגְדַּ֣עְתָּ לָאָ֔רֶץ חוֹלֵ֖שׁ עַל־גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ykh nplt mshmym hyll bnshchr ngd't l'rts chvlsh 'lgvym
verses.translation: How art thou fallen from heaven, O day-star, son of the morning! How art thou cut down to the ground, That didst cast lots over the nations!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ בִֽלְבָבְךָ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֶעֱלֶ֔ה מִמַּ֥עַל לְכוֹכְבֵי־אֵ֖ל אָרִ֣ים כִּסְאִ֑י וְאֵשֵׁ֥ב בְּהַר־מוֹעֵ֖ד בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'th 'mrt blbbkh hshmym ''lh mm'l lkhvkhby'l 'rym khs'y v'shb bhrmv'd byrkhty tspvn
verses.translation: And thou saidst in thy heart: ‘I will ascend into heaven, Above the stars of God Will I exalt my throne, And I will sit upon the mount of meeting, In the uttermost parts of the north;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶעֱלֶ֖ה עַל־בָּ֣מֳתֵי עָ֑ב אֶדַּמֶּ֖ה לְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: ''lh 'lbmty 'b 'dmh l'lyvn
verses.translation: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the Most High.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ אֶל־שְׁא֛וֹל תּוּרָ֖ד אֶל־יַרְכְּתֵי־בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'kh 'lsh'vl tvrd 'lyrkhtybvr
verses.translation: Yet thou shalt be brought down to the nether-world, To the uttermost parts of the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹאֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יַשְׁגִּ֔יחוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ יִתְבּוֹנָ֑נוּ הֲזֶ֤ה הָאִישׁ֙ מַרְגִּ֣יז הָאָ֔רֶץ מַרְעִ֖ישׁ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: r'ykh 'lykh yshgychv 'lykh ytbvnnv hzh h'ysh mrgyz h'rts mr'ysh mmlkhvt
verses.translation: They that saw thee do narrowly look upon thee, They gaze earnestly at thee: ‘Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, That did shake kingdoms;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֥ם תֵּבֵ֛ל כַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְעָרָ֣יו הָרָ֑ס אֲסִירָ֖יו לֹא־פָ֥תַח בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.translit: shm tbl khmdbr v'ryv hrs 'syryv l'ptch byth
verses.translation: That made the world as a wilderness, And destroyed the cities thereof; That opened not the house of his prisoners?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם שָׁכְב֥וּ בְכָב֖וֹד אִ֥ישׁ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khlmlkhy gvym khlm shkhbv bkhbvd 'ysh bbytv
verses.translation: All the kings of the nations, all of them, sleep in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה הׇשְׁלַ֤כְתָּ מִֽקִּבְרְךָ֙ כְּנֵ֣צֶר נִתְעָ֔ב לְבֻ֥שׁ הֲרֻגִ֖ים מְטֹ֣עֲנֵי חָ֑רֶב יוֹרְדֵ֥י אֶל־אַבְנֵי־ב֖וֹר כְּפֶ֥גֶר מוּבָֽס׃
verses.translit: v'th hshlkht mqbrkh khntsr nt'b lbsh hrgym mt'ny chrb yvrdy 'l'bnybvr khpgr mvbs
verses.translation: But thou art cast forth away from thy grave Like an abhorred offshoot, In the raiment of the slain, that are thrust through with the sword, That go down to the pavement of the pit, As a carcass trodden under foot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תֵחַ֤ד אִתָּם֙ בִּקְבוּרָ֔ה כִּי־אַרְצְךָ֥ שִׁחַ֖תָּ עַמְּךָ֣ הָרָ֑גְתָּ לֹא־יִקָּרֵ֥א לְעוֹלָ֖ם זֶ֥רַע מְרֵעִֽים׃
verses.translit: l'tchd 'tm bqbvrh khy'rtskh shcht 'mkh hrgt l'yqr' l'vlm zr' mr'ym
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, Thou hast slain thy people; the seed of evil-doers shall not be named for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָכִ֧ינוּ לְבָנָ֛יו מַטְבֵּ֖חַ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתָ֑ם בַּל־יָקֻ֙מוּ֙ וְיָ֣רְשׁוּ אָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵי־תֵבֵ֖ל עָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: hkhynv lbnyv mtbch b'vn 'bvtm blyqmv vyrshv 'rts vml'v pnytbl 'rym
verses.translation: Prepare ye slaughter for his children For the iniquity of their fathers; That they rise not up, and possess the earth, And fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקַמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל שֵׁ֥ם וּשְׁאָ֛ר וְנִ֥ין וָנֶ֖כֶד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vqmty 'lyhm n'm yhvh tsb'vt vhkhrty lbbl shm vsh'r vnyn vnkhd n'myhvh
verses.translation: And I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and offshoot and offspring, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֛יהָ לְמוֹרַ֥שׁ קִפֹּ֖ד וְאַגְמֵי־מָ֑יִם וְטֵאטֵאתִ֙יהָ֙ בְּמַטְאֲטֵ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֔ד נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshmtyh lmvrsh qpd v'gmymym vt't'tyh bmt't' hshmd n'm yhvh tsb'vt {s}
verses.translation: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water; and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־לֹ֞א כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּמִּ֙יתִי֙ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֔תָה וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָעַ֖צְתִּי הִ֥יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh tsb'vt l'mr 'ml' kh'shr dmyty khn hyth vkh'shr y'tsty hy' tqvm
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying: Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; And as I have purposed, so shall it stand,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁבֹּ֤ר אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּאַרְצִ֔י וְעַל־הָרַ֖י אֲבוּסֶ֑נּוּ וְסָ֤ר מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם֙ עֻלּ֔וֹ וְסֻ֨בֳּל֔וֹ מֵעַ֥ל שִׁכְמ֖וֹ יָסֽוּר׃
verses.translit: lshbr 'shvr b'rtsy v'lhry 'bvsnv vsr m'lyhm 'lv vsblv m'l shkhmv ysvr
verses.translation: That I will break Asshur in My land, And upon My mountains tread him under foot; then shall his yoke depart from off them, And his burden depart from off their shoulder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֛את הָעֵצָ֥ה הַיְּעוּצָ֖ה עַל־כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזֹ֛את הַיָּ֥ד הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה עַל־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: z't h'tsh hy'vtsh 'lkhlh'rts vz't hyd hntvyh 'lkhlhgvym
verses.translation: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; And this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יָעָ֖ץ וּמִ֣י יָפֵ֑ר וְיָד֥וֹ הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה וּמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khyyhvh tsb'vt y'ts vmy ypr vydv hntvyh vmy yshybnh {p}
verses.translation: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, And who shall disannul it? And His hand is stretched out, And who shall turn it back?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת־מ֖וֹת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֑ז הָיָ֖ה הַמַּשָּׂ֥א הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: bshntmvt hmlkh 'chz hyh hmsh' hzh
verses.translation: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י פְלֶ֙שֶׁת֙ כֻּלֵּ֔ךְ כִּ֥י נִשְׁבַּ֖ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַכֵּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־מִשֹּׁ֤רֶשׁ נָחָשׁ֙ יֵ֣צֵא צֶ֔פַע וּפִרְי֖וֹ שָׂרָ֥ף מְעוֹפֵֽף׃
verses.translit: 'ltshmchy plsht khlkh khy nshbr shbt mkhkh khymshrsh nchsh yts' tsp' vpryv shrf m'vpf
verses.translation: Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of thee, Because the rod that smote thee is broken: For out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a basilisk, And his fruit shall be a flying serpent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָעוּ֙ בְּכוֹרֵ֣י דַלִּ֔ים וְאֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לָבֶ֣טַח יִרְבָּ֑צוּ וְהֵמַתִּ֤י בָרָעָב֙ שׇׁרְשֵׁ֔ךְ וּשְׁאֵרִיתֵ֖ךְ יַהֲרֹֽג׃
verses.translit: vr'v bkhvry dlym v'byvnym lbtch yrbtsv vhmty br'b shrshkh vsh'rytkh yhrg
verses.translation: And the first-born of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; and I will kill thy root with famine, and thy remnant shall be slain
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵילִ֤ילִֽי שַׁ֙עַר֙ זַֽעֲקִי־עִ֔יר נָמ֖וֹג פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת כֻּלֵּ֑ךְ כִּ֤י מִצָּפוֹן֙ עָשָׁ֣ן בָּ֔א וְאֵ֥ין בּוֹדֵ֖ד בְּמוֹעָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hylyly sh'r z'qy'yr nmvg plsht khlkh khy mtspvn 'shn b' v'yn bvdd bmv'dyv
verses.translation: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; Melt away, O Philistia, all of thee; For there cometh a smoke out of the north, And there is no straggler in his ranks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַֽה־יַּעֲנֶ֖ה מַלְאֲכֵי־ג֑וֹי כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ יִסַּ֣ד צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָ֥הּ יֶחֱס֖וּ עֲנִיֵּ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmhy'nh ml'khygvy khy yhvh ysd tsyvn vbh ychsv 'nyy 'mv {p}
verses.translation: What then shall one answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, And in her shall the afflicted of His people take refuge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מוֹאָ֑ב כִּ֠י בְּלֵ֞יל שֻׁדַּ֨ד עָ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ נִדְמָ֔ה כִּ֗י בְּלֵ֛יל שֻׁדַּ֥ד קִיר־מוֹאָ֖ב נִדְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: msh' mv'b khy blyl shdd 'r mv'b ndmh khy blyl shdd qyrmv'b ndmh
verses.translation: The burden of Moab. For in the night that Ar of Moab is laid waste, He is brought to ruin; for in the night that Kir of Moab is laid waste, He is brought to ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֨ה הַבַּ֧יִת וְדִיבֹ֛ן הַבָּמ֖וֹת לְבֶ֑כִי עַל־נְב֞וֹ וְעַ֤ל מֵֽידְבָא֙ מוֹאָ֣ב יְיֵלִ֔יל בְּכׇל־רֹאשָׁ֣יו קׇרְחָ֔ה כׇּל־זָקָ֖ן גְּרוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh hbyt vdybn hbmvt lbkhy 'lnbv v'l mydb' mv'b yylyl bkhlr'shyv qrchh khlzqn grv'h
verses.translation: He is gone up to Baith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep; upon Nebo, and upon Medeba, Moab howleth; on all their heads is baldness, every beard is shaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחוּצֹתָ֖יו חָ֣גְרוּ שָׂ֑ק עַ֣ל גַּגּוֹתֶ֧יהָ וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֛יהָ כֻּלֹּ֥ה יְיֵלִ֖יל יֹרֵ֥ד בַּבֶּֽכִי׃
verses.translit: bchvtstyv chgrv shq 'l ggvtyh vbrchbtyh khlh yylyl yrd bbkhy
verses.translation: In their streets they gird themselves with sackcloth; On their housetops, and in their broad places, Every one howleth, weeping profusely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּזְעַ֤ק חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶלְעָלֵ֔ה עַד־יַ֖הַץ נִשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלָ֑ם עַל־כֵּ֗ן חֲלֻצֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ יָרִ֔יעוּ נַפְשׁ֖וֹ יָ֥רְעָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtz'q chshbvn v'l'lh 'dyhts nshm' qvlm 'lkhn chltsy mv'b yry'v npshv yr'h lv
verses.translation: And Heshbon crieth out, and Elealeh; their voice is heard even unto Jahaz; therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; his soul is faint within him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבִּי֙ לְמוֹאָ֣ב יִזְעָ֔ק בְּרִיחֶ֕הָ עַד־צֹ֖עַר עֶגְלַ֣ת שְׁלִשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֣י  מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַלּוּחִ֗ית בִּבְכִי֙ יַֽעֲלֶה־בּ֔וֹ כִּ֚י דֶּ֣רֶךְ חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם זַעֲקַת־שֶׁ֖בֶר יְעֹעֵֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: lby lmv'b yz'q brychh 'dts'r 'glt shlshyh khy  m'lh hlvchyt bbkhy y'lhbv khy drkh chvrnym z'qtshbr y''rv
verses.translation: My heart crieth out for Moab; her fugitives reach unto Zoar, a heifer of three years old; for by the ascent of Luhith With weeping they go up; for in the way of Horonaim they raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־מֵ֥י נִמְרִ֖ים מְשַׁמּ֣וֹת יִֽהְי֑וּ כִּֽי־יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ כָּ֣לָה דֶ֔שֶׁא יֶ֖רֶק לֹ֥א הָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: khymy nmrym mshmvt yhyv khyybsh chtsyr khlh dsh' yrq l' hyh
verses.translation: For the Waters of Nimrim shall be desolate; For the grass is withered away, the herbage faileth, There is no green thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֖ן יִתְרָ֣ה עָשָׂ֑ה וּ֨פְקֻדָּתָ֔ם עַ֛ל נַ֥חַל הָעֲרָבִ֖ים יִשָּׂאֽוּם׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn ytrh 'shh vpqdtm 'l nchl h'rbym ysh'vm
verses.translation: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, And that which they have laid up, Shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־הִקִּ֥יפָה הַזְּעָקָ֖ה אֶת־גְּב֣וּל מוֹאָ֑ב עַד־אֶגְלַ֙יִם֙ יִלְלָתָ֔הּ וּבְאֵ֥ר אֵילִ֖ים יִלְלָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khyhqyph hz'qh 'tgbvl mv'b 'd'glym yllth vb'r 'ylym yllth
verses.translation: For the cry is gone round about The borders of Moab; The howling thereof unto Eglaim, And the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵ֤י דִימוֹן֙ מָ֣לְאוּ דָ֔ם כִּֽי־אָשִׁ֥ית עַל־דִּימ֖וֹן נוֹסָפ֑וֹת לִפְלֵיטַ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אַרְיֵ֔ה וְלִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy my dymvn ml'v dm khy'shyt 'ldymvn nvspvt lplytt mv'b 'ryh vlsh'ryt 'dmh
verses.translation: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; For I will bring yet more upon Dimon, A lion upon him that escapeth of Moab, And upon the remnant of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁלְחוּ־כַ֥ר מֹשֵֽׁל־אֶ֖רֶץ מִסֶּ֣לַע מִדְבָּ֑רָה אֶל־הַ֖ר בַּת־צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: shlchvkhr mshl'rts msl' mdbrh 'lhr bttsyvn
verses.translation: Send ye the lambs for the ruler of the land From the crags that are toward the wilderness, Unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה כְעוֹף־נוֹדֵ֖ד קֵ֣ן מְשֻׁלָּ֑ח תִּֽהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב מַעְבָּרֹ֖ת לְאַרְנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'vfnvdd qn mshlch thyynh bnvt mv'b m'brt l'rnvn
verses.translation: For it shall be that, as wandering birds, As a scattered nest, So shall the daughters of Moab be At the fords of Arnon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (הביאו) [הָבִ֤יאִי] עֵצָה֙ עֲשׂ֣וּ פְלִילָ֔ה שִׁ֧יתִי כַלַּ֛יִל צִלֵּ֖ךְ בְּת֣וֹךְ צׇהֳרָ֑יִם סַתְּרִי֙ נִדָּחִ֔ים נֹדֵ֖ד אַל־תְּגַלִּֽי׃
verses.translit: (hby'v) [hby'y] 'tsh 'shv plylh shyty khlyl tslkh btvkh tshrym stry ndchym ndd 'ltgly
verses.translation: ’Give counsel, execute justice; Make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; Hide the outcasts; betray not the fugitive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָג֤וּרוּ בָךְ֙ נִדָּחַ֔י מוֹאָ֛ב הֱוִי־סֵ֥תֶר לָ֖מוֹ מִפְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹדֵ֑ד כִּֽי־אָפֵ֤ס הַמֵּץ֙ כָּ֣לָה שֹׁ֔ד תַּ֥מּוּ רֹמֵ֖ס מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ygvrv bkh ndchy mv'b hvystr lmv mpny shvdd khy'ps hmts khlh shd tmv rms mnh'rts {s}
verses.translation: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee; As for Moab, be thou a covert to him from the face of the spoiler.’ For the extortion is at an end, spoiling ceaseth, They that trampled down are consumed out of the land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּכַ֤ן בַּחֶ֙סֶד֙ כִּסֵּ֔א וְיָשַׁ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל דָּוִ֑ד שֹׁפֵ֛ט וְדֹרֵ֥שׁ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּמְהִ֥ר צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.translit: vhvkhn bchsd khs' vyshb 'lyv b'mt b'hl dvd shpt vdrsh mshpt vmhr tsdq
verses.translation: And a throne is established through mercy, And there sitteth thereon in truth, in the tent of David, One that judgeth, and seeketh justice, and is ready in righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּ֣א מְאֹ֑ד גַּאֲוָת֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְעֶבְרָת֖וֹ לֹא־כֵ֥ן בַּדָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: shm'nv g'vnmv'b g' m'd g'vtv vg'vnv v'brtv l'khn bdyv
verses.translation: We have heard of the pride of Moab; He is very proud; Even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his arrogancy, His ill-founded boastings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יְיֵלִ֥יל מוֹאָ֛ב לְמוֹאָ֖ב כֻּלֹּ֣ה יְיֵלִ֑יל לַאֲשִׁישֵׁ֧י קִיר־חֲרֶ֛שֶׂת תֶּהְגּ֖וּ אַךְ־נְכָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: lkhn yylyl mv'b lmv'b khlh yylyl l'shyshy qyrchrsht thgv 'khnkh'ym
verses.translation: Therefore shall Moab wail for Moab, Every one shall wail; for the sweet cakes of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn, Sorely stricken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׁדְמוֹת֩ חֶשְׁבּ֨וֹן אֻמְלָ֜ל גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֗ה בַּעֲלֵ֤י גוֹיִם֙ הָלְמ֣וּ שְׂרוּקֶּ֔יהָ עַד־יַעְזֵ֥ר נָגָ֖עוּ תָּ֣עוּ מִדְבָּ֑ר שְׁלֻ֣חוֹתֶ֔יהָ נִטְּשׁ֖וּ עָ֥בְרוּ יָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy shdmvt chshbvn 'mll gpn shbmh b'ly gvym hlmv shrvqyh 'dy'zr ng'v t'v mdbr shlchvtyh ntshv 'brv ym
verses.translation: For the fields of Heshbon languish, And the vine of Sibmah, Whose choice plants did overcome The lords of nations; They reached even unto Jazer, They wandered into the wilderness; Her branches were spread abroad, They passed over the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֡ן אֶבְכֶּ֞ה בִּבְכִ֤י יַעְזֵר֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה אֲרַיָּ֙וֶךְ֙ דִּמְעָתִ֔י חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה כִּ֧י עַל־קֵיצֵ֛ךְ וְעַל־קְצִירֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד נָפָֽל׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'bkhh bbkhy y'zr gpn shbmh 'ryvkh dm'ty chshbvn v'l'lh khy 'lqytskh v'lqtsyrkh hydd npl
verses.translation: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer For the vine of Sibmah; I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh; For upon thy summer fruits and upon thy harvest The battle shout is fallen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶאֱסַ֨ף שִׂמְחָ֤ה וָגִיל֙ מִן־הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל וּבַכְּרָמִ֥ים לֹֽא־יְרֻנָּ֖ן לֹ֣א יְרֹעָ֑ע יַ֗יִן בַּיְקָבִ֛ים לֹא־יִדְרֹ֥ךְ הַדֹּרֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃
verses.translit: vn'sf shmchh vgyl mnhkhrml vbkhrmym l'yrnn l' yr'' yyn byqbym l'ydrkh hdrkh hydd hshbty
verses.translation: And gladness and joy are taken away Out of the fruitful field; And in the vineyards there shall be no singing, Neither shall there be shouting; No treader shall tread out wine in the presses; I have made the vintage shout to cease.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ מֵעַ֣י לְמוֹאָ֔ב כַּכִּנּ֖וֹר יֶהֱמ֑וּ וְקִרְבִּ֖י לְקִ֥יר חָֽרֶשׂ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn m'y lmv'b khkhnvr yhmv vqrby lqyr chrsh
verses.translation: Wherefore my heart moaneth like a harp for Moab, And mine inward parts for Kir-heres.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֧ה כִֽי־נִרְאָ֛ה כִּֽי־נִלְאָ֥ה מוֹאָ֖ב עַל־הַבָּמָ֑ה וּבָ֧א אֶל־מִקְדָּשׁ֛וֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יוּכָֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyh khynr'h khynl'h mv'b 'lhbmh vb' 'lmqdshv lhtpll vl' yvkhl {s}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab hath wearied himself upon the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־מוֹאָ֖ב מֵאָֽז׃
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'lmv'b m'z
verses.translation: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בְּשָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ כִּשְׁנֵ֣י שָׂכִ֔יר וְנִקְלָה֙ כְּב֣וֹד מוֹאָ֔ב בְּכֹ֖ל הֶהָמ֣וֹן הָרָ֑ב וּשְׁאָ֥ר מְעַ֛ט מִזְעָ֖ר ל֥וֹא כַבִּֽיר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th dbr yhvh l'mr bshlsh shnym khshny shkhyr vnqlh khbvd mv'b bkhl hhmvn hrb vsh'r m't mz'r lv' khbyr {p}
verses.translation: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying: ‘Within three years, as the years of a hireling, and the glory of Moab shall wax contemptible for all his great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and without strength.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א דַּמָּ֑שֶׂק הִנֵּ֤ה דַמֶּ֙שֶׂק֙ מוּסָ֣ר מֵעִ֔יר וְהָיְתָ֖ה מְעִ֥י מַפָּלָֽה׃
verses.translit: msh' dmshq hnh dmshq mvsr m'yr vhyth m'y mplh
verses.translation: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, And it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲזֻב֖וֹת עָרֵ֣י עֲרֹעֵ֑ר לַעֲדָרִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ינָה וְרָבְצ֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: 'zbvt 'ry 'r'r l'drym thyynh vrbtsv v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: The cities of Aroer are forsaken; They shall be for flocks, Which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁבַּ֤ת מִבְצָר֙ מֵאֶפְרַ֔יִם וּמַמְלָכָ֥ה מִדַּמֶּ֖שֶׂק וּשְׁאָ֣ר אֲרָ֑ם כִּכְב֤וֹד בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִֽהְי֔וּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnshbt mbtsr m'prym vmmlkhh mdmshq vsh'r 'rm khkhbvd bnyyshr'l yhyv n'm yhvh tsb'vt {p}
verses.translation: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus; and the remnant of Aram shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִדַּ֖ל כְּב֣וֹד יַעֲקֹ֑ב וּמִשְׁמַ֥ן בְּשָׂר֖וֹ יֵרָזֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ydl khbvd y'qb vmshmn bshrv yrzh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, And the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כֶּֽאֱסֹף֙ קָצִ֣יר קָמָ֔ה וּזְרֹע֖וֹ שִׁבֳּלִ֣ים יִקְצ֑וֹר וְהָיָ֛ה כִּמְלַקֵּ֥ט שִׁבֳּלִ֖ים בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'sf qtsyr qmh vzr'v shblym yqtsvr vhyh khmlqt shblym b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the standing corn, And reapeth the ears with his arm; Yea, it shall be as when one gleaneth ears In the valley of Rephaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁאַר־בּ֤וֹ עֽוֹלֵלֹת֙ כְּנֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת שְׁנַ֧יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֛ה גַּרְגְּרִ֖ים בְּרֹ֣אשׁ אָמִ֑יר אַרְבָּעָ֣ה חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה בִּסְעִפֶ֙יהָ֙ פֹּֽרִיָּ֔ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vnsh'rbv 'vllt khnqf zyt shnym shlshh grgrym br'sh 'myr 'rb'h chmshh bs'pyh pryh n'myhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Yet there shall be left therein gleanings, As at the beating of an olive-tree, Two or three berries In the top of the uppermost bough, Four or five in the branches of the fruitful tree, Saith the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִשְׁעֶ֥ה הָאָדָ֖ם עַל־עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וְעֵינָ֕יו אֶל־קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ysh'h h'dm 'l'shhv v'ynyv 'lqdvsh yshr'l tr'ynh
verses.translation: In that day shall a man regard his Maker, And his eyes shall look to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁעֶ֔ה אֶל־הַֽמִּזְבְּח֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֔ה וְהָאֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְהָחַמָּנִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl' ysh'h 'lhmzbchvt m'shh ydyv v'shr 'shv 'tsb'tyv l' yr'h vh'shrym vhchmnym {s}
verses.translation: And he shall not regard the altars, The work of his hands, Neither shall he look to that which his fingers have made, Either the Asherim, or the sun-images.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִהְי֣וּ  עָרֵ֣י מָעוּזּ֗וֹ כַּעֲזוּבַ֤ת הַחֹ֙רֶשׁ֙ וְהָ֣אָמִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽזְב֔וּ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָיְתָ֖ה שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyv  'ry m'vzv kh'zvbt hchrsh vh'myr 'shr 'zbv mpny bny yshr'l vhyth shmmh
verses.translation: In that day shall his strong cities be as the forsaken places, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel, after the manner of woods and lofty forests; and it shall be a desolation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁכַ֙חַתְּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔ךְ וְצ֥וּר מָעֻזֵּ֖ךְ לֹ֣א זָכָ֑רְתְּ עַל־כֵּ֗ן תִּטְּעִי֙ נִטְעֵ֣י נַעֲמָנִ֔ים וּזְמֹ֥רַת זָ֖ר תִּזְרָעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khy shkhcht 'lhy ysh'kh vtsvr m'zkh l' zkhrt 'lkhn tt'y nt'y n'mnym vzmrt zr tzr'nv
verses.translation: For thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, And thou hast not been mindful of the Rock of thy stronghold; Therefore thou didst plant plants of pleasantness, And didst set it with slips of a stranger;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֤וֹם נִטְעֵךְ֙ תְּשַׂגְשֵׂ֔גִי וּבַבֹּ֖קֶר זַרְעֵ֣ךְ תַּפְרִ֑יחִי נֵ֥ד קָצִ֛יר בְּי֥וֹם נַחֲלָ֖ה וּכְאֵ֥ב אָנֽוּשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: byvm nt'kh tshgshgy vbbqr zr'kh tprychy nd qtsyr byvm nchlh vkh'b 'nvsh {s}
verses.translation: In the day of thy planting thou didst make it to grow, And in the morning thou didst make thy seed to blossom— A heap of boughs in the day of grief And of desperate pain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי הֲמוֹן֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כַּהֲמ֥וֹת יַמִּ֖ים יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּשְׁא֣וֹן לְאֻמִּ֔ים כִּשְׁא֛וֹן מַ֥יִם כַּבִּירִ֖ים יִשָּׁאֽוּן׃
verses.translit: hvy hmvn 'mym rbym khhmvt ymym yhmyvn vsh'vn l'mym khsh'vn mym khbyrym ysh'vn
verses.translation: Ah, the uproar of many peoples, That roar like the roaring of the seas; And the rushing of nations, that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאֻמִּ֗ים כִּשְׁא֞וֹן מַ֤יִם רַבִּים֙ יִשָּׁא֔וּן וְגָ֥עַר בּ֖וֹ וְנָ֣ס מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק וְרֻדַּ֗ף כְּמֹ֤ץ הָרִים֙ לִפְנֵי־ר֔וּחַ וּכְגַלְגַּ֖ל לִפְנֵ֥י סוּפָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'mym khsh'vn mym rbym ysh'vn vg'r bv vns mmrchq vrdf khmts hrym lpnyrvch vkhglgl lpny svph
verses.translation: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters; But He shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, And shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, And like the whirling dust before the storm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֵ֥ת עֶ֙רֶב֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה בַלָּהָ֔ה בְּטֶ֥רֶם בֹּ֖קֶר אֵינֶ֑נּוּ זֶ֚ה חֵ֣לֶק שׁוֹסֵ֔ינוּ וְגוֹרָ֖ל לְבֹזְזֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l't 'rb vhnh blhh btrm bqr 'ynnv zh chlq shvsynv vgvrl lbzzynv {p}
verses.translation: At eventide behold terror; And before the morning they are not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, And the lot of them that rob us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וֹי אֶ֖רֶץ צִלְצַ֣ל כְּנָפָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעֵ֖בֶר לְנַהֲרֵי־כֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: hvy 'rts tsltsl khnpym 'shr m'br lnhrykhvsh
verses.translation: Ah, land of the buzzing of wings, Which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֹּׁלֵ֨חַ בַּיָּ֜ם צִירִ֗ים וּבִכְלֵי־גֹ֘מֶא֮ עַל־פְּנֵי־מַ֒יִם֒ לְכ֣וּ  מַלְאָכִ֣ים קַלִּ֗ים אֶל־גּוֹי֙ מְמֻשָּׁ֣ךְ וּמוֹרָ֔ט אֶל־עַ֥ם נוֹרָ֖א מִן־ה֣וּא וָהָ֑לְאָה גּ֚וֹי קַו־קָ֣ו וּמְבוּסָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־בָּזְא֥וּ נְהָרִ֖ים אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hshlch bym tsyrym vbkhlygm' 'lpnymym lkhv  ml'khym qlym 'lgvy mmshkh vmvrt 'l'm nvr' mnhv' vhl'h gvy qvqv vmbvsh 'shrbz'v nhrym 'rtsv
verses.translation: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, Even in vessels of papyrus upon the waters! Go, ye swift messengers, To a nation tall and of glossy skin, To a people terrible from their beginning onward; A nation that is sturdy and treadeth down, Whose land the rivers divide!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵ֖ל וְשֹׁ֣כְנֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּנְשֹׂא־נֵ֤ס הָרִים֙ תִּרְא֔וּ וְכִתְקֹ֥עַ שׁוֹפָ֖ר תִּשְׁמָֽעוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlyshby tbl vshkhny 'rts khnsh'ns hrym tr'v vkhtq' shvpr tshm'v {s}
verses.translation: All ye inhabitants of the world, and ye dwellers on the earth, When an ensign is lifted up on the mountains, see ye; And when the horn is blown, hear ye.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י (אשקוטה) [אֶשְׁקֳטָ֖ה] וְאַבִּ֣יטָה בִמְכוֹנִ֑י כְּחֹ֥ם צַח֙ עֲלֵי־א֔וֹר כְּעָ֥ב טַ֖ל בְּחֹ֥ם קָצִֽיר׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'ly ('shqvth) ['shqth] v'byth bmkhvny khchm tsch 'ly'vr kh'b tl bchm qtsyr
verses.translation: For thus hath the LORD said unto me: I will hold Me still, and I will look on in My dwelling-place, Like clear heat in sunshine, Like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־לִפְנֵ֤י קָצִיר֙ כְּתׇם־פֶּ֔רַח וּבֹ֥סֶר גֹּמֵ֖ל יִֽהְיֶ֣ה נִצָּ֑הֿ וְכָרַ֤ת הַזַּלְזַלִּים֙ בַּמַּזְמֵר֔וֹת וְאֶת־הַנְּטִישׁ֖וֹת הֵסִ֥יר הֵתַֽז׃
verses.translit: khylpny qtsyr khtmprch vbsr gml yhyh ntsh vkhrt hzlzlym bmzmrvt v'thntyshvt hsyr htz
verses.translation: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, And the bud becometh a ripening grape, He will cut off the sprigs with pruning-hooks, And the shoots will He take away and lop off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵעָזְב֤וּ יַחְדָּו֙ לְעֵ֣יט הָרִ֔ים וּֽלְבֶהֱמַ֖ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְקָ֤ץ עָלָיו֙ הָעַ֔יִט וְכׇל־בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ עָלָ֥יו תֶּחֱרָֽף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: y'zbv ychdv l'yt hrym vlbhmt h'rts vqts 'lyv h'yt vkhlbhmt h'rts 'lyv tchrf {s}
verses.translation: They shall be left together unto the ravenous birds of the mountains, And to the beasts of the earth; And the ravenous birds shall summer upon them, And all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
