verses.original: בָּעֵת֩ הַהִ֨יא יוּבַל־שַׁ֜י לַיהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת עַ֚ם מְמֻשָּׁ֣ךְ וּמוֹרָ֔ט וּמֵעַ֥ם נוֹרָ֖א מִן־ה֣וּא וָהָ֑לְאָה גּ֣וֹי  קַו־קָ֣ו וּמְבוּסָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּזְא֤וּ נְהָרִים֙ אַרְצ֔וֹ אֶל־מְק֛וֹם שֵׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת הַר־צִיּֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: b't hhy' yvblshy lyhvh tsb'vt 'm mmshkh vmvrt vm'm nvr' mnhv' vhl'h gvy  qvqv vmbvsh 'shr bz'v nhrym 'rtsv 'lmqvm shmyhvh tsb'vt hrtsyvn {p}
verses.translation: In that time shall a present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people tall and of glossy skin, and from a people terrible from their beginning onward; a nation that is sturdy and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מִצְרָ֑יִם הִנֵּ֨ה יְהֹוָ֜ה רֹכֵ֨ב עַל־עָ֥ב קַל֙ וּבָ֣א מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנָע֞וּ אֱלִילֵ֤י מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ מִפָּנָ֔יו וּלְבַ֥ב מִצְרַ֖יִם יִמַּ֥ס בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: msh' mtsrym hnh yhvh rkhb 'l'b ql vb' mtsrym vn'v 'lyly mtsrym mpnyv vlbb mtsrym yms bqrbv
verses.translation: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, And cometh unto Egypt; And the idols of Egypt shall be moved at His presence, And the heart of Egypt shall melt within it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסִכְסַכְתִּ֤י מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֖יו וְאִ֣ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֑הוּ עִ֣יר בְּעִ֔יר מַמְלָכָ֖ה בְּמַמְלָכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vskhskhty mtsrym bmtsrym vnlchmv 'yshb'chyv v'ysh br'hv 'yr b'yr mmlkhh bmmlkhh
verses.translation: And I will spur Egypt against Egypt; And they shall fight every one against his brother, And everyone against his neighbour; City against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָבְקָ֤ה רוּחַ־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲצָת֖וֹ אֲבַלֵּ֑עַ וְדָרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל־הָֽאֱלִילִים֙ וְאֶל־הָ֣אִטִּ֔ים וְאֶל־הָאֹב֖וֹת וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vnbqh rvchmtsrym bqrbv v'tstv 'bl' vdrshv 'lh'lylym v'lh'tym v'lh'bvt v'lhyd'nym
verses.translation: And the spirit of Egypt shall be made empty within it; And I will make void the counsel thereof; And they shall seek unto the idols, and to the whisperers, And to the ghosts, and to the familiar spirits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסִכַּרְתִּי֙ אֶת־מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּיַ֖ד אֲדֹנִ֣ים קָשֶׁ֑ה וּמֶ֤לֶךְ עַז֙ יִמְשׇׁל־בָּ֔ם נְאֻ֥ם הָאָד֖וֹן יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vskhrty 'tmtsrym byd 'dnym qshh vmlkh 'z ymshlbm n'm h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְּׁתוּ־מַ֖יִם מֵֽהַיָּ֑ם וְנָהָ֖ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vnshtvmym mhym vnhr ychrb vybsh
verses.translation: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be drained dry,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶאֶזְנִ֣יחוּ נְהָר֔וֹת דָּלְל֥וּ וְחָרְב֖וּ יְאֹרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר קָנֶ֥ה וָס֖וּף קָמֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vh'znychv nhrvt dllv vchrbv y'ry mtsvr qnh vsvf qmlv
verses.translation: And the rivers shall become foul; The streams of Egypt shall be minished and dried up; The reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָר֥וֹת עַל־יְא֖וֹר עַל־פִּ֣י יְא֑וֹר וְכֹל֙ מִזְרַ֣ע יְא֔וֹר יִיבַ֥שׁ נִדַּ֖ף וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'rvt 'ly'vr 'lpy y'vr vkhl mzr' y'vr yybsh ndf v'ynnv
verses.translation: The mosses by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all that is sown by the Nile, shall become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנוּ֙ הַדַּיָּגִ֔ים וְאָ֣בְל֔וּ כׇּל־מַשְׁלִיכֵ֥י בַיְא֖וֹר חַכָּ֑ה וּפֹרְשֵׂ֥י מִכְמֹ֛רֶת עַל־פְּנֵי־מַ֖יִם אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: v'nv hdygym v'blv khlmshlykhy by'vr chkhh vprshy mkhmrt 'lpnymym 'mllv
verses.translation: The fishers also shall lament, and all they that cast angle into the Nile shall mourn, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֹ֛שׁוּ עֹבְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים שְׂרִיק֑וֹת וְאֹרְגִ֖ים חוֹרָֽי׃
verses.translit: vbshv 'bdy pshtym shryqvt v'rgym chvry
verses.translation: Moreover they that work in combed flax, And they that weave cotton, shall be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁתֹתֶ֖יהָ מְדֻכָּאִ֑ים כׇּל־עֹ֥שֵׂי שֶׂ֖כֶר אַגְמֵי־נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vhyv shttyh mdkh'ym khl'shy shkhr 'gmynpsh
verses.translation: And her foundations shall be crushed, All they that make dams shall be grieved in soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־אֱוִלִים֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן חַכְמֵי֙ יֹעֲצֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה עֵצָ֖ה נִבְעָרָ֑ה אֵ֚יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה בֶּן־חֲכָמִ֥ים אֲנִ֖י בֶּן־מַלְכֵי־קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: 'kh'vlym shry ts'n chkhmy y'tsy pr'h 'tsh nb'rh 'ykh t'mrv 'lpr'h bnchkhmym 'ny bnmlkhyqdm
verses.translation: The princes of Zoan are utter fools; the wisest counsellors of Pharaoh are a senseless counsel; How can ye say unto Pharaoh: ‘I am the son of the wise, The son of ancient kings’?.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַיָּם֙ אֵפ֣וֹא חֲכָמֶ֔יךָ וְיַגִּ֥ידוּ נָ֖א לָ֑ךְ וְיֵ֣דְע֔וּ מַה־יָּעַ֛ץ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'ym 'pv' chkhmykh vygydv n' lkh vyd'v mhy'ts yhvh tsb'vt 'lmtsrym
verses.translation: Where are they, then, thy wise men? And let them tell thee now; And let them know what the LORD of hosts Hath purposed concerning Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֽוֹאֲלוּ֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן נִשְּׁא֖וּ שָׂ֣רֵי נֹ֑ף הִתְע֥וּ אֶת־מִצְרַ֖יִם פִּנַּ֥ת שְׁבָטֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: nv'lv shry ts'n nsh'v shry nf ht'v 'tmtsrym pnt shbtyh
verses.translation: The princes of Zoan are become fools, The princes of Noph are deceived; They have caused Egypt to go astray, That are the corner-stone of her tribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֛ה מָסַ֥ךְ בְּקִרְבָּ֖הּ ר֣וּחַ עִוְעִ֑ים וְהִתְע֤וּ אֶת־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בְּכׇֽל־מַעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ כְּהִתָּע֥וֹת שִׁכּ֖וֹר בְּקִיאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhvh mskh bqrbh rvch 'v'ym vht'v 'tmtsrym bkhlm'shhv khht'vt shkhvr bqy'v
verses.translation: The LORD hath mingled within her A spirit of dizziness; And they have caused Egypt to stagger in every work thereof, As a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְמִצְרַ֖יִם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יַעֲשֶׂ֛ה רֹ֥אשׁ וְזָנָ֖ב כִּפָּ֥ה וְאַגְמֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vl'yhyh lmtsrym m'shh 'shr y'shh r'sh vznb khph v'gmvn
verses.translation: Neither shall there be for Egypt any work, Which head or tail, palm-branch or rush, may do.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִהְיֶ֥ה מִצְרַ֖יִם כַּנָּשִׁ֑ים וְחָרַ֣ד  וּפָחַ֗ד מִפְּנֵי֙ תְּנוּפַת֙ יַד־יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ה֖וּא מֵנִ֥יף עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh mtsrym khnshym vchrd  vpchd mpny tnvpt ydyhvh tsb'vt 'shrhv' mnyf 'lyv
verses.translation: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women; and it shall tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which He shaketh over it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיְתָ֠ה אַדְמַ֨ת יְהוּדָ֤ה לְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְחׇגָּ֔א כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַזְכִּ֥יר אֹתָ֛הּ אֵלָ֖יו יִפְחָ֑ד מִפְּנֵ֗י עֲצַת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ה֖וּא יוֹעֵ֥ץ עָלָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyth 'dmt yhvdh lmtsrym lchg' khl 'shr yzkhyr 'th 'lyv ypchd mpny 'tst yhvh tsb'vt 'shrhv' yv'ts 'lyv {s}
verses.translation: And the land of Judah shall become a terror unto Egypt, whensoever one maketh mention thereof to it; it shall be afraid, because of the purpose of the LORD of hosts, which He purposeth against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא יִהְיוּ֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם מְדַבְּרוֹת֙ שְׂפַ֣ת כְּנַ֔עַן וְנִשְׁבָּע֖וֹת לַיהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת עִ֣יר הַהֶ֔רֶס יֵאָמֵ֖ר לְאֶחָֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyv chmsh 'rym b'rts mtsrym mdbrvt shpt khn'n vnshb'vt lyhvh tsb'vt 'yr hhrs y'mr l'cht {s}
verses.translation: In that day there shall be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called The city of destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֤ה מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וּמַצֵּבָ֥ה אֵצֶל־גְּבוּלָ֖הּ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh mzbch lyhvh btvkh 'rts mtsrym vmtsbh 'tslgbvlh lyhvh
verses.translation: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה לְא֥וֹת וּלְעֵ֛ד לַיהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־יִצְעֲק֤וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָה֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י לֹחֲצִ֔ים וְיִשְׁלַ֥ח לָהֶ֛ם מוֹשִׁ֥יעַ וָרָ֖ב וְהִצִּילָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh l'vt vl'd lyhvh tsb'vt b'rts mtsrym khyyts'qv 'lyhvh mpny lchtsym vyshlch lhm mvshy' vrb vhtsylm
verses.translation: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and He will send them a saviour, and a defender, who will deliver them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנוֹדַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ לְמִצְרַ֔יִם וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְעָֽבְדוּ֙ זֶ֣בַח וּמִנְחָ֔ה וְנָדְרוּ־נֵ֥דֶר לַיהֹוָ֖ה וְשִׁלֵּֽמוּ׃
verses.translit: vnvd' yhvh lmtsrym vyd'v mtsrym 'tyhvh byvm hhv' v'bdv zbch vmnchh vndrvndr lyhvh vshlmv
verses.translation: And the LORD shall make Himself known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day; yea, they shall worship with sacrifice and offering, and shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and shall perform it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָגַ֧ף יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מִצְרַ֖יִם נָגֹ֣ף וְרָפ֑וֹא וְשָׁ֙בוּ֙ עַד־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְנֶעְתַּ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם וּרְפָאָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vngf yhvh 'tmtsrym ngf vrpv' vshbv 'dyhvh vn'tr lhm vrp'm {s}
verses.translation: And the LORD will smite Egypt, smiting and healing; and they shall return unto the LORD, and He will be entreated of them, and will heal them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא תִּהְיֶ֨ה מְסִלָּ֤ה מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ אַשּׁ֔וּרָה וּבָא־אַשּׁ֥וּר בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם וּמִצְרַ֣יִם בְּאַשּׁ֑וּר וְעָבְד֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם אֶת־אַשּֽׁוּר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: byvm hhv' thyh mslh mmtsrym 'shvrh vb''shvr bmtsrym vmtsrym b'shvr v'bdv mtsrym 't'shvr {s}
verses.translation: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians shall worship with the Assyrians.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שְׁלִ֣ישִׁיָּ֔ה לְמִצְרַ֖יִם וּלְאַשּׁ֑וּר בְּרָכָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh yshr'l shlyshyh lmtsrym vl'shvr brkhh bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֧ר בֵּרְכ֛וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר בָּר֨וּךְ עַמִּ֜י מִצְרַ֗יִם וּמַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדַי֙ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְנַחֲלָתִ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shr brkhv yhvh tsb'vt l'mr brvkh 'my mtsrym vm'shh ydy 'shvr vnchlty yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: for that the LORD of hosts hath blessed him, saying: ‘Blessed be Egypt My people and Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel Mine inheritance.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת בֹּ֤א תַרְתָּן֙ אַשְׁדּ֔וֹדָה בִּשְׁלֹ֣חַ אֹת֔וֹ סַֽרְג֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיִּלָּ֥חֶם בְּאַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: bshnt b' trtn 'shdvdh bshlch 'tv srgvn mlkh 'shvr vylchm b'shdvd vylkhdh
verses.translation: In the year that Tartan came into Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָה֮ בְּיַ֣ד יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ לֵ֗ךְ וּפִתַּחְתָּ֤ הַשַּׂק֙ מֵעַ֣ל מׇתְנֶ֔יךָ וְנַעַלְךָ֥ תַחֲלֹ֖ץ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כֵּ֔ן הָלֹ֖ךְ עָר֥וֹם וְיָחֵֽף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b't hhy' dbr yhvh byd ysh'yhv bn'mvts l'mr lkh vptcht hshq m'l mtnykh vn'lkh tchlts m'l rglkh vy'sh khn hlkh 'rvm vychf {s}
verses.translation: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying: ‘Go, and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put thy shoe from off thy foot.’ And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֛ךְ עַבְדִּ֥י יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ עָר֣וֹם וְיָחֵ֑ף שָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ א֣וֹת וּמוֹפֵ֔ת עַל־מִצְרַ֖יִם וְעַל־כּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh kh'shr hlkh 'bdy ysh'yhv 'rvm vychf shlsh shnym 'vt vmvpt 'lmtsrym v'lkhvsh
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘Like as My servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot to be for three years a sign and a wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן יִנְהַ֣ג מֶֽלֶךְ־אַ֠שּׁ֠וּר אֶת־שְׁבִ֨י מִצְרַ֜יִם וְאֶת־גָּל֥וּת כּ֛וּשׁ נְעָרִ֥ים וּזְקֵנִ֖ים עָר֣וֹם וְיָחֵ֑ף וַחֲשׂוּפַ֥י שֵׁ֖ת עֶרְוַ֥ת מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khn ynhg mlkh'shvr 'tshby mtsrym v'tglvt khvsh n'rym vzqnym 'rvm vychf vchshvpy sht 'rvt mtsrym
verses.translation: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt, and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַתּ֖וּ וָבֹ֑שׁוּ מִכּוּשׁ֙ מַבָּטָ֔ם וּמִן־מִצְרַ֖יִם תִּפְאַרְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vchtv vbshv mkhvsh mbtm vmnmtsrym tp'rtm
verses.translation: And they shall be dismayed and ashamed, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אָמַ֠ר יֹשֵׁ֨ב הָאִ֣י הַזֶּה֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֒ הִנֵּה־כֹ֣ה מַבָּטֵ֗נוּ אֲשֶׁר־נַ֤סְנוּ שָׁם֙ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה לְהִ֨נָּצֵ֔ל מִפְּנֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְאֵ֖יךְ נִמָּלֵ֥ט אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mr yshb h'y hzh byvm hhv' hnhkhh mbtnv 'shrnsnv shm l'zrh lhntsl mpny mlkh 'shvr v'ykh nmlt 'nchnv {p}
verses.translation: And the inhabitant of this coast-land shall say in that day: Behold, such is our expectation, whither we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria; and how shall we escape?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מִדְבַּר־יָ֑ם כְּסוּפ֤וֹת בַּנֶּ֙גֶב֙ לַחֲלֹ֔ף מִמִּדְבָּ֣ר בָּ֔א מֵאֶ֖רֶץ נוֹרָאָֽה׃
verses.translit: msh' mdbrym khsvpvt bngb lchlf mmdbr b' m'rts nvr'h
verses.translation: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweeping on, It cometh from the wilderness, from a dreadful land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָז֥וּת קָשָׁ֖ה הֻגַּד־לִ֑י הַבּוֹגֵ֤ד ׀ בּוֹגֵד֙ וְהַשּׁוֹדֵ֣ד ׀ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד עֲלִ֤י עֵילָם֙ צוּרִ֣י מָדַ֔י כׇּל־אַנְחָתָ֖הֿ הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃
verses.translit: chzvt qshh hgdly hbvgd  bvgd vhshvdd  shvdd 'ly 'ylm tsvry mdy khl'nchth hshbty
verses.translation: A grievous vision is declared unto me: ‘The treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam! besiege, O Media! All the sighing thereof have I made to cease.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֗ן מָלְא֤וּ מׇתְנַי֙ חַלְחָלָ֔ה צִירִ֣ים אֲחָז֔וּנִי כְּצִירֵ֖י יוֹלֵדָ֑ה נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי מִשְּׁמֹ֔עַ נִבְהַ֖לְתִּי מֵרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn ml'v mtny chlchlh tsyrym 'chzvny khtsyry yvldh n'vyty mshm' nbhlty mr'vt
verses.translation: Therefore are my loins filled with convulsion; Pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman in travail; I am bent so that I cannot hear; I am affrighted so that I cannot see.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּעָ֣ה לְבָבִ֔י פַּלָּצ֖וּת בִּֽעֲתָ֑תְנִי אֵ֚ת נֶ֣שֶׁף חִשְׁקִ֔י שָׂ֥ם לִ֖י לַחֲרָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: t'h lbby pltsvt b'ttny 't nshf chshqy shm ly lchrdh
verses.translation: My heart is bewildered, terror hath overwhelmed me; The twilight that I longed for hath been turned for me into trembling.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָרֹ֧ךְ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן צָפֹ֥ה הַצָּפִ֖ית אָכ֣וֹל שָׁתֹ֑ה ק֥וּמוּ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים מִשְׁח֥וּ מָגֵֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rkh hshlchn tsph htspyt 'khvl shth qvmv hshrym mshchv mgn {s}
verses.translation: They prepare the table, they light the lamps, they eat, they drink— ’Rise up, ye princes, anoint the shield.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֵלַ֖י אֲדֹנָ֑י לֵ֚ךְ הַעֲמֵ֣ד הַֽמְצַפֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִרְאֶ֖ה יַגִּֽיד׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'ly 'dny lkh h'md hmtsph 'shr yr'h ygyd
verses.translation: For thus hath the Lord said unto me: Go, set a watchman; let him declare what he seeth!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָ֣אָה רֶ֗כֶב צֶ֚מֶד פָּרָשִׁ֔ים רֶ֥כֶב חֲמ֖וֹר רֶ֣כֶב גָּמָ֑ל וְהִקְשִׁ֥יב קֶ֖שֶׁב רַב־קָֽשֶׁב׃
verses.translit: vr'h rkhb tsmd prshym rkhb chmvr rkhb gml vhqshyb qshb rbqshb
verses.translation: And when he seeth a troop, horsemen by pairs, A troop of asses, a troop of camels, He shall hearken diligently with much heed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֖א אַרְיֵ֑ה עַל־מִצְפֶּ֣ה  אֲדֹנָ֗י אָנֹכִ֞י עֹמֵ֤ד תָּמִיד֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְעַ֨ל־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֔י אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב כׇּל־הַלֵּילֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'ryh 'lmtsph  'dny 'nkhy 'md tmyd yvmm v'lmshmrty 'nkhy ntsb khlhlylvt
verses.translation: And he cried as a lion: ‘Upon the watch-tower, O Lord, I stand continually in the daytime, And I am set in my ward all the nights.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה־זֶ֥ה בָא֙ רֶ֣כֶב אִ֔ישׁ צֶ֖מֶד פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּ֣עַן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָפְלָ֤ה נָֽפְלָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְכׇל־פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ שִׁבַּ֥ר לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhnhzh b' rkhb 'ysh tsmd prshym vy'n vy'mr nplh nplh bbl vkhlpsyly 'lhyh shbr l'rts
verses.translation: And, behold, there came a troop of men, horsemen by pairs. And he spoke and said: ‘Fallen, fallen is Babylon; And all the graven images of her gods are broken unto the ground.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְדֻשָׁתִ֖י וּבֶן־גׇּרְנִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵאֵ֨ת יְהֹוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הִגַּ֥דְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mdshty vbngrny 'shr shm'ty m't yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hgdty lkhm {p}
verses.translation: O thou my threshing, and the winnowing of my floor, That which I have heard from the LORD of hosts, The God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א דּוּמָ֑ה אֵלַי֙ קֹרֵ֣א מִשֵּׂעִ֔יר שֹׁמֵר֙ מַה־מִּלַּ֔יְלָה שֹׁמֵ֖ר מַה־מִּלֵּֽיל׃
verses.translit: msh' dvmh 'ly qr' msh'yr shmr mhmlylh shmr mhmlyl
verses.translation: The burden of Dumah. One calleth unto me out of Seir: ‘Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר שֹׁמֵ֔ר אָתָ֥ה בֹ֖קֶר וְגַם־לָ֑יְלָה אִם־תִּבְעָי֥וּן בְּעָ֖יוּ שֻׁ֥בוּ אֵתָֽיוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'mr shmr 'th bqr vgmlylh 'mtb'yvn b'yv shbv 'tyv {p}
verses.translation: The watchman said: ‘The morning cometh, and also the night— If ye will inquire, inquire ye; return, come.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בַּעְרָ֑ב בַּיַּ֤עַר בַּעְרַב֙ תָּלִ֔ינוּ אֹרְח֖וֹת דְּדָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: msh' b'rb by'r b'rb tlynv 'rchvt ddnym
verses.translation: The burden upon Arabia. In the thickets in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye caravans of Dedanites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִקְרַ֥את צָמֵ֖א הֵתָ֣יוּ מָ֑יִם יֹֽשְׁבֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ תֵּימָ֔א בְּלַחְמ֖וֹ קִדְּמ֥וּ נֹדֵֽד׃
verses.translit: lqr't tsm' htyv mym yshby 'rts tym' blchmv qdmv ndd
verses.translation: Unto him that is thirsty bring ye water! The inhabitants of the land of Tema did meet the fugitive with his bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מִפְּנֵ֥י חֲרָב֖וֹת נָדָ֑דוּ מִפְּנֵ֣י  חֶ֣רֶב נְטוּשָׁ֗ה וּמִפְּנֵי֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת דְּרוּכָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י כֹּ֥בֶד מִלְחָמָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khympny chrbvt nddv mpny  chrb ntvshh vmpny qsht drvkhh vmpny khbd mlchmh {s}
verses.translation: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, And from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֛ה אָמַ֥ר אֲדֹנָ֖י אֵלָ֑י בְּע֤וֹד שָׁנָה֙ כִּשְׁנֵ֣י שָׂכִ֔יר וְכָלָ֖ה כׇּל־כְּב֥וֹד קֵדָֽר׃
verses.translit: khykhh 'mr 'dny 'ly b'vd shnh khshny shkhyr vkhlh khlkhbvd qdr
verses.translation: For thus hath the Lord said unto me: ‘Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֧ר מִסְפַּר־קֶ֛שֶׁת גִּבּוֹרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־קֵדָ֖ר יִמְעָ֑טוּ כִּ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דִּבֵּֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'r msprqsht gbvry bnyqdr ym'tv khy yhvh 'lhyyshr'l dbr {s}
verses.translation: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished; for the LORD, the God of Israel, hath spoken it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א גֵּ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מַה־לָּ֣ךְ אֵפ֔וֹא כִּי־עָלִ֥ית כֻּלָּ֖ךְ לַגַּגּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: msh' gy' chzyvn mhlkh 'pv' khy'lyt khlkh lggvt
verses.translation: The burden concerning the Valley of Vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשֻׁא֣וֹת  מְלֵאָ֗ה עִ֚יר הֽוֹמִיָּ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָ֑ה חֲלָלַ֙יִךְ֙ לֹ֣א חַלְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹ֖א מֵתֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: tsh'vt  ml'h 'yr hvmyh qryh 'lyzh chllykh l' chllychrb vl' mty mlchmh
verses.translation: Thou that art full of uproar, a tumultuous city, a joyous town? Thy slain are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־קְצִינַ֥יִךְ נָֽדְדוּ־יַ֖חַד מִקֶּ֣שֶׁת אֻסָּ֑רוּ כׇּל־נִמְצָאַ֙יִךְ֙ אֻסְּר֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו מֵרָח֖וֹק בָּרָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: khlqtsynykh nddvychd mqsht 'srv khlnmts'ykh 'srv ychdv mrchvq brchv
verses.translation: All thy rulers are fled together, Without the bow they are bound; All that are found of thee are bound together, they are fled afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֛רְתִּי שְׁע֥וּ מִנִּ֖י אֲמָרֵ֣ר בַּבֶּ֑כִי אַל־תָּאִ֣יצוּ לְנַֽחֲמֵ֔נִי עַל־שֹׁ֖ד בַּת־עַמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'mrty sh'v mny 'mrr bbkhy 'lt'ytsv lnchmny 'lshd bt'my
verses.translation: Therefore said I: ‘Look away from me, I will weep bitterly; Strain not to comfort me, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יוֹם֩ מְהוּמָ֨ה וּמְבוּסָ֜ה וּמְבוּכָ֗ה לַֽאדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּגֵ֣י חִזָּי֑וֹן מְקַרְקַ֥ר קִ֖ר וְשׁ֥וֹעַ אֶל־הָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: khy yvm mhvmh vmbvsh vmbvkhh l'dny yhvh tsb'vt bgy chzyvn mqrqr qr vshv' 'lhhr
verses.translation: For it is a day of trouble, and of trampling, and of perplexity, From the Lord, the GOD of hosts, in the Valley of Vision; Kir shouting, and Shoa at the mount.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵילָם֙ נָשָׂ֣א אַשְׁפָּ֔ה בְּרֶ֥כֶב אָדָ֖ם פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְקִ֥יר עֵרָ֖ה מָגֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v'ylm nsh' 'shph brkhb 'dm prshym vqyr 'rh mgn
verses.translation: And Elam bore the quiver, with troops of men, even horsemen; And Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י מִבְחַר־עֲמָקַ֖יִךְ מָ֣לְאוּ רָ֑כֶב וְהַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים שֹׁ֖ת שָׁ֥תוּ הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy mbchr'mqykh ml'v rkhb vhprshym sht shtv hsh'rh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when thy choicest valleys were full of chariots, And the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְגַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מָסַ֣ךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַתַּבֵּט֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֶל־נֶ֖שֶׁק בֵּ֥ית הַיָּֽעַר׃
verses.translit: vygl 't mskh yhvdh vtbt byvm hhv' 'lnshq byt hy'r
verses.translation: And the covering of Judah was laid bare, that thou didst look in that day to the armour in the house of the forest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת בְּקִיעֵ֧י עִיר־דָּוִ֛ד רְאִיתֶ֖ם כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וַֽתְּקַבְּצ֔וּ אֶת־מֵ֥י הַבְּרֵכָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: v't bqy'y 'yrdvd r'ytm khyrbv vtqbtsv 'tmy hbrkhh htchtvnh
verses.translation: And ye saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בָּתֵּ֥י יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם סְפַרְתֶּ֑ם וַתִּתְצוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים לְבַצֵּ֖ר הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tbty yrvshl͏m sprtm vtttsv hbtym lbtsr hchvmh
verses.translation: And ye numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and ye broke down the houses to fortify the wall;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִקְוָ֣ה  עֲשִׂיתֶ֗ם בֵּ֚ין הַחֹ֣מֹתַ֔יִם לְמֵ֖י הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הַיְשָׁנָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הִבַּטְתֶּם֙ אֶל־עֹשֶׂ֔יהָ וְיֹצְרָ֥הּ מֵרָח֖וֹק לֹ֥א רְאִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vmqvh  'shytm byn hchmtym lmy hbrkhh hyshnh vl' hbttm 'l'shyh vytsrh mrchvq l' r'ytm
verses.translation: ye made also a basin between the two walls for the water of the old pool— But ye looked not unto Him that had done this, Neither had ye respect unto Him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֲדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא לִבְכִי֙ וּלְמִסְפֵּ֔ד וּלְקׇרְחָ֖ה וְלַחֲגֹ֥ר שָֽׂק׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'dny yhvh tsb'vt byvm hhv' lbkhy vlmspd vlqrchh vlchgr shq
verses.translation: And in that day did the Lord, the GOD of hosts, call To weeping, and to lamentation, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה  שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֗ה הָרֹ֤ג ׀ בָּקָר֙ וְשָׁחֹ֣ט צֹ֔אן אָכֹ֥ל בָּשָׂ֖ר וְשָׁת֣וֹת יָ֑יִן אָכ֣וֹל וְשָׁת֔וֹ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר נָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vhnh  shshvn vshmchh hrg  bqr vshcht ts'n 'khl bshr vshtvt yyn 'khvl vshtv khy mchr nmvt
verses.translation: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine— 'Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we shall die!’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִגְלָ֥ה בְאׇזְנָ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־יְ֠כֻפַּ֠ר הֶעָוֺ֨ן הַזֶּ֤ה לָכֶם֙ עַד־תְּמֻת֔וּן אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnglh b'zny yhvh tsb'vt 'mykhpr h'vn hzh lkhm 'dtmtvn 'mr 'dny yhvh tsb'vt {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD of hosts revealed Himself in mine ears: Surely this iniquity shall not be expiated by you till ye die, Saith the Lord, the GOD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת לֶךְ־בֹּא֙ אֶל־הַסֹּכֵ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־שֶׁבְנָ֖א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh tsb'vt lkhb' 'lhskhn hzh 'lshbn' 'shr 'lhbyt
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord, the GOD of hosts: Go, get thee unto this steward, even unto Shebna, who is over the house:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־לְּךָ֥ פֹה֙ וּמִ֣י לְךָ֣ פֹ֔ה כִּֽי־חָצַ֧בְתָּ לְּךָ֛ פֹּ֖ה קָ֑בֶר חֹצְבִ֤י מָרוֹם֙ קִבְר֔וֹ חֹקְקִ֥י בַסֶּ֖לַע מִשְׁכָּ֥ן לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mhlkh ph vmy lkh ph khychtsbt lkh ph qbr chtsby mrvm qbrv chqqy bsl' mshkhn lv
verses.translation: What hast thou here, and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out here a sepulchre, Thou that hewest thee out a sepulchre on high, And gravest a habitation for thyself in the rock?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ מְטַלְטֶלְךָ֔ טַלְטֵלָ֖ה גָּ֑בֶר וְעֹטְךָ֖ עָטֹֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh yhvh mtltlkh tltlh gbr v'tkh 'th
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD will hurl thee up and down with a man’s throw; yea, He will wind thee round and round;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָנ֤וֹף יִצְנׇפְךָ֙ צְנֵפָ֔ה כַּדּ֕וּר אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדָ֑יִם שָׁ֣מָּה תָמ֗וּת וְשָׁ֙מָּה֙ מַרְכְּב֣וֹת כְּבוֹדֶ֔ךָ קְל֖וֹן בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: tsnvf ytsnpkh tsnph khdvr 'l'rts rchbt ydym shmh tmvt vshmh mrkhbvt khbvdkh qlvn byt 'dnykh
verses.translation: He will violently roll and toss thee like a ball into a large country; there shalt thou die, and there shall be the chariots of thy glory, Thou shame of the lord’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲדַפְתִּ֖יךָ מִמַּצָּבֶ֑ךָ וּמִמַּעֲמָֽדְךָ֖ יֶהֶרְסֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vhdptykh mmtsbkh vmm'mdkh yhrskh
verses.translation: And I will thrust thee from thy post, And from thy station shalt thou be pulled down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְקָרָ֣אתִי לְעַבְדִּ֔י לְאֶלְיָקִ֖ים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' vqr'ty l'bdy l'lyqym bnchlqyhv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתִּ֣יו כֻּתׇּנְתֶּ֗ךָ וְאַבְנֵֽטְךָ֙ אֲחַזְּקֶ֔נּוּ וּמֶֽמְשַׁלְתְּךָ֖ אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְאָ֛ב לְיוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וּלְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhlbshtyv khtntkh v'bntkh 'chzqnv vmmshltkh 'tn bydv vhyh l'b lyvshb yrvshl͏m vlbyt yhvdh
verses.translation: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and bind him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand; and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י מַפְתֵּ֥חַ בֵּית־דָּוִ֖ד עַל־שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וּפָתַח֙ וְאֵ֣ין סֹגֵ֔ר וְסָגַ֖ר וְאֵ֥ין פֹּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vntty mptch bytdvd 'lshkhmv vptch v'yn sgr vsgr v'yn ptch
verses.translation: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; and he shall open, and none shall shut; And he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּתְקַעְתִּ֥יו יָתֵ֖ד בְּמָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְהָיָ֛ה לְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד לְבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vtq'tyv ytd bmqvm n'mn vhyh lkhs' khbvd lbyt 'byv
verses.translation: And I will fasten him as a peg in a sure place; And he shall be for a throne of honour to his father’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָל֨וּ עָלָ֜יו כֹּ֣ל  כְּב֣וֹד בֵּית־אָבִ֗יו הַצֶּֽאֱצָאִים֙ וְהַצְּפִע֔וֹת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַקָּטָ֑ן מִכְּלֵי֙ הָאַגָּנ֔וֹת וְעַ֖ד כׇּל־כְּלֵ֥י הַנְּבָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vtlv 'lyv khl  khbvd byt'byv hts'ts'ym vhtsp'vt khl khly hqtn mkhly h'gnvt v'd khlkhly hnblym
verses.translation: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תָּמוּשׁ֙ הַיָּתֵ֔ד הַתְּקוּעָ֖ה בְּמָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְנִגְדְּעָ֣ה וְנָפְלָ֗ה וְנִכְרַת֙ הַמַּשָּׂ֣א אֲשֶׁר־עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt tmvsh hytd htqv'h bmqvm n'mn vngd'h vnplh vnkhrt hmsh' 'shr'lyh khy yhvh dbr {p}
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the peg that was fastened in a sure place give way; and it shall be hewn down, and fall, and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off; for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א צֹ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ  אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־שֻׁדַּ֤ד מִבַּ֙יִת֙ מִבּ֔וֹא מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כִּתִּ֖ים נִגְלָה־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: msh' tsr hylylv  'nyvt trshysh khyshdd mbyt mbv' m'rts khtym nglhlmv
verses.translation: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish, For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in; From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דֹּ֖מּוּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אִ֑י סֹחֵ֥ר צִיד֛וֹן עֹבֵ֥ר יָ֖ם מִלְאֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: dmv yshby 'y schr tsydvn 'br ym ml'vkh
verses.translation: Be still, ye inhabitants of the coast-land; Thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְמַ֤יִם רַבִּים֙ זֶ֣רַע שִׁחֹ֔ר קְצִ֥יר יְא֖וֹר תְּבוּאָתָ֑הּ וַתְּהִ֖י סְחַ֥ר גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbmym rbym zr' shchr qtsyr y'vr tbv'th vthy schr gvym
verses.translation: And on great waters the seed of Shihor, The harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; And she was the mart of nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּ֣וֹשִׁי צִיד֔וֹן כִּֽי־אָמַ֣ר יָ֔ם מָע֥וֹז הַיָּ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־חַ֣לְתִּי וְלֹֽא־יָלַ֗דְתִּי וְלֹ֥א גִדַּ֛לְתִּי בַּחוּרִ֖ים רוֹמַ֥מְתִּי בְתוּלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: bvshy tsydvn khy'mr ym m'vz hym l'mr l'chlty vl'yldty vl' gdlty bchvrym rvmmty btvlvt
verses.translation: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon; for the sea hath spoken, The stronghold of the sea, saying: ‘I have not travailed, nor brought forth, Neither have I reared young men, nor brought up virgins.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁר־שֵׁ֖מַע לְמִצְרָ֑יִם יָחִ֖ילוּ כְּשֵׁ֥מַע צֹֽר׃
verses.translit: kh'shrshm' lmtsrym ychylv khshm' tsr
verses.translation: When the report cometh to Egypt, They shall be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְר֖וּ תַּרְשִׁ֑ישָׁה הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי אִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'brv trshyshh hylylv yshby 'y
verses.translation: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the coast-land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲזֹ֥את לָכֶ֖ם עַלִּיזָ֑ה מִֽימֵי־קֶ֤דֶם קַדְמָתָהּ֙ יֹבִל֣וּהָ רַגְלֶ֔יהָ מֵרָח֖וֹק לָגֽוּר׃
verses.translit: hz't lkhm 'lyzh mymyqdm qdmth yblvh rglyh mrchvq lgvr
verses.translation: Is this your joyous city, Whose feet in antiquity, In ancient days, Carried her afar off to sojourn?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֚י יָעַ֣ץ זֹ֔את עַל־צֹ֖ר הַמַּעֲטִירָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר סֹחֲרֶ֙יהָ֙ שָׂרִ֔ים כִּנְעָנֶ֖יהָ נִכְבַּדֵּי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: my y'ts z't 'ltsr hm'tyrh 'shr schryh shrym khn'nyh nkhbdy'rts
verses.translation: Who hath devised this against Tyre, the crowning city, Whose merchants are princes, Whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יְעָצָ֑הּ לְחַלֵּל֙ גְּא֣וֹן כׇּל־צְבִ֔י לְהָקֵ֖ל כׇּל־נִכְבַּדֵּי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: yhvh tsb'vt y'tsh lchll g'vn khltsby lhql khlnkhbdy'rts
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts hath devised it, To pollute the pride of all glory, To bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י אַרְצֵ֖ךְ כַּיְאֹ֑ר בַּת־תַּרְשִׁ֕ישׁ אֵ֖ין מֵ֥זַח עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: 'bry 'rtskh khy'r bttrshysh 'yn mzch 'vd
verses.translation: Overflow thy land as the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish! there is no girdle any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָדוֹ֙ נָטָ֣ה עַל־הַיָּ֔ם הִרְגִּ֖יז מַמְלָכ֑וֹת יְהֹוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶל־כְּנַ֔עַן לַשְׁמִ֖ד מָעֻזְנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: ydv nth 'lhym hrgyz mmlkhvt yhvh tsvh 'lkhn'n lshmd m'znyh
verses.translation: He hath stretched out His hand over the sea, He hath shaken the kingdoms; The LORD hath given commandment concerning Canaan, To destroy the strongholds thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹא־תוֹסִ֥יפִי ע֖וֹד לַעְל֑וֹז הַֽמְעֻשָּׁקָ֞ה בְּתוּלַ֣ת בַּת־צִיד֗וֹן (כתיים) [כִּתִּים֙] ק֣וּמִי עֲבֹ֔רִי גַּם־שָׁ֖ם לֹא־יָנ֥וּחַֽ לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr l'tvsypy 'vd l'lvz hm'shqh btvlt bttsydvn (khtyym) [khtym] qvmy 'bry gmshm l'ynvch lkh
verses.translation: And He said: ‘Thou shalt no more rejoice.’ O thou oppressed virgin daughter of Zidon, Arise, pass over to Kittim; Even there shalt thou have no rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן  אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים זֶ֤ה הָעָם֙ לֹ֣א הָיָ֔ה אַשּׁ֖וּר יְסָדָ֣הּ לְצִיִּ֑ים הֵקִ֣ימוּ (בחיניו) [בַחוּנָ֗יו] עֽוֹרְרוּ֙ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שָׂמָ֖הּ לְמַפֵּלָֽה׃
verses.translit: hn  'rts khshdym zh h'm l' hyh 'shvr ysdh ltsyym hqymv (bchynyv) [bchvnyv] 'vrrv 'rmnvtyh shmh lmplh
verses.translation: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans—this is the people that was not, when Asshur founded it for shipmen—they set up their towers, they overthrew the palaces thereof; it is made a ruin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מָעֻזְּכֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hylylv 'nyvt trshysh khy shdd m'zkhn {s}
verses.translation: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish, For your stronghold is laid waste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְנִשְׁכַּ֤חַת צֹר֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה כִּימֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶחָ֑ד מִקֵּ֞ץ שִׁבְעִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לְצֹ֔ר כְּשִׁירַ֖ת הַזּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' vnshkhcht tsr shb'ym shnh khymy mlkh 'chd mqts shb'ym shnh yhyh ltsr khshyrt hzvnh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king; after the end of seventy years it shall fare with Tyre as in the song of the harlot:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְחִ֥י כִנּ֛וֹר סֹ֥בִּי עִ֖יר זוֹנָ֣ה נִשְׁכָּחָ֑ה הֵיטִ֤יבִי נַגֵּן֙ הַרְבִּי־שִׁ֔יר לְמַ֖עַן תִּזָּכֵֽרִי׃
verses.translit: qchy khnvr sby 'yr zvnh nshkhchh hytyby ngn hrbyshyr lm'n tzkhry
verses.translation: Take a harp, Go about the city, Thou harlot long forgotten; Make sweet melody, Sing many songs, That thou mayest be remembered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה מִקֵּ֣ץ  שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יִפְקֹ֤ד יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־צֹ֔ר וְשָׁבָ֖ה לְאֶתְנַנָּ֑הֿ וְזָ֥נְתָ֛ה אֶת־כׇּל־מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh mqts  shb'ym shnh ypqd yhvh 'ttsr vshbh l'tnnh vznth 'tkhlmmlkhvt h'rts 'lpny h'dmh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will remember Tyre, and she shall return to her hire, and shall have commerce with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה סַחְרָ֜הּ וְאֶתְנַנָּ֗הּ קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לֹ֥א יֵאָצֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יֵחָסֵ֑ן כִּ֣י לַיֹּשְׁבִ֞ים לִפְנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה סַחְרָ֔הּ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל לְשׇׂבְעָ֖ה וְלִמְכַסֶּ֥ה עָתִֽיק׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh schrh v'tnnh qdsh lyhvh l' y'tsr vl' ychsn khy lyshbym lpny yhvh yhyh schrh l'khl lshb'h vlmkhsh 'tyq {p}
verses.translation: And her gain and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD; it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her gain shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat their fill, and for stately clothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה בּוֹקֵ֥ק הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֽוֹלְקָ֑הּ וְעִוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֖יץ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: hnh yhvh bvqq h'rts vbvlqh v'vh pnyh vhpyts yshbyh
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty and maketh it waste, And turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה כָעָם֙ כַּכֹּהֵ֔ן כַּעֶ֙בֶד֙ כַּֽאדֹנָ֔יו כַּשִּׁפְחָ֖ה כַּגְּבִרְתָּ֑הּ כַּקּוֹנֶה֙ כַּמּוֹכֵ֔ר כַּמַּלְוֶה֙ כַּלֹּוֶ֔ה כַּנֹּשֶׁ֕ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נֹשֶׁ֥א בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'm khkhhn kh'bd kh'dnyv khshpchh khgbrth khqvnh khmvkhr khmlvh khlvh khnshh kh'shr nsh' bv
verses.translation: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; As with the servant, so with his master; As with the maid, so with her mistress; As with the buyer, so with the seller; As with the lender, so with the borrower; As with the creditor, so with the debtor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִבּ֧וֹק ׀ תִּבּ֛וֹק הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִבּ֣וֹז ׀ תִּבֹּ֑ז כִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: hbvq  tbvq h'rts vhbvz  tbz khy yhvh dbr 'thdbr hzh
verses.translation: The earth shall be utterly emptied, and clean despoiled; For the LORD hath spoken this word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבְלָ֤ה נָֽבְלָה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֻמְלְלָ֥ה נָבְלָ֖ה תֵּבֵ֑ל אֻמְלָ֖לוּ מְר֥וֹם עַם־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'blh nblh h'rts 'mllh nblh tbl 'mllv mrvm 'mh'rts
verses.translation: The earth fainteth and fadeth away, The world faileth and fadeth away, The lofty people of the earth do fail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ חָנְפָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־עָבְר֤וּ תוֹרֹת֙ חָ֣לְפוּ חֹ֔ק הֵפֵ֖רוּ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'rts chnph tcht yshbyh khy'brv tvrt chlpv chq hprv bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; Because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statute, Broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֗ן אָלָה֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֶ֔רֶץ וַֽיֶּאְשְׁמ֖וּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ עַל־כֵּ֗ן חָרוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'lh 'khlh 'rts vy'shmv yshby bh 'lkhn chrv yshby 'rts vnsh'r 'nvsh mz'r
verses.translation: Therefore hath a curse devoured the earth, And they that dwell therein are found guilty; Therefore the inhabitants of the earth waste away, And men are left few.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבַ֥ל תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלְלָה־גָ֑פֶן נֶאֶנְח֖וּ כׇּל־שִׂמְחֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: 'bl tyrvsh 'mllhgpn n'nchv khlshmchylb
verses.translation: The new wine faileth, the vine fadeth; All the merry-hearted do sigh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ תֻּפִּ֔ים חָדַ֖ל שְׁא֣וֹן עַלִּיזִ֑ים שָׁבַ֖ת מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: shbt mshvsh tpym chdl sh'vn 'lyzym shbt mshvsh khnvr
verses.translation: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, The noise of them that rejoice endeth, The joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּשִּׁ֖יר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתּוּ־יָ֑יִן יֵמַ֥ר שֵׁכָ֖ר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: bshyr l' yshtvyyn ymr shkhr lshtyv
verses.translation: They drink not wine with a song; Strong drink is bitter to them that drink it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה קִרְיַת־תֹּ֑הוּ סֻגַּ֥ר כׇּל־בַּ֖יִת מִבּֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: nshbrh qrytthv sgr khlbyt mbv'
verses.translation: Broken down is the city of wasteness; Every house is shut up, that none may come in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְוָחָ֥ה עַל־הַיַּ֖יִן בַּחוּצ֑וֹת עָֽרְבָה֙ כׇּל־שִׂמְחָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: tsvchh 'lhyyn bchvtsvt 'rbh khlshmchh glh mshvsh h'rts
verses.translation: There is a crying in the streets amidst the wine; All joy is darkened, The mirth of the land is gone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּעִ֖יר שַׁמָּ֑ה וּשְׁאִיָּ֖ה יֻכַּת־שָֽׁעַר׃
verses.translit: nsh'r b'yr shmh vsh'yh ykhtsh'r
verses.translation: In the city is left desolation, And the gate is smitten unto ruin. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יִֽהְיֶ֛ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעַמִּ֑ים כְּנֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת כְּעוֹלֵלֹ֖ת אִם־כָּלָ֥ה בָצִֽיר׃
verses.translit: khy khh yhyh bqrb h'rts btvkh h'mym khnqf zyt kh'vllt 'mkhlh btsyr
verses.translation: For thus shall it be in the midst of the earth, among the peoples, As at the beating of an olive-tree, As at the gleanings when the vintage is done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֛מָּה יִשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם יָרֹ֑נּוּ בִּגְא֣וֹן יְהֹוָ֔ה צָהֲל֖וּ מִיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: hmh ysh'v qvlm yrnv bg'vn yhvh tshlv mym
verses.translation: Those yonder lift up their voice, they sing for joy; For the majesty of the LORD they shout from the sea:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֥ן בָּאֻרִ֖ים כַּבְּד֣וּ יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּאִיֵּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם שֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lkhn b'rym khbdv yhvh b'yy hym shm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: ’Therefore glorify ye the LORD in the regions of light, Even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the isles of the sea.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכְּנַ֨ף הָאָ֜רֶץ זְמִרֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ צְבִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֔יק וָאֹמַ֛ר רָזִי־לִ֥י רָֽזִי־לִ֖י א֣וֹי לִ֑י בֹּגְדִ֣ים בָּגָ֔דוּ וּבֶ֥גֶד בּוֹגְדִ֖ים בָּגָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: mkhnf h'rts zmrt shm'nv tsby ltsdyq v'mr rzyly rzyly 'vy ly bgdym bgdv vbgd bvgdym bgdv
verses.translation: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs: ‘Glory to the righteous.’ But I say: I waste away, I waste away, woe is me! The treacherous deal treacherously; Yea, the treacherous deal very treacherously.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: pchd vpcht vpch 'lykh yvshb h'rts
verses.translation: Terror, and the pit, and the trap, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָ֠ה הַנָּ֞ס מִקּ֤וֹל הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעוֹלֶה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִמָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ וַֽיִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhyh hns mqvl hpchd ypl 'lhpcht vh'vlh mtvkh hpcht ylkhd bpch khy'rbvt mmrvm nptchv vyr'shv mvsdy 'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the terror shall fall into the pit; And he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the trap; For the windows on high are opened, And the foundations of the earth do shake;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹ֥עָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ פּ֤וֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ מ֥וֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָ֖ה אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: r'h htr''h h'rts pvr htpvrrh 'rts mvt htmvtth 'rts
verses.translation: The earth is broken, broken down, The earth is crumbled in pieces, The earth trembleth and tottereth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נ֣וֹעַ תָּנ֤וּעַ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ כַּשִּׁכּ֔וֹר וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּמְּלוּנָ֑ה וְכָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה וְלֹא־תֹסִ֥יף קֽוּם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nv' tnv' 'rts khshkhvr vhtnvddh khmlvnh vkhbd 'lyh psh'h vnplh vl'tsyf qvm {s}
verses.translation: The earth reeleth to and fro like a drunken man, And swayeth to and fro as a lodge; And the transgression thereof is heavy upon it, And it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִפְקֹ֧ד יְהֹוָ֛ה עַל־צְבָ֥א הַמָּר֖וֹם בַּמָּר֑וֹם וְעַל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ypqd yhvh 'ltsb' hmrvm bmrvm v'lmlkhy h'dmh 'lh'dmh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the LORD will punish the host of the high heaven on high, And the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֻסְּפ֨וּ אֲסֵפָ֤ה אַסִּיר֙ עַל־בּ֔וֹר וְסֻגְּר֖וּ עַל־מַסְגֵּ֑ר וּמֵרֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: v'spv 'sph 'syr 'lbvr vsgrv 'lmsgr vmrb ymym ypqdv
verses.translation: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the dungeon, And shall be shut up in the prison, And after many days shall they be punished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָֽפְרָה֙ הַלְּבָנָ֔ה וּבוֹשָׁ֖ה הַחַמָּ֑ה כִּֽי־מָלַ֞ךְ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת בְּהַ֤ר צִיּוֹן֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְנֶ֥גֶד זְקֵנָ֖יו כָּבֽוֹד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vchprh hlbnh vbvshh hchmh khymlkh yhvh tsb'vt bhr tsyvn vbyrvshl͏m vngd zqnyv khbvd {p}
verses.translation: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; For the LORD of hosts will reign in mount Zion, And in Jerusalem, and before His elders shall be Glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַי֙ אַתָּ֔ה אֲרֽוֹמִמְךָ֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ פֶּ֑לֶא עֵצ֥וֹת מֵרָחֹ֖ק אֱמ֥וּנָה אֹֽמֶן׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'th 'rvmmkh 'vdh shmkh khy 'shyt pl' 'tsvt mrchq 'mvnh 'mn
verses.translation: O LORD, Thou art my God, I will exalt Thee, I will praise Thy name, For Thou hast done wonderful things; Even counsels of old, in faithfulness and truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֤מְתָּ מֵעִיר֙ לַגָּ֔ל קִרְיָ֥ה בְצוּרָ֖ה לְמַפֵּלָ֑ה אַרְמ֤וֹן זָרִים֙ מֵעִ֔יר לְעוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א יִבָּנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khy shmt m'yr lgl qryh btsvrh lmplh 'rmvn zrym m'yr l'vlm l' ybnh
verses.translation: For Thou hast made of a city a heap, Of a fortified city a ruin; A castle of strangers to be no city, It shall never be built. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֖ן יְכַבְּד֣וּךָ עַם־עָ֑ז קִרְיַ֛ת גּוֹיִ֥ם עָרִיצִ֖ים יִירָאֽוּךָ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn ykhbdvkh 'm'z qryt gvym 'rytsym yyr'vkh
verses.translation: Therefore shall the strong people glorify Thee, The city of the terrible nations shall fear Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־הָיִ֨יתָ מָע֥וֹז לַדָּ֛ל מָע֥וֹז לָאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּצַּר־ל֑וֹ מַחְסֶ֤ה מִזֶּ֙רֶם֙ צֵ֣ל מֵחֹ֔רֶב כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ עָרִיצִ֖ים כְּזֶ֥רֶם קִֽיר׃
verses.translit: khyhyyt m'vz ldl m'vz l'byvn btsrlv mchsh mzrm tsl mchrb khy rvch 'rytsym khzrm qyr
verses.translation: For Thou hast been a stronghold to the poor, A stronghold to the needy in his distress, A refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat; For the blast of the terrible ones was as a storm against the wall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּחֹ֣רֶב בְּצָי֔וֹן שְׁא֥וֹן זָרִ֖ים תַּכְנִ֑יעַ חֹ֚רֶב בְּצֵ֣ל עָ֔ב זְמִ֥יר עָרִיצִ֖ים יַעֲנֶֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khchrb btsyvn sh'vn zrym tkhny' chrb btsl 'b zmyr 'rytsym y'nh {p}
verses.translation: As the heat in a dry place, Thou didst subdue the noise of strangers; As the heat by the shadow of a cloud, the song of the terrible ones was brought low.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂה֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת לְכׇל־הָֽעַמִּים֙ בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה מִשְׁתֵּ֥ה שְׁמָנִ֖ים מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה שְׁמָרִ֑ים שְׁמָנִים֙ מְמֻ֣חָיִ֔ם שְׁמָרִ֖ים מְזֻקָּקִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'shh yhvh tsb'vt lkhlh'mym bhr hzh mshth shmnym mshth shmrym shmnym mmchym shmrym mzqqym
verses.translation: And in this mountain will the LORD of hosts make unto all peoples A feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, Of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִלַּע֙ בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה פְּנֵֽי־הַלּ֥וֹט ׀ הַלּ֖וֹט עַל־כׇּל־הָעַמִּ֑ים וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה הַנְּסוּכָ֖ה עַל־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vbl' bhr hzh pnyhlvt  hlvt 'lkhlh'mym vhmskhh hnsvkhh 'lkhlhgvym
verses.translation: And He will destroy in this mountain The face of the covering that is cast over all peoples, And the veil that is spread over all nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּלַּ֤ע הַמָּ֙וֶת֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וּמָחָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה דִּמְעָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל כׇּל־פָּנִ֑ים וְחֶרְפַּ֣ת עַמּ֗וֹ יָסִיר֙ מֵעַ֣ל כׇּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bl' hmvt lntsch vmchh 'dny yhvh dm'h m'l khlpnym vchrpt 'mv ysyr m'l khlh'rts khy yhvh dbr {p}
verses.translation: He will swallow up death for ever; And the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; And the reproach of His people will He take away from off all the earth; For the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הִנֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ זֶ֛ה קִוִּ֥ינוּ ל֖וֹ וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נוּ זֶ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ קִוִּ֣ינוּ ל֔וֹ נָגִ֥ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֖ה בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mr byvm hhv' hnh 'lhynv zh qvynv lv vyvshy'nv zh yhvh qvynv lv ngylh vnshmchh byshv'tv
verses.translation: And it shall be said in that day: ‘Lo, this is our God, For whom we waited, that He might save us; This is the LORD, for whom we waited, We will be glad and rejoice in His salvation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־תָנ֥וּחַ יַד־יְהֹוָ֖ה בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְנָד֤וֹשׁ מוֹאָב֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו כְּהִדּ֥וּשׁ מַתְבֵּ֖ן (במי) [בְּמ֥וֹ] מַדְמֵנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khytnvch ydyhvh bhr hzh vndvsh mv'b tchtyv khhdvsh mtbn (bmy) [bmv] mdmnh
verses.translation: For in this mountain will the hand of the LORD rest, And Moab shall be trodden down in his place, Even as straw is trodden down in the dunghill.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפֵרַ֤שׂ יָדָיו֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְפָרֵ֥שׂ הַשֹּׂחֶ֖ה לִשְׂח֑וֹת וְהִשְׁפִּיל֙ גַּאֲוָת֔וֹ עִ֖ם אׇרְבּ֥וֹת יָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vprsh ydyv bqrbv kh'shr yprsh hshchh lshchvt vhshpyl g'vtv 'm 'rbvt ydyv
verses.translation: And when he shall spread forth his hands in the midst thereof, As he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim, His pride shall be brought down together with the cunning of his hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבְצַ֞ר מִשְׂגַּ֣ב חוֹמֹתֶ֗יךָ הֵשַׁ֥ח הִשְׁפִּ֛יל הִגִּ֥יעַ לָאָ֖רֶץ עַד־עָפָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmbtsr mshgb chvmtykh hshch hshpyl hgy' l'rts 'd'pr {s}
verses.translation: And the high fortress of thy walls will He bring down, lay low, And bring to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יוּשַׁ֥ר הַשִּׁיר־הַזֶּ֖ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה עִ֣יר עׇז־לָ֔נוּ יְשׁוּעָ֥ה יָשִׁ֖ית חוֹמ֥וֹת וָחֵֽל׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yvshr hshyrhzh b'rts yhvdh 'yr 'zlnv yshv'h yshyt chvmvt vchl
verses.translation: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; Walls and bulwarks doth He appoint for salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּתְח֖וּ שְׁעָרִ֑ים וְיָבֹ֥א גוֹי־צַדִּ֖יק שֹׁמֵ֥ר אֱמֻנִֽים׃
verses.translit: ptchv sh'rym vyb' gvytsdyq shmr 'mnym
verses.translation: Open ye the gates, That the righteous nation that keepeth faithfulness may enter in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵ֣צֶר סָמ֔וּךְ תִּצֹּ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם ׀ שָׁל֑וֹם כִּ֥י בְךָ֖ בָּטֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: ytsr smvkh ttsr shlvm  shlvm khy bkh btvch
verses.translation: The mind stayed on Thee Thou keepest in perfect peace; Because it trusteth in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּטְח֥וּ בַיהֹוָ֖ה עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד כִּ֚י בְּיָ֣הּ יְהֹוָ֔ה צ֖וּר עוֹלָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: btchv byhvh 'dy'd khy byh yhvh tsvr 'vlmym
verses.translation: Trust ye in the LORD for ever, For the LORD is GOD, an everlasting Rock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֵשַׁח֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מָר֔וֹם קִרְיָ֖ה נִשְׂגָּבָ֑ה יַשְׁפִּילֶ֤נָּה יַשְׁפִּילָהּ֙ עַד־אֶ֔רֶץ יַגִּיעֶ֖נָּה עַד־עָפָֽר׃
verses.translit: khy hshch yshby mrvm qryh nshgbh yshpylnh yshpylh 'd'rts ygy'nh 'd'pr
verses.translation: For He hath brought down them that dwell on high, The lofty city, laying it low, laying it low even to the ground, Bringing it even to the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּרְמְסֶ֖נָּה רָ֑גֶל רַגְלֵ֥י עָנִ֖י פַּעֲמֵ֥י דַלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: trmsnh rgl rgly 'ny p'my dlym
verses.translation: The foot shall tread it down, Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֥רַח לַצַּדִּ֖יק מֵישָׁרִ֑ים יָשָׁ֕ר מַעְגַּ֥ל צַדִּ֖יק תְּפַלֵּֽס׃
verses.translit: 'rch ltsdyq myshrym yshr m'gl tsdyq tpls
verses.translation: The way of the just is straight; Thou, Most Upright, makest plain the path of the just.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ף אֹ֧רַח מִשְׁפָּטֶ֛יךָ יְהֹוָ֖ה קִוִּינ֑וּךָ לְשִׁמְךָ֥ וּלְזִכְרְךָ֖ תַּאֲוַת־נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'f 'rch mshptykh yhvh qvynvkh lshmkh vlzkhrkh t'vtnpsh
verses.translation: Yea, in the way of Thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for Thee; To Thy name and to Thy memorial is the desire of our soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֤י אִוִּיתִ֙ךָ֙ בַּלַּ֔יְלָה אַף־רוּחִ֥י בְקִרְבִּ֖י אֲשַׁחֲרֶ֑ךָּ כִּ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מִשְׁפָּטֶ֙יךָ֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ צֶ֥דֶק לָמְד֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
verses.translit: npshy 'vytkh blylh 'frvchy bqrby 'shchrkh khy kh'shr mshptykh l'rts tsdq lmdv yshby tbl
verses.translation: With my soul have I desired Thee in the night; Yea, with my spirit within me have I sought Thee earnestly; For when Thy judgments are in the earth, The inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֻחַ֤ן רָשָׁע֙ בַּל־לָמַ֣ד צֶ֔דֶק בְּאֶ֥רֶץ נְכֹח֖וֹת יְעַוֵּ֑ל וּבַל־יִרְאֶ֖ה גֵּא֥וּת יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ychn rsh' bllmd tsdq b'rts nkhchvt y'vl vblyr'h g'vt yhvh {p}
verses.translation: Let favour be shown to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness; In the land of uprightness will he deal wrongfully, And will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֛ה רָ֥מָה יָדְךָ֖ בַּל־יֶחֱזָי֑וּן יֶחֱז֤וּ וְיֵבֹ֙שׁוּ֙ קִנְאַת־עָ֔ם אַף־אֵ֖שׁ צָרֶ֥יךָ תֹאכְלֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yhvh rmh ydkh blychzyvn ychzv vybshv qn't'm 'f'sh tsrykh t'khlm {s}
verses.translation: LORD, Thy hand was lifted up, yet they see not; They shall see with shame Thy zeal for the people; Yea, fire shall devour Thine adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֕ה תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ת שָׁל֖וֹם לָ֑נוּ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם כׇּֽל־מַעֲשֵׂ֖ינוּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yhvh tshpt shlvm lnv khy gm khlm'shynv p'lt lnv {s}
verses.translation: LORD, Thou wilt establish peace for us; For Thou hast indeed wrought all our works for us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ בְּעָל֥וּנוּ אֲדֹנִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑ךָ לְבַד־בְּךָ֖ נַזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv b'lvnv 'dnym zvltkh lbdbkh nzkhyr shmkh
verses.translation: O LORD our God, other lords beside Thee have had dominion over us; But by Thee only do we make mention of Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵתִים֙ בַּל־יִ֣חְי֔וּ רְפָאִ֖ים בַּל־יָקֻ֑מוּ לָכֵ֤ן פָּקַ֙דְתָּ֙ וַתַּשְׁמִידֵ֔ם וַתְּאַבֵּ֥ד כׇּל־זֵ֖כֶר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: mtym blychyv rp'ym blyqmv lkhn pqdt vtshmydm vt'bd khlzkhr lmv
verses.translation: The dead live not, the shades rise not; To that end hast Thou punished and destroyed them, And made all their memory to perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָסַ֤פְתָּ לַגּוֹי֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה יָסַ֥פְתָּ לַגּ֖וֹי נִכְבָּ֑דְתָּ רִחַ֖קְתָּ כׇּל־קַצְוֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yspt lgvy yhvh yspt lgvy nkhbdt rchqt khlqtsvy'rts {p}
verses.translation: Thou hast gotten Thee honour with the nations, O LORD, Yea, exceeding great honour with the nations; Thou art honoured unto the farthest ends of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּצַּ֣ר פְּקָד֑וּךָ צָק֣וּן לַ֔חַשׁ מוּסָרְךָ֖ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhvh btsr pqdvkh tsqvn lchsh mvsrkh lmv
verses.translation: LORD, in trouble have they sought Thee, Silently they poured out a prayer when Thy chastening was upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ הָרָה֙ תַּקְרִ֣יב לָלֶ֔דֶת תָּחִ֥יל תִּזְעַ֖ק בַּחֲבָלֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֛ן הָיִ֥ינוּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khmv hrh tqryb lldt tchyl tz'q bchblyh khn hyynv mpnykh yhvh
verses.translation: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, Is in pain and crieth out in her pangs; So have we been at Thy presence, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִ֣ינוּ חַ֔לְנוּ כְּמ֖וֹ יָלַ֣דְנוּ ר֑וּחַ יְשׁוּעֹת֙ בַּל־נַ֣עֲשֶׂה אֶ֔רֶץ וּבַֽל־יִפְּל֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hrynv chlnv khmv yldnv rvch yshv't bln'shh 'rts vblyplv yshby tbl
verses.translation: We have been with child, we have been in pain, We have as it were brought forth wind; We have not wrought any deliverance in the land; Neither are the inhabitants of the world come to life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽחְי֣וּ מֵתֶ֔יךָ נְבֵלָתִ֖י יְקוּמ֑וּן הָקִ֨יצוּ וְרַנְּנ֜וּ שֹׁכְנֵ֣י עָפָ֗ר כִּ֣י טַ֤ל אוֹרֹת֙ טַלֶּ֔ךָ וָאָ֖רֶץ רְפָאִ֥ים תַּפִּֽיל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ychyv mtykh nblty yqvmvn hqytsv vrnnv shkhny 'pr khy tl 'vrt tlkh v'rts rp'ym tpyl {p}
verses.translation: Thy dead shall live, my dead bodies shall arise— Awake and sing, ye that dwell in the dust— For Thy dew is as the dew of light, And the earth shall bring to life the shades.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ עַמִּי֙ בֹּ֣א בַחֲדָרֶ֔יךָ וּֽסְגֹ֥ר (דלתיך) [דְּלָֽתְךָ֖] בַּעֲדֶ֑ךָ חֲבִ֥י כִמְעַט־רֶ֖גַע עַד־(יעבור)־[יַעֲבׇר־]זָֽעַם׃
verses.translit: lkh 'my b' bchdrykh vsgr (dltykh) [dltkh] b'dkh chby khm'trg' 'd(y'bvr)[y'br]z'm
verses.translation: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, And shut thy doors about thee; Hide thyself for a little moment, Until the indignation be overpast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ יֹצֵ֣א מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ לִפְקֹ֛ד עֲוֺ֥ן יֹֽשֵׁב־הָאָ֖רֶץ עָלָ֑יו וְגִלְּתָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־דָּמֶ֔יהָ וְלֹא־תְכַסֶּ֥ה ע֖וֹד עַל־הֲרוּגֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khyhnh yhvh yts' mmqvmv lpqd 'vn yshbh'rts 'lyv vglth h'rts 'tdmyh vl'tkhsh 'vd 'lhrvgyh {p}
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of His place To visit upon the inhabitants of the earth their iniquity; The earth also shall disclose her blood, And shall no more cover her slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהֹוָה֩ בְּחַרְבּ֨וֹ הַקָּשָׁ֜ה וְהַגְּדוֹלָ֣ה וְהַחֲזָקָ֗ה עַ֤ל לִוְיָתָן֙ נָחָ֣שׁ בָּרִ֔חַ וְעַל֙ לִוְיָתָ֔ן נָחָ֖שׁ עֲקַלָּת֑וֹן וְהָרַ֥ג אֶת־הַתַּנִּ֖ין אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּיָּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ypqd yhvh bchrbv hqshh vhgdvlh vhchzqh 'l lvytn nchsh brch v'l lvytn nchsh 'qltvn vhrg 'thtnyn 'shr bym {s}
verses.translation: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword will punish leviathan the slant serpent, and leviathan the tortuous serpent; and He will slay the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֖וֹם הַה֑וּא כֶּ֥רֶם חֶ֖מֶר עַנּוּ־לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' khrm chmr 'nvlh
verses.translation: In that day sing ye of her: ‘A vineyard of foaming wine! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ נֹֽצְרָ֔הּ לִרְגָעִ֖ים אַשְׁקֶ֑נָּה פֶּ֚ן יִפְקֹ֣ד עָלֶ֔יהָ לַ֥יְלָה וָי֖וֹם אֶצֳּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh ntsrh lrg'ym 'shqnh pn ypqd 'lyh lylh vyvm 'tsrnh
verses.translation: I the LORD do guard it, I water it every moment; Lest Mine anger visit it, I guard it night and day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֵמָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לִ֑י מִֽי־יִתְּנֵ֜נִי שָׁמִ֥יר שַׁ֙יִת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶפְשְׂעָ֥ה בָ֖הּ אֲצִיתֶ֥נָּה יָּֽחַד׃
verses.translit: chmh 'yn ly myytnny shmyr shyt bmlchmh 'psh'h bh 'tsytnh ychd
verses.translation: Fury is not in Me; Would that I were as the briers and thorns in flame! I would with one step burn it altogether.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֚וֹ יַחֲזֵ֣ק בְּמָעוּזִּ֔י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם לִ֑י שָׁל֖וֹם יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'v ychzq bm'vzy y'shh shlvm ly shlvm y'shhly
verses.translation: Or else let him take hold of My strength, That he may make peace with Me; yea, let him make peace with Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבָּאִים֙ יַשְׁרֵ֣שׁ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יָצִ֥יץ וּפָרַ֖ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵי־תֵבֵ֖ל תְּנוּבָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hb'ym yshrsh y'qb ytsyts vprch yshr'l vml'v pnytbl tnvbh {p}
verses.translation: In days to come shall Jacob take root, Israel shall blossom and bud; And the face of the world shall be filled with fruitage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכְּמַכַּ֥ת מַכֵּ֖הוּ הִכָּ֑הוּ אִם־כְּהֶ֥רֶג הֲרֻגָ֖יו הֹרָֽג׃
verses.translit: hkhmkht mkhhv hkhhv 'mkhhrg hrgyv hrg
verses.translation: Hath He smitten him as He smote those that smote him? Or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that were slain by Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּסַאסְּאָ֖ה בְּשַׁלְחָ֣הּ תְּרִיבֶ֑נָּה הָגָ֛ה בְּרוּח֥וֹ הַקָּשָׁ֖ה בְּי֥וֹם קָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: bs's'h bshlchh trybnh hgh brvchv hqshh byvm qdym
verses.translation: In full measure, when Thou sendest her away, Thou dost contend with her; He hath removed her with His rough blast in the day of the east wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן בְּזֹאת֙ יְכֻפַּ֣ר עֲוֺֽן־יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְזֶ֕ה כׇּל־פְּרִ֖י הָסִ֣ר חַטָּאת֑וֹ בְּשׂוּמ֣וֹ  כׇּל־אַבְנֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֗חַ כְּאַבְנֵי־גִר֙ מְנֻפָּצ֔וֹת לֹא־יָקֻ֥מוּ אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְחַמָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: lkhn bz't ykhpr 'vny'qb vzh khlpry hsr cht'tv bshvmv  khl'bny mzbch kh'bnygr mnptsvt l'yqmv 'shrym vchmnym
verses.translation: Therefore by this shall the iniquity of Jacob be expiated, And this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: When he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in pieces, So that the Asherim and the sun-images shall rise no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עִ֤יר בְּצוּרָה֙ בָּדָ֔ד נָוֶ֕ה מְשֻׁלָּ֥ח וְנֶעֱזָ֖ב כַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר שָׁ֣ם יִרְעֶ֥ה עֵ֛גֶל וְשָׁ֥ם יִרְבָּ֖ץ וְכִלָּ֥ה סְעִפֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: khy 'yr btsvrh bdd nvh mshlch vn'zb khmdbr shm yr'h 'gl vshm yrbts vkhlh s'pyh
verses.translation: For the fortified city is solitary, A habitation abandoned and forsaken, like the wilderness; There shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, And consume the branches thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּיבֹ֤שׁ קְצִירָהּ֙ תִּשָּׁבַ֔רְנָה נָשִׁ֕ים בָּא֖וֹת מְאִיר֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עַם־בִּינוֹת֙ ה֔וּא עַל־כֵּן֙ לֹא־יְרַחֲמֶ֣נּוּ עֹשֵׂ֔הוּ וְיֹצְר֖וֹ לֹ֥א יְחֻנֶּֽנּוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bybsh qtsyrh tshbrnh nshym b'vt m'yrvt 'vth khy l' 'mbynvt hv' 'lkhn l'yrchmnv 'shhv vytsrv l' ychnnv {p}
verses.translation: When the boughs thereof are withered, They shall be broken off; The women shall come, and set them on fire; For it is a people of no understanding; Therefore He that made them will not have compassion upon them, And He that formed them will not be gracious unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יַחְבֹּ֧ט יְהֹוָ֛ה מִשִּׁבֹּ֥לֶת הַנָּהָ֖ר עַד־נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאַתֶּ֧ם תְּלֻקְּט֛וּ לְאַחַ֥ד אֶחָ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ychbt yhvh mshblt hnhr 'dnchl mtsrym v'tm tlqtv l'chd 'chd bny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the LORD will beat off [His fruit] From the flood of the River unto the Brook of Egypt, And ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִתָּקַע֮ בְּשׁוֹפָ֣ר גָּדוֹל֒ וּבָ֗אוּ הָאֹֽבְדִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְהַנִּדָּחִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲו֧וּ לַיהֹוָ֛ה בְּהַ֥ר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' ytq' bshvpr gdvl vb'v h'bdym b'rts 'shvr vhndchym b'rts mtsrym vhshtchvv lyhvh bhr hqdsh byrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That a great horn shall be blown; And they shall come that were lost in the land of Assyria, And they that were dispersed in the land of Egypt; And they shall worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי עֲטֶ֤רֶת גֵּאוּת֙ שִׁכֹּרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְצִ֥יץ נֹבֵ֖ל צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ גֵּֽיא־שְׁמָנִ֖ים הֲל֥וּמֵי יָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: hvy 'trt g'vt shkhry 'prym vtsyts nbl tsby tp'rtv 'shr 'lr'sh gy'shmnym hlvmy yyn
verses.translation: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, And to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, Which is on the head of the fat valley of them that are smitten down with wine!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה חָזָ֤ק וְאַמִּץ֙ לַֽאדֹנָ֔י כְּזֶ֥רֶם בָּרָ֖ד שַׂ֣עַר קָ֑טֶב כְּ֠זֶ֠רֶם מַ֣יִם כַּבִּירִ֥ים שֹׁטְפִ֛ים הִנִּ֥יחַ לָאָ֖רֶץ בְּיָֽד׃
verses.translit: hnh chzq v'mts l'dny khzrm brd sh'r qtb khzrm mym khbyrym shtpym hnych l'rts byd
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, As a storm of hail, a tempest of destruction, As a storm of mighty waters overflowing, That casteth down to the earth with violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרַגְלַ֖יִם תֵּרָמַ֑סְנָה עֲטֶ֥רֶת גֵּא֖וּת שִׁכּוֹרֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: brglym trmsnh 'trt g'vt shkhvry 'prym
verses.translation: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim Shall be trodden under foot;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה צִיצַ֤ת נֹבֵל֙ צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־רֹ֖אשׁ גֵּ֣יא שְׁמָנִ֑ים כְּבִכּוּרָהּ֙ בְּטֶ֣רֶם קַ֔יִץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְאֶ֤ה הָרֹאֶה֙ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּעוֹדָ֥הּ בְּכַפּ֖וֹ יִבְלָעֶֽנָּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyth tsytst nbl tsby tp'rtv 'shr 'lr'sh gy' shmnym khbkhvrh btrm qyts 'shr yr'h hr'h 'vth b'vdh bkhpv ybl'nh {s}
verses.translation: And the fading flower of his glorious beauty, Which is on the head of the fat valley, Shall be as the first-ripe fig before the summer, Which when one looketh upon it, While it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַעֲטֶ֣רֶת צְבִ֔י וְלִצְפִירַ֖ת תִּפְאָרָ֑ה לִשְׁאָ֖ר עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh yhvh tsb'vt l'trt tsby vltspyrt tp'rh lsh'r 'mv
verses.translation: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be For a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, Unto the residue of His people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְר֖וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט לַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ עַל־הַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְלִ֨גְבוּרָ֔ה מְשִׁיבֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה שָֽׁעְרָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlrvch mshpt lyvshb 'lhmshpt vlgbvrh mshyby mlchmh sh'rh {s}
verses.translation: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, And for strength to them that turn back the battle at the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ בַּיַּ֣יִן שָׁג֔וּ וּבַשֵּׁכָ֖ר תָּע֑וּ כֹּהֵ֣ן וְנָבִיא֩ שָׁג֨וּ בַשֵּׁכָ֜ר נִבְלְע֣וּ מִן־הַיַּ֗יִן תָּעוּ֙ מִן־הַשֵּׁכָ֔ר שָׁגוּ֙ בָּרֹאֶ֔ה פָּק֖וּ פְּלִילִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vgm'lh byyn shgv vbshkhr t'v khhn vnby' shgv bshkhr nbl'v mnhyyn t'v mnhshkhr shgv br'h pqv plylyh
verses.translation: But these also reel through wine, And stagger through strong drink; The priest and the prophet reel through strong drink, They are confused because of wine, They stagger because of strong drink; They reel in vision, they totter in judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י כׇּל־שֻׁלְחָנ֔וֹת מָלְא֖וּ קִ֣יא צֹאָ֑ה בְּלִ֖י מָקֽוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy khlshlchnvt ml'v qy' ts'h bly mqvm {p}
verses.translation: For all tables are full of filthy vomit, and no place is clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־מִי֙ יוֹרֶ֣ה דֵעָ֔ה וְאֶת־מִ֖י יָבִ֣ין שְׁמוּעָ֑ה גְּמוּלֵי֙ מֵחָלָ֔ב עַתִּיקֵ֖י מִשָּׁדָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'tmy yvrh d'h v'tmy ybyn shmv'h gmvly mchlb 'tyqy mshdym
verses.translation: Whom shall one teach knowledge? And whom shall one make to understand the message? Them that are weaned from the milk, Them that are drawn from the breasts?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י צַ֤ו לָצָו֙ צַ֣ו לָצָ֔ו קַ֥ו לָקָ֖ו קַ֣ו לָקָ֑ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֥יר שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: khy tsv ltsv tsv ltsv qv lqv qv lqv z'yr shm z'yr shm
verses.translation: For it is precept by precept, precept by precept, Line by line, line by line; Here a little, there a little.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י בְּלַעֲגֵ֣י שָׂפָ֔ה וּבְלָשׁ֖וֹן אַחֶ֑רֶת יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy bl'gy shph vblshvn 'chrt ydbr 'lh'm hzh
verses.translation: For with stammering lips and with a strange tongue Shall it be spoken to this people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר  אָמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֹ֤את הַמְּנוּחָה֙ הָנִ֣יחוּ לֶעָיֵ֔ף וְזֹ֖את הַמַּרְגֵּעָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וּא שְׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.translit: 'shr  'mr 'lyhm z't hmnvchh hnychv l'yf vz't hmrg'h vl' 'bv' shmv'
verses.translation: To whom it was said: ‘This is the rest, Give ye rest to the weary; And this is the refreshing’; Yet they would not hear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה לָהֶ֜ם דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה צַ֣ו לָצָ֞ו צַ֤ו לָצָו֙ קַ֤ו לָקָו֙ קַ֣ו לָקָ֔ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֣יר שָׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן יֵלְכ֜וּ וְכָשְׁל֤וּ אָחוֹר֙ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh lhm dbryhvh tsv ltsv tsv ltsv qv lqv qv lqv z'yr shm z'yr shm lm'n ylkhv vkhshlv 'chvr vnshbrv vnvqshv vnlkhdv {p}
verses.translation: And so the word of the LORD is unto them Precept by precept, precept by precept, Line by line, line by line; Here a little, there a little; That they may go, and fall backward, and be broken, And snared, and taken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָצ֑וֹן מֹֽשְׁלֵי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v dbryhvh 'nshy ltsvn mshly h'm hzh 'shr byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scoffers, The ballad-mongers of this people which is in Jerusalem:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם כָּרַ֤תְנֽוּ בְרִית֙ אֶת־מָ֔וֶת וְעִם־שְׁא֖וֹל עָשִׂ֣ינוּ חֹזֶ֑ה (שיט) [שׁ֣וֹט] שׁוֹטֵ֤ף כִּי־[יַֽעֲבֹר֙] (עבר) לֹ֣א יְבוֹאֵ֔נוּ כִּ֣י שַׂ֧מְנוּ כָזָ֛ב מַחְסֵ֖נוּ וּבַשֶּׁ֥קֶר נִסְתָּֽרְנוּ׃ {פ}
