verses.translit: khy 'mrtm khrtnv bryt 'tmvt v'msh'vl 'shynv chzh (shyt) [shvt] shvtf khy[y'br] ('br) l' ybv'nv khy shmnv khzb mchsnv vbshqr nstrnv {p}
verses.translation: Because ye have said: ‘We have made a covenant with death, And with the nether-world are we at agreement; When the scouring scourge shall pass through, It shall not come unto us; For we have made lies our refuge, And in falsehood have we hid ourselves’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֛י יִסַּ֥ד בְּצִיּ֖וֹן אָ֑בֶן אֶ֣בֶן בֹּ֜חַן פִּנַּ֤ת יִקְרַת֙ מוּסָ֣ד מוּסָּ֔ד הַֽמַּאֲמִ֖ין לֹ֥א יָחִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny ysd btsyvn 'bn 'bn bchn pnt yqrt mvsd mvsd hm'myn l' ychysh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, A tried stone, a costly corner-stone of sure foundation; He that believeth shall not make haste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ לְקָ֔ו וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְמִשְׁקָ֑לֶת וְיָעָ֤ה בָרָד֙ מַחְסֵ֣ה כָזָ֔ב וְסֵ֥תֶר מַ֖יִם יִשְׁטֹֽפוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshmty mshpt lqv vtsdqh lmshqlt vy'h brd mchsh khzb vstr mym yshtpv {s}
verses.translation: And I will make justice the line, And righteousness the plummet; And the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, And the waters shall overflow the hiding-place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֻפַּ֤ר בְּרִֽיתְכֶם֙ אֶת־מָ֔וֶת וְחָזוּתְכֶ֥ם אֶת־שְׁא֖וֹל לֹ֣א תָק֑וּם שׁ֤וֹט שׁוֹטֵף֙ כִּ֣י יַֽעֲבֹ֔ר וִהְיִ֥יתֶם ל֖וֹ לְמִרְמָֽס׃
verses.translit: vkhpr brytkhm 'tmvt vchzvtkhm 'tsh'vl l' tqvm shvt shvtf khy y'br vhyytm lv lmrms
verses.translation: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled And your agreement with the nether-world shall not stand; When the scouring scourge shall pass through, Then ye shall be trodden down by it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִדֵּ֤י עׇבְרוֹ֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֶתְכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־בַבֹּ֧קֶר בַּבֹּ֛קֶר יַעֲבֹ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָיָ֥ה רַק־זְוָעָ֖ה הָבִ֥ין שְׁמוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: mdy 'brv yqch 'tkhm khybbqr bbqr y'br byvm vblylh vhyh rqzv'h hbyn shmv'h
verses.translation: As often as it passeth through, it shall take you; For morning by morning shall it pass through, By day and by night; And it shall be sheer terror to understand the message.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־קָצַ֥ר הַמַּצָּ֖ע מֵהִשְׂתָּרֵ֑עַ וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה צָ֖רָה כְּהִתְכַּנֵּֽס׃
verses.translit: khyqtsr hmts' mhshtr' vhmskhh tsrh khhtkhns
verses.translation: For the bed is too short for a man to stretch himself; And the covering too narrow when he gathereth himself up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כְהַר־פְּרָצִים֙ יָק֣וּם יְהֹוָ֔ה כְּעֵ֖מֶק בְּגִבְע֣וֹן יִרְגָּ֑ז לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ זָ֣ר מַעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ נׇכְרִיָּ֖ה עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy khhrprtsym yqvm yhvh kh'mq bgb'vn yrgz l'shvt m'shhv zr m'shhv vl'bd 'bdtv nkhryh 'bdtv
verses.translation: For the LORD will rise up as in mount Perazim, He will be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon; That He may do His work, strange is His work, And bring to pass His act, strange is His act.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־תִּתְלוֹצָ֔צוּ פֶּֽן־יֶחְזְק֖וּ מֽוֹסְרֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־כָלָ֨ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֜ה שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵאֵ֨ת אֲדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th 'lttlvtstsv pnychzqv mvsrykhm khykhlh vnchrtsh shm'ty m't 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'lkhlh'rts {p}
verses.translation: Now therefore be ye not scoffers, Lest your bands be made strong; For an extermination wholly determined have I heard from the Lord, the GOD of hosts, Upon the whole land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ קוֹלִ֑י הַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אִמְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: h'zynv vshm'v qvly hqshybv vshm'v 'mrty
verses.translation: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; attend, and hear my speech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲכֹ֣ל הַיּ֔וֹם יַחֲרֹ֥שׁ הַחֹרֵ֖שׁ לִזְרֹ֑עַ יְפַתַּ֥ח וִֽישַׂדֵּ֖ד אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hkhl hyvm ychrsh hchrsh lzr' yptch vyshdd 'dmtv
verses.translation: Is the plowman never done with plowing to sow, With the opening and harrowing of his ground?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלוֹא֙ אִם־שִׁוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֥יץ קֶ֖צַח וְכַמֹּ֣ן יִזְרֹ֑ק וְשָׂ֨ם חִטָּ֤ה שׂוֹרָה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֣ה נִסְמָ֔ן וְכֻסֶּ֖מֶת גְּבֻלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hlv' 'mshvh pnyh vhpyts qtsch vkhmn yzrq vshm chth shvrh vsh'rh nsmn vkhsmt gbltv
verses.translation: When he hath made plain the face thereof, Doth he not cast abroad the black cummin, and scatter the cummin, And put in the wheat in rows and the barley in the appointed place And the spelt in the border thereof?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִסְּר֥וֹ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט אֱלֹהָ֥יו יוֹרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vysrv lmshpt 'lhyv yvrnv
verses.translation: For He doth instruct him aright; His God doth teach him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א בֶחָרוּץ֙ י֣וּדַשׁ קֶ֔צַח וְאוֹפַ֣ן עֲגָלָ֔ה עַל־כַּמֹּ֖ן יוּסָּ֑ב כִּ֧י בַמַּטֶּ֛ה יֵחָ֥בֶט קֶ֖צַח וְכַמֹּ֥ן בַּשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.translit: khy l' bchrvts yvdsh qtsch v'vpn 'glh 'lkhmn yvsb khy bmth ychbt qtsch vkhmn bshbt
verses.translation: For the black cummin is not threshed with a threshing-sledge, Neither is a cart-wheel turned about upon the cummin; But the black cummin is beaten out with a staff, And the cummin with a rod.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם יוּדָ֔ק כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָנֶ֖צַח אָד֣וֹשׁ יְדוּשֶׁ֑נּוּ וְ֠הָמַ֠ם גִּלְגַּ֧ל עֶגְלָת֛וֹ וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו לֹ֥א יְדֻקֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: lchm yvdq khy l' lntsch 'dvsh ydvshnv vhmm glgl 'gltv vprshyv l' ydqnv
verses.translation: Is bread corn crushed? Nay, he will not ever be threshing it; And though the roller of his wagon and its sharp edges move noisily, He doth not crush it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־זֹ֕את מֵעִ֛ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יָצָ֑אָה הִפְלִ֣א עֵצָ֔ה הִגְדִּ֖יל תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: gmz't m'm yhvh tsb'vt yts'h hpl' 'tsh hgdyl tvshyh {p}
verses.translation: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts: Wonderful is His counsel, and great His wisdom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֚וֹי אֲרִיאֵ֣ל אֲרִיאֵ֔ל קִרְיַ֖ת חָנָ֣ה דָוִ֑ד סְפ֥וּ שָׁנָ֛ה עַל־שָׁנָ֖ה חַגִּ֥ים יִנְקֹֽפוּ׃
verses.translit: hvy 'ry'l 'ry'l qryt chnh dvd spv shnh 'lshnh chgym ynqpv
verses.translation: Ah, Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add ye year to year, Let the feasts come round!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲצִיק֖וֹתִי לַאֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְהָיְתָ֤ה תַֽאֲנִיָּה֙ וַאֲנִיָּ֔ה וְהָ֥יְתָה לִּ֖י כַּאֲרִיאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhtsyqvty l'ry'l vhyth t'nyh v'nyh vhyth ly kh'ry'l
verses.translation: Then will I distress Ariel, And there shall be mourning and moaning; and she shall be unto Me as a hearth of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָנִ֥יתִי כַדּ֖וּר עָלָ֑יִךְ וְצַרְתִּ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ מֻצָּ֔ב וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י עָלַ֖יִךְ מְצֻרֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vchnyty khdvr 'lykh vtsrty 'lykh mtsb vhqymty 'lykh mtsrt
verses.translation: And I will encamp against thee round about, And will lay siege against thee with a mound, And I will raise siege works against thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁפַלְתְּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי וּמֵעָפָ֖ר תִּשַּׁ֣ח אִמְרָתֵ֑ךְ וְֽ֠הָיָ֠ה כְּא֤וֹב מֵאֶ֙רֶץ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ וּמֵעָפָ֖ר אִמְרָתֵ֥ךְ תְּצַפְצֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vshplt m'rts tdbry vm'pr tshch 'mrtkh vhyh kh'vb m'rts qvlkh vm'pr 'mrtkh ttsptsf
verses.translation: And brought down thou shalt speak out of the ground, And thy speech shall be low out of the dust; And thy voice shall be as of a ghost out of the ground, And thy speech shall chirp out of the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֛ה כְּאָבָ֥ק דַּ֖ק הֲמ֣וֹן זָרָ֑יִךְ וּכְמֹ֤ץ עֹבֵר֙ הֲמ֣וֹן עָרִיצִ֔ים וְהָיָ֖ה לְפֶ֥תַע פִּתְאֹֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'bq dq hmvn zrykh vkhmts 'br hmvn 'rytsym vhyh lpt' pt'm
verses.translation: But the multitude of thy foes shall be like small dust, And the multitude of the terrible ones as chaff that passeth away; Yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעִ֨ם יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ תִּפָּקֵ֔ד בְּרַ֥עַם וּבְרַ֖עַשׁ וְק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל סוּפָה֙ וּסְעָרָ֔ה וְלַ֖הַב אֵ֥שׁ אוֹכֵלָֽה׃
verses.translit: m'm yhvh tsb'vt tpqd br'm vbr'sh vqvl gdvl svph vs'rh vlhb 'sh 'vkhlh
verses.translation: There shall be a visitation from the LORD of hosts With thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, With whirlwind and tempest, and the flame of a devouring fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּֽחֲלוֹם֙ חֲז֣וֹן לַ֔יְלָה הֲמוֹן֙ כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַצֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל־אֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְכׇל־צֹבֶ֙יהָ֙ וּמְצֹ֣דָתָ֔הּ וְהַמְּצִיקִ֖ים לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khchlvm chzvn lylh hmvn khlhgvym htsb'ym 'l'ry'l vkhltsbyh vmtsdth vhmtsyqym lh
verses.translation: And the multitude of all the nations that war against Ariel, Even all that war against her, and the bulwarks about her, and they that distress her, Shall be as a dream, a vision of the night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יַחֲלֹ֨ם הָרָעֵ֜ב וְהִנֵּ֣ה אוֹכֵ֗ל וְהֵקִיץ֮ וְרֵיקָ֣ה נַפְשׁוֹ֒ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַחֲלֹ֤ם הַצָּמֵא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה שֹׁתֶ֔ה וְהֵקִיץ֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עָיֵ֔ף וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ שׁוֹקֵקָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן יִֽהְיֶ֗ה הֲמוֹן֙ כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַצֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל־הַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr ychlm hr'b vhnh 'vkhl vhqyts vryqh npshv vkh'shr ychlm htsm' vhnh shth vhqyts vhnh 'yf vnpshv shvqqh khn yhyh hmvn khlhgvym htsb'ym 'lhr tsyvn {p}
verses.translation: And it shall be as when a hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth, But he awaketh, and his soul is empty; Or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh, But he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite— So shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִתְמַהְמְה֣וּ וּתְמָ֔הוּ הִשְׁתַּעַשְׁע֖וּ וָשֹׁ֑עוּ שָׁכְר֣וּ וְלֹא־יַ֔יִן נָע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.translit: htmhmhv vtmhv hsht'sh'v vsh'v shkhrv vl'yyn n'v vl' shkhr
verses.translation: Stupefy yourselves, and be stupid! Blind yourselves, and be blind! Ye that are drunken, but not with wine, That stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נָסַ֨ךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ ר֣וּחַ תַּרְדֵּמָ֔ה וַיְעַצֵּ֖ם אֶת־עֵינֵיכֶ֑ם אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־רָאשֵׁיכֶ֥ם הַחֹזִ֖ים כִּסָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khynskh 'lykhm yhvh rvch trdmh vy'tsm 't'ynykhm 'thnby'ym v'tr'shykhm hchzym khsh
verses.translation: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, And hath closed your eyes; The prophets, and your heads, the seers, hath He covered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י לָכֶ֜ם חָז֣וּת הַכֹּ֗ל כְּדִבְרֵי֮ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הֶחָתוּם֒ אֲשֶֽׁר־יִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ אֶל־יוֹדֵ֥עַ (הספר) [סֵ֛פֶר] לֵאמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא־זֶ֑ה וְאָמַר֙ לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל כִּ֥י חָת֖וּם הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vthy lkhm chzvt hkhl khdbry hspr hchtvm 'shrytnv 'tv 'lyvd' (hspr) [spr] l'mr qr' n'zh v'mr l' 'vkhl khy chtvm hv'
verses.translation: And the vision of all this is become unto you as the words of a writing that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying: ‘Read this, I pray thee’; and he saith: ‘I cannot, for it is sealed’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִתַּ֣ן הַסֵּ֗פֶר עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יָדַ֥ע סֵ֛פֶר לֵאמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא־זֶ֑ה וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי סֵֽפֶר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vntn hspr 'l 'shr l'yd' spr l'mr qr' n'zh v'mr l' yd'ty spr {s}
verses.translation: and the writing is delivered to him that is not learned, saying: ‘Read this, I pray thee’; and he saith: ‘I am not learned.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י נִגַּשׁ֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה בְּפִ֤יו וּבִשְׂפָתָיו֙ כִּבְּד֔וּנִי וְלִבּ֖וֹ רִחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי וַתְּהִ֤י יִרְאָתָם֙ אֹתִ֔י מִצְוַ֥ת אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְלֻמָּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny y'n khy ngsh h'm hzh bpyv vbshptyv khbdvny vlbv rchq mmny vthy yr'tm 'ty mtsvt 'nshym mlmdh
verses.translation: And the Lord said: Forasmuch as this people draw near, and with their mouth and with their lips do honour Me, But have removed their heart far from Me, And their fear of Me is a commandment of men learned by rote;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִנְנִ֥י יוֹסִ֛ף לְהַפְלִ֥יא אֶת־הָעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה הַפְלֵ֣א וָפֶ֑לֶא וְאָֽבְדָה֙ חׇכְמַ֣ת חֲכָמָ֔יו וּבִינַ֥ת נְבֹנָ֖יו תִּסְתַּתָּֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lkhn hnny yvsf lhply' 'th'mhzh hpl' vpl' v'bdh chkhmt chkhmyv vbynt nbnyv tsttr {s}
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will again do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the prudence of their prudent men shall be hid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֛וֹי הַמַּעֲמִיקִ֥ים מֵיְהֹוָ֖ה לַסְתִּ֣ר עֵצָ֑ה וְהָיָ֤ה בְמַחְשָׁךְ֙ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י רֹאֵ֖נוּ וּמִ֥י יֹֽדְעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: hvy hm'myqym myhvh lstr 'tsh vhyh bmchshkh m'shyhm vy'mrv my r'nv vmy yd'nv
verses.translation: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say: ‘Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֨פְכְּכֶ֔ם אִם־כְּחֹ֥מֶר הַיֹּצֵ֖ר יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב כִּֽי־יֹאמַ֨ר מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְעֹשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֔נִי וְיֵ֛צֶר אָמַ֥ר לְיֹצְר֖וֹ לֹ֥א הֵבִֽין׃
verses.translit: hpkhkhm 'mkhchmr hytsr ychshb khyy'mr m'shh l'shhv l' 'shny vytsr 'mr lytsrv l' hbyn
verses.translation: O your perversity! Shall the potter be esteemed as clay; that the thing made should say of him that made it: ‘He made me not’; Or the thing framed say of him that framed it: ‘He hath no understanding?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־עוֹד֙ מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֔ר וְשָׁ֥ב לְבָנ֖וֹן לַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וְהַכַּרְמֶ֖ל לַיַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: hlv''vd m't mz'r vshb lbnvn lkhrml vhkhrml ly'r ychshb
verses.translation: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמְע֧וּ בַיּוֹם־הַה֛וּא הַחֵרְשִׁ֖ים דִּבְרֵי־סֵ֑פֶר וּמֵאֹ֣פֶל וּמֵחֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֵינֵ֥י עִוְרִ֖ים תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: vshm'v byvmhhv' hchrshym dbryspr vm'pl vmchshkh 'yny 'vrym tr'ynh
verses.translation: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of a book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָסְפ֧וּ עֲנָוִ֛ים בַּֽיהֹוָ֖ה שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְאֶבְיוֹנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם בִּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יָגִֽילוּ׃
verses.translit: vyspv 'nvym byhvh shmchh v'byvny 'dm bqdvsh yshr'l ygylv
verses.translation: The humble also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the neediest among men shall exult in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אָפֵ֥ס עָרִ֖יץ וְכָ֣לָה לֵ֑ץ וְנִכְרְת֖וּ כׇּל־שֹׁ֥קְדֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: khy'ps 'ryts vkhlh lts vnkhrtv khlshqdy 'vn
verses.translation: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner ceaseth, and all they that watch for iniquity are cut off;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַחֲטִיאֵ֤י אָדָם֙ בְּדָבָ֔ר וְלַמּוֹכִ֥יחַ בַּשַּׁ֖עַר יְקֹשׁ֑וּן וַיַּטּ֥וּ בַתֹּ֖הוּ צַדִּֽיק׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mchty'y 'dm bdbr vlmvkhych bsh'r yqshvn vytv bthv tsdyq {p}
verses.translation: That make a man an offender by words, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, And turn aside the just with a thing of nought.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדָ֖ה אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם לֹֽא־עַתָּ֤ה יֵבוֹשׁ֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹ֥א עַתָּ֖ה פָּנָ֥יו יֶחֱוָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'lbyt y'qb 'shr pdh 't'brhm l''th ybvsh y'qb vl' 'th pnyv ychvrv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: Jacob shall not now be ashamed, Neither shall his face now wax pale;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בִ֠רְאֹת֠וֹ יְלָדָ֞יו מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֛י בְּקִרְבּ֖וֹ יַקְדִּ֣ישֽׁוּ שְׁמִ֑י וְהִקְדִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ אֶת־קְד֣וֹשׁ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יַעֲרִֽיצוּ׃
verses.translit: khy br'tv yldyv m'shh ydy bqrbv yqdyshv shmy vhqdyshv 'tqdvsh y'qb v't'lhy yshr'l y'rytsv
verses.translation: When he seeth his children, the work of My hands, in the midst of him, That they sanctify My name; yea, they shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, And shall stand in awe of the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֥וּ תֹֽעֵי־ר֖וּחַ בִּינָ֑ה וְרוֹגְנִ֖ים יִלְמְדוּ־לֶֽקַח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyd'v t'yrvch bynh vrvgnym ylmdvlqch {s}
verses.translation: They also that err in spirit shall come to understanding, And they that murmur shall learn instruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי בָּנִ֤ים סֽוֹרְרִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת עֵצָה֙ וְלֹ֣א מִנִּ֔י וְלִנְסֹ֥ךְ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א רוּחִ֑י לְמַ֛עַן סְפ֥וֹת חַטָּ֖את עַל־חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: hvy bnym svrrym n'myhvh l'shvt 'tsh vl' mny vlnskh mskhh vl' rvchy lm'n spvt cht't 'lcht't
verses.translation: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, That take counsel, but not of Me; and that form projects, but not of My spirit, that they may add sin to sin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַהֹֽלְכִים֙ לָרֶ֣דֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם וּפִ֖י לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לוּ לָעוֹז֙ בְּמָע֣וֹז פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלַחְס֖וֹת בְּצֵ֥ל מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: hhlkhym lrdt mtsrym vpy l' sh'lv l'vz bm'vz pr'h vlchsvt btsl mtsrym
verses.translation: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at My mouth; to take refuge in the stronghold of Pharaoh, and to take shelter in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם מָע֥וֹז פַּרְעֹ֖ה לְבֹ֑שֶׁת וְהֶחָס֥וּת בְּצֵל־מִצְרַ֖יִם לִכְלִמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh lkhm m'vz pr'h lbsht vhchsvt btslmtsrym lkhlmh
verses.translation: Therefore shall the stronghold of Pharaoh turn to your shame, and the shelter in the shadow of Egypt to your confusion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הָי֥וּ בְצֹ֖עַן שָׂרָ֑יו וּמַלְאָכָ֖יו חָנֵ֥ס יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.translit: khyhyv bts'n shryv vml'khyv chns ygy'v
verses.translation: For his princes are at Zoan, and his ambassadors are come to Hanes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל הֹבִ֔אישׁ עַל־עַ֖ם לֹא־יוֹעִ֣ילוּ לָ֑מוֹ לֹ֤א לְעֵ֙זֶר֙ וְלֹ֣א לְהוֹעִ֔יל כִּ֥י לְבֹ֖שֶׁת וְגַם־לְחֶרְפָּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khl hb'ysh 'l'm l'yv'ylv lmv l' l'zr vl' lhv'yl khy lbsht vgmlchrph {s}
verses.translation: They shall all be ashamed of a people that cannot profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בַּהֲמ֣וֹת נֶ֑גֶב בְּאֶ֩רֶץ֩ צָרָ֨ה וְצוּקָ֜ה לָבִ֧יא וָלַ֣יִשׁ מֵהֶ֗ם אֶפְעֶה֙ וְשָׂרָ֣ף מְעוֹפֵ֔ף יִשְׂאוּ֩ עַל־כֶּ֨תֶף עֲיָרִ֜ים חֵילֵהֶ֗ם וְעַל־דַּבֶּ֤שֶׁת גְּמַלִּים֙ אֽוֹצְרֹתָ֔ם עַל־עַ֖ם לֹ֥א יוֹעִֽילוּ׃
verses.translit: msh' bhmvt ngb b'rts tsrh vtsvqh lby' vlysh mhm 'p'h vshrf m'vpf ysh'v 'lkhtf 'yrym chylhm v'ldbsht gmlym 'vtsrtm 'l'm l' yv'ylv
verses.translation: The burden of the beasts of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the lioness and the lion, the viper and flying serpent, they carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the humps of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֕יִם הֶ֥בֶל וָרִ֖יק יַעְזֹ֑רוּ לָכֵן֙ קָרָ֣אתִי לָזֹ֔את רַ֥הַב הֵ֖ם שָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.translit: vmtsrym hbl vryq y'zrv lkhn qr'ty lz't rhb hm shbt
verses.translation: For Egypt helpeth in vain, and to no purpose; therefore have I called her arrogancy that sitteth still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה בּ֣וֹא כׇתְבָ֥הּ עַל־ל֛וּחַ אִתָּ֖ם וְעַל־סֵ֣פֶר חֻקָּ֑הּ וּתְהִי֙ לְי֣וֹם אַחֲר֔וֹן לָעַ֖ד עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'th bv' khtbh 'llvch 'tm v'lspr chqh vthy lyvm 'chrvn l'd 'd'vlm
verses.translation: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come For ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם מְרִי֙ ה֔וּא בָּנִ֖ים כֶּחָשִׁ֑ים בָּנִ֕ים לֹא־אָב֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹעַ תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 'm mry hv' bnym khchshym bnym l''bv shmv' tvrt yhvh
verses.translation: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children that refuse to hear the teaching of the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמְר֤וּ לָרֹאִים֙ לֹ֣א תִרְא֔וּ וְלַ֣חֹזִ֔ים לֹ֥א תֶחֱזוּ־לָ֖נוּ נְכֹח֑וֹת דַּבְּרוּ־לָ֣נוּ חֲלָק֔וֹת חֲז֖וּ מַהֲתַלּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'mrv lr'ym l' tr'v vlchzym l' tchzvlnv nkhchvt dbrvlnv chlqvt chzv mhtlvt
verses.translation: That say to the seers: ‘See not’, and to the prophets: ‘Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy delusions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֚וּרוּ מִנֵּי־דֶ֔רֶךְ הַטּ֖וּ מִנֵּי־אֹ֑רַח הַשְׁבִּ֥יתוּ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ אֶת־קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: svrv mnydrkh htv mny'rch hshbytv mpnynv 'tqdvsh yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֥עַן מׇאׇסְכֶ֖ם בַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַֽתִּבְטְחוּ֙ בְּעֹ֣שֶׁק וְנָל֔וֹז וַתִּֽשָּׁעֲנ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr qdvsh yshr'l y'n m'skhm bdbr hzh vtbtchv b'shq vnlvz vtsh'nv 'lyv
verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel: Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ הֶעָוֺ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה כְּפֶ֣רֶץ נֹפֵ֔ל נִבְעֶ֖ה בְּחוֹמָ֣ה נִשְׂגָּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־פִּתְאֹ֥ם לְפֶ֖תַע יָב֥וֹא שִׁבְרָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn yhyh lkhm h'vn hzh khprts npl nb'h bchvmh nshgbh 'shrpt'm lpt' ybv' shbrh
verses.translation: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠שְׁבָרָ֠הּ כְּשֵׁ֨בֶר נֵ֧בֶל יוֹצְרִ֛ים כָּת֖וּת לֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל וְלֹֽא־יִמָּצֵ֤א בִמְכִתָּתוֹ֙ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לַחְתּ֥וֹת אֵשׁ֙ מִיָּק֔וּד וְלַחְשֹׂ֥ף מַ֖יִם מִגֶּֽבֶא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshbrh khshbr nbl yvtsrym khtvt l' ychml vl'ymts' bmkhttv chrsh lchtvt 'sh myqvd vlchshf mym mgb' {s}
verses.translation: And He shall break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing; so that there shall not be found among the pieces thereof a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water out of the cistern.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹֽה־אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֜ה קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּשׁוּבָ֤ה וָנַ֙חַת֙ תִּוָּ֣שֵׁע֔וּן בְּהַשְׁקֵט֙ וּבְבִטְחָ֔ה תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה גְּבוּרַתְכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֖א אֲבִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy khh'mr 'dny yhvh qdvsh yshr'l bshvbh vncht tvsh'vn bhshqt vbbtchh thyh gbvrtkhm vl' 'bytm
verses.translation: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel: In sitting still and rest shall ye be saved, in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength; And ye would not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמְר֥וּ לֹא־כִ֛י עַל־ס֥וּס נָנ֖וּס עַל־כֵּ֣ן תְּנוּס֑וּן וְעַל־קַ֣ל נִרְכָּ֔ב עַל־כֵּ֖ן יִקַּ֥לּוּ רֹדְפֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vt'mrv l'khy 'lsvs nnvs 'lkhn tnvsvn v'lql nrkhb 'lkhn yqlv rdpykhm
verses.translation: But ye said: ‘No, for we will flee upon horses’; Therefore shall ye flee; and: ‘We will ride upon the swift’; Therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֣לֶף אֶחָ֗ד מִפְּנֵי֙ גַּעֲרַ֣ת אֶחָ֔ד מִפְּנֵ֛י גַּעֲרַ֥ת חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה תָּנֻ֑סוּ עַ֣ד אִם־נוֹתַרְתֶּ֗ם כַּתֹּ֙רֶן֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֔ר וְכַנֵּ֖ס עַל־הַגִּבְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lf 'chd mpny g'rt 'chd mpny g'rt chmshh tnsv 'd 'mnvtrtm khtrn 'lr'sh hhr vkhns 'lhgb'h
verses.translation: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one, At the rebuke of five shall ye flee; Till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, And as an ensign on a hill.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָכֵ֞ן יְחַכֶּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לַחֲנַנְכֶ֔ם וְלָכֵ֥ן יָר֖וּם לְרַחֶמְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אֱלֹהֵ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה אַשְׁרֵ֖י כׇּל־ח֥וֹכֵי לֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlkhn ychkhh yhvh lchnnkhm vlkhn yrvm lrchmkhm khy'lhy mshpt yhvh 'shry khlchvkhy lv {p}
verses.translation: And therefore will the LORD wait, that He may be gracious unto you, And therefore will He be exalted, that He may have compassion upon you; For the LORD is a God of justice, Happy are all they that wait for Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־עַ֛ם בְּצִיּ֥וֹן יֵשֵׁ֖ב בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם בָּכ֣וֹ לֹֽא־תִבְכֶּ֗ה חָנ֤וֹן יׇחְנְךָ֙ לְק֣וֹל זַעֲקֶ֔ךָ כְּשׇׁמְעָת֖וֹ עָנָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy'm btsyvn yshb byrvshl͏m bkhv l'tbkhh chnvn ychnkh lqvl z'qkh khshm'tv 'nkh
verses.translation: For, O people that dwellest in Zion at Jerusalem, Thou shalt weep no more; He will surely be gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry, When He shall hear, He will answer thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֧ם אֲדֹנָ֛י לֶ֥חֶם צָ֖ר וּמַ֣יִם לָ֑חַץ וְלֹא־יִכָּנֵ֥ף עוֹד֙ מוֹרֶ֔יךָ וְהָי֥וּ עֵינֶ֖יךָ רֹא֥וֹת אֶת־מוֹרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vntn lkhm 'dny lchm tsr vmym lchts vl'ykhnf 'vd mvrykh vhyv 'ynykh r'vt 'tmvrykh
verses.translation: And though the Lord give you sparing bread and scant water, Yet shall not thy Teacher hide Himself any more, But thine eyes shall see thy Teacher;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאׇזְנֶ֙יךָ֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣עְנָה דָבָ֔ר מֵאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֤ה הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ לְכ֣וּ ב֔וֹ כִּ֥י תַאֲמִ֖ינוּ וְכִ֥י תַשְׂמְאִֽילוּ׃
verses.translit: v'znykh tshm'nh dbr m'chrykh l'mr zh hdrkh lkhv bv khy t'mynv vkhy tshm'ylv
verses.translation: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying: ‘This is the way, walk ye in it, When ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְטִמֵּאתֶ֗ם אֶת־צִפּוּי֙ פְּסִילֵ֣י כַסְפֶּ֔ךָ וְאֶת־אֲפֻדַּ֖ת מַסֵּכַ֣ת זְהָבֶ֑ךָ תִּזְרֵם֙ כְּמ֣וֹ דָוָ֔ה צֵ֖א תֹּ֥אמַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtm'tm 'ttspvy psyly khspkh v't'pdt mskht zhbkh tzrm khmv dvh ts' t'mr lv
verses.translation: And ye shall defile thy graven images overlaid with silver, And thy molten images covered with gold; Thou shalt put them far away as one unclean; Thou shalt say unto it: ‘Get thee hence.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַן֩ מְטַ֨ר זַרְעֲךָ֜ אֲשֶׁר־תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת־הָאֲדָמָ֗ה וְלֶ֙חֶם֙ תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָאֲדָמָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה דָשֵׁ֖ן וְשָׁמֵ֑ן יִרְעֶ֥ה מִקְנֶ֛יךָ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כַּ֥ר נִרְחָֽב׃
verses.translit: vntn mtr zr'kh 'shrtzr' 'th'dmh vlchm tbv't h'dmh vhyh dshn vshmn yr'h mqnykh byvm hhv' khr nrchb
verses.translation: And He will give the rain for thy seed, wherewith thou sowest the ground, And bread of the increase of the ground, and it shall be fat and plenteous; In that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֲלָפִ֣ים וְהָעֲיָרִ֗ים עֹֽבְדֵי֙ הָאֲדָמָ֔ה בְּלִ֥יל חָמִ֖יץ יֹאכֵ֑לוּ אֲשֶׁר־זֹרֶ֥ה בָרַ֖חַת וּבַמִּזְרֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'lpym vh'yrym 'bdy h'dmh blyl chmyts y'khlv 'shrzrh brcht vbmzrh
verses.translation: The oxen likewise and the young asses that till the ground shall eat savoury provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  עַל־כׇּל־הַ֣ר גָּבֹ֗הַּ וְעַל֙ כׇּל־גִּבְעָ֣ה נִשָּׂאָ֔ה פְּלָגִ֖ים יִבְלֵי־מָ֑יִם בְּיוֹם֙ הֶ֣רֶג רָ֔ב בִּנְפֹ֖ל מִגְדָּלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyh  'lkhlhr gbh v'l khlgb'h nsh'h plgym yblymym byvm hrg rb bnpl mgdlym
verses.translation: And there shall be upon every lofty mountain, and upon every high hill Streams and watercourses, In the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה אוֹר־הַלְּבָנָה֙ כְּא֣וֹר הַחַמָּ֔ה וְא֤וֹר הַֽחַמָּה֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה שִׁבְעָתַ֔יִם כְּא֖וֹר שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים בְּי֗וֹם חֲבֹ֤שׁ יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣בֶר עַמּ֔וֹ וּמַ֥חַץ מַכָּת֖וֹ יִרְפָּֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh 'vrhlbnh kh'vr hchmh v'vr hchmh yhyh shb'tym kh'vr shb't hymym byvm chbsh yhvh 'tshbr 'mv vmchts mkhtv yrp' {p}
verses.translation: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, And the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of the seven days, In the day that the LORD bindeth up the bruise of His people, And healeth the stroke of their wound.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה שֵׁם־יְהֹוָה֙ בָּ֣א מִמֶּרְחָ֔ק בֹּעֵ֣ר אַפּ֔וֹ וְכֹ֖בֶד מַשָּׂאָ֑הֿ שְׂפָתָיו֙ מָ֣לְאוּ זַ֔עַם וּלְשׁוֹנ֖וֹ כְּאֵ֥שׁ אֹכָֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: hnh shmyhvh b' mmrchq b'r 'pv vkhbd msh'h shptyv ml'v z'm vlshvnv kh'sh 'khlt
verses.translation: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, With His anger burning, and in thick uplifting of smoke; His lips are full of indignation, And His tongue is as a devouring fire;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרוּח֞וֹ כְּנַ֤חַל שׁוֹטֵף֙ עַד־צַוָּ֣אר יֶחֱצֶ֔ה לַהֲנָפָ֥ה גוֹיִ֖ם בְּנָ֣פַת שָׁ֑וְא וְרֶ֣סֶן מַתְעֶ֔ה עַ֖ל לְחָיֵ֥י עַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vrvchv khnchl shvtf 'dtsv'r ychtsh lhnph gvym bnpt shv' vrsn mt'h 'l lchyy 'mym
verses.translation: And His breath is as an overflowing stream, That divideth even unto the neck, To sift the nations with the sieve of destruction; And a bridle that causeth to err shall be in the jaws of the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשִּׁיר֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כְּלֵ֖יל הִתְקַדֶּשׁ־חָ֑ג וְשִׂמְחַ֣ת לֵבָ֗ב כַּהוֹלֵךְ֙ בֶּחָלִ֔יל לָב֥וֹא בְהַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־צ֥וּר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hshyr yhyh lkhm khlyl htqdshchg vshmcht lbb khhvlkh bchlyl lbv' bhryhvh 'ltsvr yshr'l
verses.translation: Ye shall have a song As in the night when a feast is hallowed; And gladness of heart, as when one goeth with the pipe To come into the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁמִ֨יעַ יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶת־ה֣וֹד קוֹל֗וֹ וְנַ֤חַת זְרוֹעוֹ֙ יַרְאֶ֔ה בְּזַ֣עַף אַ֔ף וְלַ֖הַב אֵ֣שׁ אוֹכֵלָ֑ה נֶ֥פֶץ וָזֶ֖רֶם וְאֶ֥בֶן בָּרָֽד׃
verses.translit: vhshmy' yhvh 'thvd qvlv vncht zrv'v yr'h bz'f 'f vlhb 'sh 'vkhlh npts vzrm v'bn brd
verses.translation: And the LORD will cause His glorious voice to be heard, And will show the lighting down of His arm, With furious anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, With a bursting of clouds, and a storm of rain, and hailstones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מִקּ֥וֹל יְהֹוָ֖ה יֵחַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֖בֶט יַכֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khymqvl yhvh ycht 'shvr bshbt ykhh
verses.translation: For through the voice of the LORD shall Asshur be dismayed, The rod with which He smote.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כֹּ֚ל מַֽעֲבַר֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מֽוּסָדָ֔הֿ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנִ֤יחַ יְהֹוָה֙ עָלָ֔יו בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבְכִנֹּר֑וֹת וּבְמִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תְּנוּפָ֖ה נִלְחַם־[בָּֽם] (בה)׃
verses.translit: vhyh khl m'br mth mvsdh 'shr ynych yhvh 'lyv btpym vbkhnrvt vbmlchmvt tnvph nlchm[bm] (bh)
verses.translation: And in every place where the appointed staff shall pass, Which the LORD shall lay upon him, It shall be with tabrets and harps; And in battles of wielding will He fight with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עָר֤וּךְ מֵֽאֶתְמוּל֙ תׇּפְתֶּ֔ה גַּם־[הִ֛יא] (הוא) לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הוּכָ֖ן הֶעְמִ֣יק הִרְחִ֑ב מְדֻרָתָ֗הּ אֵ֤שׁ וְעֵצִים֙ הַרְבֵּ֔ה נִשְׁמַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ כְּנַ֣חַל גׇּפְרִ֔ית בֹּעֲרָ֖ה בָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy'rvkh m'tmvl tpth gm[hy'] (hv') lmlkh hvkhn h'myq hrchb mdrth 'sh v'tsym hrbh nshmt yhvh khnchl gpryt b'rh bh {p}
verses.translation: For a hearth is ordered of old; Yea, for the king it is prepared, Deep and large; The pile thereof is fire and much wood; The breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי הַיֹּרְדִ֤ים מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה עַל־סוּסִ֖ים יִשָּׁעֵ֑נוּ וַיִּבְטְח֨וּ עַל־רֶ֜כֶב כִּ֣י רָ֗ב וְעַ֤ל פָּרָשִׁים֙ כִּֽי־עָצְמ֣וּ מְאֹ֔ד וְלֹ֤א שָׁעוּ֙ עַל־קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: hvy hyrdym mtsrym l'zrh 'lsvsym ysh'nv vybtchv 'lrkhb khy rb v'l prshym khy'tsmv m'd vl' sh'v 'lqdvsh yshr'l v'tyhvh l' drshv
verses.translation: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help, And rely on horses, And trust in chariots, because they are many, And in horsemen, because they are exceeding mighty; But they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, Neither seek the LORD!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־ה֤וּא חָכָם֙ וַיָּ֣בֵא רָ֔ע וְאֶת־דְּבָרָ֖יו לֹ֣א הֵסִ֑יר וְקָם֙ עַל־בֵּ֣ית מְרֵעִ֔ים וְעַל־עֶזְרַ֖ת פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: vgmhv' chkhm vyb' r' v'tdbryv l' hsyr vqm 'lbyt mr'ym v'l'zrt p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Yet He also is wise, And bringeth evil, And doth not call back His words; But will arise against the house of the evil-doers, And against the help of them that work iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֤יִם אָדָם֙ וְֽלֹא־אֵ֔ל וְסוּסֵיהֶ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וְלֹא־ר֑וּחַ וַיהֹוָ֞ה יַטֶּ֣ה יָד֗וֹ וְכָשַׁ֤ל עוֹזֵר֙ וְנָפַ֣ל עָזֻ֔ר וְיַחְדָּ֖ו כֻּלָּ֥ם יִכְלָיֽוּן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmtsrym 'dm vl''l vsvsyhm bshr vl'rvch vyhvh yth ydv vkhshl 'vzr vnpl 'zr vychdv khlm ykhlyvn {s}
verses.translation: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God, And their horses flesh, and not spirit; So when the LORD shall stretch out His hand, Both he that helpeth shall stumble, and he that is helped shall fall, And they all shall perish together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ אֵלַ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶהְגֶּה֩ הָאַרְיֵ֨ה וְהַכְּפִ֜יר עַל־טַרְפּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקָּרֵ֤א עָלָיו֙ מְלֹ֣א רֹעִ֔ים מִקּוֹלָם֙ לֹ֣א יֵחָ֔ת וּמֵהֲמוֹנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה כֵּ֗ן יֵרֵד֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לִצְבֹּ֥א עַל־הַר־צִיּ֖וֹן וְעַל־גִּבְעָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mryhvh  'ly kh'shr yhgh h'ryh vhkhpyr 'ltrpv 'shr yqr' 'lyv ml' r'ym mqvlm l' ycht vmhmvnm l' y'nh khn yrd yhvh tsb'vt ltsb' 'lhrtsyvn v'lgb'th
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD unto me: Like as the lion, or the young lion, growling over his prey, Though a multitude of shepherds be called forth against him, Will not be dismayed at their voice, Nor abase himself for the noise of them; So will the LORD of hosts come down To fight upon mount Zion, and upon the hill thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּצִפֳּרִ֣ים עָפ֔וֹת כֵּ֗ן יָגֵ֛ן יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם גָּנ֥וֹן וְהִצִּ֖יל פָּסֹ֥חַ וְהִמְלִֽיט׃
verses.translit: khtsprym 'pvt khn ygn yhvh tsb'vt 'lyrvshl͏m gnvn vhtsyl psch vhmlyt
verses.translation: As birds hovering, So will the LORD of hosts protect Jerusalem; He will deliver it as He protecteth it, He will rescue it as He passeth over.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֗וּבוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֛ר הֶעְמִ֥יקוּ סָרָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: shvbv l'shr h'myqv srh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Turn ye unto Him Against whom ye have deeply rebelled, O children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִמְאָס֗וּן אִ֚ישׁ אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔וֹ וֶאֱלִילֵ֖י זְהָב֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם יְדֵיכֶ֖ם חֵֽטְא׃
verses.translit: khy byvm hhv' ym'svn 'ysh 'lyly khspv v'lyly zhbv 'shr 'shv lkhm ydykhm cht'
verses.translation: For in that day they shall cast away every man his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, Which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָפַ֤ל אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּחֶ֣רֶב לֹא־אִ֔ישׁ וְחֶ֥רֶב לֹא־אָדָ֖ם תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ וְנָ֥ס לוֹ֙ מִפְּנֵי־חֶ֔רֶב וּבַחוּרָ֖יו לָמַ֥ס יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vnpl 'shvr bchrb l''ysh vchrb l''dm t'khlnv vns lv mpnychrb vbchvryv lms yhyv
verses.translation: Then shall Asshur fall with the sword, not of man, And the sword, not of men, shall devour him; And he shall flee from the sword, And his young men shall become tributary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסַלְעוֹ֙ מִמָּג֣וֹר יַעֲב֔וֹר וְחַתּ֥וּ מִנֵּ֖ס שָׂרָ֑יו נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־א֥וּר לוֹ֙ בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וְתַנּ֥וּר ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vsl'v mmgvr y'bvr vchtv mns shryv n'myhvh 'shr'vr lv btsyvn vtnvr lv byrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: And his rock shall pass away by reason of terror, And his princes shall be dismayed at the ensign, Saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, And His furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֥ן לְצֶ֖דֶק יִמְלׇךְ־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּלְשָׂרִ֖ים לְמִשְׁפָּ֥ט יָשֹֽׂרוּ׃
verses.translit: hn ltsdq ymlkhmlkh vlshrym lmshpt yshrv
verses.translation: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, And as for princes, they shall rule in justice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה־אִ֥ישׁ כְּמַחֲבֵא־ר֖וּחַ וְסֵ֣תֶר זָ֑רֶם כְּפַלְגֵי־מַ֣יִם בְּצָי֔וֹן כְּצֵ֥ל סֶלַע־כָּבֵ֖ד בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עֲיֵפָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh'ysh khmchb'rvch vstr zrm khplgymym btsyvn khtsl sl'khbd b'rts 'yph
verses.translation: And a man shall be as in a hiding-place from the wind, And a covert from the tempest; As by the watercourses in a dry place, As in the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁעֶ֖ינָה עֵינֵ֣י רֹאִ֑ים וְאׇזְנֵ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים תִּקְשַֽׁבְנָה׃
verses.translit: vl' tsh'ynh 'yny r'ym v'zny shm'ym tqshbnh
verses.translation: And the eyes of them that see shall not be closed, And the ears of them that hear shall attend.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְבַ֥ב נִמְהָרִ֖ים יָבִ֣ין לָדָ֑עַת וּלְשׁ֣וֹן עִלְּגִ֔ים תְּמַהֵ֖ר לְדַבֵּ֥ר צָחֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vlbb nmhrym ybyn ld't vlshvn 'lgym tmhr ldbr tschvt
verses.translation: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, And the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד לְנָבָ֖ל נָדִ֑יב וּלְכִילַ֕י לֹ֥א יֵאָמֵ֖ר שֽׁוֹעַ׃
verses.translit: l'yqr' 'vd lnbl ndyb vlkhyly l' y'mr shv'
verses.translation: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, Nor the churl said to be noble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י נָבָל֙ נְבָלָ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְלִבּ֖וֹ יַעֲשֶׂה־אָ֑וֶן לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חֹ֗נֶף וּלְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־יְהֹוָה֙ תּוֹעָ֔ה לְהָרִיק֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָעֵ֔ב וּמַשְׁקֶ֥ה צָמֵ֖א יַחְסִֽיר׃
verses.translit: khy nbl nblh ydbr vlbv y'shh'vn l'shvt chnf vldbr 'lyhvh tv'h lhryq npsh r'b vmshqh tsm' ychsyr
verses.translation: For the vile person will speak villainy, And his heart will work iniquity, To practise ungodliness, and to utter wickedness against the LORD, To make empty the soul of the hungry, And to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֵלַ֖י כֵּלָ֣יו רָעִ֑ים ה֚וּא זִמּ֣וֹת יָעָ֔ץ לְחַבֵּ֤ל (ענוים) [עֲנִיִּים֙] בְּאִמְרֵי־שֶׁ֔קֶר וּבְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶבְי֖וֹן מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: vkhly khlyv r'ym hv' zmvt y'ts lchbl ('nvym) ['nyym] b'mryshqr vbdbr 'byvn mshpt
verses.translation: The instruments also of the churl are evil; He deviseth wicked devices To destroy the poor with lying words, And the needy when he speaketh right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָדִ֖יב נְדִיב֣וֹת יָעָ֑ץ וְה֖וּא עַל־נְדִיב֥וֹת יָקֽוּם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vndyb ndybvt y'ts vhv' 'lndybvt yqvm {s}
verses.translation: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; And by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָשִׁים֙ שַׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת קֹ֖מְנָה שְׁמַ֣עְנָה קוֹלִ֑י בָּנוֹת֙ בֹּֽטְח֔וֹת הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: nshym sh'nnvt qmnh shm'nh qvly bnvt btchvt h'znh 'mrty
verses.translation: Rise up, ye women that are at ease, and hear my voice; Ye confident daughters, give ear unto my speech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָמִים֙ עַל־שָׁנָ֔ה תִּרְגַּ֖זְנָה בֹּטְח֑וֹת כִּ֚י כָּלָ֣ה בָצִ֔יר אֹ֖סֶף בְּלִ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: ymym 'lshnh trgznh btchvt khy khlh btsyr 'sf bly ybv'
verses.translation: After a year and days shall ye be troubled, ye confident women; For the vintage shall fail, the ingathering shall not come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִרְדוּ֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת רְגָ֖זָה בֹּטְח֑וֹת פְּשֹׁ֣טָֽה וְעֹ֔רָה וַחֲג֖וֹרָה עַל־חֲלָצָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: chrdv sh'nnvt rgzh btchvt pshth v'rh vchgvrh 'lchltsym
verses.translation: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; Be troubled, ye confident ones; Strip you, and make you bare, And gird sackcloth upon your loins,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־שָׁדַ֖יִם סֹפְדִ֑ים עַל־שְׂדֵי־חֶ֕מֶד עַל־גֶּ֖פֶן פֹּרִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lshdym spdym 'lshdychmd 'lgpn pryh
verses.translation: Smiting upon the breasts For the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת עַמִּ֔י ק֥וֹץ שָׁמִ֖יר תַּעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֚י עַל־כׇּל־בָּתֵּ֣י מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'l 'dmt 'my qvts shmyr t'lh khy 'lkhlbty mshvsh qryh 'lyzh
verses.translation: For the land of my people Whereon thorns and briers come up; Yea, for all the houses of joy And the joyous city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַרְמ֣וֹן נֻטָּ֔שׁ הֲמ֥וֹן עִ֖יר עֻזָּ֑ב עֹ֣פֶל וָבַ֜חַן הָיָ֨ה בְעַ֤ד מְעָרוֹת֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ פְּרָאִ֖ים מִרְעֵ֥ה עֲדָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy'rmvn ntsh hmvn 'yr 'zb 'pl vbchn hyh b'd m'rvt 'd'vlm mshvsh pr'ym mr'h 'drym
verses.translation: For the palace shall be forsaken; The city with its stir shall be deserted; The mound and the tower shall be for dens for ever, A joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־יֵ֨עָרֶ֥ה עָלֵ֛ינוּ ר֖וּחַ מִמָּר֑וֹם וְהָיָ֤ה מִדְבָּר֙ לַכַּרְמֶ֔ל (וכרמל) [וְהַכַּרְמֶ֖ל] לַיַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: 'dy'rh 'lynv rvch mmrvm vhyh mdbr lkhrml (vkhrml) [vhkhrml] ly'r ychshb
verses.translation: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, And the wilderness become a fruitful field, And the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁכַ֥ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בַּכַּרְמֶ֥ל תֵּשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vshkhn bmdbr mshpt vtsdqh bkhrml tshb
verses.translation: Then justice shall dwell in the wilderness, And righteousness shall abide in the fruitful field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַצְּדָקָ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם וַֽעֲבֹדַת֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֥ט וָבֶ֖טַח עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh m'shh htsdqh shlvm v'bdt htsdqh hshqt vbtch 'd'vlm
verses.translation: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; And the effect of righteousness quietness and confidence for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשַׁ֥ב עַמִּ֖י בִּנְוֵ֣ה שָׁל֑וֹם וּֽבְמִשְׁכְּנוֹת֙ מִבְטַחִ֔ים וּבִמְנוּחֹ֖ת שַׁאֲנַנּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'my bnvh shlvm vbmshkhnvt mbtchym vbmnvcht sh'nnvt
verses.translation: And my people shall abide in a peaceable habitation, And in secure dwellings, and in quiet resting-places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָרַ֖ד בְּרֶ֣דֶת הַיָּ֑עַר וּבַשִּׁפְלָ֖ה תִּשְׁפַּ֥ל הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vbrd brdt hy'r vbshplh tshpl h'yr
verses.translation: And it shall hail, in the downfall of the forest; But the city shall descend into the valley.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵיכֶ֕ם זֹרְעֵ֖י עַל־כׇּל־מָ֑יִם מְשַׁלְּחֵ֥י רֶגֶל־הַשּׁ֖וֹר וְהַחֲמֽוֹר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shrykhm zr'y 'lkhlmym mshlchy rglhshvr vhchmvr {s}
verses.translation: Happy are ye that sow beside all waters, That send forth freely the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי שׁוֹדֵ֗ד וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א שָׁד֔וּד וּבוֹגֵ֖ד וְלֹא־בָ֣גְדוּ ב֑וֹ כַּהֲתִֽמְךָ֤ שׁוֹדֵד֙ תּוּשַּׁ֔ד כַּנְּלֹתְךָ֥ לִבְגֹּ֖ד יִבְגְּדוּ־בָֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvy shvdd v'th l' shdvd vbvgd vl'bgdv bv khhtmkh shvdd tvshd khnltkh lbgd ybgdvbkh {s}
verses.translation: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; And dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! When thou hast ceased to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; And when thou art weary with dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה חׇנֵּ֖נוּ לְךָ֣ קִוִּ֑ינוּ הֱיֵ֤ה זְרֹעָם֙ לַבְּקָרִ֔ים אַף־יְשׁוּעָתֵ֖נוּ בְּעֵ֥ת צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh chnnv lkh qvynv hyh zr'm lbqrym 'fyshv'tnv b't tsrh
verses.translation: O LORD, be gracious unto us; We have waited for Thee; be Thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּ֣וֹל הָמ֔וֹן נָדְד֖וּ עַמִּ֑ים מֵר֣וֹמְמֻתֶ֔ךָ נָפְצ֖וּ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: mqvl hmvn nddv 'mym mrvmmtkh nptsv gvym
verses.translation: At the noise of the tumult the peoples are fled; at the lifting up of Thyself the nations are scattered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֻסַּ֣ף שְׁלַלְכֶ֔ם אֹ֖סֶף הֶחָסִ֑יל כְּמַשַּׁ֥ק גֵּבִ֖ים שֹׁקֵ֥ק בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'sf shllkhm 'sf hchsyl khmshq gbym shqq bv
verses.translation: And your spoil is gathered as the caterpillar gathereth; as locusts leap do they leap upon it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׂגָּ֣ב יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁכֵ֖ן מָר֑וֹם מִלֵּ֣א צִיּ֔וֹן מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: nshgb yhvh khy shkhn mrvm ml' tsyvn mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: The LORD is exalted, for He dwelleth on high; He hath filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ אֱמוּנַ֣ת עִתֶּ֔יךָ חֹ֥סֶן יְשׁוּעֹ֖ת חׇכְמַ֣ת וָדָ֑עַת יִרְאַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה הִ֥יא אוֹצָרֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh 'mvnt 'tykh chsn yshv't chkhmt vd't yr't yhvh hy' 'vtsrv {p}
verses.translation: And the stability of thy times shall be a hoard of salvation—wisdom and knowledge, And the fear of the LORD which is His treasure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֚ן אֶרְאֶלָּ֔ם צָעֲק֖וּ חֻ֑צָה מַלְאֲכֵ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם מַ֖ר יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃
verses.translit: hn 'r'lm ts'qv chtsh ml'khy shlvm mr ybkhyvn
verses.translation: Behold, their valiant ones cry without; The ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָשַׁ֣מּוּ מְסִלּ֔וֹת שָׁבַ֖ת עֹבֵ֣ר אֹ֑רַח הֵפֵ֤ר בְּרִית֙ מָאַ֣ס עָרִ֔ים לֹ֥א חָשַׁ֖ב אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: nshmv mslvt shbt 'br 'rch hpr bryt m's 'rym l' chshb 'nvsh
verses.translation: The highways lie waste, The wayfaring man ceaseth; He hath broken the covenant, He hath despised the cities, He regardeth not man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבַ֤ל אֻמְלְלָה֙ אָ֔רֶץ הֶחְפִּ֥יר לְבָנ֖וֹן קָמַ֑ל הָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ כָּֽעֲרָבָ֔ה וְנֹעֵ֥ר בָּשָׁ֖ן וְכַרְמֶֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'bl 'mllh 'rts hchpyr lbnvn qml hyh hshrvn kh'rbh vn'r bshn vkhrml {s}
verses.translation: The land mourneth and languisheth; Lebanon is ashamed, it withereth; Sharon is like a wilderness; And Bashan and Carmel are clean bare.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֥ה אָק֖וּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ אֵֽרוֹמָ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא׃
verses.translit: 'th 'qvm y'mr yhvh 'th 'rvmm 'th 'nsh'
verses.translation: Now will I arise, saith the LORD; Now will I be exalted; now will I lift Myself up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּהֲר֥וּ חֲשַׁ֖שׁ תֵּ֣לְדוּ קַ֑שׁ רוּחֲכֶ֕ם אֵ֖שׁ תֹּאכַלְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: thrv chshsh tldv qsh rvchkhm 'sh t'khlkhm
verses.translation: Ye conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble; Your breath is a fire that shall devour you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת שִׂ֑יד קוֹצִ֥ים כְּסוּחִ֖ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יִצַּֽתּוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyv 'mym mshrpvt shyd qvtsym khsvchym b'sh ytstv {p}
verses.translation: And the peoples shall be as the burnings of lime; As thorns cut down, that are burned in the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ רְחוֹקִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וּדְע֥וּ קְרוֹבִ֖ים גְּבֻרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: shm'v rchvqym 'shr 'shyty vd'v qrvbym gbrty
verses.translation: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; And, ye that are near, acknowledge My might.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּחֲד֤וּ בְצִיּוֹן֙ חַטָּאִ֔ים אָחֲזָ֥ה רְעָדָ֖ה חֲנֵפִ֑ים מִ֣י  יָג֣וּר לָ֗נוּ אֵ֚שׁ אֽוֹכֵלָ֔ה מִֽי־יָג֥וּר לָ֖נוּ מוֹקְדֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: pchdv btsyvn cht'ym 'chzh r'dh chnpym my  ygvr lnv 'sh 'vkhlh myygvr lnv mvqdy 'vlm
verses.translation: The sinners in Zion are afraid; Trembling hath seized the ungodly: ‘Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? Who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹלֵ֣ךְ צְדָק֔וֹת וְדֹבֵ֖ר מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מֹאֵ֞ס בְּבֶ֣צַע מַעֲשַׁקּ֗וֹת נֹעֵ֤ר כַּפָּיו֙ מִתְּמֹ֣ךְ בַּשֹּׁ֔חַד אֹטֵ֤ם אׇזְנוֹ֙ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ דָּמִ֔ים וְעֹצֵ֥ם עֵינָ֖יו מֵרְא֥וֹת בְּרָֽע׃
verses.translit: hlkh tsdqvt vdbr myshrym m's bbts' m'shqvt n'r khpyv mtmkh bshchd 'tm 'znv mshm' dmym v'tsm 'ynyv mr'vt br'
verses.translation: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; He that despiseth the gain of oppressions, That shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, That stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, And shutteth his eyes from looking upon evil;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֚וּא מְרוֹמִ֣ים יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן מְצָד֥וֹת סְלָעִ֖ים מִשְׂגַּבּ֑וֹ לַחְמ֣וֹ נִתָּ֔ן מֵימָ֖יו נֶאֱמָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: hv' mrvmym yshkhn mtsdvt sl'ym mshgbv lchmv ntn mymyv n'mnym
verses.translation: He shall dwell on high; His place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks; His bread shall be given, his waters shall be sure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּיׇפְי֖וֹ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֑יךָ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים׃
verses.translit: mlkh bypyv tchzynh 'ynykh tr'ynh 'rts mrchqym
verses.translation: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty; they shall behold a land stretching afar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְּךָ֖ יֶהְגֶּ֣ה אֵימָ֑ה אַיֵּ֤ה סֹפֵר֙ אַיֵּ֣ה שֹׁקֵ֔ל אַיֵּ֖ה סֹפֵ֥ר אֶת־הַמִּגְדָּלִֽים׃
verses.translit: lbkh yhgh 'ymh 'yh spr 'yh shql 'yh spr 'thmgdlym
verses.translation: Thy heart shall muse on the terror: ‘Where is he that counted, where is he that weighed? Where is he that counted the towers?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־עַ֥ם נוֹעָ֖ז לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה עַ֣ם עִמְקֵ֤י שָׂפָה֙ מִשְּׁמ֔וֹעַ נִלְעַ֥ג לָשׁ֖וֹן אֵ֥ין בִּינָֽה׃
verses.translit: 't'm nv'z l' tr'h 'm 'mqy shph mshmv' nl'g lshvn 'yn bynh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not see the fierce people; A people of a deep speech that thou canst not perceive, Of a stammering tongue that thou canst not understand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲזֵ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן קִרְיַ֖ת מוֹעֲדֵ֑נוּ עֵינֶ֩יךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם נָוֶ֣ה שַׁאֲנָ֗ן אֹ֤הֶל בַּל־יִצְעָן֙ בַּל־יִסַּ֤ע יְתֵדֹתָיו֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וְכׇל־חֲבָלָ֖יו בַּל־יִנָּתֵֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: chzh tsyvn qryt mv'dnv 'ynykh tr'ynh yrvshl͏m nvh sh'nn 'hl blyts'n blys' ytdtyv lntsch vkhlchblyv blyntqv
verses.translation: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemn gatherings; Thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a peaceful habitation, A tent that shall not be removed, The stakes whereof shall never be plucked up, Neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־שָׁ֞ם אַדִּ֤יר יְהֹוָה֙ לָ֔נוּ מְקוֹם־נְהָרִ֥ים יְאֹרִ֖ים רַחֲבֵ֣י יָדָ֑יִם בַּל־תֵּ֤לֶךְ בּוֹ֙ אֳנִי־שַׁ֔יִט וְצִ֥י אַדִּ֖יר לֹ֥א יַעַבְרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'mshm 'dyr yhvh lnv mqvmnhrym y'rym rchby ydym bltlkh bv 'nyshyt vtsy 'dyr l' y'brnv
verses.translation: But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, In a place of broad rivers and streams; Wherein shall go no galley with oars, Neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֔נוּ יְהֹוָ֖ה מְחֹקְקֵ֑נוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה מַלְכֵּ֖נוּ ה֥וּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: khy yhvh shptnv yhvh mchqqnv yhvh mlkhnv hv' yvshy'nv
verses.translation: For the LORD is our Judge, The LORD is our Lawgiver, The LORD is our King; He will save us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִטְּשׁ֖וּ חֲבָלָ֑יִךְ בַּל־יְחַזְּק֤וּ כֵן־תׇּרְנָם֙ בַּל־פָּ֣רְשׂוּ נֵ֔ס אָ֣ז חֻלַּ֤ק עַד־שָׁלָל֙ מַרְבֶּ֔ה פִּסְחִ֖ים בָּ֥זְזוּ בַֽז׃
verses.translit: ntshv chblykh blychzqv khntrnm blprshv ns 'z chlq 'dshll mrbh pschym bzzv bz
verses.translation: Thy tacklings are loosed; They do not hold the stand of their mast, They do not spread the sail; Then is the prey of a great spoil divided; The lame take the prey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַל־יֹאמַ֥ר שָׁכֵ֖ן חָלִ֑יתִי הָעָ֛ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּ֖הּ נְשֻׂ֥א עָוֺֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbly'mr shkhn chlyty h'm hyshb bh nsh' 'vn {s}
verses.translation: And the inhabitant shall not say: ‘I am sick’; The people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִרְב֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים הַקְשִׁ֑יבוּ תִּשְׁמַ֤ע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ תֵּבֵ֖ל וְכׇל־צֶאֱצָאֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: qrbv gvym lshm' vl'mym hqshybv tshm' h'rts vml'h tbl vkhlts'ts'yh
verses.translation: Come near, ye nations, to hear, And attend, ye peoples; Let the earth hear, and the fulness thereof, The world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י קֶ֤צֶף לַֽיהֹוָה֙ עַל־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֵמָ֖ה עַל־כׇּל־צְבָאָ֑ם הֶחֱרִימָ֖ם נְתָנָ֥ם לַטָּֽבַח׃
verses.translit: khy qtsf lyhvh 'lkhlhgvym vchmh 'lkhltsb'm hchrymm ntnm ltbch
verses.translation: For the LORD hath indignation against all the nations, And fury against all their host; He hath utterly destroyed them, He hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַלְלֵיהֶ֣ם יֻשְׁלָ֔כוּ וּפִגְרֵיהֶ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה בׇאְשָׁ֑ם וְנָמַ֥סּוּ הָרִ֖ים מִדָּמָֽם׃
verses.translit: vchllyhm yshlkhv vpgryhm y'lh b'shm vnmsv hrym mdmm
verses.translation: Their slain also shall be cast out, And the stench of their carcasses shall come up, And the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָמַ֙קּוּ֙ כׇּל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנָגֹ֥לּוּ כַסֵּ֖פֶר הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְכׇל־צְבָאָ֣ם יִבּ֔וֹל כִּנְבֹ֤ל עָלֶה֙ מִגֶּ֔פֶן וּכְנֹבֶ֖לֶת מִתְּאֵנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnmqv khltsb' hshmym vnglv khspr hshmym vkhltsb'm ybvl khnbl 'lh mgpn vkhnblt mt'nh
verses.translation: And all the host of heaven shall moulder away, And the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll; And all their host shall fall down, As the leaf falleth off from the vine, And as a falling fig from the fig-tree.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־רִוְּתָ֥ה בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם חַרְבִּ֑י הִנֵּה֙ עַל־אֱד֣וֹם תֵּרֵ֔ד וְעַל־עַ֥ם חֶרְמִ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: khyrvth bshmym chrby hnh 'l'dvm trd v'l'm chrmy lmshpt
verses.translation: For My sword hath drunk its fill in heaven; Behold, it shall come down upon Edom, And upon the people of My ban, to judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֣רֶב לַיהֹוָ֞ה מָלְאָ֥ה דָם֙ הֻדַּ֣שְׁנָה מֵחֵ֔לֶב מִדַּ֤ם כָּרִים֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים מֵחֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת אֵילִ֑ים כִּ֣י זֶ֤בַח לַֽיהֹוָה֙ בְּבׇצְרָ֔ה וְטֶ֥בַח גָּד֖וֹל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: chrb lyhvh ml'h dm hdshnh mchlb mdm khrym v'tvdym mchlb khlyvt 'ylym khy zbch lyhvh bbtsrh vtbch gdvl b'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, It is made fat with fatness, With the blood of lambs and goats, With the fat of the kidneys of rams; For the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרְד֤וּ רְאֵמִים֙ עִמָּ֔ם וּפָרִ֖ים עִם־אַבִּירִ֑ים וְרִוְּתָ֤ה אַרְצָם֙ מִדָּ֔ם וַעֲפָרָ֖ם מֵחֵ֥לֶב יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vyrdv r'mym 'mm vprym 'm'byrym vrvth 'rtsm mdm v'prm mchlb ydshn
verses.translation: And the wild-oxen shall come down with them, And the bullocks with the bulls; And their land shall be drunken with blood, And their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה שְׁנַ֥ת שִׁלּוּמִ֖ים לְרִ֥יב צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: khy yvm nqm lyhvh shnt shlvmym lryb tsyvn
verses.translation: For the LORD hath a day of vengeance, A year of recompense for the controversy of Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶהֶפְכ֤וּ נְחָלֶ֙יהָ֙ לְזֶ֔פֶת וַעֲפָרָ֖הּ לְגׇפְרִ֑ית וְהָיְתָ֣ה אַרְצָ֔הּ לְזֶ֖פֶת בֹּעֵרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnhpkhv nchlyh lzpt v'prh lgpryt vhyth 'rtsh lzpt b'rh
verses.translation: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, And the dust thereof into brimstone, And the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֤יְלָה וְיוֹמָם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה לְעוֹלָ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה עֲשָׁנָ֑הּ מִדּ֤וֹר לָדוֹר֙ תֶּחֱרָ֔ב לְנֵ֣צַח נְצָחִ֔ים אֵ֥ין עֹבֵ֖ר בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lylh vyvmm l' tkhbh l'vlm y'lh 'shnh mdvr ldvr tchrb lntsch ntschym 'yn 'br bh
verses.translation: It shall not be quenched night nor day, The smoke thereof shall go up for ever; From generation to generation it shall lie waste: None shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִירֵשׁ֙וּהָ֙ קָאַ֣ת וְקִפּ֔וֹד וְיַנְשׁ֥וֹף וְעֹרֵ֖ב יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָ֑הּ וְנָטָ֥ה עָלֶ֛יהָ קַֽו־תֹֿ֖הוּ וְאַבְנֵי־בֹֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vyrshvh q't vqpvd vynshvf v'rb yshkhnvbh vnth 'lyh qvthv v'bnybhv
verses.translation: But the pelican and the bittern shall possess it, And the owl and the raven shall dwell therein; And He shall stretch over it The line of confusion, and the plummet of emptiness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֹרֶ֥יהָ וְאֵֽין־שָׁ֖ם מְלוּכָ֣ה יִקְרָ֑אוּ וְכׇל־שָׂרֶ֖יהָ יִ֥הְיוּ אָֽפֶס׃
verses.translit: chryh v'ynshm mlvkhh yqr'v vkhlshryh yhyv 'ps
verses.translation: As for her nobles, none shall be there to be called to the kingdom; And all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלְתָ֤ה אַרְמְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ סִירִ֔ים קִמּ֥וֹשׂ וָח֖וֹחַ בְּמִבְצָרֶ֑יהָ וְהָֽיְתָה֙ נְוֵ֣ה תַנִּ֔ים חָצִ֖יר לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lth 'rmntyh syrym qmvsh vchvch bmbtsryh vhyth nvh tnym chtsyr lbnvt y'nh
verses.translation: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, Nettles and thistles in the fortresses thereof; And it shall be a habitation of wild-dogs, An enclosure for ostriches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָגְשׁ֤וּ צִיִּים֙ אֶת־אִיִּ֔ים וְשָׂעִ֖יר עַל־רֵעֵ֣הוּ יִקְרָ֑א אַךְ־שָׁם֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעָה לִּילִ֔ית וּמָצְאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ מָנֽוֹחַ׃
verses.translit: vpgshv tsyym 't'yym vsh'yr 'lr'hv yqr' 'khshm hrgy'h lylyt vmts'h lh mnvch
verses.translation: And the wild-cats shall meet with the jackals, And the satyr shall cry to his fellow; Yea, the night-monster shall repose there, And shall find her a place of rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה קִנְּנָ֤ה קִפּוֹז֙ וַתְּמַלֵּ֔ט וּבָקְעָ֖ה וְדָגְרָ֣ה בְצִלָּ֑הּ אַךְ־שָׁ֛ם נִקְבְּצ֥וּ דַיּ֖וֹת אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: shmh qnnh qpvz vtmlt vbq'h vdgrh btslh 'khshm nqbtsv dyvt 'shh r'vth
verses.translation: There shall the arrowsnake make her nest, and lay, And hatch, and brood under her shadow; Yea, there shall the kites be gathered, Every one with her mate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֨וּ מֵעַל־סֵ֤פֶר יְהֹוָה֙ וּֽקְרָ֔אוּ אַחַ֤ת מֵהֵ֙נָּה֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔רָה אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָ֖הּ לֹ֣א פָקָ֑דוּ כִּי־פִי֙ ה֣וּא צִוָּ֔ה וְרוּח֖וֹ ה֥וּא קִבְּצָֽן׃
verses.translit: drshv m'lspr yhvh vqr'v 'cht mhnh l' n'drh 'shh r'vth l' pqdv khypy hv' tsvh vrvchv hv' qbtsn
verses.translation: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read; No one of these shall be missing, None shall want her mate; For My mouth it hath commanded, And the breath thereof it hath gathered them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־הִפִּ֤יל לָהֶן֙ גּוֹרָ֔ל וְיָד֛וֹ חִלְּקַ֥תָּה לָהֶ֖ם בַּקָּ֑ו עַד־עוֹלָם֙ יִֽירָשׁ֔וּהָ לְד֥וֹר וָד֖וֹר יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhv'hpyl lhn gvrl vydv chlqth lhm bqv 'd'vlm yyrshvh ldvr vdvr yshkhnvbh {s}
verses.translation: And He hath cast the lot for them, And His hand hath divided it unto them by line; They shall possess it for ever, From generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְשֻׂשׂ֥וּם מִדְבָּ֖ר וְצִיָּ֑ה וְתָגֵ֧ל עֲרָבָ֛ה וְתִפְרַ֖ח כַּחֲבַצָּֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: yshshvm mdbr vtsyh vtgl 'rbh vtprch khchbtslt
verses.translation: The wilderness and the parched land shall be glad; And the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּרֹ֨חַ תִּפְרַ֜ח וְתָגֵ֗ל אַ֚ף גִּילַ֣ת וְרַנֵּ֔ן כְּב֤וֹד הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ נִתַּן־לָ֔הּ הֲדַ֥ר הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל וְהַשָּׁר֑וֹן הֵ֛מָּה יִרְא֥וּ כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה הֲדַ֥ר אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: prch tprch vtgl 'f gylt vrnn khbvd hlbnvn ntnlh hdr hkhrml vhshrvn hmh yr'v khbvdyhvh hdr 'lhynv {p}
verses.translation: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice, Even with joy and singing; The glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, The excellency of Carmel and Sharon; They shall see the glory of the LORD, The excellency of our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַזְּק֖וּ יָדַ֣יִם רָפ֑וֹת וּבִרְכַּ֥יִם כֹּשְׁל֖וֹת אַמֵּֽצוּ׃
verses.translit: chzqv ydym rpvt vbrkhym khshlvt 'mtsv
verses.translation: Strengthen ye the weak hands, And make firm the tottering knees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִמְרוּ֙ לְנִמְהֲרֵי־לֵ֔ב חִזְק֖וּ אַל־תִּירָ֑אוּ הִנֵּ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ נָקָ֣ם יָב֔וֹא גְּמ֣וּל אֱלֹהִ֔ים ה֥וּא יָב֖וֹא וְיֹשַׁעֲכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mrv lnmhrylb chzqv 'ltyr'v hnh 'lhykhm nqm ybv' gmvl 'lhym hv' ybv' vysh'khm
verses.translation: Say to them that are of a fearful heart: ‘Be strong, fear not’; Behold, your God will come with vengeance, With the recompense of God He will come and save you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֥ז תִּפָּקַ֖חְנָה עֵינֵ֣י עִוְרִ֑ים וְאׇזְנֵ֥י חֵרְשִׁ֖ים תִּפָּתַֽחְנָה׃
verses.translit: 'z tpqchnh 'yny 'vrym v'zny chrshym tptchnh
verses.translation: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, And the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז יְדַלֵּ֤ג כָּֽאַיָּל֙ פִּסֵּ֔חַ וְתָרֹ֖ן לְשׁ֣וֹן אִלֵּ֑ם כִּֽי־נִבְקְע֤וּ בַמִּדְבָּר֙ מַ֔יִם וּנְחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲרָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'z ydlg kh'yl psch vtrn lshvn 'lm khynbq'v bmdbr mym vnchlym b'rbh
verses.translation: Then shall the lame man leap as a hart, And the tongue of the dumb shall sing; For in the wilderness shall waters break out, And streams in the desert.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרָב֙ לַאֲגַ֔ם וְצִמָּא֖וֹן לְמַבּ֣וּעֵי מָ֑יִם בִּנְוֵ֤ה תַנִּים֙ רִבְצָ֔הּ חָצִ֖יר לְקָנֶ֥ה וָגֹֽמֶא׃
verses.translit: vhyh hshrb l'gm vtsm'vn lmbv'y mym bnvh tnym rbtsh chtsyr lqnh vgm'
verses.translation: And the parched land shall become a pool, And the thirsty ground springs of water; In the habitation of jackals herds shall lie down, It shall be an enclosure for reeds and rushes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה־שָׁ֞ם מַסְל֣וּל וָדֶ֗רֶךְ וְדֶ֤רֶךְ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִקָּ֣רֵא לָ֔הּ לֹא־יַעַבְרֶ֥נּוּ טָמֵ֖א וְהוּא־לָ֑מוֹ הֹלֵ֥ךְ דֶּ֛רֶךְ וֶאֱוִילִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִתְעֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyhshm mslvl vdrkh vdrkh hqdsh yqr' lh l'y'brnv tm' vhv'lmv hlkh drkh v'vylym l' yt'v
verses.translation: And a highway shall be there, and a way, And it shall be called The way of holiness; The unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those; The wayfaring men, yea fools, shall not err therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֨ה שָׁ֜ם אַרְיֵ֗ה וּפְרִ֤יץ חַיּוֹת֙ בַּֽל־יַעֲלֶ֔נָּה לֹ֥א תִמָּצֵ֖א שָׁ֑ם וְהָלְכ֖וּ גְּאוּלִֽים׃
verses.translit: l'yhyh shm 'ryh vpryts chyvt bly'lnh l' tmts' shm vhlkhv g'vlym
verses.translation: No lion shall be there, Nor shall any ravenous beast go up thereon, They shall not be found there; But the redeemed shall walk there;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְדוּיֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה יְשֻׁב֗וּן וּבָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּרִנָּ֔ה וְשִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל־רֹאשָׁ֑ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְשִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂ֔יגוּ וְנָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַאֲנָחָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vpdvyy yhvh yshbvn vb'v tsyvn brnh vshmcht 'vlm 'lr'shm shshvn vshmchh yshygv vnsv ygvn v'nchh {s}
verses.translation: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, And come with singing unto Zion, And everlasting joy shall be upon their heads; They shall obtain gladness and joy, And sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י בְּאַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עָלָ֞ה סַנְחֵרִ֤יב מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ עַ֣ל כׇּל־עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת וַֽיִּתְפְּשֵֽׂם׃
verses.translit: vyhy b'rb' 'shrh shnh lmlkh chzqyhv 'lh snchryb mlkh'shvr 'l khl'ry yhvdh hbtsrvt vytpshm
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֣וּר  אֶת־רַבְשָׁקֵ֨ה מִלָּכִ֧ישׁ יְרוּשָׁלַ֛͏ְמָה אֶל־הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּחֵ֣יל כָּבֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד בִּתְעָלַת֙ הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה בִּמְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס׃
verses.translit: vyshlch mlkh'shvr  'trbshqh mlkhysh yrvshl͏mh 'lhmlkh chzqyhv bchyl khbd vy'md bt'lt hbrkhh h'lyvnh bmslt shdh khvbs
verses.translation: And the king of Assyria sent Rab-shakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fullers’field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א אֵלָ֛יו אֶלְיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַבָּ֑יִת וְשֶׁבְנָא֙ הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְיוֹאָ֥ח בֶּן־אָסָ֖ף הַמַּזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'lyv 'lyqym bnchlqyhv 'shr 'lhbyt vshbn' hspr vyv'ch bn'sf hmzkhyr
verses.translation: Then came forth unto him Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ רַבְשָׁקֵ֔ה אִמְרוּ־נָ֖א אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר מָ֧ה הַבִּטָּח֛וֹן הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּטָֽחְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm rbshqh 'mrvn' 'lchzqyhv khh'mr hmlkh hgdvl mlkh 'shvr mh hbtchvn hzh 'shr btcht
verses.translation: And Rab-shakeh said unto them: ‘Say ye now to Hezekiah: Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria: What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ אַךְ־דְּבַר־שְׂפָתַ֔יִם עֵצָ֥ה וּגְבוּרָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ עַל־מִ֣י בָטַ֔חְתָּ כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְתָּ בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mrty 'khdbrshptym 'tsh vgbvrh lmlchmh 'th 'lmy btcht khy mrdt by
verses.translation: I said: It is but vain words; for counsel and strength are for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou hast rebelled against me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה בָטַ֡חְתָּ עַל־מִשְׁעֶ֩נֶת֩ הַקָּנֶ֨ה הָרָצ֤וּץ הַזֶּה֙ עַל־מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִסָּמֵ֥ךְ אִישׁ֙ עָלָ֔יו וּבָ֥א בְכַפּ֖וֹ וּנְקָבָ֑הּ כֵּ֚ן פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֔יִם לְכׇֽל־הַבֹּטְחִ֖ים עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hnh btcht 'lmsh'nt hqnh hrtsvts hzh 'lmtsrym 'shr ysmkh 'ysh 'lyv vb' bkhpv vnqbh khn pr'h mlkhmtsrym lkhlhbtchym 'lyv
verses.translation: Behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it; so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust on him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־תֹאמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י אֶל־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ בָּטָ֑חְנוּ הֲלוֹא־ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵסִ֤יר חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶת־בָּמֹתָ֣יו וְאֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָ֔יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לִיהוּדָה֙ וְלִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם לִפְנֵ֛י הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ הַזֶּ֖ה תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhyt'mr 'ly 'lyhvh 'lhynv btchnv hlv'hv' 'shr hsyr chzqyhv 'tbmtyv v'tmzbchtyv vy'mr lyhvdh vlyrvshl͏m lpny hmzbch hzh tshtchvv
verses.translation: But if thou say unto me: We trust in the LORD our God; is not that He, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and to Jerusalem: Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הִתְעָ֣רֶב נָ֔א אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֖י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לְךָ֙ אַלְפַּ֣יִם סוּסִ֔ים אִם־תּוּכַ֕ל לָ֥תֶת לְךָ֖ רֹכְבִ֥ים עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th ht'rb n' 't'dny hmlkh 'shvr v'tnh lkh 'lpym svsym 'mtvkhl ltt lkh rkhbym 'lyhm
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray thee, make a wager with my master, the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣יךְ תָּשִׁ֗יב אֵ֠ת פְּנֵ֨י פַחַ֥ת אַחַ֛ד עַבְדֵ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖י הַקְּטַנִּ֑ים וַתִּבְטַ֤ח לְךָ֙ עַל־מִצְרַ֔יִם לְרֶ֖כֶב וּלְפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: v'ykh tshyb 't pny pcht 'chd 'bdy 'dny hqtnym vtbtch lkh 'lmtsrym lrkhb vlprshym
verses.translation: How then canst thou turn away the face of one captain, even of the least of my master’s servants? yet thou puttest thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הֲמִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה עָלִ֛יתִי עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֑הּ יְהֹוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את וְהַשְׁחִיתָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th hmbl'dy yhvh 'lyty 'lh'rts hz't lhshchyth yhvh 'mr 'ly 'lh 'lh'rts hz't vhshchyth {s}
verses.translation: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? The LORD said unto me: Go up against this land, and destroy it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶלְיָקִים֩ וְשֶׁבְנָ֨א וְיוֹאָ֜ח אֶל־רַבְשָׁקֵ֗ה דַּבֶּר־נָ֤א אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲרָמִ֔ית כִּ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְאַל־תְּדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלֵ֙ינוּ֙ יְהוּדִ֔ית בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyqym vshbn' vyv'ch 'lrbshqh dbrn' 'l'bdykh 'rmyt khy shm'ym 'nchnv v'ltdbr 'lynv yhvdyt b'zny h'm 'shr 'lhchvmh
verses.translation: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rab-shakeh: ‘Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Aramean language, for we understand it; and speak not to us in the Jews’language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר רַבְשָׁקֵ֗ה הַאֶ֨ל אֲדֹנֶ֤יךָ וְאֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲדֹנִ֔י לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה הֲלֹ֣א עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ עַל־הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה לֶאֱכֹ֣ל אֶת־[צוֹאָתָ֗ם] (חראיהם) וְלִשְׁתּ֛וֹת אֶת־[מֵימֵ֥י רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם] (שיניהם) עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr rbshqh h'l 'dnykh v'lykh shlchny 'dny ldbr 'thdbrym h'lh hl' 'lh'nshym hyshbym 'lhchvmh l'khl 't[tsv'tm] (chr'yhm) vlshtvt 't[mymy rglyhm] (shynyhm) 'mkhm
verses.translation: But Rab-shakeh said: ‘Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own water with you?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ רַבְשָׁקֵ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְקוֹל־גָּד֖וֹל יְהוּדִ֑ית וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְע֗וּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֛י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הַגָּד֖וֹל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: vy'md rbshqh vyqr' bqvlgdvl yhvdyt vy'mr shm'v 'tdbry hmlkh hgdvl mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Then Rab-shakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’language, and said: ‘Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אַל־יַשִּׁ֥א לָכֶ֖ם חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּ֥י לֹֽא־יוּכַ֖ל לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr hmlkh 'lysh' lkhm chzqyhv khy l'yvkhl lhtsyl 'tkhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the king: Let not Hezekiah beguile you, for he will not be able to deliver you;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַל־יַבְטַ֨ח אֶתְכֶ֤ם חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה לֵאמֹ֔ר הַצֵּ֥ל יַצִּילֵ֖נוּ יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את בְּיַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: v'lybtch 'tkhm chzqyhv 'lyhvh l'mr htsl ytsylnv yhvh l' tntn h'yr hz't byd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying: The LORD will surely deliver us; this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּשְׁמְע֖וּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ {פ} כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֗וּר עֲשֽׂוּ־אִתִּ֤י בְרָכָה֙ וּצְא֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וְאִכְל֤וּ אִישׁ־גַּפְנוֹ֙ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּאֵנָת֔וֹ וּשְׁת֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מֵי־בוֹרֽוֹ׃
