verses.translit: 'ltshm'v 'lchzqyhv {p} khy khh 'mr hmlkh 'shvr 'shv'ty brkhh vts'v 'ly v'khlv 'yshgpnv v'ysh t'ntv vshtv 'ysh mybvrv
verses.translation: Hearken not to Hezekiah; for thus saith the king of Assyria: Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig-tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־בֹּאִ֕י וְלָקַחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם אֶ֤רֶץ דָּגָן֙ וְתִיר֔וֹשׁ אֶ֥רֶץ לֶ֖חֶם וּכְרָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'db'y vlqchty 'tkhm 'l'rts kh'rtskhm 'rts dgn vtyrvsh 'rts lchm vkhrmym
verses.translation: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־יַסִּ֨ית אֶתְכֶ֤ם חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהֹוָ֖ה יַצִּילֵ֑נוּ הַהִצִּ֜ילוּ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אַרְצ֔וֹ מִיַּ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: pnysyt 'tkhm chzqyhv l'mr yhvh ytsylnv hhtsylv 'lhy hgvym 'ysh 't'rtsv myd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying: The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַיֵּ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י חֲמָת֙ וְאַרְפָּ֔ד אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י סְפַרְוָ֑יִם וְכִֽי־הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְר֖וֹן מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'yh 'lhy chmt v'rpd 'yh 'lhy sprvym vkhyhtsylv 'tshmrvn mydy
verses.translation: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֗י בְּכׇל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָאֲרָצוֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת־אַרְצָ֖ם מִיָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־יַצִּ֧יל יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: my bkhl'lhy h'rtsvt h'lh 'shrhtsylv 't'rtsm mydy khyytsyl yhvh 'tyrvshl͏m mydy
verses.translation: Who are they among all the gods of these countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּחֲרִ֔ישׁוּ וְלֹא־עָנ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ דָּבָ֑ר כִּֽי־מִצְוַ֨ת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הִ֛יא לֵאמֹ֖ר לֹ֥א תַעֲנֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vychryshv vl''nv 'tv dbr khymtsvt hmlkh hy' l'mr l' t'nhv
verses.translation: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, saying: ‘Answer him not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַ֠בַּ֠יִת וְשֶׁבְנָ֨א הַסֹּפֵ֜ר וְיוֹאָ֨ח בֶּן־אָסָ֧ף הַמַּזְכִּ֛יר אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ קְרוּעֵ֣י בְגָדִ֑ים וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י רַבְשָׁקֵֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyqym bnchlqyhv 'shr'lhbyt vshbn' hspr vyv'ch bn'sf hmzkhyr 'lchzqyhv qrv'y bgdym vygydv lv 't dbry rbshqh {s}
verses.translation: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֗י כִּשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־בְּגָדָ֑יו וַיִּתְכַּ֣ס בַּשָּׂ֔ק וַיָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh chzqyhv vyqr' 'tbgdyv vytkhs bshq vyb' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַ֠ח אֶת־אֶלְיָקִ֨ים אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּ֜יִת וְאֵ֣ת  שֶׁבְנָ֣א הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וְאֵת֙ זִקְנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים מִתְכַּסִּ֖ים בַּשַּׂקִּ֑ים אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־אָמ֖וֹץ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 't'lyqym 'shr'lhbyt v't  shbn' hsvpr v't zqny hkhhnym mtkhsym bshqym 'lysh'yhv bn'mvts hnby'
verses.translation: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ יוֹם־צָרָ֧ה וְתוֹכֵחָ֛ה וּנְאָצָ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י בָ֤אוּ בָנִים֙ עַד־מַשְׁבֵּ֔ר וְכֹ֥חַ אַ֖יִן לְלֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv khh 'mr chzqyhv yvmtsrh vtvkhchh vn'tsh hyvm hzh khy b'v bnym 'dmshbr vkhch 'yn lldh
verses.translation: And they said unto him: ‘Thus saith Hezekiah: This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of contumely; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוּלַ֡י יִשְׁמַע֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֵ֣ת  דִּבְרֵ֣י רַבְשָׁקֵ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שְׁלָח֨וֹ מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֤וּר ׀ אֲדֹנָיו֙ לְחָרֵף֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַ֔י וְהוֹכִ֙יחַ֙ בַּדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖ע יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְנָשָׂ֣אתָ תְפִלָּ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד הַשְּׁאֵרִ֖ית הַנִּמְצָאָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'vly yshm' yhvh 'lhykh 't  dbry rbshqh 'shr shlchv mlkh'shvr  'dnyv lchrf 'lhym chy vhvkhych bdbrym 'shr shm' yhvh 'lhykh vnsh't tplh b'd hsh'ryt hnmts'h
verses.translation: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to taunt the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD thy God hath heard; wherefore make prayer for the remnant that is left.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ עַבְדֵ֛י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֶֽל־יְשַׁעְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'bdy hmlkh chzqyhv 'lysh'yhv
verses.translation: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּן אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֑ם כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אַל־תִּירָא֙ מִפְּנֵ֤י הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר גִּדְּפ֛וּ נַעֲרֵ֥י מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֖וּר אוֹתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm ysh'yhv khh t'mrvn 'l'dnykhm khh  'mr yhvh 'ltyr' mpny hdbrym 'shr shm't 'shr gdpv n'ry mlkh'shvr 'vty
verses.translation: And Isaiah said unto them: ‘Thus shall ye say to your master: Thus saith the LORD: Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י נוֹתֵ֥ן בּוֹ֙ ר֔וּחַ וְשָׁמַ֥ע שְׁמוּעָ֖ה וְשָׁ֣ב אֶל־אַרְצ֑וֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּ֥יו בַּחֶ֖רֶב בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnny nvtn bv rvch vshm' shmv'h vshb 'l'rtsv vhpltyv bchrb b'rtsv
verses.translation: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return unto his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שׇׁב֙ רַבְשָׁקֵ֔ה וַיִּמְצָא֙ אֶת־מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר נִלְחָ֖ם עַל־לִבְנָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י נָסַ֖ע מִלָּכִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vyshb rbshqh vymts' 'tmlkh 'shvr nlchm 'llbnh khy shm' khy ns' mlkhysh
verses.translation: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע עַל־תִּרְהָ֤קָה מֶֽלֶךְ־כּוּשׁ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יָצָ֖א לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם אִתָּ֑ךְ וַיִּשְׁמַע֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshm' 'ltrhqh mlkhkhvsh l'mr yts' lhlchm 'tkh vyshm' vyshlch ml'khym 'lchzqyhv l'mr
verses.translation: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia: ‘He is come out to fight against thee.’ And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה תֹאמְר֗וּן אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַל־יַשִּׁאֲךָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בּ֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם בְּיַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: khh t'mrvn 'lchzqyhv mlkhyhvdh l'mr 'lysh'kh 'lhykh 'shr 'th bvtch bv l'mr l' tntn yrvshl͏m byd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: ’Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: Let not thy God in whom thou trustest beguile thee, saying: Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה  אַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר לְכׇל־הָאֲרָצ֖וֹת לְהַחֲרִימָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּנָּצֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hnh  'th shm't 'shr 'shv mlkhy 'shvr lkhlh'rtsvt lhchrymm v'th tntsl
verses.translation: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַהִצִּ֨ילוּ אוֹתָ֜ם אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִשְׁחִ֣יתוּ אֲבוֹתַ֔י אֶת־גּוֹזָ֖ן וְאֶת־חָרָ֑ן וְרֶ֥צֶף וּבְנֵי־עֶ֖דֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּתְלַשָּֽׂר׃
verses.translit: hhtsylv 'vtm 'lhy hgvym 'shr hshchytv 'bvty 'tgvzn v'tchrn vrtsf vbny'dn 'shr btlshr
verses.translation: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden that were in Telassar?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַיֵּ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־חֲמָת֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אַרְפָּ֔ד וּמֶ֖לֶךְ לָעִ֣יר סְפַרְוָ֑יִם הֵנַ֖ע וְעִוָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'yh mlkhchmt vmlkh 'rpd vmlkh l'yr sprvym hn' v'vh
verses.translation: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חִזְקִיָּ֧הוּ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִ֛ים מִיַּ֥ד הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים וַיִּקְרָאֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֙עַל֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂ֥הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqch chzqyhv 'thsprym myd hml'khym vyqr'hv vy'l byt yhvh vyprshhv chzqyhv lpny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vytpll chzqyhv 'lyhvh l'mr
verses.translation: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אַתָּה־ה֤וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְבַדְּךָ֔ לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l yshb hkhrbym 'thhv' h'lhym lbdkh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts 'th 'shyt 'thshmym v'th'rts
verses.translation: ’O LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, that sittest upon the cherubim, Thou art the God, even Thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; Thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַטֵּ֨ה יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אׇזְנְךָ֙ וּֽשְׁמָ֔ע פְּקַ֧ח יְהֹוָ֛ה עֵינֶ֖ךָ וּרְאֵ֑ה וּשְׁמַ֗ע אֵ֚ת כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֣י סַנְחֵרִ֔יב אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֔ח לְחָרֵ֖ף אֱלֹהִ֥ים חָֽי׃
verses.translit: hth yhvh  'znkh vshm' pqch yhvh 'ynkh vr'h vshm' 't khldbry snchryb 'shr shlch lchrf 'lhym chy
verses.translation: Incline Thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open Thine eyes, O LORD, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, who hath sent to taunt the living God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇמְנָ֖ם יְהֹוָ֑ה הֶחֱרִ֜יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר אֶת־כׇּל־הָאֲרָצ֖וֹת וְאֶת־אַרְצָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mnm yhvh hchrybv mlkhy 'shvr 'tkhlh'rtsvt v't'rtsm
verses.translation: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the countries, and their land,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתֹ֥ן אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֣י אִם־מַעֲשֵׂ֧ה יְדֵֽי־אָדָ֛ם עֵ֥ץ וָאֶ֖בֶן וַֽיְאַבְּדֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vntn 't'lhyhm b'sh khy l' 'lhym hmh khy 'mm'shh ydy'dm 'ts v'bn vy'bdvm
verses.translation: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֖נוּ מִיָּד֑וֹ וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ כׇּל־מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhynv hvshy'nv mydv vyd'v khlmmlkhvt h'rts khy'th yhvh lbdkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that Thou art the LORD, even Thou only.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־אָמ֔וֹץ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ הִתְפַּלַּ֣לְתָּ אֵלַ֔י אֶל־סַנְחֵרִ֖יב מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: vyshlch ysh'yhv bn'mvts 'lchzqyhv l'mr khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr htpllt 'ly 'lsnchryb mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying: ‘Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel: Whereas thou hast prayed to Me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו בָּזָ֨ה לְךָ֜ לָעֲגָ֣ה לְךָ֗ בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן אַחֲרֶ֙יךָ֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הֵנִ֔יעָה בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shrdbr yhvh 'lyv bzh lkh l'gh lkh btvlt bttsyvn 'chrykh r'sh hny'h bt yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: this is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion Hath despised thee and laughed thee to scorn; The daughter of Jerusalem Hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־מִ֤י חֵרַ֙פְתָּ֙ וְגִדַּ֔פְתָּ וְעַל־מִ֖י הֲרִימ֣וֹתָה קּ֑וֹל וַתִּשָּׂ֥א מָר֛וֹם עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֶל־קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'tmy chrpt vgdpt v'lmy hrymvth qvl vtsh' mrvm 'ynykh 'lqdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Whom hast thou taunted and blasphemed? And against whom hast thou exalted thy voice? Yea, thou hast lifted up thine eyes on high, Even against the Holy One of Israel!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיַ֣ד עֲבָדֶ֘יךָ֮ חֵרַ֣פְתָּ ׀ אֲדֹנָי֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר בְּרֹ֥ב רִכְבִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י עָלִ֛יתִי מְר֥וֹם הָרִ֖ים יַרְכְּתֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְאֶכְרֹ֞ת קוֹמַ֤ת אֲרָזָיו֙ מִבְחַ֣ר בְּרֹשָׁ֔יו וְאָבוֹא֙ מְר֣וֹם קִצּ֔וֹ יַ֖עַר כַּרְמִלּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: byd 'bdykh chrpt  'dny vt'mr brb rkhby 'ny 'lyty mrvm hrym yrkhty lbnvn v'khrt qvmt 'rzyv mbchr brshyv v'bv' mrvm qtsv y'r khrmlv
verses.translation: By thy servants hast thou taunted the Lord, And hast said: With the multitude of my chariots Am I come up to the height of the mountains, To the innermost parts of Lebanon; And I have cut down the tall cedars thereof, And the choice cypress-trees thereof; And I have entered into his farthest height, The forest of his fruitful field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י קַ֖רְתִּי וְשָׁתִ֣יתִי מָ֑יִם וְאַחְרִב֙ בְּכַף־פְּעָמַ֔י כֹּ֖ל יְאֹרֵ֥י מָצֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'ny qrty vshtyty mym v'chrb bkhfp'my khl y'ry mtsvr
verses.translation: I have digged and drunk water, And with the sole of my feet have I dried up All the rivers of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֽוֹא־שָׁמַ֤עְתָּ לְמֵֽרָחוֹק֙ אוֹתָ֣הּ עָשִׂ֔יתִי מִ֥ימֵי קֶ֖דֶם וִיצַרְתִּ֑יהָ עַתָּ֣ה הֲבֵאתִ֔יהָ וּתְהִ֗י לְהַשְׁא֛וֹת גַּלִּ֥ים נִצִּ֖ים עָרִ֥ים בְּצֻרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hlv'shm't lmrchvq 'vth 'shyty mymy qdm vytsrtyh 'th hb'tyh vthy lhsh'vt glym ntsym 'rym btsrvt
verses.translation: Hast thou not heard? Long ago I made it, In ancient times I fashioned it; Now have I brought it to pass, Yea, it is done; that fortified cities Should be laid waste into ruinous heaps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֹֽשְׁבֵיהֶן֙ קִצְרֵי־יָ֔ד חַ֖תּוּ וָבֹ֑שׁוּ הָי֞וּ עֵ֤שֶׂב שָׂדֶה֙ וִ֣ירַק דֶּ֔שֶׁא חֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֔וֹת וּשְׁדֵמָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י קָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshbyhn qtsryyd chtv vbshv hyv 'shb shdh vyrq dsh' chtsyr ggvt vshdmh lpny qmh
verses.translation: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, They were dismayed and confounded; They were as the grass of the field, And as the green herb, As the grass on the housetops, And as a field of corn before it is grown up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ וְצֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֲךָ֖ יָדָ֑עְתִּי וְאֵ֖ת הִֽתְרַגֶּזְךָ֥ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vshbtkh vts'tkh vbv'kh yd'ty v't htrgzkh 'ly
verses.translation: But I know thy sitting down, and thy going out, and thy coming in, And thy raging against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֚עַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ֣ אֵלַ֔י וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ֖ עָלָ֣ה בְאׇזְנָ֑י וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י חַחִ֜י בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ וּמִתְגִּי֙ בִּשְׂפָתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲשִׁ֣יבֹתִ֔יךָ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אתָ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: y'n htrgzkh 'ly vsh'nnkh 'lh b'zny vshmty chchy b'pkh vmtgy bshptykh vhshybtykh bdrkh 'shrb't bh
verses.translation: Because of thy raging against Me, And for that thine uproar is come up into Mine ears, Therefore will I put My hook in thy nose, And My bridle in thy lips, And I will turn thee back by the way By which thou camest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֣ הָא֔וֹת אָכ֤וֹל הַשָּׁנָה֙ סָפִ֔יחַ וּבַשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית שָׁחִ֑יס וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗ית זִרְע֧וּ וְקִצְר֛וּ וְנִטְע֥וּ כְרָמִ֖ים (ואכול) [וְאִכְל֥וּ] פִרְיָֽם׃
verses.translit: vzhlkh h'vt 'khvl hshnh spych vbshnh hshnyt shchys vbshnh hshlyshyt zr'v vqtsrv vnt'v khrmym (v'khvl) [v'khlv] prym
verses.translation: And this shall be the sign unto thee: ye shall eat this year that which groweth of itself, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָ֨סְפָ֜ה פְּלֵיטַ֧ת בֵּית־יְהוּדָ֛ה הַנִּשְׁאָרָ֖ה שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ לְמָ֑טָּה וְעָשָׂ֥ה פְרִ֖י לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: vysph plytt bytyhvdh hnsh'rh shrsh lmth v'shh pry lm'lh
verses.translation: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ תֵּצֵ֣א שְׁאֵרִ֔ית וּפְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵהַ֣ר צִיּ֑וֹן קִנְאַ֛ת יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּֽאת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy myrvshl͏m tts' sh'ryt vplyth mhr tsyvn qn't yhvh tsb'vt t'shhz't {s}
verses.translation: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and out of mount Zion they that shall escape; the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall perform this.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לֹ֤א יָבוֹא֙ אֶל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְלֹא־יוֹרֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם חֵ֑ץ וְלֹֽא־יְקַדְּמֶ֣נָּה מָגֵ֔ן וְלֹֽא־יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ עָלֶ֖יהָ סֹלְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'lmlkh 'shvr l' ybv' 'lh'yr hz't vl'yvrh shm chts vl'yqdmnh mgn vl'yshpkh 'lyh sllh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not come unto this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither shall he come before it with shield, nor cast a mound against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֖א בָּ֣הּ יָשׁ֑וּב וְאֶל־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bdrkh 'shrb' bh yshvb v'lh'yr hz't l' ybv' n'myhvh
verses.translation: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and he shall not come unto this city, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַנּוֹתִ֛י עַל־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את לְהֽוֹשִׁיעָ֑הּ לְמַֽעֲנִ֔י וּלְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vgnvty 'lh'yr hz't lhvshy'h lm'ny vlm'n dvd 'bdy {s}
verses.translation: For I will defend this city to save it, for Mine own sake, and for My servant David’s sake.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א  מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֗ה וַיַּכֶּה֙ בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה אַשּׁ֔וּר מֵאָ֛ה וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהִנֵּ֥ה כֻלָּ֖ם פְּגָרִ֥ים מֵתִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyts'  ml'kh yhvh vykhh bmchnh 'shvr m'h vshmnym vchmshh 'lf vyshkhymv bbqr vhnh khlm pgrym mtym
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand; and when men arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֣ע וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֖שׇׁב סַנְחֵרִ֣יב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּנִֽינְוֵֽה׃
verses.translit: vys' vylkh vyshb snchryb mlkh'shvr vyshb bnynvh
verses.translation: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went, and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ ה֨וּא מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֜ה בֵּ֣ית  נִסְרֹ֣ךְ אֱלֹהָ֗יו וְֽאַדְרַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וְשַׂרְאֶ֤צֶר בָּנָיו֙ הִכֻּ֣הוּ בַחֶ֔רֶב וְהֵ֥מָּה נִמְלְט֖וּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֲרָרָ֑ט וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֵסַר־חַדֹּ֥ן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy hv' mshtchvh byt  nsrkh 'lhyv v'drmlkh vshr'tsr bnyv hkhhv bchrb vhmh nmltv 'rts 'rrt vymlkh 'srchdn bnv tchtyv {s}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sarezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לָמ֑וּת וַיָּב֣וֹא אֵ֠לָ֠יו יְשַֽׁעְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־אָמ֜וֹץ הַנָּבִ֗יא וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ צַ֣ו לְבֵיתֶ֔ךָ כִּ֛י מֵ֥ת אַתָּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: bymym hhm chlh chzqyhv lmvt vybv' 'lyv ysh'yhv bn'mvts hnby' vy'mr 'lyv khh'mr yhvh tsv lbytkh khy mt 'th vl' tchyh
verses.translation: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Set thy house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּסֵּ֧ב חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ פָּנָ֖יו אֶל־הַקִּ֑יר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vysb chzqyhv pnyv 'lhqyr vytpll 'lyhvh
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר אָנָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ זְכׇר־נָ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְפָנֶ֗יךָ בֶּֽאֱמֶת֙ וּבְלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם וְהַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'nh yhvh zkhrn' 't 'shr hthlkhty lpnykh b'mt vblb shlm vhtvb b'ynykh 'shyty vybkh chzqyhv bkhy gdvl {s}
verses.translation: and said: ‘Remember now, O LORD, I beseech Thee, how I have walked before Thee in truth and with a whole heart, and have done that which is good in Thy sight.’ And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶֽל־יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'lysh'yhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָל֞וֹךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔יךָ שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֶ֔ךָ רָאִ֖יתִי אֶת־דִּמְעָתֶ֑ךָ הִנְנִי֙ יוֹסִ֣ף עַל־יָמֶ֔יךָ חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: hlvkh v'mrt 'lchzqyhv khh'mr yhvh 'lhy dvd 'bykh shm'ty 'ttpltkh r'yty 'tdm'tkh hnny yvsf 'lymykh chmsh 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: ’Go, and say to Hezekiah: Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears; behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִכַּ֤ף מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר֙ אַצִּ֣ילְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְגַנּוֹתִ֖י עַל־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vmkhf mlkh'shvr 'tsylkh v't h'yr hz't vgnvty 'lh'yr hz't
verses.translation: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֥ הָא֖וֹת מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vzhlkh h'vt m't yhvh 'shr y'shh yhvh 'thdbr hzh 'shr dbr
verses.translation: And this shall be the sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that He hath spoken:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מֵשִׁ֣יב אֶת־צֵ֣ל הַֽמַּעֲל֡וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדָה֩ בְמַעֲל֨וֹת אָחָ֥ז בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ אֲחֹרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֑וֹת וַתָּ֤שׇׁב הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֔וֹת בַּֽמַּעֲל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרָֽדָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnny mshyb 'ttsl hm'lvt 'shr yrdh bm'lvt 'chz bshmsh 'chrnyt 'shr m'lvt vtshb hshmsh 'shr m'lvt bm'lvt 'shr yrdh {s}
verses.translation: behold, I will cause the shadow of the dial, which is gone down on the sun-dial of Ahaz, to return backward ten degrees.’ So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכְתָּ֖ב לְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה בַּחֲלֹת֕וֹ וַיְחִ֖י מֵחׇלְיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mkhtb lchzqyhv mlkhyhvdh bchltv vychy mchlyv
verses.translation: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי בִּדְמִ֥י יָמַ֛י אֵלֵ֖כָה בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֣י שְׁא֑וֹל פֻּקַּ֖דְתִּי יֶ֥תֶר שְׁנוֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ny 'mrty bdmy ymy 'lkhh bsh'ry sh'vl pqdty ytr shnvty
verses.translation: I said: In the noontide of my days I shall go, even to the gates of the nether-world; I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לֹא־אֶרְאֶ֣ה יָ֔הּ יָ֖הּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַחַיִּ֑ים לֹא־אַבִּ֥יט אָדָ֛ם ע֖וֹד עִם־י֥וֹשְׁבֵי חָֽדֶל׃
verses.translit: 'mrty l''r'h yh yh b'rts hchyym l''byt 'dm 'vd 'myvshby chdl
verses.translation: I said: I shall not see the LORD, even the LORD in the land of the living; I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דּוֹרִ֗י נִסַּ֧ע וְנִגְלָ֛ה מִנִּ֖י כְּאֹ֣הֶל רֹעִ֑י קִפַּ֨דְתִּי כָאֹרֵ֤ג חַיַּי֙ מִדַּלָּ֣ה יְבַצְּעֵ֔נִי מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: dvry ns' vnglh mny kh'hl r'y qpdty kh'rg chyy mdlh ybts'ny myvm 'dlylh tshlymny
verses.translation: My habitation is plucked up and carried away from me as a shepherd’s tent; I have rolled up like a weaver my life; He will cut me off from the thrum; from day even to night wilt Thou make an end of me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁוִּ֤יתִי עַד־בֹּ֙קֶר֙ כָּאֲרִ֔י כֵּ֥ן יְשַׁבֵּ֖ר כׇּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑י מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shvyty 'dbqr kh'ry khn yshbr khl'tsmvty myvm 'dlylh tshlymny
verses.translation: The more I make myself like unto a lion until morning, the more it breaketh all my bones; from day even to night wilt Thou make an end of me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּס֤וּס עָגוּר֙ כֵּ֣ן אֲצַפְצֵ֔ף אֶהְגֶּ֖ה כַּיּוֹנָ֑ה דַּלּ֤וּ עֵינַי֙ לַמָּר֔וֹם אֲדֹנָ֖י עָֽשְׁקָה־לִּ֥י עׇרְבֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khsvs 'gvr khn 'tsptsf 'hgh khyvnh dlv 'yny lmrvm 'dny 'shqhly 'rbny
verses.translation: Like a swallow or a crane, so do I chatter, I do moan as a dove; mine eyes fail with looking upward. O LORD, I am oppressed, be Thou my surety. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָֽה־אֲדַבֵּ֥ר וְאָֽמַר־לִ֖י וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑ה אֶדַּדֶּ֥ה כׇל־שְׁנוֹתַ֖י עַל־מַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: mh'dbr v'mrly vhv' 'shh 'ddh khlshnvty 'lmr npshy
verses.translation: What shall I say? He hath both spoken unto me, and Himself hath done it; I shall go softly all my years for the bitterness of my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִֽחְי֑וּ וּלְכׇל־בָּהֶן֙ חַיֵּ֣י רוּחִ֔י וְתַחֲלִימֵ֖נִי וְהַחֲיֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'dny 'lyhm ychyv vlkhlbhn chyy rvchy vtchlymny vhchyny
verses.translation: O Lord, by these things men live, and altogether therein is the life of my spirit; wherefore recover Thou me, and make me to live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לְשָׁל֖וֹם מַר־לִ֣י מָ֑ר וְאַתָּ֞ה חָשַׁ֤קְתָּ נַפְשִׁי֙ מִשַּׁ֣חַת בְּלִ֔י כִּ֥י הִשְׁלַ֛כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גֵוְךָ֖ כׇּל־חֲטָאָֽי׃
verses.translit: hnh lshlvm mrly mr v'th chshqt npshy mshcht bly khy hshlkht 'chry gvkh khlcht'y
verses.translation: Behold, for my peace I had great bitterness; But Thou hast in love to my soul delivered it From the pit of corruption; For Thou hast cast all my sins behind Thy back.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א שְׁא֛וֹל תּוֹדֶ֖ךָּ מָ֣וֶת יְהַלְלֶ֑ךָּ לֹא־יְשַׂבְּר֥וּ יוֹרְדֵי־ב֖וֹר אֶל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khy l' sh'vl tvdkh mvt yhllkh l'yshbrv yvrdybvr 'l'mtkh
verses.translation: For the nether-world cannot praise Thee, Death cannot celebrate Thee; They that go down into the pit cannot hope for Thy truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַ֥י חַ֛י ה֥וּא יוֹדֶ֖ךָ כָּמ֣וֹנִי הַיּ֑וֹם אָ֣ב לְבָנִ֔ים יוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: chy chy hv' yvdkh khmvny hyvm 'b lbnym yvdy' 'l'mtkh
verses.translation: The living, the living, he shall praise Thee, As I do this day; The father to the children shall make known Thy truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּנְגִנוֹתַ֧י נְנַגֵּ֛ן כׇּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּ֖ינוּ עַל־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh lhvshy'ny vngnvty nngn khlymy chyynv 'lbyt yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD is ready to save me; Therefore we will sing songs to the stringed instruments All the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ יִשְׂא֖וּ דְּבֶ֣לֶת תְּאֵנִ֑ים וְיִמְרְח֥וּ עַֽל־הַשְּׁחִ֖ין וְיֶֽחִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ysh'yhv ysh'v dblt t'nym vymrchv 'lhshchyn vychy
verses.translation: And Isaiah said: ‘Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a plaster upon the boil, and he shall recover.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מָ֣ה א֑וֹת כִּ֥י אֶעֱלֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr chzqyhv mh 'vt khy ''lh byt yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And Hezekiah said. 'What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֡יא שָׁלַ֡ח מְרֹדַ֣ךְ בַּ֠לְאֲדָ֠ן בֶּֽן־בַּלְאֲדָ֧ן מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל סְפָרִ֥ים וּמִנְחָ֖ה אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע כִּ֥י חָלָ֖ה וַֽיֶּחֱזָֽק׃
verses.translit: b't hhy' shlch mrdkh bl'dn bnbl'dn mlkhbbl sprym vmnchh 'lchzqyhv vyshm' khy chlh vychzq
verses.translation: At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent a letter and a present to Hezekiah; for he heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמַ֣ח עֲלֵיהֶם֮ חִזְקִיָּ֒הוּ֒ וַיַּרְאֵ֣ם אֶת־בֵּ֣ית נְכֹתֹ֡ה אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף֩ וְאֶת־הַזָּהָ֨ב וְאֶת־הַבְּשָׂמִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת  הַשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַטּ֗וֹב וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־בֵּ֣ית כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִמְצָ֖א בְּאֹצְרֹתָ֑יו לֹא־הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹֽא־הֶרְאָ֧ם חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּבֵית֖וֹ וּבְכׇל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshmch 'lyhm chzqyhv vyr'm 'tbyt nkhth 'thkhsf v'thzhb v'thbshmym v't  hshmn htvb v't khlbyt khlyv v't khl'shr nmts' b'tsrtyv l'hyh dbr 'shr l'hr'm chzqyhv bbytv vbkhlmmshltv {s}
verses.translation: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and showed them his treasure-house, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures; there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah showed them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו מָ֥ה אָמְר֣וּ  הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּמֵאַ֙יִן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ מֵאֶ֧רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֛ה בָּ֥אוּ אֵלַ֖י מִבָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vyb' ysh'yhv hnby' 'lhmlkh chzqyhv vy'mr 'lyv mh 'mrv  h'nshym h'lh vm'yn yb'v 'lykh vy'mr chzqyhv m'rts rchvqh b'v 'ly mbbl
verses.translation: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him: ‘What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee?’ And Hezekiah said: ‘They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֥ה רָא֖וּ בְּבֵיתֶ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּבֵיתִי֙ רָא֔וּ לֹא־הָיָ֥ה דָבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הִרְאִיתִ֖ים בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mh r'v bbytkh vy'mr chzqyhv 't khl'shr bbyty r'v l'hyh dbr 'shr l'hr'ytym b'vtsrty
verses.translation: Then said he: ‘What have they seen in thy house?’ And Hezekiah answered: ‘All that is in my house have they seen; there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ysh'yhv 'lchzqyhv shm' dbryhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah: ‘Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֮ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִים֒ וְנִשָּׂ֣א  כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּבֵיתֶ֗ךָ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר אָצְר֧וּ אֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ עַד־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה בָּבֶ֑ל לֹֽא־יִוָּתֵ֥ר דָּבָ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym vnsh'  khl'shr bbytkh v'shr 'tsrv 'btykh 'dhyvm hzh bbl l'yvtr dbr 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thy house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon; nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִבָּנֶ֜יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצְא֧וּ מִמְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹלִ֖יד יִקָּ֑חוּ וְהָיוּ֙ סָרִיסִ֔ים בְּהֵיכַ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vmbnykh 'shr yts'v mmkh 'shr tvlyd yqchv vhyv srysym bhykhl mlkh bbl
verses.translation: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, whom thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be officers in the palace of the king of Babylon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶֽל־יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ ט֥וֹב דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י יִהְיֶ֛ה שָׁל֥וֹם וֶאֱמֶ֖ת בְּיָמָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr chzqyhv 'lysh'yhv tvb dbryhvh 'shr dbrt vy'mr khy yhyh shlvm v'mt bymy {p}
verses.translation: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah: ‘Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken.’ He said moreover: ‘If but there shall be peace and truth in my days.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַחֲמ֥וּ נַחֲמ֖וּ עַמִּ֑י יֹאמַ֖ר אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: nchmv nchmv 'my y'mr 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Comfort ye, comfort ye My people, saith your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבְּר֞וּ עַל־לֵ֤ב יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ וְקִרְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֤י מָֽלְאָה֙ צְבָאָ֔הּ כִּ֥י נִרְצָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּ֤י לָֽקְחָה֙ מִיַּ֣ד יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּפְלַ֖יִם בְּכׇל־חַטֹּאתֶֽיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: dbrv 'llb yrvshl͏m vqr'v 'lyh khy ml'h tsb'h khy nrtsh 'vnh khy lqchh myd yhvh khplym bkhlcht'tyh {s}
verses.translation: Bid Jerusalem take heart, and proclaim unto her, that her time of service is accomplished, that her guilt is paid off; that she hath received of the LORD’S hand double for all her sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וֹל קוֹרֵ֔א בַּמִּדְבָּ֕ר פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה יַשְּׁרוּ֙ בָּעֲרָבָ֔ה מְסִלָּ֖ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: qvl qvr' bmdbr pnv drkh yhvh yshrv b'rbh mslh l'lhynv
verses.translation: Hark! one calleth: ‘Clear ye in the wilderness the way of the LORD, make plain in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־גֶּיא֙ יִנָּשֵׂ֔א וְכׇל־הַ֥ר וְגִבְעָ֖ה יִשְׁפָּ֑לוּ וְהָיָ֤ה הֶֽעָקֹב֙ לְמִישׁ֔וֹר וְהָרְכָסִ֖ים לְבִקְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: khlgy' ynsh' vkhlhr vgb'h yshplv vhyh h'qb lmyshvr vhrkhsym lbq'h
verses.translation: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill shall be made low; and the rugged shall be made level, and the rough places a plain;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִגְלָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֑ה וְרָא֤וּ כׇל־בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnglh khbvd yhvh vr'v khlbshr ychdv khy py yhvh dbr {p}
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֚וֹל אֹמֵ֣ר קְרָ֔א וְאָמַ֖ר מָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א כׇּל־הַבָּשָׂ֣ר חָצִ֔יר וְכׇל־חַסְדּ֖וֹ כְּצִ֥יץ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: qvl 'mr qr' v'mr mh 'qr' khlhbshr chtsyr vkhlchsdv khtsyts hshdh
verses.translation: Hark! one saith: ‘Proclaim!’ And he saith: ‘What shall I proclaim?’ ’All flesh is grass, And all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ נָ֣בֵֽל־צִ֔יץ כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יְהֹוָ֖ה נָ֣שְׁבָה בּ֑וֹ אָכֵ֥ן חָצִ֖יר הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: ybsh chtsyr nbltsyts khy rvch yhvh nshbh bv 'khn chtsyr h'm
verses.translation: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; Because the breath of the LORD bloweth upon it— Surely the people is grass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָבֵ֥שׁ חָצִ֖יר נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֑יץ וּדְבַר־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יָק֥וּם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ybsh chtsyr nbl tsyts vdbr'lhynv yqvm l'vlm {s}
verses.translation: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; But the word of our God shall stand for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣ל הַר־גָּבֹ֤הַּ עֲלִי־לָךְ֙ מְבַשֶּׂ֣רֶת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֤ימִי בַכֹּ֙חַ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ מְבַשֶּׂ֖רֶת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם הָרִ֙ימִי֙ אַל־תִּירָ֔אִי אִמְרִי֙ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'l hrgbh 'lylkh mbshrt tsyvn hrymy bkhch qvlkh mbshrt yrvshl͏m hrymy 'ltyr'y 'mry l'ry yhvdh hnh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: O thou that tellest good tidings to Zion, Get thee up into the high mountain; O thou that tellest good tidings to Jerusalem, Lift up thy voice with strength; Lift it up, be not afraid; Say unto the cities of Judah: ‘Behold your God! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ בְּחָזָ֣ק יָב֔וֹא וּזְרֹע֖וֹ מֹ֣שְׁלָה ל֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hnh 'dny yhvh bchzq ybv' vzr'v mshlh lv hnh shkhrv 'tv vp'ltv lpnyv
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a Mighty One, And His arm will rule for Him; Behold, His reward is with Him, And His recompense before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה בִּזְרֹעוֹ֙ יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים וּבְחֵיק֖וֹ יִשָּׂ֑א עָל֖וֹת יְנַהֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khr'h 'drv yr'h bzr'v yqbts tl'ym vbchyqv ysh' 'lvt ynhl {s}
verses.translation: Even as a shepherd that feedeth his flock, That gathereth the lambs in his arm, And carrieth them in his bosom, And gently leadeth those that give suck.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־מָדַ֨ד בְּשׇׁעֳל֜וֹ מַ֗יִם וְשָׁמַ֙יִם֙ בַּזֶּ֣רֶת תִּכֵּ֔ן וְכָ֥ל בַּשָּׁלִ֖שׁ עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁקַ֤ל בַּפֶּ֙לֶס֙ הָרִ֔ים וּגְבָע֖וֹת בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: mymdd bsh'lv mym vshmym bzrt tkhn vkhl bshlsh 'pr h'rts vshql bpls hrym vgb'vt bm'znym
verses.translation: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, And meted out heaven with the span, And comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, And weighed the mountains in scales, And the hills in a balance?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־תִכֵּ֥ן אֶת־ר֖וּחַ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ עֲצָת֥וֹ יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: mytkhn 'trvch yhvh v'ysh 'tstv yvdy'nv
verses.translation: Who hath meted out the spirit of the LORD? Or who was His counsellor that he might instruct Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־מִ֤י נוֹעָץ֙ וַיְבִינֵ֔הוּ וַֽיְלַמְּדֵ֖הוּ בְּאֹ֣רַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וַיְלַמְּדֵ֣הוּ דַ֔עַת וְדֶ֥רֶךְ תְּבוּנ֖וֹת יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'tmy nv'ts vybynhv vylmdhv b'rch mshpt vylmdhv d't vdrkh tbvnvt yvdy'nv
verses.translation: With whom took He counsel, and who instructed Him, And taught Him in the path of right, And taught Him knowledge, And made Him to know the way of discernment?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן גּוֹיִם֙ כְּמַ֣ר מִדְּלִ֔י וּכְשַׁ֥חַק מֹאזְנַ֖יִם נֶחְשָׁ֑בוּ הֵ֥ן אִיִּ֖ים כַּדַּ֥ק יִטּֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: hn gvym khmr mdly vkhshchq m'znym nchshbv hn 'yym khdq ytvl
verses.translation: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, And are counted as the small dust of the balance; Behold the isles are as a mote in weight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְבָנ֕וֹן אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י בָּעֵ֑ר וְחַ֨יָּת֔וֹ אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י עוֹלָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlbnvn 'yn dy b'r vchytv 'yn dy 'vlh {p}
verses.translation: And Lebanon is not sufficient fuel, Nor the beasts thereof sufficient for burnt-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם כְּאַ֣יִן נֶגְדּ֑וֹ מֵאֶ֥פֶס וָתֹ֖הוּ נֶחְשְׁבוּ־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khlhgvym kh'yn ngdv m'ps vthv nchshbvlv
verses.translation: All the nations are as nothing before Him; They are accounted by Him as things of nought, and vanity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וּמַה־דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'lmy tdmyvn 'l vmhdmvt t'rkhv lv
verses.translation: To whom then will ye liken God? Or what likeness will ye compare unto Him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַפֶּ֙סֶל֙ נָסַ֣ךְ חָרָ֔שׁ וְצֹרֵ֖ף בַּזָּהָ֣ב יְרַקְּעֶ֑נּוּ וּרְתֻק֥וֹת כֶּ֖סֶף צוֹרֵֽף׃
verses.translit: hpsl nskh chrsh vtsrf bzhb yrq'nv vrtqvt khsf tsvrf
verses.translation: The image perchance, which the craftsman hath melted, And the goldsmith spread over with gold, The silversmith casting silver chains?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְסֻכָּ֣ן תְּרוּמָ֔ה עֵ֥ץ לֹא־יִרְקַ֖ב יִבְחָ֑ר חָרָ֤שׁ חָכָם֙ יְבַקֶּשׁ־ל֔וֹ לְהָכִ֥ין פֶּ֖סֶל לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hmskhn trvmh 'ts l'yrqb ybchr chrsh chkhm ybqshlv lhkhyn psl l' ymvt {s}
verses.translation: A holm-oak is set apart, He chooseth a tree that will not rot; He seeketh unto him a cunning craftsman To set up an image, that shall not be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא תֵֽדְעוּ֙ הֲל֣וֹא תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הֲל֛וֹא הֻגַּ֥ד מֵרֹ֖אשׁ לָכֶ֑ם הֲלוֹא֙ הֲבִ֣ינוֹתֶ֔ם מוֹסְד֖וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hlv' td'v hlv' tshm'v hlv' hgd mr'sh lkhm hlv' hbynvtm mvsdvt h'rts
verses.translation: Know ye not? hear ye not? Hath it not been told you from the beginning? Have ye not understood the foundations of the earth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַל־ח֣וּג הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כַּחֲגָבִ֑ים הַנּוֹטֶ֤ה כַדֹּק֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּמְתָּחֵ֥ם כָּאֹ֖הֶל לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.translit: hyshb 'lchvg h'rts vyshbyh khchgbym hnvth khdq shmym vymtchm kh'hl lshbt
verses.translation: It is He that sitteth above the circle of the earth, And the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; That stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, And spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן רוֹזְנִ֖ים לְאָ֑יִן שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אֶ֖רֶץ כַּתֹּ֥הוּ עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: hnvtn rvznym l'yn shpty 'rts khthv 'shh
verses.translation: That bringeth princes to nothing; He maketh the judges of the earth as a thing of nought.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ף בַּל־נִטָּ֗עוּ אַ֚ף בַּל־זֹרָ֔עוּ אַ֛ף בַּל־שֹׁרֵ֥שׁ בָּאָ֖רֶץ גִּזְעָ֑ם וְגַם־נָשַׁ֤ף בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּבָ֔שׁוּ וּסְעָרָ֖ה כַּקַּ֥שׁ תִּשָּׂאֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'f blnt'v 'f blzr'v 'f blshrsh b'rts gz'm vgmnshf bhm vybshv vs'rh khqsh tsh'm {s}
verses.translation: Scarce are they planted, Scarce are they sown, Scarce hath their stock taken root in the earth; When He bloweth upon them, they wither, And the whirlwind taketh them away as stubble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'lmy tdmyvny v'shvh y'mr qdvsh
verses.translation: To whom then will ye liken Me, that I should be equal? Saith the Holy One.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־מָר֨וֹם עֵינֵיכֶ֤ם וּרְאוּ֙ מִֽי־בָרָ֣א אֵ֔לֶּה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא בְמִסְפָּ֖ר צְבָאָ֑ם לְכֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִקְרָ֔א מֵרֹ֤ב אוֹנִים֙ וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֔חַ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א נֶעְדָּֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: sh'vmrvm 'ynykhm vr'v mybr' 'lh hmvtsy' bmspr tsb'm lkhlm bshm yqr' mrb 'vnym v'myts khch 'ysh l' n'dr {s}
verses.translation: Lift up your eyes on high, And see: who hath created these? He that bringeth out their host by number, He calleth them all by name; By the greatness of His might, and for that He is strong in power, Not one faileth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תֹאמַר֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּתְדַבֵּ֖ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִסְתְּרָ֤ה דַרְכִּי֙ מֵיְהֹוָ֔ה וּמֵאֱלֹהַ֖י מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: lmh t'mr y'qb vtdbr yshr'l nstrh drkhy myhvh vm'lhy mshpty y'bvr
verses.translation: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel: ‘My way is hid from the LORD, and my right is passed over from my God’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא יָדַ֜עְתָּ אִם־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֱלֹהֵ֨י עוֹלָ֤ם ׀ יְהֹוָה֙ בּוֹרֵא֙ קְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִיעַ֖ף וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֑ע אֵ֥ין חֵ֖קֶר לִתְבוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hlv' yd't 'ml' shm't 'lhy 'vlm  yhvh bvr' qtsvt h'rts l' yy'f vl' yyg' 'yn chqr ltbvntv
verses.translation: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard That the everlasting God, the LORD, The Creator of the ends of the earth, Fainteth not, neither is weary? His discernment is past searching out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֹתֵ֥ן לַיָּעֵ֖ף כֹּ֑חַ וּלְאֵ֥ין אוֹנִ֖ים עׇצְמָ֥ה יַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: ntn ly'f khch vl'yn 'vnym 'tsmh yrbh
verses.translation: He giveth power to the faint; And to him that hath no might He increaseth strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִעֲפ֥וּ נְעָרִ֖ים וְיִגָ֑עוּ וּבַחוּרִ֖ים כָּשׁ֥וֹל יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'pv n'rym vyg'v vbchvrym khshvl ykhshlv
verses.translation: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, And the young men shall utterly fall;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקוֹיֵ֤ יְהֹוָה֙ יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֔חַ יַעֲל֥וּ אֵ֖בֶר כַּנְּשָׁרִ֑ים יָר֙וּצוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֔עוּ יֵלְכ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א יִיעָֽפוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vqvy yhvh ychlypv khch y'lv 'br khnshrym yrvtsv vl' yyg'v ylkhv vl' yy'pv {s}
verses.translation: But they that wait for the LORD shall renew their strength; They shall mount up with wings as eagles; They shall run, and not be weary; They shall walk, and not faint.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֲרִ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַי֙ אִיִּ֔ים וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֑חַ יִגְּשׁוּ֙ אָ֣ז יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ יַחְדָּ֖ו לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט נִקְרָֽבָה׃
verses.translit: hchryshv 'ly 'yym vl'mym ychlypv khch ygshv 'z ydbrv ychdv lmshpt nqrbh
verses.translation: Keep silence before Me, O islands, And let the peoples renew their strength; Let them draw near, then let them speak; Let us come near together to judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י הֵעִיר֙ מִמִּזְרָ֔ח צֶ֖דֶק יִקְרָאֵ֣הוּ לְרַגְל֑וֹ יִתֵּ֨ן לְפָנָ֤יו גּוֹיִם֙ וּמְלָכִ֣ים יַ֔רְדְּ יִתֵּ֤ן כֶּֽעָפָר֙ חַרְבּ֔וֹ כְּקַ֥שׁ נִדָּ֖ף קַשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: my h'yr mmzrch tsdq yqr'hv lrglv ytn lpnyv gvym vmlkhym yrd ytn kh'pr chrbv khqsh ndf qshtv
verses.translation: Who hath raised up one from the east, At whose steps victory attendeth? He giveth nations before him, And maketh him rule over kings; His sword maketh them as the dust, His bow as the driven stubble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְדְּפֵ֖ם יַעֲב֣וֹר שָׁל֑וֹם אֹ֥רַח בְּרַגְלָ֖יו לֹ֥א יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: yrdpm y'bvr shlvm 'rch brglyv l' ybv'
verses.translation: He pursueth them, and passeth on safely; The way with his feet he treadeth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־פָעַ֣ל וְעָשָׂ֔ה קֹרֵ֥א הַדֹּר֖וֹת מֵרֹ֑אשׁ אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ רִאשׁ֔וֹן וְאֶת־אַחֲרֹנִ֖ים אֲנִי־הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: myp'l v'shh qr' hdrvt mr'sh 'ny yhvh r'shvn v't'chrnym 'nyhv'
verses.translation: Who hath wrought and done it? He that called the generations from the beginning. I, the LORD, who am the first, And with the last am the same.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָא֤וּ אִיִּים֙ וְיִרָ֔אוּ קְצ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ קָרְב֖וּ וַיֶּאֱתָיֽוּן׃
verses.translit: r'v 'yym vyr'v qtsvt h'rts ychrdv qrbv vy'tyvn
verses.translation: The isles saw, and feared; The ends of the earth trembled; They drew near, and came.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֖הוּ יַעְזֹ֑רוּ וּלְאָחִ֖יו יֹאמַ֥ר חֲזָֽק׃
verses.translit: 'ysh 'tr'hv y'zrv vl'chyv y'mr chzq
verses.translation: They helped every one his neighbour; And every one said to his brother: ‘Be of good courage.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֤ק חָרָשׁ֙ אֶת־צֹרֵ֔ף מַחֲלִ֥יק פַּטִּ֖ישׁ אֶת־ה֣וֹלֶם פָּ֑עַם אֹמֵ֤ר לַדֶּ֙בֶק֙ ט֣וֹב ה֔וּא וַיְחַזְּקֵ֥הוּ בְמַסְמְרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychzq chrsh 'ttsrf mchlyq ptysh 'thvlm p'm 'mr ldbq tvb hv' vychzqhv bmsmrym l' ymvt {s}
verses.translation: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, And he that smootheth with the hammer him that smiteth the anvil, Saying of the soldering: ‘It is good’; And he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדִּ֔י יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּחַרְתִּ֑יךָ זֶ֖רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹהֲבִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th yshr'l 'bdy y'qb 'shr bchrtykh zr' 'brhm 'hby
verses.translation: But thou, Israel, My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, The seed of Abraham My friend;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶחֱזַקְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִקְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵאֲצִילֶ֖יהָ קְרָאתִ֑יךָ וָאֹ֤מַר לְךָ֙ עַבְדִּי־אַ֔תָּה בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֥א מְאַסְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'shr hchzqtykh mqtsvt h'rts vm'tsylyh qr'tykh v'mr lkh 'bdy'th bchrtykh vl' m'stykh
verses.translation: Thou whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, And called thee from the uttermost parts thereof, And said unto thee: ‘Thou art My servant, I have chosen thee and not cast thee away’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י עִמְּךָ־אָ֔נִי אַל־תִּשְׁתָּ֖ע כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אִמַּצְתִּ֙יךָ֙ אַף־עֲזַרְתִּ֔יךָ אַף־תְּמַכְתִּ֖יךָ בִּימִ֥ין צִדְקִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ltyr' khy 'mkh'ny 'ltsht' khy'ny 'lhykh 'mtstykh 'f'zrtykh 'ftmkhtykh bymyn tsdqy
verses.translation: Fear thou not, for I am with thee, Be not dismayed, for I am thy God; I strengthen thee, yea, I help thee; Yea, I uphold thee with My victorious right hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יֵבֹ֙שׁוּ֙ וְיִכָּ֣לְמ֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ יִהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וְיֹאבְד֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י רִיבֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hn ybshv vykhlmv khl hnchrym bkh yhyv kh'yn vy'bdv 'nshy rybkh
verses.translation: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee Shall be ashamed and confounded; They that strove with thee Shall be as nothing, and shall perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּבַקְשֵׁם֙ וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָאֵ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֖י מַצֻּתֶ֑ךָ יִהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וּכְאֶ֖פֶס אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחַמְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: tbqshm vl' tmts'm 'nshy mtstkh yhyv kh'yn vkh'ps 'nshy mlchmtkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, Even them that contended with thee; They that warred against thee Shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מַחֲזִ֣יק יְמִינֶ֑ךָ הָאֹמֵ֥ר לְךָ֛ אַל־תִּירָ֖א אֲנִ֥י עֲזַרְתִּֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykh mchzyq ymynkh h'mr lkh 'ltyr' 'ny 'zrtykh {s}
verses.translation: For I the LORD thy God Hold thy right hand, Who say unto thee: ‘Fear not, I help thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּֽירְאִי֙ תּוֹלַ֣עַת יַעֲקֹ֔ב מְתֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עֲזַרְתִּיךְ֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'ltyr'y tvl't y'qb mty yshr'l 'ny 'zrtykh n'myhvh vg'lkh qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, And ye men of Israel; I help thee, saith the LORD, And thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה שַׂמְתִּ֗יךְ לְמוֹרַג֙ חָר֣וּץ חָדָ֔שׁ בַּ֖עַל פִּיפִיּ֑וֹת תָּד֤וּשׁ הָרִים֙ וְתָדֹ֔ק וּגְבָע֖וֹת כַּמֹּ֥ץ תָּשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: hnh shmtykh lmvrg chrvts chdsh b'l pypyvt tdvsh hrym vtdq vgb'vt khmts tshym
verses.translation: Behold, I make thee a new threshing-sledge Having sharp teeth; Thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, And shalt make the hills as chaff.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּזְרֵם֙ וְר֣וּחַ תִּשָּׂאֵ֔ם וּסְעָרָ֖ה תָּפִ֣יץ אוֹתָ֑ם וְאַתָּה֙ תָּגִ֣יל בַּֽיהֹוָ֔ה בִּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּתְהַלָּֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: tzrm vrvch tsh'm vs'rh tpyts 'vtm v'th tgyl byhvh bqdvsh yshr'l tthll {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, And the whirlwind shall scatter them; And thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, Thou shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָעֲנִיִּ֨ים וְהָאֶבְיוֹנִ֜ים מְבַקְשִׁ֥ים מַ֙יִם֙ וָאַ֔יִן לְשׁוֹנָ֖ם בַּצָּמָ֣א נָשָׁ֑תָּה אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֶעֱנֵ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֵֽם׃
verses.translit: h'nyym vh'byvnym mbqshym mym v'yn lshvnm btsm' nshth 'ny yhvh ''nm 'lhy yshr'l l' ''zbm
verses.translation: The poor and needy seek water and there is none, And their tongue faileth for thirst; I the LORD will answer them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְתַּ֤ח עַל־שְׁפָיִים֙ נְהָר֔וֹת וּבְת֥וֹךְ בְּקָע֖וֹת מַעְיָנ֑וֹת אָשִׂ֤ים מִדְבָּר֙ לַאֲגַם־מַ֔יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִיָּ֖ה לְמוֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'ptch 'lshpyym nhrvt vbtvkh bq'vt m'ynvt 'shym mdbr l'gmmym v'rts tsyh lmvts'y mym
verses.translation: I will open rivers on the high hills, And fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, And the dry land springs of water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶתֵּ֤ן בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אֶ֣רֶז שִׁטָּ֔ה וַהֲדַ֖ס וְעֵ֣ץ שָׁ֑מֶן אָשִׂ֣ים בָּעֲרָבָ֗ה בְּר֛וֹשׁ תִּדְהָ֥ר וּתְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: 'tn bmdbr 'rz shth vhds v'ts shmn 'shym b'rbh brvsh tdhr vt'shvr ychdv
verses.translation: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia-tree, And the myrtle, and the oil-tree; I will set in the desert the cypress, the plane-tree, and the larch together;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֧עַן יִרְא֣וּ וְיֵדְע֗וּ וְיָשִׂ֤ימוּ וְיַשְׂכִּ֙ילוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֥י יַד־יְהֹוָ֖ה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּ֑את וּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרָאָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n yr'v vyd'v vyshymv vyshkhylv ychdv khy ydyhvh 'shth z't vqdvsh yshr'l br'h {p}
verses.translation: That they may see, and know, And consider, and understand together, That the hand of the LORD hath done this, And the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרְב֥וּ רִֽיבְכֶ֖ם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה הַגִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ עֲצֻמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם יֹאמַ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: qrbv rybkhm y'mr yhvh hgyshv 'tsmvtykhm y'mr mlkh y'qb
verses.translation: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; Bring forth your reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַגִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔נוּ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְרֶ֑ינָה הָרִאשֹׁנ֣וֹת  מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה הַגִּ֜ידוּ וְנָשִׂ֤ימָה לִבֵּ֙נוּ֙ וְנֵדְעָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֔ן א֥וֹ הַבָּא֖וֹת הַשְׁמִיעֻֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: ygyshv vygydv lnv 't 'shr tqrynh hr'shnvt  mh hnh hgydv vnshymh lbnv vnd'h 'chrytn 'v hb'vt hshmy'nv
verses.translation: Let them bring them forth, and declare unto us The things that shall happen; The former things, what are they? Declare ye, that we may consider, And know the end of them; Or announce to us things to come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגִּ֙ידוּ֙ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת לְאָח֔וֹר וְנֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אַף־תֵּיטִ֣יבוּ וְתָרֵ֔עוּ וְנִשְׁתָּ֖עָה (ונרא) [וְנִרְאֶ֥ה] יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: hgydv h'tyvt l'chvr vnd'h khy 'lhym 'tm 'ftytybv vtr'v vnsht'h (vnr') [vnr'h] ychdv
verses.translation: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, That we may know that ye are gods; Yea, do good, or do evil, That we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן־אַתֶּ֣ם מֵאַ֔יִן וּפׇעׇלְכֶ֖ם מֵאָ֑פַע תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה יִבְחַ֥ר בָּכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hn'tm m'yn vp'lkhm m'p' tv'bh ybchr bkhm {p}
verses.translation: Behold, ye are nothing, And your work a thing of nought; An abomination is he that chooseth you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעִיר֤וֹתִי מִצָּפוֹן֙ וַיַּ֔את מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֑י וְיָבֹ֤א סְגָנִים֙ כְּמוֹ־חֹ֔מֶר וּכְמ֥וֹ יוֹצֵ֖ר יִרְמׇס־טִֽיט׃
verses.translit: h'yrvty mtspvn vy't mmzrchshmsh yqr' bshmy vyb' sgnym khmvchmr vkhmv yvtsr yrmstyt
verses.translation: I have roused up one from the north, and he is come, From the rising of the sun one that calleth upon My name; And he shall come upon rulers as upon mortar, And as the potter treadeth clay.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־הִגִּ֤יד מֵרֹאשׁ֙ וְנֵדָ֔עָה וּמִלְּפָנִ֖ים וְנֹאמַ֣ר צַדִּ֑יק אַ֣ף אֵין־מַגִּ֗יד אַ֚ף אֵ֣ין מַשְׁמִ֔יעַ אַ֥ף אֵין־שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: myhgyd mr'sh vnd'h vmlpnym vn'mr tsdyq 'f 'ynmgyd 'f 'yn mshmy' 'f 'ynshm' 'mrykhm
verses.translation: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? And beforetime, that we may say that he is right? Yea, there is none that declareth, Yea, there is none that announceth, Yea, there is none that heareth your utterances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רִאשׁ֥וֹן לְצִיּ֖וֹן הִנֵּ֣ה הִנָּ֑ם וְלִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר אֶתֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: r'shvn ltsyvn hnh hnm vlyrvshl͏m mbshr 'tn
verses.translation: A harbinger unto Zion will I give: ‘Behold, behold them’, And to Jerusalem a messenger of good tidings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙רֶא֙ וְאֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וּמֵאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֵ֣ין יוֹעֵ֑ץ וְאֶשְׁאָלֵ֖ם וְיָשִׁ֥יבוּ דָבָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'r' v'yn 'ysh vm'lh v'yn yv'ts v'sh'lm vyshybv dbr
verses.translation: And I look, but there is no man; Even among them, but there is no counsellor, That, when I ask of them, can give an answer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן כֻּלָּ֔ם אָ֥וֶן אֶ֖פֶס מַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם ר֥וּחַ וָתֹ֖הוּ נִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hn khlm 'vn 'ps m'shyhm rvch vthv nskhyhm {p}
verses.translation: Behold, all of them, Their works are vanity and nought; Their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן עַבְדִּי֙ אֶתְמׇךְ־בּ֔וֹ בְּחִירִ֖י רָצְתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י נָתַ֤תִּי רוּחִי֙ עָלָ֔יו מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לַגּוֹיִ֥ם יוֹצִֽיא׃
verses.translit: hn 'bdy 'tmkhbv bchyry rtsth npshy ntty rvchy 'lyv mshpt lgvym yvtsy'
verses.translation: Behold My servant, whom I uphold; Mine elect, in whom My soul delighteth; I have put My spirit upon him, He shall make the right to go forth to the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א יִצְעַ֖ק וְלֹ֣א יִשָּׂ֑א וְלֹא־יַשְׁמִ֥יעַ בַּח֖וּץ קוֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l' yts'q vl' ysh' vl'yshmy' bchvts qvlv
verses.translation: He shall not cry, nor lift up, Nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָנֶ֤ה רָצוּץ֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁבּ֔וֹר וּפִשְׁתָּ֥ה כֵהָ֖ה לֹ֣א יְכַבֶּ֑נָּה לֶאֱמֶ֖ת יוֹצִ֥יא מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: qnh rtsvts l' yshbvr vpshth khhh l' ykhbnh l'mt yvtsy' mshpt
verses.translation: A bruised reed shall he not break, And the dimly burning wick shall he not quench; He shall make the right to go forth according to the truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִכְהֶה֙ וְלֹ֣א יָר֔וּץ עַד־יָשִׂ֥ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּלְתוֹרָת֖וֹ אִיִּ֥ים יְיַחֵֽלוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l' ykhhh vl' yrvts 'dyshym b'rts mshpt vltvrtv 'yym yychlv {p}
verses.translation: He shall not fail nor be crushed, Till he have set the right in the earth; And the isles shall wait for his teaching.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר הָאֵ֣ל ׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה בּוֹרֵ֤א הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְנ֣וֹטֵיהֶ֔ם רֹקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ וְצֶאֱצָאֶ֑יהָ נֹתֵ֤ן נְשָׁמָה֙ לָעָ֣ם עָלֶ֔יהָ וְר֖וּחַ לַהֹלְכִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr h'l  yhvh bvr' hshmym vnvtyhm rq' h'rts vts'ts'yh ntn nshmh l'm 'lyh vrvch lhlkhym bh
verses.translation: Thus saith God the LORD, He that created the heavens, and stretched them forth, He that spread forth the earth and that which cometh out of it, He that giveth breath unto the people upon it, And spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה קְרָאתִ֥יךָֽ בְצֶ֖דֶק וְאַחְזֵ֣ק בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְאֶצׇּרְךָ֗ וְאֶתֶּנְךָ֛ לִבְרִ֥ית עָ֖ם לְא֥וֹר גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh qr'tykh btsdq v'chzq bydkh v'tsrkh v'tnkh lbryt 'm l'vr gvym
verses.translation: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, And have taken hold of thy hand, And kept thee, and set thee for a covenant of the people, For a light of the nations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִפְקֹ֖חַ עֵינַ֣יִם עִוְר֑וֹת לְהוֹצִ֤יא מִמַּסְגֵּר֙ אַסִּ֔יר מִבֵּ֥ית כֶּ֖לֶא יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: lpqch 'ynym 'vrvt lhvtsy' mmsgr 'syr mbyt khl' yshby chshkh
verses.translation: To open the blind eyes, To bring out the prisoners from the dungeon, And them that sit in darkness out of the prison-house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה ה֣וּא שְׁמִ֑י וּכְבוֹדִי֙ לְאַחֵ֣ר לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֔ן וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י לַפְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh hv' shmy vkhbvdy l'chr l''tn vthlty lpsylym
verses.translation: I am the LORD, that is My name; And My glory will I not give to another, Neither My praise to graven images.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הִנֵּה־בָ֑אוּ וַֽחֲדָשׁוֹת֙ אֲנִ֣י מַגִּ֔יד בְּטֶ֥רֶם תִּצְמַ֖חְנָה אַשְׁמִ֥יעַ אֶתְכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hr'shnvt hnhb'v vchdshvt 'ny mgyd btrm ttsmchnh 'shmy' 'tkhm {p}
verses.translation: Behold, the former things are come to pass, And new things do I declare; Before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֔שׁ תְּהִלָּת֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ יוֹרְדֵ֤י הַיָּם֙ וּמְלֹא֔וֹ אִיִּ֖ים וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh shyr chdsh thltv mqtsh h'rts yvrdy hym vml'v 'yym vyshbyhm
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD a new song, And His praise from the end of the earth; Ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein, The isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂא֤וּ מִדְבָּר֙ וְעָרָ֔יו חֲצֵרִ֖ים תֵּשֵׁ֣ב קֵדָ֑ר יָרֹ֙נּוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי סֶ֔לַע מֵרֹ֥אשׁ הָרִ֖ים יִצְוָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: ysh'v mdbr v'ryv chtsrym tshb qdr yrnv yshby sl' mr'sh hrym ytsvchv
verses.translation: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, The villages that Kedar doth inhabit; Let the inhabitants of Sela exult, Let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לַיהֹוָ֖ה כָּב֑וֹד וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ בָּאִיִּ֥ים יַגִּֽידוּ׃
verses.translit: yshymv lyhvh khbvd vthltv b'yym ygydv
verses.translation: Let them give glory unto the LORD, And declare His praise in the islands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָה֙ כַּגִּבּ֣וֹר יֵצֵ֔א כְּאִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמ֖וֹת יָעִ֣יר קִנְאָ֑ה יָרִ֙יעַ֙ אַף־יַצְרִ֔יחַ עַל־אֹיְבָ֖יו יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: yhvh khgbvr yts' kh'ysh mlchmvt y'yr qn'h yry' 'fytsrych 'l'ybyv ytgbr {s}
verses.translation: The LORD will go forth as a mighty man, He will stir up jealousy like a man of war; He will cry, yea, He will shout aloud, He will prove Himself mighty against His enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶחֱשֵׁ֙יתִי֙ מֵֽעוֹלָ֔ם אַחֲרִ֖ישׁ אֶתְאַפָּ֑ק כַּיּוֹלֵדָ֣ה אֶפְעֶ֔ה אֶשֹּׁ֥ם וְאֶשְׁאַ֖ף יָֽחַד׃
verses.translit: hchshyty m'vlm 'chrysh 't'pq khyvldh 'p'h 'shm v'sh'f ychd
verses.translation: I have long time held My peace, I have been still, and refrained Myself; Now will I cry like a travailing woman, Gasping and panting at once.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרִ֤יב הָרִים֙ וּגְבָע֔וֹת וְכׇל־עֶשְׂבָּ֖ם אוֹבִ֑ישׁ וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י נְהָרוֹת֙ לָאִיִּ֔ים וַאֲגַמִּ֖ים אוֹבִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: 'chryb hrym vgb'vt vkhl'shbm 'vbysh vshmty nhrvt l'yym v'gmym 'vbysh
verses.translation: I will make waste mountains and hills, And dry up all their herbs; And I will make the rivers islands, And will dry up the pools.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹלַכְתִּ֣י עִוְרִ֗ים בְּדֶ֙רֶךְ֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ בִּנְתִיב֥וֹת לֹא־יָדְע֖וּ אַדְרִיכֵ֑ם אָשִׂים֩ מַחְשָׁ֨ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶ֜ם לָא֗וֹר וּמַֽעֲקַשִּׁים֙ לְמִישׁ֔וֹר אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים עֲשִׂיתִ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עֲזַבְתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vhvlkhty 'vrym bdrkh l' yd'v bntybvt l'yd'v 'drykhm 'shym mchshkh lpnyhm l'vr vm'qshym lmyshvr 'lh hdbrym 'shytm vl' 'zbtym
verses.translation: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not, In paths that they knew not will I lead them; I will make darkness light before them, and rugged places plain. These things will I do, And I will not leave them undone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָסֹ֤גוּ אָחוֹר֙ יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ בֹ֔שֶׁת הַבֹּטְחִ֖ים בַּפָּ֑סֶל הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לְמַסֵּכָ֖ה אַתֶּ֥ם אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: nsgv 'chvr ybshv bsht hbtchym bpsl h'mrym lmskhh 'tm 'lhynv {p}
verses.translation: They shall be turned back, greatly ashamed, That trust in graven images, That say unto molten images: ‘Ye are our gods.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֵרְשִׁ֖ים שְׁמָ֑עוּ וְהַעִוְרִ֖ים הַבִּ֥יטוּ לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hchrshym shm'v vh'vrym hbytv lr'vt
verses.translation: Hear, ye deaf, And look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י עִוֵּר֙ כִּ֣י אִם־עַבְדִּ֔י וְחֵרֵ֖שׁ כְּמַלְאָכִ֣י אֶשְׁלָ֑ח מִ֤י עִוֵּר֙ כִּמְשֻׁלָּ֔ם וְעִוֵּ֖ר כְּעֶ֥בֶד יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: my 'vr khy 'm'bdy vchrsh khml'khy 'shlch my 'vr khmshlm v'vr kh'bd yhvh
verses.translation: Who is blind, but My servant? Or deaf, as My messenger that I send? Who is blind as he that is wholehearted, And blind as the LORD’S servant?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ראית) [רָא֥וֹת] רַבּ֖וֹת וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמֹ֑ר פָּק֥וֹחַ אׇזְנַ֖יִם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: (r'yt) [r'vt] rbvt vl' tshmr pqvch 'znym vl' yshm'
verses.translation: Seeing many things, thou observest not; Opening the ears, he heareth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה חָפֵ֖ץ לְמַ֣עַן צִדְק֑וֹ יַגְדִּ֥יל תּוֹרָ֖ה וְיַאְדִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: yhvh chpts lm'n tsdqv ygdyl tvrh vy'dyr
verses.translation: The LORD was pleased, for His righteousness’sake, To make the teaching great and glorious.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּא֮ עַם־בָּז֣וּז וְשָׁסוּי֒ הָפֵ֤חַ בַּחוּרִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם וּבְבָתֵּ֥י כְלָאִ֖ים הׇחְבָּ֑אוּ הָי֤וּ לָבַז֙ וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּ֔יל מְשִׁסָּ֖ה וְאֵין־אֹמֵ֥ר הָשַֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vhv' 'mbzvz vshsvy hpch bchvrym khlm vbbty khl'ym hchb'v hyv lbz v'yn mtsyl mshsh v'yn'mr hshb
verses.translation: But this is a people robbed and spoiled, They are all of them snared in holes, And they are hid in prison-houses; They are for a prey, and none delivereth, For a spoil, and none saith: ‘Restore.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֥י בָכֶ֖ם יַאֲזִ֣ין זֹ֑את יַקְשִׁ֥ב וְיִשְׁמַ֖ע לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: my bkhm y'zyn z't yqshb vyshm' l'chvr
verses.translation: Who among you will give ear to this? Who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־נָתַ֨ן (למשוסה) [לִמְשִׁסָּ֧ה] יַעֲקֹ֛ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל לְבֹזְזִ֖ים הֲל֣וֹא יְהֹוָ֑ה ז֚וּ חָטָ֣אנוּ ל֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־אָב֤וּ בִדְרָכָיו֙ הָל֔וֹךְ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּתוֹרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: myntn (lmshvsh) [lmshsh] y'qb vyshr'l lbzzym hlv' yhvh zv cht'nv lv vl''bv bdrkhyv hlvkh vl' shm'v btvrtv
verses.translation: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? Did not the LORD? He against whom we have sinned, And in whose ways they would not walk, Neither were they obedient unto His law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ עָלָיו֙ חֵמָ֣ה אַפּ֔וֹ וֶעֱז֖וּז מִלְחָמָ֑ה וַתְּלַהֲטֵ֤הוּ מִסָּבִיב֙ וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֔ע וַתִּבְעַר־בּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־יָשִׂ֥ים עַל־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: vyshpkh 'lyv chmh 'pv v'zvz mlchmh vtlhthv msbyb vl' yd' vtb'rbv vl'yshym 'llb
verses.translation: Therefore He poured upon him the fury of His anger, And the strength of battle; And it set him on fire round about, yet he knew not, And it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ בֹּרַאֲךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹצֶרְךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַל־תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י גְאַלְתִּ֔יךָ קָרָ֥אתִי בְשִׁמְךָ֖ לִי־אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: v'th khh'mr yhvh br'kh y'qb vytsrkh yshr'l 'ltyr' khy g'ltykh qr'ty bshmkh ly'th
verses.translation: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, And He that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name, thou art Mine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תַעֲבֹ֤ר בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ אִתְּךָ־אָ֔נִי וּבַנְּהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּךָ כִּֽי־תֵלֵ֤ךְ בְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶ֔ה וְלֶהָבָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִבְעַר־בָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khyt'br bmym 'tkh'ny vbnhrvt l' yshtpvkh khytlkh bmv'sh l' tkhvh vlhbh l' tb'rbkh
verses.translation: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee, And through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee; When thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, Neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִׁיעֶ֑ךָ נָתַ֤תִּי כׇפְרְךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם כּ֥וּשׁ וּסְבָ֖א תַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykh qdvsh yshr'l mvshy'kh ntty khprkh mtsrym khvsh vsb' tchtykh
verses.translation: For I am the LORD thy God, The Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour; I have given Egypt as thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָקַ֧רְתָּ בְעֵינַ֛י נִכְבַּ֖דְתָּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֲהַבְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶתֵּ֤ן אָדָם֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יךָ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: m'shr yqrt b'yny nkhbdt v'ny 'hbtykh v'tn 'dm tchtykh vl'mym tcht npshkh
verses.translation: Since thou art precious in My sight, and honourable, and I have loved thee; Therefore will I give men for thee, And peoples for thy life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּירָ֖א כִּ֣י אִתְּךָ־אָ֑נִי מִמִּזְרָח֙ אָבִ֣יא זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֖ב אֲקַבְּצֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: 'ltyr' khy 'tkh'ny mmzrch 'by' zr'kh vmm'rb 'qbtskh
verses.translation: Fear not, for I am with thee; I will bring thy seed from the east, And gather thee from the west;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹמַ֤ר לַצָּפוֹן֙ תֵּ֔נִי וּלְתֵימָ֖ן אַל־תִּכְלָ֑אִי הָבִ֤יאִי בָנַי֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וּבְנוֹתַ֖י מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'mr ltspvn tny vltymn 'ltkhl'y hby'y bny mrchvq vbnvty mqtsh h'rts
verses.translation: I will say to the north: ‘Give up’, And to the south: ‘Keep not back, bring My sons from far, and My daughters from the end of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הַנִּקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֔י וְלִכְבוֹדִ֖י בְּרָאתִ֑יו יְצַרְתִּ֖יו אַף־עֲשִׂיתִֽיו׃
verses.translit: khl hnqr' bshmy vlkhbvdy br'tyv ytsrtyv 'f'shytyv
verses.translation: Every one that is called by My name, and whom I have created for My glory, I have formed him, yea, I have made him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹצִ֥יא עַם־עִוֵּ֖ר וְעֵינַ֣יִם יֵ֑שׁ וְחֵרְשִׁ֖ים וְאׇזְנַ֥יִם לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvtsy' 'm'vr v'ynym ysh vchrshym v'znym lmv
verses.translation: The blind people that have eyes shall be brought forth, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֞ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֗ו וְיֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִ֤י בָהֶם֙ יַגִּ֣יד זֹ֔את וְרִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת יַשְׁמִיעֻ֑נוּ יִתְּנ֤וּ עֵֽדֵיהֶם֙ וְיִצְדָּ֔קוּ וְיִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translit: khlhgvym nqbtsv ychdv vy'spv l'mym my bhm ygyd z't vr'shnvt yshmy'nv ytnv 'dyhm vytsdqv vyshm'v vy'mrv 'mt
verses.translation: All the nations are gathered together, and the peoples are assembled; who among them can declare this, And announce to us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; And let them hear, and say: ‘It is truth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתֶּ֤ם עֵדַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְעַבְדִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתִּי לְמַ֣עַן תֵּ֠דְע֠וּ וְתַאֲמִ֨ינוּ לִ֤י וְתָבִ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא לְפָנַי֙ לֹא־נ֣וֹצַר אֵ֔ל וְאַחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'tm 'dy n'myhvh v'bdy 'shr bchrty lm'n td'v vt'mynv ly vtbynv khy'ny hv' lpny l'nvtsr 'l v'chry l' yhyh {s}
verses.translation: Ye are My witnesses, saith the LORD, and My servant whom I have chosen; that ye may know and believe Me, and understand That I am He; before Me there was no God formed, neither shall any be after Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מִבַּלְעָדַ֖י מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'nkhy yhvh v'yn mbl'dy mvshy'
