verses.translation: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside Me there is no saviour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֞י הִגַּ֤דְתִּי וְהוֹשַׁ֙עְתִּי֙ וְהִשְׁמַ֔עְתִּי וְאֵ֥ין בָּכֶ֖ם זָ֑ר וְאַתֶּ֥ם עֵדַ֛י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַאֲנִי־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy hgdty vhvsh'ty vhshm'ty v'yn bkhm zr v'tm 'dy n'myhvh v'ny'l
verses.translation: I have declared, and I have saved, and I have announced, and there was no strange god among you; therefore ye are My witnesses, saith the LORD, and I am God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־מִיּוֹם֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּ֑יל אֶפְעַ֖ל וּמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gmmyvm 'ny hv' v'yn mydy mtsyl 'p'l vmy yshybnh {s}
verses.translation: Yea, since the day was I am He, and there is none that can deliver out of My hand; I will work, and who can reverse it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְכֶ֖ם קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְמַעַנְכֶ֞ם שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָבֶ֗לָה וְהוֹרַדְתִּ֤י בָֽרִיחִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְכַשְׂדִּ֖ים בָּאֳנִיּ֥וֹת רִנָּתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh g'lkhm qdvsh yshr'l lm'nkhm shlchty bblh vhvrdty brychym khlm vkhshdym b'nyvt rntm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, your Redeemer, The Holy One of Israel: For your sake I have sent to Babylon, And I will bring down all of them as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their shouting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה קְדֽוֹשְׁכֶ֑ם בּוֹרֵ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מַלְכְּכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh qdvshkhm bvr' yshr'l mlkhkhm {s}
verses.translation: I am the LORD, your Holy One, The Creator of Israel, your King.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן בַּיָּ֖ם דָּ֑רֶךְ וּבְמַ֥יִם עַזִּ֖ים נְתִיבָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnvtn bym drkh vbmym 'zym ntybh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, who maketh a way in the sea, And a path in the mighty waters;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמּוֹצִ֥יא רֶכֶב־וָס֖וּס חַ֣יִל וְעִזּ֑וּז יַחְדָּ֤ו יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ בַּל־יָק֔וּמוּ דָּעֲכ֖וּ כַּפִּשְׁתָּ֥ה כָבֽוּ׃
verses.translit: hmvtsy' rkhbvsvs chyl v'zvz ychdv yshkhbv blyqvmv d'khv khpshth khbv
verses.translation: Who bringeth forth the chariot and horse, The army and the power— They lie down together, they shall not rise, They are extinct, they are quenched as a wick:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּזְכְּר֖וּ רִאשֹׁנ֑וֹת וְקַדְמֹנִיּ֖וֹת אַל־תִּתְבֹּנָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ltzkhrv r'shnvt vqdmnyvt 'lttbnnv
verses.translation: Remember ye not the former things, Neither consider the things of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י עֹשֶׂ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ עַתָּ֣ה תִצְמָ֔ח הֲל֖וֹא תֵּדָע֑וּהָ אַ֣ף אָשִׂ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ דֶּ֔רֶךְ בִּישִׁמ֖וֹן נְהָרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hnny 'shh chdshh 'th ttsmch hlv' td'vh 'f 'shym bmdbr drkh byshmvn nhrvt
verses.translation: Behold, I will do a new thing; Now shall it spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, And rivers in the desert.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּכַבְּדֵ֙נִי֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה תַּנִּ֖ים וּבְנ֣וֹת יַעֲנָ֑ה כִּֽי־נָתַ֨תִּי בַמִּדְבָּ֜ר מַ֗יִם נְהָרוֹת֙ בִּֽישִׁימֹ֔ן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת עַמִּ֥י בְחִירִֽי׃
verses.translit: tkhbdny chyt hshdh tnym vbnvt y'nh khyntty bmdbr mym nhrvt byshymn lhshqvt 'my bchyry
verses.translation: The beasts of the field shall honour Me, The jackals and the ostriches; Because I give waters in the wilderness, And rivers in the desert, To give drink to My people, Mine elect;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַם־זוּ֙ יָצַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔י תְּהִלָּתִ֖י יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mzv ytsrty ly thlty ysprv {s}
verses.translation: The people which I formed for Myself, That they might tell of My praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־אֹתִ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי־יָגַ֥עְתָּ בִּ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vl''ty qr't y'qb khyyg't by yshr'l
verses.translation: Yet thou hast not called upon Me, O Jacob, Neither hast thou wearied thyself about Me, O Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־הֵבֵ֤יאתָ לִּי֙ שֵׂ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֔יךָ וּזְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א כִבַּדְתָּ֑נִי לֹ֤א הֶעֱבַדְתִּ֙יךָ֙ בְּמִנְחָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הוֹגַעְתִּ֖יךָ בִּלְבוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'hby't ly shh 'ltykh vzbchykh l' khbdtny l' h'bdtykh bmnchh vl' hvg'tykh blbvnh
verses.translation: Thou hast not brought Me the small cattle of thy burnt-offerings; Neither hast thou honoured Me with thy sacrifices. I have not burdened thee with a meal-offering, Nor wearied thee with frankincense.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־קָנִ֨יתָ לִּ֤י בַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ קָנֶ֔ה וְחֵ֥לֶב זְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א הִרְוִיתָ֑נִי אַ֗ךְ הֶעֱבַדְתַּ֙נִי֙ בְּחַטֹּאותֶ֔יךָ הוֹגַעְתַּ֖נִי בַּעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: l'qnyt ly bkhsf qnh vchlb zbchykh l' hrvytny 'kh h'bdtny bcht'vtykh hvg'tny b'vntykh
verses.translation: Thou hast bought Me no sweet cane with money, Neither hast thou satisfied Me with the fat of thy sacrifices; But thou hast burdened Me with thy sins, Thou hast wearied Me with thine iniquities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֨י אָנֹכִ֥י ה֛וּא מֹחֶ֥ה פְשָׁעֶ֖יךָ לְמַעֲנִ֑י וְחַטֹּאתֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א אֶזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'nkhy hv' mchh psh'ykh lm'ny vcht'tykh l' 'zkhr
verses.translation: I, even I, am He that blotteth out thy transgressions for Mine own sake; And thy sins I will not remember.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַזְכִּירֵ֕נִי נִשָּׁפְטָ֖ה יָ֑חַד סַפֵּ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
verses.translit: hzkhyrny nshpth ychd spr 'th lm'n ttsdq
verses.translation: Put Me in remembrance, let us plead together; Declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבִ֥יךָ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן חָטָ֑א וּמְלִיצֶ֖יךָ פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'bykh hr'shvn cht' vmlytsykh psh'v by
verses.translation: Thy first father sinned, And thine intercessors have transgressed against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחַלֵּ֖ל שָׂ֣רֵי קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לַחֵ֙רֶם֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְגִדּוּפִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'chll shry qdsh v'tnh lchrm y'qb vyshr'l lgdvpym {p}
verses.translation: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, And I have given Jacob to condemnation, And Israel to reviling.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה שְׁמַ֖ע יַעֲקֹ֣ב עַבְדִּ֑י וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'th shm' y'qb 'bdy vyshr'l bchrty bv
verses.translation: Yet now hear, O Jacob My servant, And Israel, whom I have chosen;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה עֹשֶׂ֛ךָ וְיֹצֶרְךָ֥ מִבֶּ֖טֶן יַעְזְרֶ֑ךָּ אַל־תִּירָא֙ עַבְדִּ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וִישֻׁר֖וּן בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh 'shkh vytsrkh mbtn y'zrkh 'ltyr' 'bdy y'qb vyshrvn bchrty bv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, And formed thee from the womb, who will help thee: Fear not, O Jacob My servant, And thou, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶצׇּק־מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־צָמֵ֔א וְנֹזְלִ֖ים עַל־יַבָּשָׁ֑ה אֶצֹּ֤ק רוּחִי֙ עַל־זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וּבִרְכָתִ֖י עַל־צֶאֱצָאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khy 'tsqmym 'ltsm' vnzlym 'lybshh 'tsq rvchy 'lzr'kh vbrkhty 'lts'ts'ykh
verses.translation: For I will pour water upon the thirsty land, And streams upon the dry ground; I will pour My spirit upon thy seed, And My blessing upon thine offspring;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצָמְח֖וּ בְּבֵ֣ין חָצִ֑יר כַּעֲרָבִ֖ים עַל־יִבְלֵי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vtsmchv bbyn chtsyr kh'rbym 'lyblymym
verses.translation: And they shall spring up among the grass, As willows by the watercourses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֤ה יֹאמַר֙ לַיהֹוָ֣ה אָ֔נִי וְזֶ֖ה יִקְרָ֣א בְשֵֽׁם־יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְזֶ֗ה יִכְתֹּ֤ב יָדוֹ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וּבְשֵׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יְכַנֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: zh y'mr lyhvh 'ny vzh yqr' bshmy'qb vzh ykhtb ydv lyhvh vbshm yshr'l ykhnh {p}
verses.translation: One shall say: ‘I am the LORD’S’; And another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; And another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, And surname himself by the name of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְגֹאֲל֖וֹ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אֲנִ֤י רִאשׁוֹן֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲר֔וֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדַ֖י אֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh mlkhyshr'l vg'lv yhvh tsb'vt 'ny r'shvn v'ny 'chrvn vmbl'dy 'yn 'lhym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, the King of Israel, And his Redeemer the LORD of hosts: I am the first, and I am the last, And beside Me there is no God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִי־כָמ֣וֹנִי יִקְרָ֗א וְיַגִּידֶ֤הָ וְיַעְרְכֶ֙הָ֙ לִ֔י מִשּׂוּמִ֖י עַם־עוֹלָ֑ם וְאֹתִיּ֛וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖אנָה יַגִּ֥ידוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmykhmvny yqr' vygydh vy'rkhh ly mshvmy 'm'vlm v'tyvt v'shr tb'nh ygydv lmv
verses.translation: And who, as I, can proclaim— Let him declare it, and set it in order for Me— Since I appointed the ancient people? And the things that are coming, and that shall come to pass, let them declare.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּפְחֲדוּ֙ וְאַל־תִּרְה֔וּ הֲלֹ֥א מֵאָ֛ז הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֥יךָ וְהִגַּ֖דְתִּי וְאַתֶּ֣ם עֵדָ֑י הֲיֵ֤שׁ אֱל֙וֹהַּ֙ מִבַּלְעָדַ֔י וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר בַּל־יָדָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.translit: 'ltpchdv v'ltrhv hl' m'z hshm'tykh vhgdty v'tm 'dy hysh 'lvh mbl'dy v'yn tsvr blyd'ty
verses.translation: Fear ye not, neither be afraid; Have I not announced unto thee of old, and declared it? And ye are My witnesses. Is there a God beside Me? Yea, there is no Rock; I know not any.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹצְרֵי־פֶ֤סֶל כֻּלָּם֙ תֹּ֔הוּ וַחֲמוּדֵיהֶ֖ם בַּל־יוֹעִ֑ילוּ וְעֵדֵיהֶ֣ם הֵ֗ׄמָּׄהׄ בַּל־יִרְא֛וּ וּבַל־יֵדְע֖וּ לְמַ֥עַן יֵבֹֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: ytsrypsl khlm thv vchmvdyhm blyv'ylv v'dyhm hmh blyr'v vblyd'v lm'n ybshv
verses.translation: They that fashion a graven image are all of them vanity, And their delectable things shall not profit; And their own witnesses see not, nor know; That they may be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יָצַ֥ר אֵ֖ל וּפֶ֣סֶל נָסָ֑ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.translit: myytsr 'l vpsl nskh lblty hv'yl
verses.translation: Who hath fashioned a god, or molten an image That is profitable for nothing?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כׇּל־חֲבֵרָיו֙ יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ וְחָרָשִׁ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה מֵאָדָ֑ם יִֽתְקַבְּצ֤וּ כֻלָּם֙ יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ יִפְחֲד֖וּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ יָֽחַד׃
verses.translit: hn khlchbryv ybshv vchrshym hmh m'dm ytqbtsv khlm y'mdv ypchdv ybshv ychd
verses.translation: Behold, all the fellows thereof shall be ashamed; And the craftsmen skilled above men; Let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; They shall fear, they shall be ashamed together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָרַ֤שׁ בַּרְזֶל֙ מַֽעֲצָ֔ד וּפָעַל֙ בַּפֶּחָ֔ם וּבַמַּקָּב֖וֹת יִצְּרֵ֑הוּ וַיִּפְעָלֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ כֹּח֔וֹ גַּם־רָעֵב֙ וְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֔חַ לֹא־שָׁ֥תָה מַ֖יִם וַיִּיעָֽף׃
verses.translit: chrsh brzl m'tsd vp'l bpchm vbmqbvt ytsrhv vyp'lhv bzrv' khchv gmr'b v'yn khch l'shth mym vyy'f
verses.translation: The smith maketh an axe, And worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, And worketh it with his strong arm; Yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth; He drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָרַ֣שׁ עֵצִים֮ נָ֣טָה קָו֒ יְתָאֲרֵ֣הוּ בַשֶּׂ֔רֶד יַעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ בַּמַּקְצֻע֔וֹת וּבַמְּחוּגָ֖ה יְתׇאֳרֵ֑הוּ וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ כְּתַבְנִ֣ית אִ֔ישׁ כְּתִפְאֶ֥רֶת אָדָ֖ם לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: chrsh 'tsym nth qv yt'rhv bshrd y'shhv bmqts'vt vbmchvgh yt'rhv vy'shhv khtbnyt 'ysh khtp'rt 'dm lshbt byt
verses.translation: The carpenter stretcheth out a line; He marketh it out with a pencil; He fitteth it with planes, And he marketh it out with the compasses, And maketh it after the figure of a man, According to the beauty of a man, to dwell in the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִכְרׇת־ל֣וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים וַיִּקַּ֤ח תִּרְזָה֙ וְאַלּ֔וֹן וַיְאַמֶּץ־ל֖וֹ בַּעֲצֵי־יָ֑עַר נָטַ֥ע אֹ֖רֶן וְגֶ֥שֶׁם יְגַדֵּֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhrtlv 'rzym vyqch trzh v'lvn vy'mtslv b'tsyy'r nt' 'rn vgshm ygdl
verses.translation: He heweth him down cedars, And taketh the ilex and the oak, And strengtheneth for himself one among the trees of the forest; He planteth a bay-tree, and the rain doth nourish it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לְאָדָם֙ לְבָעֵ֔ר וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֵהֶם֙ וַיָּ֔חׇם אַף־יַשִּׂ֖יק וְאָ֣פָה לָ֑חֶם אַף־יִפְעַל־אֵל֙ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ עָשָׂ֥הוּ פֶ֖סֶל וַיִּסְגׇּד־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh l'dm lb'r vyqch mhm vychm 'fyshyq v'ph lchm 'fyp'l'l vyshtchv 'shhv psl vysgdlmv
verses.translation: Then a man useth it for fuel; And he taketh thereof, and warmeth himself; Yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; Yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; He maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶצְיוֹ֙ שָׂרַ֣ף בְּמוֹ־אֵ֔שׁ עַל־חֶצְיוֹ֙ בָּשָׂ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל יִצְלֶ֥ה צָלִ֖י וְיִשְׂבָּ֑ע אַף־יָחֹם֙ וְיֹאמַ֣ר הֶאָ֔ח חַמּוֹתִ֖י רָאִ֥יתִי אֽוּר׃
verses.translit: chtsyv shrf bmv'sh 'lchtsyv bshr y'khl ytslh tsly vyshb' 'fychm vy'mr h'ch chmvty r'yty 'vr
verses.translation: He burneth the half thereof in the fire; With the half thereof he eateth flesh; He roasteth roast, and is satisfied; Yea, he warmeth himself, and saith: ‘Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁאֵ֣רִית֔וֹ לְאֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֖ה לְפִסְל֑וֹ (יסגוד) [יִסְגׇּד־]ל֤וֹ וְיִשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֔יו וְיֹאמַר֙ הַצִּילֵ֔נִי כִּ֥י אֵלִ֖י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vsh'rytv l'l 'shh lpslv (ysgvd) [ysgd]lv vyshtchv vytpll 'lyv vy'mr htsylny khy 'ly 'th
verses.translation: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image; He falleth down unto it and worshippeth, and prayeth unto it, And saith: ‘Deliver me, for thou art my god.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ינוּ כִּ֣י טַ֤ח מֵֽרְאוֹת֙ עֵינֵיהֶ֔ם מֵהַשְׂכִּ֖יל לִבֹּתָֽם׃
verses.translit: l' yd'v vl' ybynv khy tch mr'vt 'ynyhm mhshkhyl lbtm
verses.translation: They know not, neither do they understand; For their eyes are bedaubed, that they cannot see, And their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־יָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־לִבּ֗וֹ וְלֹ֨א דַ֥עַת וְלֹֽא־תְבוּנָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ חֶצְי֞וֹ שָׂרַ֣פְתִּי בְמוֹ־אֵ֗שׁ וְ֠אַ֠ף אָפִ֤יתִי עַל־גֶּחָלָיו֙ לֶ֔חֶם אֶצְלֶ֥ה בָשָׂ֖ר וְאֹכֵ֑ל וְיִתְרוֹ֙ לְתוֹעֵבָ֣ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה לְב֥וּל עֵ֖ץ אֶסְגּֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vl'yshyb 'llbv vl' d't vl'tbvnh l'mr chtsyv shrpty bmv'sh v'f 'pyty 'lgchlyv lchm 'tslh bshr v'khl vytrv ltv'bh ''shh lbvl 'ts 'sgvd
verses.translation: And none considereth in his heart, Neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say: ‘I have burned the half of it in the fire; Yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh and eaten it; And shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? Shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה אֵ֔פֶר לֵ֥ב הוּתַ֖ל הִטָּ֑הוּ וְלֹא־יַצִּ֤יל אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א יֹאמַ֔ר הֲל֥וֹא שֶׁ֖קֶר בִּימִינִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: r'h 'pr lb hvtl hthv vl'ytsyl 'tnpshv vl' y'mr hlv' shqr bymyny {s}
verses.translation: He striveth after ashes, A deceived heart hath turned him aside, That he cannot deliver his soul, nor say: ‘Is there not a lie in my right hand?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכׇר־אֵ֣לֶּה יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֣י עַבְדִּי־אָ֑תָּה יְצַרְתִּ֤יךָ עֶֽבֶד־לִי֙ אַ֔תָּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א תִנָּשֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.translit: zkhr'lh y'qb vyshr'l khy 'bdy'th ytsrtykh 'bdly 'th yshr'l l' tnshny
verses.translation: Remember these things, O Jacob, And Israel, for thou art My servant; I have formed thee, thou art Mine own servant; O Israel, thou shouldest not forget Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָחִ֤יתִי כָעָב֙ פְּשָׁעֶ֔יךָ וְכֶעָנָ֖ן חַטֹּאותֶ֑יךָ שׁוּבָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י כִּ֥י גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: mchyty kh'b psh'ykh vkh'nn cht'vtykh shvbh 'ly khy g'ltykh
verses.translation: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, And, as a cloud, thy sins; Return unto Me, for I have redeemed thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רׇנּ֨וּ שָׁמַ֜יִם כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֣ה יְהֹוָ֗ה הָרִ֙יעוּ֙ תַּחְתִּיּ֣וֹת אָ֔רֶץ פִּצְח֤וּ הָרִים֙ רִנָּ֔ה יַ֖עַר וְכׇל־עֵ֣ץ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־גָאַ֤ל יְהֹוָה֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְפָּאָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: rnv shmym khy'shh yhvh hry'v tchtyvt 'rts ptschv hrym rnh y'r vkhl'ts bv khyg'l yhvh y'qb vbyshr'l ytp'r {s}
verses.translation: Sing, O ye heavens, for the LORD hath done it; Shout, ye lowest parts of the earth; Break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein; For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, And doth glorify Himself in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ גֹּאֲלֶ֔ךָ וְיֹצֶרְךָ֖ מִבָּ֑טֶן אָנֹכִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ עֹ֣שֶׂה כֹּ֔ל נֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ לְבַדִּ֔י רֹקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ (מי אתי) [מֵאִתִּֽי]׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh g'lkh vytsrkh mbtn 'nkhy yhvh 'shh khl nth shmym lbdy rq' h'rts (my 'ty) [m'ty]
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, And He that formed thee from the womb: I am the LORD, that maketh all things; That stretched forth the heavens alone; That spread abroad the earth by Myself;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵפֵר֙ אֹת֣וֹת בַּדִּ֔ים וְקֹסְמִ֖ים יְהוֹלֵ֑ל מֵשִׁ֧יב חֲכָמִ֛ים אָח֖וֹר וְדַעְתָּ֥ם יְסַכֵּֽל׃
verses.translit: mpr 'tvt bdym vqsmym yhvll mshyb chkhmym 'chvr vd'tm yskhl
verses.translation: That frustrateth the tokens of the imposters, And maketh diviners mad; That turneth wise men backward, And maketh their knowledge foolish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵקִים֙ דְּבַ֣ר עַבְדּ֔וֹ וַעֲצַ֥ת מַלְאָכָ֖יו יַשְׁלִ֑ים הָאֹמֵ֨ר לִירוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם תּוּשָׁ֗ב וּלְעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ינָה וְחׇרְבוֹתֶ֖יהָ אֲקוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.translit: mqym dbr 'bdv v'tst ml'khyv yshlym h'mr lyrvshl͏m tvshb vl'ry yhvdh tbnynh vchrbvtyh 'qvmm
verses.translation: That confirmeth the word of His servant, And performeth the counsel of His messengers; That saith of Jerusalem: ‘She shall be inhabited’; And of the cities of Judah: ‘They shall be built, And I will raise up the waste places thereof’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֥ר לַצּוּלָ֖ה חֳרָ֑בִי וְנַהֲרֹתַ֖יִךְ אוֹבִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: h'mr ltsvlh chrby vnhrtykh 'vbysh
verses.translation: That saith to the deep: ‘Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֤ר לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ רֹעִ֔י וְכׇל־חֶפְצִ֖י יַשְׁלִ֑ם וְלֵאמֹ֤ר לִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ה וְהֵיכָ֖ל תִּוָּסֵֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: h'mr lkhvrsh r'y vkhlchptsy yshlm vl'mr lyrvshl͏m tbnh vhykhl tvsd {p}
verses.translation: That saith of Cyrus: ‘He is My shepherd, And shall perform all My pleasure’; Even saying of Jerusalem: ‘She shall be built’; And to the temple: ‘My foundation shall be laid.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָה֮ לִמְשִׁיחוֹ֮ לְכ֣וֹרֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱזַ֣קְתִּי בִימִינ֗וֹ לְרַד־לְפָנָיו֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וּמׇתְנֵ֥י מְלָכִ֖ים אֲפַתֵּ֑חַ לִפְתֹּ֤חַ לְפָנָיו֙ דְּלָתַ֔יִם וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִסָּגֵֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh lmshychv lkhvrsh 'shrhchzqty bymynv lrdlpnyv gvym vmtny mlkhym 'ptch lptch lpnyv dltym vsh'rym l' ysgrv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD to His anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him, and to loose the loins of kings; to open the doors before him, and that the gates may not be shut:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֵלֵ֔ךְ וַהֲדוּרִ֖ים (אושר) [אֲיַשֵּׁ֑ר] דַּלְת֤וֹת נְחוּשָׁה֙ אֲשַׁבֵּ֔ר וּבְרִיחֵ֥י בַרְזֶ֖ל אֲגַדֵּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: 'ny lpnykh 'lkh vhdvrym ('vshr) ['yshr] dltvt nchvshh 'shbr vbrychy brzl 'gd'
verses.translation: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight; I will break in pieces the doors of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ אוֹצְר֣וֹת חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וּמַטְמֻנֵ֖י מִסְתָּרִ֑ים לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֗ע כִּֽי־אֲנִ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה הַקּוֹרֵ֥א בְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vntty lkh 'vtsrvt chshkh vmtmny mstrym lm'n td' khy'ny yhvh hqvr' bshmkh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I am the LORD, who call thee by thy name, even the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ עַבְדִּ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּחִירִ֑י וָאֶקְרָ֤א לְךָ֙ בִּשְׁמֶ֔ךָ אֲכַנְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: lm'n 'bdy y'qb vyshr'l bchyry v'qr' lkh bshmkh 'khnkh vl' yd'tny
verses.translation: For the sake of Jacob My servant, and Israel Mine elect, I have called thee by thy name, I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד זוּלָתִ֖י אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲאַזֶּרְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh v'yn 'vd zvlty 'yn 'lhym ''zrkh vl' yd'tny
verses.translation: I am the LORD, and there is none else, beside Me there is no God; I have girded thee, though thou hast not known Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְע֗וּ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וּמִמַּ֣עֲרָבָ֔הֿ כִּי־אֶ֖פֶס בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: lm'n yd'v mmzrchshmsh vmm'rbh khy'ps bl'dy 'ny yhvh v'yn 'vd
verses.translation: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside Me; I am the LORD; and there is none else;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹר֙ וּבוֹרֵ֣א חֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם וּב֣וֹרֵא רָ֑ע אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה כׇל־אֵֽלֶּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yvtsr 'vr vbvr' chshkh 'shh shlvm vbvr' r' 'ny yhvh 'shh khl'lh {p}
verses.translation: I form the light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil; I am the LORD, that doeth all these things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַרְעִ֤יפוּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וּשְׁחָקִ֖ים יִזְּלוּ־צֶ֑דֶק תִּפְתַּח־אֶ֣רֶץ וְיִפְרוּ־יֶ֗שַׁע וּצְדָקָ֤ה תַצְמִ֙יחַ֙ יַ֔חַד אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּרָאתִֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hr'ypv shmym mm'l vshchqym yzlvtsdq tptch'rts vyprvysh' vtsdqh ttsmych ychd 'ny yhvh br'tyv {s}
verses.translation: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness; let the earth open, that they may bring forth salvation, and let her cause righteousness to spring up together; I the LORD have created it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי רָ֚ב אֶת־יֹ֣צְר֔וֹ חֶ֖רֶשׂ אֶת־חַרְשֵׂ֣י אֲדָמָ֑ה הֲיֹאמַ֨ר חֹ֤מֶר לְיֹֽצְרוֹ֙ מַֽה־תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּפׇעׇלְךָ֖ אֵין־יָדַ֥יִם לֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvy rb 'tytsrv chrsh 'tchrshy 'dmh hy'mr chmr lytsrv mht'shh vp'lkh 'ynydym lv {s}
verses.translation: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker, as a potsherd with the potsherds of the earth! Shall the clay say to him that fashioned it: ‘What makest thou?’ Or: ‘Thy work, it hath no hands’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֛וֹי אֹמֵ֥ר לְאָ֖ב מַה־תּוֹלִ֑יד וּלְאִשָּׁ֖ה מַה־תְּחִילִֽין׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvy 'mr l'b mhtvlyd vl'shh mhtchylyn {s}
verses.translation: Woe unto him that saith unto his father. 'Wherefore begettest thou?’ Or to a woman: ‘Wherefore travailest thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְיֹצְר֑וֹ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת שְׁאָל֔וּנִי עַל־בָּנַ֛י וְעַל־פֹּ֥עַל יָדַ֖י תְּצַוֻּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh qdvsh yshr'l vytsrv h'tyvt sh'lvny 'lbny v'lp'l ydy ttsvny
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, The Holy One of Israel, and his Maker: Ask Me of the things that are to come; Concerning My sons, and concerning the work of My hands, command ye Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֖ם עָלֶ֣יהָ בָרָ֑אתִי אֲנִ֗י יָדַי֙ נָט֣וּ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְכׇל־צְבָאָ֖ם צִוֵּֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'shyty 'rts v'dm 'lyh br'ty 'ny ydy ntv shmym vkhltsb'm tsvyty
verses.translation: I, even I, have made the earth, And created man upon it; I, even My hands, have stretched out the heavens, And all their host have I commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ הַעִירֹתִ֣הֽוּ בְצֶ֔דֶק וְכׇל־דְּרָכָ֖יו אֲיַשֵּׁ֑ר הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֤ה עִירִי֙ וְגָלוּתִ֣י יְשַׁלֵּ֔חַ לֹ֤א בִמְחִיר֙ וְלֹ֣א בְשֹׁ֔חַד אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'nkhy h'yrthv btsdq vkhldrkhyv 'yshr hv'ybnh 'yry vglvty yshlch l' bmchyr vl' bshchd 'mr yhvh tsb'vt {s}
verses.translation: I have roused him up in victory, And I make level all his ways; He shall build My city, And he shall let Mine exiles go free, Not for price nor reward, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה יְגִ֨יעַ מִצְרַ֥יִם וּֽסְחַר־כּוּשׁ֮ וּסְבָאִים֮ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִדָּה֒ עָלַ֤יִךְ יַעֲבֹ֙רוּ֙ וְלָ֣ךְ יִֽהְי֔וּ אַחֲרַ֣יִךְ יֵלֵ֔כוּ בַּזִּקִּ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְאֵלַ֤יִךְ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֙ אֵלַ֣יִךְ יִתְפַּלָּ֔לוּ אַ֣ךְ בָּ֥ךְ אֵ֛ל וְאֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד אֶ֥פֶס אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh ygy' mtsrym vschrkhvsh vsb'ym 'nshy mdh 'lykh y'brv vlkh yhyv 'chrykh ylkhv bzqym y'brv v'lykh yshtchvv 'lykh ytpllv 'kh bkh 'l v'yn 'vd 'ps 'lhym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: The labour of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, And of the Sabeans, men of stature, Shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine; They shall go after thee, in chains they shall come over; And they shall fall down unto thee, They shall make supplication unto thee: Surely God is in thee, and there is none else, There is no other God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָכֵ֕ן אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל מִסְתַּתֵּ֑ר אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: 'khn 'th 'l msttr 'lhy yshr'l mvshy'
verses.translation: Verily Thou art a God that hidest Thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּ֥וֹשׁוּ וְגַֽם־נִכְלְמ֖וּ כֻּלָּ֑ם יַחְדָּו֙ הָלְכ֣וּ בַכְּלִמָּ֔ה חָרָשֵׁ֖י צִירִֽים׃
verses.translit: bvshv vgmnkhlmv khlm ychdv hlkhv bkhlmh chrshy tsyrym
verses.translation: They shall be ashamed, yea, confounded, all of them; They shall go in confusion together that are makers of idols.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּֽיהֹוָ֔ה תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת עוֹלָמִ֑ים לֹא־תֵבֹ֥שׁוּ וְלֹא־תִכָּלְמ֖וּ עַד־ע֥וֹלְמֵי עַֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yshr'l nvsh' byhvh tshv't 'vlmym l'tbshv vl'tkhlmv 'd'vlmy 'd {p}
verses.translation: O Israel, that art saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; Ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה בּוֹרֵ֨א הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים יֹצֵ֨ר הָאָ֤רֶץ וְעֹשָׂהּ֙ ה֣וּא כֽוֹנְנָ֔הּ לֹא־תֹ֥הוּ בְרָאָ֖הּ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת יְצָרָ֑הּ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mryhvh bvr' hshmym hv' h'lhym ytsr h'rts v'shh hv' khvnnh l'thv br'h lshbt ytsrh 'ny yhvh v'yn 'vd
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens, He is God; That formed the earth and made it, He established it, He created it not to be empty or chaotic, He established it to be settled and inhabited: I am the LORD, and there is none else.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֧א בַסֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי בִּמְקוֹם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לֹ֥א אָמַ֛רְתִּי לְזֶ֥רַע יַעֲקֹ֖ב תֹּ֣הוּ בַקְּשׁ֑וּנִי אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ דֹּבֵ֣ר צֶ֔דֶק מַגִּ֖יד מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: l' bstr dbrty bmqvm 'rts chshkh l' 'mrty lzr' y'qb thv bqshvny 'ny yhvh dbr tsdq mgyd myshrym
verses.translation: I have not spoken in secret, In a place of the land of darkness; I said not unto the seed of Jacob: ‘Seek ye Me in vain’; I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וָבֹ֛אוּ הִֽתְנַגְּשׁ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו פְּלִיטֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לֹ֣א יָדְע֗וּ הַנֹּֽשְׂאִים֙ אֶת־עֵ֣ץ פִּסְלָ֔ם וּמִֽתְפַּלְלִ֔ים אֶל־אֵ֖ל לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: hqbtsv vb'v htngshv ychdv plyty hgvym l' yd'v hnsh'ym 't'ts pslm vmtpllym 'l'l l' yvshy'
verses.translation: Assemble yourselves and come, draw near together, Ye that are escaped of the nations; They have no knowledge that carry the wood of their graven image, And pray unto a god that cannot save.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ וְהַגִּ֔ישׁוּ אַ֥ף יִֽוָּעֲצ֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו מִ֣י הִשְׁמִ֩יעַ֩ זֹ֨את מִקֶּ֜דֶם מֵאָ֣ז הִגִּידָ֗הּ הֲל֨וֹא אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ וְאֵֽין־ע֤וֹד אֱלֹהִים֙ מִבַּלְעָדַ֔י אֵל־צַדִּ֣יק וּמוֹשִׁ֔יעַ אַ֖יִן זוּלָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: hgydv vhgyshv 'f yv'tsv ychdv my hshmy' z't mqdm m'z hgydh hlv' 'ny yhvh v'yn'vd 'lhym mbl'dy 'ltsdyq vmvshy' 'yn zvlty
verses.translation: Declare ye, and bring them near, Yea, let them take counsel together: Who hath announced this from ancient time, And declared it of old? Have not I the LORD? And there is no God else beside Me, A just God and a Saviour; There is none beside Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנוּ־אֵלַ֥י וְהִוָּשְׁע֖וּ כׇּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אֲנִי־אֵ֖ל וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: pnv'ly vhvsh'v khl'psy'rts khy 'ny'l v'yn 'vd
verses.translation: Look unto Me, and be ye saved, All the ends of the earth; For I am God, and there is none else.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּ֣י נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי יָצָ֨א מִפִּ֧י צְדָקָ֛ה דָּבָ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יָשׁ֑וּב כִּי־לִי֙ תִּכְרַ֣ע כׇּל־בֶּ֔רֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַ֖ע כׇּל־לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: by nshb'ty yts' mpy tsdqh dbr vl' yshvb khyly tkhr' khlbrkh tshb' khllshvn
verses.translation: By Myself have I sworn, The word is gone forth from My mouth in righteousness, And shall not come back, That unto Me every knee shall bow, Every tongue shall swear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ בַּיהֹוָ֛ה לִ֥י אָמַ֖ר צְדָק֣וֹת וָעֹ֑ז עָדָיו֙ יָב֣וֹא וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'kh byhvh ly 'mr tsdqvt v'z 'dyv ybv' vybshv khl hnchrym bv
verses.translation: Only in the LORD, shall one say of Me, is victory and strength; Even to Him shall men come in confusion, All they that were incensed against Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיהֹוָ֛ה יִצְדְּק֥וּ וְיִֽתְהַלְל֖וּ כׇּל־זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: byhvh ytsdqv vythllv khlzr' yshr'l
verses.translation: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּרַ֥ע בֵּל֙ קֹרֵ֣ס נְב֔וֹ הָיוּ֙ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֔ם לַחַיָּ֖ה וְלַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נְשֻׂאֹתֵיכֶ֣ם עֲמוּס֔וֹת מַשָּׂ֖א לַעֲיֵפָֽה׃
verses.translit: khr' bl qrs nbv hyv 'tsbyhm lchyh vlbhmh nsh'tykhm 'mvsvt msh' l'yph
verses.translation: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth; their idols are upon the beasts, and upon the cattle; the things that ye carried about are made a load, a burden to the weary beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרְס֤וּ כָֽרְעוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ מַלֵּ֣ט מַשָּׂ֑א וְנַפְשָׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁבִ֥י הָלָֽכָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qrsv khr'v ychdv l' ykhlv mlt msh' vnpshm bshby hlkhh {p}
verses.translation: They stoop, they bow down together, they could not deliver the burden; and themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכׇל־שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽעֲמֻסִים֙ מִנִּי־בֶ֔טֶן הַנְּשֻׂאִ֖ים מִנִּי־רָֽחַם׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly byt y'qb vkhlsh'ryt byt yshr'l h'msym mnybtn hnsh'ym mnyrchm
verses.translation: Hearken unto Me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that are borne [by Me] from the birth, that are carried from the womb:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַד־זִקְנָה֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְעַד־שֵׂיבָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י אֶסְבֹּ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עָשִׂ֙יתִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶשָּׂ֔א וַאֲנִ֥י אֶסְבֹּ֖ל וַאֲמַלֵּֽט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'dzqnh 'ny hv' v'dshybh 'ny 'sbl 'ny 'shyty v'ny 'sh' v'ny 'sbl v'mlt {s}
verses.translation: Even to old age I am the same, and even to hoar hairs will I carry you; I have made, and I will bear; yea, I will carry, and will deliver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְתַשְׁו֑וּ וְתַמְשִׁל֖וּנִי וְנִדְמֶֽה׃
verses.translit: lmy tdmyvny vtshvv vtmshlvny vndmh
verses.translation: To whom will ye liken Me, and make Me equal, and compare Me, that we may be like?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַזָּלִ֤ים זָהָב֙ מִכִּ֔יס וְכֶ֖סֶף בַּקָּנֶ֣ה יִשְׁקֹ֑לוּ יִשְׂכְּר֤וּ צוֹרֵף֙ וְיַעֲשֵׂ֣הוּ אֵ֔ל יִסְגְּד֖וּ אַף־יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.translit: hzlym zhb mkhys vkhsf bqnh yshqlv yshkhrv tsvrf vy'shhv 'l ysgdv 'fyshtchvv
verses.translation: Ye that lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance; ye that hire a goldsmith, that he make it a god, to fall down thereto, yea, to worship.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֠שָּׂאֻ֠הוּ עַל־כָּתֵ֨ף יִסְבְּלֻ֜הוּ וְיַנִּיחֻ֤הוּ תַחְתָּיו֙ וְיַֽעֲמֹ֔ד מִמְּקוֹמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א יָמִ֑ישׁ אַף־יִצְעַ֤ק אֵלָיו֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֔ה מִצָּרָת֖וֹ לֹ֥א יוֹשִׁיעֶֽנּוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ysh'hv 'lkhtf ysblhv vynychhv tchtyv vy'md mmqvmv l' ymysh 'fyts'q 'lyv vl' y'nh mtsrtv l' yvshy'nv {s}
verses.translation: He is borne upon the shoulder, he is carried, and set in his place, and he standeth, from his place he doth not remove; yea, though one cry unto him, he cannot answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִכְרוּ־זֹ֖את וְהִתְאֹשָׁ֑שׁוּ הָשִׁ֥יבוּ פוֹשְׁעִ֖ים עַל־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: zkhrvz't vht'shshv hshybv pvsh'ym 'llb
verses.translation: Remember this, and stand fast; bring it to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִכְר֥וּ רִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת מֵעוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י אֵל֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאֶ֥פֶס כָּמֽוֹנִי׃
verses.translit: zkhrv r'shnvt m'vlm khy 'nkhy 'l v'yn 'vd 'lhym v'ps khmvny
verses.translation: Remember the former things of old: That I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַגִּ֤יד מֵֽרֵאשִׁית֙ אַחֲרִ֔ית וּמִקֶּ֖דֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־נַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ אֹמֵר֙ עֲצָתִ֣י תָק֔וּם וְכׇל־חֶפְצִ֖י אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: mgyd mr'shyt 'chryt vmqdm 'shr l'n'shv 'mr 'tsty tqvm vkhlchptsy ''shh
verses.translation: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done; Saying: ‘My counsel shall stand, and all My pleasure will I do’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹרֵ֤א מִמִּזְרָח֙ עַ֔יִט מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָ֖ק אִ֣ישׁ (עצתו) [עֲצָתִ֑י] אַף־דִּבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ אַף־אֲבִיאֶ֔נָּה יָצַ֖רְתִּי אַף־אֶעֱשֶֽׂנָּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qr' mmzrch 'yt m'rts mrchq 'ysh ('tstv) ['tsty] 'fdbrty 'f'by'nh ytsrty 'f''shnh {s}
verses.translation: Calling a bird of prey from the east, the man of My counsel from a far country; Yea, I have spoken, I will also bring it to pass, I have purposed, I will also do it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֖י אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֑ב הָרְחוֹקִ֖ים מִצְּדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly 'byry lb hrchvqym mtsdqh
verses.translation: Hearken unto Me, ye stout-hearted, That are far from righteousness:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֵרַ֤בְתִּי צִדְקָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תִרְחָ֔ק וּתְשׁוּעָתִ֖י לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר וְנָתַתִּ֤י בְצִיּוֹן֙ תְּשׁוּעָ֔ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּפְאַרְתִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qrbty tsdqty l' trchq vtshv'ty l' t'chr vntty btsyvn tshv'h lyshr'l tp'rty {s}
verses.translation: I bring near My righteousness, it shall not be far off, And My salvation shall not tarry; And I will place salvation in Zion For Israel My glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְדִ֣י  וּשְׁבִ֣י עַל־עָפָ֗ר בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת־בָּבֶ֔ל שְׁבִי־לָאָ֥רֶץ אֵין־כִּסֵּ֖א בַּת־כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י לֹ֤א תוֹסִ֙יפִי֙ יִקְרְאוּ־לָ֔ךְ רַכָּ֖ה וַעֲנֻגָּֽה׃
verses.translit: rdy  vshby 'l'pr btvlt btbbl shbyl'rts 'ynkhs' btkhshdym khy l' tvsypy yqr'vlkh rkhh v'ngh
verses.translation: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, Sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans; For thou shalt no more be called Tender and delicate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְחִ֥י רֵחַ֖יִם וְטַ֣חֲנִי קָ֑מַח גַּלִּ֨י צַמָּתֵ֧ךְ חֶשְׂפִּי־שֹׁ֛בֶל גַּלִּי־שׁ֖וֹק עִבְרִ֥י נְהָרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: qchy rchym vtchny qmch gly tsmtkh chshpyshbl glyshvq 'bry nhrvt
verses.translation: Take the millstones, and grind meal; Remove thy veil, Strip off the train, uncover the leg, Pass through the rivers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּגָּל֙ עֶרְוָתֵ֔ךְ גַּ֥ם תֵּרָאֶ֖ה חֶרְפָּתֵ֑ךְ נָקָ֣ם אֶקָּ֔ח וְלֹ֥א אֶפְגַּ֖ע אָדָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tgl 'rvtkh gm tr'h chrptkh nqm 'qch vl' 'pg' 'dm {p}
verses.translation: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, Yea, thy shame shall be seen; I will take vengeance, And will let no man intercede.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּאֲלֵ֕נוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: g'lnv yhvh tsb'vt shmv qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Our Redeemer, the LORD of hosts is His name, The Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁבִ֥י דוּמָ֛ם וּבֹ֥אִי בַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ בַּת־כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י לֹ֤א תוֹסִ֙יפִי֙ יִקְרְאוּ־לָ֔ךְ גְּבֶ֖רֶת מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: shby dvmm vb'y bchshkh btkhshdym khy l' tvsypy yqr'vlkh gbrt mmlkhvt
verses.translation: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; For thou shalt no more be called The mistress of kingdoms.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָצַ֣פְתִּי עַל־עַמִּ֗י חִלַּ֙לְתִּי֙ נַחֲלָתִ֔י וָאֶתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיָדֵ֑ךְ לֹא־שַׂ֤מְתְּ לָהֶם֙ רַחֲמִ֔ים עַל־זָקֵ֕ן הִכְבַּ֥דְתְּ עֻלֵּ֖ךְ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: qtspty 'l'my chllty nchlty v'tnm bydkh l'shmt lhm rchmym 'lzqn hkhbdt 'lkh m'd
verses.translation: I was wroth with My people, I profaned Mine inheritance, And gave them into thy hand; Thou didst show them no mercy; Upon the aged hast thou very heavily Laid thy yoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמְרִ֔י לְעוֹלָ֖ם אֶהְיֶ֣ה גְבָ֑רֶת עַ֣ד לֹא־שַׂ֥מְתְּ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ עַל־לִבֵּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א זָכַ֖רְתְּ אַחֲרִיתָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vt'mry l'vlm 'hyh gbrt 'd l'shmt 'lh 'llbkh l' zkhrt 'chryth {p}
verses.translation: And thou saidst: ‘For ever shall I be mistress’; So that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, Neither didst remember the end thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה שִׁמְעִי־זֹ֤את עֲדִינָה֙ הַיּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָבֶ֔טַח הָאֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔הּ אֲנִ֖י וְאַפְסִ֣י ע֑וֹד לֹ֤א אֵשֵׁב֙ אַלְמָנָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א אֵדַ֖ע שְׁכֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: v'th shm'yz't 'dynh hyvshbt lbtch h'mrh blbbh 'ny v'psy 'vd l' 'shb 'lmnh vl' 'd' shkhvl
verses.translation: Now therefore hear this, thou that art given to pleasures, That sittest securely, That sayest in thy heart: ‘I am, and there is none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, Neither shall I know the loss of children’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָבֹ֩אנָה֩ לָּ֨ךְ שְׁתֵּי־אֵ֥לֶּה רֶ֛גַע בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד שְׁכ֣וֹל וְאַלְמֹ֑ן כְּתֻמָּם֙ בָּ֣אוּ עָלַ֔יִךְ בְּרֹ֣ב כְּשָׁפַ֔יִךְ בְּעׇצְמַ֥ת חֲבָרַ֖יִךְ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vtb'nh lkh shty'lh rg' byvm 'chd shkhvl v'lmn khtmm b'v 'lykh brb khshpykh b'tsmt chbrykh m'd
verses.translation: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment In one day, the loss of children, and widow-hood; In their full measure shall they come upon thee, For the multitude of thy sorceries, And the great abundance of thine enchantments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבְטְחִ֣י בְרָעָתֵ֗ךְ אָמַרְתְּ֙ אֵ֣ין רֹאָ֔נִי חׇכְמָתֵ֥ךְ וְדַעְתֵּ֖ךְ הִ֣יא שׁוֹבְבָ֑תֶךְ וַתֹּאמְרִ֣י בְלִבֵּ֔ךְ אֲנִ֖י וְאַפְסִ֥י עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vtbtchy br'tkh 'mrt 'yn r'ny chkhmtkh vd'tkh hy' shvbbtkh vt'mry blbkh 'ny v'psy 'vd
verses.translation: And thou hast been secure in thy wickedness, Thou hast said: ‘None seeth me’; Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, It hath perverted thee; And thou hast said in thy heart. ’I am, and there is none else beside me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֧א עָלַ֣יִךְ רָעָ֗ה לֹ֤א תֵֽדְעִי֙ שַׁחְרָ֔הּ וְתִפֹּ֤ל עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ הֹוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תוּכְלִ֖י כַּפְּרָ֑הּ וְתָבֹ֨א עָלַ֧יִךְ פִּתְאֹ֛ם שֹׁאָ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵדָֽעִי׃
verses.translit: vb' 'lykh r'h l' td'y shchrh vtpl 'lykh hvh l' tvkhly khprh vtb' 'lykh pt'm sh'h l' td'y
verses.translation: Yet shall evil came upon thee; Thou shalt not know how to charm it away; And calamity shall fall upon thee; Thou shalt not be able to put it away; And ruin shall come upon thee suddenly, Before thou knowest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִמְדִי־נָ֤א בַחֲבָרַ֙יִךְ֙ וּבְרֹ֣ב כְּשָׁפַ֔יִךְ בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגַ֖עַתְּ מִנְּעוּרָ֑יִךְ אוּלַ֛י תּוּכְלִ֥י הוֹעִ֖יל אוּלַ֥י תַּעֲרֽוֹצִי׃
verses.translit: 'mdyn' bchbrykh vbrb khshpykh b'shr yg't mn'vrykh 'vly tvkhly hv'yl 'vly t'rvtsy
verses.translation: Stand now with thine enchantments, And with the multitude of thy sorceries, Wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; If so be thou shalt be able to profit, If so be thou mayest prevail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִלְאֵ֖ית בְּרֹ֣ב עֲצָתָ֑יִךְ יַעַמְדוּ־נָ֨א וְיוֹשִׁיעֻ֜ךְ (הברו) [הֹבְרֵ֣י] שָׁמַ֗יִם הַחֹזִים֙ בַּכּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים מֽוֹדִעִים֙ לֶחֳדָשִׁ֔ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖אוּ עָלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: nl'yt brb 'tstykh y'mdvn' vyvshy'kh (hbrv) [hbry] shmym hchzym bkhvkhbym mvd'ym lchdshym m'shr yb'v 'lykh
verses.translation: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels; Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, The monthly prognosticators, Stand up, and save thee From the things that shall come upon thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה הָי֤וּ כְקַשׁ֙ אֵ֣שׁ שְׂרָפָ֔תַם לֹא־יַצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת־נַפְשָׁ֖ם מִיַּ֣ד לֶהָבָ֑ה אֵין־גַּחֶ֣לֶת לַחְמָ֔ם א֖וּר לָשֶׁ֥בֶת נֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnh hyv khqsh 'sh shrptm l'ytsylv 'tnpshm myd lhbh 'yngchlt lchmm 'vr lshbt ngdv
verses.translation: Behold, they shall be as stubble; The fire shall burn them; They shall not deliver themselves From the power of the flame; It shall not be a coal to warm at, Nor a fire to sit before.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֥ן הָיוּ־לָ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגָ֑עַתְּ סֹחֲרַ֣יִךְ מִנְּעוּרַ֗יִךְ אִ֤ישׁ לְעֶבְרוֹ֙ תָּע֔וּ אֵ֖ין מוֹשִׁיעֵֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khn hyvlkh 'shr yg't schrykh mn'vrykh 'ysh l'brv t'v 'yn mvshy'kh {s}
verses.translation: Thus shall they be unto thee With whom thou hast laboured; They that have trafficked with thee from thy youth Shall wander every one to his quarter; There shall be none to save thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֣את בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַנִּקְרָאִים֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִמֵּ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יָצָ֑אוּ הַֽנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים  בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֗ה וּבֵאלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א בֶאֱמֶ֖ת וְלֹ֥א בִצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'vz't byty'qb hnqr'ym bshm yshr'l vmmy yhvdh yts'v hnshb'ym  bshm yhvh vb'lhy yshr'l yzkhyrv l' b'mt vl' btsdqh
verses.translation: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, Who are called by the name of Israel, And are come forth out of the fountain of Judah; Who swear by the name of the LORD, And make mention of the God of Israel, But not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מֵעִ֤יר הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ נִקְרָ֔אוּ וְעַל־אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִסְמָ֑כוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khym'yr hqdsh nqr'v v'l'lhy yshr'l nsmkhv yhvh tsb'vt shmv {s}
verses.translation: For they call themselves of the holy city, And stay themselves upon the God of Israel, The LORD of hosts is His name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִֽאשֹׁנוֹת֙ מֵאָ֣ז הִגַּ֔דְתִּי וּמִפִּ֥י יָצְא֖וּ וְאַשְׁמִיעֵ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם עָשִׂ֖יתִי וַתָּבֹֽאנָה׃
verses.translit: hr'shnvt m'z hgdty vmpy yts'v v'shmy'm pt'm 'shyty vtb'nh
verses.translation: I have declared the former things from of old; Yea, they went forth out of My mouth, and I announced them; Suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִדַּעְתִּ֕י כִּ֥י קָשֶׁ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וְגִ֤יד בַּרְזֶל֙ עׇרְפֶּ֔ךָ וּמִצְחֲךָ֖ נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: md'ty khy qshh 'th vgyd brzl 'rpkh vmtschkh nchvshh
verses.translation: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, And thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַגִּ֤יד לְךָ֙ מֵאָ֔ז בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ פֶּן־תֹּאמַר֙ עׇצְבִּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ם וּפִסְלִ֥י וְנִסְכִּ֖י צִוָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'gyd lkh m'z btrm tbv' hshm'tykh pnt'mr 'tsby 'shm vpsly vnskhy tsvm
verses.translation: Therefore I have declared it to thee from of old; Before it came to pass I announced it to thee; Lest thou shouldest say: ‘Mine idol hath done them, And my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּֽ חֲזֵה֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְאַתֶּ֖ם הֲל֣וֹא תַגִּ֑ידוּ הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֤יךָ חֲדָשׁוֹת֙ מֵעַ֔תָּה וּנְצֻר֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: shm't chzh khlh v'tm hlv' tgydv hshm'tykh chdshvt m'th vntsrvt vl' yd'tm
verses.translation: Thou hast heard, see, all this; And ye, will ye not declare it? I have announced unto thee new things from this time, Even hidden things, which thou hast not known.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֤ה נִבְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מֵאָ֔ז וְלִפְנֵי־י֖וֹם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתָּ֑ם פֶּן־תֹּאמַ֖ר הִנֵּ֥ה יְדַעְתִּֽין׃
verses.translit: 'th nbr'v vl' m'z vlpnyyvm vl' shm'tm pnt'mr hnh yd'tyn
verses.translation: They are created now, and not from of old, And before this day thou heardest them not; Lest thou shouldest say: ‘Behold, I knew them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם לֹֽא־שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ גַּ֚ם לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ גַּ֕ם מֵאָ֖ז לֹא־פִתְּחָ֣ה אׇזְנֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ בָּג֣וֹד תִּבְגּ֔וֹד וּפֹשֵׁ֥עַ מִבֶּ֖טֶן קֹ֥רָא לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: gm l'shm't gm l' yd't gm m'z l'ptchh 'znkh khy yd'ty bgvd tbgvd vpsh' mbtn qr' lkh
verses.translation: Yea, thou heardest not; Yea, thou knewest not; Yea, from of old thine ear was not opened; For I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, And wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ אַאֲרִ֣יךְ אַפִּ֔י וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י אֶחֱטׇם־לָ֑ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַכְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lm'n shmy ''rykh 'py vthlty 'chtmlkh lblty hkhrytkh
verses.translation: For My name’s sake will I defer Mine anger, And for My praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה צְרַפְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א בְכָ֑סֶף בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ בְּכ֥וּר עֹֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hnh tsrptykh vl' bkhsf bchrtykh bkhvr 'ny
verses.translation: Behold, I have refined thee, but not as silver; I have tried thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַעֲנִ֧י לְמַעֲנִ֛י אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣יךְ יֵחָ֑ל וּכְבוֹדִ֖י לְאַחֵ֥ר לֹא־אֶתֵּֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'ny lm'ny ''shh khy 'ykh ychl vkhbvdy l'chr l''tn {p}
verses.translation: For Mine own sake, for Mine own sake, will I do it; For how should it be profaned? And My glory will I not give to another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: shm' 'ly y'qb vyshr'l mqr'y 'nyhv' 'ny r'shvn 'f 'ny 'chrvn
verses.translation: Hearken unto Me, O Jacob, And Israel My called: I am He; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַף־יָדִי֙ יָ֣סְדָה אֶ֔רֶץ וִימִינִ֖י טִפְּחָ֣ה שָׁמָ֑יִם קֹרֵ֥א אֲנִ֛י אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יַעַמְד֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: 'fydy ysdh 'rts vymyny tpchh shmym qr' 'ny 'lyhm y'mdv ychdv
verses.translation: Yea, My hand hath laid the foundation of the earth, And My right hand hath spread out the heavens; When I call unto them, They stand up together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֤וּ כֻלְּכֶם֙ וּֽשְׁמָ֔עוּ מִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם הִגִּ֣יד אֶת־אֵ֑לֶּה יְהֹוָ֣ה אֲהֵב֔וֹ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה חֶפְצוֹ֙ בְּבָבֶ֔ל וּזְרֹע֖וֹ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: hqbtsv khlkhm vshm'v my bhm hgyd 't'lh yhvh 'hbv y'shh chptsv bbbl vzr'v khshdym
verses.translation: Assemble yourselves, all ye, and hear; Which among them hath declared these things? He whom the LORD loveth shall perform His pleasure on Babylon, And show His arm on the Chaldeans.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י אֲנִ֛י דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אַף־קְרָאתִ֑יו הֲבִאֹתִ֖יו וְהִצְלִ֥יחַ דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'ny 'ny dbrty 'fqr'tyv hb'tyv vhtslych drkhv
verses.translation: I, even I, have spoken, yea, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִרְב֧וּ אֵלַ֣י שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֗את לֹ֤א מֵרֹאשׁ֙ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי מֵעֵ֥ת הֱיוֹתָ֖הּ שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי וְעַתָּ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה שְׁלָחַ֖נִי וְרוּחֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qrbv 'ly shm'vz't l' mr'sh bstr dbrty m't hyvth shm 'ny v'th 'dny yhvh shlchny vrvchv {p}
verses.translation: Come ye near unto Me, hear ye this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; From the time that it was, there am I; And now the Lord GOD hath sent me, and His spirit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְךָ֖ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מְלַמֶּדְךָ֣ לְהוֹעִ֔יל מַדְרִֽיכְךָ֖ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh g'lkh qdvsh yshr'l 'ny yhvh 'lhykh mlmdkh lhv'yl mdrykhkh bdrkh tlkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, The Holy One of Israel: I am the LORD thy God, Who teacheth thee for thy profit, Who leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ל֥וּא הִקְשַׁ֖בְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָ֑י וַיְהִ֤י כַנָּהָר֙ שְׁלוֹמֶ֔ךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֖ כְּגַלֵּ֥י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: lv' hqshbt lmtsvty vyhy khnhr shlvmkh vtsdqtkh khgly hym
verses.translation: Oh that thou wouldest hearken to My commandments! Then would thy peace be as a river, And thy righteousness as the waves of the sea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י כַחוֹל֙ זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֵ֥י מֵעֶ֖יךָ כִּמְעֹתָ֑יו לֹא־יִכָּרֵ֧ת וְֽלֹא־יִשָּׁמֵ֛ד שְׁמ֖וֹ מִלְּפָנָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy khchvl zr'kh vts'ts'y m'ykh khm'tyv l'ykhrt vl'yshmd shmv mlpny {s}
verses.translation: Thy seed also would be as the sand, And the offspring of thy body like the grains thereof; His name would not be cut off Nor destroyed from before Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְא֣וּ מִבָּבֶל֮ בִּרְח֣וּ מִכַּשְׂדִּים֒ בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּ֗ה הַגִּ֤ידוּ הַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ זֹ֔את הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ עַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ אִמְר֕וּ גָּאַ֥ל יְהֹוָ֖ה עַבְדּ֥וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: ts'v mbbl brchv mkhshdym bqvl rnh hgydv hshmy'v z't hvtsy'vh 'dqtsh h'rts 'mrv g'l yhvh 'bdv y'qb
verses.translation: Go ye forth from Babylon, Flee ye from the Chaldeans; With a voice of singing Declare ye, tell this, Utter it even to the end of the earth; Say ye: ‘The LORD hath redeemed His servant Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א צָמְא֗וּ בׇּֽחֳרָבוֹת֙ הוֹלִיכָ֔ם מַ֥יִם מִצּ֖וּר הִזִּ֣יל לָ֑מוֹ וַיִּ֨בְקַע־צ֔וּר וַיָּזֻ֖בוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vl' tsm'v bchrbvt hvlykhm mym mtsvr hzyl lmv vybq'tsvr vyzbv mym
verses.translation: And they thirsted not When He led them through the deserts; He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; He cleaved the rock also, and the waters gushed out.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה לָרְשָׁעִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'yn shlvm 'mr yhvh lrsh'ym {p}
verses.translation: There is no peace, Saith the LORD concerning the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אִיִּים֙ אֵלַ֔י וְהַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ לְאֻמִּ֖ים מֵרָח֑וֹק יְהֹוָה֙ מִבֶּ֣טֶן קְרָאָ֔נִי מִמְּעֵ֥י אִמִּ֖י הִזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'yym 'ly vhqshybv l'mym mrchvq yhvh mbtn qr'ny mm'y 'my hzkhyr shmy
verses.translation: Listen, O isles, unto me, And hearken, ye peoples, from far: The LORD hath called me from the womb, From the bowels of my mother hath He made mention of my name;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם פִּי֙ כְּחֶ֣רֶב חַדָּ֔ה בְּצֵ֥ל יָד֖וֹ הֶחְבִּיאָ֑נִי וַיְשִׂימֵ֙נִי֙ לְחֵ֣ץ בָּר֔וּר בְּאַשְׁפָּת֖וֹ הִסְתִּירָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vyshm py khchrb chdh btsl ydv hchby'ny vyshymny lchts brvr b'shptv hstyrny
verses.translation: And He hath made my mouth like a sharp sword, In the shadow of His hand hath He hid me; And He hath made me a polished shaft, In His quiver hath He concealed me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֖י עַבְדִּי־אָ֑תָּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֕ל אֲשֶׁר־בְּךָ֖ אֶתְפָּאָֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ly 'bdy'th yshr'l 'shrbkh 'tp'r
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Thou art My servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לְרִ֣יק יָגַ֔עְתִּי לְתֹ֥הוּ וְהֶ֖בֶל כֹּחִ֣י כִלֵּ֑יתִי אָכֵן֙ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה וּפְעֻלָּתִ֖י אֶת־אֱלֹהָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty lryq yg'ty lthv vhbl khchy khlyty 'khn mshpty 'tyhvh vp'lty 't'lhy {s}
verses.translation: But I said: ‘I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought and vanity; Yet surely my right is with the LORD, And my recompense with my God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה יֽוֹצְרִ֤י מִבֶּ֙טֶן֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד ל֔וֹ לְשׁוֹבֵ֤ב יַֽעֲקֹב֙ אֵלָ֔יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל (לא) [ל֣וֹ] יֵאָסֵ֑ף וְאֶכָּבֵד֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וֵאלֹהַ֖י הָיָ֥ה עֻזִּֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th  'mr yhvh yvtsry mbtn l'bd lv lshvbb y'qb 'lyv vyshr'l (l') [lv] y'sf v'khbd b'yny yhvh v'lhy hyh 'zy
verses.translation: And now saith the LORD That formed me from the womb to be His servant, To bring Jacob back to Him, And that Israel be gathered unto Him— For I am honourable in the eyes of the LORD, And my God is become my strength—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָקֵ֨ל מִֽהְיוֹתְךָ֥ לִי֙ עֶ֔בֶד לְהָקִים֙ אֶת־שִׁבְטֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב (ונצירי) [וּנְצוּרֵ֥י] יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהָשִׁ֑יב וּנְתַתִּ֙יךָ֙ לְא֣וֹר גּוֹיִ֔ם לִהְי֥וֹת יְשׁוּעָתִ֖י עַד־קְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr nql mhyvtkh ly 'bd lhqym 'tshbty y'qb (vntsyry) [vntsvry] yshr'l lhshyb vnttykh l'vr gvym lhyvt yshv'ty 'dqtsh h'rts {s}
verses.translation: Yea, He saith: ‘It is too light a thing that thou shouldest be My servant To raise up the tribes of Jacob, And to restore the offspring of Israel; I will also give thee for a light of the nations, That My salvation may be unto the end of the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָֽמַר־יְהֹוָה֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קְדוֹשׁ֗וֹ לִבְזֹה־נֶ֜פֶשׁ לִמְתָ֤עֵֽב גּוֹי֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד מֹשְׁלִ֔ים מְלָכִים֙ יִרְא֣וּ וָקָ֔מוּ שָׂרִ֖ים וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֑וּ לְמַ֤עַן יְהֹוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶאֱמָ֔ן קְדֹ֥שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּבְחָרֶֽךָּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh 'mryhvh g'l yshr'l qdvshv lbzhnpsh lmt'b gvy l'bd mshlym mlkhym yr'v vqmv shrym vyshtchvv lm'n yhvh 'shr n'mn qdsh yshr'l vybchrkh {s}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, The Redeemer of Israel, his Holy One, To him who is despised of men, To him who is abhorred of nations, To a servant of rulers: Kings shall see and arise, Princes, and they shall prostrate themselves; Because of the LORD that is faithful, Even the Holy One of Israel, who hath chosen thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּעֵ֤ת רָצוֹן֙ עֲנִיתִ֔יךָ וּבְי֥וֹם יְשׁוּעָ֖ה עֲזַרְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶצׇּרְךָ֗ וְאֶתֶּנְךָ֙ לִבְרִ֣ית עָ֔ם לְהָקִ֣ים אֶ֔רֶץ לְהַנְחִ֖יל נְחָל֥וֹת שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh b't rtsvn 'nytykh vbyvm yshv'h 'zrtykh v'tsrkh v'tnkh lbryt 'm lhqym 'rts lhnchyl nchlvt shmmvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: In an acceptable time have I answered thee, And in a day of salvation have I helped thee; And I will preserve thee, and give thee For a covenant of the people, To raise up the land, To cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֤ר לַֽאֲסוּרִים֙ צֵ֔אוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּחֹ֖שֶׁךְ הִגָּל֑וּ עַל־דְּרָכִ֣ים יִרְע֔וּ וּבְכׇל־שְׁפָיִ֖ים מַרְעִיתָֽם׃
verses.translit: l'mr l'svrym ts'v l'shr bchshkh hglv 'ldrkhym yr'v vbkhlshpyym mr'ytm
verses.translation: Saying to the prisoners: ‘Go forth’; To them that are in darkness: ‘Show yourselves’; They shall feed in the ways, And in all high hills shall be their pasture;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִרְעָ֙בוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִצְמָ֔אוּ וְלֹא־יַכֵּ֥ם שָׁרָ֖ב וָשָׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּֽי־מְרַחֲמָ֣ם יְנַהֲגֵ֔ם וְעַל־מַבּ֥וּעֵי מַ֖יִם יְנַהֲלֵֽם׃
verses.translit: l' yr'bv vl' ytsm'v vl'ykhm shrb vshmsh khymrchmm ynhgm v'lmbv'y mym ynhlm
verses.translation: They shall not hunger nor thirst, Neither shall the heat nor sun smite them; For He that hath compassion on them will lead them, Even by the springs of water will He guide them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י כׇל־הָרַ֖י לַדָּ֑רֶךְ וּמְסִלֹּתַ֖י יְרֻמֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vshmty khlhry ldrkh vmslty yrmvn
verses.translation: And I will make all My mountains a way, And My highways shall be raised on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־אֵ֕לֶּה מֵרָח֖וֹק יָבֹ֑אוּ וְהִֽנֵּה־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ מִצָּפ֣וֹן וּמִיָּ֔ם וְאֵ֖לֶּה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ סִינִֽים׃
verses.translit: hnh'lh mrchvq yb'v vhnh'lh mtspvn vmym v'lh m'rts synym
verses.translation: Behold, these shall come from far; And, lo, these from the north and from the west, And these from the land of Sinim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רׇנּ֤וּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְגִ֣ילִי אָ֔רֶץ (יפצחו) [וּפִצְח֥וּ] הָרִ֖ים רִנָּ֑ה כִּֽי־נִחַ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ וַעֲנִיָּ֖יו יְרַחֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: rnv shmym vgyly 'rts (yptschv) [vptschv] hrym rnh khynchm yhvh 'mv v'nyyv yrchm {s}
verses.translation: Sing, O heavens, and be joyful, O earth, And break forth into singing, O mountains; For the LORD hath comforted His people, And hath compassion upon His afflicted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר צִיּ֖וֹן עֲזָבַ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֑ה וַאדֹנָ֖י שְׁכֵחָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr tsyvn 'zbny yhvh v'dny shkhchny
verses.translation: But Zion said: ‘The LORD hath forsaken me, And the Lord hath forgotten me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתִשְׁכַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ עוּלָ֔הּ מֵרַחֵ֖ם בֶּן־בִּטְנָ֑הּ גַּם־אֵ֣לֶּה תִשְׁכַּ֔חְנָה וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶשְׁכָּחֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: htshkhch 'shh 'vlh mrchm bnbtnh gm'lh tshkhchnh v'nkhy l' 'shkhchkh
verses.translation: Can a woman forget her sucking child, That she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yea, these may forget, Yet will not I forget thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֥ן עַל־כַּפַּ֖יִם חַקֹּתִ֑יךְ חוֹמֹתַ֥יִךְ נֶגְדִּ֖י תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: hn 'lkhpym chqtykh chvmtykh ngdy tmyd
verses.translation: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of My hands; Thy walls are continually before Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִהֲר֖וּ בָּנָ֑יִךְ מְהָֽרְסַ֥יִךְ וּמַחֲרִיבַ֖יִךְ מִמֵּ֥ךְ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: mhrv bnykh mhrsykh vmchrybykh mmkh yts'v
verses.translation: Thy children make haste; Thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth from thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאִֽי־סָבִ֤יב עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ וּרְאִ֔י כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ־לָ֑ךְ חַי־אָ֣נִי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה כִּ֤י כֻלָּם֙ כָּעֲדִ֣י תִלְבָּ֔שִׁי וּֽתְקַשְּׁרִ֖ים כַּכַּלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: sh'ysbyb 'ynykh vr'y khlm nqbtsv b'vlkh chy'ny n'myhvh khy khlm kh'dy tlbshy vtqshrym khkhlh
verses.translation: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: All these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD, Thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all as with an ornament, And gird thyself with them, like a bride.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י חׇרְבֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְשֹׁ֣מְמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְאֶ֖רֶץ הֲרִסֻתֵ֑ךְ כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ תֵּצְרִ֣י מִיּוֹשֵׁ֔ב וְרָחֲק֖וּ מְבַלְּעָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: khy chrbtykh vshmmtykh v'rts hrstkh khy 'th ttsry myvshb vrchqv mbl'ykh
verses.translation: For thy waste and thy desolate places And thy land that hath been destroyed— Surely now shalt thou be too strait for the inhabitants, And they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֚וֹד יֹאמְר֣וּ בְאׇזְנַ֔יִךְ בְּנֵ֖י שִׁכֻּלָ֑יִךְ צַר־לִ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם גְּשָׁה־לִּ֥י וְאֵשֵֽׁבָה׃
verses.translit: 'vd y'mrv b'znykh bny shkhlykh tsrly hmqvm gshhly v'shbh
verses.translation: The children of thy bereavement Shall yet say in thine ears: ‘The place is too strait for me; Give place to me that I may dwell.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣רְתְּ בִּלְבָבֵ֗ךְ מִ֤י יָֽלַד־לִי֙ אֶת־אֵ֔לֶּה וַאֲנִ֥י שְׁכוּלָ֖ה וְגַלְמוּדָ֑ה גֹּלָ֣ה  וְסוּרָ֗ה וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ מִ֣י גִדֵּ֔ל הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה אֵיפֹ֥ה הֵֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrt blbbkh my yldly 't'lh v'ny shkhvlh vglmvdh glh  vsvrh v'lh my gdl hn 'ny nsh'rty lbdy 'lh 'yph hm {p}
verses.translation: Then shalt thou say in thy heart: ‘Who hath begotten me these, Seeing I have been bereaved of my children, and am solitary, An exile, and wandering to and fro? And who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; These, where were they?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אֶשָּׂ֤א אֶל־גּוֹיִם֙ יָדִ֔י וְאֶל־עַמִּ֖ים אָרִ֣ים נִסִּ֑י וְהֵבִ֤יאוּ בָנַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּחֹ֔צֶן וּבְנֹתַ֖יִךְ עַל־כָּתֵ֥ף תִּנָּשֶֽׂאנָה׃
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'sh' 'lgvym ydy v'l'mym 'rym nsy vhby'v bnykh bchtsn vbntykh 'lkhtf tnsh'nh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations, And set up Mine ensign to the peoples, And they shall bring thy sons in their bosom, And thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ מְלָכִ֜ים אֹמְנַ֗יִךְ וְשָׂרֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ מֵינִ֣יקֹתַ֔יִךְ אַפַּ֗יִם אֶ֚רֶץ יִשְׁתַּ֣חֲווּ לָ֔ךְ וַעֲפַ֥ר רַגְלַ֖יִךְ יְלַחֵ֑כוּ וְיָדַ֙עַתְּ֙ כִּי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ קֹוָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyv mlkhym 'mnykh vshrvtyhm mynyqtykh 'pym 'rts yshtchvv lkh v'pr rglykh ylchkhv vyd't khy'ny yhvh 'shr l'ybshv qvy {s}
verses.translation: And kings shall be thy foster-fathers, And their queens thy nursing mothers; They shall bow down to thee with their face to the earth, And lick the dust of thy feet; And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, For they shall not be ashamed that wait for Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֻקַּ֥ח מִגִּבּ֖וֹר מַלְק֑וֹחַ וְאִם־שְׁבִ֥י צַדִּ֖יק יִמָּלֵֽט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hyqch mgbvr mlqvch v'mshby tsdyq ymlt {s}
verses.translation: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, Or the captives of the victorious be delivered?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁבִ֤י גִבּוֹר֙ יֻקָּ֔ח וּמַלְק֥וֹחַ עָרִ֖יץ יִמָּלֵ֑ט וְאֶת־יְרִיבֵךְ֙ אָנֹכִ֣י אָרִ֔יב וְאֶת־בָּנַ֖יִךְ אָנֹכִ֥י אוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh gmshby gbvr yqch vmlqvch 'ryts ymlt v'tyrybkh 'nkhy 'ryb v'tbnykh 'nkhy 'vshy'
verses.translation: But thus saith the LORD: Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, And the prey of the terrible shall be delivered; And I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, And I will save thy children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֤י אֶת־מוֹנַ֙יִךְ֙ אֶת־בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְכֶעָסִ֖יס דָּמָ֣ם יִשְׁכָּר֑וּן וְיָדְע֣וּ כׇל־בָּשָׂ֗ר כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔ךְ וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vh'khlty 'tmvnykh 'tbshrm vkh'sys dmm yshkhrvn vyd'v khlbshr khy 'ny yhvh mvshy'kh vg'lkh 'byr y'qb {s}
verses.translation: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; And they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine; And all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour, And thy Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵ֣י זֶ֠ה סֵ֣פֶר כְּרִית֤וּת אִמְּכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁלַּחְתִּ֔יהָ א֚וֹ מִ֣י מִנּוֹשַׁ֔י אֲשֶׁר־מָכַ֥רְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם ל֑וֹ הֵ֤ן בַּעֲוֺנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ נִמְכַּרְתֶּ֔ם וּבְפִשְׁעֵיכֶ֖ם שֻׁלְּחָ֥ה אִמְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh 'y zh spr khrytvt 'mkhm 'shr shlchtyh 'v my mnvshy 'shrmkhrty 'tkhm lv hn b'vntykhm nmkhrtm vbpsh'ykhm shlchh 'mkhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, Wherewith I have put her away? Or which of My creditors is it To whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities were ye sold, And for your transgressions was your mother put away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַדּ֨וּעַ בָּ֜אתִי וְאֵ֣ין אִ֗ישׁ קָרָ֘אתִי֮ וְאֵ֣ין עוֹנֶה֒ הֲקָצ֨וֹר קָצְרָ֤ה יָדִי֙ מִפְּד֔וּת וְאִם־אֵֽין־בִּ֥י כֹ֖חַ לְהַצִּ֑יל הֵ֣ן בְּגַעֲרָתִ֞י אַחֲרִ֣יב יָ֗ם אָשִׂ֤ים נְהָרוֹת֙ מִדְבָּ֔ר תִּבְאַ֤שׁ דְּגָתָם֙ מֵאֵ֣ין מַ֔יִם וְתָמֹ֖ת בַּצָּמָֽא׃
verses.translit: mdv' b'ty v'yn 'ysh qr'ty v'yn 'vnh hqtsvr qtsrh ydy mpdvt v'm'ynby khch lhtsyl hn bg'rty 'chryb ym 'shym nhrvt mdbr tb'sh dgtm m'yn mym vtmt btsm'
verses.translation: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? When I called, was there none to answer? Is My hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at My rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness; Their fish become foul, because there is no water, And die for thirst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלְבִּ֥ישׁ שָׁמַ֖יִם קַדְר֑וּת וְשַׂ֖ק אָשִׂ֥ים כְּסוּתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lbysh shmym qdrvt vshq 'shym khsvtm {p}
verses.translation: I clothe the heavens with blackness, And I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה נָ֤תַן לִי֙ לְשׁ֣וֹן לִמּוּדִ֔ים לָדַ֛עַת לָע֥וּת אֶת־יָעֵ֖ף דָּבָ֑ר יָעִ֣יר  בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר יָעִ֥יר לִי֙ אֹ֔זֶן לִשְׁמֹ֖עַ כַּלִּמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'dny yhvh ntn ly lshvn lmvdym ld't l'vt 'ty'f dbr y'yr  bbqr bbqr y'yr ly 'zn lshm' khlmvdym
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath given me The tongue of them that are taught, That I should know how to sustain with words him that is weary; He wakeneth morning by morning, He wakeneth mine ear To hear as they that are taught.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ פָּתַֽח־לִ֣י אֹ֔זֶן וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א מָרִ֑יתִי אָח֖וֹר לֹ֥א נְסוּגֹֽתִי׃
verses.translit: 'dny yhvh ptchly 'zn v'nkhy l' mryty 'chvr l' nsvgty
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, And I was not rebellious, Neither turned away backward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֵּוִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְמַכִּ֔ים וּלְחָיַ֖י לְמֹֽרְטִ֑ים פָּנַי֙ לֹ֣א הִסְתַּ֔רְתִּי מִכְּלִמּ֖וֹת וָרֹֽק׃
verses.translit: gvy ntty lmkhym vlchyy lmrtym pny l' hstrty mkhlmvt vrq
verses.translation: I gave my back to the smiters, And my checks to them that plucked off the hair; I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ יַֽעֲזׇר־לִ֔י עַל־כֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א נִכְלָ֑מְתִּי עַל־כֵּ֞ן שַׂ֤מְתִּי פָנַי֙ כַּחַלָּמִ֔ישׁ וָאֵדַ֖ע כִּי־לֹ֥א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'dny yhvh y'zrly 'lkhn l' nkhlmty 'lkhn shmty pny khchlmysh v'd' khyl' 'bvsh
verses.translation: For the Lord GOD will help me; Therefore have I not been confounded; Therefore have I set my face like a flint, And I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרוֹב֙ מַצְדִּיקִ֔י מִֽי־יָרִ֥יב אִתִּ֖י נַ֣עַמְדָה יָּ֑חַד מִי־בַ֥עַל מִשְׁפָּטִ֖י יִגַּ֥שׁ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: qrvb mtsdyqy myyryb 'ty n'mdh ychd myb'l mshpty ygsh 'ly
verses.translation: He is near that justifieth me; Who will contend with me? let us stand up together; Who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ יַעֲזׇר־לִ֔י מִי־ה֖וּא יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי הֵ֤ן כֻּלָּם֙ כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֔וּ עָ֖שׁ יֹאכְלֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hn 'dny yhvh y'zrly myhv' yrshy'ny hn khlm khbgd yblv 'sh y'khlm {s}
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; Who is he that shall condemn me? Behold, they all shall wax old as a garment, The moth shall eat them up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י בָכֶם֙ יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖עַ בְּק֣וֹל עַבְדּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר  הָלַ֣ךְ חֲשֵׁכִ֗ים וְאֵ֥ין נֹ֙גַהּ֙ ל֔וֹ יִבְטַח֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה וְיִשָּׁעֵ֖ן בֵּאלֹהָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: my bkhm yr' yhvh shm' bqvl 'bdv 'shr  hlkh chshkhym v'yn ngh lv ybtch bshm yhvh vysh'n b'lhyv {s}
verses.translation: Who is among you that feareth the LORD, That obeyeth the voice of His servant? Though he walketh in darkness, And hath no light, Let him trust in the name of the LORD, And stay upon his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֧ן כֻּלְּכֶ֛ם קֹ֥דְחֵי אֵ֖שׁ מְאַזְּרֵ֣י זִיק֑וֹת לְכ֣וּ  בְּא֣וּר אֶשְׁכֶ֗ם וּבְזִיקוֹת֙ בִּֽעַרְתֶּ֔ם מִיָּדִי֙ הָיְתָה־זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֔ם לְמַעֲצֵבָ֖ה תִּשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hn khlkhm qdchy 'sh m'zry zyqvt lkhv  b'vr 'shkhm vbzyqvt b'rtm mydy hythz't lkhm lm'tsbh tshkhbvn {s}
verses.translation: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, That gird yourselves with firebrands, Begone in the flame of your fire, And among the brands that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of My hand; Ye shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֛י רֹ֥דְפֵי צֶ֖דֶק מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַבִּ֙יטוּ֙ אֶל־צ֣וּר חֻצַּבְתֶּ֔ם וְאֶל־מַקֶּ֥בֶת בּ֖וֹר נֻקַּרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly rdpy tsdq mbqshy yhvh hbytv 'ltsvr chtsbtm v'lmqbt bvr nqrtm
verses.translation: Hearken to Me, ye that follow after righteousness, Ye that seek the LORD; Look unto the rock whence ye were hewn, And to the hole of the pit whence ye were digged.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבִּ֙יטוּ֙ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֣ם אֲבִיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־שָׂרָ֖ה תְּחוֹלֶלְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אֶחָ֣ד קְרָאתִ֔יו וַאֲבָרְכֵ֖הוּ וְאַרְבֵּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: hbytv 'l'brhm 'bykhm v'lshrh tchvllkhm khy'chd qr'tyv v'brkhhv v'rbhv
verses.translation: Look unto Abraham your father, And unto Sarah that bore you; For when he was but one I called him, And I blessed him, and made him many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־נִחַ֨ם יְהֹוָ֜ה צִיּ֗וֹן נִחַם֙ כׇּל־חׇרְבֹתֶ֔יהָ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם מִדְבָּרָהּ֙ כְּעֵ֔דֶן וְעַרְבָתָ֖הּ כְּגַן־יְהֹוָ֑ה שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְשִׂמְחָה֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא בָ֔הּ תּוֹדָ֖ה וְק֥וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khynchm yhvh tsyvn nchm khlchrbtyh vyshm mdbrh kh'dn v'rbth khgnyhvh shshvn vshmchh ymts' bh tvdh vqvl zmrh {s}
verses.translation: For the LORD hath comforted Zion; He hath comforted all her waste places, And hath made her wilderness like Eden, And her desert like the garden of the LORD; Joy and gladness shall be found therein, Thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבוּ אֵלַי֙ עַמִּ֔י וּלְאוּמִּ֖י אֵלַ֣י הַאֲזִ֑ינוּ כִּ֤י תוֹרָה֙ מֵאִתִּ֣י תֵצֵ֔א וּמִ֨שְׁפָּטִ֔י לְא֥וֹר עַמִּ֖ים אַרְגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: hqshybv 'ly 'my vl'vmy 'ly h'zynv khy tvrh m'ty tts' vmshpty l'vr 'mym 'rgy'
verses.translation: Attend unto Me, O My people, And give ear unto Me, O My nation; For instruction shall go forth from Me, And My right on a sudden for a light of the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָר֤וֹב צִדְקִי֙ יָצָ֣א יִשְׁעִ֔י וּזְרֹעַ֖י עַמִּ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּ֑טוּ אֵלַי֙ אִיִּ֣ים יְקַוּ֔וּ וְאֶל־זְרֹעִ֖י יְיַחֵלֽוּן׃
verses.translit: qrvb tsdqy yts' ysh'y vzr'y 'mym yshptv 'ly 'yym yqvv v'lzr'y yychlvn
verses.translation: My favour is near, My salvation is gone forth, And Mine arms shall judge the peoples; The isles shall wait for Me, And on Mine arm shall they trust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאוּ֩ לַשָּׁמַ֨יִם עֵינֵיכֶ֜ם וְֽהַבִּ֧יטוּ אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ מִתַּ֗חַת כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֜יִם כֶּעָשָׁ֤ן נִמְלָ֙חוּ֙ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ כַּבֶּ֣גֶד תִּבְלֶ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כְּמוֹ־כֵ֣ן יְמוּת֑וּן וִישֽׁוּעָתִי֙ לְעוֹלָ֣ם תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְצִדְקָתִ֖י לֹ֥א תֵחָֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: sh'v lshmym 'ynykhm vhbytv 'lh'rts mtcht khyshmym kh'shn nmlchv vh'rts khbgd tblh vyshbyh khmvkhn ymvtvn vyshv'ty l'vlm thyh vtsdqty l' tcht {p}
verses.translation: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, And look upon the earth beneath; For the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, And the earth shall wax old like a garment, And they that dwell therein shall die in like manner; But My salvation shall be for ever, And My favour shall not be abolished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַי֙ יֹ֣דְעֵי צֶ֔דֶק עַ֖ם תּוֹרָתִ֣י בְלִבָּ֑ם אַל־תִּֽירְאוּ֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת אֱנ֔וֹשׁ וּמִגִּדֻּפֹתָ֖ם אַל־תֵּחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly yd'y tsdq 'm tvrty blbm 'ltyr'v chrpt 'nvsh vmgdptm 'ltchtv
