verses.original: וְעַמֵּךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם צַדִּיקִ֔ים לְעוֹלָ֖ם יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ נֵ֧צֶר (מטעו) [מַטָּעַ֛י] מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֖י לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃
verses.translit: v'mkh khlm tsdyqym l'vlm yyrshv 'rts ntsr (mt'v) [mt'y] m'shh ydy lhtp'r
verses.translation: Thy people also shall be all righteous, They shall inherit the land for ever; The branch of My planting, the work of My hands, Wherein I glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקָּטֹן֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָאֶ֔לֶף וְהַצָּעִ֖יר לְג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּעִתָּ֥הּ אֲחִישֶֽׁנָּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hqtn yhyh l'lf vhts'yr lgvy 'tsvm 'ny yhvh b'th 'chyshnh {s}
verses.translation: The smallest shall become a thousand, And the least a mighty nation; I the LORD will hasten it in its time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֛וּחַ אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה עָלָ֑י יַ֡עַן מָשַׁח֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לְבַשֵּׂ֣ר עֲנָוִ֗ים שְׁלָחַ֙נִי֙ לַחֲבֹ֣שׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֔ב לִקְרֹ֤א לִשְׁבוּיִם֙ דְּר֔וֹר וְלַאֲסוּרִ֖ים פְּקַח־קֽוֹחַ׃
verses.translit: rvch 'dny yhvh 'ly y'n mshch yhvh 'ty lbshr 'nvym shlchny lchbsh lnshbrylb lqr' lshbvym drvr vl'svrym pqchqvch
verses.translation: The spirit of the Lord God is upon me; Because the LORD hath anointed me To bring good tidings unto the humble; He hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, To proclaim liberty to the captives, And the opening of the eyes to them that are bound;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִקְרֹ֤א שְׁנַת־רָצוֹן֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וְי֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם לֵאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְנַחֵ֖ם כׇּל־אֲבֵלִֽים׃
verses.translit: lqr' shntrtsvn lyhvh vyvm nqm l'lhynv lnchm khl'blym
verses.translation: To proclaim the year of the LORD’S good pleasure, And the day of vengeance of our God; To comfort all that mourn;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָשׂ֣וּם  לַאֲבֵלֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן לָתֵת֩ לָהֶ֨ם פְּאֵ֜ר תַּ֣חַת אֵ֗פֶר שֶׁ֤מֶן שָׂשׂוֹן֙ תַּ֣חַת אֵ֔בֶל מַעֲטֵ֣ה תְהִלָּ֔ה תַּ֖חַת ר֣וּחַ כֵּהָ֑ה וְקֹרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֵילֵ֣י הַצֶּ֔דֶק מַטַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃
verses.translit: lshvm  l'bly tsyvn ltt lhm p'r tcht 'pr shmn shshvn tcht 'bl m'th thlh tcht rvch khhh vqr' lhm 'yly htsdq mt' yhvh lhtp'r
verses.translation: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, To give unto them a garland for ashes, The oil of joy for mourning, The mantle of praise for the spirit of heaviness; That they might be called terebinths of righteousness, The planting of the LORD, wherein He might glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָנוּ֙ חׇרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם שֹׁמְמ֥וֹת רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים יְקוֹמֵ֑מוּ וְחִדְּשׁוּ֙ עָ֣רֵי חֹ֔רֶב שֹׁמְמ֖וֹת דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vbnv chrbvt 'vlm shmmvt r'shnym yqvmmv vchdshv 'ry chrb shmmvt dvr vdvr
verses.translation: And they shall build the old wastes, They shall raise up the former desolations, And they shall renew the waste cities, The desolations of many generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָמְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים וְרָע֖וּ צֹאנְכֶ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י נֵכָ֔ר אִכָּרֵיכֶ֖ם וְכֹרְמֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mdv zrym vr'v ts'nkhm vbny nkhr 'khrykhm vkhrmykhm
verses.translation: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, And aliens shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם כֹּהֲנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ תִּקָּרֵ֔אוּ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ יֵאָמֵ֖ר לָכֶ֑ם חֵ֤יל גּוֹיִם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וּבִכְבוֹדָ֖ם תִּתְיַמָּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: v'tm khhny yhvh tqr'v mshrty 'lhynv y'mr lkhm chyl gvym t'khlv vbkhbvdm ttymrv
verses.translation: But ye shall be named the priests of the LORD, Men shall call you the ministers of our God; Ye shall eat the wealth of the nations, And in their splendour shall ye revel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת בׇּשְׁתְּכֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה וּכְלִמָּ֖ה יָרֹ֣נּוּ חֶלְקָ֑ם לָכֵ֤ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֣ה יִירָ֔שׁוּ שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: tcht bshtkhm mshnh vkhlmh yrnv chlqm lkhn b'rtsm mshnh yyrshv shmcht 'vlm thyh lhm
verses.translation: For your shame which was double, And for that they rejoiced: ‘Confusion is their portion’; Therefore in their land they shall possess double, Everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֹהֵ֣ב מִשְׁפָּ֔ט שֹׂנֵ֥א גָזֵ֖ל בְּעוֹלָ֑ה וְנָתַתִּ֤י פְעֻלָּתָם֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת וּבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם אֶכְר֥וֹת לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'hb mshpt shn' gzl b'vlh vntty p'ltm b'mt vbryt 'vlm 'khrvt lhm
verses.translation: For I the LORD love justice, I hate robbery with iniquity; And I will give them their recompense in truth, And I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנוֹדַ֤ע בַּגּוֹיִם֙ זַרְעָ֔ם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעַמִּ֑ים כׇּל־רֹֽאֵיהֶם֙ יַכִּיר֔וּם כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע בֵּרַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnvd' bgvym zr'm vts'ts'yhm btvkh h'mym khlr'yhm ykhyrvm khy hm zr' brkh yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And their seed shall be known among the nations, And their offspring among the peoples; All that see them shall acknowledge them, That they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׂ֧וֹשׂ אָשִׂ֣ישׂ בַּֽיהֹוָ֗ה תָּגֵ֤ל נַפְשִׁי֙ בֵּֽאלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י הִלְבִּישַׁ֙נִי֙ בִּגְדֵי־יֶ֔שַׁע מְעִ֥יל צְדָקָ֖ה יְעָטָ֑נִי כֶּֽחָתָן֙ יְכַהֵ֣ן פְּאֵ֔ר וְכַכַּלָּ֖ה תַּעְדֶּ֥ה כֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: shvsh 'shysh byhvh tgl npshy b'lhy khy hlbyshny bgdyysh' m'yl tsdqh y'tny khchtn ykhhn p'r vkhkhlh t'dh khlyh
verses.translation: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, My soul shall be joyful in my God; For He hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, He hath covered me with the robe of victory, As a bridegroom putteth on a priestly diadem, And as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תּוֹצִ֣יא צִמְחָ֔הּ וּכְגַנָּ֖ה זֵרוּעֶ֣יהָ תַצְמִ֑יחַ כֵּ֣ן  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה יַצְמִ֤יחַ צְדָקָה֙ וּתְהִלָּ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: khy kh'rts tvtsy' tsmchh vkhgnh zrv'yh ttsmych khn  'dny yhvh ytsmych tsdqh vthlh ngd khlhgvym
verses.translation: For as the earth bringeth forth her growth, And as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; So the Lord GOD will cause victory and glory To spring forth before all the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן צִיּוֹן֙ לֹ֣א אֶחֱשֶׁ֔ה וּלְמַ֥עַן יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם לֹ֣א אֶשְׁק֑וֹט עַד־יֵצֵ֤א כַנֹּ֙גַהּ֙ צִדְקָ֔הּ וִישׁוּעָתָ֖הּ כְּלַפִּ֥יד יִבְעָֽר׃
verses.translit: lm'n tsyvn l' 'chshh vlm'n yrvshl͏m l' 'shqvt 'dyts' khngh tsdqh vyshv'th khlpyd yb'r
verses.translation: For Zion’s sake will I not hold My peace, And for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, Until her triumph go forth as brightness, And her salvation as a torch that burneth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ צִדְקֵ֔ךְ וְכׇל־מְלָכִ֖ים כְּבוֹדֵ֑ךְ וְקֹ֤רָא לָךְ֙ שֵׁ֣ם חָדָ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה יִקֳּבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vr'v gvym tsdqkh vkhlmlkhym khbvdkh vqr' lkh shm chdsh 'shr py yhvh yqbnv
verses.translation: And the nations shall see thy triumph, And all kings thy glory; And thou shalt be called by a new name, Which the mouth of the LORD shall mark out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיִ֛ית עֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּיַד־יְהֹוָ֑ה (וצנוף) [וּצְנִ֥יף] מְלוּכָ֖ה בְּכַף־אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: vhyyt 'trt tp'rt bydyhvh (vtsnvf) [vtsnyf] mlvkhh bkhf'lhykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt also be a crown of beauty in the hand of the LORD, And a royal diadem in the open hand of thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יֵאָמֵר֩ לָ֨ךְ ע֜וֹד עֲזוּבָ֗ה וּלְאַרְצֵךְ֙ לֹא־יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה כִּ֣י לָ֗ךְ יִקָּרֵא֙ חֶפְצִי־בָ֔הּ וּלְאַרְצֵ֖ךְ בְּעוּלָ֑ה כִּֽי־חָפֵ֤ץ יְהֹוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְאַרְצֵ֖ךְ תִּבָּעֵֽל׃
verses.translit: l'y'mr lkh 'vd 'zvbh vl'rtskh l'y'mr 'vd shmmh khy lkh yqr' chptsybh vl'rtskh b'vlh khychpts yhvh bkh v'rtskh tb'l
verses.translation: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken, Neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate; But thou shalt be called, My delight is in her, And thy land, Espoused; For the LORD delighteth in thee, And thy land shall be espoused.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֤ל בָּחוּר֙ בְּתוּלָ֔ה יִבְעָל֖וּךְ בָּנָ֑יִךְ וּמְשׂ֤וֹשׂ חָתָן֙ עַל־כַּלָּ֔ה יָשִׂ֥ישׂ עָלַ֖יִךְ אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: khyyb'l bchvr btvlh yb'lvkh bnykh vmshvsh chtn 'lkhlh yshysh 'lykh 'lhykh
verses.translation: For as a young man espouseth a virgin, So shall thy sons espouse thee; And as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, So shall thy God rejoice over thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־חוֹמֹתַ֣יִךְ יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם הִפְקַ֙דְתִּי֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים כׇּל־הַיּ֧וֹם וְכׇל־הַלַּ֛יְלָה תָּמִ֖יד לֹ֣א יֶחֱשׁ֑וּ הַמַּזְכִּרִים֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה אַל־דֳּמִ֖י לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lchvmtykh yrvshl͏m hpqdty shmrym khlhyvm vkhlhlylh tmyd l' ychshv hmzkhrym 'tyhvh 'ldmy lkhm
verses.translation: I have set watchmen Upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, They shall never hold their peace Day nor night: ‘Ye that are the LORD’S remembrancers, Take ye no rest,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽל־תִּתְּנ֥וּ דֳמִ֖י ל֑וֹ עַד־יְכוֹנֵ֞ן וְעַד־יָשִׂ֧ים אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם תְּהִלָּ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'lttnv dmy lv 'dykhvnn v'dyshym 'tyrvshl͏m thlh b'rts
verses.translation: And give Him no rest, Till He establish, And till He make Jerusalem A praise in the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהֹוָ֛ה בִּימִינ֖וֹ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ עֻזּ֑וֹ אִם־אֶתֵּן֩ אֶת־דְּגָנֵ֨ךְ ע֤וֹד מַֽאֲכָל֙ לְאֹ֣יְבַ֔יִךְ וְאִם־יִשְׁתּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־נֵכָר֙ תִּֽירוֹשֵׁ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגַ֖עַתְּ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh bymynv vbzrv' 'zv 'm'tn 'tdgnkh 'vd m'khl l'ybykh v'myshtv bnynkhr tyrvshkh 'shr yg't bv
verses.translation: The LORD hath sworn by His right hand, And by the arm of His strength: Surely I will no more give thy corn To be food for thine enemies; And strangers shall not drink thy wine, For which thou hast laboured;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְאַסְפָיו֙ יֹאכְלֻ֔הוּ וְהִֽלְל֖וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמְקַבְּצָ֥יו יִשְׁתֻּ֖הוּ בְּחַצְר֥וֹת קׇדְשִֽׁי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy m'spyv y'khlhv vhllv 'tyhvh vmqbtsyv yshthv bchtsrvt qdshy {s}
verses.translation: But they that have garnered it shall eat it, And praise the LORD, And they that have gathered it shall drink it In the courts of My sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְר֤וּ עִבְרוּ֙ בַּשְּׁעָרִ֔ים פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָעָ֑ם סֹ֣לּוּ סֹ֤לּוּ הַֽמְסִלָּה֙ סַקְּל֣וּ מֵאֶ֔בֶן הָרִ֥ימוּ נֵ֖ס עַל־הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'brv 'brv bsh'rym pnv drkh h'm slv slv hmslh sqlv m'bn hrymv ns 'lh'mym
verses.translation: Go through, go through the gates, Clear ye the way of the people; Cast up, cast up the highway, Gather out the stones; Lift up an ensign over the peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֗ה הִשְׁמִ֙יעַ֙ אֶל־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ אִמְרוּ֙ לְבַת־צִיּ֔וֹן הִנֵּ֥ה יִשְׁעֵ֖ךְ בָּ֑א הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hnh yhvh hshmy' 'lqtsh h'rts 'mrv lbttsyvn hnh ysh'kh b' hnh shkhrv 'tv vp'ltv lpnyv
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed Unto the end of the earth: Say ye to the daughter of Zion: ‘Behold, thy salvation cometh; Behold, His reward is with Him, And His recompense before Him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם עַם־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלָךְ֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א דְרוּשָׁ֔ה עִ֖יר לֹ֥א נֶעֱזָֽבָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vqr'v lhm 'mhqdsh g'vly yhvh vlkh yqr' drvshh 'yr l' n'zbh {s}
verses.translation: And they shall call them The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD; And thou shalt be called Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־זֶ֣ה  בָּ֣א מֵאֱד֗וֹם חֲמ֤וּץ בְּגָדִים֙ מִבׇּצְרָ֔ה זֶ֚ה הָד֣וּר בִּלְבוּשׁ֔וֹ צֹעֶ֖ה בְּרֹ֣ב כֹּח֑וֹ אֲנִ֛י מְדַבֵּ֥ר בִּצְדָקָ֖ה רַ֥ב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: myzh  b' m'dvm chmvts bgdym mbtsrh zh hdvr blbvshv ts'h brb khchv 'ny mdbr btsdqh rb lhvshy'
verses.translation: ’Who is this that cometh from Edom, with crimsoned garments from Bozrah? This that is glorious in his apparel, stately in the greatness of his strength?’— ’I that speak in victory, mighty to save.’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַדּ֥וּעַ אָדֹ֖ם לִלְבוּשֶׁ֑ךָ וּבְגָדֶ֖יךָ כְּדֹרֵ֥ךְ בְּגַֽת׃
verses.translit: mdv' 'dm llbvshkh vbgdykh khdrkh bgt
verses.translation: ’Wherefore is Thine apparel red, and Thy garments like his that treadeth in the winevat?’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פּוּרָ֣ה  דָּרַ֣כְתִּי לְבַדִּ֗י וּמֵֽעַמִּים֙ אֵֽין־אִ֣ישׁ אִתִּ֔י וְאֶדְרְכֵ֣ם בְּאַפִּ֔י וְאֶרְמְסֵ֖ם בַּחֲמָתִ֑י וְיֵ֤ז נִצְחָם֙ עַל־בְּגָדַ֔י וְכׇל־מַלְבּוּשַׁ֖י אֶגְאָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translit: pvrh  drkhty lbdy vm'mym 'yn'ysh 'ty v'drkhm b'py v'rmsm bchmty vyz ntschm 'lbgdy vkhlmlbvshy 'g'lty
verses.translation: ’I have trodden the winepress alone, and of the peoples there was no man with Me; yea, I trod them in Mine anger, and trampled them in My fury; and their lifeblood is dashed against My garments, and I have stained all My raiment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם בְּלִבִּ֑י וּשְׁנַ֥ת גְּאוּלַ֖י בָּֽאָה׃
verses.translit: khy yvm nqm blby vshnt g'vly b'h
verses.translation: For the day of vengeance that was in My heart, and My year of redemption are come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבִּיט֙ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵ֔ר וְאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין סוֹמֵ֑ךְ וַתּ֤וֹשַֽׁע־לִי֙ זְרֹעִ֔י וַחֲמָתִ֖י הִ֥יא סְמָכָֽתְנִי׃
verses.translit: v'byt v'yn 'zr v'shtvmm v'yn svmkh vtvsh'ly zr'y vchmty hy' smkhtny
verses.translation: And I looked, and there was none to help, and I beheld in astonishment, and there was none to uphold; therefore Mine own arm brought salvation unto Me, And My fury, it upheld Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָב֤וּס עַמִּים֙ בְּאַפִּ֔י וַאֲשַׁכְּרֵ֖ם בַּחֲמָתִ֑י וְאוֹרִ֥יד לָאָ֖רֶץ נִצְחָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'bvs 'mym b'py v'shkhrm bchmty v'vryd l'rts ntschm {s}
verses.translation: And I trod down the peoples in Mine anger, and made them drunk with My fury, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַֽסְדֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אַזְכִּיר֙ תְּהִלֹּ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה כְּעַ֕ל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־גְּמָלָ֖נוּ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְרַב־טוּב֙ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־גְּמָלָ֥ם כְּֽרַחֲמָ֖יו וּכְרֹ֥ב חֲסָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: chsdy yhvh  'zkhyr thlt yhvh kh'l khl 'shrgmlnv yhvh vrbtvb lbyt yshr'l 'shrgmlm khrchmyv vkhrb chsdyv
verses.translation: I will make mention of the mercies of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us; and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which He hath bestowed on them according to His compassions, and according to the multitude of His mercies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַךְ־עַמִּ֣י הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְשַׁקֵּ֑רוּ וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְמוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'kh'my hmh bnym l' yshqrv vyhy lhm lmvshy'
verses.translation: For He said: ‘Surely, they are My people, children that will not deal falsely’; so He was their Saviour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּֽכׇל־צָרָתָ֣ם  (לא) [ל֣וֹ] צָ֗ר וּמַלְאַ֤ךְ פָּנָיו֙ הוֹשִׁיעָ֔ם בְּאַהֲבָת֥וֹ וּבְחֶמְלָת֖וֹ ה֣וּא גְאָלָ֑ם וַֽיְנַטְּלֵ֥ם וַֽיְנַשְּׂאֵ֖ם כׇּל־יְמֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: bkhltsrtm  (l') [lv] tsr vml'kh pnyv hvshy'm b'hbtv vbchmltv hv' g'lm vyntlm vynsh'm khlymy 'vlm
verses.translation: In all their affliction He was afflicted, and the angel of His presence saved them; in His love and in His pity He redeemed them; And He bore them, and carried them all the days of old. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֛מָּה מָר֥וּ וְעִצְּב֖וּ אֶת־ר֣וּחַ קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ וַיֵּהָפֵ֥ךְ לָהֶ֛ם לְאוֹיֵ֖ב ה֥וּא נִלְחַם־בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhmh mrv v'tsbv 'trvch qdshv vyhpkh lhm l'vyb hv' nlchmbm
verses.translation: But they rebelled, and grieved His holy spirit; therefore He was turned to be their enemy, Himself fought against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר יְמֵֽי־עוֹלָ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ אַיֵּ֣ה  הַֽמַּעֲלֵ֣ם מִיָּ֗ם אֵ֚ת רֹעֵ֣י צֹאנ֔וֹ אַיֵּ֛ה הַשָּׂ֥ם בְּקִרְבּ֖וֹ אֶת־ר֥וּחַ קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyzkhr ymy'vlm mshh 'mv 'yh  hm'lm mym 't r'y ts'nv 'yh hshm bqrbv 'trvch qdshv
verses.translation: Then His people remembered the days of old, the days of Moses: ‘Where is He that brought them up out of the sea With the shepherds of His flock? Where is He that put His holy spirit In the midst of them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹלִיךְ֙ לִימִ֣ין מֹשֶׁ֔ה זְר֖וֹעַ תִּפְאַרְתּ֑וֹ בּ֤וֹקֵֽעַ מַ֙יִם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ שֵׁ֥ם עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: mvlykh lymyn mshh zrv' tp'rtv bvq' mym mpnyhm l'shvt lv shm 'vlm
verses.translation: That caused His glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses? That divided the water before them, To make Himself an everlasting name?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מוֹלִיכָ֖ם בַּתְּהֹמ֑וֹת כַּסּ֥וּס בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֥א יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
verses.translit: mvlykhm bthmvt khsvs bmdbr l' ykhshlv
verses.translation: That led them through the deep, as a horse in the wilderness, without stumbling?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּבְּהֵמָה֙ בַּבִּקְעָ֣ה תֵרֵ֔ד ר֥וּחַ יְהֹוָ֖ה תְּנִיחֶ֑נּוּ כֵּ֚ן נִהַ֣גְתָּ עַמְּךָ֔ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְךָ֖ שֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאָֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: khbhmh bbq'h trd rvch yhvh tnychnv khn nhgt 'mkh l'shvt lkh shm tp'rt
verses.translation: As the cattle that go down into the valley, the spirit of the LORD caused them to rest; So didst Thou lead Thy people, To make Thyself a glorious name.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבֵּ֤ט מִשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מִזְּבֻ֥ל קׇדְשְׁךָ֖ וְתִפְאַרְתֶּ֑ךָ אַיֵּ֤ה קִנְאָֽתְךָ֙ וּגְב֣וּרֹתֶ֔ךָ הֲמ֥וֹן מֵעֶ֛יךָ וְֽרַחֲמֶ֖יךָ אֵלַ֥י הִתְאַפָּֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: hbt mshmym vr'h mzbl qdshkh vtp'rtkh 'yh qn'tkh vgbvrtkh hmvn m'ykh vrchmykh 'ly ht'pqv
verses.translation: Look down from heaven, and see, even from Thy holy and glorious habitation; Where is Thy zeal and Thy mighty acts, The yearning of Thy heart and Thy compassions, Now restrained toward me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אָבִ֔ינוּ כִּ֤י אַבְרָהָם֙ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֔נוּ וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יַכִּירָ֑נוּ אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אָבִ֔ינוּ גֹּאֲלֵ֥נוּ מֵעוֹלָ֖ם שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khy'th 'bynv khy 'brhm l' yd'nv vyshr'l l' ykhyrnv 'th yhvh 'bynv g'lnv m'vlm shmkh
verses.translation: For Thou art our Father; for Abraham knoweth us not, and Israel doth not acknowledge us; Thou, O LORD, art our Father, Our Redeemer from everlasting is Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה תַתְעֵ֤נוּ יְהֹוָה֙ מִדְּרָכֶ֔יךָ תַּקְשִׁ֥יחַ לִבֵּ֖נוּ מִיִּרְאָתֶ֑ךָ שׁ֚וּב לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ שִׁבְטֵ֖י נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lmh tt'nv yhvh mdrkhykh tqshych lbnv myr'tkh shvb lm'n 'bdykh shbty nchltkh
verses.translation: O LORD, why dost Thou make us to err from Thy ways, And hardenest our heart from Thy fear? Return for Thy servants’sake, The tribes of Thine inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמִּצְעָ֕ר יָרְשׁ֖וּ עַם־קׇדְשֶׁ֑ךָ צָרֵ֕ינוּ בּוֹסְס֖וּ מִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: lmts'r yrshv 'mqdshkh tsrynv bvssv mqdshkh
verses.translation: Thy holy people they have well nigh driven out, Our adversaries have trodden down Thy sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיִ֗ינוּ מֵֽעוֹלָם֙ לֹא־מָשַׁ֣לְתָּ בָּ֔ם לֹֽא־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם לֽוּא־קָרַ֤עְתָּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃
verses.translit: hyynv m'vlm l'mshlt bm l'nqr' shmkh 'lyhm lv'qr't shmym yrdt mpnykh hrym nzlv
verses.translation: We are become as they over whom Thou never borest rule, As they that were not called by Thy name. Oh, that Thou wouldest rend the heavens, that Thou wouldest come down, That the mountains might quake at Thy presence,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּקְדֹ֧חַ אֵ֣שׁ הֲמָסִ֗ים מַ֚יִם תִּבְעֶה־אֵ֔שׁ לְהוֹדִ֥יעַ שִׁמְךָ֖ לְצָרֶ֑יךָ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ גּוֹיִ֥ם יִרְגָּֽזוּ׃
verses.translit: khqdch 'sh hmsym mym tb'h'sh lhvdy' shmkh ltsrykh mpnykh gvym yrgzv
verses.translation: As when fire kindleth the brush-wood, and the fire causeth the waters to boil; to make Thy name known to Thine adversaries, that the nations might tremble at Thy presence,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ֥ נוֹרָא֖וֹת לֹ֣א נְקַוֶּ֑ה יָרַ֕דְתָּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b'shvtkh nvr'vt l' nqvh yrdt mpnykh hrym nzlv {s}
verses.translation: when Thou didst tremendous things which we looked not for— Oh that Thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might quake at Thy presence!—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־שָׁמְע֖וּ לֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ עַ֣יִן לֹֽא־רָאָ֗תָה אֱלֹהִים֙ זוּלָ֣תְךָ֔ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִמְחַכֵּה־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vm'vlm l'shm'v l' h'zynv 'yn l'r'th 'lhym zvltkh y'shh lmchkhhlv
verses.translation: And whereof from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen a God beside Thee, who worketh for him that waiteth for Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּגַ֤עְתָּ אֶת־שָׂשׂ֙ וְעֹ֣שֵׂה צֶ֔דֶק בִּדְרָכֶ֖יךָ יִזְכְּר֑וּךָ הֵן־אַתָּ֤ה קָצַ֙פְתָּ֙ וַֽנֶּחֱטָ֔א בָּהֶ֥ם עוֹלָ֖ם וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: pg't 'tshsh v'shh tsdq bdrkhykh yzkhrvkh hn'th qtspt vncht' bhm 'vlm vnvsh'
verses.translation: Thou didst take away him that joyfully worked righteousness, those that remembered Thee in Thy ways— Behold, Thou wast wroth, and we sinned— Upon them have we stayed of old, that we might be saved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנְּהִ֤י כַטָּמֵא֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וּכְבֶ֥גֶד עִדִּ֖ים כׇּל־צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ וַנָּ֤בֶל כֶּֽעָלֶה֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַעֲוֺנֵ֖נוּ כָּר֥וּחַ יִשָּׂאֻֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vnhy khtm' khlnv vkhbgd 'dym khltsdqtynv vnbl kh'lh khlnv v'vnnv khrvch ysh'nv
verses.translation: And we are all become as one that is unclean, and all our righteousnesses are as a polluted garment; and we all do fade as a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵין־קוֹרֵ֣א בְשִׁמְךָ֔ מִתְעוֹרֵ֖ר לְהַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־הִסְתַּ֤רְתָּ פָנֶ֙יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וַתְּמוּגֵ֖נוּ בְּיַד־עֲוֺנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ynqvr' bshmkh mt'vrr lhchzyq bkh khyhstrt pnykh mmnv vtmvgnv byd'vnnv
verses.translation: And there is none that calleth upon Thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of Thee; for Thou hast hid Thy face from us, and hast consumed us by means of our iniquities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אָבִ֣ינוּ אָ֑תָּה אֲנַ֤חְנוּ הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה יֹצְרֵ֔נוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְךָ֖ כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'bynv 'th 'nchnv hchmr v'th ytsrnv vm'shh ydkh khlnv
verses.translation: But now, O LORD, Thou art our Father; we are the clay, and Thou our potter, and we all are the work of Thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּקְצֹ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ עַד־מְאֹ֔ד וְאַל־לָעַ֖ד תִּזְכֹּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן הֵ֥ן הַבֶּט־נָ֖א עַמְּךָ֥ כֻלָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ltqtsf yhvh 'dm'd v'll'd tzkhr 'vn hn hbtn' 'mkh khlnv
verses.translation: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever; behold, look, we beseech Thee, we are all Thy people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָרֵ֥י קׇדְשְׁךָ֖ הָי֣וּ מִדְבָּ֑ר צִיּוֹן֙ מִדְבָּ֣ר הָיָ֔תָה יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ry qdshkh hyv mdbr tsyvn mdbr hyth yrvshl͏m shmmh
verses.translation: Thy holy cities are become a wilderness, Zion is become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֧ית קׇדְשֵׁ֣נוּ וְתִפְאַרְתֵּ֗נוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִֽלְל֙וּךָ֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ הָיָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵ֣פַת אֵ֑שׁ וְכׇל־מַחֲמַדֵּ֖ינוּ הָיָ֥ה לְחׇרְבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: byt qdshnv vtp'rtnv 'shr hllvkh 'btynv hyh lshrpt 'sh vkhlmchmdynv hyh lchrbh
verses.translation: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised Thee, is burned with fire; and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעַל־אֵ֥לֶּה תִתְאַפַּ֖ק יְהֹוָ֑ה תֶּחֱשֶׁ֥ה וּתְעַנֵּ֖נוּ עַד־מְאֹֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: h'l'lh tt'pq yhvh tchshh vt'nnv 'dm'd {p}
verses.translation: Wilt Thou refrain Thyself for these things, O LORD? Wilt Thou hold Thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִדְרַ֙שְׁתִּי֙ לְל֣וֹא שָׁאָ֔לוּ נִמְצֵ֖אתִי לְלֹ֣א בִקְשֻׁ֑נִי אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ הִנֵּ֣נִי הִנֵּ֔נִי אֶל־גּ֖וֹי לֹא־קֹרָ֥א בִשְׁמִֽי׃
verses.translit: ndrshty llv' sh'lv nmts'ty ll' bqshny 'mrty hnny hnny 'lgvy l'qr' bshmy
verses.translation: I gave access to them that asked not for Me, I was at hand to them that sought Me not; I said: ‘Behold Me, behold Me’, unto a nation that was not called by My name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֵּרַ֧שְׂתִּי יָדַ֛י כׇּל־הַיּ֖וֹם אֶל־עַ֣ם סוֹרֵ֑ר הַהֹֽלְכִים֙ הַדֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ט֔וֹב אַחַ֖ר מַחְשְׁבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: prshty ydy khlhyvm 'l'm svrr hhlkhym hdrkh l'tvb 'chr mchshbtyhm
verses.translation: I have spread out My hands all the day unto a rebellious people, that walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָעָ֗ם הַמַּכְעִסִ֥ים אֹתִ֛י עַל־פָּנַ֖י תָּמִ֑יד זֹֽבְחִים֙ בַּגַּנּ֔וֹת וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים עַל־הַלְּבֵנִֽים׃
verses.translit: h'm hmkh'sym 'ty 'lpny tmyd zbchym bgnvt vmqtrym 'lhlbnym
verses.translation: A people that provoke Me to My face continually, that sacrifice in gardens, and burn incense upon bricks;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בַּקְּבָרִ֔ים וּבַנְּצוּרִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ הָאֹֽכְלִים֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַחֲזִ֔יר (ופרק) [וּמְרַ֥ק] פִּגֻּלִ֖ים כְּלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hyshbym bqbrym vbntsvrym ylynv h'khlym bshr hchzyr (vprq) [vmrq] pglym khlyhm
verses.translation: That sit among the graves, and lodge in the vaults; that eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ קְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־תִּגַּשׁ־בִּ֖י כִּ֣י קְדַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אֵ֚לֶּה עָשָׁ֣ן בְּאַפִּ֔י אֵ֥שׁ יֹקֶ֖דֶת כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: h'mrym qrb 'lykh 'ltgshby khy qdshtykh 'lh 'shn b'py 'sh yqdt khlhyvm
verses.translation: That say: ‘Stand by thyself, come not near to me, for I am holier than thou’; these are a smoke in My nose, a fire that burneth all the day. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה כְתוּבָ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י לֹ֤א אֶֽחֱשֶׁה֙ כִּ֣י אִם־שִׁלַּ֔מְתִּי וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֖י עַל־חֵיקָֽם׃
verses.translit: hnh khtvbh lpny l' 'chshh khy 'mshlmty vshlmty 'lchyqm
verses.translation: Behold, it is written before Me; I will not keep silence, except I have requited, Yea, I will requite into their bosom,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲ֠וֺנֹֽתֵיכֶ֠ם וַעֲוֺנֹ֨ת אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ֙ עַל־הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים וְעַל־הַגְּבָע֖וֹת חֵרְפ֑וּנִי וּמַדֹּתִ֧י פְעֻלָּתָ֛ם רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה (על) [אֶל־]חֵיקָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'vntykhm v'vnt 'bvtykhm ychdv 'mr yhvh 'shr qtrv 'lhhrym v'lhgb'vt chrpvny vmdty p'ltm r'shnh ('l) ['l]chyqm {s}
verses.translation: Your own iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, that have offered upon the mountains, and blasphemed Me upon the hills; therefore will I first measure their wage into their bosom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א הַתִּירוֹשׁ֙ בָּֽאֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל וְאָמַר֙ אַל־תַּשְׁחִיתֵ֔הוּ כִּ֥י בְרָכָ֖ה בּ֑וֹ כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדַ֔י לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַֽשְׁחִ֥ית הַכֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh kh'shr ymts' htyrvsh b'shkhvl v'mr 'ltshchythv khy brkhh bv khn ''shh lm'n 'bdy lblty hshchyt hkhl
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: As, when wine is found in the cluster, One saith: ‘Destroy it not, For a blessing is in it’; So will I do for My servants’ sakes, That I may not destroy all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י מִֽיַּעֲקֹב֙ זֶ֔רַע וּמִֽיהוּדָ֖ה יוֹרֵ֣שׁ הָרָ֑י וִירֵשׁ֣וּהָ בְחִירַ֔י וַעֲבָדַ֖י יִשְׁכְּנוּ־שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vhvts'ty my'qb zr' vmyhvdh yvrsh hry vyrshvh bchyry v'bdy yshkhnvshmh
verses.translation: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of My mountains; and Mine elect shall inherit it, And My servants shall dwell there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ לִנְוֵה־צֹ֔אן וְעֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְרֵ֣בֶץ בָּקָ֑ר לְעַמִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר דְּרָשֽׁוּנִי׃
verses.translit: vhyh hshrvn lnvhts'n v'mq 'khvr lrbts bqr l'my 'shr drshvny
verses.translation: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for My people that have sought Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹזְבֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה הַשְּׁכֵחִ֖ים אֶת־הַ֣ר קׇדְשִׁ֑י הַעֹרְכִ֤ים לַגַּד֙ שֻׁלְחָ֔ן וְהַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים לַמְנִ֥י מִמְסָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'tm 'zby yhvh hshkhchym 'thr qdshy h'rkhym lgd shlchn vhmml'ym lmny mmskh
verses.translation: But ye that forsake the LORD, That forget My holy mountain, That prepare a table for Fortune, And that offer mingled wine in full measure unto Destiny,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָנִ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם לַחֶ֗רֶב וְכֻלְּכֶם֙ לַטֶּ֣בַח תִּכְרָ֔עוּ יַ֤עַן קָרָ֙אתִי֙ וְלֹ֣א עֲנִיתֶ֔ם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַתַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־חָפַ֖צְתִּי בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmnyty 'tkhm lchrb vkhlkhm ltbch tkhr'v y'n qr'ty vl' 'nytm dbrty vl' shm'tm vt'shv hr' b'yny vb'shr l'chptsty bchrtm {p}
verses.translation: I will destine you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, ye did not answer, when I spoke, ye did not hear; But ye did that which was evil in Mine eyes, And chose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה עֲבָדַ֤י ׀ יֹאכֵ֙לוּ֙ וְאַתֶּ֣ם תִּרְעָ֔בוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יִשְׁתּ֖וּ וְאַתֶּ֣ם תִּצְמָ֑אוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יִשְׂמָ֖חוּ וְאַתֶּ֥ם תֵּבֹֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr  'dny yhvh hnh 'bdy  y'khlv v'tm tr'bv hnh 'bdy yshtv v'tm ttsm'v hnh 'bdy yshmchv v'tm tbshv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, My servants shall eat, But ye shall be hungry; Behold, My servants shall drink, But ye shall be thirsty; Behold, My servants shall rejoice, But ye shall be ashamed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יָרֹ֖נּוּ מִטּ֣וּב לֵ֑ב וְאַתֶּ֤ם תִּצְעֲקוּ֙ מִכְּאֵ֣ב לֵ֔ב וּמִשֵּׁ֥בֶר ר֖וּחַ תְּיֵלִֽילוּ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'bdy yrnv mtvb lb v'tm tts'qv mkh'b lb vmshbr rvch tylylv
verses.translation: Behold, My servants shall sing For joy of heart, But ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, And shall wail for vexation of spirit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנַּחְתֶּ֨ם שִׁמְכֶ֤ם לִשְׁבוּעָה֙ לִבְחִירַ֔י וֶהֱמִֽיתְךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה וְלַעֲבָדָ֥יו יִקְרָ֖א שֵׁ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vhnchtm shmkhm lshbv'h lbchyry vhmytkh 'dny yhvh vl'bdyv yqr' shm 'chr
verses.translation: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto Mine elect: ‘So may the Lord GOD slay thee’; But He shall call His servants by another name;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַמִּתְבָּרֵ֜ךְ בָּאָ֗רֶץ יִתְבָּרֵךְ֙ בֵּאלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֔ן וְהַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בָּאָ֔רֶץ יִשָּׁבַ֖ע בֵּאלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֑ן כִּ֣י נִשְׁכְּח֗וּ הַצָּרוֹת֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְכִ֥י נִסְתְּר֖וּ מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shr hmtbrkh b'rts ytbrkh b'lhy 'mn vhnshb' b'rts yshb' b'lhy 'mn khy nshkhchv htsrvt hr'shnvt vkhy nstrv m'yny
verses.translation: So that he who blesseth himself in the earth Shall bless himself by the God of truth; And he that sweareth in the earth Shall swear by the God of truth; Because the former troubles are forgotten, And because they are hid from Mine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנְנִ֥י בוֹרֵ֛א שָׁמַ֥יִם חֲדָשִׁ֖ים וָאָ֣רֶץ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תִזָּכַ֙רְנָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְלֹ֥א תַעֲלֶ֖ינָה עַל־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: khyhnny bvr' shmym chdshym v'rts chdshh vl' tzkhrnh hr'shnvt vl' t'lynh 'llb
verses.translation: For, behold, I create new heavens And a new earth; And the former things shall not be remembered, Nor come into mind. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אִם־שִׂ֤ישֽׂוּ וְגִ֙ילוּ֙ עֲדֵי־עַ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֣י בוֹרֵ֑א כִּי֩ הִנְנִ֨י בוֹרֵ֧א אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם גִּילָ֖הֿ וְעַמָּ֥הּ מָשֽׂוֹשׂ׃
verses.translit: khy'mshyshv vgylv 'dy'd 'shr 'ny bvr' khy hnny bvr' 'tyrvshl͏m gylh v'mh mshvsh
verses.translation: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever In that which I create; For, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, And her people a joy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַלְתִּ֥י בִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֣י בְעַמִּ֑י וְלֹא־יִשָּׁמַ֥ע בָּהּ֙ ע֔וֹד ק֥וֹל בְּכִ֖י וְק֥וֹל זְעָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vglty byrvshl͏m vshshty b'my vl'yshm' bh 'vd qvl bkhy vqvl z'qh
verses.translation: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, And joy in My people; And the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, Nor the voice of crying.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֨ה מִשָּׁ֜ם ע֗וֹד ע֤וּל יָמִים֙ וְזָקֵ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת־יָמָ֑יו כִּ֣י הַנַּ֗עַר בֶּן־מֵאָ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יָמ֔וּת וְהַ֣חוֹטֶ֔א בֶּן־מֵאָ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה יְקֻלָּֽל׃
verses.translit: l'yhyh mshm 'vd 'vl ymym vzqn 'shr l'yml' 'tymyv khy hn'r bnm'h shnh ymvt vhchvt' bnm'h shnh yqll
verses.translation: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man, That hath not filled his days; For the youngest shall die a hundred years old, And the sinner being a hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָנ֥וּ בָתִּ֖ים וְיָשָׁ֑בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְאָכְל֖וּ פִּרְיָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbnv btym vyshbv vnt'v khrmym v'khlv prym
verses.translation: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; And they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִבְנוּ֙ וְאַחֵ֣ר יֵשֵׁ֔ב לֹ֥א יִטְּע֖וּ וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל כִּֽי־כִימֵ֤י הָעֵץ֙ יְמֵ֣י עַמִּ֔י וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם יְבַלּ֥וּ בְחִירָֽי׃
verses.translit: l' ybnv v'chr yshb l' yt'v v'chr y'khl khykhymy h'ts ymy 'my vm'shh ydyhm yblv bchyry
verses.translation: They shall not build, and another inhabit, They shall not plant, and another eat; For as the days of a tree shall be the days of My people, And Mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִֽיגְעוּ֙ לָרִ֔יק וְלֹ֥א יֵלְד֖וּ לַבֶּהָלָ֑ה כִּ֣י זֶ֜רַע בְּרוּכֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם אִתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: l' yyg'v lryq vl' yldv lbhlh khy zr' brvkhy yhvh hmh vts'ts'yhm 'tm
verses.translation: They shall not labour in vain, Nor bring forth for terror; For they are the seed blessed of the LORD, And their offspring with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה טֶרֶם־יִקְרָ֖אוּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה ע֛וֹד הֵ֥ם מְדַבְּרִ֖ים וַאֲנִ֥י אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: vhyh trmyqr'v v'ny ''nh 'vd hm mdbrym v'ny 'shm'
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass that, before they call, I will answer, And while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְאֵ֨ב וְטָלֶ֜ה יִרְע֣וּ כְאֶחָ֗ד וְאַרְיֵה֙ כַּבָּקָ֣ר יֹאכַל־תֶּ֔בֶן וְנָחָ֖שׁ עָפָ֣ר לַחְמ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יָרֵ֧עוּ וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁחִ֛יתוּ בְּכׇל־הַ֥ר קׇדְשִׁ֖י אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: z'b vtlh yr'v kh'chd v'ryh khbqr y'khltbn vnchsh 'pr lchmv l'yr'v vl'yshchytv bkhlhr qdshy 'mr yhvh {s}
verses.translation: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, And the lion shall eat straw like the ox; And dust shall be the serpent’s food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כִּסְאִ֔י וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֲדֹ֣ם רַגְלָ֑י אֵי־זֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּבְנוּ־לִ֔י וְאֵי־זֶ֥ה מָק֖וֹם מְנוּחָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hshmym khs'y vh'rts hdm rgly 'yzh byt 'shr tbnvly v'yzh mqvm mnvchty
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: The heaven is My throne, and the earth is My footstool; where is the house that ye may build unto Me? And where is the place that may be My resting-place?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ יָדִ֣י עָשָׂ֔תָה וַיִּהְי֥וּ כׇל־אֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶל־זֶ֣ה אַבִּ֔יט אֶל־עָנִי֙ וּנְכֵה־ר֔וּחַ וְחָרֵ֖ד עַל־דְּבָרִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'tkhl'lh ydy 'shth vyhyv khl'lh n'myhvh v'lzh 'byt 'l'ny vnkhhrvch vchrd 'ldbry
verses.translation: For all these things hath My hand made, and so all these things came to be, saith the LORD; but on this man will I look, even on him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at My word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹחֵ֨ט הַשּׁ֜וֹר מַכֵּה־אִ֗ישׁ זוֹבֵ֤חַ הַשֶּׂה֙ עֹ֣רֵֽף כֶּ֔לֶב מַעֲלֵ֤ה מִנְחָה֙ דַּם־חֲזִ֔יר מַזְכִּ֥יר לְבֹנָ֖ה מְבָ֣רֵֽךְ אָ֑וֶן גַּם־הֵ֗מָּה בָּֽחֲרוּ֙ בְּדַרְכֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְשִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם נַפְשָׁ֥ם חָפֵֽצָה׃
verses.translit: shvcht hshvr mkhh'ysh zvbch hshh 'rf khlb m'lh mnchh dmchzyr mzkhyr lbnh mbrkh 'vn gmhmh bchrv bdrkhyhm vbshqvtsyhm npshm chptsh
verses.translation: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he broke a dog’s neck; He that offereth a meal-offering, as if he offered swine’s blood; he that maketh a memorial-offering of frankincense, as if he blessed an idol; according as they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אֲנִ֞י אֶבְחַ֣ר בְּתַעֲלֻלֵיהֶ֗ם וּמְגֽוּרֹתָם֙ אָבִ֣יא לָהֶ֔ם יַ֤עַן קָרָ֙אתִי֙ וְאֵ֣ין עוֹנֶ֔ה דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־חָפַ֖צְתִּי בָּחָֽרוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gm'ny 'bchr bt'llyhm vmgvrtm 'by' lhm y'n qr'ty v'yn 'vnh dbrty vl' shm'v vy'shv hr' b'yny vb'shr l'chptsty bchrv {s}
verses.translation: Even so I will choose their mockings, And will bring their fears upon them; Because when I called, none did answer; When I spoke, they did not hear, But they did that which was evil in Mine eyes, And chose that in which I delighted not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה הַחֲרֵדִ֖ים אֶל־דְּבָר֑וֹ אָמְרוּ֩ אֲחֵיכֶ֨ם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶ֜ם מְנַדֵּיכֶ֗ם לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ יִכְבַּ֣ד יְהֹוָ֔ה וְנִרְאֶ֥ה בְשִׂמְחַתְכֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם יֵבֹֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: shm'v dbryhvh hchrdym 'ldbrv 'mrv 'chykhm shn'ykhm mndykhm lm'n shmy ykhbd yhvh vnr'h bshmchtkhm vhm ybshv
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD, Ye that tremble at His word: Your brethren that hate you, that cast you out for My name’s sake, have said: ‘Let the LORD be glorified, That we may gaze upon your joy’, But they shall be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֤וֹל שָׁאוֹן֙ מֵעִ֔יר ק֖וֹל מֵהֵיכָ֑ל ק֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֔ה מְשַׁלֵּ֥ם גְּמ֖וּל לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.translit: qvl sh'vn m'yr qvl mhykhl qvl yhvh mshlm gmvl l'ybyv
verses.translation: Hark! an uproar from the city, Hark! it cometh from the temple, Hark! the LORD rendereth recompense to His enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּחִ֖יל יָלָ֑דָה בְּטֶ֨רֶם יָב֥וֹא חֵ֛בֶל לָ֖הּ וְהִמְלִ֥יטָה זָכָֽר׃
verses.translit: btrm tchyl yldh btrm ybv' chbl lh vhmlyth zkhr
verses.translation: Before she travailed, she brought forth; Before her pain came, She was delivered of a man-child.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־שָׁמַ֣ע כָּזֹ֗את מִ֤י רָאָה֙ כָּאֵ֔לֶּה הֲי֤וּחַל אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּי֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד אִם־יִוָּ֥לֵֽד־גּ֖וֹי פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כִּי־חָ֛לָה גַּם־יָלְדָ֥ה צִיּ֖וֹן אֶת־בָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: myshm' khz't my r'h kh'lh hyvchl 'rts byvm 'chd 'myvldgvy p'm 'cht khychlh gmyldh tsyvn 'tbnyh
verses.translation: Who hath heard such a thing? Who hath seen such things? Is a land born in one day? Is a nation brought forth at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, She brought forth her children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֲנִ֥י אַשְׁבִּ֛יר וְלֹ֥א אוֹלִ֖יד יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה אִם־אֲנִ֧י הַמּוֹלִ֛יד וְעָצַ֖רְתִּי אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'ny 'shbyr vl' 'vlyd y'mr yhvh 'm'ny hmvlyd v'tsrty 'mr 'lhykh {s}
verses.translation: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? Saith the LORD; Shall I that cause to bring forth shut the womb? Saith thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂמְח֧וּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם וְגִ֥ילוּ בָ֖הּ כׇּל־אֹהֲבֶ֑יהָ שִׂ֤ישׂוּ אִתָּהּ֙ מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ כׇּל־הַמִּֽתְאַבְּלִ֖ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: shmchv 'tyrvshl͏m vgylv bh khl'hbyh shyshv 'th mshvsh khlhmt'blym 'lyh
verses.translation: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, And be glad with her, all ye that love her; Rejoice for joy with her, All ye that mourn for her;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽינְקוּ֙ וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֔ם מִשֹּׁ֖ד תַּנְחֻמֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֧עַן תָּמֹ֛צּוּ וְהִתְעַנַּגְתֶּ֖ם מִזִּ֥יז כְּבוֹדָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lm'n tynqv vshb'tm mshd tnchmyh lm'n tmtsv vht'ngtm mzyz khbvdh {s}
verses.translation: That ye may suck, and be satisfied With the breast of her consolations; That ye may drink deeply with delight Of the abundance of her glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹטֶֽה־אֵ֠לֶ֠יהָ כְּנָהָ֨ר שָׁל֜וֹם וּכְנַ֧חַל שׁוֹטֵ֛ף כְּב֥וֹד גּוֹיִ֖ם וִֽינַקְתֶּ֑ם עַל־צַד֙ תִּנָּשֵׂ֔אוּ וְעַל־בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תְּשׇׁעֳשָֽׁעוּ׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh hnny nth'lyh khnhr shlvm vkhnchl shvtf khbvd gvym vynqtm 'ltsd tnsh'v v'lbrkhym tsh'sh'v
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river. And the wealth of the nations like an overflowing stream, and ye shall suck thereof: Ye shall be borne upon the side, and shall be dandled upon the knees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִמּ֖וֹ תְּנַחֲמֶ֑נּוּ כֵּ֤ן אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֲנַ֣חֶמְכֶ֔ם וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם תְּנֻחָֽמוּ׃
verses.translit: kh'ysh 'shr 'mv tnchmnv khn 'nkhy 'nchmkhm vbyrvshl͏m tnchmv
verses.translation: As one whom his mother comforteth, So will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאִיתֶם֙ וְשָׂ֣שׂ לִבְּכֶ֔ם וְעַצְמוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם כַּדֶּ֣שֶׁא תִפְרַ֑חְנָה וְנוֹדְעָ֤ה יַד־יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־עֲבָדָ֔יו וְזָעַ֖ם אֶת־אֹיְבָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vr'ytm vshsh lbkhm v'tsmvtykhm khdsh' tprchnh vnvd'h ydyhvh 't'bdyv vz'm 't'ybyv {s}
verses.translation: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like young grass; and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward His servants, and He will have indignation against His enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בָּאֵ֣שׁ יָב֔וֹא וְכַסּוּפָ֖ה מַרְכְּבֹתָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֤יב בְּחֵמָה֙ אַפּ֔וֹ וְגַעֲרָת֖וֹ בְּלַהֲבֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khyhnh yhvh b'sh ybv' vkhsvph mrkhbtyv lhshyb bchmh 'pv vg'rtv blhby'sh
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD will come in fire, And His chariots shall be like the whirlwind; to render His anger with fury, And His rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י בָאֵשׁ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה נִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחַרְבּ֖וֹ אֶת־כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֑ר וְרַבּ֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy b'sh yhvh nshpt vbchrbv 'tkhlbshr vrbv chlly yhvh
verses.translation: For by fire will the LORD contend, And by His sword with all flesh; And the slain of the LORD shall be many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמִּתְקַדְּשִׁ֨ים וְהַמִּֽטַּהֲרִ֜ים אֶל־הַגַּנּ֗וֹת אַחַ֤ר (אחד) [אַחַת֙] בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ אֹֽכְלֵי֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַחֲזִ֔יר וְהַשֶּׁ֖קֶץ וְהָעַכְבָּ֑ר יַחְדָּ֥ו יָסֻ֖פוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hmtqdshym vhmthrym 'lhgnvt 'chr ('chd) ['cht] btvkh 'khly bshr hchzyr vhshqts vh'khbr ychdv yspv n'myhvh
verses.translation: They that sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go unto the gardens, behind one in the midst, Eating swine’s flesh, and the detestable thing, and the mouse, Shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֗י מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ וּמַחְשְׁבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם בָּאָ֕ה לְקַבֵּ֥ץ אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְהַלְּשֹׁנ֑וֹת וּבָ֖אוּ וְרָא֥וּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy m'shyhm vmchshbtyhm b'h lqbts 'tkhlhgvym vhlshnvt vb'v vr'v 'tkhbvdy
verses.translation: For I [know] their works and their thoughts; [the time] cometh, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and shall see My glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י בָהֶ֜ם א֗וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י מֵהֶ֣ם ׀ פְּ֠לֵיטִ֠ים אֶֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֞ם תַּרְשִׁ֨ישׁ פּ֥וּל וְל֛וּד מֹ֥שְׁכֵי קֶ֖שֶׁת תֻּבַ֣ל וְיָוָ֑ן הָאִיִּ֣ים הָרְחֹקִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־שָׁמְע֤וּ אֶת־שִׁמְעִי֙ וְלֹא־רָא֣וּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדִ֔י וְהִגִּ֥ידוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדִ֖י בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vshmty bhm 'vt vshlchty mhm  plytym 'lhgvym trshysh pvl vlvd mshkhy qsht tbl vyvn h'yym hrchqym 'shr l'shm'v 'tshm'y vl'r'v 'tkhbvdy vhgydv 'tkhbvdy bgvym
verses.translation: And I will work a sign among them, and I will send such as escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard My fame, neither have seen My glory; and they shall declare My glory among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֶת־כׇּל־אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם מִכׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֣ם ׀ מִנְחָ֣ה ׀ לַיהֹוָ֡ה בַּסּוּסִ֡ים וּ֠בָרֶ֠כֶב וּבַצַּבִּ֨ים וּבַפְּרָדִ֜ים וּבַכִּרְכָּר֗וֹת עַ֣ל הַ֥ר קׇדְשִׁ֛י יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבִ֩יאוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֛ה בִּכְלִ֥י טָה֖וֹר בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhby'v 'tkhl'chykhm mkhlhgvym  mnchh  lyhvh bsvsym vbrkhb vbtsbym vbprdym vbkhrkhrvt 'l hr qdshy yrvshl͏m 'mr yhvh kh'shr yby'v bny yshr'l 'thmnchh bkhly thvr byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall bring all your brethren out of all the nations for an offering unto the LORD, upon horses, and in chariots, and in fitters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to My holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־מֵהֶ֥ם אֶקַּ֛ח לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים לַלְוִיִּ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vgmmhm 'qch lkhhnym llvym 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And of them also will I take for the priests and for the Levites, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם הַ֠חֲדָשִׁ֠ים וְהָאָ֨רֶץ הַחֲדָשָׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה עֹמְדִ֥ים לְפָנַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כֵּ֛ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד זַרְעֲכֶ֖ם וְשִׁמְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy kh'shr hshmym hchdshym vh'rts hchdshh 'shr 'ny 'shh 'mdym lpny n'myhvh khn y'md zr'khm vshmkhm
verses.translation: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before Me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה מִֽדֵּי־חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בְּחׇדְשׁ֔וֹ וּמִדֵּ֥י שַׁבָּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ יָב֧וֹא כׇל־בָּשָׂ֛ר לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֥ת לְפָנַ֖י אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh mdychdsh bchdshv vmdy shbt bshbtv ybv' khlbshr lhshtchvt lpny 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצְא֣וּ וְרָא֔וּ בְּפִגְרֵי֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַפֹּשְׁעִ֖ים בִּ֑י כִּ֣י תוֹלַעְתָּ֞ם לֹ֣א תָמ֗וּת וְאִשָּׁם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ דֵרָא֖וֹן לְכׇל־בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vyts'v vr'v bpgry h'nshym hpsh'ym by khy tvl'tm l' tmvt v'shm l' tkhbh vhyv dr'vn lkhlbshr
verses.translation: And they shall go forth, and look Upon the carcasses of the men that have rebelled against Me; For their worm shall not die, Neither shall their fire be quenched; And they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּ֑הוּ מִן־הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת בְּאֶ֖רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.translit: dbry yrmyhv bnchlqyhv mnhkhhnym 'shr b'ntvt b'rts bnymn
verses.translation: THE WORDS of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו בִּימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בִּשְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לְמׇלְכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbryhvh 'lyv bymy y'shyhv bn'mvn mlkh yhvdh bshlsh'shrh shnh lmlkhv
verses.translation: to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַד־תֹּם֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְצִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה עַד־גְּל֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy bymy yhvyqym bny'shyhv mlkh yhvdh 'dtm 'shty 'shrh shnh ltsdqyhv bny'shyhv mlkh yhvdh 'dglvt yrvshl͏m bchdsh hchmyshy {p}
verses.translation: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֨רֶם (אצורך) [אֶצׇּרְךָ֤] בַבֶּ֙טֶן֙ יְדַעְתִּ֔יךָ וּבְטֶ֛רֶם תֵּצֵ֥א מֵרֶ֖חֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֑יךָ נָבִ֥יא לַגּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: btrm ('tsvrkh) ['tsrkh] bbtn yd'tykh vbtrm tts' mrchm hqdshtykh nby' lgvym nttykh
verses.translation: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee, And before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee; I have appointed thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה לֹֽא־יָדַ֖עְתִּי דַּבֵּ֑ר כִּי־נַ֖עַר אָנֹֽכִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh hnh l'yd'ty dbr khyn'r 'nkhy {s}
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak; for I am a child.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י אַל־תֹּאמַ֖ר נַ֣עַר אָנֹ֑כִי כִּ֠י עַֽל־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וְאֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוְּךָ֖ תְּדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'lt'mr n'r 'nkhy khy 'lkhl'shr 'shlchkh tlkh v't khl'shr 'tsvkh tdbr
verses.translation: But the LORD said unto me: Say not: I am a child; For to whomsoever I shall send thee thou shalt go, And whatsoever I shall command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּירָ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְהַצִּלֶ֖ךָ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ltyr' mpnyhm khy'tkh 'ny lhtslkh n'myhvh
verses.translation: Be not afraid of them; For I am with thee to deliver thee, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ וַיַּגַּ֖ע עַל־פִּ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי דְבָרַ֖י בְּפִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh 'tydv vyg' 'lpy vy'mr yhvh 'ly hnh ntty dbry bpykh
verses.translation: Then the LORD put forth His hand, and touched my mouth; and the LORD said unto me: Behold, I have put My words in thy mouth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֞ה הִפְקַדְתִּ֣יךָ  הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה עַל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ וְעַל־הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת לִנְת֥וֹשׁ וְלִנְת֖וֹץ וּלְהַאֲבִ֣יד וְלַהֲר֑וֹס לִבְנ֖וֹת וְלִנְטֽוֹעַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: r'h hpqdtykh  hyvm hzh 'lhgvym v'lhmmlkhvt lntvsh vlntvts vlh'byd vlhrvs lbnvt vlntv' {p}
verses.translation: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, To root out and to pull down, And to destroy and to overthrow; To build, and to plant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י דְבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֔ר מָה־אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וָאֹמַ֕ר מַקֵּ֥ל שָׁקֵ֖ד אֲנִ֥י רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr mh'th r'h yrmyhv v'mr mql shqd 'ny r'h
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying: ‘Jeremiah, what seest thou?’ And I said: ‘I see a rod of an almond-tree.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י הֵיטַ֣בְתָּ לִרְא֑וֹת כִּֽי־שֹׁקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עַל־דְּבָרִ֖י לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly hytbt lr'vt khyshqd 'ny 'ldbry l'shtv {s}
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me: ‘Thou hast well seen; for I watch over My word to perform it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אֵלַי֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר סִ֤יר נָפ֙וּחַ֙ אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֔ה וּפָנָ֖יו מִפְּנֵ֥י צָפֽוֹנָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh  'ly shnyt l'mr mh 'th r'h v'mr syr npvch 'ny r'h vpnyv mpny tspvnh
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying: ‘What seest thou?’ And I said: ‘I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is from the north.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י מִצָּפוֹן֙ תִּפָּתַ֣ח הָרָעָ֔ה עַ֥ל כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly mtspvn tptch hr'h 'l khlyshby h'rts
verses.translation: Then the LORD said unto me: ‘Out of the north the evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  הִנְנִ֣י קֹרֵ֗א לְכׇֽל־מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת צָפ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וּבָ֡אוּ וְֽנָתְנוּ֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּסְא֜וֹ פֶּ֣תַח  שַׁעֲרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם וְעַ֤ל כׇּל־חוֹמֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy  hnny qr' lkhlmshpchvt mmlkhvt tspvnh n'myhvh vb'v vntnv 'ysh khs'v ptch  sh'ry yrvshl͏m v'l khlchvmtyh sbyb v'l khl'ry yhvdh
verses.translation: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּטַי֙ אוֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל כׇּל־רָעָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥י יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vdbrty mshpty 'vtm 'l khlr'tm 'shr 'zbvny vyqtrv l'lhym 'chrym vyshtchvv lm'shy ydyhm
verses.translation: And I will utter My judgments against them touching all their wickedness; in that they have forsaken me, and have offered unto other gods, and worshipped the work of their own hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ תֶּאְזֹ֣ר מׇתְנֶ֔יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֙ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ אַל־תֵּחַת֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם פֶּֽן־אֲחִתְּךָ֖ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th t'zr mtnykh vqmt vdbrt 'lyhm 't khl'shr 'nkhy 'tsvkh 'ltcht mpnyhm pn'chtkh lpnyhm
verses.translation: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee; be not dismayed at them, lest I dismay thee before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נְתַתִּ֣יךָ הַיּ֗וֹם לְעִ֨יר מִבְצָ֜ר וּלְעַמּ֥וּד בַּרְזֶ֛ל וּלְחֹמ֥וֹת נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל־כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ לְמַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ לְשָׂרֶ֔יהָ לְכֹהֲנֶ֖יהָ וּלְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'ny hnh nttykh hyvm l'yr mbtsr vl'mvd brzl vlchmvt nchsht 'lkhlh'rts lmlkhy yhvdh lshryh lkhhnyh vl'm h'rts
verses.translation: For, behold, I have made thee this day a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and brazen walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹא־י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ךְ כִּי־אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהַצִּילֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnlchmv 'lykh vl'yvkhlv lkh khy'tkh 'ny n'myhvh lhtsylkh {p}
verses.translation: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְֽקָרָ֩אתָ֩ בְאׇזְנֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה זָכַ֤רְתִּי לָךְ֙ חֶ֣סֶד נְעוּרַ֔יִךְ אַהֲבַ֖ת כְּלוּלֹתָ֑יִךְ לֶכְתֵּ֤ךְ אַֽחֲרַי֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א זְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: hlkh vqr't b'zny yrvshl͏m l'mr khh 'mr yhvh zkhrty lkh chsd n'vrykh 'hbt khlvltykh lkhtkh 'chry bmdbr b'rts l' zrv'h
verses.translation: Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying: Thus saith the LORD: I remember for thee the affection of thy youth, the love of thine espousals; how thou wentest after Me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹ֤דֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה רֵאשִׁ֖ית תְּבוּאָתֹ֑ה כׇּל־אֹכְלָ֣יו יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ רָעָ֛ה תָּבֹ֥א אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qdsh yshr'l lyhvh r'shyt tbv'th khl'khlyv y'shmv r'h tb' 'lyhm n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: Israel is the LORD’S hallowed portion, His first-fruits of the increase; all that devour him shall be held guilty, evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְכׇֽל־מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: shm'v dbryhvh byt y'qb vkhlmshpchvt byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה מַה־מָּצְא֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֥ם בִּי֙ עָ֔וֶל כִּ֥י רָחֲק֖וּ מֵעָלָ֑י וַיֵּ֥לְכ֛וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַהֶ֖בֶל וַיֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh mhmts'v 'bvtykhm by 'vl khy rchqv m'ly vylkhv 'chry hhbl vyhblv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: What unrighteousness have your fathers found in Me, that they are gone far from Me, and have walked after things of nought, and are become nought?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אָֽמְר֔וּ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה הַמַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖נוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַמּוֹלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּאֶ֨רֶץ עֲרָבָ֤ה וְשׁוּחָה֙ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ צִיָּ֣ה וְצַלְמָ֔וֶת בְּאֶ֗רֶץ לֹא־עָ֤בַר בָּהּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹא־יָשַׁ֥ב אָדָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vl' 'mrv 'yh yhvh hm'lh 'tnv m'rts mtsrym hmvlykh 'tnv bmdbr b'rts 'rbh vshvchh b'rts tsyh vtslmvt b'rts l''br bh 'ysh vl'yshb 'dm shm
verses.translation: Neither said they: ‘Where is the LORD that brought us up Out of the land of Egypt; that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָבִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל לֶאֱכֹ֥ל פִּרְיָ֖הּ וְטוּבָ֑הּ וַתָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַתְּטַמְּא֣וּ אֶת־אַרְצִ֔י וְנַחֲלָתִ֥י שַׂמְתֶּ֖ם לְתוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'by' 'tkhm 'l'rts hkhrml l'khl pryh vtvbh vtb'v vttm'v 't'rtsy vnchlty shmtm ltv'bh
verses.translation: And I brought you into a land of fruitful fields, to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled My land, and made My heritage an abomination.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים לֹ֤א אָֽמְרוּ֙ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה וְתֹפְשֵׂ֤י הַתּוֹרָה֙ לֹ֣א יְדָע֔וּנִי וְהָרֹעִ֖ים פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑י וְהַנְּבִאִים֙ נִבְּא֣וּ בַבַּ֔עַל וְאַחֲרֵ֥י לֹֽא־יוֹעִ֖לוּ הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: hkhhnym l' 'mrv 'yh yhvh vtpshy htvrh l' yd'vny vhr'ym psh'v by vhnb'ym nb'v bb'l v'chry l'yv'lv hlkhv
verses.translation: The priests said not: ‘Where is the LORD?’ And they that handle the law knew Me not, and the rulers transgressed against Me; the prophets also prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן עֹ֛ד אָרִ֥יב אִתְּכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י בְנֵיכֶ֖ם אָרִֽיב׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'd 'ryb 'tkhm n'myhvh v'tbny bnykhm 'ryb
verses.translation: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children’s children will I plead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עִבְר֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י כִתִּיִּים֙ וּרְא֔וּ וְקֵדָ֛ר שִׁלְח֥וּ וְהִֽתְבּוֹנְנ֖וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּרְא֕וּ הֵ֥ן הָיְתָ֖ה כָּזֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: khy 'brv 'yy khtyym vr'v vqdr shlchv vhtbvnnv m'd vr'v hn hyth khz't
verses.translation: For pass over to the isles of the Kittites, and see, and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there hath been such a thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַהֵימִ֥יר גּוֹי֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵ֖מָּה לֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַמִּ֛י הֵמִ֥יר כְּבוֹד֖וֹ בְּל֥וֹא יוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.translit: hhymyr gvy 'lhym vhmh l' 'lhym v'my hmyr khbvdv blv' yv'yl
verses.translation: Hath a nation changed its gods, which yet are no gods? But My people hath changed its glory For that which doth not profit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁ֥מּוּ שָׁמַ֖יִם עַל־זֹ֑את וְשַׂעֲר֛וּ חׇרְב֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shmv shmym 'lz't vsh'rv chrbv m'd n'myhvh
verses.translation: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye exceeding amazed, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שְׁתַּ֥יִם רָע֖וֹת עָשָׂ֣ה עַמִּ֑י אֹתִ֨י עָזְב֜וּ מְק֣וֹר  מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֗ים לַחְצֹ֤ב לָהֶם֙ בֹּאר֔וֹת בֹּארֹת֙ נִשְׁבָּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יָכִ֖לוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khyshtym r'vt 'shh 'my 'ty 'zbv mqvr  mym chyym lchtsb lhm b'rvt b'rt nshbrym 'shr l'ykhlv hmym
verses.translation: For My people have committed two evils: They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, That can hold no water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעֶ֙בֶד֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־יְלִ֥יד בַּ֖יִת ה֑וּא מַדּ֖וּעַ הָיָ֥ה לָבַֽז׃
verses.translit: h'bd yshr'l 'mylyd byt hv' mdv' hyh lbz
verses.translation: Is Israel a servant? Is he a home-born slave? Why is he become a prey?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָיו֙ יִשְׁאֲג֣וּ כְפִרִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ קוֹלָ֑ם וַיָּשִׁ֤יתוּ אַרְצוֹ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה עָרָ֥יו (נצתה) [נִצְּת֖וּ] מִבְּלִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: 'lyv ysh'gv khprym ntnv qvlm vyshytv 'rtsv lshmh 'ryv (ntsth) [ntstv] mbly yshb
verses.translation: The young lions have roared upon him, and let their voice resound; and they have made his land desolate, his cities are laid waste, without inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־בְּנֵי־נֹ֖ף (ותחפנס) [וְתַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס] יִרְע֖וּךְ קׇדְקֹֽד׃
verses.translit: gmbnynf (vtchpns) [vtchpnchs] yr'vkh qdqd
verses.translation: The children also of Noph and Tahpanhes feed upon the crown of thy head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־זֹ֖את תַּעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֑ךְ עׇזְבֵךְ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִךְ בְּעֵ֖ת מוֹלִכֵ֥ךְ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: hlv'z't t'shhlkh 'zbkh 'tyhvh 'lhykh b't mvlkhkh bdrkh
verses.translation: Is it not this that doth cause it unto thee, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when He led thee by the way?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה מַה־לָּךְ֙ לְדֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִשְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֣י שִׁח֑וֹר וּמַה־לָּךְ֙ לְדֶ֣רֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לִשְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֥י נָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'th mhlkh ldrkh mtsrym lshtvt my shchvr vmhlkh ldrkh 'shvr lshtvt my nhr
verses.translation: And now what hast thou to do in the way to Egypt, to drink the waters of Shihor? Or what hast thou to do in the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּיַסְּרֵ֣ךְ רָעָתֵ֗ךְ וּמְשֻׁבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ תּֽוֹכִחֻ֔ךְ וּדְעִ֤י וּרְאִי֙ כִּֽי־רַ֣ע וָמָ֔ר עׇזְבֵ֖ךְ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִךְ וְלֹ֤א פַחְדָּתִי֙ אֵלַ֔יִךְ נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: tysrkh r'tkh vmshbvtykh tvkhchkh vd'y vr'y khyr' vmr 'zbkh 'tyhvh 'lhykh vl' pchdty 'lykh n'm'dny yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: Know therefore and see that it is an evil and a bitter thing, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, neither is My fear in thee, Saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵעוֹלָ֞ם שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי עֻלֵּ֗ךְ נִתַּ֙קְתִּי֙ מוֹסְרוֹתַ֔יִךְ וַתֹּאמְרִ֖י לֹ֣א (אעבוד) [אֶעֱב֑וֹר] כִּ֣י עַֽל־כׇּל־גִּבְעָ֞ה גְּבֹהָ֗ה וְתַ֙חַת֙ כׇּל־עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן אַ֖תְּ צֹעָ֥ה זֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy m'vlm shbrty 'lkh ntqty mvsrvtykh vt'mry l' (''bvd) [''bvr] khy 'lkhlgb'h gbhh vtcht khl'ts r'nn 't ts'h znh
verses.translation: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands, and thou saidst: ‘I will not transgress’; upon every high hill And under every leafy tree Thou didst recline, playing the harlot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נְטַעְתִּ֣יךְ שׂוֹרֵ֔ק כֻּלֹּ֖ה זֶ֣רַע אֱמֶ֑ת וְאֵיךְ֙ נֶהְפַּ֣כְתְּ לִ֔י סוּרֵ֖י הַגֶּ֥פֶן נׇכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy nt'tykh shvrq khlh zr' 'mt v'ykh nhpkht ly svry hgpn nkhryh
verses.translation: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, Wholly a right seed; How then art thou turned into the degenerate plant Of a strange vine unto Me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־תְּכַבְּסִי֙ בַּנֶּ֔תֶר וְתַרְבִּי־לָ֖ךְ בֹּרִ֑ית נִכְתָּ֤ם עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ לְפָנַ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 'mtkhbsy bntr vtrbylkh bryt nkhtm 'vnkh lpny n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before Me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣יךְ תֹּאמְרִ֞י לֹ֣א נִטְמֵ֗אתִי אַחֲרֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ לֹ֣א הָלַ֔כְתִּי רְאִ֤י דַרְכֵּךְ֙ בַּגַּ֔יְא דְּעִ֖י מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑ית בִּכְרָ֥ה קַלָּ֖ה מְשָׂרֶ֥כֶת דְּרָכֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: 'ykh t'mry l' ntm'ty 'chry hb'lym l' hlkhty r'y drkhkh bgy' d'y mh 'shyt bkhrh qlh mshrkht drkhyh
verses.translation: How canst thou say: ‘I am not defiled, I have not gone after the Baalim’? See thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done; thou art a swift young camel traversing her ways;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּ֣רֶה  לִמֻּ֣ד מִדְבָּ֗ר בְּאַוַּ֤ת (נפשו) [נַפְשָׁהּ֙] שָׁאֲפָ֣ה ר֔וּחַ תַּאֲנָתָ֖הּ מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נָּה כׇּל־מְבַקְשֶׁ֙יהָ֙ לֹ֣א יִיעָ֔פוּ בְּחׇדְשָׁ֖הּ יִמְצָאֽוּנְהָ׃
verses.translit: prh  lmd mdbr b'vt (npshv) [npshh] sh'ph rvch t'nth my yshybnh khlmbqshyh l' yy'pv bchdshh ymts'vnh
verses.translation: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind in her desire; her lust, who can hinder it? All they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנְעִ֤י רַגְלֵךְ֙ מִיָּחֵ֔ף (וגורנך) [וּגְרוֹנֵ֖ךְ] מִצִּמְאָ֑ה וַתֹּאמְרִ֣י נוֹאָ֔שׁ ל֕וֹא כִּֽי־אָהַ֥בְתִּי זָרִ֖ים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֥ם אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: mn'y rglkh mychf (vgvrnkh) [vgrvnkh] mtsm'h vt'mry nv'sh lv' khy'hbty zrym v'chryhm 'lkh
verses.translation: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst; but thou saidst: ‘There is no hope; No, for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּבֹ֤שֶׁת גַּנָּב֙ כִּ֣י יִמָּצֵ֔א כֵּ֥ן הֹבִ֖ישׁוּ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָׂרֵיהֶ֔ם וְכֹהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִיאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khbsht gnb khy ymts' khn hbyshv byt yshr'l hmh mlkhyhm shryhm vkhhnyhm vnby'yhm
verses.translation: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֨ים לָעֵ֜ץ אָ֣בִי אַ֗תָּה וְלָאֶ֙בֶן֙ אַ֣תְּ (ילדתני) [יְלִדְתָּ֔נוּ] כִּֽי־פָנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛י עֹ֖רֶף וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וּבְעֵ֤ת רָעָתָם֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ ק֖וּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'mrym l'ts 'by 'th vl'bn 't (yldtny) [yldtnv] khypnv 'ly 'rf vl' pnym vb't r'tm y'mrv qvmh vhvshy'nv
verses.translation: Who say to a stock: ‘Thou art my father’, and to a stone: ‘Thou hast brought us forth’, for they have turned their back unto Me, and not their face; but in the time of their trouble they will say: ‘Arise, and save us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַיֵּ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔ךְ יָק֕וּמוּ אִם־יוֹשִׁיע֖וּךָ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר עָרֶ֔יךָ הָי֥וּ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יְהוּדָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'yh 'lhykh 'shr 'shyt lkh yqvmv 'myvshy'vkh b't r'tkh khy mspr 'rykh hyv 'lhykh yhvdh {s}
verses.translation: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? Let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble; for according to the number of thy cities Are thy gods, O Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֥מָּה תָרִ֖יבוּ אֵלָ֑י כֻּלְּכֶ֛ם פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם בִּ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lmh trybv 'ly khlkhm psh'tm by n'myhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore will ye contend with Me? Ye all have transgressed against Me, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַשָּׁוְא֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֔ם מוּסָ֖ר לֹ֣א לָקָ֑חוּ אָכְלָ֧ה חַרְבְּכֶ֛ם נְבִיאֵיכֶ֖ם כְּאַרְיֵ֥ה מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.translit: lshv' hkhyty 'tbnykhm mvsr l' lqchv 'khlh chrbkhm nby'ykhm kh'ryh mshchyt
verses.translation: In vain have I smitten your children— They received no correction; Your sword hath devoured your prophets, Like a destroying lion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדּ֗וֹר אַתֶּם֙ רְא֣וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה הֲמִדְבָּ֤ר הָיִ֙יתִי֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֛ם אֶ֥רֶץ מַאְפֵּ֖לְיָ֑ה מַדּ֜וּעַ אָמְר֤וּ עַמִּי֙ רַ֔דְנוּ לֽוֹא־נָב֥וֹא ע֖וֹד אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hdvr 'tm r'v dbryhvh hmdbr hyyty lyshr'l 'm 'rts m'plyh mdv' 'mrv 'my rdnv lv'nbv' 'vd 'lykh
verses.translation: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD: Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Wherefore say My people: ‘We roam at large; we will come no more unto Thee’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתִשְׁכַּ֤ח בְּתוּלָה֙ עֶדְיָ֔הּ כַּלָּ֖ה קִשֻּׁרֶ֑יהָ וְעַמִּ֣י שְׁכֵח֔וּנִי יָמִ֖ים אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: htshkhch btvlh 'dyh khlh qshryh v'my shkhchvny ymym 'yn mspr
verses.translation: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet My people have forgotten Me days without number.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תֵּיטִ֥בִי דַרְכֵּ֖ךְ לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה לָכֵן֙ גַּ֣ם אֶת־הָרָע֔וֹת (למדתי) [לִמַּ֖דְתְּ] אֶת־דְּרָכָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: mhtytby drkhkh lbqsh 'hbh lkhn gm 'thr'vt (lmdty) [lmdt] 'tdrkhykh
verses.translation: How trimmest thou thy way To seek love! Therefore—even the wicked women hast thou taught thy ways;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם בִּכְנָפַ֙יִךְ֙ נִמְצְא֔וּ דַּ֛ם נַפְשׁ֥וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים נְקִיִּ֑ים לֹֽא־בַמַּחְתֶּ֥רֶת מְצָאתִ֖ים כִּ֥י עַל־כׇּל־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: gm bkhnpykh nmts'v dm npshvt 'byvnym nqyym l'bmchtrt mts'tym khy 'lkhl'lh
verses.translation: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the innocent poor; thou didst not find them breaking in; yet for all these things
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּֽאמְרִי֙ כִּ֣י נִקֵּ֔יתִי אַ֛ךְ שָׁ֥ב אַפּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נִּי הִנְנִי֙ נִשְׁפָּ֣ט אוֹתָ֔ךְ עַל־אׇמְרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א חָטָֽאתִי׃
verses.translit: vt'mry khy nqyty 'kh shb 'pv mmny hnny nshpt 'vtkh 'l'mrkh l' cht'ty
verses.translation: Thou saidst: ‘I am innocent; surely His anger is turned away from me’— Behold, I will enter into judgment with thee, because thou sayest: ‘I have not sinned.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תֵּזְלִ֥י מְאֹ֖ד לְשַׁנּ֣וֹת אֶת־דַּרְכֵּ֑ךְ גַּ֤ם מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ תֵּבֹ֔שִׁי כַּאֲשֶׁר־בֹּ֖שְׁתְּ מֵאַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: mhtzly m'd lshnvt 'tdrkhkh gm mmtsrym tbshy kh'shrbsht m'shvr
verses.translation: How greatly dost thou cheapen thyself to change thy way? Thou shalt be ashamed of Egypt also, As thou wast ashamed of Asshur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מֵאֵ֥ת זֶה֙ תֵּֽצְאִ֔י וְיָדַ֖יִךְ עַל־רֹאשֵׁ֑ךְ כִּֽי־מָאַ֤ס יְהֹוָה֙ בְּמִבְטַחַ֔יִךְ וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחִי לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: gm m't zh tts'y vydykh 'lr'shkh khym's yhvh bmbtchykh vl' ttslychy lhm
verses.translation: From him also shalt thou go forth, with thy hands upon thy head; for the LORD hath rejected them in whom thou didst trust, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֡ר הֵ֣ן יְשַׁלַּ֣ח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ֩ וְהָלְכָ֨ה מֵאִתּ֜וֹ וְהָיְתָ֣ה לְאִישׁ־אַחֵ֗ר הֲיָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ ע֔וֹד הֲל֛וֹא חָנ֥וֹף תֶּחֱנַ֖ף הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑יא וְאַ֗תְּ זָנִית֙ רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְשׁ֥וֹב אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'mr hn yshlch 'ysh 't'shtv vhlkhh m'tv vhyth l'ysh'chr hyshvb 'lyh 'vd hlv' chnvf tchnf h'rts hhy' v't znyt r'ym rbym vshvb 'ly n'myhvh
