verses.translation: . . . saying: If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, may he return unto her again? Will not that land be greatly polluted? But thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; and wouldest thou yet return to Me? Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאִי־עֵינַ֨יִךְ עַל־שְׁפָיִ֜ם וּרְאִ֗י אֵיפֹה֙ לֹ֣א (שגלת) [שֻׁכַּ֔בְתְּ] עַל־דְּרָכִים֙ יָשַׁ֣בְתְּ לָהֶ֔ם כַּעֲרָבִ֖י בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַתַּחֲנִ֣יפִי אֶ֔רֶץ בִּזְנוּתַ֖יִךְ וּבְרָעָתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: sh'y'ynykh 'lshpym vr'y 'yph l' (shglt) [shkhbt] 'ldrkhym yshbt lhm kh'rby bmdbr vtchnypy 'rts bznvtykh vbr'tkh
verses.translation: Lift up thine eyes unto the high hills, and see: Where hast thou not been lain with? By the ways hast thou sat for them, as an Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy harlotries and with thy wickedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמָּנְע֣וּ רְבִבִ֔ים וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ ל֣וֹא הָיָ֑ה וּמֵ֨צַח אִשָּׁ֤ה זוֹנָה֙ הָ֣יָה לָ֔ךְ מֵאַ֖נְתְּ הִכָּלֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vymn'v rbbym vmlqvsh lv' hyh vmtsch 'shh zvnh hyh lkh m'nt hkhlm
verses.translation: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and there hath been no latter rain; yet thou hadst a harlot’s forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא מֵעַ֔תָּה (קראתי) [קָרָ֥את] לִ֖י אָבִ֑י אַלּ֥וּף נְעֻרַ֖י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: hlv' m'th (qr'ty) [qr't] ly 'by 'lvf n'ry 'th
verses.translation: Didst thou not just now cry unto Me: ‘My father, Thou art the friend of my youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִנְטֹ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֔ם אִם־יִשְׁמֹ֖ר לָנֶ֑צַח הִנֵּ֥ה דִבַּ֛רְתְּ וַתַּעֲשִׂ֥י הָרָע֖וֹת וַתּוּכָֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hyntr l'vlm 'myshmr lntsch hnh dbrt vt'shy hr'vt vtvkhl {p}
verses.translation: Will He bear grudge for ever? Will He keep it to the end?’ Behold, thou hast spoken, but hast done evil things, and hast had thy way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י בִּימֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הֲֽרָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֹלְכָ֨ה הִ֜יא עַל־כׇּל־הַ֣ר גָּבֹ֗הַּ וְאֶל־תַּ֛חַת כׇּל־עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָ֖ן וַתִּזְנִי־שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly bymy y'shyhv hmlkh hr'yt 'shr 'shth mshbh yshr'l hlkhh hy' 'lkhlhr gbh v'ltcht khl'ts r'nn vtznyshm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me in the days of Josiah the king: ‘Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel did? she went up upon every high mountain and under every leafy tree, and there played the harlot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אַחֲרֵ֨י עֲשׂוֹתָ֧הּ אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֛לֶּה אֵלַ֥י תָּשׁ֖וּב וְלֹא־שָׁ֑בָה (ותראה) [וַתֵּ֛רֶא] בָּגוֹדָ֥ה אֲחוֹתָ֖הּ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'chry 'shvth 'tkhl'lh 'ly tshvb vl'shbh (vtr'h) [vtr'] bgvdh 'chvth yhvdh
verses.translation: And I said: After she hath done all these things, she will return unto me; but she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֗רֶא כִּ֤י עַל־כׇּל־אֹדוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽאֲפָה֙ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁלַּחְתִּ֕יהָ וָאֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת־סֵ֥פֶר כְּרִיתֻתֶ֖יהָ אֵלֶ֑יהָ וְלֹ֨א יָרְאָ֜ה בֹּגֵדָ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ אֲחוֹתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ וַתִּ֥זֶן גַּם־הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: v'r' khy 'lkhl'dvt 'shr n'ph mshbh yshr'l shlchtyh v'tn 'tspr khryttyh 'lyh vl' yr'h bgdh yhvdh 'chvth vtlkh vtzn gmhy'
verses.translation: And I saw, when, forasmuch as backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a bill of divorcement, that yet treacherous Judah her sister feared not; but she also went and played the harlot;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ מִקֹּ֣ל זְנוּתָ֔הּ וַתֶּחֱנַ֖ף אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַתִּנְאַ֥ף אֶת־הָאֶ֖בֶן וְאֶת־הָעֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: vhyh mql znvth vtchnf 'th'rts vtn'f 'th'bn v'th'ts
verses.translation: and it came to pass through the lightness of her harlotry, that the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with stocks;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־בְּכׇל־זֹ֗את לֹא־שָׁ֨בָה אֵלַ֜י בָּגוֹדָ֧ה אֲחוֹתָ֛הּ יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּכׇל־לִבָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י אִם־בְּשֶׁ֖קֶר נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vgmbkhlz't l'shbh 'ly bgvdh 'chvth yhvdh bkhllbh khy 'mbshqr n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: and yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not returned unto Me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י צִדְּקָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖הּ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִבֹּגֵדָ֖ה יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly tsdqh npshh mshbh yshr'l mbgdh yhvdh
verses.translation: even the LORD said unto me—backsliding Israel hath proved herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְֽקָרָ֩אתָ֩ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה צָפ֗וֹנָה וְ֠אָמַרְתָּ֠ שׁ֣וּבָה מְשֻׁבָ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה לוֹא־אַפִּ֥יל פָּנַ֖י בָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־חָסִ֤יד אֲנִי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה לֹ֥א אֶטּ֖וֹר לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: hlkh vqr't 'thdbrym h'lh tspvnh v'mrt shvbh mshbh yshr'l n'myhvh lv''pyl pny bkhm khychsyd 'ny n'myhvh l' 'tvr l'vlm
verses.translation: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say: Return, thou backsliding Israel, Saith the LORD; I will not frown upon you; For I am merciful, saith the LORD, I will not bear grudge for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֚ךְ דְּעִ֣י עֲוֺנֵ֔ךְ כִּ֛י בַּיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖יִךְ פָּשָׁ֑עַתְּ וַתְּפַזְּרִ֨י אֶת־דְּרָכַ֜יִךְ לַזָּרִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת כׇּל־עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן וּבְקוֹלִ֥י לֹֽא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'kh d'y 'vnkh khy byhvh 'lhykh psh't vtpzry 'tdrkhykh lzrym tcht khl'ts r'nn vbqvly l'shm'tm n'myhvh
verses.translation: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, That thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, And hast scattered thy ways to the strangers Under every leafy tree, And ye have not hearkened to My voice, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֣וּבוּ בָנִ֤ים שֽׁוֹבָבִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י בָּעַ֣לְתִּי בָכֶ֑ם וְלָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם אֶחָ֣ד מֵעִ֗יר וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ מִמִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: shvbv bnym shvbbym n'myhvh khy 'nkhy b'lty bkhm vlqchty 'tkhm 'chd m'yr vshnym mmshpchh vhb'ty 'tkhm tsyvn
verses.translation: Return, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am a lord unto you, and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים כְּלִבִּ֑י וְרָע֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם דֵּעָ֥ה וְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
verses.translit: vntty lkhm r'ym khlby vr'v 'tkhm d'h vhshkhyl
verses.translation: and I will give you shepherds according to My heart, who shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כִּ֣י תִרְבּוּ֩ וּפְרִיתֶ֨ם בָּאָ֜רֶץ בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵ֙מָּה֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה לֹא־יֹ֣אמְרוּ ע֗וֹד אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל־לֵ֑ב וְלֹ֤א יִזְכְּרוּ־בוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִפְקֹ֔דוּ וְלֹ֥א יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vhyh khy trbv vprytm b'rts bymym hhmh n'myhvh l'y'mrv 'vd 'rvn brytyhvh vl' y'lh 'llb vl' yzkhrvbv vl' ypqdv vl' y'shh 'vd
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when ye are multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more: The ark of the covenant of the LORD; neither shall it come to mind; neither shall they make mention of it; neither shall they miss it; neither shall it be made any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא יִקְרְא֤וּ לִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ כִּסֵּ֣א יְהֹוָ֔ה וְנִקְו֨וּ אֵלֶ֧יהָ כׇֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֛ם לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה לִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְלֹא־יֵלְכ֣וּ ע֔וֹד אַחֲרֵ֕י שְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֥ם הָרָֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b't hhy' yqr'v lyrvshl͏m khs' yhvh vnqvv 'lyh khlhgvym lshm yhvh lyrvshl͏m vl'ylkhv 'vd 'chry shrrvt lbm hr' {s}
verses.translation: At that time they shall call Jerusalem The throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem; neither shall they walk any more after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה יֵלְכ֥וּ בֵית־יְהוּדָ֖ה עַל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְיָבֹ֤אוּ יַחְדָּו֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִנְחַ֖לְתִּי אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bymym hhmh ylkhv bytyhvdh 'lbyt yshr'l vyb'v ychdv m'rts tspvn 'lh'rts 'shr hnchlty 't'bvtykhm
verses.translation: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֵ֚יךְ אֲשִׁיתֵ֣ךְ בַּבָּנִ֔ים וְאֶתֶּן־לָךְ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֔ה נַחֲלַ֥ת צְבִ֖י צִבְא֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וָאֹמַ֗ר אָבִי֙ (תקראו) [תִּקְרְאִי־]לִ֔י וּמֵאַחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א (תשובו) [תָשֽׁוּבִי]׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy 'mrty 'ykh 'shytkh bbnym v'tnlkh 'rts chmdh nchlt tsby tsb'vt gvym v'mr 'by (tqr'v) [tqr'y]ly vm'chry l' (tshvbv) [tshvby]
verses.translation: But I said: ‘How would I put thee among the sons, And give thee a pleasant land, The goodliest heritage of the nations! ’ And I said: ‘Thou shalt call Me, My father; And shalt not turn away from following Me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָכֵ֛ן בָּגְדָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵרֵעָ֑הּ כֵּ֣ן בְּגַדְתֶּ֥ם בִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'khn bgdh 'shh mr'h khn bgdtm by byt yshr'l n'myhvh
verses.translation: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, So have ye dealt treacherously with Me, O house of Israel, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֚וֹל עַל־שְׁפָיִ֣ים נִשְׁמָ֔ע בְּכִ֥י תַחֲנוּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י הֶעֱווּ֙ אֶת־דַּרְכָּ֔ם שָׁכְח֖וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: qvl 'lshpyym nshm' bkhy tchnvny bny yshr'l khy h'vv 'tdrkhm shkhchv 'tyhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Hark! upon the high hills is heard The suppliant weeping of the children of Israel; For that they have perverted their way, They have forgotten the LORD their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבוּ בָּנִ֣ים שׁוֹבָבִ֔ים אֶרְפָּ֖ה מְשׁוּבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם הִנְנוּ֙ אָתָ֣נוּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: shvbv bnym shvbbym 'rph mshvbtykhm hnnv 'tnv lkh khy 'th yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Return, ye backsliding children, I will heal your backslidings.— ‘Here we are, we are come unto Thee; For Thou art the LORD our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָכֵ֥ן לַשֶּׁ֛קֶר מִגְּבָע֖וֹת הָמ֣וֹן הָרִ֑ים אָכֵן֙ בַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'khn lshqr mgb'vt hmvn hrym 'khn byhvh 'lhynv tshv't yshr'l
verses.translation: Truly vain have proved the hills, The uproar on the mountains; Truly in the LORD our God Is the salvation of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבֹּ֗שֶׁת אָ֥כְלָ֛ה אֶת־יְגִ֥יעַ אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ מִנְּעוּרֵ֑ינוּ אֶת־צֹאנָם֙ וְאֶת־בְּקָרָ֔ם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhbsht 'khlh 'tygy' 'bvtynv mn'vrynv 'tts'nm v'tbqrm 'tbnyhm v'tbnvtyhm
verses.translation: But the shameful thing hath devoured The labour of our fathers from our youth; Their flocks and their herds, Their sons and their daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה בְּבׇשְׁתֵּ֗נוּ וּֽתְכַסֵּ֘נוּ֮ כְּלִמָּתֵ֒נוּ֒ כִּי֩ לַיהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ חָטָ֗אנוּ אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ וַאֲבוֹתֵ֔ינוּ מִנְּעוּרֵ֖ינוּ וְעַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nshkhbh bbshtnv vtkhsnv khlmtnv khy lyhvh 'lhynv cht'nv 'nchnv v'bvtynv mn'vrynv v'dhyvm hzh vl' shm'nv bqvl yhvh 'lhynv {s}
verses.translation: Let us lie down in our shame, And let our confusion cover us; For we have sinned against the LORD our God, We and our fathers, From our youth even unto this day; And we have not hearkened To the voice of the LORD our God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תָּשׁ֨וּב יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל ׀ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י תָּשׁ֑וּב וְאִם־תָּסִ֧יר שִׁקּוּצֶ֛יךָ מִפָּנַ֖י וְלֹ֥א תָנֽוּד׃
verses.translit: 'mtshvb yshr'l  n'myhvh 'ly tshvb v'mtsyr shqvtsykh mpny vl' tnvd
verses.translation: If thou wilt return, O Israel, Saith the LORD, Yea, return unto Me; and if thou wilt put away thy detestable things out of My sight, and wilt not waver;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁבַּ֙עְתָּ֙ חַי־יְהֹוָ֔ה בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט וּבִצְדָקָ֑ה וְהִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֛וֹ גּוֹיִ֖ם וּב֥וֹ יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnshb't chyyhvh b'mt bmshpt vbtsdqh vhtbrkhv bv gvym vbv ythllv {s}
verses.translation: And wilt swear: ‘As the LORD liveth’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness; then shall the nations bless themselves by Him, and in Him shall they glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה לְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וְלִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם נִ֥ירוּ לָכֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְאַֽל־תִּזְרְע֖וּ אֶל־קֹצִֽים׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh l'ysh yhvdh vlyrvshl͏m nyrv lkhm nyr v'ltzr'v 'lqtsym
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: Break up for you a fallow ground, And sow not among thorns.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִמֹּ֣לוּ לַיהֹוָ֗ה וְהָסִ֙רוּ֙ עׇרְל֣וֹת לְבַבְכֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם פֶּן־תֵּצֵ֨א כָאֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗י וּבָֽעֲרָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hmlv lyhvh vhsrv 'rlvt lbbkhm 'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshl͏m pntts' kh'sh chmty vb'rh v'yn mkhbh mpny r' m'llykhm
verses.translation: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest My fury go forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, Because of the evil of your doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ בִֽיהוּדָ֗ה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ הַשְׁמִ֔יעוּ וְאִמְר֕וּ (ותקעו) [תִּקְע֥וּ] שׁוֹפָ֖ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ קִרְא֤וּ מַלְאוּ֙ וְאִמְר֔וּ הֵאָסְפ֥וּ וְנָב֖וֹאָה אֶל־עָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָֽר׃
verses.translit: hgydv byhvdh vbyrvshl͏m hshmy'v v'mrv (vtq'v) [tq'v] shvpr b'rts qr'v ml'v v'mrv h'spv vnbv'h 'l'ry hmbtsr
verses.translation: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem, And say: ‘Blow ye the horn in the land’; cry aloud and say: ‘Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the fortified cities.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־נֵ֣ס צִיּ֔וֹנָה הָעִ֖יזוּ אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ כִּ֣י רָעָ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא מִצָּפ֖וֹן וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: sh'vns tsyvnh h'yzv 'lt'mdv khy r'h 'nkhy mby' mtspvn vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: Set up a standard toward Zion; put yourselves under covert, stay not; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה אַרְיֵה֙ מִֽסֻּבְּכ֔וֹ וּמַשְׁחִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם נָסַ֖ע יָצָ֣א מִמְּקֹמ֑וֹ לָשׂ֤וּם אַרְצֵךְ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה עָרַ֥יִךְ תִּצֶּ֖ינָה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'ryh msbkhv vmshchyt gvym ns' yts' mmqmv lshvm 'rtskh lshmh 'rykh ttsynh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: A lion is gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations is set out, gone forth from his place; to make thy land desolate, that thy cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־זֹ֛את חִגְר֥וּ שַׂקִּ֖ים סִפְד֣וּ וְהֵילִ֑ילוּ כִּ֥י לֹֽא־שָׁ֛ב חֲר֥וֹן אַף־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lz't chgrv shqym spdv vhylylv khy l'shb chrvn 'fyhvh mmnv {p}
verses.translation: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and wail; For the fierce anger of the LORD Is not turned back from us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה יֹאבַ֥ד לֵב־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְלֵ֣ב הַשָּׂרִ֑ים וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וְהַנְּבִאִ֖ים יִתְמָֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyh byvmhhv' n'myhvh y'bd lbhmlkh vlb hshrym vnshmv hkhhnym vhnb'ym ytmhv {s}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass at that day, Saith the LORD, That the heart of the king shall fail, And the heart of the princes; And the priests shall be astonished, And the prophets shall wonder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֹמַ֞ר אֲהָ֣הּ  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אָכֵן֩ הַשֵּׁ֨א הִשֵּׁ֜אתָ לָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ וְלִירוּשָׁלַ֣͏ִם לֵאמֹ֔ר שָׁל֖וֹם יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְנָגְעָ֥ה חֶ֖רֶב עַד־הַנָּֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'hh  'dny yhvh 'khn hsh' hsh't l'm hzh vlyrvshl͏m l'mr shlvm yhyh lkhm vng'h chrb 'dhnpsh
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘Ah, Lord GOD! surely Thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying: Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָעָם־הַזֶּה֙ וְלִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם ר֣וּחַ צַ֤ח שְׁפָיִם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ בַּת־עַמִּ֑י ל֥וֹא לִזְר֖וֹת וְל֥וֹא לְהָבַֽר׃
verses.translit: b't hhy' y'mr l'mhzh vlyrvshl͏m rvch tsch shpym bmdbr drkh bt'my lv' lzrvt vlv' lhbr
verses.translation: At that time shall it be said of this people and of Jerusalem; a hot wind of the high hills in the wilderness Toward the daughter of My people, Not to fan, nor to cleanse;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֧וּחַ מָלֵ֛א מֵאֵ֖לֶּה יָ֣בוֹא לִ֑י עַתָּ֕ה גַּם־אֲנִ֛י אֲדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: rvch ml' m'lh ybv' ly 'th gm'ny 'dbr mshptym 'vtm
verses.translation: A wind too strong for this shall come for Me; now will I also utter judgments against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה  כַּעֲנָנִ֣ים יַעֲלֶ֗ה וְכַסּוּפָה֙ מַרְכְּבוֹתָ֔יו קַלּ֥וּ מִנְּשָׁרִ֖ים סוּסָ֑יו א֥וֹי לָ֖נוּ כִּ֥י שֻׁדָּֽדְנוּ׃
verses.translit: hnh  kh'nnym y'lh vkhsvph mrkhbvtyv qlv mnshrym svsyv 'vy lnv khy shddnv
verses.translation: Behold, he cometh up as clouds, and his chariots are as the whirlwind; his horses are swifter than eagles.— ’Woe unto us! for we are undone.’—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּבְּסִ֨י מֵרָעָ֤ה לִבֵּךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם לְמַ֖עַן תִּוָּשֵׁ֑עִי עַד־מָתַ֛י תָּלִ֥ין בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת אוֹנֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khbsy mr'h lbkh yrvshl͏m lm'n tvsh'y 'dmty tlyn bqrbkh mchshbvt 'vnkh
verses.translation: O Jerusalem, wash thy heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy baleful thoughts lodge within thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י ק֥וֹל מַגִּ֖יד מִדָּ֑ן וּמַשְׁמִ֥יעַ אָ֖וֶן מֵהַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khy qvl mgyd mdn vmshmy' 'vn mhr 'prym
verses.translation: For hark! one declareth from Dan, and announceth calamity from the hills of Ephraim:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַזְכִּ֣ירוּ לַגּוֹיִ֗ם הִנֵּה֙ הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם נֹצְרִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ הַמֶּרְחָ֑ק וַֽיִּתְּנ֛וּ עַל־עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה קוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: hzkhyrv lgvym hnh hshmy'v 'lyrvshl͏m ntsrym b'ym m'rts hmrchq vytnv 'l'ry yhvdh qvlm
verses.translation: ’Make ye mention to the nations: Behold—publish concerning Jerusalem— Watchers come from a far country, And give out their voice against the cities of Judah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּשֹׁמְרֵ֣י שָׂדַ֔י הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֖יהָ מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּי־אֹתִ֥י מָרָ֖תָה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khshmry shdy hyv 'lyh msbyb khy'ty mrth n'myhvh
verses.translation: As keepers of a field Are they against her round about; Because she hath been rebellious against Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּרְכֵּךְ֙ וּמַ֣עֲלָלַ֔יִךְ עָשׂ֥וֹ אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑ךְ זֹ֤את רָעָתֵךְ֙ כִּ֣י מָ֔ר כִּ֥י נָגַ֖ע עַד־לִבֵּֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: drkhkh vm'llykh 'shv 'lh lkh z't r'tkh khy mr khy ng' 'dlbkh {p}
verses.translation: Thy way and thy doings have procured These things unto thee; This is thy wickedness; yea, it is bitter, Yea, it reacheth unto thy heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעַ֣י  מֵעַ֨י ׀ [אוֹחִ֜ילָה] (אחולה) קִיר֥וֹת לִבִּ֛י הֹמֶה־לִּ֥י לִבִּ֖י לֹ֣א אַחֲרִ֑שׁ כִּ֣י ק֤וֹל שׁוֹפָר֙ (שמעתי) [שָׁמַ֣עַתְּ] נַפְשִׁ֔י תְּרוּעַ֖ת מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: m'y  m'y  ['vchylh] ('chvlh) qyrvt lby hmhly lby l' 'chrsh khy qvl shvpr (shm'ty) [shm't] npshy trv't mlchmh
verses.translation: My bowels, my bowels! I writhe in pain! The chambers of my heart! My heart moaneth within me! I cannot hold my peace! Because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the horn, The alarm of war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֤בֶר עַל־שֶׁ֙בֶר֙ נִקְרָ֔א כִּ֥י שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּתְאֹם֙ שֻׁדְּד֣וּ אֹֽהָלַ֔י רֶ֖גַע יְרִיעֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: shbr 'lshbr nqr' khy shddh khlh'rts pt'm shddv 'hly rg' yry'ty
verses.translation: Destruction followeth upon destruction, For the whole land is spoiled; Suddenly are my tents spoiled, My curtains in a moment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֖י אֶרְאֶה־נֵּ֑ס אֶשְׁמְעָ֖ה ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'dmty 'r'hns 'shm'h qvl shvpr {p}
verses.translation: How long shall I see the standard, Shall I hear the sound of the horn?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  אֱוִ֣יל עַמִּ֗י אוֹתִי֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ בָּנִ֤ים סְכָלִים֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְלֹ֥א נְבוֹנִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים הֵ֙מָּה֙ לְהָרַ֔ע וּלְהֵיטִ֖יב לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: khy  'vyl 'my 'vty l' yd'v bnym skhlym hmh vl' nbvnym hmh chkhmym hmh lhr' vlhytyb l' yd'v
verses.translation: For My people is foolish, They know Me not; They are sottish children, And they have no understanding; They are wise to do evil, But to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִנֵּה־תֹ֖הוּ וָבֹ֑הוּ וְאֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ין אוֹרָֽם׃
verses.translit: r'yty 'th'rts vhnhthv vbhv v'lhshmym v'yn 'vrm
verses.translation: I beheld the earth, And, lo, it was waste and void; And the heavens, and they had no light. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֙יתִי֙ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְהִנֵּ֖ה רֹעֲשִׁ֑ים וְכׇל־הַגְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְקַלְקָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: r'yty hhrym vhnh r'shym vkhlhgb'vt htqlqlv
verses.translation: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, And all the hills moved to and fro.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֕יתִי וְהִנֵּ֖ה אֵ֣ין הָאָדָ֑ם וְכׇל־ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם נָדָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: r'yty vhnh 'yn h'dm vkhl'vf hshmym nddv
verses.translation: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, And all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֕יתִי וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְכׇל־עָרָ֗יו נִתְּצוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: r'yty vhnh hkhrml hmdbr vkhl'ryv nttsv mpny yhvh mpny chrvn 'pv {s}
verses.translation: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful field was a wilderness, And all the cities thereof were broken down At the presence of the LORD, And before His fierce anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה שְׁמָמָ֥ה תִֽהְיֶ֖ה כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכָלָ֖ה לֹ֥א אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: khykhh 'mr yhvh shmmh thyh khlh'rts vkhlh l' ''shh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: The whole land shall be desolate; Yet will I not make a full end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־זֹאת֙ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְקָדְר֥וּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם מִמָּ֑עַל עַ֤ל כִּֽי־דִבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ זַמֹּ֔תִי וְלֹ֥א נִחַ֖מְתִּי וְלֹא־אָשׁ֥וּב מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: 'lz't t'bl h'rts vqdrv hshmym mm'l 'l khydbrty zmty vl' nchmty vl''shvb mmnh
verses.translation: For this shall the earth mourn, And the heavens above be black; Because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, And I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּ֨וֹל פָּרָ֜שׁ וְרֹ֣מֵה קֶ֗שֶׁת בֹּרַ֙חַת֙ כׇּל־הָעִ֔יר בָּ֚אוּ בֶּעָבִ֔ים וּבַכֵּפִ֖ים עָל֑וּ כׇּל־הָעִ֣יר עֲזוּבָ֔ה וְאֵין־יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּהֵ֖ן אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: mqvl prsh vrmh qsht brcht khlh'yr b'v b'bym vbkhpym 'lv khlh'yr 'zvbh v'ynyvshb bhn 'ysh
verses.translation: For the noise of the horsemen and bowmen The whole city fleeth; They go into the thickets, And climb up upon the rocks; Every city is forsaken, And not a man dwelleth therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ואתי) [וְאַ֨תְּ] שָׁד֜וּד מַֽה־תַּעֲשִׂ֗י כִּֽי־תִלְבְּשִׁ֨י שָׁנִ֜י כִּֽי־תַעְדִּ֣י עֲדִֽי־זָהָ֗ב כִּֽי־תִקְרְעִ֤י בַפּוּךְ֙ עֵינַ֔יִךְ לַשָּׁ֖וְא תִּתְיַפִּ֑י מָאֲסוּ־בָ֥ךְ עֹגְבִ֖ים נַפְשֵׁ֥ךְ יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: (v'ty) [v't] shdvd mht'shy khytlbshy shny khyt'dy 'dyzhb khytqr'y bpvkh 'ynykh lshv' ttypy m'svbkh 'gbym npshkh ybqshv
verses.translation: And thou, that art spoiled, what doest thou, That thou clothest thyself with scarlet, That thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, That thou enlargest thine eyes with paint? In vain dost thou make thyself fair; Thy lovers despise thee, they seek thy life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ ק֨וֹל כְּחוֹלָ֜ה שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי צָרָה֙ כְּמַבְכִּירָ֔ה ק֧וֹל בַּת־צִיּ֛וֹן תִּתְיַפֵּ֖חַ תְּפָרֵ֣שׂ כַּפֶּ֑יהָ אֽוֹי־נָ֣א לִ֔י כִּֽי־עָיְפָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י לְהֹרְגִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy qvl khchvlh shm'ty tsrh khmbkhyrh qvl bttsyvn ttypch tprsh khpyh 'vyn' ly khy'yph npshy lhrgym {p}
verses.translation: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, The anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, The voice of the daughter of Zion, that gaspeth for breath, That spreadeth her hands: ‘Woe is me, now! for my soul fainteth Before the murderers.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹטְט֞וּ בְּחוּצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם וּרְאוּ־נָ֤א וּדְעוּ֙ וּבַקְשׁ֣וּ בִרְחוֹבוֹתֶ֔יהָ אִם־תִּמְצְא֣וּ אִ֔ישׁ אִם־יֵ֛שׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֱמוּנָ֑ה וְאֶסְלַ֖ח לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: shvttv bchvtsvt yrvshl͏m vr'vn' vd'v vbqshv brchvbvtyh 'mtmts'v 'ysh 'mysh 'shh mshpt mbqsh 'mvnh v'slch lh
verses.translation: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, And see now, and know, And seek in the broad places thereof, If ye can find a man, If there be any that doeth justly, that seeketh truth; And I will pardon her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֥ם חַי־יְהֹוָ֖ה יֹאמֵ֑רוּ לָכֵ֥ן לַשֶּׁ֖קֶר יִשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: v'm chyyhvh y'mrv lkhn lshqr yshb'v
verses.translation: And though they say: ‘As the LORD liveth’, Surely they swear falsely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה עֵינֶ֘יךָ֮ הֲל֣וֹא לֶאֱמוּנָה֒ הִכִּ֤יתָה אֹתָם֙ וְֽלֹא־חָ֔לוּ כִּלִּיתָ֕ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ קַ֣חַת מוּסָ֑ר חִזְּק֤וּ פְנֵיהֶם֙ מִסֶּ֔לַע מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'ynykh hlv' l'mvnh hkhyth 'tm vl'chlv khlytm m'nv qcht mvsr chzqv pnyhm msl' m'nv lshvb
verses.translation: O LORD, are not Thine eyes upon truth? Thou hast stricken them, but they were not affected; Thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction; They have made their faces harder than a rock; They have refused to return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַךְ־דַּלִּ֖ים הֵ֑ם נוֹאֲל֕וּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָֽדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty 'khdlym hm nv'lv khy l' yd'v drkh yhvh mshpt 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And I said: ‘Surely these are poor, They are foolish, for they know not the way of the LORD, Nor the ordinance of their God; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽלְכָה־לִּ֤י אֶל־הַגְּדֹלִים֙ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ם כִּ֣י הֵ֗מָּה יָֽדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם אַ֣ךְ הֵ֤מָּה יַחְדָּו֙ שָׁ֣בְרוּ עֹ֔ל נִתְּק֖וּ מוֹסֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'lkhhly 'lhgdlym v'dbrh 'vtm khy hmh yd'v drkh yhvh mshpt 'lhyhm 'kh hmh ychdv shbrv 'l ntqv mvsrvt
verses.translation: I will get me unto the great men, And will speak unto them; For they know the way of the LORD, And the ordinance of their God.’ But these had altogether broken the yoke, And burst the bands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֩ הִכָּ֨ם אַרְיֵ֜ה מִיַּ֗עַר זְאֵ֤ב עֲרָבוֹת֙ יְשׇׁדְדֵ֔ם נָמֵ֤ר שֹׁקֵד֙ עַל־עָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם כׇּל־הַיּוֹצֵ֥א מֵהֵ֖נָּה יִטָּרֵ֑ף כִּ֤י רַבּוּ֙ פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֔ם עָצְמ֖וּ מְשֻׁבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn hkhm 'ryh my'r z'b 'rbvt yshddm nmr shqd 'l'ryhm khlhyvts' mhnh ytrf khy rbv psh'yhm 'tsmv mshbvtyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore a lion out of the forest doth slay them, A wolf of the deserts doth spoil them, A leopard watcheth over their cities, Every one that goeth out thence is torn in pieces; Because their transgressions are many, Their backslidings are increased.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤י לָזֹאת֙ (אסלוח) [אֶֽסְלַֽח־]לָ֔ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ עֲזָב֔וּנִי וַיִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ בְּלֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וָאַשְׂבִּ֤עַ אוֹתָם֙ וַיִּנְאָ֔פוּ וּבֵ֥ית זוֹנָ֖ה יִתְגּוֹדָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: 'y lz't ('slvch) ['slch]lkh bnykh 'zbvny vyshb'v bl' 'lhym v'shb' 'vtm vyn'pv vbyt zvnh ytgvddv
verses.translation: Wherefore should I pardon thee? The children have forsaken Me, And sworn by no-gods; And when I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, And assembled themselves in troops at the harlots’houses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סוּסִ֥ים מְיֻזָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁכִּ֣ים הָי֑וּ אִ֛ישׁ אֶל־אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ יִצְהָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: svsym myznym mshkhym hyv 'ysh 'l'sht r'hv ytshlv
verses.translation: They are become as well-fed horses, lusty stallions; Every one neigheth after his neighbour’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעַל־אֵ֥לֶּה לֽוֹא־אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאִם֙ בְּג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּזֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'l'lh lv''pqd n'myhvh v'm bgvy 'shrkhzh l' ttnqm npshy {s}
verses.translation: Shall I not punish for these things? Saith the LORD; And shall not My soul be avenged On such a nation as this?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲל֤וּ בְשָׁרוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וְשַׁחֵ֔תוּ וְכָלָ֖ה אַֽל־תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ הָסִ֙ירוּ֙ נְטִ֣ישׁוֹתֶ֔יהָ כִּ֛י ל֥וֹא לַיהֹוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: 'lv bshrvtyh vshchtv vkhlh 'lt'shv hsyrv ntyshvtyh khy lv' lyhvh hmh
verses.translation: Go ye up into her rows, and destroy, But make not a full end; Take away her shoots; For they are not the LORD’S.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ בָג֨וֹד בָּגְד֜וּ בִּ֗י בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy bgvd bgdv by byt yshr'l vbyt yhvdh n'myhvh
verses.translation: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah Have dealt very treacherously against Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽחֲשׁוּ֙ בַּיהֹוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לוֹא־ה֑וּא וְלֹֽא־תָב֤וֹא עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה וְחֶ֥רֶב וְרָעָ֖ב ל֥וֹא נִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khchshv byhvh vy'mrv lv'hv' vl'tbv' 'lynv r'h vchrb vr'b lv' nr'h
verses.translation: They have belied the LORD, And said: ‘It is not He, Neither shall evil come upon us; Neither shall we see sword nor famine;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנְּבִיאִים֙ יִהְי֣וּ לְר֔וּחַ וְהַדִּבֵּ֖ר אֵ֣ין בָּהֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhnby'ym yhyv lrvch vhdbr 'yn bhm khh y'shh lhm {s}
verses.translation: And the prophets shall become wind, And the word is not in them; Thus be it done unto them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְכֶ֔ם אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ דְּבָרַ֨י בְּפִ֜יךָ לְאֵ֗שׁ וְהָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֛ה עֵצִ֖ים וַאֲכָלָֽתַם׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt y'n dbrkhm 'thdbr hzh hnny ntn dbry bpykh l'sh vh'm hzh 'tsym v'khltm
verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts: Because ye speak this word, Behold, I will make My words in thy mouth fire, And this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מֵבִיא֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם גּ֧וֹי מִמֶּרְחָ֛ק בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה גּ֣וֹי  אֵיתָ֣ן ה֗וּא גּ֤וֹי מֵֽעוֹלָם֙ ה֔וּא גּ֚וֹי לֹא־תֵדַ֣ע לְשֹׁנ֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע מַה־יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: hnny mby' 'lykhm gvy mmrchq byt yshr'l n'myhvh gvy  'ytn hv' gvy m'vlm hv' gvy l'td' lshnv vl' tshm' mhydbr
verses.translation: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD; It is an enduring nation, It is an ancient nation, A nation whose language thou knowest not, Neither understandest what they say.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁפָּת֖וֹ כְּקֶ֣בֶר פָּת֑וּחַ כֻּלָּ֖ם גִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'shptv khqbr ptvch khlm gbvrym
verses.translation: Their quiver is an open sepulchre, They are all mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָכַ֨ל קְצִֽירְךָ֜ וְלַחְמֶ֗ךָ יֹֽאכְלוּ֙ בָּנֶ֣יךָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יךָ יֹאכַ֤ל צֹֽאנְךָ֙ וּבְקָרֶ֔ךָ יֹאכַ֥ל גַּפְנְךָ֖ וּתְאֵנָתֶ֑ךָ יְרֹשֵׁ֞שׁ עָרֵ֣י מִבְצָרֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖נָּה בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'khl qtsyrkh vlchmkh y'khlv bnykh vbnvtykh y'khl ts'nkh vbqrkh y'khl gpnkh vt'ntkh yrshsh 'ry mbtsrykh 'shr 'th btch bhnh bchrb
verses.translation: And they shall eat up thy harvest, and thy bread, They shall eat up thy sons and thy daughters, They shall eat up thy flocks and thy herds, They shall eat up thy vines and thy fig-trees; They shall batter thy fortified cities, Wherein thou trusteth, with the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֛ם בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖מָּה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹא־אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם כָּלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vgm bymym hhmh n'myhvh l'''shh 'tkhm khlh
verses.translation: But even in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ תַּ֣חַת מֶ֗ה עָשָׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ לָ֖נוּ אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ וַתַּעַבְד֞וּ אֱלֹהֵ֤י נֵכָר֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם כֵּ֚ן תַּעַבְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א לָכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh khy t'mrv tcht mh 'shh yhvh 'lhynv lnv 'tkhl'lh v'mrt 'lyhm kh'shr 'zbtm 'vty vt'bdv 'lhy nkhr b'rtskhm khn t'bdv zrym b'rts l' lkhm {p}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say: ‘Wherefore hath the LORD our God done all these things unto us?’ then shalt Thou say unto them: ‘Like as ye have forsaken Me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגִּ֥ידוּ זֹ֖את בְּבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְהַשְׁמִיע֥וּהָ בִיהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: hgydv z't bbyt y'qb vhshmy'vh byhvdh l'mr
verses.translation: Declare ye this in the house of Jacob, And announce it in Judah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֣א זֹ֔את עַ֥ם סָכָ֖ל וְאֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב עֵינַ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ אׇזְנַ֥יִם לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: shm'vn' z't 'm skhl v'yn lb 'ynym lhm vl' yr'v 'znym lhm vl' yshm'v
verses.translation: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding, That have eyes, and see not, That have ears, and hear not:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאוֹתִ֨י לֹא־תִירָ֜אוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה אִ֤ם מִפָּנַי֙ לֹ֣א תָחִ֔ילוּ אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֤מְתִּי חוֹל֙ גְּב֣וּל לַיָּ֔ם חׇק־עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יַעַבְרֶ֑נְהוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יוּכָ֔לוּ וְהָמ֥וּ גַלָּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א יַעַבְרֻֽנְהוּ׃
verses.translit: h'vty l'tyr'v n'myhvh 'm mpny l' tchylv 'shrshmty chvl gbvl lym chq'vlm vl' y'brnhv vytg'shv vl' yvkhlv vhmv glyv vl' y'brnhv
verses.translation: Fear ye not Me? saith the LORD; Will ye not tremble at My presence? Who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea, An everlasting ordinance, which it cannot pass; And though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; Though they roar, yet can they not pass over it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ הָיָ֔ה לֵ֖ב סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמוֹרֶ֑ה סָ֖רוּ וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: vl'm hzh hyh lb svrr vmvrh srv vylkhv
verses.translation: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; They are revolted, and gone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֽוֹא־אָמְר֣וּ בִלְבָבָ֗ם נִ֤ירָא נָא֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הַנֹּתֵ֗ן גֶּ֛שֶׁם (וירה) [יוֹרֶ֥ה] וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ בְּעִתּ֑וֹ שְׁבֻעֹ֛ת חֻקּ֥וֹת קָצִ֖יר יִשְׁמׇר־לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vlv''mrv blbbm nyr' n' 'tyhvh 'lhynv hntn gshm (vyrh) [yvrh] vmlqvsh b'tv shb't chqvt qtsyr yshmrlnv
verses.translation: Neither say they in their heart: ‘Let us now fear the LORD our God, That giveth the former rain, and the latter in due season; That keepeth for us The appointed weeks of the harvest.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲוֺנוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם הִטּוּ־אֵ֑לֶּה וְחַטֹּ֣אותֵיכֶ֔ם מָנְע֥וּ הַטּ֖וֹב מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'vnvtykhm htv'lh vcht'vtykhm mn'v htvb mkhm
verses.translation: Your iniquities have turned away these things, And your sins have withholden good from you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נִמְצְא֥וּ בְעַמִּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֑ים יָשׁוּר֙ כְּשַׁ֣ךְ יְקוּשִׁ֔ים הִצִּ֥יבוּ מַשְׁחִ֖ית אֲנָשִׁ֥ים יִלְכֹּֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: khynmts'v b'my rsh'ym yshvr khshkh yqvshym htsybv mshchyt 'nshym ylkhdv
verses.translation: For among My people are found wicked men; They pry, as fowlers lie in wait; They set a trap, they catch men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּכְלוּב֙ מָ֣לֵא ע֔וֹף כֵּ֥ן בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם מְלֵאִ֣ים מִרְמָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֥ן גָּדְל֖וּ וַֽיַּעֲשִֽׁירוּ׃
verses.translit: khkhlvb ml' 'vf khn btyhm ml'ym mrmh 'lkhn gdlv vy'shyrv
verses.translation: As a cage is full of birds, So are their houses full of deceit; Therefore they are become great, and waxen rich;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָֽׁמְנ֣וּ עָֽשְׁת֗וּ גַּ֚ם עָבְר֣וּ דִבְרֵי־רָ֔ע דִּ֣ין לֹא־דָ֔נוּ דִּ֥ין יָת֖וֹם וְיַצְלִ֑יחוּ וּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לֹ֥א שָׁפָֽטוּ׃
verses.translit: shmnv 'shtv gm 'brv dbryr' dyn l'dnv dyn ytvm vytslychv vmshpt 'byvnym l' shptv
verses.translation: They are waxen fat, they are become sleek; Yea, they overpass in deeds of wickedness; They plead not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, That they might make it to prosper; And the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעַל־אֵ֥לֶּה לֹֽא־אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה אִ֚ם בְּג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּזֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'l'lh l''pqd n'myhvh 'm bgvy 'shrkhzh l' ttnqm npshy {s}
verses.translation: Shall I not punish for these things? Saith the LORD; Shall not My soul be avenged On such a nation as this?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ וְשַׁ֣עֲרוּרָ֔ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: shmh vsh'rvrh nhyth b'rts
verses.translation: An appalling and horrible thing Is come to pass in the land:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנְּבִאִ֞ים נִבְּא֣וּ בַשֶּׁ֗קֶר וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ יִרְדּ֣וּ עַל־יְדֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַמִּ֖י אָ֣הֲבוּ כֵ֑ן וּמַֽה־תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hnb'ym nb'v bshqr vhkhhnym yrdv 'lydyhm v'my 'hbv khn vmht'shv l'chryth
verses.translation: The prophets prophesy in the service of falsehood, And the priests bear rule at their beck; And My people love to have it so; What then will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָעִ֣זוּ  בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֗ן מִקֶּ֙רֶב֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וּבִתְק֙וֹעַ֙ תִּקְע֣וּ שׁוֹפָ֔ר וְעַל־בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּ֖רֶם שְׂא֣וּ מַשְׂאֵ֑ת כִּ֥י רָעָ֛ה נִשְׁקְפָ֥ה מִצָּפ֖וֹן וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: h'zv  bny bnymn mqrb yrvshl͏m vbtqv' tq'v shvpr v'lbyt hkhrm sh'v msh't khy r'h nshqph mtspvn vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: Put yourselves under covert, ye children of Benjamin, Away from the midst of Jerusalem, And blow the horn in Tekoa, And set up a signal on Beth-cherem; For evil looketh forth from the north, And a great destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנָּוָה֙ וְהַמְּעֻנָּגָ֔ה דָּמִ֖יתִי בַּת־צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: hnvh vhm'ngh dmyty bttsyvn
verses.translation: The comely and delicate one, The daughter of Zion, will I cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלֶ֛יהָ יָבֹ֥אוּ רֹעִ֖ים וְעֶדְרֵיהֶ֑ם תָּקְע֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ אֹֽהָלִים֙ סָבִ֔יב רָע֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־יָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lyh yb'v r'ym v'dryhm tq'v 'lyh 'hlym sbyb r'v 'ysh 'tydv
verses.translation: Shepherds with their flocks come unto her; They pitch their tents against her round about; They feed bare every one what is nigh at hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה ק֖וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה בַֽצׇּהֳרָ֑יִם א֥וֹי לָ֙נוּ֙ כִּֽי־פָנָ֣ה הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י יִנָּט֖וּ צִלְלֵי־עָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: qdshv 'lyh mlchmh qvmv vn'lh btshrym 'vy lnv khypnh hyvm khy yntv tslly'rb
verses.translation: ’Prepare ye war against her; Arise, and let us go up at noon! ’ ’Woe unto us! for the day declineth, For the shadows of the evening are stretched out! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֚וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה בַלָּ֔יְלָה וְנַשְׁחִ֖יתָה אַרְמְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qvmv vn'lh blylh vnshchyth 'rmnvtyh {p}
verses.translation: ’Arise, and let us go up by night, And let us destroy her palaces.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת כִּרְת֣וּ עֵצָ֔הֿ וְשִׁפְכ֥וּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם סֹֽלְלָ֑ה הִ֚יא הָעִ֣יר הׇפְקַ֔ד כֻּלָּ֖הּ עֹ֥שֶׁק בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt khrtv 'tsh vshpkhv 'lyrvshl͏m sllh hy' h'yr hpqd khlh 'shq bqrbh
verses.translation: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said: Hew ye down her trees, And cast up a mound against Jerusalem; This is the city to be punished; Everywhere there is oppression in the midst of her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּהָקִ֥יר (בור) [בַּ֙יִר֙] מֵימֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֖ן הֵקֵ֣רָה רָעָתָ֑הּ חָמָ֣ס וָ֠שֹׁ֠ד יִשָּׁ֨מַע בָּ֧הּ עַל־פָּנַ֛י תָּמִ֖יד חֳלִ֥י וּמַכָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khhqyr (bvr) [byr] mymyh khn hqrh r'th chms vshd yshm' bh 'lpny tmyd chly vmkhh
verses.translation: As a cistern welleth with her waters, So she welleth with her wickedness; Violence and spoil is heard in her; Before Me continually is sickness and wounds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִוָּֽסְרִי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם פֶּן־תֵּקַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֖י מִמֵּ֑ךְ פֶּן־אֲשִׂימֵ֣ךְ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ ל֥וֹא נוֹשָֽׁבָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hvsry yrvshl͏m pntq' npshy mmkh pn'shymkh shmmh 'rts lv' nvshbh {p}
verses.translation: Be thou corrected, O Jerusalem, Lest My soul be alienated from thee, Lest I make thee desolate, A land not inhabited.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עוֹלֵ֛ל יְעוֹלְל֥וּ כַגֶּ֖פֶן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָשֵׁב֙ יָֽדְךָ֔ כְּבוֹצֵ֖ר עַל־סַלְסִלּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'vll y'vllv khgpn sh'ryt yshr'l hshb ydkh khbvtsr 'lslslvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: They shall thoroughly glean as a vine The remnant of Israel; Turn again thy hand As a grape-gatherer upon the shoots.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מִ֨י אֲדַבְּרָ֤ה וְאָעִ֙ידָה֙ וְיִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הִנֵּה֙ עֲרֵלָ֣ה אׇזְנָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֑יב הִנֵּ֣ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ־בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lmy 'dbrh v''ydh vyshm'v hnh 'rlh 'znm vl' yvkhlv lhqshyb hnh dbryhvh hyh lhm lchrph l' ychptsvbv
verses.translation: To whom shall I speak and give warning, That they may hear? Behold, their ear is dull, And they cannot attend; Behold, the word of the LORD is become unto them a reproach, They have no delight in it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ חֲמַ֨ת יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ מָלֵ֙אתִי֙ נִלְאֵ֣יתִי הָכִ֔יל שְׁפֹ֤ךְ עַל־עוֹלָל֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְעַ֛ל ס֥וֹד בַּחוּרִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־גַם־אִ֤ישׁ עִם־אִשָּׁה֙ יִלָּכֵ֔דוּ זָקֵ֖ן עִם־מְלֵ֥א יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v't chmt yhvh  ml'ty nl'yty hkhyl shpkh 'l'vll bchvts v'l svd bchvrym ychdv khygm'ysh 'm'shh ylkhdv zqn 'mml' ymym
verses.translation: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD, I am weary with holding in: Pour it out upon the babes in the street, And upon the assembly of young men together; For even the husband with the wife shall be taken, The aged with him that is full of days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֤בּוּ בָֽתֵּיהֶם֙ לַאֲחֵרִ֔ים שָׂד֥וֹת וְנָשִׁ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־אַטֶּ֧ה אֶת־יָדִ֛י עַל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnsbv btyhm l'chrym shdvt vnshym ychdv khy'th 'tydy 'lyshby h'rts n'myhvh
verses.translation: And their houses shall be turned unto others, Their fields and their wives together; For I will stretch out My hand upon the inhabitants of the land, Saith the LORD. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִקְּטַנָּם֙ וְעַד־גְּדוֹלָ֔ם כֻּלּ֖וֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וּמִנָּבִיא֙ וְעַד־כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלּ֖וֹ עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: khy mqtnm v'dgdvlm khlv bvts' bts' vmnby' v'dkhhn khlv 'shh shqr
verses.translation: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them Every one is greedy for gain; And from the prophet even unto the priest Every one dealeth falsely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְרַפְּא֞וּ אֶת־שֶׁ֤בֶר עַמִּי֙ עַל־נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵאמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם ׀ שָׁל֑וֹם וְאֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyrp'v 'tshbr 'my 'lnqlh l'mr shlvm  shlvm v'yn shlvm
verses.translation: They have healed also the hurt of My people lightly, Saying: ‘Peace, peace’, when there is no peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא־יֵב֗וֹשׁוּ גַּם־הַכְלִים֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָכֵ֞ן יִפְּל֧וּ בַנֹּפְלִ֛ים בְּעֵת־פְּקַדְתִּ֥ים יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hbyshv khy tv'bh 'shv gmbvsh l'ybvshv gmhkhlym l' yd'v lkhn yplv bnplym b'tpqdtym ykhshlv 'mr yhvh {s}
verses.translation: They shall be put to shame because they have committed abomination; Yea, they are not at all ashamed, Neither know they how to blush; Therefore they shall fall among them that fall, At the time that I punish them they shall stumble, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֡ה עִמְדוּ֩ עַל־דְּרָכִ֨ים וּרְא֜וּ וְשַׁאֲל֣וּ  לִנְתִב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֗ם אֵי־זֶ֨ה דֶ֤רֶךְ הַטּוֹב֙ וּלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ וּמִצְא֥וּ מַרְגּ֖וֹעַ לְנַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'mdv 'ldrkhym vr'v vsh'lv  lntbvt 'vlm 'yzh drkh htvb vlkhvbh vmts'v mrgv' lnpshkhm vy'mrv l' nlkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Stand ye in the ways and see, And ask for the old paths, Where is the good way, and walk therein, And ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said: ‘We will not walk therein.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ צֹפִ֔ים הַקְשִׁ֖יבוּ לְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַקְשִֽׁיב׃
verses.translit: vhqmty 'lykhm tspym hqshybv lqvl shvpr vy'mrv l' nqshyb
verses.translation: And I set watchmen over you: ‘Attend to the sound of the horn’, But they said: ‘We will not attend.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֖ן שִׁמְע֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּדְעִ֥י עֵדָ֖ה אֶת־אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v hgvym vd'y 'dh 't'shrbm
verses.translation: Therefore hear, ye nations, And know, O congregation, what is against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעִ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה פְּרִ֣י מַחְשְׁבוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֤י עַל־דְּבָרַי֙ לֹ֣א הִקְשִׁ֔יבוּ וְתוֹרָתִ֖י וַיִּמְאֲסוּ־בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: shm'y h'rts hnh 'nkhy mby' r'h 'lh'm hzh pry mchshbvtm khy 'ldbry l' hqshybv vtvrty vym'svbh
verses.translation: Hear, O earth: Behold, I will bring evil upon this people, Even the fruit of their thoughts, Because they have not attended unto My words, And as for My teaching, they have rejected it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָמָּה־זֶּ֨ה לִ֤י לְבוֹנָה֙ מִשְּׁבָ֣א תָב֔וֹא וְקָנֶ֥ה הַטּ֖וֹב מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מֶרְחָ֑ק עֹלֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ לֹ֣א לְרָצ֔וֹן וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם לֹא־עָ֥רְבוּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmhzh ly lbvnh mshb' tbv' vqnh htvb m'rts mrchq 'lvtykhm l' lrtsvn vzbchykhm l''rbv ly
verses.translation: To what purpose is to Me the frankincense that cometh from Sheba, And the sweet cane, from a far country? Your burnt-offerings are not acceptable, Nor your sacrifices pleasing unto Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן אֶל־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה מִכְשֹׁלִ֑ים וְכָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֠ם אָב֨וֹת וּבָנִ֥ים יַחְדָּ֛ו שָׁכֵ֥ן וְרֵע֖וֹ (יאבדו) [וְאָבָֽדוּ]׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 'lh'm hzh mkhshlym vkhshlv bm 'bvt vbnym ychdv shkhn vr'v (y'bdv) [v'bdv] {p}
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, And the fathers and the sons together shall stumble against them, The neighbour and his friend, and they shall perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן וְג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnh 'm b' m'rts tspvn vgvy gdvl y'vr myrkhty'rts
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, a people cometh from the north country, And a great nation shall be roused from the uttermost parts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְכִיד֞וֹן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הוּא֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָם֙ כַּיָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְעַל־סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּאִישׁ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִךְ בַּת־צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: qsht vkhydvn ychzyqv 'khzry hv' vl' yrchmv qvlm khym yhmh v'lsvsym yrkhbv 'rvkh kh'ysh lmlchmh 'lykh bttsyvn
verses.translation: They lay hold on bow and spear, They are cruel, and have no compassion; Their voice is like the roaring sea, And they ride upon horses; Set in array, as a man for war, Against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ אֶת־שׇׁמְע֖וֹ רָפ֣וּ יָדֵ֑ינוּ צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִקַ֔תְנוּ חִ֖יל כַּיּֽוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'nv 'tshm'v rpv ydynv tsrh hchzqtnv chyl khyvldh
verses.translation: ’We have heard the fame thereof, our hands wax feeble, Anguish hath taken hold of us, And pain, as of a woman in travail.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־[תֵּֽצְאוּ֙] (תצאי) הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וּבַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אַל־[תֵּלֵ֑כוּ] (תלכי) כִּ֚י חֶ֣רֶב לְאֹיֵ֔ב מָג֖וֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: 'l[tts'v] (tts'y) hshdh vbdrkh 'l[tlkhv] (tlkhy) khy chrb l'yb mgvr msbyb
verses.translation: Go not forth into the field, Nor walk by the way; For there is the sword of the enemy, And terror on every side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּת־עַמִּ֤י חִגְרִי־שָׂק֙ וְהִתְפַּלְּשִׁ֣י בָאֵ֔פֶר אֵ֤בֶל יָחִיד֙ עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔ךְ מִסְפַּ֖ד תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים כִּ֣י פִתְאֹ֔ם יָבֹ֥א הַשֹּׁדֵ֖ד עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: bt'my chgryshq vhtplshy b'pr 'bl ychyd 'shy lkh mspd tmrvrym khy pt'm yb' hshdd 'lynv
verses.translation: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, And wallow thyself in ashes; Make thee mourning, as for an only son, Most bitter lamentation; For the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּח֛וֹן נְתַתִּ֥יךָ בְעַמִּ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר וְתֵדַ֕ע וּבָחַנְתָּ֖ אֶת־דַּרְכָּֽם׃
verses.translit: bchvn nttykh b'my mbtsr vtd' vbchnt 'tdrkhm
verses.translation: I have made thee a tower and a fortress among My people; That thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ סָרֵ֣י סוֹרְרִ֔ים הֹלְכֵ֥י רָכִ֖יל נְחֹ֣שֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֑ל כֻּלָּ֥ם מַשְׁחִיתִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: khlm sry svrrym hlkhy rkhyl nchsht vbrzl khlm mshchytym hmh
verses.translation: They are all grievous revolters, Going about with slanders; They are brass and iron; They all of them deal corruptly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָחַ֣ר מַפֻּ֔חַ (מאשתם) [מֵאֵ֖שׁ תַּ֣ם] עֹפָ֑רֶת לַשָּׁוְא֙ צָרַ֣ף צָר֔וֹף וְרָעִ֖ים לֹ֥א נִתָּֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: nchr mpch (m'shtm) [m'sh tm] 'prt lshv' tsrf tsrvf vr'ym l' ntqv
verses.translation: The bellows blow fiercely, The lead is consumed of the fire; In vain doth the founder refine, For the wicked are not separated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף נִמְאָ֔ס קָרְא֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־מָאַ֥ס יְהֹוָ֖ה בָּהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khsf nm's qr'v lhm khym's yhvh bhm {p}
verses.translation: Refuse silver shall men call them, Because the LORD hath rejected them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'lyrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲמֹ֗ד בְּשַׁ֙עַר֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה וְקָרָ֣אתָ שָּׁ֔ם אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־יְהוּדָה֙ הַבָּאִים֙ בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'md bsh'r byt yhvh vqr't shm 'thdbr hzh v'mrt shm'v dbryhvh khlyhvdh hb'ym bsh'rym h'lh lhshtchvt lyhvh {s}
verses.translation: Stand in the gate of the LORD’S house, and proclaim there this word, and say: Hear the word of the LORD, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשַׁכְּנָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hytybv drkhykhm vm'llykhm v'shkhnh 'tkhm bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּבְטְח֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשֶּׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵיכַ֤ל יְהֹוָה֙ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהֹוָ֔ה הֵיכַ֥ל יְהֹוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: 'ltbtchv lkhm 'ldbry hshqr l'mr hykhl yhvh hykhl yhvh hykhl yhvh hmh
verses.translation: Trust ye not in lying words, saying: ‘The temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, are these.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־הֵיטֵיב֙ תֵּיטִ֔יבוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם אִם־עָשׂ֤וֹ תַֽעֲשׂוּ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּבֵ֥ין רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'mhytyb tytybv 'tdrkhykhm v'tm'llykhm 'm'shv t'shv mshpt byn 'ysh vbyn r'hv
verses.translation: Nay, but if ye thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbour;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֵּ֣ר יָת֤וֹם וְאַלְמָנָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֹׁ֔קוּ וְדָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְאַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ לְרַ֥ע לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: gr ytvm v'lmnh l' t'shqv vdm nqy 'ltshpkhv bmqvm hzh v'chry 'lhym 'chrym l' tlkhv lr' lkhm
verses.translation: if ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁכַּנְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמִן־עוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vshkhnty 'tkhm bmqvm hzh b'rts 'shr ntty l'bvtykhm lmn'vlm v'd'vlm
verses.translation: then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם עַל־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשָּׁ֑קֶר לְבִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.translit: hnh 'tm btchym lkhm 'ldbry hshqr lblty hv'yl
verses.translation: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲגָנֹ֤ב ׀ רָצֹ֙חַ֙ וְֽנָאֹ֔ף וְהִשָּׁבֵ֥עַ לַשֶּׁ֖קֶר וְקַטֵּ֣ר לַבָּ֑עַל וְהָלֹ֗ךְ אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: hgnb  rtsch vn'f vhshb' lshqr vqtr lb'l vhlkh 'chry 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l'yd'tm
verses.translation: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and offer unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye have not known,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָאתֶ֞ם וַעֲמַדְתֶּ֣ם לְפָנַ֗י בַּבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִקְרָֽא־שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֔יו וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם נִצַּ֑לְנוּ לְמַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vb'tm v'mdtm lpny bbyt hzh 'shr nqr'shmy 'lyv v'mrtm ntslnv lm'n 'shvt 't khlhtv'bvt h'lh
verses.translation: and come and stand before Me in this house, whereupon My name is called, and say: ‘We are delivered’, that ye may do all these abominations?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְעָרַ֣ת פָּרִצִ֗ים הָיָ֨ה הַבַּ֧יִת הַזֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָֽא־שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם גַּ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה רָאִ֖יתִי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hm'rt prtsym hyh hbyt hzh 'shrnqr'shmy 'lyv b'ynykhm gm 'nkhy hnh r'yty n'myhvh
verses.translation: Is this house, whereupon My name is called, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I, even I, have seen it, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לְכוּ־נָ֗א אֶל־מְקוֹמִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשִׁיל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכַּ֧נְתִּֽי שְׁמִ֛י שָׁ֖ם בָּרִֽאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּרְאוּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי ל֔וֹ מִפְּנֵ֕י רָעַ֖ת עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy lkhvn' 'lmqvmy 'shr bshylv 'shr shkhnty shmy shm br'shvnh vr'v 't 'shr'shyty lv mpny r't 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: For go ye now unto My place which was in Shiloh, where I caused My name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of My people Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה יַ֧עַן עֲשׂוֹתְכֶ֛ם אֶת־כׇּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וָאֲדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵיכֶ֜ם הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם וְדַבֵּר֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם וָאֶקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עֲנִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th y'n 'shvtkhm 'tkhlhm'shym h'lh n'myhvh v'dbr 'lykhm hshkhm vdbr vl' shm'tm v'qr' 'tkhm vl' 'nytm
verses.translation: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spoke unto you, speaking betimes and often, but ye heard not, and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי לַבַּ֣יִת  אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא־שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים בּ֔וֹ וְלַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְשִׁלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shyty lbyt  'shr nqr'shmy 'lyv 'shr 'tm btchym bv vlmqvm 'shrntty lkhm vl'bvtykhm kh'shr 'shyty lshlv
verses.translation: therefore will I do unto the house, whereupon My name is called, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלַ֙כְתִּי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־אֲחֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כׇּל־זֶ֥רַע אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhshlkhty 'tkhm m'l pny kh'shr hshlkhty 'tkhl'chykhm 't khlzr' 'prym {p}
verses.translation: And I will cast you out of My sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אַל־תִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל  בְּעַד־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה וְאַל־תִּשָּׂ֧א בַעֲדָ֛ם רִנָּ֥ה וּתְפִלָּ֖ה וְאַל־תִּפְגַּע־בִּ֑י כִּֽי־אֵינֶ֥נִּי שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'th 'lttpll  b'dh'm hzh v'ltsh' b'dm rnh vtplh v'ltpg'by khy'ynny shm' 'tkh
verses.translation: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to Me; for I will not hear thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֵינְךָ֣ רֹאֶ֔ה מָ֛ה הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִׂ֖ים בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבְחֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: h'ynkh r'h mh hmh 'shym b'ry yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבָּנִ֞ים מְלַקְּטִ֣ים עֵצִ֗ים וְהָאָבוֹת֙ מְבַעֲרִ֣ים אֶת־הָאֵ֔שׁ וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים לָשׁ֣וֹת בָּצֵ֑ק לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת כַּוָּנִ֜ים לִמְלֶ֣כֶת הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְהַסֵּ֤ךְ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hbnym mlqtym 'tsym vh'bvt mb'rym 'th'sh vhnshym lshvt btsq l'shvt khvnym lmlkht hshmym vhskh nskhym l'lhym 'chrym lm'n hkh'sny
verses.translation: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink-offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֹתִ֛י הֵ֥ם מַכְעִסִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא אֹתָ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן בֹּ֥שֶׁת פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: h'ty hm mkh'sym n'myhvh hlv' 'tm lm'n bsht pnyhm
verses.translation: Do they provoke Me? saith the LORD; do they not provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אַפִּ֤י וַחֲמָתִי֙ נִתֶּ֙כֶת֙ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־הָאָדָם֙ וְעַל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַל־עֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְעַל־פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr  'dny yhvh hnh 'py vchmty ntkht 'lhmqvm hzh 'lh'dm v'lhbhmh v'l'ts hshdh v'lpry h'dmh vb'rh vl' tkhbh {p}
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, Mine anger and My fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the land; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹלוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם סְפ֥וּ עַל־זִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם וְאִכְל֥וּ בָשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'lvtykhm spv 'lzbchykhm v'khlv bshr
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt-offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat ye flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־דִבַּ֤רְתִּי אֶת־אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֔ים בְּי֛וֹם (הוציא) [הוֹצִיאִ֥י] אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־דִּבְרֵ֥י עוֹלָ֖ה וָזָֽבַח׃
verses.translit: khy l'dbrty 't'bvtykhm vl' tsvytym byvm (hvtsy') [hvtsy'y] 'vtm m'rts mtsrym 'ldbry 'vlh vzbch
verses.translation: For I spoke not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt-offerings or sacrifices;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִֽם־אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַ֠זֶּ֠ה צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹתָ֤ם לֵאמֹר֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ בְקוֹלִ֔י וְהָיִ֤יתִי לָכֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּֽהְיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם בְּכׇל־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'm'thdbr hzh tsvyty 'vtm l'mr shm'v bqvly vhyyty lkhm l'lhym v'tm thyvly l'm vhlkhtm bkhlhdrkh 'shr 'tsvh 'tkhm lm'n yytb lkhm
verses.translation: but this thing I commanded them, saying: ‘Hearken unto My voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be My people; and walk ye in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְלֹא־הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־אׇזְנָ֔ם וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּמֹ֣עֵצ֔וֹת בִּשְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֣ם הָרָ֑ע וַיִּהְי֥וּ לְאָח֖וֹר וְלֹ֥א לְפָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vl'htv 't'znm vylkhv bm'tsvt bshrrvt lbm hr' vyhyv l'chvr vl' lpnym
verses.translation: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in their own counsels, even in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward and not forward,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמִן־הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים י֖וֹם הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹֽחַ׃
verses.translit: lmnhyvm 'shr yts'v 'bvtykhm m'rts mtsrym 'd hyvm hzh v'shlch 'lykhm 'tkhl'bdy hnby'ym yvm hshkhm vshlch
verses.translation: even since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day; and though I have sent unto you all My servants the prophets, sending them daily betimes and often,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְל֤וֹא שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת־אׇזְנָ֑ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עׇרְפָּ֔ם הֵרֵ֖עוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vlv' shm'v 'ly vl' htv 't'znm vyqshv 't'rpm hr'v m'bvtm
verses.translation: yet they hearkened not unto Me, nor inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff; they did worse than their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְע֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֽוּכָה׃
verses.translit: vdbrt 'lyhm 'tkhlhdbrym h'lh vl' yshm'v 'lykh vqr't 'lyhm vl' y'nvkhh
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak all these words unto them, but they will not hearken to thee; thou shalt also call unto them, but they will not answer thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֶ֤ה הַגּוֹי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֽוֹא־שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א לָקְח֖וּ מוּסָ֑ר אָֽבְדָה֙ הָאֱמוּנָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מִפִּיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm zh hgvy 'shr lv'shm'v bqvl yhvh 'lhyv vl' lqchv mvsr 'bdh h'mvnh vnkhrth mpyhm {s}
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt say unto them: This is the nation that hath not hearkened To the voice of the LORD their God, Nor received correction; Faithfulness is perished, And is cut off from their mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גׇּזִּ֤י נִזְרֵךְ֙ וְֽהַשְׁלִ֔יכִי וּשְׂאִ֥י עַל־שְׁפָיִ֖ם קִינָ֑ה כִּ֚י מָאַ֣ס יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיִּטֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־דּ֥וֹר עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: gzy nzrkh vhshlykhy vsh'y 'lshpym qynh khy m's yhvh vytsh 'tdvr 'brtv
verses.translation: Cut off thy hair, and cast it away, And take up a lamentation on the high hills; For the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־עָשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֥ה הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה שָׂ֣מוּ שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָֽא־שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy'shv bnyyhvdh hr' b'yny n'myhvh shmv shqvtsyhm bbyt 'shrnqr'shmy 'lyv ltm'v
verses.translation: For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in My sight, saith the LORD; they have set their detestable things in the house whereon My name is called, to defile it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָנ֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת הַתֹּ֗פֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם לִשְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צִוִּ֔יתִי וְלֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל־לִבִּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbnv bmvt htpt 'shr bgy' bnhnm lshrf 'tbnyhm v'tbntyhm b'sh 'shr l' tsvyty vl' 'lth 'llby {p}
verses.translation: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded not, neither came it into My mind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹא־יֵאָמֵ֨ר ע֤וֹד הַתֹּ֙פֶת֙ וְגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם כִּ֖י אִם־גֵּ֣יא הַהֲרֵגָ֑ה וְקָבְר֥וּ בְתֹ֖פֶת מֵאֵ֥ין מָקֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnhymym b'ym n'myhvh vl'y'mr 'vd htpt vgy' bnhnm khy 'mgy' hhrgh vqbrv btpt m'yn mqvm
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter; for they shall bury in Topheth, for lack of room.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה נִבְלַ֨ת הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vhyth nblt h'm hzh lm'khl l'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: And the carcasses of this people shall be food for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall frighten them away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֣י  מֵעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וּמֵֽחֻצוֹת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה כִּ֥י לְחׇרְבָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhshbty  m'ry yhvdh vmchtsvt yrvshl͏m qvl shshvn vqvl shmchh qvl chtn vqvl khlh khy lchrbh thyh h'rts
verses.translation: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land shall be desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֣יא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֡ה (ויציאו) [יוֹצִ֣יאוּ] אֶת־עַצְמ֣וֹת מַלְכֵי־יְהוּדָ֣ה וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׂרָיו֩ וְאֶת־עַצְמ֨וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת  עַצְמ֣וֹת הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים וְאֵ֛ת עַצְמ֥וֹת יוֹשְׁבֵֽי־יְרוּשָׁלָ֖͏ִם מִקִּבְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: b't hhy' n'myhvh (vytsy'v) [yvtsy'v] 't'tsmvt mlkhyyhvdh v't'tsmvtshryv v't'tsmvt hkhhnym v't  'tsmvt hnby'ym v't 'tsmvt yvshbyyrvshl͏m mqbryhm
verses.translation: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁטָחוּם֩ לַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵ֜חַ וּלְכֹ֣ל  צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲהֵב֜וּם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדוּם֙ וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ הָלְכ֣וּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר דְּרָשׁ֔וּם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם לֹ֤א יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְדֹ֛מֶן עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vshtchvm lshmsh vlyrch vlkhl  tsb' hshmym 'shr 'hbvm v'shr 'bdvm v'shr hlkhv 'chryhm v'shr drshvm v'shr hshtchvv lhm l' y'spv vl' yqbrv ldmn 'lpny h'dmh yhyv
verses.translation: and they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped; they shall not be gathered, nor be buried, they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִבְחַ֥ר מָ֙וֶת֙ מֵחַיִּ֔ים לְכֹ֗ל הַשְּׁאֵרִית֙ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֔ים מִן־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּכׇל־הַמְּקֹמ֤וֹת הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתִּ֣ים שָׁ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnbchr mvt mchyym lkhl hsh'ryt hnsh'rym mnhmshpchh hr'h hz't bkhlhmqmvt hnsh'rym 'shr hdchtym shm n'm yhvh tsb'vt {s}
verses.translation: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הֲיִפְּל֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יָק֑וּמוּ אִם־יָשׁ֖וּב וְלֹ֥א יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh hyplv vl' yqvmv 'myshvb vl' yshvb
verses.translation: Moreover thou shalt say unto them: Thus saith the LORD: Do men fall, and not rise up again? Doth one turn away, and not return?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַדּ֨וּעַ שׁוֹבְבָ֜ה הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֛ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם מְשֻׁבָ֣ה נִצַּ֑חַת הֶחֱזִ֙יקוּ֙ בַּתַּרְמִ֔ת מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: mdv' shvbbh h'm hzh yrvshl͏m mshbh ntscht hchzyqv btrmt m'nv lshvb
verses.translation: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? They hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִקְשַׁ֤בְתִּי וָֽאֶשְׁמָע֙ לוֹא־כֵ֣ן יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ אֵ֣ין אִ֗ישׁ נִחָם֙ עַל־רָ֣עָת֔וֹ לֵאמֹ֖ר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתִי כֻּלֹּ֗ה שָׁ֚ב (במרצותם) [בִּמְר֣וּצָתָ֔ם] כְּס֥וּס שׁוֹטֵ֖ף בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: hqshbty v'shm' lv'khn ydbrv 'yn 'ysh nchm 'lr'tv l'mr mh 'shyty khlh shb (bmrtsvtm) [bmrvtstm] khsvs shvtf bmlchmh
verses.translation: I attended and listened, but they spoke not aright; no man repenteth him of his wickedness, saying: ‘What have I done?’ Every one turneth away in his course, as a horse that rusheth headlong in the battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־חֲסִידָ֣ה בַשָּׁמַ֗יִם יָֽדְעָה֙ מוֹעֲדֶ֔יהָ וְתֹ֤ר (וסוס) [וְסִיס֙] וְעָג֔וּר שָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־עֵ֣ת בֹּאָ֑נָה וְעַמִּ֕י לֹ֣א יָדְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: gmchsydh bshmym yd'h mv'dyh vtr (vsvs) [vsys] v'gvr shmrv 't't b'nh v'my l' yd'v 't mshpt yhvh
verses.translation: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the swallow and the crane observe the time of their coming; but My people know not the ordinance of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיכָ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ חֲכָמִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְתוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה אִתָּ֑נוּ אָכֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה לַשֶּׁ֣קֶר עָשָׂ֔ה עֵ֖ט שֶׁ֥קֶר סֹפְרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ykhh t'mrv chkhmym 'nchnv vtvrt yhvh 'tnv 'khn hnh lshqr 'shh 't shqr sprym
verses.translation: How do ye say: ‘We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us’? Lo, certainly in vain hath wrought the vain pen of the scribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹבִ֣שׁוּ חֲכָמִ֔ים חַ֖תּוּ וַיִּלָּכֵ֑דוּ הִנֵּ֤ה בִדְבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ מָאָ֔סוּ וְחׇכְמַ֥ת מֶ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hbshv chkhmym chtv vylkhdv hnh bdbryhvh m'sv vchkhmt mh lhm
verses.translation: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken; lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֜ם לַאֲחֵרִ֗ים שְׂדֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ לְי֣וֹרְשִׁ֔ים כִּ֤י מִקָּטֹן֙ וְעַד־גָּד֔וֹל כֻּלֹּ֖ה בֹּצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע מִנָּבִיא֙ וְעַד־כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלֹּ֖ה עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'tn 'tnshyhm l'chrym shdvtyhm lyvrshym khy mqtn v'dgdvl khlh bts' bts' mnby' v'dkhhn khlh 'shh shqr
