verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָֽצְמוּ־לִ֤י אַלְמְנוֹתָו֙ מֵח֣וֹל יַמִּ֔ים הֵבֵ֨אתִי לָהֶ֥ם עַל־אֵ֛ם בָּח֖וּר שֹׁדֵ֣ד בַּֽצׇּהֳרָ֑יִם הִפַּ֤לְתִּי עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ פִּתְאֹ֔ם עִ֖יר וּבֶהָלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'tsmvly 'lmnvtv mchvl ymym hb'ty lhm 'l'm bchvr shdd btshrym hplty 'lyh pt'm 'yr vbhlvt
verses.translation: Their widows are increased to Me above the sand of the seas; I bring upon them, against the mother, a chosen one, Even a spoiler at noonday; I cause anguish and terrors to fall upon her suddenly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֻמְלְלָ֞ה יֹלֶ֣דֶת הַשִּׁבְעָ֗ה נָפְחָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֛הּ (באה) [בָּ֥א] שִׁמְשָׁ֛הּ בְּעֹ֥ד יוֹמָ֖ם בּ֣וֹשָׁה וְחָפֵ֑רָה וּשְׁאֵרִיתָ֗ם לַחֶ֧רֶב אֶתֵּ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mllh yldt hshb'h npchh npshh (b'h) [b'] shmshh b'd yvmm bvshh vchprh vsh'rytm lchrb 'tn lpny 'ybyhm n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: She that hath borne seven languisheth; Her spirit droopeth; Her sun is gone down while it was yet day, She is ashamed and confounded; And the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, Saith the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֽוֹי־לִ֣י אִמִּ֔י כִּ֣י יְלִדְתִּ֗נִי אִ֥ישׁ רִ֛יב וְאִ֥ישׁ מָד֖וֹן לְכׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא־נָשִׁ֥יתִי וְלֹא־נָֽשׁוּ־בִ֖י כֻּלֹּ֥ה מְקַֽלְלַֽוְנִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'vyly 'my khy yldtny 'ysh ryb v'ysh mdvn lkhlh'rts l'nshyty vl'nshvby khlh mqllvny {s}
verses.translation: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me A man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; Yet every one of them doth curse me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אִם־לֹ֥א (שרותך) [שֵׁרִיתִ֖יךָ] לְט֑וֹב אִם־ל֣וֹא  הִפְגַּ֣עְתִּֽי בְךָ֗ בְּעֵ֥ת רָעָ֛ה וּבְעֵ֥ת צָרָ֖ה אֶת־הָאֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translit: 'mr yhvh 'ml' (shrvtkh) [shrytykh] ltvb 'mlv'  hpg'ty bkh b't r'h vb't tsrh 'th'yb
verses.translation: The LORD said: ‘Verily I will release thee for good; verily I will cause the enemy to make supplication unto thee in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיָרֹ֨עַ בַּרְזֶ֧ל ׀ בַּרְזֶ֛ל מִצָּפ֖וֹן וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: hyr' brzl  brzl mtspvn vnchsht
verses.translation: Can iron break iron from the north and brass?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֵילְךָ֧ וְאוֹצְרוֹתֶ֛יךָ לָבַ֥ז אֶתֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א בִמְחִ֑יר וּבְכׇל־חַטֹּאותֶ֖יךָ וּבְכׇל־גְּבוּלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: chylkh v'vtsrvtykh lbz 'tn l' bmchyr vbkhlcht'vtykh vbkhlgbvlykh
verses.translation: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give for a spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֹ֣יְבֶ֔יךָ בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּי־אֵ֛שׁ קָדְחָ֥ה בְאַפִּ֖י עֲלֵיכֶ֥ם תּוּקָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vh'brty 't'ybykh b'rts l' yd't khy'sh qdchh b'py 'lykhm tvqd {s}
verses.translation: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not; for a fire is kindled in My nostril, which shall burn upon you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֧ה יָדַ֣עְתָּ יְהֹוָ֗ה זׇכְרֵ֤נִי וּפׇקְדֵ֙נִי֙ וְהִנָּ֤קֶם לִי֙ מֵרֹ֣דְפַ֔י אַל־לְאֶ֥רֶךְ אַפְּךָ֖ תִּקָּחֵ֑נִי דַּ֕ע שְׂאֵתִ֥י עָלֶ֖יךָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'th yd't yhvh zkhrny vpqdny vhnqm ly mrdpy 'll'rkh 'pkh tqchny d' sh'ty 'lykh chrph
verses.translation: Thou, O LORD, knowest; Remember me, and think of me, and avenge me of my persecutors; Take me not away because of Thy long-suffering; Know that for Thy sake I have suffered taunts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִמְצְא֤וּ דְבָרֶ֙יךָ֙ וָאֹ֣כְלֵ֔ם וַיְהִ֤י (דבריך) [דְבָֽרְךָ֙] לִ֔י לְשָׂשׂ֖וֹן וּלְשִׂמְחַ֣ת לְבָבִ֑י כִּֽי־נִקְרָ֤א שִׁמְךָ֙ עָלַ֔י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nmts'v dbrykh v'khlm vyhy (dbrykh) [dbrkh] ly lshshvn vlshmcht lbby khynqr' shmkh 'ly yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt {s}
verses.translation: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; And Thy words were unto me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart; Because Thy name was called on me, O LORD God of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יָשַׁ֥בְתִּי בְסוֹד־מְשַׂחֲקִ֖ים וָאֶעְלֹ֑ז מִפְּנֵ֤י יָֽדְךָ֙ בָּדָ֣ד יָשַׁ֔בְתִּי כִּי־זַ֖עַם מִלֵּאתָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: l'yshbty bsvdmshchqym v''lz mpny ydkh bdd yshbty khyz'm ml'tny
verses.translation: I sat not in the assembly of them that make merry, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of Thy hand; For Thou hast filled me with indignation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה הָיָ֤ה כְאֵבִי֙ נֶ֔צַח וּמַכָּתִ֖י אֲנוּשָׁ֑ה מֵֽאֲנָה֙ הֵרָפֵ֔א הָי֨וֹ תִהְיֶ֥ה לִי֙ כְּמ֣וֹ אַכְזָ֔ב מַ֖יִם לֹ֥א נֶאֱמָֽנוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lmh hyh kh'by ntsch vmkhty 'nvshh m'nh hrp' hyv thyh ly khmv 'khzb mym l' n'mnv {s}
verses.translation: Why is my pain perpetual, And my wound incurable, so that it refuseth to be healed? Wilt Thou indeed be unto me as a deceitful brook, As waters that fail?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אִם־תָּשׁ֤וּב וַאֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֙ לְפָנַ֣י תַּעֲמֹ֔ד וְאִם־תּוֹצִ֥יא יָקָ֛ר מִזּוֹלֵ֖ל כְּפִ֣י תִֽהְיֶ֑ה יָשֻׁ֤בוּ הֵ֙מָּה֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹא־תָשׁ֥וּב אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'mtshvb v'shybkh lpny t'md v'mtvtsy' yqr mzvll khpy thyh yshbv hmh 'lykh v'th l'tshvb 'lyhm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: If thou return, and I bring thee back, Thou shalt stand before Me; And if thou bring forth the precious out of the vile, Thou shalt be as My mouth; Let them return unto thee, But thou shalt not return unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֜יךָ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה לְחוֹמַ֤ת נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ בְּצוּרָ֔ה וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹא־י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְהוֹשִׁיעֲךָ֥ וּלְהַצִּילֶ֖ךָ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnttykh l'm hzh lchvmt nchsht btsvrh vnlchmv 'lykh vl'yvkhlv lkh khy'tkh 'ny lhvshy'kh vlhtsylkh n'myhvh
verses.translation: And I will make thee unto this people a fortified brazen wall; And they shall fight against thee, But they shall not prevail against thee; For I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִצַּלְתִּ֖יךָ מִיַּ֣ד רָעִ֑ים וּפְדִתִ֖יךָ מִכַּ֥ף עָרִצִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhtsltykh myd r'ym vpdtykh mkhf 'rtsym {s}
verses.translation: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, And I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תִקַּ֥ח לְךָ֖ אִשָּׁ֑ה וְלֹֽא־יִהְי֤וּ לְךָ֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֔וֹת בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'tqch lkh 'shh vl'yhyv lkh bnym vbnvt bmqvm hzh {s}
verses.translation: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה עַל־הַבָּנִים֙ וְעַל־הַבָּנ֔וֹת הַיִּלּוֹדִ֖ים בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְעַֽל־אִמֹּתָ֞ם הַיֹּלְד֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗ם וְעַל־אֲבוֹתָ֛ם הַמּוֹלִדִ֥ים אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh 'lhbnym v'lhbnvt hylvdym bmqvm hzh v'l'mtm hyldvt 'vtm v'l'bvtm hmvldym 'vtm b'rts hz't
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bore them, and concerning their fathers that begot them in this land:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְמוֹתֵ֨י תַחֲלֻאִ֜ים יָמֻ֗תוּ לֹ֤א יִסָּֽפְדוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְדֹ֛מֶן עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה יִהְי֑וּ וּבַחֶ֤רֶב וּבָֽרָעָב֙ יִכְל֔וּ וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָתָם֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mmvty tchl'ym ymtv l' yspdv vl' yqbrv ldmn 'lpny h'dmh yhyv vbchrb vbr'b ykhlv vhyth nbltm lm'khl l'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts {s}
verses.translation: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented, neither shall they be buried, they shall be as dung upon the face of the ground; and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcasses shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אַל־תָּבוֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית מַרְזֵ֔חַ וְאַל־תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לִסְפּ֔וֹד וְאַל־תָּנֹ֖ד לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אָסַ֨פְתִּי אֶת־שְׁלוֹמִ֜י מֵאֵ֨ת הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־הַחֶ֖סֶד וְאֶת־הָרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh 'ltbv' byt mrzch v'ltlkh lspvd v'ltnd lhm khy'spty 'tshlvmy m't h'm hzh n'myhvh 'thchsd v'thrchmym
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament, neither bemoan them; for I have taken away My peace from this people, saith the LORD, even mercy and compassion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵ֨תוּ גְדֹלִ֧ים וּקְטַנִּ֛ים בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְלֹא־יִסְפְּד֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יִתְגֹּדַ֔ד וְלֹ֥א יִקָּרֵ֖חַ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vmtv gdlym vqtnym b'rts hz't l' yqbrv vl'yspdv lhm vl' ytgdd vl' yqrch lhm
verses.translation: Both the great and the small shall die in this land; they shall not be buried; neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יִפְרְס֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם עַל־אֵ֖בֶל לְנַחֲמ֣וֹ עַל־מֵ֑ת וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁק֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ כּ֣וֹס תַּנְחוּמִ֔ים עַל־אָבִ֖יו וְעַל־אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'yprsv lhm 'l'bl lnchmv 'lmt vl'yshqv 'vtm khvs tnchvmym 'l'byv v'l'mv
verses.translation: neither shall men break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵית־מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה לֹֽא־תָב֖וֹא לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אוֹתָ֑ם לֶאֱכֹ֖ל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbytmshth l'tbv' lshbt 'vtm l'khl vlshtvt {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֨י מַשְׁבִּ֜ית מִן־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה לְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם וּבִימֵיכֶ֑ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֥וֹל כַּלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mshbyt mnhmqvm hzh l'ynykhm vbymykhm qvl shshvn vqvl shmchh qvl chtn vqvl khlh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, Before your eyes and in your days, The voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, The voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י תַגִּיד֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ עַל־מֶה֩ דִבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וּמֶ֤ה עֲוֺנֵ֙נוּ֙ וּמֶ֣ה חַטָּאתֵ֔נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לַיהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khy tgyd l'm hzh 't khlhdbrym h'lh v'mrv 'lykh 'lmh dbr yhvh 'lynv 't khlhr'h hgdvlh hz't vmh 'vnnv vmh cht'tnv 'shr cht'nv lyhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt tell this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee: ‘Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם עַל֩ אֲשֶׁר־עָזְב֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיַּעַבְד֖וּם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וְאֹתִ֣י עָזָ֔בוּ וְאֶת־תּוֹרָתִ֖י לֹ֥א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm 'l 'shr'zbv 'bvtykhm 'vty n'myhvh vylkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym vy'bdvm vyshtchvv lhm v'ty 'zbv v'ttvrty l' shmrv
verses.translation: then shalt thou say unto them: ‘Because your fathers have forsaken Me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken Me, and have not kept My law;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֛ם הֲרֵעֹתֶ֥ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִנְּכֶ֣ם הֹלְכִ֗ים אִ֚ישׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבּֽוֹ־הָרָ֔ע לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמֹ֥עַ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'tm hr'tm l'shvt m'bvtykhm vhnkhm hlkhym 'ysh 'chry shrrvt lbvhr' lblty shm' 'ly
verses.translation: and ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that ye hearken not unto Me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵטַלְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם־שָׁ֞ם אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־אֶתֵּ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם חֲנִינָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhtlty 'tkhm m'l h'rts hz't 'lh'rts 'shr l' yd'tm 'tm v'bvtykhm v'bdtmshm 't'lhym 'chrym yvmm vlylh 'shr l''tn lkhm chnynh {p}
verses.translation: therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye have not known, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; forasmuch as I will show you no favour.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנֵּה־יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלֹא־יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ חַי־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnhymym b'ym n'myhvh vl'y'mr 'vd chyyhvh 'shr h'lh 'tbny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said: 'As the LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt,'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־חַי־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱלָ֜ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וּמִכֹּל֙ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדִּיחָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ עַל־אַדְמָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבוֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy 'mchyyhvh 'shr h'lh 'tbny yshr'l m'rts tspvn vmkhl h'rtsvt 'shr hdychm shmh vhshbtym 'l'dmtm 'shr ntty l'bvtm {p}
verses.translation: but: ‘As the LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries whither He had driven them’; and I will bring them back into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ (לדוגים) [לְדַיָּגִ֥ים] רַבִּ֛ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְדִיג֑וּם וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁלַח֙ לְרַבִּ֣ים צַיָּדִ֔ים וְצָד֞וּם מֵעַ֤ל כׇּל־הַר֙ וּמֵעַ֣ל כׇּל־גִּבְעָ֔ה וּמִנְּקִיקֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִֽים׃
verses.translit: hnny shlch (ldvgym) [ldygym] rbym n'myhvh vdygvm v'chrykhn 'shlch lrbym tsydym vtsdvm m'l khlhr vm'l khlgb'h vmnqyqy hsl'ym
verses.translation: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֵינַי֙ עַל־כׇּל־דַּרְכֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִסְתְּר֖וּ מִלְּפָנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־נִצְפַּ֥ן עֲוֺנָ֖ם מִנֶּ֥גֶד עֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy 'yny 'lkhldrkhyhm l' nstrv mlpny vl'ntspn 'vnm mngd 'yny
verses.translation: For Mine eyes are upon all their ways, They are not hid from My face; Neither is their iniquity concealed from Mine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֣י רִאשׁוֹנָ֗ה מִשְׁנֵ֤ה עֲוֺנָם֙ וְחַטָּאתָ֔ם עַ֖ל חַלְּלָ֣ם אֶת־אַרְצִ֑י בְּנִבְלַ֤ת שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶם֙ וְתוֹעֲב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם מָלְא֖וּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshlmty r'shvnh mshnh 'vnm vcht'tm 'l chllm 't'rtsy bnblt shqvtsyhm vtv'bvtyhm ml'v 'tnchlty {p}
verses.translation: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; Because they have profaned My land; They have filled Mine inheritance With the carcasses of their detestable things and their abominations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֞ה עֻזִּ֧י וּמָעֻזִּ֛י וּמְנוּסִ֖י בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ גּוֹיִ֤ם יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ מֵֽאַפְסֵי־אָ֔רֶץ וְיֹאמְר֗וּ אַךְ־שֶׁ֙קֶר֙ נָחֲל֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֔ינוּ הֶ֖בֶל וְאֵֽין־בָּ֥ם מוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'zy vm'zy vmnvsy byvm tsrh 'lykh gvym yb'v m'psy'rts vy'mrv 'khshqr nchlv 'bvtynv hbl v'ynbm mv'yl
verses.translation: O LORD, my strength, and my stronghold, And my refuge, in the day of affliction, Unto Thee shall the nations come From the ends of the earth, and shall say: ‘Our fathers have inherited nought but lies, Vanity and things wherein there is no profit.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיַעֲשֶׂה־לּ֥וֹ אָדָ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְהֵ֖מָּה לֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: hy'shhlv 'dm 'lhym vhmh l' 'lhym
verses.translation: Shall a man make unto himself gods, And they are no gods?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י מֽוֹדִיעָ֔ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֔את אוֹדִיעֵ֥ם אֶת־יָדִ֖י וְאֶת־גְּבוּרָתִ֑י וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־שְׁמִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lkhn hnny mvdy'm bp'm hz't 'vdy'm 'tydy v'tgbvrty vyd'v khyshmy yhvh {s}
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will cause them to know, This once will I cause them to know My hand and My might; And they shall know that My name is the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַטַּ֣את יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּתוּבָ֛ה בְּעֵ֥ט בַּרְזֶ֖ל בְּצִפֹּ֣רֶן שָׁמִ֑יר חֲרוּשָׁה֙ עַל־ל֣וּחַ לִבָּ֔ם וּלְקַרְנ֖וֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: cht't yhvdh khtvbh b't brzl btsprn shmyr chrvshh 'llvch lbm vlqrnvt mzbchvtykhm
verses.translation: The sin of Judah is written With a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond; It is graven upon the tablet of their heart, And upon the horns of your altars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּזְכֹּ֤ר בְּנֵיהֶם֙ מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֔ם וַאֲשֵׁרֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֑ן עַ֖ל גְּבָע֥וֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khzkhr bnyhm mzbchvtm v'shryhm 'l'ts r'nn 'l gb'vt hgbhvt
verses.translation: Like the symbols of their sons are their altars, And their Asherim are by the leafy trees, Upon the high hills.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲרָרִי֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה חֵילְךָ֥ כׇל־אוֹצְרוֹתֶ֖יךָ לָבַ֣ז אֶתֵּ֑ן בָּמֹתֶ֕יךָ בְּחַטָּ֖את בְּכׇל־גְּבוּלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hrry bshdh chylkh khl'vtsrvtykh lbz 'tn bmtykh bcht't bkhlgbvlykh
verses.translation: O thou that sittest upon the mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures for a spoil, And thy high places, because of sin, throughout all thy borders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַטְתָּ֗ה וּבְךָ֙ מִנַּחֲלָֽתְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וְהַעֲבַדְתִּ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־אֹ֣יְבֶ֔יךָ בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּֽי־אֵ֛שׁ קְדַחְתֶּ֥ם בְּאַפִּ֖י עַד־עוֹלָ֥ם תּוּקָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshmtth vbkh mnchltkh 'shr ntty lkh vh'bdtykh 't'ybykh b'rts 'shr l'yd't khy'sh qdchtm b'py 'd'vlm tvqd {s}
verses.translation: And thou, even of thyself, shalt discontinue from thy heritage That I gave thee; And I will cause thee to serve thine enemies In the land which thou knowest not; For ye have kindled a fire in My nostril, Which shall burn for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אָר֤וּר הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְטַ֣ח בָּאָדָ֔ם וְשָׂ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר זְרֹע֑וֹ וּמִן־יְהֹוָ֖ה יָס֥וּר לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh 'rvr hgbr 'shr ybtch b'dm vshm bshr zr'v vmnyhvh ysvr lbv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Cursed is the man that trusteth in man, And maketh flesh his arm, And whose heart departeth from the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כְּעַרְעָ֣ר בָּעֲרָבָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יִרְאֶ֖ה כִּֽי־יָ֣בוֹא ט֑וֹב וְשָׁכַ֤ן חֲרֵרִים֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֶ֥רֶץ מְלֵחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyh kh'r'r b'rbh vl' yr'h khyybv' tvb vshkhn chrrym bmdbr 'rts mlchh vl' tshb {s}
verses.translation: For he shall be like a tamarisk in the desert, And shall not see when good cometh; But shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, A salt land and not inhabited.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ הַגֶּ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְטַ֖ח בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: brvkh hgbr 'shr ybtch byhvh vhyh yhvh mbtchv
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, And whose trust the LORD is.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כְּעֵ֣ץ  שָׁת֣וּל עַל־מַ֗יִם וְעַל־יוּבַל֙ יְשַׁלַּ֣ח שׇׁרָשָׁ֔יו וְלֹ֤א (ירא) [יִרְאֶה֙] כִּי־יָ֣בֹא חֹ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה עָלֵ֖הוּ רַעֲנָ֑ן וּבִשְׁנַ֤ת בַּצֹּ֙רֶת֙ לֹ֣א יִדְאָ֔ג וְלֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מֵעֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּֽרִי׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'ts  shtvl 'lmym v'lyvbl yshlch shrshyv vl' (yr') [yr'h] khyyb' chm vhyh 'lhv r'nn vbshnt btsrt l' yd'g vl' ymysh m'shvt pry
verses.translation: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, And that spreadeth out its roots by the river, And shall not see when heat cometh, But its foliage shall be luxuriant; And shall not be anxious in the year of drought, Neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָקֹ֥ב הַלֵּ֛ב מִכֹּ֖ל וְאָנֻ֣שׁ ה֑וּא מִ֖י יֵדָעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'qb hlb mkhl v'nsh hv' my yd'nv
verses.translation: The heart is deceitful above all things, And it is exceeding weak—who can know it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה חֹקֵ֥ר לֵ֖ב בֹּחֵ֣ן כְּלָי֑וֹת וְלָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔ו כִּפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh chqr lb bchn khlyvt vltt l'ysh khdrkhv khpry m'llyv {s}
verses.translation: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, Even to give every man according to his ways, According to the fruit of his doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹרֵ֤א דָגַר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָלָ֔ד עֹ֥שֶׂה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְלֹ֣א בְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּחֲצִ֤י יָמָו֙ יַעַזְבֶ֔נּוּ וּבְאַחֲרִית֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָבָֽל׃
verses.translit: qr' dgr vl' yld 'shh 'shr vl' bmshpt bchtsy ymv y'zbnv vb'chrytv yhyh nbl
verses.translation: As the partridge that broodeth over young which she hath not brought forth, So is he that getteth riches, and not by right; In the midst of his days he shall leave them, And at his end he shall be a fool.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּסֵּ֣א כָב֔וֹד מָר֖וֹם מֵרִאשׁ֑וֹן מְק֖וֹם מִקְדָּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.translit: khs' khbvd mrvm mr'shvn mqvm mqdshnv
verses.translation: Thou throne of glory, on high from the beginning, Thou place of our sanctuary,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקְוֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה כׇּל־עֹזְבֶ֖יךָ יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ (יסורי) [וְסוּרַי֙] בָּאָ֣רֶץ יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ כִּ֥י עָזְב֛וּ מְק֥וֹר מַֽיִם־חַיִּ֖ים אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mqvh yshr'l yhvh khl'zbykh ybshv (ysvry) [vsvry] b'rts ykhtbv khy 'zbv mqvr mymchyym 'tyhvh {p}
verses.translation: Thou hope of Israel, the LORD! All that forsake Thee shall be ashamed; They that depart from Thee shall be written in the earth, Because they have forsaken the LORD, The fountain of living waters. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְפָאֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָה֙ וְאֵ֣רָפֵ֔א הוֹשִׁיעֵ֖נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה כִּ֥י תְהִלָּתִ֖י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: rp'ny yhvh v'rp' hvshy'ny v'vsh'h khy thlty 'th
verses.translation: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; Save me, and I shall be saved; For Thou art my praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־הֵ֕מָּה אֹמְרִ֖ים אֵלָ֑י אַיֵּ֥ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה יָ֥בוֹא נָֽא׃
verses.translit: hnhhmh 'mrym 'ly 'yh dbryhvh ybv' n'
verses.translation: Behold, they say unto me: ‘Where is the word of the LORD? let it come now.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י לֹא־אַ֣צְתִּי  מֵרֹעֶ֣ה אַחֲרֶ֗יךָ וְי֥וֹם אָנ֛וּשׁ לֹ֥א הִתְאַוֵּ֖יתִי אַתָּ֣ה יָדָ֑עְתָּ מוֹצָ֣א שְׂפָתַ֔י נֹ֥כַח פָּנֶ֖יךָ הָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ny l''tsty  mr'h 'chrykh vyvm 'nvsh l' ht'vyty 'th yd't mvts' shpty nkhch pnykh hyh
verses.translation: As for me, I have not hastened from being a shepherd after Thee; Neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest it; That which came out of my lips was manifest before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּֽהְיֵה־לִ֖י לִמְחִתָּ֑ה מַחֲסִי־אַ֖תָּה בְּי֥וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lthyhly lmchth mchsy'th byvm r'h
verses.translation: Be not a ruin unto me; Thou art my refuge in the day of evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ רֹֽדְפַי֙ וְאַל־אֵבֹ֣שָׁה אָ֔נִי יֵחַ֣תּוּ הֵ֔מָּה וְאַל־אֵחַ֖תָּה אָ֑נִי הָבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ י֣וֹם רָעָ֔ה וּמִשְׁנֶ֥ה שִׁבָּר֖וֹן שׇׁבְרֵֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ybshv rdpy v'l'bshh 'ny ychtv hmh v'l'chth 'ny hby' 'lyhm yvm r'h vmshnh shbrvn shbrm {s}
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed that persecute me, but let not me be ashamed; Let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed; Bring upon them the day of evil, And destroy them with double destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הָלֹ֤ךְ וְעָֽמַדְתָּ֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר בְּנֵֽי־[הָעָ֔ם] (עם) אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֤אוּ בוֹ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר יֵ֣צְאוּ ב֑וֹ וּבְכֹ֖ל שַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh 'ly hlkh v'mdt bsh'r bny[h'm] ('m) 'shr yb'v bv mlkhy yhvdh v'shr yts'v bv vbkhl sh'ry yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Thus said the LORD unto me: Go, and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲ֠לֵיהֶ֠ם שִׁמְע֨וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֜ה מַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וְכׇל־יְהוּדָ֔ה וְכֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם הַבָּאִ֖ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm shm'v dbryhvh mlkhy yhvdh vkhlyhvdh vkhl yshby yrvshl͏m hb'ym bsh'rym h'lh
verses.translation: and say unto them: Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִשָּׁמְר֖וּ בְּנַפְשׁוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַל־תִּשְׂא֤וּ מַשָּׂא֙ בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וַהֲבֵאתֶ֖ם בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרֽוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hshmrv bnpshvtykhm v'ltsh'v msh' byvm hshbt vhb'tm bsh'ry yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: thus saith the LORD: Take heed for the sake of your souls, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־תוֹצִ֨יאוּ מַשָּׂ֤א מִבָּֽתֵּיכֶם֙ בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וְכׇל־מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vl'tvtsy'v msh' mbtykhm byvm hshbt vkhlml'khh l' t'shv vqdshtm 'tyvm hshbt kh'shr tsvyty 't'bvtykhm
verses.translation: neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work; but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמְע֔וּ וְלֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת־אׇזְנָ֑ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עׇרְפָּ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֣י (שומע) [שְׁמ֔וֹעַ] וּלְבִלְתִּ֖י קַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vl' htv 't'znm vyqshv 't'rpm lblty (shvm') [shmv'] vlblty qcht mvsr
verses.translation: but they hearkened not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָ֠ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֨עַ תִּשְׁמְע֤וּן אֵלַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י  הָבִ֣יא מַשָּׂ֗א בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וּלְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת לְבִלְתִּ֥י עֲשֽׂוֹת־בֹּ֖ה כׇּל־מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'mshm' tshm'vn 'ly n'myhvh lblty  hby' msh' bsh'ry h'yr hz't byvm hshbt vlqdsh 'tyvm hshbt lblty 'shvtbh khlml'khh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto Me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but to hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֣אוּ בְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֡את מְלָכִ֣ים ׀ וְשָׂרִ֡ים יֹשְׁבִים֩ עַל־כִּסֵּ֨א דָוִ֜ד רֹכְבִ֣ים  בָּרֶ֣כֶב וּבַסּוּסִ֗ים הֵ֚מָּה וְשָׂ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְיָשְׁבָ֥ה הָעִיר־הַזֹּ֖את לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vb'v bsh'ry h'yr hz't mlkhym  vshrym yshbym 'lkhs' dvd rkhbym  brkhb vbsvsym hmh vshryhm 'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshl͏m vyshbh h'yrhz't l'vlm
verses.translation: then shall there enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall be inhabited for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֣אוּ מֵעָרֵֽי־יְ֠הוּדָ֠ה וּמִסְּבִיב֨וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וּמִן־הַשְּׁפֵלָ֤ה וּמִן־הָהָר֙ וּמִן־הַנֶּ֔גֶב מְבִאִ֛ים עוֹלָ֥ה וְזֶ֖בַח וּמִנְחָ֣ה וּלְבוֹנָ֑ה וּמְבִאֵ֥י תוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vb'v m'ryyhvdh vmsbybvt yrvshl͏m vm'rts bnymn vmnhshplh vmnhhr vmnhngb mb'ym 'vlh vzbch vmnchh vlbvnh vmb'y tvdh byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places round about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the Lowland, and from the mountains, and from the South, bringing burnt-offerings, and sacrifices, and meal-offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving, unto the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תִשְׁמְע֜וּ אֵלַ֗י לְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וּלְבִלְתִּ֣י  שְׂאֵ֣ת מַשָּׂ֗א וּבֹ֛א בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וְהִצַּ֧תִּי אֵ֣שׁ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֗יהָ וְאָ֥כְלָ֛ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ml' tshm'v 'ly lqdsh 'tyvm hshbt vlblty  sh't msh' vb' bsh'ry yrvshl͏m byvm hshbt vhtsty 'sh bsh'ryh v'khlh 'rmnvt yrvshl͏m vl' tkhbh {p}
verses.translation: But if ye will not hearken unto Me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'lyrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֥וּם וְיָרַדְתָּ֖ בֵּ֣ית הַיּוֹצֵ֑ר וְשָׁ֖מָּה אַשְׁמִיעֲךָ֥ אֶת־דְּבָרָֽי׃
verses.translit: qvm vyrdt byt hyvtsr vshmh 'shmy'kh 'tdbry
verses.translation: ’Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear My words.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵרֵ֖ד בֵּ֣ית הַיּוֹצֵ֑ר (והנהו) [וְהִנֵּה־ה֛וּא] עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה עַל־הָאׇבְנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'rd byt hyvtsr (vhnhv) [vhnhhv'] 'shh ml'khh 'lh'bnym
verses.translation: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he was at his work on the wheels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁחַ֣ת הַכְּלִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֛ה בַּחֹ֖מֶר בְּיַ֣ד הַיּוֹצֵ֑ר וְשָׁ֗ב וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ כְּלִ֣י אַחֵ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשַׁ֛ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י הַיּוֹצֵ֖ר לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnshcht hkhly 'shr hv' 'shh bchmr byd hyvtsr vshb vy'shhv khly 'chr kh'shr yshr b'yny hyvtsr l'shvt {s}
verses.translation: And whensoever the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mvr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲכַיּוֹצֵ֨ר הַזֶּ֜ה לֹא־אוּכַ֨ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָכֶ֛ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה כַחֹ֙מֶר֙ בְּיַ֣ד הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר כֵּן־אַתֶּ֥ם בְּיָדִ֖י בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hkhyvtsr hzh l''vkhl l'shvt lkhm byt yshr'l n'myhvh hnh khchmr byd hyvtsr khn'tm bydy byt yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: ’O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are ye in My hand, O house of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֶ֣גַע אֲדַבֵּ֔ר עַל־גּ֖וֹי וְעַל־מַמְלָכָ֑ה לִנְת֥וֹשׁ וְלִנְת֖וֹץ וּֽלְהַאֲבִֽיד׃
verses.translit: rg' 'dbr 'lgvy v'lmmlkhh lntvsh vlntvts vlh'byd
verses.translation: At one instant I may speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁב֙ הַגּ֣וֹי הַה֔וּא מֵרָ֣עָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עָלָ֑יו וְנִֽחַמְתִּי֙ עַל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖בְתִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshb hgvy hhv' mr'tv 'shr dbrty 'lyv vnchmty 'lhr'h 'shr chshbty l'shvt lv {s}
verses.translation: but if that nation turn from their evil, because of which I have spoken against it, I repent of the evil that I thought to do unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֶ֣גַע אֲדַבֵּ֔ר עַל־גּ֖וֹי וְעַל־מַמְלָכָ֑ה לִבְנ֖וֹת וְלִנְטֽוֹעַ׃
verses.translit: vrg' 'dbr 'lgvy v'lmmlkhh lbnvt vlntv'
verses.translation: And at one instant I may speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה (הרעה) [הָרַע֙] בְּעֵינַ֔י לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמֹ֣עַ בְּקוֹלִ֑י וְנִֽחַמְתִּי֙ עַל־הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֖רְתִּי לְהֵיטִ֥יב אוֹתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shh (hr'h) [hr'] b'yny lblty shm' bqvly vnchmty 'lhtvbh 'shr 'mrty lhytyb 'vtv {s}
verses.translation: but if it do evil in My sight, that it hearken not to My voice, then I repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה אֱמׇר־נָ֣א אֶל־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה֩ וְעַל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י יוֹצֵ֤ר עֲלֵיכֶם֙ רָעָ֔ה וְחֹשֵׁ֥ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מַחֲשָׁבָ֑ה שׁ֣וּבוּ נָ֗א אִ֚ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֔ה וְהֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th 'mrn' 'l'yshyhvdh v'lyvshby yrvshl͏m l'mr khh 'mr yhvh hnh 'nkhy yvtsr 'lykhm r'h vchshb 'lykhm mchshbh shvbv n' 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vhytybv drkhykhm vm'llykhm
verses.translation: Now therefore do thou speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you; return ye now every one from his evil way, and amend your ways and your doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמְר֖וּ נוֹאָ֑שׁ כִּֽי־אַחֲרֵ֤י מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ נֵלֵ֔ךְ וְאִ֛ישׁ שְׁרִר֥וּת לִבּֽוֹ־הָרָ֖ע נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrv nv'sh khy'chry mchshbvtynv nlkh v'ysh shrrvt lbvhr' n'shh {p}
verses.translation: But they say: There is no hope; but we will walk after our own devices, and we will do every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה שַֽׁאֲלוּ־נָא֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם מִ֥י שָׁמַ֖ע כָּאֵ֑לֶּה שַֽׁעֲרֻרִת֙ עָשְׂתָ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh sh'lvn' bgvym my shm' kh'lh sh'rrt 'shth m'd btvlt yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: Ask ye now among the nations, Who hath heard such things; The virgin of Israel hath done A very horrible thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיַעֲזֹ֥ב מִצּ֛וּר שָׂדַ֖י שֶׁ֣לֶג לְבָנ֑וֹן אִם־יִנָּֽתְשׁ֗וּ מַ֛יִם זָרִ֥ים קָרִ֖ים נוֹזְלִֽים׃
verses.translit: hy'zb mtsvr shdy shlg lbnvn 'myntshv mym zrym qrym nvzlym
verses.translation: Doth the snow of Lebanon fail From the rock of the field? Or are the strange cold flowing waters Plucked up?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שְׁכֵחֻ֥נִי עַמִּ֖י לַשָּׁ֣וְא יְקַטֵּ֑רוּ וַיַּכְשִׁל֤וּם בְּדַרְכֵיהֶם֙ שְׁבִילֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם לָלֶ֣כֶת נְתִיב֔וֹת דֶּ֖רֶךְ לֹ֥א סְלוּלָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyshkhchny 'my lshv' yqtrv vykhshlvm bdrkhyhm shbyly 'vlm llkht ntybvt drkh l' slvlh
verses.translation: For My people hath forgotten Me, They offer unto vanity; And they have been made to stumble in their ways, In the ancient paths, To walk in bypaths, In a way not cast up;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָשׂ֥וּם אַרְצָ֛ם לְשַׁמָּ֖ה (שרוקת) [שְׁרִיק֣וֹת] עוֹלָ֑ם כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשֹּׁ֖ם וְיָנִ֥יד בְּרֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: lshvm 'rtsm lshmh (shrvqt) [shryqvt] 'vlm khl 'vbr 'lyh yshm vynyd br'shv
verses.translation: To make their land an astonishment, And a perpetual hissing; Every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, And shake his head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרוּחַ־קָדִ֥ים אֲפִיצֵ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב עֹ֧רֶף וְלֹֽא־פָנִ֛ים אֶרְאֵ֖ם בְּי֥וֹם אֵידָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khrvchqdym 'pytsm lpny 'vyb 'rf vl'pnym 'r'm byvm 'ydm {s}
verses.translation: I will scatter them as with an east wind Before the enemy; I will look upon their back, and not their face, In the day of their calamity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ לְכ֨וּ וְנַחְשְׁבָ֥ה עַֽל־יִרְמְיָ֘הוּ֮ מַחֲשָׁבוֹת֒ כִּי֩ לֹא־תֹאבַ֨ד תּוֹרָ֜ה מִכֹּהֵ֗ן וְעֵצָה֙ מֵחָכָ֔ם וְדָבָ֖ר מִנָּבִ֑יא לְכוּ֙ וְנַכֵּ֣הוּ בַלָּשׁ֔וֹן וְאַל־נַקְשִׁ֖יבָה אֶל־כׇּל־דְּבָרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv lkhv vnchshbh 'lyrmyhv mchshbvt khy l't'bd tvrh mkhhn v'tsh mchkhm vdbr mnby' lkhv vnkhhv blshvn v'lnqshybh 'lkhldbryv
verses.translation: Then said they: ‘Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; For instruction shall not perish from the priest, Nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, And let us not give heed to any of his words.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וּשְׁמַ֖ע לְק֥וֹל יְרִיבָֽי׃
verses.translit: hqshybh yhvh 'ly vshm' lqvl yryby
verses.translation: Give heed to me, O LORD, And hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיְשֻׁלַּ֤ם תַּֽחַת־טוֹבָה֙ רָעָ֔ה כִּי־כָר֥וּ שׁוּחָ֖ה לְנַפְשִׁ֑י זְכֹ֣ר  עׇמְדִ֣י לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְדַבֵּ֤ר עֲלֵיהֶם֙ טוֹבָ֔ה לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־חֲמָתְךָ֖ מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hyshlm tchttvbh r'h khykhrv shvchh lnpshy zkhr  'mdy lpnykh ldbr 'lyhm tvbh lhshyb 'tchmtkh mhm
verses.translation: Shall evil be recompensed for good? For they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before Thee To speak good for them, To turn away Thy wrath from them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ תֵּ֨ן אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֜ם לָרָעָ֗ב וְהַגִּרֵם֮ עַל־יְדֵי־חֶ֒רֶב֒ וְתִהְיֶ֨נָה נְשֵׁיהֶ֤ם שַׁכֻּלוֹת֙ וְאַלְמָנ֔וֹת וְאַ֨נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם יִהְי֖וּ הֲרֻ֣גֵי מָ֑וֶת בַּח֣וּרֵיהֶ֔ם מֻכֵּי־חֶ֖רֶב בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn tn 'tbnyhm lr'b vhgrm 'lydychrb vthynh nshyhm shkhlvt v'lmnvt v'nshyhm yhyv hrgy mvt bchvryhm mkhychrb bmlchmh
verses.translation: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, And hurl them to the power of the sword; And let their wives be bereaved of their children, and widows; And let their men be slain of death, And their young men smitten of the sword in battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּשָּׁמַ֤ע זְעָקָה֙ מִבָּ֣תֵּיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־תָבִ֧יא עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם גְּד֖וּד פִּתְאֹ֑ם כִּֽי־כָר֤וּ (שיחה) [שׁוּחָה֙] לְלׇכְדֵ֔נִי וּפַחִ֖ים טָמְנ֥וּ לְרַגְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: tshm' z'qh mbtyhm khytby' 'lyhm gdvd pt'm khykhrv (shychh) [shvchh] llkhdny vpchym tmnv lrgly
verses.translation: Let a cry be heard from their houses, When thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them; For they have digged a pit to take me, And hid snares for my feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה יָדַ֜עְתָּ אֶֽת־כׇּל־עֲצָתָ֤ם עָלַי֙ לַמָּ֔וֶת אַל־תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל־עֲוֺנָ֔ם וְחַטָּאתָ֖ם מִלְּפָנֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּ֑מְחִי (והיו) [וְיִהְי֤וּ] מֻכְשָׁלִים֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ בְּעֵ֥ת אַפְּךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֥ה בָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th yhvh yd't 'tkhl'tstm 'ly lmvt 'ltkhpr 'l'vnm vcht'tm mlpnykh 'ltmchy (vhyv) [vyhyv] mkhshlym lpnykh b't 'pkh 'shh bhm {s}
verses.translation: Yet, LORD, Thou knowest All their counsel against me to slay me; Forgive not their iniquity, Neither blot out their sin from Thy sight; But let them be made to stumble before Thee; Deal Thou with them in the time of Thine anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הָלֹ֛ךְ וְקָנִ֥יתָ בַקְבֻּ֖ק יוֹצֵ֣ר חָ֑רֶשׂ וּמִזִּקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם וּמִזִּקְנֵ֖י הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hlkh vqnyt bqbq yvtsr chrsh vmzqny h'm vmzqny hkhhnym
verses.translation: Thus said the LORD: Go, and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and take of the elders of the people, and of the elders of the priests;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֙אתָ֙ אֶל־גֵּ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֕ר פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר (החרסות) [הַחַרְסִ֑ית] וְקָרָ֣אתָ שָּׁ֔ם אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyts't 'lgy' bnhnm 'shr ptch sh'r (hchrsvt) [hchrsyt] vqr't shm 'thdbrym 'shr'dbr 'lykh
verses.translation: and go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא רָעָה֙ עַל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כׇּל־שֹׁמְעָ֖הּ תִּצַּ֥לְנָה אׇזְנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'mrt shm'v dbryhvh mlkhy yhvdh vyshby yrvshl͏m khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mby' r'h 'lhmqvm hzh 'shr khlshm'h ttslnh 'znyv
verses.translation: and say: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֣עַן  אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָבֻ֗נִי וַֽיְנַכְּר֞וּ אֶת־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וַיְקַטְּרוּ־בוֹ֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יְדָע֛וּם הֵ֥מָּה וַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם וּמַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּמָ֥לְא֛וּ אֶת־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה דַּ֥ם נְקִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: y'n  'shr 'zbny vynkhrv 'thmqvm hzh vyqtrvbv l'lhym 'chrym 'shr l'yd'vm hmh v'bvtyhm vmlkhy yhvdh vml'v 'thmqvm hzh dm nqym
verses.translation: because they have forsaken Me, and have estranged this place, and have offered in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah; and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָנ֞וּ אֶת־בָּמ֣וֹת הַבַּ֗עַל לִשְׂרֹ֧ף אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֛ם בָּאֵ֖שׁ עֹל֣וֹת לַבָּ֑עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־צִוִּ֙יתִי֙ וְלֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתִּי וְלֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל־לִבִּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbnv 'tbmvt hb'l lshrf 'tbnyhm b'sh 'lvt lb'l 'shr l'tsvyty vl' dbrty vl' 'lth 'llby {p}
verses.translation: and have built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons in the fire for burnt-offerings unto Baal; which I commanded not, nor spoke it, neither came it into My mind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹא־יִקָּרֵא֩ לַמָּק֨וֹם הַזֶּ֥ה ע֛וֹד הַתֹּ֖פֶת וְגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֑ם כִּ֖י אִם־גֵּ֥יא הַהֲרֵגָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnhymym b'ym n'myhvh vl'yqr' lmqvm hzh 'vd htpt vgy' bnhnm khy 'mgy' hhrgh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠בַקֹּתִ֠י אֶת־עֲצַ֨ת יְהוּדָ֤ה וִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִפַּלְתִּ֤ים בַּחֶ֙רֶב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְיַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־נִבְלָתָם֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vbqty 't'tst yhvdh vyrvshl͏m bmqvm hzh vhpltym bchrb lpny 'ybyhm vbyd mbqshy npshm vntty 'tnbltm lm'khl l'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts
verses.translation: and I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of them that seek their life; and their carcasses will I give to be food for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּי֙ אֶת־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לְשַׁמָּ֖ה וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְיִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל־כׇּל־מַכֹּתֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: vshmty 'th'yr hz't lshmh vlshrqh khl 'br 'lyh yshm vyshrq 'lkhlmkhth
verses.translation: and I will make this city an astonishment, and a hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֞ים אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֵת֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִ֥ישׁ בְּשַׂר־רֵעֵ֖הוּ יֹאכֵ֑לוּ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֧יקוּ לָהֶ֛ם אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vh'khltym 'tbshr bnyhm v't bshr bntyhm v'ysh bshrr'hv y'khlv bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shr ytsyqv lhm 'ybyhm vmbqshy npshm
verses.translation: and I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend, in the siege and in the straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their life, shall straiten them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁבַרְתָּ֖ הַבַּקְבֻּ֑ק לְעֵינֵי֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַהֹלְכִ֖ים אוֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vshbrt hbqbq l'yny h'nshym hhlkhym 'vtkh
verses.translation: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת־הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ וְאֶת־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁבֹּר֙ אֶת־כְּלִ֣י הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יוּכַ֥ל לְהֵרָפֵ֖ה ע֑וֹד וּבְתֹ֣פֶת יִקְבְּר֔וּ מֵאֵ֥ין מָק֖וֹם לִקְבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh'mr  yhvh tsb'vt khkhh 'shbr 'th'm hzh v'th'yr hz't kh'shr yshbr 'tkhly hyvtsr 'shr l'yvkhl lhrph 'vd vbtpt yqbrv m'yn mqvm lqbvr
verses.translation: and shalt say unto them: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again; and they shall bury in Topheth, for want of room to bury.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּֽן־אֶעֱשֶׂ֞ה לַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה וּלְיֽוֹשְׁבָ֑יו וְלָתֵ֛ת אֶת־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את כְּתֹֽפֶת׃
verses.translit: khn''shh lmqvm hzh n'myhvh vlyvshbyv vltt 'th'yr hz't khtpt
verses.translation: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, even making this city as Topheth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם וּבָתֵּי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּמְק֥וֹם הַתֹּ֖פֶת הַטְּמֵאִ֑ים לְכֹ֣ל הַבָּתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטְּר֜וּ עַל־גַּגֹּֽתֵיהֶם֙ לְכֹל֙ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְהַסֵּ֥ךְ נְסָכִ֖ים לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyv bty yrvshl͏m vbty mlkhy yhvdh khmqvm htpt htm'ym lkhl hbtym 'shr qtrv 'lggtyhm lkhl tsb' hshmym vhskh nskhym l'lhym 'chrym {p}
verses.translation: and the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, shall be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses upon whose roofs they have offered unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink-offerings unto other gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵֽהַתֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר שְׁלָח֧וֹ יְהֹוָ֛ה שָׁ֖ם לְהִנָּבֵ֑א וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל־כׇּל־הָעָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb' yrmyhv mhtpt 'shr shlchv yhvh shm lhnb' vy'md bchtsr bytyhvh vy'mr 'lkhlh'm {s}
verses.translation: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’S house, and said to all the people:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֜י אֶל־הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־כׇּל־עָרֶ֔יהָ אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֤י הִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עׇרְפָּ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֶת־דְּבָרָֽי׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mby 'lh'yr hz't v'lkhl'ryh 't khlhr'h 'shr dbrty 'lyh khy hqshv 't'rpm lblty shmv' 'tdbry
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it; because they have made their neck stiff, that they might not hear My words.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע פַּשְׁחוּר֙ בֶּן־אִמֵּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהוּא־פָקִ֥יד נָגִ֖יד בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶֽת־יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ נִבָּ֖א אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyshm' pshchvr bn'mr hkhhn vhv'pqyd ngyd bbyt yhvh 'tyrmyhv nb' 'thdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: Now Pashhur the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכֶּ֣ה פַשְׁח֔וּר אֵ֖ת יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹת֜וֹ עַל־הַמַּהְפֶּ֗כֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּשַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vykhh pshchvr 't yrmyhv hnby' vytn 'tv 'lhmhpkht 'shr bsh'r bnymn h'lyvn 'shr bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Then Pashhur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמׇּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֹּצֵ֥א פַשְׁח֛וּר אֶֽת־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִן־הַמַּהְפָּ֑כֶת וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ לֹ֤א פַשְׁחוּר֙ קָרָ֤א יְהֹוָה֙ שְׁמֶ֔ךָ כִּ֖י אִם־מָג֥וֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyts' pshchvr 'tyrmyhv mnhmhpkht vy'mr 'lyv yrmyhv l' pshchvr qr' yhvh shmkh khy 'mmgvr msbyb {s}
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashhur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him: ‘The LORD hath not called thy name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֡ה הִנְנִי֩ נֹתֶנְךָ֨ לְמָג֜וֹר לְךָ֣ וּלְכׇל־אֹהֲבֶ֗יךָ וְנָ֥פְל֛וּ בְּחֶ֥רֶב אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹא֑וֹת וְאֶת־כׇּל־יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְהִגְלָ֥ם בָּבֶ֖לָה וְהִכָּ֥ם בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntnkh lmgvr lkh vlkhl'hbykh vnplv bchrb 'ybyhm v'ynykh r'vt v'tkhlyhvdh 'tn byd mlkhbbl vhglm bblh vhkhm bchrb
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive to Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֗י אֶת־כׇּל־חֹ֙סֶן֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶת־כׇּל־יְגִיעָ֖הּ וְאֶת־כׇּל־יְקָרָ֑הּ וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־אוֹצְר֜וֹת מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ בְּיַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְזָזוּם֙ וּלְקָח֔וּם וֶהֱבִיא֖וּם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: vntty 'tkhlchsn h'yr hz't v'tkhlygy'h v'tkhlyqrh v't khl'vtsrvt mlkhy yhvdh 'tn byd 'ybyhm vbzzvm vlqchvm vhby'vm bblh
verses.translation: Moreover I will give all the store of this city, and all the gains thereof, and all the wealth thereof, yea, all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, who shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה פַשְׁח֗וּר וְכֹל֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֔ךָ תֵּלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּׁ֑בִי וּבָבֶ֣ל תָּב֗וֹא וְשָׁ֤ם תָּמוּת֙ וְשָׁ֣ם תִּקָּבֵ֔ר אַתָּה֙ וְכׇל־אֹֽהֲבֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־נִבֵּ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם בַּשָּֽׁקֶר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th pshchvr vkhl yshby bytkh tlkhv bshby vbbl tbv' vshm tmvt vshm tqbr 'th vkhl'hbykh 'shrnb't lhm bshqr {p}
verses.translation: And thou, Pashhur, and all that dwell in thy house shall go into captivity; and thou
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּתִּיתַ֤נִי יְהֹוָה֙ וָאֶפָּ֔ת חֲזַקְתַּ֖נִי וַתּוּכָ֑ל הָיִ֤יתִי לִשְׂחוֹק֙ כׇּל־הַיּ֔וֹם כֻּלֹּ֖ה לֹעֵ֥ג לִֽי׃
verses.translit: ptytny yhvh v'pt chzqtny vtvkhl hyyty lshchvq khlhyvm khlh l'g ly
verses.translation: O LORD, Thou hast enticed me, and I was enticed, Thou hast overcome me, and hast prevailed; I am become a laughing-stock all the day, Every one mocketh me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מִדֵּ֤י אֲדַבֵּר֙ אֶזְעָ֔ק חָמָ֥ס וָשֹׁ֖ד אֶקְרָ֑א כִּֽי־הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֥ה לִ֛י לְחֶרְפָּ֥ה וּלְקֶ֖לֶס כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: khymdy 'dbr 'z'q chms vshd 'qr' khyhyh dbryhvh ly lchrph vlqls khlhyvm
verses.translation: For as often as I speak, I cry out, I cry: ‘Violence and spoil’; Because the word of the LORD is made A reproach unto me, and a derision, all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י לֹֽא־אֶזְכְּרֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא־אֲדַבֵּ֥ר עוֹד֙ בִּשְׁמ֔וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה בְלִבִּי֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ בֹּעֶ֔רֶת עָצֻ֖ר בְּעַצְמֹתָ֑י וְנִלְאֵ֥יתִי כַּֽלְכֵ֖ל וְלֹ֥א אוּכָֽל׃
verses.translit: v'mrty l''zkhrnv vl''dbr 'vd bshmv vhyh blby kh'sh b'rt 'tsr b'tsmty vnl'yty khlkhl vl' 'vkhl
verses.translation: And if I say: ‘I will not make mention of Him, Nor speak any more in His name’, Then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire Shut up in my bones, And I weary myself to hold it in, But cannot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֜עְתִּי דִּבַּ֣ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֣וֹר מִסָּבִיב֒ הַגִּ֙ידוּ֙ וְנַגִּידֶ֔נּוּ כֹּ֚ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ שְׁלֹמִ֔י שֹׁמְרֵ֖י צַלְעִ֑י אוּלַ֤י יְפֻתֶּה֙ וְנ֣וּכְלָה ל֔וֹ וְנִקְחָ֥ה נִקְמָתֵ֖נוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khy shm'ty dbt rbym mgvr msbyb hgydv vngydnv khl 'nvsh shlmy shmry tsl'y 'vly ypth vnvkhlh lv vnqchh nqmtnv mmnv
verses.translation: For I have heard the whispering of many, Terror on every side: ‘Denounce, and we will denounce him’; Even of all my familiar friends, Them that watch for my halting: ‘Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, And we shall take our revenge on him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֤ה אוֹתִי֙ כְּגִבּ֣וֹר עָרִ֔יץ עַל־כֵּ֛ן רֹדְפַ֥י יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יֻכָ֑לוּ בֹּ֤שֽׁוּ מְאֹד֙ כִּי־לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ כְּלִמַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vyhvh 'vty khgbvr 'ryts 'lkhn rdpy ykhshlv vl' ykhlv bshv m'd khyl' hshkhylv khlmt 'vlm l' tshkhch
verses.translation: But the LORD is with me as a mighty warrior; Therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail; They shall be greatly ashamed, because they have not prospered, Even with an everlasting confusion which shall never be forgotten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן צַדִּ֔יק רֹאֶ֥ה כְלָי֖וֹת וָלֵ֑ב אֶרְאֶ֤ה נִקְמָֽתְךָ֙ מֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־רִיבִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhvh tsb'vt bchn tsdyq r'h khlyvt vlb 'r'h nqmtkh mhm khy 'lykh glyty 'tryby {s}
verses.translation: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, That seest the reins and the heart, Let me see Thy vengeance on them; For unto Thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֚ירוּ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה הַֽלְל֖וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִצִּ֛יל אֶת־נֶ֥פֶשׁ אֶבְי֖וֹן מִיַּ֥ד מְרֵעִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh hllv 'tyhvh khy htsyl 'tnpsh 'byvn myd mr'ym {s}
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD, Praise ye the LORD; For He hath delivered the soul of the needy From the hand of evil-doers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּ֖דְתִּי בּ֑וֹ י֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יְלָדַ֥תְנִי אִמִּ֖י אַל־יְהִ֥י בָרֽוּךְ׃
verses.translit: 'rvr hyvm 'shr yldty bv yvm 'shryldtny 'my 'lyhy brvkh
verses.translation: Cursed be the day Wherein I was born; The day wherein my mother bore me, Let it not be blessed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּשַּׂ֤ר אֶת־אָבִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יֻֽלַּד־לְךָ֖ בֵּ֣ן זָכָ֑ר שַׂמֵּ֖חַ שִׂמְּחָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'rvr h'ysh 'shr bshr 't'by l'mr yldlkh bn zkhr shmch shmchhv
verses.translation: Cursed be the man who brought tidings To my father, saying: ‘A man-child is born unto thee’; Making him very glad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא כֶּעָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־הָפַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א נִחָ֑ם וְשָׁמַ֤ע זְעָקָה֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וּתְרוּעָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥ת צׇהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhyh h'ysh hhv' kh'rym 'shrhpkh yhvh vl' nchm vshm' z'qh bbqr vtrv'h b't tshrym
verses.translation: And let that man be as the cities Which the LORD overthrew, and repented not; And let him hear a cry in the morning, And an alarm at noontide;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־מוֹתְתַ֖נִי מֵרָ֑חֶם וַתְּהִי־לִ֤י אִמִּי֙ קִבְרִ֔י וְרַחְמָ֖הֿ הֲרַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shr l'mvttny mrchm vthyly 'my qbry vrchmh hrt 'vlm
verses.translation: Because He slew me not from the womb; And so my mother would have been my grave, And her womb always great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה זֶּה֙ מֵרֶ֣חֶם יָצָ֔אתִי לִרְא֥וֹת עָמָ֖ל וְיָג֑וֹן וַיִּכְל֥וּ בְּבֹ֖שֶׁת יָמָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lmh zh mrchm yts'ty lr'vt 'ml vygvn vykhlv bbsht ymy {p}
verses.translation: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb To see labour and sorrow, That my days should be consumed in shame?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה בִּשְׁלֹ֨חַ אֵלָ֜יו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֶת־פַּשְׁחוּר֙ בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּ֔ה וְאֶת־צְפַנְיָ֧ה בֶן־מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shrhyh 'lyrmyhv m't yhvh bshlch 'lyv hmlkh tsdqyhv 'tpshchvr bnmlkhyh v'ttspnyh bnm'shyh hkhhn l'mr
verses.translation: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashhur the son of Malchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּרׇשׁ־נָ֤א בַעֲדֵ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֛י נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל נִלְחָ֣ם עָלֵ֑ינוּ אוּלַי֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אוֹתָ֙נוּ֙ כְּכׇל־נִפְלְאֹתָ֔יו וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: drshn' b'dnv 'tyhvh khy nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl nlchm 'lynv 'vly y'shh yhvh 'vtnv khkhlnpl'tyv vy'lh m'lynv
verses.translation: ’Inquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; peradventure the LORD will deal with us according to all His wondrous works, that he may go up from us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְרֻ֖ן אֶל־צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'lyhm khh t'mrn 'ltsdqyhv {s}
verses.translation: Then said Jeremiah unto them: Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֣י מֵסֵב֮ אֶת־כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיֶדְכֶם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם נִלְחָמִ֣ים בָּ֗ם אֶת־מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ וְאֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַצָּרִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם מִח֖וּץ לַחוֹמָ֑ה וְאָסַפְתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל־תּ֖וֹךְ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hnny msb 'tkhly hmlchmh 'shr bydkhm 'shr 'tm nlchmym bm 'tmlkh bbl v'thkhshdym htsrym 'lykhm mchvts lchvmh v'spty 'vtm 'ltvkh h'yr hz't
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel: Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, that besiege you without the walls, and I will gather them into the midst of this city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִלְחַמְתִּ֤י אֲנִי֙ אִתְּכֶ֔ם בְּיָ֥ד נְטוּיָ֖ה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ חֲזָקָ֑ה וּבְאַ֥ף וּבְחֵמָ֖ה וּבְקֶ֥צֶף גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vnlchmty 'ny 'tkhm byd ntvyh vbzrv' chzqh vb'f vbchmh vbqtsf gdvl
verses.translation: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֗י אֶת־יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶת־הָאָדָ֖ם וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל יָמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: vhkhyty 'tyvshby h'yr hz't v'th'dm v'thbhmh bdbr gdvl ymtv
verses.translation: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast; they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֣ן נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֡ה אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֣ה וְאֶת־עֲבָדָ֣יו ׀ וְאֶת־הָעָ֡ם וְאֶת־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֩ בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את מִן־הַדֶּ֣בֶר  מִן־הַחֶ֣רֶב וּמִן־הָרָעָ֗ב בְּיַד֙ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וּבְיַד֙ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְיַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְהִכָּ֣ם לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב לֹא־יָח֣וּס עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יַחְמֹ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יְרַחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'chrykhn n'myhvh 'tn 'ttsdqyhv mlkhyhvdh v't'bdyv  v'th'm v'thnsh'rym b'yr hz't mnhdbr  mnhchrb vmnhr'b byd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl vbyd 'ybyhm vbyd mbqshy npshm vhkhm lpychrb l'ychvs 'lyhm vl' ychml vl' yrchm
verses.translation: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life; and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have compassion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י נֹתֵן֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֶת־דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: v'lh'm hzh t'mr khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn lpnykhm 'tdrkh hchyym v'tdrkh hmvt
verses.translation: And unto this people thou shalt say: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וְהַיּוֹצֵא֩ וְנָפַ֨ל עַל־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַצָּרִ֤ים עֲלֵיכֶם֙ (יחיה) [וְחָיָ֔ה] וְהָיְתָה־לּ֥וֹ נַפְשׁ֖וֹ לְשָׁלָֽל׃
verses.translit: hyshb b'yr hz't ymvt bchrb vbr'b vbdbr vhyvts' vnpl 'lhkhshdym htsrym 'lykhm (ychyh) [vchyh] vhythlv npshv lshll
verses.translation: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he that goeth out, and falleth away to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֣מְתִּי פָ֠נַי בָּעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֧את לְרָעָ֛ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּיַד־מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ תִּנָּתֵ֔ן וּשְׂרָפָ֖הּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy shmty pny b'yr hz't lr'h vl' ltvbh n'myhvh bydmlkh bbl tntn vshrph b'sh {s}
verses.translation: For I have set My face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD; it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְבֵית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlbyt mlkh yhvdh shm'v dbryhvh
verses.translation: And unto the house of the king of Judah: Hear ye the word of the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה דִּ֤ינוּ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְהַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִיַּ֣ד עוֹשֵׁ֑ק פֶּן־תֵּצֵ֨א כָאֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗י וּבָֽעֲרָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ (מעלליהם) [מַעַלְלֵיכֶֽם]׃
verses.translit: byt dvd khh 'mr yhvh dynv lbqr mshpt vhtsylv gzvl myd 'vshq pntts' kh'sh chmty vb'rh v'yn mkhbh mpny r' (m'llyhm) [m'llykhm]
verses.translation: O house of David, thus saith the LORD: Execute justice in the morning, And deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, Lest My fury go forth like fire, And burn that none can quench it, Because of the evil of your doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלַ֜יִךְ יֹשֶׁ֧בֶת הָעֵ֛מֶק צ֥וּר הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ מִֽי־יֵחַ֣ת עָלֵ֔ינוּ וּמִ֥י יָב֖וֹא בִּמְעוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh yshbt h'mq tsvr hmyshr n'myhvh h'mrym myycht 'lynv vmy ybv' bm'vnvtynv
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, And rock of the plain, saith the LORD; Ye that say: ‘Who shall come down against us? Or who shall enter into our habitations?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם כִּפְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּיַעְרָ֔הּ וְאָכְלָ֖ה כׇּל־סְבִיבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vpqdty 'lykhm khpry m'llykhm n'myhvh vhtsty 'sh by'rh v'khlh khlsbybyh
verses.translation: And I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, Saith the LORD; And I will kindle a fire in her forest, And it shall devour all that is round about her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה רֵ֖ד בֵּֽית־מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh rd bytmlkh yhvdh vdbrt shm 'thdbr hzh
verses.translation: Thus said the LORD: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד אַתָּ֤ה וַעֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֔ הַבָּאִ֖ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt shm' dbryhvh mlkh yhvdh hyshb 'lkhs' dvd 'th v'bdykh v'mkh hb'ym bsh'rym h'lh
verses.translation: and say: Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה עֲשׂ֤וּ מִשְׁפָּט֙ וּצְדָקָ֔ה וְהַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִיַּ֣ד עָשׁ֑וֹק וְגֵר֩ יָת֨וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֤ה אַל־תֹּנוּ֙ אַל־תַּחְמֹ֔סוּ וְדָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh 'shv mshpt vtsdqh vhtsylv gzvl myd 'shvq vgr ytvm v'lmnh 'ltnv 'ltchmsv vdm nqy 'ltshpkhv bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Execute ye justice and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor; and do no wrong, do no violence, to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־עָשׂוֹ֙ תַּעֲשׂ֔וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה וּבָ֣אוּ בְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֡ה מְלָכִים֩ יֹשְׁבִ֨ים לְדָוִ֜ד עַל־כִּסְא֗וֹ רֹֽכְבִים֙ בָּרֶ֣כֶב וּבַסּוּסִ֔ים ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָ֖ו וְעַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy 'm'shv t'shv 'thdbr hzh vb'v bsh'ry hbyt hzh mlkhym yshbym ldvd 'lkhs'v rkhbym brkhb vbsvsym hv' v'bdv v'mv
verses.translation: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בִּ֤י נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּֽי־לְחׇרְבָּ֥ה יִֽהְיֶ֖ה הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'm l' tshm'v 'thdbrym h'lh by nshb'ty n'myhvh khylchrbh yhyh hbyt hzh {p}
verses.translation: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by Myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה עַל־בֵּית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה גִּלְעָ֥ד אַתָּ֛ה לִ֖י רֹ֣אשׁ הַלְּבָנ֑וֹן אִם־לֹ֤א אֲשִֽׁיתְךָ֙ מִדְבָּ֔ר עָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א (נושבה) [נוֹשָֽׁבוּ]׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh 'lbyt mlkh yhvdh gl'd 'th ly r'sh hlbnvn 'ml' 'shytkh mdbr 'rym l' (nvshbh) [nvshbv]
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD concerning the house of the king of Judah: Thou art Gilead unto Me, The head of Lebanon; Yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, Cities which are not inhabited.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֥י עָלֶ֛יךָ מַשְׁחִתִ֖ים אִ֣ישׁ וְכֵלָ֑יו וְכָֽרְתוּ֙ מִבְחַ֣ר אֲרָזֶ֔יךָ וְהִפִּ֖ילוּ עַל־הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vqdshty 'lykh mshchtym 'ysh vkhlyv vkhrtv mbchr 'rzykh vhpylv 'lh'sh
verses.translation: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, Every one with his weapons; And they shall cut down thy choice cedars, And cast them into the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָֽבְרוּ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים עַ֖ל הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֔הוּ עַל־מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָעִ֥יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: v'brv gvym rbym 'l h'yr hz't v'mrv 'ysh 'lr'hv 'lmh 'shh yhvh khkhh l'yr hgdvlh hz't
verses.translation: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour: ‘Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֣מְר֔וּ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָזְב֔וּ אֶת־בְּרִ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים וַיַּעַבְדֽוּם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l 'shr 'zbv 'tbryt yhvh 'lhyhm vyshtchvv l'lhym 'chrym vy'bdvm {s}
verses.translation: Then they shall answer: ‘Because they forsook the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּבְכּ֣וּ לְמֵ֔ת וְאַל־תָּנֻ֖דוּ ל֑וֹ בְּכ֤וּ בָכוֹ֙ לַהֹלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ ע֔וֹד וְרָאָ֖ה אֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'ltbkhv lmt v'ltndv lv bkhv bkhv lhlkh khy l' yshvb 'vd vr'h 't'rts mvldtv
verses.translation: Weep ye not for the dead, Neither bemoan him; But weep sore for him that goeth away, For he shall return no more, Nor see his native country.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה אֶל־שַׁלֻּ֨ם בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַמֹּלֵךְ֙ תַּ֚חַת יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָ֖א מִן־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לֹא־יָשׁ֥וּב שָׁ֖ם עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mryhvh 'lshlm bny'shyhv mlkh yhvdh hmlkh tcht y'shyhv 'byv 'shr yts' mnhmqvm hzh l'yshvb shm 'vd
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went forth out of this place: He shall not return thither any more;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י בִּמְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־הִגְל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ שָׁ֣ם יָמ֑וּת וְאֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לֹא־יִרְאֶ֥ה עֽוֹד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy bmqvm 'shrhglv 'tv shm ymvt v'th'rts hz't l'yr'h 'vd {s}
verses.translation: but in the place whither they have led him captive, there shall he die, and he shall see this land no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי בֹּנֶ֤ה בֵיתוֹ֙ בְּֽלֹא־צֶ֔דֶק וַעֲלִיּוֹתָ֖יו בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֑ט בְּרֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ יַעֲבֹ֣ד חִנָּ֔ם וּפֹעֲל֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִתֶּן־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvy bnh bytv bl'tsdq v'lyvtyv bl' mshpt br'hv y'bd chnm vp'lv l' ytnlv
verses.translation: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, And his chambers by injustice; That useth his neighbour’s service without wages, And giveth him not his hire;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֗ר אֶבְנֶה־לִּי֙ בֵּ֣ית מִדּ֔וֹת וַעֲלִיּ֖וֹת מְרֻוָּחִ֑ים וְקָ֤רַֽע לוֹ֙ חַלּוֹנָ֔י וְסָפ֣וּן בָּאָ֔רֶז וּמָשׁ֖וֹחַ בַּשָּׁשַֽׁר׃
verses.translit: h'mr 'bnhly byt mdvt v'lyvt mrvchym vqr' lv chlvny vspvn b'rz vmshvch bshshr
verses.translation: That saith: ‘I will build me a wide house And spacious chambers’, And cutteth him out windows, And it is ceiled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתִֽמְלֹ֔ךְ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה מְתַחֲרֶ֣ה בָאָ֑רֶז אָבִ֜יךָ הֲל֧וֹא אָכַ֣ל וְשָׁתָ֗ה וְעָשָׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּט֙ וּצְדָקָ֔ה אָ֖ז ט֥וֹב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: htmlkh khy 'th mtchrh b'rz 'bykh hlv' 'khl vshth v'shh mshpt vtsdqh 'z tvb lv
verses.translation: Shalt thou reign, because thou strivest to excel in cedar? Did not thy father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּ֛ן דִּין־עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֖וֹן אָ֣ז ט֑וֹב הֲלוֹא־הִ֛יא הַדַּ֥עַת אֹתִ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: dn dyn'ny v'byvn 'z tvb hlv'hy' hd't 'ty n'myhvh
verses.translation: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; Then it was well. Is not this to know Me? saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וְלִבְּךָ֔ כִּ֖י אִם־עַל־בִּצְעֶ֑ךָ וְעַ֤ל דַּֽם־הַנָּקִי֙ לִשְׁפּ֔וֹךְ וְעַל־הָעֹ֥שֶׁק וְעַל־הַמְּרוּצָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'yn 'ynykh vlbkh khy 'm'lbts'kh v'l dmhnqy lshpvkh v'lh'shq v'lhmrvtsh l'shvt {s}
verses.translation: But thine eyes and thy heart Are not but for thy covetousness, And for shedding innocent blood, And for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶל־יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹא־יִסְפְּד֣וּ ל֔וֹ ה֥וֹי אָחִ֖י וְה֣וֹי אָח֑וֹת לֹא־יִסְפְּד֣וּ ל֔וֹ ה֥וֹי אָד֖וֹן וְה֥וֹי הֹדֹֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'lyhvyqym bny'shyhv mlkh yhvdh l'yspdv lv hvy 'chy vhvy 'chvt l'yspdv lv hvy 'dvn vhvy hdh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: They shall not lament for him: ‘Ah my brother! ’ or: ‘Ah sister! ’ They shall not lament for him: ‘Ah lord! ’ or: ‘Ah his glory! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְבוּרַ֥ת חֲמ֖וֹר יִקָּבֵ֑ר סָח֣וֹב וְהַשְׁלֵ֔ךְ מֵהָ֖לְאָה לְשַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qbvrt chmvr yqbr schvb vhshlkh mhl'h lsh'ry yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, Drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲלִ֤י הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ וּֽצְעָ֔קִי וּבַבָּשָׁ֖ן תְּנִ֣י קוֹלֵ֑ךְ וְצַֽעֲקִי֙ מֵעֲבָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י נִשְׁבְּר֖וּ כׇּל־מְאַהֲבָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: 'ly hlbnvn vts'qy vbbshn tny qvlkh vts'qy m'brym khy nshbrv khlm'hbykh
