verses.translation: Go up to Lebanon, and cry, And lift up thy voice in Bashan; And cry from Abarim, For all thy lovers are destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּשַׁלְוֺתַ֔יִךְ אָמַ֖רְתְּ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע זֶ֤ה דַרְכֵּךְ֙ מִנְּעוּרַ֔יִךְ כִּ֥י לֹא־שָׁמַ֖עַתְּ בְּקוֹלִֽי׃
verses.translit: dbrty 'lykh bshlvtykh 'mrt l' 'shm' zh drkhkh mn'vrykh khy l'shm't bqvly
verses.translation: I spoke unto thee in thy prosperity, But thou saidst: ‘I will not hear.’ This hath been thy manner from thy youth, That thou hearkenedst not to My voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־רֹעַ֙יִךְ֙ תִּרְעֶה־ר֔וּחַ וּֽמְאַהֲבַ֖יִךְ בַּשְּׁבִ֣י יֵלֵ֑כוּ כִּ֣י אָ֤ז תֵּבֹ֙שִׁי֙ וְנִכְלַ֔מְתְּ מִכֹּ֖ל רָעָתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khlr'ykh tr'hrvch vm'hbykh bshby ylkhv khy 'z tbshy vnkhlmt mkhl r'tkh
verses.translation: The wind shall feed upon all thy shepherds, And thy lovers shall go into captivity; Surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded For all thy wickedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ישבתי) [יֹשַׁבְתְּ֙] בַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן (מקננתי) [מְקֻנַּ֖נְתְּ] בָּאֲרָזִ֑ים מַה־נֵּחַנְתְּ֙ בְּבֹא־לָ֣ךְ חֲבָלִ֔ים חִ֖יל כַּיֹּלֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: (yshbty) [yshbt] blbnvn (mqnnty) [mqnnt] b'rzym mhnchnt bb'lkh chblym chyl khyldh
verses.translation: O inhabitant of Lebanon, That art nestled in the cedars, How gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, The pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־אָ֘נִי֮ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה֒ כִּ֣י אִם־יִהְיֶ֞ה כׇּנְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־יְהֽוֹיָקִים֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה חוֹתָ֖ם עַל־יַ֣ד יְמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י מִשָּׁ֖ם אֶתְּקֶֽנְךָּ׃
verses.translit: chy'ny n'myhvh khy 'myhyh khnyhv bnyhvyqym mlkh yhvdh chvtm 'lyd ymyny khy mshm 'tqnkh
verses.translation: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon My right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֗יךָ בְּיַד֙ מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וּבְיַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה יָג֖וֹר מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וּבְיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וּבְיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vnttykh byd mbqshy npshkh vbyd 'shr'th ygvr mpnyhm vbyd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl vbyd hkhshdym
verses.translation: and I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them of whom thou art afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵטַלְתִּ֣י אֹתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת־אִמְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְלָדַ֔תְךָ עַ֚ל הָאָ֣רֶץ אַחֶ֔רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יֻלַּדְתֶּ֖ם שָׁ֑ם וְשָׁ֖ם תָּמֽוּתוּ׃
verses.translit: vhtlty 'tkh v't'mkh 'shr yldtkh 'l h'rts 'chrt 'shr l'yldtm shm vshm tmvtv
verses.translation: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bore thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֛ם מְנַשְּׂאִ֥ים אֶת־נַפְשָׁ֖ם לָשׁ֣וּב שָׁ֑ם שָׁ֖מָּה לֹ֥א יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'lh'rts 'shrhm mnsh'ym 'tnpshm lshvb shm shmh l' yshvbv {p}
verses.translation: But to the land whereunto they long to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעֶ֨צֶב נִבְזֶ֜ה נָפ֗וּץ הָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ כׇּנְיָ֔הוּ אִ֨ם־כְּלִ֔י אֵ֥ין חֵ֖פֶץ בּ֑וֹ מַדּ֤וּעַ הֽוּטְלוּ֙ ה֣וּא וְזַרְע֔וֹ וְהֻ֨שְׁלְכ֔וּ עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: h'tsb nbzh npvts h'ysh hzh khnyhv 'mkhly 'yn chpts bv mdv' hvtlv hv' vzr'v vhshlkhv 'lh'rts 'shr l'yd'v
verses.translation: Is this man Coniah a despised, broken image? Is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? Wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, And are cast into the land which they know not?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֥רֶץ אֶ֖רֶץ אָ֑רֶץ שִׁמְעִ֖י דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'rts 'rts 'rts shm'y dbryhvh
verses.translation: O land, land, land, Hear the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה כִּתְב֞וּ אֶת־הָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ עֲרִירִ֔י גֶּ֖בֶר לֹא־יִצְלַ֣ח בְּיָמָ֑יו כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יִצְלַ֜ח מִזַּרְע֗וֹ אִ֚ישׁ יֹשֵׁב֙ עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֔ד וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל ע֖וֹד בִּיהוּדָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh khtbv 'th'ysh hzh 'ryry gbr l'ytslch bymyv khy l' ytslch mzr'v 'ysh yshb 'lkhs' dvd vmshl 'vd byhvdh {p}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Write ye this man childless, A man that shall not prosper in his days; For no man of his seed shall prosper, Sitting upon the throne of David, And ruling any more in Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֗ים מְאַבְּדִ֧ים וּמְפִצִ֛ים אֶת־צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvy r'ym m'bdym vmptsym 'tts'n mr'yty n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: Woe unto the shepherds that destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture! saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֠כֵ֠ן כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַֽל־הָרֹעִים֮ הָרֹעִ֣ים אֶת־עַמִּי֒ אַתֶּ֞ם הֲפִצֹתֶ֤ם אֶת־צֹאנִי֙ וַתַּדִּח֔וּם וְלֹ֥א פְקַדְתֶּ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם הִנְנִ֨י פֹקֵ֧ד עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אֶת־רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'lhr'ym hr'ym 't'my 'tm hptstm 'tts'ny vtdchvm vl' pqdtm 'tm hnny pqd 'lykhm 'tr' m'llykhm n'myhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, against the shepherds that feed My people: Ye have scattered My flock, and driven them away, and have not taken care of them; behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י אֲקַבֵּץ֙ אֶת־שְׁאֵרִ֣ית צֹאנִ֔י מִכֹּל֙ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִדַּ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑ם וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י אֶתְהֶ֛ן עַל־נְוֵהֶ֖ן וּפָר֥וּ וְרָבֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ny 'qbts 'tsh'ryt ts'ny mkhl h'rtsvt 'shrhdchty 'tm shm vhshbty 'thn 'lnvhn vprv vrbv
verses.translation: And I will gather the remnant of My flock out of all the countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them back to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and multiply.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים וְרָע֑וּם וְלֹא־יִֽירְא֨וּ ע֧וֹד וְלֹא־יֵחַ֛תּוּ וְלֹ֥א יִפָּקֵ֖דוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhqmty 'lyhm r'ym vr'vm vl'yyr'v 'vd vl'ychtv vl' ypqdv n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: And I will set up shepherds over them, who shall feed them; and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall any be lacking, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י לְדָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צַדִּ֑יק וּמָ֤לַךְ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהִשְׂכִּ֔יל וְעָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'myhvh vhqmty ldvd tsmch tsdyq vmlkh mlkh vhshkhyl v'shh mshpt vtsdqh b'rts
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous shoot, and he shall reign as king and prosper, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיָמָיו֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁכֹּ֣ן לָבֶ֑טַח וְזֶה־שְּׁמ֥וֹ אֲֽשֶׁר־יִקְרְא֖וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ צִדְקֵֽנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bymyv tvsh' yhvdh vyshr'l yshkhn lbtch vzhshmv 'shryqr'v yhvh  tsdqnv {p}
verses.translation: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely; and this is his name whereby he shall be called, the LORD is our righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנֵּה־יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלֹא־יֹ֤אמְרוּ עוֹד֙ חַי־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnhymym b'ym n'myhvh vl'y'mrv 'vd chyyhvh 'shr h'lh 'tbny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say: ‘As the LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־חַי־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת־זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָה וּמִכֹּל֙ הָאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֖וּ עַל־אַדְמָתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy 'mchyyhvh 'shr h'lh v'shr hby' 'tzr' byt yshr'l m'rts tspvnh vmkhl h'rtsvt 'shr hdchtym shm vyshbv 'l'dmtm {p}
verses.translation: but: ‘As the LORD liveth, that brought up and that led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries whither I had driven them’; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַנְּבִאִ֞ים נִשְׁבַּ֧ר לִבִּ֣י בְקִרְבִּ֗י רָֽחֲפוּ֙ כׇּל־עַצְמוֹתַ֔י הָיִ֙יתִי֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ שִׁכּ֔וֹר וּכְגֶ֖בֶר עֲבָ֣רוֹ יָ֑יִן מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י דִּבְרֵ֥י קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: lnb'ym nshbr lby bqrby rchpv khl'tsmvty hyyty kh'ysh shkhvr vkhgbr 'brv yyn mpny yhvh vmpny dbry qdshv
verses.translation: Concerning the prophets. My heart within me is broken, All my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, And like a man whom wine hath overcome; Because of the LORD, And because of His holy words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְנָֽאֲפִים֙ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי־מִפְּנֵ֤י אָלָה֙ אָבְלָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ יָבְשׁ֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וַתְּהִ֤י מְרֽוּצָתָם֙ רָעָ֔ה וּגְבוּרָתָ֖ם לֹא־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: khy mn'pym ml'h h'rts khympny 'lh 'blh h'rts ybshv n'vt mdbr vthy mrvtstm r'h vgbvrtm l'khn
verses.translation: For the land is full of adulterers; For because of swearing the land mourneth, The pastures of the wilderness are dried up; And their course is evil, And their force is not right.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־גַם־נָבִ֥יא גַם־כֹּהֵ֖ן חָנֵ֑פוּ גַּם־בְּבֵיתִ֛י מָצָ֥אתִי רָעָתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khygmnby' gmkhhn chnpv gmbbyty mts'ty r'tm n'myhvh
verses.translation: For both prophet and priest are ungodly; Yea, in My house have I found their wickedness, Saith the LORD. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה דַרְכָּ֜ם לָהֶ֗ם כַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת֙ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה יִדַּ֖חוּ וְנָ֣פְלוּ בָ֑הּ כִּי־אָבִ֨יא עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם רָעָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn yhyh drkhm lhm khchlqlqvt b'plh ydchv vnplv bh khy'by' 'lyhm r'h shnt pqdtm n'myhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery places in the darkness, They shall be thrust, and fall therein; For I will bring evil upon them, Even the year of their visitation, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִנְבִיאֵ֥י שֹׁמְר֖וֹן רָאִ֣יתִי תִפְלָ֑ה הִנַּבְּא֣וּ בַבַּ֔עַל וַיַּתְע֥וּ אֶת־עַמִּ֖י אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbnby'y shmrvn r'yty tplh hnb'v bb'l vyt'v 't'my 'tyshr'l
verses.translation: And I have seen unseemliness in the prophets of Samaria: They prophesied by Baal, And caused My people Israel to err.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִנְבִאֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם רָאִ֣יתִי שַׁעֲרוּרָ֗ה נָא֞וֹף וְהָלֹ֤ךְ בַּשֶּׁ֙קֶר֙ וְחִזְּקוּ֙ יְדֵ֣י מְרֵעִ֔ים לְבִ֨לְתִּי־שָׁ֔בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מֵרָעָת֑וֹ הָיוּ־לִ֤י כֻלָּם֙ כִּסְדֹ֔ם וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כַּעֲמֹרָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbnb'y yrvshl͏m r'yty sh'rvrh n'vf vhlkh bshqr vchzqv ydy mr'ym lbltyshbv 'ysh mr'tv hyvly khlm khsdm vyshbyh kh'mrh {p}
verses.translation: But in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: They commit adultery, and walk in lies, And they strengthen the hands of evil-doers, That none doth return from his wickedness; They are all of them become unto Me as Sodom, And the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ עַל־הַנְּבִאִ֔ים הִנְנִ֨י מַאֲכִ֤יל אוֹתָם֙ לַעֲנָ֔ה וְהִשְׁקִתִ֖ים מֵי־רֹ֑אשׁ כִּ֗י מֵאֵת֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם יָצְאָ֥ה חֲנֻפָּ֖ה לְכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhnb'ym hnny m'khyl 'vtm l'nh vhshqtym myr'sh khy m't nby'y yrvshl͏m yts'h chnph lkhlh'rts {p}
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets: Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, And make them drink the water of gall; For from the prophets of Jerusalem Is ungodliness gone forth into all the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַֽל־תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ עַל־דִּבְרֵ֤י הַנְּבִאִים֙ הַנִּבְּאִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם מַהְבִּלִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה אֶתְכֶ֑ם חֲז֤וֹן לִבָּם֙ יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ לֹ֖א מִפִּ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'ltshm'v 'ldbry hnb'ym hnb'ym lkhm mhblym hmh 'tkhm chzvn lbm ydbrv l' mpy yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you, They lead you unto vanity; They speak a vision of their own heart, And not out of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֤ים אָמוֹר֙ לִֽמְנַאֲצַ֔י דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה שָׁל֖וֹם יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְ֠כֹ֠ל הֹלֵ֞ךְ בִּשְׁרִר֤וּת לִבּוֹ֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹא־תָב֥וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mrym 'mvr lmn'tsy dbr yhvh shlvm yhyh lkhm vkhl hlkh bshrrvt lbv 'mrv l'tbv' 'lykhm r'h
verses.translation: They say continually unto them that despise Me: ‘The LORD hath said: Ye shall have peace’; And unto every one that walketh in the stubbornness of his own heart they say: ‘No evil shall come upon you’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֤י עָמַד֙ בְּס֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה וְיֵ֖רֶא וְיִשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־דְּבָר֑וֹ מִי־הִקְשִׁ֥יב (דברי) [דְּבָר֖וֹ] וַיִּשְׁמָֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy my 'md bsvd yhvh vyr' vyshm' 'tdbrv myhqshyb (dbry) [dbrv] vyshm' {s}
verses.translation: For who hath stood in the council of the LORD, That he should perceive and hear His word? Who hath attended to His word, and heard it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה  סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה וְסַ֖עַר מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל׃
verses.translit: hnh  s'rt yhvh chmh yts'h vs'r mtchvll 'l r'sh rsh'ym ychvl
verses.translation: Behold, a storm of the LORD is gone forth in fury, Yea, a whirling storm; It shall whirl upon the head of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ אַף־יְהֹוָ֔ה עַד־עֲשֹׂת֥וֹ וְעַד־הֲקִימ֖וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑וֹ בְּאַֽחֲרִית֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָ֖הּ בִּינָֽה׃
verses.translit: l' yshvb 'fyhvh 'd'shtv v'dhqymv mzmvt lbv b'chryt hymym ttbvnnv bh bynh
verses.translation: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until He have executed, and till He have performed the purposes of His heart; in the end of days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־שָׁלַ֥חְתִּי אֶת־הַנְּבִאִ֖ים וְהֵ֣ם רָ֑צוּ לֹא־דִבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם נִבָּֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: l'shlchty 'thnb'ym vhm rtsv l'dbrty 'lyhm vhm nb'v
verses.translation: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran; I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־עָמְד֖וּ בְּסוֹדִ֑י וְיַשְׁמִ֤עוּ דְבָרַי֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י וִֽישִׁבוּם֙ מִדַּרְכָּ֣ם הָרָ֔ע וּמֵרֹ֖עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'm'mdv bsvdy vyshm'v dbry 't'my vyshbvm mdrkhm hr' vmr' m'llyhm {s}
verses.translation: But if they have stood in My council, Then let them cause My people to hear My words, And turn them from their evil way, And from the evil of their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֱלֹהֵ֧י מִקָּרֹ֛ב אָ֖נִי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֖י מֵרָחֹֽק׃
verses.translit: h'lhy mqrb 'ny n'myhvh vl' 'lhy mrchq
verses.translation: Am I a God near at hand, saith the LORD, And not a God afar off?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִסָּתֵ֨ר אִ֧ישׁ בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֛ים וַאֲנִ֥י לֹֽא־אֶרְאֶ֖נּוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה הֲל֨וֹא אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֧יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲנִ֥י מָלֵ֖א נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mystr 'ysh bmstrym v'ny l''r'nv n'myhvh hlv' 'thshmym v'th'rts 'ny ml' n'myhvh
verses.translation: Can any hide himself in secret places That I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־אָֽמְרוּ֙ הַנְּבִאִ֔ים הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים בִּשְׁמִ֛י שֶׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר חָלַ֖מְתִּי חָלָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.translit: shm'ty 't 'shr'mrv hnb'ym hnb'ym bshmy shqr l'mr chlmty chlmty
verses.translation: I have heard what the prophets have said, That prophesy lies in My name, saying: ‘I have dreamed, I have dreamed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַ֗י הֲיֵ֛שׁ בְּלֵ֥ב הַנְּבִאִ֖ים נִבְּאֵ֣י הַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּנְבִיאֵ֖י תַּרְמִ֥ת לִבָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'dmty hysh blb hnb'ym nb'y hshqr vnby'y trmt lbm
verses.translation: How long shall this be? Is it in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies, And the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֹשְׁבִ֗ים לְהַשְׁכִּ֤יחַ אֶת־עַמִּי֙ שְׁמִ֔י בַּחֲל֣וֹמֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְסַפְּר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁכְח֧וּ אֲבוֹתָ֛ם אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י בַּבָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: hchshbym lhshkhych 't'my shmy bchlvmtm 'shr ysprv 'ysh lr'hv kh'shr shkhchv 'bvtm 'tshmy bb'l
verses.translation: That think to cause My people to forget My name By their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, As their fathers forgot My name for Baal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֞יא אֲשֶׁר־אִתּ֤וֹ חֲלוֹם֙ יְסַפֵּ֣ר חֲל֔וֹם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר דְּבָרִי֙ אִתּ֔וֹ יְדַבֵּ֥ר דְּבָרִ֖י אֱמֶ֑ת מַה־לַתֶּ֥בֶן אֶת־הַבָּ֖ר נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnby' 'shr'tv chlvm yspr chlvm v'shr dbry 'tv ydbr dbry 'mt mhltbn 'thbr n'myhvh
verses.translation: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; And he that hath My word; let him speak My word faithfully. What hath the straw to do with the wheat? Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא כֹ֧ה דְבָרִ֛י כָּאֵ֖שׁ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וּכְפַטִּ֖ישׁ יְפֹ֥צֵֽץ סָֽלַע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hlv' khh dbry kh'sh n'myhvh vkhptysh yptsts sl' {s}
verses.translation: Is not My word like as fire? Saith the LORD; And like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִ֥י עַל־הַנְּבִאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה מְגַנְּבֵ֣י דְבָרַ֔י אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֥ת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnny 'lhnb'ym n'myhvh mgnby dbry 'ysh m't r'hv
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal My words every one from his neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֥י עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה הַלֹּקְחִ֣ים לְשׁוֹנָ֔ם וַֽיִּנְאֲמ֖וּ נְאֻֽם׃
verses.translit: hnny 'lhnby'm n'myhvh hlqchym lshvnm vyn'mv n'm
verses.translation: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use there tongues and say: ‘He saith.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֠נְנִ֠י עַֽל־נִבְּאֵ֞י חֲלֹמ֥וֹת שֶׁ֙קֶר֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַֽיְסַפְּרוּם֙ וַיַּתְע֣וּ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י בְּשִׁקְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְפַחֲזוּתָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֨י לֹֽא־שְׁלַחְתִּ֜ים וְלֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְהוֹעֵ֛יל לֹא־יוֹעִ֥ילוּ לָעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnny 'lnb'y chlmvt shqr n'myhvh vysprvm vyt'v 't'my bshqryhm vbpchzvtm v'nkhy l'shlchtym vl' tsvytym vhv'yl l'yv'ylv l'mhzh n'myhvh
verses.translation: Behold, I am against them that prophesy lying dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause My people to err by their lies, and by their wantonness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them; neither can they profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִשְׁאָלְךָ֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה אֽוֹ־הַנָּבִ֤יא אֽוֹ־כֹהֵן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַה־מַּשָּׂ֖א יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־מַה־מַּשָּׂ֔א וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhyysh'lkh h'm hzh 'vhnby' 'vkhhn l'mr mhmsh' yhvh v'mrt 'lyhm 'tmhmsh' vntshty 'tkhm n'myhvh
verses.translation: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying: ‘What is the burden of the LORD?’ then shalt thou say unto them: ‘What burden! I will cast you off, saith the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנָּבִ֤יא וְהַכֹּהֵן֙ וְהָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר מַשָּׂ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֛י עַל־הָאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא וְעַל־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhnby' vhkhhn vh'm 'shr y'mr msh' yhvh vpqdty 'lh'ysh hhv' v'lbytv
verses.translation: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say: ‘The burden of the LORD’, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְאִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו מֶה־עָנָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמַה־דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh t'mrv 'ysh 'lr'hv v'ysh 'l'chyv mh'nh yhvh vmhdbr yhvh
verses.translation: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother: ‘What hath the LORD answered?’ and: ‘What hath the LORD spoken?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַשָּׂ֥א יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֣א תִזְכְּרוּ־ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י הַמַּשָּׂ֗א יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ דְּבָר֔וֹ וַהֲפַכְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַיִּ֔ים יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vmsh' yhvh l' tzkhrv'vd khy hmsh' yhyh l'ysh dbrv vhpkhtm 'tdbry 'lhym chyym yhvh tsb'vt 'lhynv
verses.translation: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more; for every man’s own word shall be his burden; and would ye pervert the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה תֹאמַ֖ר אֶל־הַנָּבִ֑יא מֶה־עָנָ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמַה־דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh t'mr 'lhnby' mh'nkh yhvh vmhdbr yhvh
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet: ‘What hath the LORD answered thee?’ and: ‘What hath the LORD spoken?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מַשָּׂ֣א יְהֹוָה֮ תֹּאמֵ֒רוּ֒ לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה יַ֧עַן אֲמׇרְכֶ֛ם אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה מַשָּׂ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאמְר֖וּ מַשָּׂ֥א יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mmsh' yhvh t'mrv lkhn khh 'mr yhvh y'n 'mrkhm 'thdbr hzh msh' yhvh v'shlch 'lykhm l'mr l' t'mrv msh' yhvh
verses.translation: But if ye say: ‘The burden of the LORD’; therefore thus saith the LORD: Because ye say this word: ‘The burden of the LORD’, and I have sent unto you, saying: ‘Ye shall not say: The burden of the LORD’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן הִנְנִ֔י וְנָשִׁ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם נָשֹׁ֑א וְנָטַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם וְאֶת־הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם וְלַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnny vnshyty 'tkhm nsh' vntshty 'tkhm v'th'yr 'shr ntty lkhm vl'bvtykhm m'l pny
verses.translation: therefore, behold, I will utterly tear you out, and I will cast you off, and the city that I gave unto you and to your fathers, away from My presence;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם חֶרְפַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּכְלִמּ֣וּת עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vntty 'lykhm chrpt 'vlm vkhlmvt 'vlm 'shr l' tshkhch {p}
verses.translation: and I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְאַ֘נִי֮ יְהֹוָה֒ וְהִנֵּ֗ה שְׁנֵי֙ דּוּדָאֵ֣י תְאֵנִ֔ים מוּעָדִ֕ים לִפְנֵ֖י הֵיכַ֣ל יְהֹוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֣י הַגְל֣וֹת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֡ל אֶת־יְכׇנְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֩ וְאֶת־שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וְאֶת־הֶחָרָ֤שׁ וְאֶת־הַמַּסְגֵּר֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וַיְבִאֵ֖ם בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: hr'ny yhvh vhnh shny dvd'y t'nym mv'dym lpny hykhl yhvh 'chry hglvt nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl 'tykhnyhv bnyhvyqym mlkhyhvdh v'tshry yhvdh v'thchrsh v'thmsgr myrvshl͏m vyb'm bbl
verses.translation: The LORD showed me, and behold two baskets of figs set before the temple of the LORD; after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדּ֣וּד אֶחָ֗ד תְּאֵנִים֙ טֹב֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד כִּתְאֵנֵ֖י הַבַּכֻּר֑וֹת וְהַדּ֣וּד אֶחָ֗ד תְּאֵנִים֙ רָע֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹֽעַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hdvd 'chd t'nym tbvt m'd kht'ny hbkhrvt vhdvd 'chd t'nym r'vt m'd 'shr l't'khlnh mr' {p}
verses.translation: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י מָה־אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וָאֹמַ֖ר תְּאֵנִ֑ים הַתְּאֵנִ֤ים הַטֹּבוֹת֙ טֹב֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד וְהָֽרָעוֹת֙ רָע֣וֹת מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹֽעַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly mh'th r'h yrmyhv v'mr t'nym ht'nym htbvt tbvt m'd vhr'vt r'vt m'd 'shr l't'khlnh mr' {p}
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me: ‘What seest thou, Jeremiah?’ And I said: ‘Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, that cannot be eaten, they are so bad.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּתְּאֵנִ֥ים הַטֹּב֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה כֵּֽן־אַכִּ֞יר אֶת־גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁלַּ֜חְתִּי מִן־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לְטוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l kht'nym htbvt h'lh khn'khyr 'tglvt yhvdh 'shr shlchty mnhmqvm hzh 'rts khshdym ltvbh
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so will I regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֤י עֲלֵיהֶם֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֖ים עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את וּבְנִיתִים֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶהֱרֹ֔ס וּנְטַעְתִּ֖ים וְלֹ֥א אֶתּֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vshmty 'yny 'lyhm ltvbh vhshbtym 'lh'rts hz't vbnytym vl' 'hrs vnt'tym vl' 'tvsh
verses.translation: And I will set Mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּי֩ לָהֶ֨ם לֵ֜ב לָדַ֣עַת אֹתִ֗י כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהָיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים כִּֽי־יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אֵלַ֖י בְּכׇל־לִבָּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vntty lhm lb ld't 'ty khy 'ny yhvh vhyvly l'm v'nkhy 'hyh lhm l'lhym khyyshbv 'ly bkhllbm {s}
verses.translation: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God; for they shall return unto Me with their whole heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַתְּאֵנִים֙ הָרָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹ֑עַ כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה כֵּ֣ן אֶ֠תֵּ֠ן אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֤ה וְאֶת־שָׂרָיו֙ וְאֵ֣ת  שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְהַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vkht'nym hr'vt 'shr l't'khlnh mr' khykhh  'mr yhvh khn 'tn 'ttsdqyhv mlkhyhvdh v'tshryv v't  sh'ryt yrvshl͏m hnsh'rym b'rts hz't vhyshbym b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And as the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad; surely thus saith the LORD: So will I make Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּים֙ (לזועה) [לְזַעֲוָ֣ה] לְרָעָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ לְחֶרְפָּ֤ה וּלְמָשָׁל֙ לִשְׁנִינָ֣ה וְלִקְלָלָ֔ה בְּכׇל־הַמְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר־אַדִּיחֵ֥ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vnttym (lzv'h) [lz'vh] lr'h lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts lchrph vlmshl lshnynh vlqllh bkhlhmqmvt 'shr'dychm shm
verses.translation: I will even make them a horror among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָ֔ם אֶת־הַחֶ֖רֶב אֶת־הָרָעָ֣ב וְאֶת־הַדָּ֑בֶר עַד־תֻּמָּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תִּי לָהֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshlchty bm 'thchrb 'thr'b v'thdbr 'dtmm m'l h'dmh 'shrntty lhm vl'bvtyhm {p}
verses.translation: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֤ה עַֽל־יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ עַל־כׇּל־עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית לִיהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֗יא הַשָּׁנָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ית לִנְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shrhyh 'lyrmyhv 'lkhl'm yhvdh bshnh hrb'yt lyhvyqym bny'shyhv mlkh yhvdh hy' hshnh hr'shnyt lnbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ עַל־כׇּל־עַ֣ם יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶ֛ל כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'shr dbr yrmyhv hnby' 'lkhl'm yhvdh v'l khlyshby yrvshl͏m l'mr
verses.translation: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־שְׁלֹ֣שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֡ה לְיֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־אָמוֹן֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְעַ֣ד  הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה זֶ֚ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וָאֲדַבֵּ֧ר אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אַשְׁכֵּ֥ים וְדַבֵּ֖ר וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: mnshlsh 'shrh shnh ly'shyhv bn'mvn mlkh yhvdh v'd  hyvm hzh zh shlsh v'shrym shnh hyh dbryhvh 'ly v'dbr 'lykhm 'shkhym vdbr vl' shm'tm
verses.translation: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even unto this day, these three and twenty years, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, speaking betimes and often; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁלַח֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֜ם אֶֽת־כׇּל־עֲבָדָ֧יו הַנְּבִאִ֛ים הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹ֖חַ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וְלֹא־הִטִּיתֶ֥ם אֶֽת־אׇזְנְכֶ֖ם לִשְׁמֹֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vshlch yhvh 'lykhm 'tkhl'bdyv hnb'ym hshkhm vshlch vl' shm'tm vl'htytm 't'znkhm lshm'
verses.translation: And the LORD hath sent unto you all His servants the prophets, sending them betimes and often—but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר שֽׁוּבוּ־נָ֞א אִ֣ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֤וֹ הָרָעָה֙ וּמֵרֹ֣עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׁבוּ֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמִן־עוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: l'mr shvbvn' 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vmr' m'llykhm vshbv 'lh'dmh 'shr ntn yhvh lkhm vl'bvtykhm lmn'vlm v'd'vlm
verses.translation: saying: ‘Return ye now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers, for ever and ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַל־תֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְעׇבְדָ֖ם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תַכְעִ֤יסוּ אוֹתִי֙ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א אָרַ֖ע לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ltlkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym l'bdm vlhshtchvt lhm vl'tkh'ysv 'vty bm'shh ydykhm vl' 'r' lkhm
verses.translation: and go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke Me not with the work of your hands, and I will do you no hurt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה לְמַ֧עַן (הכעסוני) [הַכְעִיסֵ֛נִי] בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיכֶ֖ם לְרַ֥ע לָכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'shm'tm 'ly n'myhvh lm'n (hkh'svny) [hkh'ysny] bm'shh ydykhm lr' lkhm {p}
verses.translation: Yet ye have not hearkened unto Me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke Me with the work of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־דְּבָרָֽי׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt y'n 'shr l'shm'tm 'tdbry
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts: Because ye have not heard My words,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י שֹׁלֵ֡חַ וְלָקַחְתִּי֩ אֶת־כׇּל־מִשְׁפְּח֨וֹת צָפ֜וֹן נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה וְאֶל־נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֮ עַבְדִּי֒ וַהֲבִ֨אֹתִ֜ים עַל־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־יֹ֣שְׁבֶ֔יהָ וְעַ֛ל כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה סָבִ֑יב וְהַ֣חֲרַמְתִּ֔ים וְשַׂמְתִּים֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה וּלְחׇרְב֖וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: hnny shlch vlqchty 'tkhlmshpchvt tspvn n'myhvh v'lnbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl 'bdy vhb'tym 'lh'rts hz't v'lyshbyh v'l khlhgvym h'lh sbyb vhchrmtym vshmtym lshmh vlshrqh vlchrbvt 'vlm
verses.translation: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and I will send unto Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, My servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about; and I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֣י מֵהֶ֗ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה ק֥וֹל רֵחַ֖יִם וְא֥וֹר נֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vh'bdty mhm qvl shshvn vqvl shmchh qvl chtn vqvl khlh qvl rchym v'vr nr
verses.translation: Moreover I will cause to cease from among them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽיְתָה֙ כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את לְחׇרְבָּ֖ה לְשַׁמָּ֑ה וְעָ֨בְד֜וּ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛לֶּה אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyth khlh'rts hz't lchrbh lshmh v'bdv hgvym h'lh 'tmlkh bbl shb'ym shnh
verses.translation: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and a waste; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כִמְלֹ֣אות שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֡ה אֶפְקֹ֣ד עַל־מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֩ וְעַל־הַגּ֨וֹי הַה֧וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־עֲוֺנָ֖ם וְעַל־אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י אֹת֖וֹ לְשִֽׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh khml'vt shb'ym shnh 'pqd 'lmlkhbbl v'lhgvy hhv' n'myhvh 't'vnm v'l'rts khshdym vshmty 'tv lshmmvt 'vlm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (והבאותי) [וְהֵֽבֵאתִי֙] עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔יא אֶת־כׇּל־דְּבָרַ֖י אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֣רְתִּי עָלֶ֑יהָ אֵ֤ת כׇּל־הַכָּתוּב֙ בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נִבָּ֥א יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ עַל־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: (vhb'vty) [vhb'ty] 'lh'rts hhy' 'tkhldbry 'shrdbrty 'lyh 't khlhkhtvb bspr hzh 'shrnb' yrmyhv 'lkhlhgvym
verses.translation: And I will bring upon that land all My words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עָֽבְדוּ־בָ֤ם גַּם־הֵ֙מָּה֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּמְלָכִ֖ים גְּדוֹלִ֑ים וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם כְּפׇעֳלָ֖ם וּכְמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy 'bdvbm gmhmh gvym rbym vmlkhym gdvlym vshlmty lhm khp'lm vkhm'shh ydyhm {p}
verses.translation: For many nations and great kings shall make bondmen of them also; and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their own hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵלַ֔י קַ֠ח אֶת־כּ֨וֹס הַיַּ֧יִן הַחֵמָ֛ה הַזֹּ֖את מִיָּדִ֑י וְהִשְׁקִיתָ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י שֹׁלֵ֥חַ אוֹתְךָ֖ אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'ly qch 'tkhvs hyyn hchmh hz't mydy vhshqyth 'tv 'tkhlhgvym 'shr 'nkhy shlch 'vtkh 'lyhm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto me: Take this cup of the wine of fury at My hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁת֕וּ וְהִֽתְגֹּעֲשׁ֖וּ וְהִתְהֹלָ֑לוּ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַחֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵ֖חַ בֵּינֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vshtv vhtg'shv vhthllv mpny hchrb 'shr 'nkhy shlch byntm
verses.translation: And they shall drink, and reel to and fro, and be like madmen, because of the sword that I will send among them.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֥ח אֶת־הַכּ֖וֹס מִיַּ֣ד יְהֹוָ֑ה וָֽאַשְׁקֶה֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָחַ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'qch 'thkhvs myd yhvh v'shqh 'tkhlhgvym 'shrshlchny yhvh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Then took I the cup of the LORD’S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ וְאֶת־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶת־מְלָכֶ֖יהָ אֶת־שָׂרֶ֑יהָ לָתֵ֨ת אֹתָ֜ם לְחׇרְבָּ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה לִשְׁרֵקָ֥ה וְלִקְלָלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'tyrvshl͏m v't'ry yhvdh v'tmlkhyh 'tshryh ltt 'tm lchrbh lshmh lshrqh vlqllh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them an appalment, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֧ה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֛יִם וְאֶת־עֲבָדָ֥יו וְאֶת־שָׂרָ֖יו וְאֶת־כׇּל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'tpr'h mlkhmtsrym v't'bdyv v'tshryv v'tkhl'mv
verses.translation: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הָעֶ֔רֶב וְאֵ֕ת כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הָע֑וּץ וְאֵ֗ת כׇּל־מַלְכֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְאֶת־אַשְׁקְל֤וֹן וְאֶת־עַזָּה֙ וְאֶת־עֶקְר֔וֹן וְאֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית אַשְׁדּֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: v't khlh'rb v't khlmlkhy 'rts h'vts v't khlmlkhy 'rts plshtym v't'shqlvn v't'zh v't'qrvn v't sh'ryt 'shdvd
verses.translation: and all the mingled people; and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־אֱד֥וֹם וְאֶת־מוֹאָ֖ב וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 't'dvm v'tmv'b v'tbny 'mvn
verses.translation: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־מַלְכֵי־צֹ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֣י צִיד֑וֹן וְאֵת֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v't khlmlkhytsr v't khlmlkhy tsydvn v't mlkhy h'y 'shr b'br hym
verses.translation: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־דְּדָ֤ן וְאֶת־תֵּימָא֙ וְאֶת־בּ֔וּז וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־קְצוּצֵ֥י פֵאָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tddn v'ttym' v'tbvz v't khlqtsvtsy p'h
verses.translation: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that have the corners of their hair polled;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֣י עֲרָ֑ב וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֣י הָעֶ֔רֶב הַשֹּׁכְנִ֖ים בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: v't khlmlkhy 'rb v't khlmlkhy h'rb hshkhnym bmdbr
verses.translation: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the wilderness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת  כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֣י זִמְרִ֗י וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֥י מָדָֽי׃
verses.translit: v't  khlmlkhy zmry v't khlmlkhy 'ylm v't khlmlkhy mdy
verses.translation: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת  כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֣י הַצָּפ֗וֹן הַקְּרֹבִ֤ים וְהָרְחֹקִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֔יו וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַמַּמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ שֵׁשַׁ֖ךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v't  khlmlkhy htspvn hqrbym vhrchqym 'ysh 'l'chyv v't khlhmmlkhvt h'rts 'shr 'lpny h'dmh vmlkh shshkh yshth 'chryhm
verses.translation: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth.—And the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֡ם {פ} כֹּה־אָמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁת֤וּ וְשִׁכְרוּ֙ וּקְי֔וּ וְנִפְל֖וּ וְלֹ֣א תָק֑וּמוּ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַחֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵ֖חַ בֵּינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm {p} khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l shtv vshkhrv vqyv vnplv vl' tqvmv mpny hchrb 'shr 'nkhy shlch bynykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto them: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink ye, and be drunken, and spew, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֧י יְמָאֲנ֛וּ לָקַחַת־הַכּ֥וֹס מִיָּדְךָ֖ לִשְׁתּ֑וֹת וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שָׁת֥וֹ תִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khy ym'nv lqchthkhvs mydkh lshtvt v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shtv tshtv
verses.translation: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thy hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Ye shall surely drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנֵּ֨ה בָעִ֜יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא־שְׁמִ֣י עָלֶ֗יהָ אָֽנֹכִי֙ מֵחֵ֣ל לְהָרַ֔ע וְאַתֶּ֖ם הִנָּקֵ֣ה תִנָּק֑וּ לֹ֣א תִנָּק֔וּ כִּ֣י חֶ֗רֶב אֲנִ֤י קֹרֵא֙ עַל־כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khy hnh b'yr 'shr nqr'shmy 'lyh 'nkhy mchl lhr' v'tm hnqh tnqv l' tnqv khy chrb 'ny qr' 'lkhlyshby h'rts n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city whereupon My name is called, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ תִּנָּבֵ֣א אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם יְהֹוָ֞ה מִמָּר֤וֹם יִשְׁאָג֙ וּמִמְּע֤וֹן קׇדְשׁוֹ֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ שָׁאֹ֤ג יִשְׁאַג֙ עַל־נָוֵ֔הוּ הֵידָד֙ כְּדֹרְכִ֣ים יַעֲנֶ֔ה אֶ֥ל כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'th tnb' 'lyhm 't khlhdbrym h'lh v'mrt 'lyhm yhvh mmrvm ysh'g vmm'vn qdshv ytn qvlv sh'g ysh'g 'lnvhv hydd khdrkhym y'nh 'l khlyshby h'rts
verses.translation: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them: The LORD doth roar from on high, And utter His voice from His holy habitation; He doth mightily roar because of His fold; He giveth a shout, as they that tread the grapes, Against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֤א שָׁאוֹן֙ עַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַיהֹוָה֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם נִשְׁפָּ֥ט ה֖וּא לְכׇל־בָּשָׂ֑ר הָרְשָׁעִ֛ים נְתָנָ֥ם לַחֶ֖רֶב נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b' sh'vn 'dqtsh h'rts khy ryb lyhvh bgvym nshpt hv' lkhlbshr hrsh'ym ntnm lchrb n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: A noise is come even to the end of the earth; For the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, He doth plead with all flesh; As for the wicked, He hath given them to the sword, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנֵּ֥ה רָעָ֛ה יֹצֵ֖את מִגּ֣וֹי אֶל־גּ֑וֹי וְסַ֣עַר גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnh r'h yts't mgvy 'lgvy vs'r gdvl y'vr myrkhty'rts
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Behold, evil shall go forth From nation to nation, And a great storm shall be raised up From the uttermost parts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֞וּ חַֽלְלֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹ֣א יִסָּפְד֗וּ וְלֹ֤א יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְדֹ֛מֶן עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyv chlly yhvh byvm hhv' mqtsh h'rts v'dqtsh h'rts l' yspdv vl' y'spv vl' yqbrv ldmn 'lpny h'dmh yhyv
verses.translation: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth; they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the face of the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵילִ֨ילוּ הָרֹעִ֜ים וְזַעֲק֗וּ וְהִֽתְפַּלְּשׁוּ֙ אַדִּירֵ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן כִּי־מָלְא֥וּ יְמֵיכֶ֖ם לִטְב֑וֹחַ וּתְפוֹצ֣וֹתִיכֶ֔ם וּנְפַלְתֶּ֖ם כִּכְלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hylylv hr'ym vz'qv vhtplshv 'dyry hts'n khyml'v ymykhm ltbvch vtpvtsvtykhm vnpltm khkhly chmdh
verses.translation: Wail, ye shepherds, and cry; And wallow yourselves in the dust, ye leaders of the flock; For the days of your slaughter are fully come, And I will break you in pieces, And ye shall fall like a precious vessel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָבַ֥ד מָנ֖וֹס מִן־הָרֹעִ֑ים וּפְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵאַדִּירֵ֥י הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.translit: v'bd mnvs mnhr'ym vplyth m'dyry hts'n
verses.translation: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, Nor the leaders of the flock to escape.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֚וֹל צַעֲקַ֣ת הָרֹעִ֔ים וִֽילְלַ֖ת אַדִּירֵ֣י הַצֹּ֑אן כִּֽי־שֹׁדֵ֥ד יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מַרְעִיתָֽם׃
verses.translit: qvl ts'qt hr'ym vyllt 'dyry hts'n khyshdd yhvh 'tmr'ytm
verses.translation: Hark! the cry of the shepherds, And the wailing of the leaders of the flock! For the LORD despoileth their pasture.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָדַ֖מּוּ נְא֣וֹת הַשָּׁל֑וֹם מִפְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַף־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vndmv n'vt hshlvm mpny chrvn 'fyhvh
verses.translation: And the peaceable folds are brought to silence Because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָזַ֥ב כַּכְּפִ֖יר סֻכּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־הָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצָם֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה מִפְּנֵי֙ חֲר֣וֹן הַיּוֹנָ֔ה וּמִפְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'zb khkhpyr skhv khyhyth 'rtsm lshmh mpny chrvn hyvnh vmpny chrvn 'pv {p}
verses.translation: He hath forsaken His covert, as the lion; For their land is become a waste Because of the fierceness of the oppressing sword, And because of His fierce anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֗ית מַמְלְכ֛וּת יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָה֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה מֵאֵ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: br'shyt mmlkhvt yhvyqym bny'shyhv mlkh yhvdh hyh hdbr hzh m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word from the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה עֲמֹד֮ בַּחֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה֒ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֞ עַל־כׇּל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה הַבָּאִים֙ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖יךָ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם אַל־תִּגְרַ֖ע דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh 'md bchtsr bytyhvh vdbrt 'lkhl'ry yhvdh hb'ym lhshtchvt bytyhvh 't khlhdbrym 'shr tsvytykh ldbr 'lyhm 'ltgr' dbr
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD: Stand in the court of the LORD’S house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD’S house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוּלַ֣י יִשְׁמְע֔וּ וְיָשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָרָעָ֑ה וְנִחַמְתִּ֣י אֶל־הָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י חֹשֵׁב֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'vly yshm'v vyshbv 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vnchmty 'lhr'h 'shr 'nkhy chshb l'shvt lhm mpny r' m'llyhm
verses.translation: It may be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way; that I may repent Me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה אִם־לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹרָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh 'ml' tshm'v 'ly llkht btvrty 'shr ntty lpnykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto them: Thus saith the LORD: If ye will not hearken to Me, to walk in My law, which I have set before you,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁמֹ֗עַ עַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁלֵ֣חַ אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹ֖חַ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: lshm' 'ldbry 'bdy hnb'ym 'shr 'nkhy shlch 'lykhm vhshkhm vshlch vl' shm'tm
verses.translation: to hearken to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I send unto you, even sending them betimes and often, but ye have not hearkened;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י אֶת־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה כְּשִׁלֹ֑ה וְאֶת־הָעִ֤יר (הזאתה) [הַזֹּאת֙] אֶתֵּ֣ן לִקְלָלָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vntty 'thbyt hzh khshlh v'th'yr (hz'th) [hz't] 'tn lqllh lkhl gvy h'rts {p}
verses.translation: then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֛וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְהַנְּבִאִ֖ים וְכׇל־הָעָ֑ם אֶֽת־יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה בְּבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v hkhhnym vhnb'ym vkhlh'm 'tyrmyhv mdbr 'thdbrym h'lh bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כְּכַלּ֣וֹת יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ לְדַבֵּר֙ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־כׇּל־הָעָ֑ם וַיִּתְפְּשׂ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְכׇל־הָעָ֥ם לֵאמֹ֖ר מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khkhlvt yrmyhv ldbr 't khl'shrtsvh yhvh ldbr 'lkhlh'm vytpshv 'tv hkhhnym vhnby'ym vkhlh'm l'mr mvt tmvt
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold on him, saying: ‘Thou shalt surely die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַדּ֩וּעַ֩ נִבֵּ֨יתָ בְשֵׁם־יְהֹוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר כְּשִׁלוֹ֙ יִֽהְיֶה֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה וְהָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את תֶּחֱרַ֖ב מֵאֵ֣ין יוֹשֵׁ֑ב וַיִּקָּהֵ֧ל כׇּל־הָעָ֛ם אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בְּבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mdv' nbyt bshmyhvh l'mr khshlv yhyh hbyt hzh vh'yr hz't tchrb m'yn yvshb vyqhl khlh'm 'lyrmyhv bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying: This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate, without an inhabitant?’ And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ  שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיַּעֲל֥וּ מִבֵּית־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שְׁב֛וּ בְּפֶ֥תַח שַֽׁעַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה הֶחָדָֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshm'v  shry yhvdh 't hdbrym h'lh vy'lv mbythmlkh byt yhvh vyshbv bptch sh'ryhvh hchdsh {s}
verses.translation: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house unto the house of the LORD; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְהַנְּבִאִים֙ אֶל־הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּט־מָ֙וֶת֙ לָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֤י נִבָּא֙ אֶל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּאׇזְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv hkhhnym vhnb'ym 'lhshrym v'lkhlh'm l'mr mshptmvt l'ysh hzh khy nb' 'lh'yr hz't kh'shr shm'tm b'znykhm
verses.translation: Then spoke the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying: ‘This man is worthy of death; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־כׇּל־הַשָּׂרִ֔ים וְאֶל־כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהֹוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֗נִי לְהִנָּבֵ֞א אֶל־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וְאֶל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'lkhlhshrym v'lkhlh'm l'mr yhvh shlchny lhnb' 'lhbyt hzh v'lh'yr hz't 't khlhdbrym 'shr shm'tm
verses.translation: Then spoke Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying: ‘The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֵיטִ֤יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶם֙ וּמַ֣עַלְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְשִׁמְע֕וּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְיִנָּחֵ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th hytybv drkhykhm vm'llykhm vshm'v bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm vynchm yhvh 'lhr'h 'shr dbr 'lykhm
verses.translation: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and hearken to the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent Him of the evil that He hath pronounced against you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֖י הִנְנִ֣י בְיֶדְכֶ֑ם עֲשׂוּ־לִ֛י כַּטּ֥וֹב וְכַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ny hnny bydkhm 'shvly khtvb vkhyshr b'ynykhm
verses.translation: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand; do with me as is good and right in your eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ  יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אִם־מְמִתִ֣ים אַתֶּם֮ אֹתִי֒ כִּי־דָ֣ם נָקִ֗י אַתֶּם֙ נֹתְנִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את וְאֶל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י בֶאֱמֶ֗ת שְׁלָחַ֤נִי יְהֹוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְדַבֵּר֙ בְּאׇזְנֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'kh  yd' td'v khy 'mmmtym 'tm 'ty khydm nqy 'tm ntnym 'lykhm v'lh'yr hz't v'lyshbyh khy b'mt shlchny yhvh 'lykhm ldbr b'znykhm 't khlhdbrym h'lh {s}
verses.translation: Only know ye for certain that, if ye put me to death, ye will bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof; for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְכׇל־הָעָ֔ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְאֶל־הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים אֵין־לָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ מִשְׁפַּט־מָ֔וֶת כִּ֗י בְּשֵׁ֛ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv hshrym vkhlh'm 'lhkhhnym v'lhnby'ym 'ynl'ysh hzh mshptmvt khy bshm yhvh 'lhynv dbr 'lynv
verses.translation: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets: ‘This man is not worthy of death; for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֣מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִזִּקְנֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶֽל־כׇּל־קְהַ֥ל הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyqmv 'nshym mzqny h'rts vy'mrv 'lkhlqhl h'm l'mr
verses.translation: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (מיכיה) [מִיכָה֙] הַמּ֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י הָיָ֣ה נִבָּ֔א בִּימֵ֖י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־כׇּל־עַם֩ יְהוּדָ֨ה לֵאמֹ֜ר כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צִיּ֞וֹן שָׂדֶ֤ה תֵחָרֵשׁ֙ וִירוּשָׁלַ֙יִם֙ עִיִּ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְהַ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת לְבָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר׃
verses.translit: (mykhyh) [mykhh] hmvrshty hyh nb' bymy chzqyhv mlkhyhvdh vy'mr 'lkhl'm yhvdh l'mr khh'mr  yhvh tsb'vt tsyvn shdh tchrsh vyrvshlym 'yym thyh vhr hbyt lbmvt y'r
verses.translation: ’Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Zion shall be plowed as a field, And Jerusalem shall become heaps, And the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶהָמֵ֣ת הֱ֠מִתֻ֠הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֜ה וְכׇל־יְהוּדָ֗ה הֲלֹא֮ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהֹוָה֒ וַיְחַל֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים רָעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשׁוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: hhmt hmthv chzqyhv mlkhyhvdh vkhlyhvdh hl' yr' 'tyhvh vychl 'tpny yhvh vynchm yhvh 'lhr'h 'shrdbr 'lyhm v'nchnv 'shym r'h gdvlh 'lnpshvtynv
verses.translation: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and entreat the favour of the LORD, and the LORD repented Him of the evil which He had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our own souls.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֤ה מִתְנַבֵּא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה אוּרִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בֶּֽן־שְׁמַעְיָ֔הוּ מִקִּרְיַ֖ת הַיְּעָרִ֑ים וַיִּנָּבֵ֞א עַל־הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ וְעַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את כְּכֹ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vgm'ysh hyh mtnb' bshm yhvh 'vryhv bnshm'yhv mqryt hy'rym vynb' 'lh'yr hz't v'lh'rts hz't khkhl dbry yrmyhv
verses.translation: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath-jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־יְ֠הוֹיָקִ֠ים וְכׇל־גִּבּוֹרָ֤יו וְכׇל־הַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶת־דְּבָרָ֔יו וַיְבַקֵּ֥שׁ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הֲמִית֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אוּרִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וַיִּרָ֔א וַיִּבְרַ֖ח וַיָּבֹ֥א מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyshm' hmlkhyhvyqym vkhlgbvryv vkhlhshrym 'tdbryv vybqsh hmlkh hmytv vyshm' 'vryhv vyr' vybrch vyb' mtsrym
verses.translation: and when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֛ים אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יִם אֵ֣ת אֶלְנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־עַכְבּ֛וֹר וַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אִתּ֖וֹ אֶל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh yhvyqym 'nshym mtsrym 't 'lntn bn'khbvr v'nshym 'tv 'lmtsrym
verses.translation: and Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him, into Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת־אוּרִיָּ֜הוּ מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וַיְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹיָקִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֖הוּ בֶּחָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת־נִבְלָת֔וֹ אֶל־קִבְרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyvtsy'v 't'vryhv mmtsrym vyb'hv 'lhmlkh yhvyqym vykhhv bchrb vyshlkh 'tnbltv 'lqbry bny h'm
verses.translation: and they fetched forth Uriah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the children of the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֗ךְ יַ֚ד אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־שָׁפָ֔ן הָיְתָ֖ה אֶֽת־יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ לְבִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת־אֹת֥וֹ בְיַד־הָעָ֖ם לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'kh yd 'chyqm bnshpn hyth 'tyrmyhv lblty tt'tv bydh'm lhmytv {p}
verses.translation: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֗ית מַמְלֶ֛כֶת יְהוֹיָקִ֥ם בֶּן־יֹאושִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָ֞ה הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֔ה מֵאֵ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: br'shyt mmlkht yhvyqm bny'vshyhv mlkh yhvdh hyh hdbr hzh 'lyrmyh m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְךָ֔ מוֹסֵר֖וֹת וּמֹט֑וֹת וּנְתַתָּ֖ם עַל־צַוָּארֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh 'ly 'shh lkh mvsrvt vmtvt vnttm 'ltsv'rkh
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD to me: Make thee bands and bars, and put them upon thy neck;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתָּם֩ אֶל־מֶ֨לֶךְ אֱד֜וֹם וְאֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֶל־מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וְאֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ צֹ֖ר וְאֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ צִיד֑וֹן בְּיַ֤ד מַלְאָכִים֙ הַבָּאִ֣ים יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם אֶל־צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshlchtm 'lmlkh 'dvm v'lmlkh mv'b v'lmlkh bny 'mvn v'lmlkh tsr v'lmlkh tsydvn byd ml'khym hb'ym yrvshl͏m 'ltsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: and send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers that come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוִּיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔ם אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vtsvyt 'tm 'l'dnyhm l'mr khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l khh t'mrv 'l'dnykhm
verses.translation: and give them a charge unto their masters, saying: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Thus shall ye say unto your masters:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֞י עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־הָאָדָ֤ם וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּכֹחִי֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבִזְרוֹעִ֖י הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה וּנְתַתִּ֕יהָ לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר יָשַׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'shyty 'th'rts 'th'dm v'thbhmh 'shr 'lpny h'rts bkhchy hgdvl vbzrv'y hntvyh vnttyh l'shr yshr b'yny
verses.translation: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the face of the earth, by My great power and by My outstretched arm; and I give it unto whom it seemeth right unto Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָאֲרָצ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל עַבְדִּ֑י וְגַם֙ אֶת־חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי ל֖וֹ לְעׇבְדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'th 'nkhy ntty 'tkhlh'rtsvt h'lh byd nbvkhdn'tsr mlkhbbl 'bdy vgm 'tchyt hshdh ntty lv l'bdv
verses.translation: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant; and the beasts of the field also have I given him to serve him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבְד֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־בְּנ֖וֹ וְאֶֽת־בֶּן־בְּנ֑וֹ עַ֣ד בֹּא־עֵ֤ת אַרְצוֹ֙ גַּם־ה֔וּא וְעָ֤בְדוּ בוֹ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּמְלָכִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'bdv 'tv khlhgvym v'tbnv v'tbnbnv 'd b''t 'rtsv gmhv' v'bdv bv gvym rbym vmlkhym gdlym
verses.translation: And all the nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land come; and then many nations and great kings shall make him their bondman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַגּ֜וֹי וְהַמַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יַעַבְד֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶת־נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֵ֨ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִתֵּן֙ אֶת־צַוָּאר֔וֹ בְּעֹ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל בַּחֶ֩רֶב֩ וּבָרָעָ֨ב וּבַדֶּ֜בֶר אֶפְקֹ֨ד עַל־הַגּ֤וֹי הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה עַד־תֻּמִּ֥י אֹתָ֖ם בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh hgvy vhmmlkhh 'shr l'y'bdv 'tv 'tnbvkhdn'tsr mlkhbbl v't 'shr l'ytn 'ttsv'rv b'l mlkh bbl bchrb vbr'b vbdbr 'pqd 'lhgvy hhv' n'myhvh 'dtmy 'tm bydv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I visit, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אַתֶּ֠ם אַל־תִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֶל־נְבִיאֵיכֶ֜ם וְאֶל־קֹסְמֵיכֶ֗ם וְאֶל֙ חֲלֹמֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־עֹנְנֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֶל־כַּשָּׁפֵיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֞ם אֹמְרִ֤ים אֲלֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תַעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: v'tm 'ltshm'v 'lnby'ykhm v'lqsmykhm v'l chlmtykhm v'l'nnykhm v'lkhshpykhm 'shrhm 'mrym 'lykhm l'mr l' t'bdv 'tmlkh bbl
verses.translation: But as for you, hearken ye not to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreams, nor to your soothsayers, nor to your sorcerers, that speak unto you, saying: Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖ם נִבְּאִ֣ים לָכֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן הַרְחִ֤יק אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵעַ֣ל אַדְמַתְכֶ֔ם וְהִדַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם וַאֲבַדְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: khy shqr hm nb'ym lkhm lm'n hrchyq 'tkhm m'l 'dmtkhm vhdchty 'tkhm v'bdtm
verses.translation: for they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out and ye should perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַגּ֗וֹי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבִ֧יא אֶת־צַוָּאר֛וֹ בְּעֹ֥ל מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וַעֲבָד֑וֹ וְהִנַּחְתִּ֤יו עַל־אַדְמָתוֹ֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַעֲבָדָ֖הּ וְיָ֥שַׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhgvy 'shr yby' 'ttsv'rv b'l mlkhbbl v'bdv vhnchtyv 'l'dmtv n'myhvh v'bdh vyshb bh
verses.translation: But the nation that shall bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, that nation will I let remain in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־צִדְקִיָּ֤ה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי כְּכׇל־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹ֑ר הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־צַוְּארֵיכֶ֜ם בְּעֹ֣ל מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֗ל וְעִבְד֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וְעַמּ֖וֹ וִֽחְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ltsdqyh mlkhyhvdh dbrty khkhlhdbrym h'lh l'mr hby'v 'ttsv'rykhm b'l mlkhbbl v'bdv 'tv v'mv vchyv
verses.translation: And I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying: ‘Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תָמ֙וּתוּ֙ אַתָּ֣ה וְעַמֶּ֔ךָ בַּחֶ֖רֶב בָּרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־הַגּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: lmh tmvtv 'th v'mkh bchrb br'b vbdbr kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhgvy 'shr l'y'bd 'tmlkh bbl
verses.translation: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽל־תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֣י הַנְּבִאִ֗ים הָאֹמְרִ֤ים אֲלֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תַעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖ם נִבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ltshm'v 'ldbry hnb'ym h'mrym 'lykhm l'mr l' t'bdv 'tmlkh bbl khy shqr hm nb'ym lkhm
verses.translation: And hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying: Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon, for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א שְׁלַחְתִּים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהֵ֛ם נִבְּאִ֥ים בִּשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר לְמַ֨עַן הַדִּיחִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֕ם וְהַנְּבִאִ֖ים הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy l' shlchtym n'myhvh vhm nb'ym bshmy lshqr lm'n hdychy 'tkhm v'bdtm 'tm vhnb'ym hnb'ym lkhm
verses.translation: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, and they prophesy falsely in My name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים֩ וְאֶל־כׇּל־הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה דִּבַּ֣רְתִּי לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָה֒ אַֽל־תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֣י נְבִיאֵיכֶ֗ם הַֽנִּבְּאִ֤ים לָכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֨ה כְלֵ֧י בֵית־יְהֹוָ֛ה מוּשָׁבִ֥ים מִבָּבֶ֖לָה עַתָּ֣ה מְהֵרָ֑ה כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖מָּה נִבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lhkhhnym v'lkhlh'm hzh dbrty l'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'ltshm'v 'ldbry nby'ykhm hnb'ym lkhm l'mr hnh khly bytyhvh mvshbym mbblh 'th mhrh khy shqr hmh nb'ym lkhm
verses.translation: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying: Behold, the vessels of the LORD’S house shall now shortly be brought back from Babylon; for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּשְׁמְע֣וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עִבְד֥וּ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וִֽחְי֑וּ לָ֧מָּה תִֽהְיֶ֛ה הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את חׇרְבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ltshm'v 'lyhm 'bdv 'tmlkhbbl vchyv lmh thyh h'yr hz't chrbh
verses.translation: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live; wherefore should this city become desolate?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־נְבִאִ֣ים הֵ֔ם וְאִם־יֵ֥שׁ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אִתָּ֑ם יִפְגְּעוּ־נָא֙ בַּיהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לְבִלְתִּי־בֹ֜אוּ הַכֵּלִ֣ים  הַנּוֹתָרִ֣ים בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָ֗ה וּבֵ֨ית מֶ֧לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֛ה וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: v'mnb'ym hm v'mysh dbryhvh 'tm ypg'vn' byhvh tsb'vt lbltyb'v hkhlym  hnvtrym bbytyhvh vbyt mlkh yhvdh vbyrvshl͏m bblh
verses.translation: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֶל־הָֽעַמֻּדִ֔ים וְעַל־הַיָּ֖ם וְעַל־הַמְּכֹנ֑וֹת וְעַל֙ יֶ֣תֶר הַכֵּלִ֔ים הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים בָּעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lh'mdym v'lhym v'lhmkhnvt v'l ytr hkhlym hnvtrym b'yr hz't
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־לְקָחָ֗ם נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בַּ֠גְלוֹת֠וֹ אֶת־[יְכׇנְיָ֨ה] (יכוניה) בֶן־יְהוֹיָקִ֧ים מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֛ה מִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בָּבֶ֑לָה וְאֵ֛ת כׇּל־חֹרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: 'shr l'lqchm nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl bglvtv 't[ykhnyh] (ykhvnyh) bnyhvyqym mlkhyhvdh myrvshl͏m bblh v't khlchry yhvdh vyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַל־הַכֵּלִ֗ים הַנּֽוֹתָרִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה וּבֵ֥ית מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'lhkhlym hnvtrym byt yhvh vbyt mlkhyhvdh vyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּבֶ֥לָה יוּבָ֖אוּ וְשָׁ֣מָּה יִֽהְי֑וּ עַ֠ד י֣וֹם פׇּקְדִ֤י אֹתָם֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהַֽעֲלִיתִים֙ וַהֲשִׁ֣יבֹתִ֔ים אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bblh yvb'v vshmh yhyv 'd yvm pqdy 'tm n'myhvh vh'lytym vhshybtym 'lhmqvm hzh {p}
verses.translation: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be, until the day that I remember them, saith the LORD, and bring them up, and restore them to this place.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַהִ֗יא בְּרֵאשִׁית֙ מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֔ה (בשנת) [בַּשָּׁנָה֙] הָרְבִעִ֔ית בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֑י אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֡י חֲנַנְיָה֩ בֶן־עַזּ֨וּר הַנָּבִ֜יא אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִגִּבְעוֹן֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֧י הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְכׇל־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy  bshnh hhy' br'shyt mmlkht tsdqyh mlkhyhvdh (bshnt) [bshnh] hrb'yt bchdsh hchmyshy 'mr 'ly chnnyh bn'zvr hnby' 'shr mgb'vn bbyt yhvh l'yny hkhhnym vkhlh'm l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azzur the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁבַ֕רְתִּי אֶת־עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l l'mr shbrty 't'l mlkh bbl
verses.translation: ’Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּע֣וֹד  שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֗ים אֲנִ֤י מֵשִׁיב֙ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶֽת־כׇּל־כְּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָקַ֜ח נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֙ מִן־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: b'vd  shntym ymym 'ny mshyb 'lhmqvm hzh 'tkhlkhly byt yhvh 'shr lqch nbvkhdn'tsr mlkhbbl mnhmqvm hzh vyby'm bbl
verses.translation: Within two full years will I bring back into this place all the vessels of the LORD’S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־יְכׇנְיָ֣ה בֶן־יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶלֶךְ־יְ֠הוּדָ֠ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־גָּל֨וּת יְהוּדָ֜ה הַבָּאִ֣ים בָּבֶ֗לָה אֲנִ֥י מֵשִׁ֛יב אֶל־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֣י אֶשְׁבֹּ֔ר אֶת־עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: v'tykhnyh bnyhvyqym mlkhyhvdh v'tkhlglvt yhvdh hb'ym bblh 'ny mshyb 'lhmqvm hzh n'myhvh khy 'shbr 't'l mlkh bbl
verses.translation: and I will bring back to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went to Babylon, saith the LORD; for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֔יא אֶל־חֲנַנְיָ֖ה הַנָּבִ֑יא לְעֵינֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וּלְעֵינֵ֣י כׇל־הָעָ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyh hnby' 'lchnnyh hnby' l'yny hkhhnym vl'yny khlh'm h'mdym bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֔יא אָמֵ֕ן כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהֹוָ֑ה יָקֵ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִבֵּ֗אתָ לְהָשִׁ֞יב כְּלֵ֤י בֵית־יְהֹוָה֙ וְכׇל־הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מִבָּבֶ֖ל אֶל־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
