verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyh hnby' 'mn khn y'shh yhvh yqm yhvh 'tdbrykh 'shr nb't lhshyb khly bytyhvh vkhlhgvlh mbbl 'lhmqvm hzh
verses.translation: even the prophet Jeremiah said: ‘Amen! the LORD do so! the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the LORD’S house, and all them that are carried away captive, from Babylon unto this place!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־שְׁמַֽע־נָא֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֣ר בְּאׇזְנֶ֑יךָ וּבְאׇזְנֵ֖י כׇּל־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'khshm'n' hdbr hzh 'shr 'nkhy dbr b'znykh vb'zny khlh'm
verses.translation: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֧וּ לְפָנַ֛י וּלְפָנֶ֖יךָ מִן־הָעוֹלָ֑ם וַיִּנָּ֨בְא֜וּ אֶל־אֲרָצ֤וֹת רַבּוֹת֙ וְעַל־מַמְלָכ֣וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת לְמִלְחָמָ֖ה וּלְרָעָ֥ה וּלְדָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: hnby'ym 'shr hyv lpny vlpnykh mnh'vlm vynb'v 'l'rtsvt rbvt v'lmmlkhvt gdlvt lmlchmh vlr'h vldbr
verses.translation: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֕יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנָּבֵ֖א לְשָׁל֑וֹם בְּבֹא֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַנָּבִ֔יא יִוָּדַע֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָח֥וֹ יְהֹוָ֖ה בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translit: hnby' 'shr ynb' lshlvm bb' dbr hnby' yvd' hnby' 'shrshlchv yhvh b'mt
verses.translation: The prophet that prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶת־הַמּוֹטָ֔ה מֵעַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֑יא וַֽיִּשְׁבְּרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqch chnnyh hnby' 'thmvth m'l tsv'r yrmyh hnby' vyshbrhv
verses.translation: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חֲנַנְיָה֩ לְעֵינֵ֨י כׇל־הָעָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָה֒ כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת־עֹ֣ל  נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֗ל בְּעוֹד֙ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֔ים מֵעַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr chnnyh l'yny khlh'm l'mr khh 'mr yhvh khkhh 'shbr 't'l  nbkhdn'tsr mlkhbbl b'vd shntym ymym m'l tsv'r khlhgvym vylkh yrmyh hnby' ldrkhv {p}
verses.translation: And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’ And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֑ה אַ֠חֲרֵ֠י שְׁב֞וֹר חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶת־הַמּוֹטָ֔ה מֵעַ֗ל צַוַּ֛אר יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'lyrmyh 'chry shbvr chnnyh hnby' 'thmvth m'l tsv'r yrmyh hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָלוֹךְ֩ וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל־חֲנַנְיָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה מוֹטֹ֥ת עֵ֖ץ שָׁבָ֑רְתָּ וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ תַחְתֵּיהֶ֖ן מֹט֥וֹת בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.translit: hlvkh v'mrt 'lchnnyh l'mr khh 'mr yhvh mvtt 'ts shbrt v'shyt tchtyhn mtvt brzl
verses.translation: ’Go, and tell Hananiah, saying: Thus saith the LORD: Thou hast broken the bars of wood; but thou shalt make in their stead bars of iron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹ֣ל בַּרְזֶ֡ל נָתַ֜תִּי עַל־צַוַּ֣אר  כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה לַעֲבֹ֛ד אֶת־נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וַעֲבָדֻ֑הוּ וְגַ֛ם אֶת־חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה נָתַ֥תִּי לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'l brzl ntty 'ltsv'r  khlhgvym h'lh l'bd 'tnbkhdn'tsr mlkhbbl v'bdhv vgm 'tchyt hshdh ntty lv
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him; and I have given him the beasts of the field also.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֧ה הַנָּבִ֛יא אֶל־חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א חֲנַנְיָ֑ה לֹא־שְׁלָחֲךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאַתָּ֗ה הִבְטַ֛חְתָּ אֶת־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה עַל־שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyh hnby' 'lchnnyh hnby' shm'n' chnnyh l'shlchkh yhvh v'th hbtcht 'th'm hzh 'lshqr
verses.translation: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet: ‘Hear now, Hananiah; the LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ מְשַֽׁלֵּחֲךָ֔ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה הַשָּׁנָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה מֵ֔ת כִּי־סָרָ֥ה דִבַּ֖רְתָּ אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny mshlchkh m'l pny h'dmh hshnh 'th mt khysrh dbrt 'lyhvh
verses.translation: ’Therefore thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will send thee away from off the face of the earth; this year thou shalt die, because thou hast spoken perversion against the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מׇת חֲנַנְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַהִ֑יא בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymt chnnyh hnby' bshnh hhy' bchdsh hshby'y {p}
verses.translation: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלַ֛ח יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא מִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם אֶל־יֶ֜תֶר זִקְנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֗ה וְאֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְאֶל־הַנְּבִיאִים֙ וְאֶל־כׇּל־הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶגְלָ֧ה נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֛ר מִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: v'lh dbry hspr 'shr shlch yrmyh hnby' myrvshl͏m 'lytr zqny hgvlh v'lhkhhnym v'lhnby'ym v'lkhlh'm 'shr hglh nbvkhdn'tsr myrvshl͏m bblh
verses.translation: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people, whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י צֵ֣את יְכׇנְיָֽה־הַ֠מֶּ֠לֶךְ וְהַגְּבִירָ֨ה וְהַסָּרִיסִ֜ים שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֧ה וִירוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם וְהֶחָרָ֥שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּ֖ר מִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: 'chry ts't ykhnyhhmlkh vhgbyrh vhsrysym shry yhvdh vyrvshl͏m vhchrsh vhmsgr myrvshl͏m
verses.translation: after that Jeconiah the king, and the queen-mother, and the officers, and the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיַד֙ אֶלְעָשָׂ֣ה בֶן־שָׁפָ֔ן וּגְמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל־נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֛ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּבֶ֥לָה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: byd 'l'shh bnshpn vgmryh bnchlqyh 'shr shlch tsdqyh mlkhyhvdh 'lnbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl bblh l'mr
verses.translation: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְכׇ֨ל־הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הִגְלֵ֥יתִי מִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l lkhlhgvlh 'shrhglyty myrvshl͏m bblh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all the captivity, whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem unto Babylon:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֖ים וְשֵׁ֑בוּ וְנִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאִכְל֖וּ אֶת־פִּרְיָֽן׃
verses.translit: bnv btym vshbv vnt'v gnvt v'khlv 'tpryn
verses.translation: Build ye houses, and dwell in them, and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְח֣וּ נָשִׁ֗ים וְהוֹלִ֘ידוּ֮ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנוֹת֒ וּקְח֨וּ לִבְנֵיכֶ֜ם נָשִׁ֗ים וְאֶת־בְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ תְּנ֣וּ לַאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְתֵלַ֖דְנָה בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֑וֹת וּרְבוּ־שָׁ֖ם וְאַל־תִּמְעָֽטוּ׃
verses.translit: qchv nshym vhvlydv bnym vbnvt vqchv lbnykhm nshym v'tbnvtykhm tnv l'nshym vtldnh bnym vbnvt vrbvshm v'ltm'tv
verses.translation: take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; and multiply ye there, and be not diminished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִרְשׁ֞וּ אֶת־שְׁל֣וֹם הָעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִגְלֵ֤יתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה וְהִתְפַּֽלְל֥וּ בַעֲדָ֖הּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֣י בִשְׁלוֹמָ֔הּ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vdrshv 'tshlvm h'yr 'shr hglyty 'tkhm shmh vhtpllv b'dh 'lyhvh khy bshlvmh yhyh lkhm shlvm
verses.translation: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray unto the LORD for it; for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַל־יַשִּׁ֧יאוּ לָכֶ֛ם נְבִיאֵיכֶ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֖ם וְקֹסְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַֽל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־חֲלֹמֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם מַחְלְמִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'lyshy'v lkhm nby'ykhm 'shrbqrbkhm vqsmykhm v'ltshm'v 'lchlmtykhm 'shr 'tm mchlmym
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Let not your prophets that are in the midst of you, and your diviners, beguile you, neither hearken ye to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְשֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֛ם נִבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶ֖ם בִּשְׁמִ֑י לֹ֥א שְׁלַחְתִּ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy bshqr hm nb'ym lkhm bshmy l' shlchtym n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: For they prophesy falsely unto you in My name; I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֠י לְפִ֞י מְלֹ֧את לְבָבֶ֛ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה אֶפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרִ֣י הַטּ֔וֹב לְהָשִׁ֣יב אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khykhh 'mr yhvh khy lpy ml't lbbl shb'ym shnh 'pqd 'tkhm vhqmty 'lykhm 'tdbry htvb lhshyb 'tkhm 'lhmqvm hzh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will remember you, and perform My good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ אָנֹכִ֨י יָדַ֜עְתִּי אֶת־הַמַּחֲשָׁבֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י חֹשֵׁ֥ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה מַחְשְׁב֤וֹת שָׁלוֹם֙ וְלֹ֣א לְרָעָ֔ה לָתֵ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם אַחֲרִ֥ית וְתִקְוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy yd'ty 'thmchshbt 'shr 'nkhy chshb 'lykhm n'myhvh mchshbvt shlvm vl' lr'h ltt lkhm 'chryt vtqvh
verses.translation: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּקְרָאתֶ֤ם אֹתִי֙ וַֽהֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וְהִתְפַּלַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וְשָׁמַעְתִּ֖י אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vqr'tm 'ty vhlkhtm vhtplltm 'ly vshm'ty 'lykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall call upon Me, and go, and pray unto Me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖י וּמְצָאתֶ֑ם כִּ֥י תִדְרְשֻׁ֖נִי בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbqshtm 'ty vmts'tm khy tdrshny bkhllbbkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall seek Me, and find Me, when ye shall search for Me with all your heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִמְצֵ֣אתִי לָכֶם֮ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה֒ וְשַׁבְתִּ֣י אֶת־[שְׁבוּתְכֶ֗ם] (שביתכם) וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶ֠תְכֶ֠ם מִֽכׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֞ם וּמִכׇּל־הַמְּקוֹמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּ֧חְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֛ם שָׁ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶ֨ל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־הִגְלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vnmts'ty lkhm n'myhvh vshbty 't[shbvtkhm] (shbytkhm) vqbtsty 'tkhm mkhlhgvym vmkhlhmqvmvt 'shr hdchty 'tkhm shm n'myhvh vhshbty 'tkhm 'lhmqvm 'shrhglyty 'tkhm mshm
verses.translation: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD, and I will turn your captivity, and gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you back unto the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֖י אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם הֵקִ֨ים לָ֧נוּ יְהֹוָ֛ה נְבִאִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'mrtm hqym lnv yhvh nb'ym bblh {s}
verses.translation: For ye have said: ‘The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶל־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ אֶל־כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֔ד וְאֶ֨ל־כׇּל־הָעָ֔ם הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את אֲחֵיכֶ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־יָצְא֥וּ אִתְּכֶ֖ם בַּגּוֹלָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh 'lhmlkh hyvshb 'lkhs' dvd v'lkhlh'm hyvshb b'yr hz't 'chykhm 'shr l'yts'v 'tkhm bgvlh {s}
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD concerning the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and concerning all the people that dwell in this city, your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִי֙ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ בָּ֔ם אֶת־הַחֶ֖רֶב אֶת־הָרָעָ֣ב וְאֶת־הַדָּ֑בֶר וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֗ם כַּתְּאֵנִים֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹֽעַ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny mshlch bm 'thchrb 'thr'b v'thdbr vntty 'vtm kht'nym hsh'rym 'shr l't'khlnh mr'
verses.translation: thus saith the LORD of hosts: Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so bad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָֽדַפְתִּי֙ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם בַּחֶ֖רֶב בָּרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וּנְתַתִּ֨ים (לזועה) [לְזַעֲוָ֜ה] לְכֹ֣ל  מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֗רֶץ לְאָלָ֤ה וּלְשַׁמָּה֙ וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֣ה וּלְחֶרְפָּ֔ה בְּכׇל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vrdpty 'chryhm bchrb br'b vbdbr vnttym (lzv'h) [lz'vh] lkhl  mmlkhvt h'rts l'lh vlshmh vlshrqh vlchrph bkhlhgvym 'shrhdchtym shm
verses.translation: And I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will make them a horror unto all the kingdoms of the earth, a curse, and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֛חַת אֲשֶֽׁר־לֹא־שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶל־דְּבָרַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־עֲבָדַ֤י הַנְּבִאִים֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְשָׁלֹ֔חַ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: tcht 'shrl'shm'v 'ldbry n'myhvh 'shr shlchty 'lyhm 't'bdy hnb'ym hshkhm vshlch vl' shm'tm n'myhvh
verses.translation: because they have not hearkened to My words, saith the LORD, wherewith I sent unto them My servants the prophets, sending them betimes and often; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֑ה כׇּ֨ל־הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי מִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בָּבֶֽלָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tm shm'v dbryhvh khlhgvlh 'shrshlchty myrvshl͏m bblh {s}
verses.translation: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־אַחְאָ֤ב בֶּן־קֽוֹלָיָה֙ וְאֶל־צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־מַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֔ה הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶ֛ם בִּשְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑קֶר הִנְנִ֣י  נֹתֵ֣ן אֹתָ֗ם בְּיַד֙ נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְהִכָּ֖ם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'l'ch'b bnqvlyh v'ltsdqyhv bnm'shyh hnb'ym lkhm bshmy shqr hnny  ntn 'tm byd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl vhkhm l'ynykhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie unto you in My name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֻקַּ֤ח מֵהֶם֙ קְלָלָ֔ה לְכֹל֙ גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבָבֶ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יְשִֽׂמְךָ֤ יְהֹוָה֙ כְּצִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ וּכְאֶחָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־קָלָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vlqch mhm qllh lkhl glvt yhvdh 'shr bbbl l'mr yshmkh yhvh khtsdqyhv vkh'chb 'shrqlm mlkhbbl b'sh
verses.translation: and of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah that are in Babylon, saying: ‘The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשׂ֨וּ נְבָלָ֜ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיְנַֽאֲפוּ֙ אֶת־נְשֵׁ֣י רֵֽעֵיהֶ֔ם וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ דָבָ֤ר בִּשְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר ל֣וֹא צִוִּיתִ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֛י (הוידע) [הַיּוֹדֵ֥עַ] וָעֵ֖ד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: y'n 'shr 'shv nblh byshr'l vyn'pv 'tnshy r'yhm vydbrv dbr bshmy shqr 'shr lv' tsvytm v'nkhy (hvyd') [hyvd'] v'd n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: because they have wrought vile deeds in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’wives, and have spoken words in My name falsely, which I commanded them not; but I am He that knoweth, and am witness, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־שְׁמַעְיָ֥הוּ הַנֶּחֱלָמִ֖י תֹּאמַ֥ר לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'lshm'yhv hnchlmy t'mr l'mr
verses.translation: And concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite thou shalt speak, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּה֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתָּ בְשִׁמְכָ֜ה סְפָרִ֗ים אֶל־כׇּל־הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּירוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְאֶל־צְפַנְיָ֤ה בֶן־מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶ֥ל כׇּל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l l'mr y'n 'shr 'th shlcht bshmkhh sprym 'lkhlh'm 'shr byrvshl͏m v'ltspnyh bnm'shyh hkhhn v'l khlhkhhnym l'mr
verses.translation: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying: Because thou hast sent letters in thine own name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֞ה נְתָנְךָ֣ כֹהֵ֗ן תַּ֚חַת יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לִֽהְי֤וֹת פְּקִדִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה לְכׇל־אִ֥ישׁ מְשֻׁגָּ֖ע וּמִתְנַבֵּ֑א וְנָתַתָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֶל־הַמַּהְפֶּ֖כֶת וְאֶל־הַצִּינֹֽק׃
verses.translit: yhvh ntnkh khhn tcht yhvyd' hkhhn lhyvt pqdym byt yhvh lkhl'ysh mshg' vmtnb' vntth 'tv 'lhmhpkht v'lhtsynq
verses.translation: ’The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that there should be officers in the house of the LORD for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in the stocks and in the collar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לָ֚מָּה לֹ֣א גָעַ֔רְתָּ בְּיִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הָֽעַנְּתֹתִ֑י הַמִּתְנַבֵּ֖א לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th lmh l' g'rt byrmyhv h'ntty hmtnb' lkhm
verses.translation: Now therefore, why hast thou not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who maketh himself a prophet to you,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַל־כֵּ֞ן שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלֵ֛ינוּ בָּבֶ֥ל לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲרֻכָּ֣ה הִ֑יא בְּנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְשֵׁ֔בוּ וְנִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאִכְל֖וּ אֶת־פְּרִיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: khy 'lkhn shlch 'lynv bbl l'mr 'rkhh hy' bnv btym vshbv vnt'v gnvt v'khlv 'tpryhn
verses.translation: forasmuch as he hath sent unto us in Babylon, saying: The captivity is long; build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א צְפַנְיָ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה בְּאׇזְנֵ֖י יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqr' tspnyh hkhhn 'thspr hzh b'zny yrmyhv hnby' {p}
verses.translation: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'lyrmyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלַ֤ח עַל־כׇּל־הַגּוֹלָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־שְׁמַעְיָ֖ה הַנֶּחֱלָמִ֑י יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ נִבָּ֨א לָכֶ֜ם שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה וַֽאֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א שְׁלַחְתִּ֔יו וַיַּבְטַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם עַל־שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: shlch 'lkhlhgvlh l'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'lshm'yh hnchlmy y'n 'shr nb' lkhm shm'yh v'ny l' shlchtyv vybtch 'tkhm 'lshqr
verses.translation: Send to all them of the captivity, saying: Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he hath caused you to trust in a lie;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י פֹקֵ֜ד עַל־שְׁמַעְיָ֣ה הַנֶּחֱלָמִי֮ וְעַל־זַרְעוֹ֒ לֹא־יִהְיֶ֨ה ל֜וֹ אִ֣ישׁ  יוֹשֵׁ֣ב  בְּתוֹךְ־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה וְלֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֥ה בַטּ֛וֹב אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה־לְעַמִּ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּֽי־סָרָ֥ה דִבֶּ֖ר עַל־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh hnny pqd 'lshm'yh hnchlmy v'lzr'v l'yhyh lv 'ysh  yvshb  btvkhh'm hzh vl'yr'h btvb 'shr'ny 'shhl'my n'myhvh khysrh dbr 'lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: therefore thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed; he shall not have a man to dwell among this people, neither shall he behold the good that I will do unto My people, saith the LORD; because he hath spoken perversion against the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'lyrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּתׇב־לְךָ֗ אֵ֧ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֶל־סֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l l'mr khtblkh 't khlhdbrym 'shrdbrty 'lykh 'lspr
verses.translation: ’Thus speaketh the LORD, the God of Israel, saying: Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְ֠שַׁבְתִּ֠י אֶת־שְׁב֨וּת עַמִּ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִֽיהוּדָ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֗ים אֶל־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תִּי לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם וִֽירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy hnh ymym b'ym n'myhvh vshbty 'tshbvt 'my yshr'l vyhvdh 'mr yhvh vhshbtym 'lh'rts 'shrntty l'bvtm vyrshvh {p}
verses.translation: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will turn the captivity of My people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD; and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְאֶל־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh hdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh 'lyshr'l v'lyhvdh
verses.translation: And these are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חֲרָדָ֖ה שָׁמָ֑עְנוּ פַּ֖חַד וְאֵ֥ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: khykhh 'mr yhvh qvl chrdh shm'nv pchd v'yn shlvm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: We have heard a voice of trembling, Of fear, and not of peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁאֲלוּ־נָ֣א וּרְא֔וּ אִם־יֹלֵ֖ד זָכָ֑ר מַדּ֩וּעַ֩ רָאִ֨יתִי כׇל־גֶּ֜בֶר יָדָ֤יו עַל־חֲלָצָיו֙ כַּיּ֣וֹלֵדָ֔ה וְנֶהֶפְכ֥וּ כׇל־פָּנִ֖ים לְיֵרָקֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: sh'lvn' vr'v 'myld zkhr mdv' r'yty khlgbr ydyv 'lchltsyv khyvldh vnhpkhv khlpnym lyrqvn
verses.translation: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child; Wherefore do I see every man With his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, And all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי כִּ֥י גָד֛וֹל הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא מֵאַ֣יִן כָּמֹ֑הוּ וְעֵֽת־צָרָ֥ה הִיא֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּמִמֶּ֖נָּה יִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: hvy khy gdvl hyvm hhv' m'yn khmhv v'ttsrh hy' ly'qb vmmnh yvsh'
verses.translation: Alas! for that day is great, So that none is like it; And it is a time of trouble unto Jacob, But out of it shall he be saved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם  יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אֶשְׁבֹּ֤ר עֻלּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ וּמוֹסְרוֹתֶ֖יךָ אֲנַתֵּ֑ק וְלֹא־יַעַבְדוּ־ב֥וֹ ע֖וֹד זָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm  yhvh tsb'vt 'shbr 'lv m'l tsv'rkh vmvsrvtykh 'ntq vl'y'bdvbv 'vd zrym
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, Saith the LORD of hosts, That I will break his yoke from off thy neck, And will burst thy bands; And strangers shall no more make him their bondman;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָ֣בְד֔וּ אֵ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֵת֙ דָּוִ֣ד מַלְכָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָקִ֖ים לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'bdv 't yhvh 'lhyhm v't dvd mlkhm 'shr 'qym lhm {s}
verses.translation: But they shall serve the LORD their God, And David their king, Whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה אַל־תִּירָא֩ עַבְדִּ֨י יַעֲקֹ֤ב נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה֙ וְאַל־תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁיעֲךָ֙ מֵֽרָח֔וֹק וְאֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑ם וְשָׁ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב וְשָׁקַ֥ט וְשַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: v'th 'ltyr' 'bdy y'qb n'myhvh v'ltcht yshr'l khy hnny mvshy'kh mrchvq v'tzr'kh m'rts shbym vshb y'qb vshqt vsh'nn v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: Therefore fear thou not, O Jacob My servant, saith the LORD; Neither be dismayed, O Israel; For, lo, I will save thee from afar, And thy seed from the land of their captivity; And Jacob shall again be quiet and at ease, And none shall make him afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהֽוֹשִׁיעֶ֑ךָ כִּי֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה כָלָ֜ה בְּכׇֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֣ם  אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֲפִצוֹתִ֣יךָ שָּׁ֗ם אַ֤ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֙ לֹֽא־אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה כָלָ֔ה וְיִסַּרְתִּ֙יךָ֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֥א אֲנַקֶּֽךָּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy'tkh 'ny n'myhvh lhvshy'kh khy ''shh khlh bkhlhgvym  'shr hptsvtykh shm 'kh 'tkh l'''shh khlh vysrtykh lmshpt vnqh l' 'nqkh {s}
verses.translation: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee; For I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have scattered thee, But I will not make a full end of thee; For I will correct thee in measure, And will not utterly destroy thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אָנ֣וּשׁ לְשִׁבְרֵ֑ךְ נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'nvsh lshbrkh nchlh mkhtkh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Thy hurt is incurable, And thy wound is grievous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽין־דָּ֥ן דִּינֵ֖ךְ לְמָז֑וֹר רְפֻא֥וֹת תְּעָלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'yndn dynkh lmzvr rp'vt t'lh 'yn lkh
verses.translation: None deemeth of thy wound that it may be bound up; Thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מְאַהֲבַ֣יִךְ שְׁכֵח֔וּךְ אוֹתָ֖ךְ לֹ֣א יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ כִּי֩ מַכַּ֨ת אוֹיֵ֤ב הִכִּיתִיךְ֙ מוּסַ֣ר אַכְזָרִ֔י עַ֚ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֵ֔ךְ עָצְמ֖וּ חַטֹּאתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: khlm'hbykh shkhchvkh 'vtkh l' ydrshv khy mkht 'vyb hkhytykh mvsr 'khzry 'l rb 'vnkh 'tsmv cht'tykh
verses.translation: All thy lovers have forgotten thee, They seek thee not; For I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, With the chastisement of a cruel one; For the greatness of thine iniquity, Because thy sins were increased.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תִּזְעַק֙ עַל־שִׁבְרֵ֔ךְ אָנ֖וּשׁ מַכְאֹבֵ֑ךְ עַ֣ל  רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֵ֗ךְ עָֽצְמוּ֙ חַטֹּאתַ֔יִךְ עָשִׂ֥יתִי אֵ֖לֶּה לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: mhtz'q 'lshbrkh 'nvsh mkh'bkh 'l  rb 'vnkh 'tsmv cht'tykh 'shyty 'lh lkh
verses.translation: Why criest thou for thy hurt, That thy pain is incurable? For the greatness of thine iniquity, because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כׇּל־אֹכְלַ֙יִךְ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔לוּ וְכׇל־צָרַ֥יִךְ כֻּלָּ֖ם בַּשְּׁבִ֣י יֵלֵ֑כוּ וְהָי֤וּ שֹׁאסַ֙יִךְ֙ לִמְשִׁסָּ֔ה וְכׇל־בֹּזְזַ֖יִךְ אֶתֵּ֥ן לָבַֽז׃
verses.translit: lkhn khl'khlykh y'khlv vkhltsrykh khlm bshby ylkhv vhyv sh'sykh lmshsh vkhlbzzykh 'tn lbz
verses.translation: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured, And all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; And they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, And all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ אַעֲלֶ֨ה אֲרֻכָ֥ה לָ֛ךְ וּמִמַּכּוֹתַ֥יִךְ אֶרְפָּאֵ֖ךְ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֤י נִדָּחָה֙ קָ֣רְאוּ לָ֔ךְ צִיּ֣וֹן הִ֔יא דֹּרֵ֖שׁ אֵ֥ין לָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy ''lh 'rkhh lkh vmmkhvtykh 'rp'kh n'myhvh khy ndchh qr'v lkh tsyvn hy' drsh 'yn lh {s}
verses.translation: For I will restore health unto thee, And I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; Because they have called thee an outcast: ‘She is Zion, there is none that careth for her.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה הִנְנִי־שָׁב֙ שְׁבוּת֙ אׇהֳלֵ֣י יַֽעֲק֔וֹב וּמִשְׁכְּנֹתָ֖יו אֲרַחֵ֑ם וְנִבְנְתָ֥ה עִיר֙ עַל־תִּלָּ֔הּ וְאַרְמ֖וֹן עַל־מִשְׁפָּט֥וֹ יֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh hnnyshb shbvt 'hly y'qvb vmshkhntyv 'rchm vnbnth 'yr 'ltlh v'rmvn 'lmshptv yshb
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will turn the captivity of Jacob’s tents, And have compassion on his dwelling-places; And the city shall be builded upon her own mound, And the palace shall be inhabited upon its wonted place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֥א מֵהֶ֛ם תּוֹדָ֖ה וְק֣וֹל מְשַׂחֲקִ֑ים וְהִרְבִּתִים֙ וְלֹ֣א יִמְעָ֔טוּ וְהִכְבַּדְתִּ֖ים וְלֹ֥א יִצְעָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vyts' mhm tvdh vqvl mshchqym vhrbtym vl' ym'tv vhkhbdtym vl' yts'rv
verses.translation: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving And the voice of them that make merry; And I will multiply them, and they shall not be diminished, I will also increase them, and they shall not dwindle away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ בָנָיו֙ כְּקֶ֔דֶם וַעֲדָת֖וֹ לְפָנַ֣י תִּכּ֑וֹן וּפָ֣קַדְתִּ֔י עַ֖ל כׇּל־לֹחֲצָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhyv bnyv khqdm v'dtv lpny tkhvn vpqdty 'l khllchtsyv
verses.translation: Their children also shall be as aforetime, And their congregation shall be established before Me, And I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה אַדִּיר֜וֹ מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וּמֹֽשְׁלוֹ֙ מִקִּרְבּ֣וֹ יֵצֵ֔א וְהִקְרַבְתִּ֖יו וְנִגַּ֣שׁ אֵלָ֑י כִּי֩ מִ֨י הוּא־זֶ֜ה עָרַ֧ב אֶת־לִבּ֛וֹ לָגֶ֥שֶׁת אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'dyrv mmnv vmshlv mqrbv yts' vhqrbtyv vngsh 'ly khy my hv'zh 'rb 'tlbv lgsht 'ly n'myhvh
verses.translation: And their prince shall be of themselves, And their ruler shall proceed from the midst of them; And I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto Me; For who is he that hath pledged his heart To approach unto Me? saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִהְיִ֥יתֶם לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyytm ly l'm v'nkhy 'hyh lkhm l'lhym {s}
verses.translation: And ye shall be My people, and I will be your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה  סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה סַ֖עַר מִתְגּוֹרֵ֑ר עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל׃
verses.translit: hnh  s'rt yhvh chmh yts'h s'r mtgvrr 'l r'sh rsh'ym ychvl
verses.translation: Behold, a storm of the LORD is gone forth in fury, A sweeping storm; it shall whirl upon the head of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א יָשׁ֗וּב חֲרוֹן֙ אַף־יְהֹוָ֔ה עַד־עֲשֹׂת֥וֹ וְעַד־הֲקִימ֖וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑וֹ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: l' yshvb chrvn 'fyhvh 'd'shtv v'dhqymv mzmvt lbv b'chryt hymym ttbvnnv bh
verses.translation: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, Until He have executed, and till He have performed The purposes of His heart In the end of days ye shall consider it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶֽהְיֶה֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים לְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהֵ֖מָּה יִֽהְיוּ־לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b't hhy' n'myhvh 'hyh l'lhym lkhl mshpchvt yshr'l vhmh yhyvly l'm {s}
verses.translation: In those days, the word of the LORD, I will be unto thee a God, for all families of Israel, and they will be unto me a people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה מָצָ֥א חֵן֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר עַ֖ם שְׂרִ֣ידֵי חָ֑רֶב הָל֥וֹךְ לְהַרְגִּיע֖וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh mts' chn bmdbr 'm shrydy chrb hlvkh lhrgy'v yshr'l
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: The people that were left of the sword Have found grace in the wilderness, Even Israel, when I go to cause him to rest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵרָח֕וֹק יְהֹוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֣ה לִ֑י וְאַהֲבַ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ אֲהַבְתִּ֔יךְ עַל־כֵּ֖ן מְשַׁכְתִּ֥יךְ חָֽסֶד׃
verses.translit: mrchvq yhvh nr'h ly v'hbt 'vlm 'hbtykh 'lkhn mshkhtykh chsd
verses.translation: ’From afar the LORD appeared unto me.’ ’Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love; Therefore with affection have I drawn thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֤וֹד אֶבְנֵךְ֙ וְֽנִבְנֵ֔ית בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֚וֹד תַּעְדִּ֣י תֻפַּ֔יִךְ וְיָצָ֖את בִּמְח֥וֹל מְשַׂחֲקִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'vd 'bnkh vnbnyt btvlt yshr'l 'vd t'dy tpykh vyts't bmchvl mshchqym
verses.translation: Again will I build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel; Again shalt thou be adorned with thy tabrets, And shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֚וֹד תִּטְּעִ֣י כְרָמִ֔ים בְּהָרֵ֖י שֹֽׁמְר֑וֹן נָטְע֥וּ נֹטְעִ֖ים וְחִלֵּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'vd tt'y khrmym bhry shmrvn nt'v nt'ym vchllv
verses.translation: Again shalt thou plant vineyards upon the mountains of Samaria; The planters shall plant, and shall have the use thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֶשׁ־י֔וֹם קָרְא֥וּ נֹצְרִ֖ים בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם ק֚וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy yshyvm qr'v ntsrym bhr 'prym qvmv vn'lh tsyvn 'lyhvh 'lhynv {p}
verses.translation: For there shall be a day, That the watchmen shall call upon the mount Ephraim: Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion, Unto the LORD our God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה רׇנּ֤וּ לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ שִׂמְחָ֔ה וְצַהֲל֖וּ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם הַשְׁמִ֤יעוּ הַֽלְלוּ֙ וְאִמְר֔וּ הוֹשַׁ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ אֶֽת־עַמְּךָ֔ אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh rnv ly'qb shmchh vtshlv br'sh hgvym hshmy'v hllv v'mrv hvsh' yhvh 't'mkh 't sh'ryt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Sing with gladness for Jacob, And shout at the head of the nations; Announce ye, praise ye, and say: ‘O LORD, save Thy people, The remnant of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אוֹתָ֜ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֗וֹן וְקִבַּצְתִּים֮ מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־אָ֒רֶץ֒ בָּ֚ם עִוֵּ֣ר וּפִסֵּ֔חַ הָרָ֥ה וְיֹלֶ֖דֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו קָהָ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל יָשׁ֥וּבוּ הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: hnny mby' 'vtm m'rts tspvn vqbtstym myrkhty'rts bm 'vr vpsch hrh vyldt ychdv qhl gdvl yshvbv hnh
verses.translation: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, And gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, And with them the blind and the lame, The woman with child and her that travaileth with child together; A great company shall they return hither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּבְכִ֣י יָבֹ֗אוּ וּֽבְתַחֲנוּנִים֮ אֽוֹבִילֵם֒ אֽוֹלִיכֵם֙ אֶל־נַ֣חֲלֵי מַ֔יִם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יָשָׁ֔ר לֹ֥א יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ בָּ֑הּ כִּֽי־הָיִ֤יתִי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְאָ֔ב וְאֶפְרַ֖יִם בְּכֹ֥רִי הֽוּא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bbkhy yb'v vbtchnvnym 'vbylm 'vlykhm 'lnchly mym bdrkh yshr l' ykhshlv bh khyhyyty lyshr'l l'b v'prym bkhry hv' {p}
verses.translation: They shall come with weeping, And with supplications will I lead them; I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, In a straight way wherein they shall not stumble; For I am become a father to Israel, And Ephraim is My first-born.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְהַגִּ֥ידוּ בָאִיִּ֖ים מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק וְאִמְר֗וּ מְזָרֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְקַבְּצֶ֔נּוּ וּשְׁמָר֖וֹ כְּרֹעֶ֥ה עֶדְרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shm'v dbryhvh gvym vhgydv b'yym mmrchq v'mrv mzrh yshr'l yqbtsnv vshmrv khr'h 'drv
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, And declare it in the isles afar off, and say: ‘He that scattered Israel doth gather him, And keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־פָדָ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֑ב וּגְאָל֕וֹ מִיַּ֖ד חָזָ֥ק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khypdh yhvh 'ty'qb vg'lv myd chzq mmnv
verses.translation: For the LORD hath ransomed Jacob, And He redeemeth him from the hand of him that is stronger than he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֘אוּ֮ וְרִנְּנ֣וּ בִמְרוֹם־צִיּוֹן֒ וְנָהֲר֞וּ אֶל־ט֣וּב יְהֹוָ֗ה עַל־דָּגָן֙ וְעַל־תִּירֹ֣שׁ וְעַל־יִצְהָ֔ר וְעַל־בְּנֵי־צֹ֖אן וּבָקָ֑ר וְהָיְתָ֤ה נַפְשָׁם֙ כְּגַ֣ן רָוֶ֔ה וְלֹא־יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְדַאֲבָ֖ה עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vb'v vrnnv bmrvmtsyvn vnhrv 'ltvb yhvh 'ldgn v'ltyrsh v'lytshr v'lbnyts'n vbqr vhyth npshm khgn rvh vl'yvsypv ld'bh 'vd
verses.translation: And they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, And shall flow unto the goodness of the LORD, To the corn, and to the wine, and to the oil, And to the young of the flock and of the herd; And their soul shall be as a watered garden, And they shall not pine any more at all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז תִּשְׂמַ֤ח בְּתוּלָה֙ בְּמָח֔וֹל וּבַחֻרִ֥ים וּזְקֵנִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְהָפַכְתִּ֨י אֶבְלָ֤ם לְשָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְנִ֣חַמְתִּ֔ים וְשִׂמַּחְתִּ֖ים מִיגוֹנָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'z tshmch btvlh bmchvl vbchrym vzqnym ychdv vhpkhty 'blm lshshvn vnchmtym vshmchtym mygvnm
verses.translation: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, And the young men and the old together; For I will turn their mourning into joy, And will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרִוֵּיתִ֛י נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים דָּ֑שֶׁן וְעַמִּ֛י אֶת־טוּבִ֥י יִשְׂבָּ֖עוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vrvyty npsh hkhhnym dshn v'my 'ttvby yshb'v n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, And My people shall be satisfied with My goodness, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בְּרָמָ֤ה נִשְׁמָע֙ נְהִי֙ בְּכִ֣י תַמְרוּרִ֔ים רָחֵ֖ל מְבַכָּ֣ה עַל־בָּנֶ֑יהָ מֵאֲנָ֛ה לְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־בָּנֶ֖יהָ כִּ֥י אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh qvl brmh nshm' nhy bkhy tmrvrym rchl mbkhh 'lbnyh m'nh lhnchm 'lbnyh khy 'ynnv {s}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: A voice is heard in Ramah, Lamentation, and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children; She refuseth to be comforted for her children, Because they are not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה מִנְעִ֤י קוֹלֵךְ֙ מִבֶּ֔כִי וְעֵינַ֖יִךְ מִדִּמְעָ֑ה כִּי֩ יֵ֨שׁ שָׂכָ֤ר לִפְעֻלָּתֵךְ֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְשָׁ֖בוּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh mn'y qvlkh mbkhy v'ynykh mdm'h khy ysh shkhr lp'ltkh n'myhvh vshbv m'rts 'vyb
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Refrain thy voice from weeping, And thine eyes from tears; For thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; And they shall come back from the land of the enemy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵשׁ־תִּקְוָ֥ה לְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְשָׁ֥בוּ בָנִ֖ים לִגְבוּלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshtqvh l'chrytkh n'myhvh vshbv bnym lgbvlm
verses.translation: And there is hope for thy future, saith the LORD; And thy children shall return to their own border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמ֣וֹעַ שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ מִתְנוֹדֵ֔ד יִסַּרְתַּ֙נִי֙ וָֽאִוָּסֵ֔ר כְּעֵ֖גֶל לֹ֣א לֻמָּ֑ד הֲשִׁבֵ֣נִי וְאָשׁ֔וּבָה כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: shmv' shm'ty 'prym mtnvdd ysrtny v'vsr kh'gl l' lmd hshbny v'shvbh khy 'th yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself: ‘Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, As a calf untrained; Turn thou me, and I shall be turned, For Thou art the LORD my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַחֲרֵ֤י שׁוּבִי֙ נִחַ֔מְתִּי וְאַֽחֲרֵי֙ הִוָּ֣דְעִ֔י סָפַ֖קְתִּי עַל־יָרֵ֑ךְ בֹּ֚שְׁתִּי וְגַם־נִכְלַ֔מְתִּי כִּ֥י נָשָׂ֖אתִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נְעוּרָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'chry shvby nchmty v'chry hvd'y spqty 'lyrkh bshty vgmnkhlmty khy nsh'ty chrpt n'vry
verses.translation: Surely after that I was turned, I repented, And after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh; I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, Because I did bear the reproach of my youth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲבֵן֩ יַקִּ֨יר לִ֜י אֶפְרַ֗יִם אִ֚ם יֶ֣לֶד שַׁעֲשֻׁעִ֔ים כִּֽי־מִדֵּ֤י דַבְּרִי֙ בּ֔וֹ זָכֹ֥ר אֶזְכְּרֶ֖נּוּ ע֑וֹד עַל־כֵּ֗ן הָמ֤וּ מֵעַי֙ ל֔וֹ רַחֵ֥ם אֲֽרַחֲמֶ֖נּוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hbn yqyr ly 'prym 'm yld sh'sh'ym khymdy dbry bv zkhr 'zkhrnv 'vd 'lkhn hmv m'y lv rchm 'rchmnv n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: Is Ephraim a darling son unto Me? Is he a child that is dandled? For as often as I speak of him, I do earnestly remember him still; Therefore My heart yearneth for him, I will surely have compassion upon him, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצִּ֧יבִי לָ֣ךְ צִיֻּנִ֗ים שִׂ֤מִי לָךְ֙ תַּמְרוּרִ֔ים שִׁ֣תִי לִבֵּ֔ךְ לַֽמְסִלָּ֖ה דֶּ֣רֶךְ (הלכתי) [הָלָ֑כְתְּ] שׁ֚וּבִי בְּתוּלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֻׁ֖בִי אֶל־עָרַ֥יִךְ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: htsyby lkh tsynym shmy lkh tmrvrym shty lbkh lmslh drkh (hlkhty) [hlkht] shvby btvlt yshr'l shby 'l'rykh 'lh
verses.translation: Set thee up waymarks, Make thee guide-posts; Set thy heart toward the high-way, Even the way by which thou wentest; Return, O virgin of Israel, Return to these thy cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־מָתַי֙ תִּתְחַמָּקִ֔ין הַבַּ֖ת הַשּֽׁוֹבֵבָ֑ה כִּֽי־בָרָ֨א יְהֹוָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ נְקֵבָ֖ה תְּס֥וֹבֵֽב גָּֽבֶר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'dmty ttchmqyn hbt hshvbbh khybr' yhvh chdshh b'rts nqbh tsvbb gbr {p}
verses.translation: How long wilt thou turn away coyly, O thou backsliding daughter? For the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth: A woman shall court a man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ע֣וֹד יֹאמְר֞וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה בְּאֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְעָרָ֔יו בְּשׁוּבִ֖י אֶת־שְׁבוּתָ֑ם יְבָרֶכְךָ֧ יְהֹוָ֛ה נְוֵה־צֶ֖דֶק הַ֥ר הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'vd y'mrv 'thdbr hzh b'rts yhvdh vb'ryv bshvby 'tshbvtm ybrkhkh yhvh nvhtsdq hr hqdsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Yet again shall they use this speech In the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, When I shall turn their captivity: ‘The LORD bless thee, O habitation of righteousness, O mountain of holiness.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ בָ֛הּ יְהוּדָ֥ה וְכׇל־עָרָ֖יו יַחְדָּ֑ו אִכָּרִ֕ים וְנָסְע֖וּ בַּעֵֽדֶר׃
verses.translit: vyshbv bh yhvdh vkhl'ryv ychdv 'khrym vns'v b'dr
verses.translation: And Judah and all the cities thereof Shall dwell therein together: The husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י הִרְוֵ֖יתִי נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲיֵפָ֑ה וְכׇל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ דָּאֲבָ֖ה מִלֵּֽאתִי׃
verses.translit: khy hrvyty npsh 'yph vkhlnpsh d'bh ml'ty
verses.translation: For I have satiated the weary soul, And every pining soul have I replenished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־זֹ֖את הֱקִיצֹ֣תִי וָאֶרְאֶ֑ה וּשְׁנָתִ֖י עָ֥רְבָה לִּֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lz't hqytsty v'r'h vshnty 'rbh ly {s}
verses.translation: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; And my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְזָרַעְתִּ֗י אֶת־בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה זֶ֥רַע אָדָ֖ם וְזֶ֥רַע בְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'myhvh vzr'ty 'tbyt yshr'l v'tbyt yhvdh zr' 'dm vzr' bhmh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר שָׁקַ֣דְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לִנְת֧וֹשׁ וְלִנְת֛וֹץ וְלַהֲרֹ֖ס וּלְהַאֲבִ֣יד וּלְהָרֵ֑עַ כֵּ֣ן אֶשְׁקֹ֧ד עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לִבְנ֥וֹת וְלִנְטֹ֖עַ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr shqdty 'lyhm lntvsh vlntvts vlhrs vlh'byd vlhr' khn 'shqd 'lyhm lbnvt vlnt' n'myhvh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down, and to overthrow and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them to build and to plant, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם לֹא־יֹאמְר֣וּ ע֔וֹד אָב֖וֹת אָ֣כְלוּ בֹ֑סֶר וְשִׁנֵּ֥י בָנִ֖ים תִּקְהֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: bymym hhm l'y'mrv 'vd 'bvt 'khlv bsr vshny bnym tqhynh
verses.translation: In those days they shall say no more: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִם־אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנ֖וֹ יָמ֑וּת כׇּל־הָֽאָדָ֛ם הָאֹכֵ֥ל הַבֹּ֖סֶר תִּקְהֶ֥ינָה שִׁנָּֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'm'ysh b'vnv ymvt khlh'dm h'khl hbsr tqhynh shnyv {s}
verses.translation: But every one shall die for his own iniquity; every man that eateth the sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכָרַתִּ֗י אֶת־בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּרִ֥ית חֲדָשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'myhvh vkhrty 'tbyt yshr'l v'tbyt yhvdh bryt chdshh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א כַבְּרִ֗ית אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־אֲבוֹתָ֔ם בְּיוֹם֙ הֶחֱזִיקִ֣י בְיָדָ֔ם לְהוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֜מָּה הֵפֵ֣רוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֗י וְאָנֹכִ֛י בָּעַ֥לְתִּי בָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l' khbryt 'shr khrty 't'bvtm byvm hchzyqy bydm lhvtsy'm m'rts mtsrym 'shrhmh hprv 'tbryty v'nkhy b'lty bm n'myhvh
verses.translation: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; forasmuch as they broke My covenant, although I was a lord over them, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י זֹ֣את הַבְּרִ֡ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶכְרֹת֩ אֶת־בֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אַחֲרֵ֨י הַיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה נָתַ֤תִּי אֶת־תּֽוֹרָתִי֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔ם וְעַל־לִבָּ֖ם אֶכְתְּבֶ֑נָּה וְהָיִ֤יתִי לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵ֖מָּה יִֽהְיוּ־לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy z't hbryt 'shr 'khrt 'tbyt yshr'l 'chry hymym hhm n'myhvh ntty 'ttvrty bqrbm v'llbm 'khtbnh vhyyty lhm l'lhym vhmh yhyvly l'm
verses.translation: But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the LORD, I will put My law in their inward parts, and in their heart will I write it; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֧א יְלַמְּד֣וּ ע֗וֹד אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֜הוּ וְאִ֤ישׁ אֶת־אָחִיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דְּע֖וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּֽי־כוּלָּם֩ יֵדְע֨וּ אוֹתִ֜י לְמִקְּטַנָּ֤ם וְעַד־גְּדוֹלָם֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֤י אֶסְלַח֙ לַֽעֲוֺנָ֔ם וּלְחַטָּאתָ֖ם לֹ֥א אֶזְכָּר־עֽוֹד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl' ylmdv 'vd 'ysh 'tr'hv v'ysh 't'chyv l'mr d'v 'tyhvh khykhvlm yd'v 'vty lmqtnm v'dgdvlm n'myhvh khy 'slch l'vnm vlcht'tm l' 'zkhr'vd {s}
verses.translation: and they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying: ‘Know the LORD’; for they shall all know Me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD; for I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin will I remember no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה נֹתֵ֥ן שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ לְא֣וֹר יוֹמָ֔ם חֻקֹּ֛ת יָרֵ֥חַ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים לְא֣וֹר לָ֑יְלָה רֹגַ֤ע הַיָּם֙ וַיֶּהֱמ֣וּ גַלָּ֔יו יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh ntn shmsh l'vr yvmm chqt yrch vkhvkhbym l'vr lylh rg' hym vyhmv glyv yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD, Who giveth the sun for a light by day, And the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, Who stirreth up the sea, that the waves thereof roar, The LORD of hosts is His name:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יָמֻ֜שׁוּ הַחֻקִּ֥ים הָאֵ֛לֶּה מִלְּפָנַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה גַּם֩ זֶ֨רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל יִשְׁבְּת֗וּ מִהְי֥וֹת גּ֛וֹי לְפָנַ֖י כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mymshv hchqym h'lh mlpny n'myhvh gm zr' yshr'l yshbtv mhyvt gvy lpny khlhymym {s}
verses.translation: If these ordinances depart from before Me, Saith the LORD, Then the seed of Israel also shall cease From being a nation before Me for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אִם־יִמַּ֤דּוּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִלְמַ֔עְלָה וְיֵחָקְר֥וּ מוֹסְדֵי־אֶ֖רֶץ לְמָ֑טָּה גַּם־אֲנִ֞י אֶמְאַ֨ס בְּכׇל־זֶ֧רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַֽל־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh 'mymdv shmym mlm'lh vychqrv mvsdy'rts lmth gm'ny 'm's bkhlzr' yshr'l 'lkhl'shr 'shv n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: If heaven above can be measured, And the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, Then will I also cast off all the seed of Israel For all that they have done, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים [בָּאִ֖ים] נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְנִבְנְתָ֤ה הָעִיר֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה מִמִּגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵ֖ל שַׁ֥עַר הַפִּנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh ymym [b'ym] n'myhvh vnbnth h'yr lyhvh mmgdl chnn'l sh'r hpnh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֨א ע֜וֹד (קוה) [קָ֤ו] הַמִּדָּה֙ נֶגְדּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל גִּבְעַ֣ת גָּרֵ֑ב וְנָסַ֖ב גֹּעָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'vd (qvh) [qv] hmdh ngdv 'l gb't grb vnsb g'th
verses.translation: And the measuring line shall yet go out straight forward unto the hill Gareb, and shall turn about unto Goah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הָעֵ֣מֶק הַפְּגָרִ֣ים ׀ וְהַדֶּ֡שֶׁן וְכׇֽל־[הַשְּׁדֵמוֹת֩] (השרמות) עַד־נַ֨חַל קִדְר֜וֹן עַד־פִּנַּ֨ת שַׁ֤עַר הַסּוּסִים֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהֹוָ֑ה לֹא־יִנָּתֵ֧שׁ וְֽלֹא־יֵהָרֵ֛ס ע֖וֹד לְעוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhlh'mq hpgrym  vhdshn vkhl[hshdmvt] (hshrmvt) 'dnchl qdrvn 'dpnt sh'r hsvsym mzrchh qdsh lyhvh l'yntsh vl'yhrs 'vd l'vlm {p}
verses.translation: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֤ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה (בשנת) [בַּשָּׁנָה֙] הָעֲשִׂרִ֔ית לְצִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הִ֧יא הַשָּׁנָ֛ה שְׁמֹנֶֽה־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לִנְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּֽר׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shrhyh 'lyrmyhv m't yhvh (bshnt) [bshnh] h'shryt ltsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh hy' hshnh shmnh'shrh shnh lnbvkhdr'tsr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֗ז חֵ֚יל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְיִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא הָיָ֤ה כָלוּא֙ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּֽית־מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'z chyl mlkh bbl tsrym 'lyrvshl͏m vyrmyhv hnby' hyh khlv' bchtsr hmtrh 'shr bytmlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem; and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כְּלָא֔וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּ֩וּעַ֩ אַתָּ֨ה נִבָּ֜א לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֜ן אֶת־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'shr khl'v tsdqyhv mlkhyhvdh l'mr mdv' 'th nb' l'mr khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 'th'yr hz't byd mlkhbbl vlkhdh
verses.translation: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying: ‘Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵ֖ט מִיַּ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י הִנָּתֹ֤ן יִנָּתֵן֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְדִבֶּר־פִּ֣יו עִם־פִּ֔יו וְעֵינָ֖יו אֶת־עֵינָ֥ו תִּרְאֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: vtsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh l' ymlt myd hkhshdym khy hntn yntn byd mlkhbbl vdbrpyv 'mpyv v'ynyv 't'ynv tr'ynh
verses.translation: and Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָבֶ֞ל יוֹלִ֤ךְ אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וְשָׁ֣ם יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַד־פׇּקְדִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֧י תִֽלָּחֲמ֛וּ אֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbbl yvlkh 'ttsdqyhv vshm yhyh 'dpqdy 'tv n'myhvh khy tlchmv 'thkhshdym l' ttslychv {p}
verses.translation: and he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I remember him, saith the LORD; though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv hyh dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And Jeremiah said: ‘The word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה חֲנַמְאֵ֗ל בֶּן־שַׁלֻּם֙ דֹּֽדְךָ֔ בָּ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר קְנֵ֣ה לְךָ֗ אֶת־שָׂדִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת כִּ֥י לְךָ֛ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה לִקְנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hnh chnm'l bnshlm ddkh b' 'lykh l'mr qnh lkh 'tshdy 'shr b'ntvt khy lkh mshpt hg'lh lqnvt
verses.translation: Behold, Hanamel, the son of Shallum thine uncle, shall come unto thee, saying: Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לַ֠י חֲנַמְאֵ֨ל בֶּן־דֹּדִ֜י כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהֹוָה֮ אֶל־חֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י קְנֵ֣ה נָ֠א אֶת־שָׂדִ֨י אֲשֶׁר־בַּעֲנָת֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר  בְּאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ין כִּֽי־לְךָ֞ מִשְׁפַּ֧ט הַיְרֻשָּׁ֛ה וּלְךָ֥ הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה קְנֵה־לָ֑ךְ וָאֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'ly chnm'l bnddy khdbr yhvh 'lchtsr hmtrh vy'mr 'ly qnh n' 'tshdy 'shrb'ntvt 'shr  b'rts bnymyn khylkh mshpt hyrshh vlkh hg'lh qnhlkh v'd' khy dbryhvh hv'
verses.translation: So Hanamel mine uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me: ‘Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself.’ Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶקְנֶה֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה מֵאֵ֛ת חֲנַמְאֵ֥ל בֶּן־דֹּדִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֑וֹת וָֽאֶשְׁקְלָה־לּוֹ֙ אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים וַעֲשָׂרָ֥ה הַכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: v'qnh 'thshdh m't chnm'l bnddy 'shr b'ntvt v'shqlhlv 'thkhsf shb'h shqlym v'shrh hkhsf
verses.translation: And I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel mine uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶכְתֹּ֤ב בַּסֵּ֙פֶר֙ וָֽאֶחְתֹּ֔ם וָאָעֵ֖ד עֵדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁקֹ֥ל הַכֶּ֖סֶף בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'khtb bspr v'chtm v''d 'dym v'shql hkhsf bm'znym
verses.translation: And I subscribed the deed, and sealed it, and called witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֖ח אֶת־סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה אֶת־הֶֽחָת֛וּם הַמִּצְוָ֥ה וְהַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־הַגָּלֽוּי׃
verses.translit: v'qch 'tspr hmqnh 'thchtvm hmtsvh vhchqym v'thglvy
verses.translation: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֞ן אֶת־הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֗ה אֶל־בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן־נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־מַחְסֵיָה֒ לְעֵינֵי֙ חֲנַמְאֵ֣ל דֹּדִ֔י וּלְעֵינֵי֙ הָֽעֵדִ֔ים הַכֹּתְבִ֖ים בְּסֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֑ה לְעֵינֵי֙ כׇּל־הַיְּהוּדִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tn 'thspr hmqnh 'lbrvkh bnnryh bnmchsyh l'yny chnm'l ddy vl'yny h'dym hkhtbym bspr hmqnh l'yny khlhyhvdym hyshbym bchtsr hmtrh
verses.translation: and I delivered the deed of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel mine uncle[‘s son], and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the guard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־בָּר֔וּךְ לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'tsvh 'tbrvkh l'ynyhm l'mr
verses.translation: And I charged Baruch before them, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָק֣וֹחַ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה אֵ֣ת סֵ֩פֶר֩ הַמִּקְנָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת הֶחָת֗וּם וְאֵ֨ת סֵ֤פֶר הַגָּלוּי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וּנְתַתָּ֖ם בִּכְלִי־חָ֑רֶשׂ לְמַ֥עַן יַעַמְד֖וּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l lqvch 'thsprym h'lh 't spr hmqnh hzh v't hchtvm v't spr hglvy hzh vnttm bkhlychrsh lm'n y'mdv ymym rbym {s}
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase, both that which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel; that they may continue many days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֣וֹד יִקָּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֛ים וְשָׂד֥וֹת וּכְרָמִ֖ים בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'vd yqnv btym vshdvt vkhrmym b'rts hz't {p}
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards shall yet again be bought in this land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֤י תִתִּי֙ אֶת־סֵ֣פֶר הַמִּקְנָ֔ה אֶל־בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן־נֵרִיָּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'tpll 'lyhvh 'chry tty 'tspr hmqnh 'lbrvkh bnnryh l'mr
verses.translation: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲהָהּ֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ הִנֵּ֣ה  אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֗יתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּכֹֽחֲךָ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה לֹֽא־יִפָּלֵ֥א מִמְּךָ֖ כׇּל־דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'hh 'dny yhvh hnh  'th 'shyt 'thshmym v'th'rts bkhchkh hgdvl vbzr'kh hntvyh l'ypl' mmkh khldbr
verses.translation: ’Ah Lord GOD! behold, Thou hast made the heaven and the earth by Thy great power and by Thy outstretched arm; there is nothing too hard for Thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמְשַׁלֵּם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֔וֹת אֶל־חֵ֥יק בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם הָאֵ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַגִּבּ֔וֹר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'shh chsd l'lpym vmshlm 'vn 'bvt 'lchyq bnyhm 'chryhm h'l hgdvl hgbvr yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: who showest mercy unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them; the great, the mighty God, the LORD of hosts is His name;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּדֹל֙ הָֽעֵצָ֔ה וְרַ֖ב הָעֲלִֽילִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־עֵינֶ֣יךָ פְקֻח֗וֹת עַל־כׇּל־דַּרְכֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְכִפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: gdl h'tsh vrb h'lylyh 'shr'ynykh pqchvt 'lkhldrkhy bny 'dm ltt l'ysh khdrkhyv vkhpry m'llyv
verses.translation: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men, to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֠מְתָּ אֹת֨וֹת וּמֹפְתִ֤ים בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבָאָדָ֑ם וַתַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shrshmt 'tvt vmptym b'rtsmtsrym 'dhyvm hzh vbyshr'l vb'dm vt'shhlkh shm khyvm hzh
verses.translation: who didst set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel and among other men; and madest Thee a name, as at this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּצֵ֛א אֶת־עַמְּךָ֥ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּאֹת֣וֹת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֗ים וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבְאֶזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָ֖א גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vtts' 't'mkh 'tyshr'l m'rts mtsrym b'tvt vbmvptym vbyd chzqh vb'zrv' ntvyh vbmvr' gdvl
verses.translation: and didst bring forth Thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vttn lhm 'th'rts hz't 'shrnshb't l'bvtm ltt lhm 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: and gavest them this land, which Thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֹתָ֗הּ וְלֹֽא־שָׁמְע֤וּ בְקוֹלֶ֙ךָ֙ (ובתרותך) [וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ֣] לֹא־הָלָ֔כוּ אֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֧יתָה לָהֶ֛ם לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לֹ֣א עָשׂ֑וּ וַתַּקְרֵ֣א אֹתָ֔ם אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vyb'v vyrshv 'th vl'shm'v bqvlkh (vbtrvtkh) [vbtvrtkh] l'hlkhv 't khl'shr tsvyth lhm l'shvt l' 'shv vtqr' 'tm 't khlhr'h hz't
verses.translation: and they came in, and possessed it; but they hearkened not to Thy voice, neither walked in Thy law; they have done nothing of all that Thou commandedst them to do; therefore Thou hast caused all this evil to befall them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה הַסֹּלְל֗וֹת בָּ֣אוּ הָעִיר֮ לְלׇכְדָהּ֒ וְהָעִ֣יר נִתְּנָ֗ה בְּיַ֤ד הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יהָ מִפְּנֵ֛י הַחֶ֥רֶב וְהָרָעָ֖ב וְהַדָּ֑בֶר וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתָּ הָיָ֖ה וְהִנְּךָ֥ רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh hsllvt b'v h'yr llkhdh vh'yr ntnh byd hkhshdym hnlchmym 'lyh mpny hchrb vhr'b vhdbr v'shr dbrt hyh vhnkh r'h
verses.translation: behold the mounds, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence; and what Thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, Thou seest it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ אֵלַי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה קְנֵֽה־לְךָ֧ הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִ֑ים וְהָעִ֥יר נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th 'mrt 'ly 'dny yhvh qnhlkh hshdh bkhsf vh'd 'dym vh'yr ntnh byd hkhshdym {s}
verses.translation: Yet Thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD: Buy thee the field for money, and call witnesses; whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'lyrmyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֑ר הֲֽמִמֶּ֔נִּי יִפָּלֵ֖א כׇּל־דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: hnh 'ny yhvh 'lhy khlbshr hmmny ypl' khldbr
verses.translation: ’Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh; is there any thing too hard for Me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ אֶת־הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֜את בְּיַ֣ד הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וּבְיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וּלְכָדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 'th'yr hz't byd hkhshdym vbyd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl vlkhdh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֣אוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֗ים הַנִּלְחָמִים֙ עַל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְהִצִּ֜יתוּ אֶת־הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את בָּאֵ֖שׁ וּשְׂרָפ֑וּהָ וְאֵ֣ת הַבָּתִּ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ קִטְּר֨וּ עַל־גַּגּוֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לַבַּ֗עַל וְהִסִּ֤כוּ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vb'v hkhshdym hnlchmym 'lh'yr hz't vhtsytv 'th'yr hz't b'sh vshrpvh v't hbtym 'shr qtrv 'lggvtyhm lb'l vhskhv nskhym l'lhym 'chrym lm'n hkh'sny
verses.translation: and the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set this city on fire, and burn it, with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered unto Baal, and poured out drink-offerings unto other gods, to provoke Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־הָי֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אַ֣ךְ עֹשִׂ֥ים הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י מִנְּעֻרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַ֣ךְ מַכְעִסִ֥ים אֹתִ֛י בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyhyv bnyyshr'l vbny yhvdh 'kh 'shym hr' b'yny mn'rtyhm khy bnyyshr'l 'kh mkh'sym 'ty bm'shh ydyhm n'myhvh
verses.translation: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done that which was evil in My sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked Me with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֧י עַל־אַפִּ֣י וְעַל־חֲמָתִ֗י הָ֤יְתָה לִּי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את לְמִן־הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לַהֲסִירָ֖הּ מֵעַ֥ל פָּנָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy 'l'py v'lchmty hyth ly h'yr hz't lmnhyvm 'shr bnv 'vth v'd hyvm hzh lhsyrh m'l pny
verses.translation: For this city hath been to Me a provocation of Mine anger and of My fury from the day that they built it even unto this day, that I should remove it from before My face;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל֩ כׇּל־רָעַ֨ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ לְהַכְעִסֵ֔נִי הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָׂרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִיאֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: 'l khlr't bnyyshr'l vbny yhvdh 'shr 'shv lhkh'sny hmh mlkhyhm shryhm khhnyhm vnby'yhm v'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke Me, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛י עֹ֖רֶף וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וְלַמֵּ֤ד אֹתָם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְלַמֵּ֔ד וְאֵינָ֥ם שֹׁמְעִ֖ים לָקַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃
verses.translit: vypnv 'ly 'rf vl' pnym vlmd 'tm hshkhm vlmd v'ynm shm'ym lqcht mvsr
verses.translation: And they have turned unto Me the back, and not the face; and though I taught them, teaching them betimes and often, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָֽא־שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshymv shqvtsyhm bbyt 'shrnqr'shmy 'lyv ltm'v
verses.translation: But they set their abominations in the house whereupon My name is called, to defile it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְנוּ֩ אֶת־בָּמ֨וֹת הַבַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֣ר  בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֗ם לְ֠הַעֲבִ֠יר אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם֮ לַמֹּ֒לֶךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־צִוִּיתִ֗ים וְלֹ֤א עָֽלְתָה֙ עַל־לִבִּ֔י לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַתּוֹעֵבָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לְמַ֖עַן הַחֲטִ֥י אֶת־יְהוּדָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vybnv 'tbmvt hb'l 'shr  bgy' bnhnm lh'byr 'tbnyhm v'tbnvtyhm lmlkh 'shr l'tsvytym vl' 'lth 'llby l'shvt htv'bh hz't lm'n hchty 'tyhvdh {s}
verses.translation: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to set apart their sons and their daughters unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into My mind, that they should do this abomination; to cause Judah to sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לָכֵ֛ן כֹּה־אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֣ר  אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים נִתְּנָה֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב וּבָרָעָ֥ב וּבַדָּֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: v'th lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'lh'yr hz't 'shr  'tm 'mrym ntnh byd mlkhbbl bchrb vbr'b vbdbr
verses.translation: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say: It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י מְקַבְּצָם֙ מִכׇּל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָׁ֛ם בְּאַפִּ֥י וּבַחֲמָתִ֖י וּבְקֶ֣צֶף גָּד֑וֹל וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִים֙ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהֹשַׁבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.translit: hnny mqbtsm mkhlh'rtsvt 'shr hdchtym shm b'py vbchmty vbqtsf gdvl vhshbtym 'lhmqvm hzh vhshbtym lbtch
verses.translation: Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries, whither I have driven them in Mine anger, and in My fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them back unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyv ly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: and they shall be My people, and I will be their God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֜ם לֵ֤ב אֶחָד֙ וְדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶחָ֔ד לְיִרְאָ֥ה אוֹתִ֖י כׇּל־הַיָּמִ֑ים לְט֣וֹב לָהֶ֔ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty lhm lb 'chd vdrkh 'chd lyr'h 'vty khlhymym ltvb lhm vlbnyhm 'chryhm
verses.translation: and I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear Me for ever; for the good of them, and of their children after them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־אָשׁוּב֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם לְהֵיטִיבִ֖י אוֹתָ֑ם וְאֶת־יִרְאָתִי֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֖י ס֥וּר מֵעָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt 'vlm 'shr l''shvb m'chryhm lhytyby 'vtm v'tyr'ty 'tn blbbm lblty svr m'ly
verses.translation: and I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; and I will put My fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְהֵטִ֣יב אוֹתָ֑ם וּנְטַעְתִּ֞ים בָּאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת בְּכׇל־לִבִּ֖י וּבְכׇל־נַפְשִֽׁי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshshty 'lyhm lhtyb 'vtm vnt'tym b'rts hz't b'mt bkhllby vbkhlnpshy {s}
verses.translation: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land in truth with My whole heart and with My whole soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶל־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֛ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֥ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את כֵּ֣ן אָנֹכִ֞י מֵבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khykhh 'mr yhvh kh'shr hb'ty 'lh'm hzh 't khlhr'h hgdvlh hz't khn 'nkhy mby' 'lyhm 'tkhlhtvbh 'shr 'nkhy dbr 'lyhm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִקְנָ֥ה הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את אֲשֶׁ֣ר  אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֗ים שְׁמָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ מֵאֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ וּבְהֵמָ֔ה נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַכַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vnqnh hshdh b'rts hz't 'shr  'tm 'mrym shmmh hy' m'yn 'dm vbhmh ntnh byd hkhshdym
verses.translation: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say: It is desolate, without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂד֞וֹת בַּכֶּ֣סֶף יִקְנ֗וּ וְכָת֨וֹב בַּסֵּ֥פֶר ׀ וְחָתוֹם֮ וְהָעֵ֣ד עֵדִים֒ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן וּבִסְבִיבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם וּבְעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וּבְעָרֵ֥י הַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י הַנֶּ֑גֶב כִּֽי־אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־שְׁבוּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shdvt bkhsf yqnv vkhtvb bspr  vchtvm vh'd 'dym b'rts bnymn vbsbyby yrvshl͏m vb'ry yhvdh vb'ry hhr vb'ry hshplh vb'ry hngb khy'shyb 'tshbvtm n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe the deeds, and seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the hill-country, and in the cities of the Lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.’
