verses.translation: Make ready buckler and shield, And draw near to battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִסְר֣וּ הַסּוּסִ֗ים וַֽעֲלוּ֙ הַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּכוֹבָעִ֑ים מִרְקוּ֙ הָרְמָחִ֔ים לִבְשׁ֖וּ הַסִּרְיֹנֹֽת׃
verses.translit: 'srv hsvsym v'lv hprshym vhtytsbv bkhvb'ym mrqv hrmchym lbshv hsrynt
verses.translation: Harness the horses, and mount, ye horsemen, And stand forth with your helmets; Furbish the spears, put on the coats of mail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַדּ֣וּעַ רָאִ֗יתִי הֵ֣מָּה חַתִּים֮ נְסֹגִ֣ים אָחוֹר֒ וְגִבּוֹרֵיהֶ֣ם יֻכַּ֔תּוּ וּמָנ֥וֹס נָ֖סוּ וְלֹ֣א הִפְנ֑וּ מָג֥וֹר מִסָּבִ֖יב נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mdv' r'yty hmh chtym nsgym 'chvr vgbvryhm ykhtv vmnvs nsv vl' hpnv mgvr msbyb n'myhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore do I see them dismayed and turned backward? And their mighty ones are beaten down, And they are fled apace, and look not back; Terror is on every side, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־יָנ֣וּס הַקַּ֔ל וְאַל־יִמָּלֵ֖ט הַגִּבּ֑וֹר צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ עַל־יַ֣ד נְהַר־פְּרָ֔ת כָּשְׁל֖וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lynvs hql v'lymlt hgbvr tspvnh 'lyd nhrprt khshlv vnplv
verses.translation: The swift cannot flee away, Nor the mighty man escape; In the north by the river Euphrates Have they stumbled and fallen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־זֶ֖ה כַּיְאֹ֣ר יַעֲלֶ֑ה כַּנְּהָר֕וֹת יִֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ מֵימָֽיו׃
verses.translit: myzh khy'r y'lh khnhrvt ytg'shv mymyv
verses.translation: Who is this like the Nile that riseth up, Like the rivers whose waters toss themselves?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ כַּיְאֹ֣ר יַעֲלֶ֔ה וְכַנְּהָר֖וֹת יִתְגֹּ֣עֲשׁוּ מָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַֽעֲלֶה֙ אֲכַסֶּה־אֶ֔רֶץ אֹבִ֥ידָה עִ֖יר וְיֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: mtsrym khy'r y'lh vkhnhrvt ytg'shv mym vy'mr ''lh 'khsh'rts 'bydh 'yr vyshby bh
verses.translation: Egypt is like the Nile that riseth up, And like the rivers whose waters toss themselves; And he saith: ‘I will rise up, I will cover the earth, I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲל֤וּ הַסּוּסִים֙ וְהִתְהֹלְל֣וּ הָרֶ֔כֶב וְיֵצְא֖וּ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֑ים כּ֤וּשׁ וּפוּט֙ תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י מָגֵ֔ן וְלוּדִ֕ים תֹּפְשֵׂ֖י דֹּ֥רְכֵי קָֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: 'lv hsvsym vhthllv hrkhb vyts'v hgbvrym khvsh vpvt tpshy mgn vlvdym tpshy drkhy qsht
verses.translation: Prance, ye horses, and rush madly, ye chariots; And let the mighty men go forth: Cush and Put, that handle the shield, And the Ludim, that handle and bend the bow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא לַֽאדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת י֤וֹם נְקָמָה֙ לְהִנָּקֵ֣ם מִצָּרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֥ה חֶ֙רֶב֙ וְשָׂ֣בְעָ֔ה וְרָוְתָ֖ה מִדָּמָ֑ם כִּ֣י זֶ֠בַח לַאדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּאֶ֥רֶץ צָפ֖וֹן אֶל־נְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃
verses.translit: vhyvm hhv' l'dny yhvh tsb'vt yvm nqmh lhnqm mtsryv v'khlh chrb vshb'h vrvth mdmm khy zbch l'dny yhvh tsb'vt b'rts tspvn 'lnhrprt
verses.translation: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall have on that day A day of vengeance, that He may avenge Him of His adversaries; And the sword shall devour and be satiate, And shall be made drunk with their blood; For the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice In the north country by the river Euphrates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲלִ֤י גִלְעָד֙ וּקְחִ֣י צֳרִ֔י בְּתוּלַ֖ת בַּת־מִצְרָ֑יִם לַשָּׁוְא֙ (הרביתי) [הִרְבֵּ֣ית] רְפֻא֔וֹת תְּעָלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'ly gl'd vqchy tsry btvlt btmtsrym lshv' (hrbyty) [hrbyt] rp'vt t'lh 'yn lkh
verses.translation: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin daughter of Egypt; In vain dost thou use many medicines; There is no cure for thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמְע֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ קְלוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְצִוְחָתֵ֖ךְ מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־גִבּ֤וֹר בְּגִבּוֹר֙ כָּשָׁ֔לוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו נָפְל֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shm'v gvym qlvnkh vtsvchtkh ml'h h'rts khygbvr bgbvr khshlv ychdyv nplv shnyhm {p}
verses.translation: The nations have heard of thy shame, And the earth is full of thy cry; For the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, They are fallen both of them together. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הַנָּבִ֑יא לָב֗וֹא נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל לְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'lyrmyhv hnby' lbv' nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl lhkhvt 't'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: The word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגִּ֤ידוּ בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וְהַשְׁמִ֣יעֽוּ בְמִגְדּ֔וֹל וְהַשְׁמִ֥יעוּ בְנֹ֖ף וּבְתַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס אִמְר֗וּ הִתְיַצֵּב֙ וְהָכֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־אָכְלָ֥ה חֶ֖רֶב סְבִיבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hgydv bmtsrym vhshmy'v bmgdvl vhshmy'v bnf vbtchpnchs 'mrv htytsb vhkhn lkh khy'khlh chrb sbybykh
verses.translation: Declare ye in Egypt, and announce in Migdol, And announce in Noph and in Tahpanhes; Say ye: ‘Stand forth, and prepare thee, For the sword hath devoured round about thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַדּ֖וּעַ נִסְחַ֣ף אַבִּירֶ֑יךָ לֹ֣א עָמַ֔ד כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה הֲדָפֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mdv' nschf 'byrykh l' 'md khy yhvh hdpv
verses.translation: Why is thy strong one overthrown? He stood not, because the LORD did thrust him down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְבָּ֖ה כּוֹשֵׁ֑ל גַּם־נָפַ֞ל אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֗הוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ ק֣וּמָה  וְנָשֻׁ֣בָה אֶל־עַמֵּ֗נוּ וְאֶל־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מוֹלַדְתֵּ֔נוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַיּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: hrbh khvshl gmnpl 'ysh 'lr'hv vy'mrv qvmh  vnshbh 'l'mnv v'l'rts mvldtnv mpny chrb hyvnh
verses.translation: He made many to stumble; Yea, they fell one upon another, And said: ‘Arise, and let us return to our own people, And to the land of our birth, From the oppressing sword.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ שָׁ֑ם פַּרְעֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ שָׁא֔וֹן הֶעֱבִ֖יר הַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: qr'v shm pr'h mlkhmtsrym sh'vn h'byr hmv'd
verses.translation: They cried there: ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; He hath let the appointed time pass by.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־אָ֙נִי֙ נְאֻם־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ כִּ֚י כְּתָב֣וֹר בֶּהָרִ֔ים וּכְכַרְמֶ֖ל בַּיָּ֥ם יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: chy'ny n'mhmlkh yhvh tsb'vt shmv khy khtbvr bhrym vkhkhrml bym ybv'
verses.translation: As I live, saith the King, Whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely like Tabor among the mountains, And like Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּי־נֹף֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְנִצְּתָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khly gvlh 'shy lkh yvshbt btmtsrym khynf lshmh thyh vntsth m'yn yvshb {s}
verses.translation: O thou daughter that dwellest in Egypt, Furnish thyself to go into captivity; For Noph shall become a desolation, And shall be laid waste, without inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶגְלָ֥ה יְפֵה־פִיָּ֖ה מִצְרָ֑יִם קֶ֥רֶץ מִצָּפ֖וֹן בָּ֥א בָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'glh yphpyh mtsrym qrts mtspvn b' b'
verses.translation: Egypt is a very fair heifer; But the gadfly out of the north is come, it is come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־שְׂכִרֶ֤יהָ בְקִרְבָּהּ֙ כְּעֶגְלֵ֣י מַרְבֵּ֔ק כִּֽי־גַם־הֵ֧מָּה הִפְנ֛וּ נָ֥סוּ יַחְדָּ֖יו לֹ֣א עָמָ֑דוּ כִּ֣י י֥וֹם אֵידָ֛ם בָּ֥א עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃
verses.translit: gmshkhryh bqrbh kh'gly mrbq khygmhmh hpnv nsv ychdyv l' 'mdv khy yvm 'ydm b' 'lyhm 't pqdtm
verses.translation: Also her mercenaries in the midst of her Are like calves of the stall, For they also are turned back, they are fled away together, They did not stand; For the day of their calamity is come upon them, The time of their visitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוֹלָ֖הּ כַּנָּחָ֣שׁ יֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־בְחַ֣יִל יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּבְקַרְדֻּמּוֹת֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔הּ כְּחֹטְבֵ֖י עֵצִֽים׃
verses.translit: qvlh khnchsh ylkh khybchyl ylkhv vbqrdmvt b'v lh khchtby 'tsym
verses.translation: The sound thereof shall go like the serpent’s; For they march with an army, And come against her with axes, As hewers of wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּרְת֤וּ יַעְרָהּ֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֖י לֹ֣א יֵחָקֵ֑ר כִּ֤י רַבּוּ֙ מֵֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין לָהֶ֖ם מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: khrtv y'rh n'myhvh khy l' ychqr khy rbv m'rbh v'yn lhm mspr
verses.translation: They cut down her forest, saith the LORD, Though it cannot be searched; Because they are more than the locusts, And are innumerable.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹבִ֖ישָׁה בַּת־מִצְרָ֑יִם נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד עַם־צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: hbyshh btmtsrym ntnh byd 'mtspvn
verses.translation: The daughter of Egypt is put to shame; She is delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֤י פוֹקֵד֙ אֶל־אָמ֣וֹן מִנֹּ֔א וְעַל־פַּרְעֹה֙ וְעַל־מִצְרַ֔יִם וְעַל־אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ וְעַל־מְלָכֶ֑יהָ וְעַ֨ל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְעַ֥ל הַבֹּטְחִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny pvqd 'l'mvn mn' v'lpr'h v'lmtsrym v'l'lhyh v'lmlkhyh v'lpr'h v'l hbtchym bv
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith: Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and them that trust in him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֗ים בְּיַד֙ מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֔ם וּבְיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל וּבְיַד־עֲבָדָ֑יו וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֛ן תִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן כִּֽימֵי־קֶ֖דֶם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnttym byd mbqshy npshm vbyd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl vbyd'bdyv v'chrykhn tshkhn khymyqdm n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: and I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants; and afterwards it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אַתָּ֠ה אַל־תִּירָ֞א עַבְדִּ֤י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ וְאַל־תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁעֲךָ֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וְאֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑ם וְשָׁ֧ב יַעֲק֛וֹב וְשָׁקַ֥ט וְשַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: v'th 'ltyr' 'bdy y'qb v'ltcht yshr'l khy hnny mvsh'kh mrchvq v'tzr'kh m'rts shbym vshb y'qvb vshqt vsh'nn v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: But fear not thou, O Jacob My servant, Neither be dismayed, O Israel; For, lo, I will save thee from afar, And thy seed from the land of their captivity; And Jacob shall again be quiet and at ease, And none shall make him afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֠תָּ֠ה אַל־תִּירָ֞א עַבְדִּ֤י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אִתְּךָ֖ אָ֑נִי כִּי֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה כָלָ֜ה בְּכׇֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֣ם  אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדַּחְתִּ֣יךָ שָּׁ֗מָּה וְאֹֽתְךָ֙ לֹא־אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה כָלָ֔ה וְיִסַּרְתִּ֙יךָ֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֥א אֲנַקֶּֽךָּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'th 'ltyr' 'bdy y'qb n'myhvh khy 'tkh 'ny khy ''shh khlh bkhlhgvym  'shr hdchtykh shmh v'tkh l'''shh khlh vysrtykh lmshpt vnqh l' 'nqkh {p}
verses.translation: Fear not thou, O Jacob My servant, saith the LORD, For I am with thee; For I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee, But I will not make a full end of thee; And I will correct thee in measure, But will not utterly destroy thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא אֶל־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים בְּטֶ֛רֶם יַכֶּ֥ה פַרְעֹ֖ה אֶת־עַזָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbryhvh 'lyrmyhv hnby' 'lplshtym btrm ykhh pr'h 't'zh
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה הִנֵּה־מַ֜יִם עֹלִ֤ים מִצָּפוֹן֙ וְהָיוּ֙ לְנַ֣חַל שׁוֹטֵ֔ף וְיִשְׁטְפוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֔הּ עִ֖יר וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְזָעֲקוּ֙ הָאָדָ֔ם וְהֵילִ֕ל כֹּ֖ל יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh hnhmym 'lym mtspvn vhyv lnchl shvtf vyshtpv 'rts vmlv'h 'yr vyshby bh vz'qv h'dm vhyll khl yvshb h'rts
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall become an overflowing stream, and they shall overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and them that dwell therein; and the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּ֗וֹל שַֽׁעֲטַת֙ פַּרְס֣וֹת אַבִּירָ֔יו מֵרַ֣עַשׁ לְרִכְבּ֔וֹ הֲמ֖וֹן גַּלְגִּלָּ֑יו לֹא־הִפְנ֤וּ אָבוֹת֙ אֶל־בָּנִ֔ים מֵרִפְי֖וֹן יָדָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: mqvl sh'tt prsvt 'byryv mr'sh lrkhbv hmvn glglyv l'hpnv 'bvt 'lbnym mrpyvn ydym
verses.translation: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers look not back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־הַיּ֗וֹם הַבָּא֙ לִשְׁד֣וֹד אֶת־כׇּל־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְהַכְרִ֤ית לְצֹר֙ וּלְצִיד֔וֹן כֹּ֖ל שָׂרִ֣יד עֹזֵ֑ר כִּֽי־שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים שְׁאֵרִ֖ית אִ֥י כַפְתּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: 'lhyvm hb' lshdvd 'tkhlplshtym lhkhryt ltsr vltsydvn khl shryd 'zr khyshdd yhvh 'tplshtym sh'ryt 'y khptvr
verses.translation: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Zidon every helper that remaineth; for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֤אָה קׇרְחָה֙ אֶל־עַזָּ֔ה נִדְמְתָ֥ה אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית עִמְקָ֑ם עַד־מָתַ֖י תִּתְגּוֹדָֽדִי׃
verses.translit: b'h qrchh 'l'zh ndmth 'shqlvn sh'ryt 'mqm 'dmty ttgvddy
verses.translation: Baldness is come upon Gaza, Ashkelon is brought to nought, the remnant of their valley; how long wilt thou cut thyself?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי חֶ֚רֶב לַיהֹוָ֔ה עַד־אָ֖נָה לֹ֣א תִשְׁקֹ֑טִי הֵאָֽסְפִי֙ אֶל־תַּעְרֵ֔ךְ הֵרָגְעִ֖י וָדֹֽמִּי׃
verses.translit: hvy chrb lyhvh 'd'nh l' tshqty h'spy 'lt'rkh hrg'y vdmy
verses.translation: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? Put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣יךְ תִּשְׁקֹ֔טִי וַיהֹוָ֖ה צִוָּה־לָ֑הּ אֶֽל־אַשְׁקְל֛וֹן וְאֶל־ח֥וֹף הַיָּ֖ם שָׁ֥ם יְעָדָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ykh tshqty vyhvh tsvhlh 'l'shqlvn v'lchvf hym shm y'dh {p}
verses.translation: How canst thou be quiet? For the LORD hath given it a charge; against Ashkelon, and against the sea-shore, there hath He appointed it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמוֹאָ֡ב כֹּה־אָמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וֹי אֶל־נְבוֹ֙ כִּ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔דָה הֹבִ֥ישָׁה נִלְכְּדָ֖ה קִרְיָתָ֑יִם הֹבִ֥ישָׁה הַמִּשְׂגָּ֖ב וָחָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: lmv'b khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hvy 'lnbv khy shddh hbyshh nlkhdh qrytym hbyshh hmshgb vchth
verses.translation: Of Moab. Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled; Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and dismayed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ רָעָ֔ה לְכ֖וּ וְנַכְרִיתֶ֣נָּה מִגּ֑וֹי גַּם־מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי אַחֲרַ֖יִךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: 'yn 'vd thlt mv'b bchshbvn chshbv 'lyh r'h lkhv vnkhrytnh mgvy gmmdmn tdmy 'chrykh tlkh chrb
verses.translation: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation.’ Thou also, O Madmen, shalt be brought to silence; the sword shall pursue thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֥וֹל צְעָקָ֖ה מֵחֹרוֹנָ֑יִם שֹׁ֖ד וָשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: qvl ts'qh mchrvnym shd vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: Hark! a cry from Horonaim, Spoiling and great destruction!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁמִ֥יעוּ זְּעָקָ֖ה (צעוריה) [צְעִירֶֽיהָ]׃
verses.translit: nshbrh mv'b hshmy'v z'qh (ts'vryh) [ts'yryh]
verses.translation: Moab is destroyed; Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה (הלחות) [הַלֻּחִ֔ית] בִּבְכִ֖י יַעֲלֶה־בֶּ֑כִי כִּ֚י בְּמוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צָרֵ֥י צַעֲקַת־שֶׁ֖בֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: khy m'lh (hlchvt) [hlchyt] bbkhy y'lhbkhy khy bmvrd chvrnym tsry ts'qtshbr shm'v
verses.translation: For by the ascent of Luhith With continual weeping shall they go up; For in the going down of Horonaim They have heard the distressing cry of destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֻ֖סוּ מַלְּט֣וּ נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וְתִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה כַּעֲרוֹעֵ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: nsv mltv npshkhm vthyynh kh'rv'r bmdbr
verses.translation: Flee, save your lives, And be like a tamarisk in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י יַ֣עַן בִּטְחֵ֤ךְ בְּמַעֲשַׂ֙יִךְ֙ וּבְא֣וֹצְרוֹתַ֔יִךְ גַּם־אַ֖תְּ תִּלָּכֵ֑דִי וְיָצָ֤א (כמיש) [כְמוֹשׁ֙] בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה כֹּהֲנָ֥יו וְשָׂרָ֖יו (יחד) [יַחְדָּֽיו]׃
verses.translit: khy y'n btchkh bm'shykh vb'vtsrvtykh gm't tlkhdy vyts' (khmysh) [khmvsh] bgvlh khhnyv vshryv (ychd) [ychdyv]
verses.translation: For, because thou hast trusted In thy works and in thy treasures, Thou also shalt be taken; And Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, His priests and his princes together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָבֹ֨א שֹׁדֵ֜ד אֶל־כׇּל־עִ֗יר וְעִיר֙ לֹ֣א תִמָּלֵ֔ט וְאָבַ֥ד הָעֵ֖מֶק וְנִשְׁמַ֣ד הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyb' shdd 'lkhl'yr v'yr l' tmlt v'bd h'mq vnshmd hmyshr 'shr 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, And no city shall escape; The valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; As the LORD hath spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּנוּ־צִ֣יץ לְמוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י נָצֹ֖א תֵּצֵ֑א וְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: tnvtsyts lmv'b khy nts' tts' v'ryh lshmh thyynh m'yn yvshb bhn
verses.translation: Give wings unto Moab, For she must fly and get away; And her cities shall become a desolation, Without any to dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָר֗וּר עֹשֶׂ֛ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת יְהֹוָ֖ה רְמִיָּ֑ה וְאָר֕וּר מֹנֵ֥עַ חַרְבּ֖וֹ מִדָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'rvr 'shh ml'kht yhvh rmyh v'rvr mn' chrbv mdm
verses.translation: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD with a slack hand, And cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁאֲנַ֨ן מוֹאָ֜ב מִנְּעוּרָ֗יו וְשֹׁקֵ֥ט הוּא֙ אֶל־שְׁמָרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־הוּרַ֤ק מִכְּלִי֙ אֶל־כֶּ֔לִי וּבַגּוֹלָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ עַל־כֵּ֗ן עָמַ֤ד טַעְמוֹ֙ בּ֔וֹ וְרֵיח֖וֹ לֹ֥א נָמָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: sh'nn mv'b mn'vryv vshqt hv' 'lshmryv vl'hvrq mkhly 'lkhly vbgvlh l' hlkh 'lkhn 'md t'mv bv vrychv l' nmr {s}
verses.translation: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, And he hath settled on his lees, And hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, Neither hath he gone into captivity; Therefore his taste remaineth in him, And his scent is not changed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ל֥וֹ צֹעִ֖ים וְצֵעֻ֑הוּ וְכֵלָ֣יו יָרִ֔יקוּ וְנִבְלֵיהֶ֖ם יְנַפֵּֽצוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnhymym b'ym n'myhvh vshlchtylv ts'ym vts'hv vkhlyv yryqv vnblyhm ynptsv
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, Saith the LORD, That I will send unto him them that tilt up, And they shall tilt him up; And they shall empty his vessels, And break their bottles in pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֹ֥שׁ מוֹאָ֖ב מִכְּמ֑וֹשׁ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־בֹּ֙שׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֵּ֥ית אֵ֖ל מִבְטֶחָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbsh mv'b mkhmvsh kh'shrbshv byt yshr'l mbyt 'l mbtchm
verses.translation: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, As the house of Israel was ashamed Of Beth-el their confidence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ תֹּֽאמְר֔וּ גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְאַנְשֵׁי־חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ykh t'mrv gbvrym 'nchnv v'nshychyl lmlchmh
verses.translation: How say ye: ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֻׁדַּ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ וְעָרֶ֣יהָ עָלָ֔ה וּמִבְחַ֥ר בַּחוּרָ֖יו יָרְד֣וּ לַטָּ֑בַח נְאֻ֨ם־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shdd mv'b v'ryh 'lh vmbchr bchvryv yrdv ltbch n'mhmlkh yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: Moab is spoiled, and they are gone up into her cities, And his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, Saith the King, Whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָר֥וֹב אֵיד־מוֹאָ֖ב לָב֑וֹא וְרָ֣עָת֔וֹ מִהֲרָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: qrvb 'ydmv'b lbv' vr'tv mhrh m'd
verses.translation: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֻ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ כׇּל־סְבִיבָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל יֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ אִמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֤ה נִשְׁבַּר֙ מַטֵּה־עֹ֔ז מַקֵּ֖ל תִּפְאָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: ndv lv khlsbybyv vkhl yd'y shmv 'mrv 'ykhh nshbr mth'z mql tp'rh
verses.translation: Bemoan him, all ye that are round about him, and all ye that know his name; Say: ‘How is the strong staff broken, The beautiful rod! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְדִ֤י מִכָּבוֹד֙ (ישבי) [וּשְׁבִ֣י] בַצָּמָ֔א יֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־דִּיב֑וֹן כִּֽי־שֹׁדֵ֤ד מוֹאָב֙ עָ֣לָה בָ֔ךְ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: rdy mkhbvd (yshby) [vshby] btsm' yshbt btdybvn khyshdd mv'b 'lh bkh shcht mbtsrykh
verses.translation: O thou daughter that dwellest in Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab is come up against thee, He hath destroyed thy strongholds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־דֶּ֛רֶךְ עִמְדִ֥י וְצַפִּ֖י יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת עֲרוֹעֵ֑ר שַׁאֲלִי־נָ֣ס וְנִמְלָ֔טָה אִמְרִ֖י מַה־נִּֽהְיָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: 'ldrkh 'mdy vtspy yvshbt 'rv'r sh'lyns vnmlth 'mry mhnhyth
verses.translation: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth; Say: ‘What hath been done?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹבִ֥ישׁ מוֹאָ֛ב כִּי־חַ֖תָּה (הילילי וזעקי) [הֵילִ֣ילוּ ׀ וּֽזְעָ֑קוּ] הַגִּ֣ידוּ בְאַרְנ֔וֹן כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: hbysh mv'b khychth (hylyly vz'qy) [hylylv  vz'qv] hgydv b'rnvn khy shdd mv'b
verses.translation: Moab is put to shame, for it is dismayed; wail and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט בָּ֖א אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֶל־חֹל֥וֹן וְאֶל־יַ֖הְצָה וְעַל־(מופעת) [מֵיפָֽעַת]׃
verses.translit: vmshpt b' 'l'rts hmyshr 'lchlvn v'lyhtsh v'l(mvp't) [myp't]
verses.translation: And judgment is come upon the country of the Plain; upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־דִּיב֣וֹן וְעַל־נְב֔וֹ וְעַל־בֵּ֖ית דִּבְלָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'ldybvn v'lnbv v'lbyt dbltym
verses.translation: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֧ל קִרְיָתַ֛יִם וְעַל־בֵּ֥ית גָּמ֖וּל וְעַל־בֵּ֥ית מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'l qrytym v'lbyt gmvl v'lbyt m'vn
verses.translation: and upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־קְרִיּ֖וֹת וְעַל־בׇּצְרָ֑ה וְעַ֗ל כׇּל־עָרֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב הָרְחֹק֖וֹת וְהַקְּרֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'lqryvt v'lbtsrh v'l khl'ry 'rts mv'b hrchqvt vhqrbvt
verses.translation: and upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִגְדְּעָה֙ קֶ֣רֶן מוֹאָ֔ב וּזְרֹע֖וֹ נִשְׁבָּ֑רָה נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: ngd'h qrn mv'b vzr'v nshbrh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: The horn of Moab is cut off, And his arm is broken, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְׁכִּירֻ֕הוּ כִּ֥י עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה הִגְדִּ֑יל וְסָפַ֤ק מוֹאָב֙ בְּקִיא֔וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לִשְׂחֹ֖ק גַּם־הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: hshkhyrhv khy 'lyhvh hgdyl vspq mv'b bqy'v vhyh lshchq gmhv'
verses.translation: Make ye him drunken, For he magnified himself against the LORD; And Moab shall wallow in his vomit, And he also shall be in derision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם  ל֣וֹא הַשְּׂחֹ֗ק הָיָ֤ה לְךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־בְּגַנָּבִ֖ים (נמצאה) [נִמְצָ֑א] כִּֽי־מִדֵּ֧י דְבָרֶ֛יךָ בּ֖וֹ תִּתְנוֹדָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'm  lv' hshchq hyh lkh yshr'l 'mbgnbym (nmts'h) [nmts'] khymdy dbrykh bv ttnvdd
verses.translation: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? Was he found among thieves? For as often as thou speakest of him, Thou waggest the head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִזְב֤וּ עָרִים֙ וְשִׁכְנ֣וּ בַסֶּ֔לַע יֹשְׁבֵ֖י מוֹאָ֑ב וִֽהְי֣וּ כְיוֹנָ֔ה תְּקַנֵּ֖ן בְּעֶבְרֵ֥י פִי־פָֽחַת׃
verses.translit: 'zbv 'rym vshkhnv bsl' yshby mv'b vhyv khyvnh tqnn b'bry pypcht
verses.translation: O ye that dwell in Moab, Leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; And be like the dove that maketh her nest In the sides of the pit’s mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּאֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד גׇּבְה֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ וְרֻ֥ם לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: shm'nv g'vnmv'b g'h m'd gbhv vg'vnv vg'vtv vrm lbv
verses.translation: We have heard of the pride of Moab; He is very proud; His loftiness, and his pride, and his haughtiness, And the assumption of his heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה עֶבְרָת֖וֹ וְלֹא־כֵ֑ן בַּדָּ֖יו לֹא־כֵ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ny yd'ty n'myhvh 'brtv vl'khn bdyv l'khn 'shv
verses.translation: I know his arrogancy, saith the LORD, That it is ill-founded; His boastings have wrought nothing well-founded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ עַל־מוֹאָ֣ב אֲיֵלִ֔יל וּלְמוֹאָ֥ב כֻּלֹּ֖ה אֶזְעָ֑ק אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י קִֽיר־חֶ֖רֶשׂ יֶהְגֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'lmv'b 'ylyl vlmv'b khlh 'z'q 'l'nshy qyrchrsh yhgh
verses.translation: Therefore will I wail for Moab; Yea, I will cry out for all Moab; For the men of Kir-heres shall my heart moan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִבְּכִ֨י יַעְזֵ֤ר אֶבְכֶּה־לָּךְ֙ הַגֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה נְטִישֹׁתַ֙יִךְ֙ עָ֣בְרוּ יָ֔ם עַ֛ד יָ֥ם יַעְזֵ֖ר נָגָ֑עוּ עַל־קֵיצֵ֥ךְ וְעַל־בְּצִירֵ֖ךְ שֹׁדֵ֥ד נָפָֽל׃
verses.translit: mbkhy y'zr 'bkhhlkh hgpn shbmh ntyshtykh 'brv ym 'd ym y'zr ng'v 'lqytskh v'lbtsyrkh shdd npl
verses.translation: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for thee, O vine of Sibmah; Thy branches passed over the sea, They reached even to the sea of Jazer; Upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage The spoiler is fallen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֶאֶסְפָ֨ה שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִ֛יל מִכַּרְמֶ֖ל וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב וְיַ֙יִן֙ מִיקָבִ֣ים הִשְׁבַּ֔תִּי לֹא־יִדְרֹ֣ךְ הֵידָ֔ד הֵידָ֖ד לֹ֥א הֵידָֽד׃
verses.translit: vn'sph shmchh vgyl mkhrml vm'rts mv'b vyyn myqbym hshbty l'ydrkh hydd hydd l' hydd
verses.translation: And gladness and joy is taken away From the fruitful field, and from the land of Moab; And I have caused wine to cease from the winepresses; None shall tread with shouting; The shouting shall be no shouting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזַּעֲקַ֨ת חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן עַד־אֶלְעָלֵ֗ה עַד־יַ֙הַץ֙ נָתְנ֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם מִצֹּ֙עַר֙ עַד־חֹ֣רֹנַ֔יִם עֶגְלַ֖ת שְׁלִֽשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֚י גַּם־מֵ֣י נִמְרִ֔ים לִמְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: mz'qt chshbvn 'd'l'lh 'dyhts ntnv qvlm mts'r 'dchrnym 'glt shlshyh khy gmmy nmrym lmshmvt yhyv
verses.translation: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, Even unto Jahaz have they uttered their voice, From Zoar even unto Horonaim, A heifer of three years old; For the Waters of Nimrim also Shall be desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י לְמוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה מַעֲלֶ֣ה בָמָ֔ה וּמַקְטִ֖יר לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhshbty lmv'b n'myhvh m'lh bmh vmqtyr l'lhyv
verses.translation: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, Saith the LORD, Him that offereth in the high place, And him that offereth to his gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֞ן לִבִּ֤י לְמוֹאָב֙ כַּחֲלִלִ֣ים יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְלִבִּי֙ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י קִֽיר־חֶ֔רֶשׂ כַּחֲלִילִ֖ים יֶהֱמֶ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֛ן יִתְרַ֥ת עָשָׂ֖ה אָבָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn lby lmv'b khchllym yhmh vlby 'l'nshy qyrchrsh khchlylym yhmh 'lkhn ytrt 'shh 'bdv
verses.translation: Therefore my heart moaneth for Moab Like pipes, and my heart moaneth like pipes for the men of Kir-heres; Therefore the abundance that he hath gotten is perished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י כׇל־רֹאשׁ֙ קׇרְחָ֔ה וְכׇל־זָקָ֖ן גְּרֻעָ֑ה עַ֤ל כׇּל־יָדַ֙יִם֙ גְּדֻדֹ֔ת וְעַל־מׇתְנַ֖יִם שָֽׂק׃
verses.translit: khy khlr'sh qrchh vkhlzqn gr'h 'l khlydym gddt v'lmtnym shq
verses.translation: For every head is bald, And every beard clipped; Upon all the hands are cuttings, And upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣ל כׇּל־גַּגּ֥וֹת מוֹאָ֛ב וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֖יהָ כֻּלֹּ֣ה מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּי־שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי אֶת־מוֹאָ֗ב כִּכְלִ֛י אֵֽין־חֵ֥פֶץ בּ֖וֹ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'l khlggvt mv'b vbrchbtyh khlh mspd khyshbrty 'tmv'b khkhly 'ynchpts bv n'myhvh
verses.translation: On all the housetops of Moab and in the broad places thereof There is lamentation every where; For I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥יךְ חַ֙תָּה֙ הֵילִ֔ילוּ אֵ֛יךְ הִפְנָה־עֹ֥רֶף מוֹאָ֖ב בּ֑וֹשׁ וְהָיָ֥ה מוֹאָ֛ב לִשְׂחֹ֥ק וְלִמְחִתָּ֖ה לְכׇל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ykh chth hylylv 'ykh hpnh'rf mv'b bvsh vhyh mv'b lshchq vlmchth lkhlsbybyv {s}
verses.translation: ’How is it broken down!’ wail ye! ‘How hath Moab turned the back with shame!’ So shall Moab become a derision and a dismay to all that are round about him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה כַנֶּ֖שֶׁר יִדְאֶ֑ה וּפָרַ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖יו אֶל־מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: khykhh 'mr yhvh hnh khnshr yd'h vprsh khnpyv 'lmv'b
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Behold, he shall swoop as a vulture, And shall spread out his wings against Moab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִלְכְּדָה֙ הַקְּרִיּ֔וֹת וְהַמְּצָד֖וֹת נִתְפָּ֑שָׂה וְֽ֠הָיָ֠ה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כְּלֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה׃
verses.translit: nlkhdh hqryvt vhmtsdvt ntpshh vhyh lb gbvry mv'b byvm hhv' khlb 'shh mtsrh
verses.translation: The cities are taken, And the strongholds are seized, And the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day Shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁמַ֥ד מוֹאָ֖ב מֵעָ֑ם כִּ֥י עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה הִגְדִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: vnshmd mv'b m'm khy 'lyhvh hgdyl
verses.translation: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, Because he hath magnified himself against the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֛יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב מוֹאָ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: pchd vpcht vpch 'lykh yvshb mv'b n'myhvh
verses.translation: Terror, and the pit, and the trap, Are upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (הניס) [הַנָּ֞ס] מִפְּנֵ֤י הַפַּ֙חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעֹלֶה֙ מִן־הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אָבִ֨יא אֵלֶ֧יהָ אֶל־מוֹאָ֛ב שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: (hnys) [hns] mpny hpchd ypl 'lhpcht vh'lh mnhpcht ylkhd bpch khy'by' 'lyh 'lmv'b shnt pqdtm n'myhvh
verses.translation: He that fleeth from the terror Shall fall into the pit; And he that getteth up out of the pit Shall be taken in the trap; For I will bring upon her, even upon Moab, The year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצֵ֥ל חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עָמְד֖וּ מִכֹּ֣חַ נָסִ֑ים כִּי־אֵ֞שׁ יָצָ֣א מֵחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן וְלֶהָבָה֙ מִבֵּ֣ין סִיח֔וֹן וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ פְּאַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְקׇדְקֹ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: btsl chshbvn 'mdv mkhch nsym khy'sh yts' mchshbvn vlhbh mbyn sychvn vt'khl p't mv'b vqdqd bny sh'vn
verses.translation: In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives Stand without strength; For a fire is gone forth out of Heshbon, And a flame from the midst of Sihon, And it devoureth the corner of Moab, And the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹי־לְךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב אָבַ֖ד עַם־כְּמ֑וֹשׁ כִּֽי־לֻקְּח֤וּ בָנֶ֙יךָ֙ בַּשֶּׁ֔בִי וּבְנֹתֶ֖יךָ בַּשִּׁבְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'vylkh mv'b 'bd 'mkhmvsh khylqchv bnykh bshby vbntykh bshbyh
verses.translation: Woe unto thee, O Moab! The people of Chemosh is undone; For thy sons are taken away captive, And thy daughters into captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּ֧י שְׁבוּת־מוֹאָ֛ב בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה עַד־הֵ֖נָּה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט מוֹאָֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshbty shbvtmv'b b'chryt hymym n'myhvh 'dhnh mshpt mv'b {s}
verses.translation: Yet will I turn the captivity of Moab In the end of days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֗וֹן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הֲבָנִ֥ים אֵין֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־יוֹרֵ֖שׁ אֵ֣ין ל֑וֹ מַדּ֗וּעַ יָרַ֤שׁ מַלְכָּם֙ אֶת־גָּ֔ד וְעַמּ֖וֹ בְּעָרָ֥יו יָשָֽׁב׃
verses.translit: lbny 'mvn khh 'mr yhvh hbnym 'yn lyshr'l 'myvrsh 'yn lv mdv' yrsh mlkhm 'tgd v'mv b'ryv yshb
verses.translation: Of the children of Ammon. Thus saith the LORD: Hath Israel no sons? Hath he no heir? Why then doth Malcam take possession of Gad, And his people dwell in the cities thereof?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֡ן הִנֵּה֩ יָמִ֨ים בָּאִ֜ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה וְ֠הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֠י אֶל־רַבַּ֨ת בְּנֵי־עַמּ֜וֹן תְּרוּעַ֣ת מִלְחָמָ֗ה וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְתֵ֣ל שְׁמָמָ֔ה וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ בָּאֵ֣שׁ תִּצַּ֑תְנָה וְיָרַ֧שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־יֹרְשָׁ֖יו אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'myhvh vhshm'ty 'lrbt bny'mvn trv't mlchmh vhyth ltl shmmh vbntyh b'sh ttstnh vyrsh yshr'l 'tyrshyv 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, That I will cause an alarm of war to be heard Against Rabbah of the children of Ammon; And it shall become a desolate mound, And her daughters shall be burned with fire; Then shall Israel dispossess them that did dispossess him, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵילִ֨ילִי חֶשְׁבּ֜וֹן כִּ֣י שֻׁדְּדָה־עַ֗י צְעַ֘קְנָה֮ בְּנ֣וֹת רַבָּה֒ חֲגֹ֣רְנָה שַׂקִּ֔ים סְפֹ֕דְנָה וְהִתְשׁוֹטַ֖טְנָה בַּגְּדֵר֑וֹת כִּ֤י מַלְכָּם֙ בַּגּוֹלָ֣ה יֵלֵ֔ךְ כֹּהֲנָ֥יו וְשָׂרָ֖יו יַחְדָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: hylyly chshbvn khy shddh'y ts'qnh bnvt rbh chgrnh shqym spdnh vhtshvttnh bgdrvt khy mlkhm bgvlh ylkh khhnyv vshryv ychdyv
verses.translation: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is undone; Cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; Lament, and run to and fro among the folds; For Malcam shall go into captivity, His priests and his princes together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תִּתְהַֽלְלִי֙ בָּעֲמָקִ֔ים זָ֣ב עִמְקֵ֔ךְ הַבַּ֖ת הַשּׁוֹבֵבָ֑ה הַבֹּֽטְחָה֙ בְּאֹ֣צְרֹתֶ֔יהָ מִ֖י יָב֥וֹא אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: mhtthlly b'mqym zb 'mqkh hbt hshvbbh hbtchh b'tsrtyh my ybv' 'ly
verses.translation: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, Thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? That didst trust in thy treasures: ‘Who shall come unto me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא עָלַ֜יִךְ פַּ֗חַד נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת מִכׇּל־סְבִיבָ֑יִךְ וְנִדַּחְתֶּם֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְפָנָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין מְקַבֵּ֖ץ לַנֹּדֵֽד׃
verses.translit: hnny mby' 'lykh pchd n'm'dny yhvh tsb'vt mkhlsbybykh vndchtm 'ysh lpnyv v'yn mqbts lndd
verses.translation: Behold, I will bring a terror upon thee, Saith the Lord GOD of hosts, From all that are round about thee; And ye shall be driven out every man right forth, And there shall be none to gather up him that wandereth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אָשִׁ֛יב אֶת־שְׁב֥וּת בְּנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'chrykhn 'shyb 'tshbvt bny'mvn n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶאֱד֗וֹם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הַאֵ֥ין ע֛וֹד חׇכְמָ֖ה בְּתֵימָ֑ן אָבְדָ֤ה עֵצָה֙ מִבָּנִ֔ים נִסְרְחָ֖ה חׇכְמָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: l'dvm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt h'yn 'vd chkhmh btymn 'bdh 'tsh mbnym nsrchh chkhmtm
verses.translation: Of Edom. Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Is wisdom no more in Teman? Is counsel perished from the prudent? Is their wisdom vanished?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֻ֤סוּ הׇפְנוּ֙ הֶעְמִ֣יקוּ לָשֶׁ֔בֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּדָ֑ן כִּ֣י אֵ֥יד עֵשָׂ֛ו הֵבֵ֥אתִי עָלָ֖יו עֵ֥ת פְּקַדְתִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: nsv hpnv h'myqv lshbt yshby ddn khy 'yd 'shv hb'ty 'lyv 't pqdtyv
verses.translation: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; For I do bring the calamity of Esau upon him, The time that I shall punish him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־בֹּֽצְרִים֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַשְׁאִ֖רוּ עוֹלֵל֑וֹת אִם־גַּנָּבִ֥ים בַּלַּ֖יְלָה הִשְׁחִ֥יתוּ דַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mbtsrym b'v lkh l' ysh'rv 'vllvt 'mgnbym blylh hshchytv dym
verses.translation: If grape-gatherers came to thee, Would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves by night, Would they not destroy till they had enough?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֲנִ֞י חָשַׂ֣פְתִּי אֶת־עֵשָׂ֗ו גִּלֵּ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־מִסְתָּרָ֔יו וְנֶחְבָּ֖ה לֹ֣א יוּכָ֑ל שֻׁדַּ֥ד זַרְע֛וֹ וְאֶחָ֥יו וּשְׁכֵנָ֖יו וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: khy'ny chshpty 't'shv glyty 'tmstryv vnchbh l' yvkhl shdd zr'v v'chyv vshkhnyv v'ynnv
verses.translation: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, And he shall not be able to hide himself; His seed is spoiled, and his brethren, And his neighbours, and he is not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עׇזְבָ֥ה יְתֹמֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֣י אֲחַיֶּ֑ה וְאַלְמְנוֹתֶ֖יךָ עָלַ֥י תִּבְטָֽחוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'zbh ytmykh 'ny 'chyh v'lmnvtykh 'ly tbtchv {s}
verses.translation: Leave thy fatherless children, I will rear them, And let thy widows trust in Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה הִ֠נֵּ֠ה אֲשֶׁר־אֵ֨ין מִשְׁפָּטָ֜ם לִשְׁתּ֤וֹת הַכּוֹס֙ שָׁת֣וֹ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ וְאַתָּ֣ה ה֔וּא נָקֹ֖ה תִּנָּקֶ֑ה לֹ֣א תִנָּקֶ֔ה כִּ֥י שָׁתֹ֖ה תִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khykhh  'mr yhvh hnh 'shr'yn mshptm lshtvt hkhvs shtv yshtv v'th hv' nqh tnqh l' tnqh khy shth tshth
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: Behold, they to whom it pertained not to drink of the cup shall assuredly drink; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י בִ֤י נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּֽי־לְשַׁמָּ֧ה לְחֶרְפָּ֛ה לְחֹ֥רֶב וְלִקְלָלָ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֣ה בׇצְרָ֑ה וְכׇל־עָרֶ֥יהָ תִהְיֶ֖ינָה לְחׇרְב֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy by nshb'ty n'myhvh khylshmh lchrph lchrb vlqllh thyh btsrh vkhl'ryh thyynh lchrbvt 'vlm
verses.translation: For I have sworn by Myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמוּעָ֤ה שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה וְצִ֖יר בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם שָׁל֑וּחַ הִֽתְקַבְּצוּ֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ עָלֶ֔יהָ וְק֖וּמוּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: shmv'h shm'ty m't yhvh vtsyr bgvym shlvch htqbtsv vb'v 'lyh vqvmv lmlchmh
verses.translation: I have heard a message from the LORD, And an ambassador is sent among the nations: ‘Gather yourselves together, and come against her, And rise up to the battle.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֥ה קָטֹ֛ן נְתַתִּ֖יךָ בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם בָּז֖וּי בָּאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: khyhnh qtn nttykh bgvym bzvy b'dm
verses.translation: For, behold, I make thee small among the nations, And despised among men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּֽפְלַצְתְּךָ֞ הִשִּׁ֤יא אֹתָךְ֙ זְד֣וֹן לִבֶּ֔ךָ שֹֽׁכְנִי֙ בְּחַגְוֵ֣י הַסֶּ֔לַע תֹּפְשִׂ֖י מְר֣וֹם גִּבְעָ֑ה כִּֽי־תַגְבִּ֤יהַּ כַּנֶּ֙שֶׁר֙ קִנֶּ֔ךָ מִשָּׁ֥ם אוֹרִֽידְךָ֖ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: tpltstkh hshy' 'tkh zdvn lbkh shkhny bchgvy hsl' tpshy mrvm gb'h khytgbyh khnshr qnkh mshm 'vrydkh n'myhvh
verses.translation: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, Even the pride of thy heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, That holdest the height of the hill; Though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה אֱד֖וֹם לְשַׁמָּ֑ה כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְיִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל־כׇּל־מַכּוֹתֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: vhyth 'dvm lshmh khl 'br 'lyh yshm vyshrq 'lkhlmkhvth
verses.translation: And Edom shall become an astonishment; Every one that passeth by it Shall be astonished and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּֽמַהְפֵּכַ֞ת סְדֹ֧ם וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וּשְׁכֵנֶ֖יהָ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹא־יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹא־יָג֥וּר בָּ֖הּ בֶּן־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: khmhpkht sdm v'mrh vshkhnyh 'mr yhvh l'yshb shm 'ysh vl'ygvr bh bn'dm
verses.translation: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah And the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD, No man shall abide there, Neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֠נֵּ֠ה כְּאַרְיֵ֞ה יַעֲלֶ֨ה מִגְּא֣וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן֮ אֶל־נְוֵ֣ה אֵיתָן֒ כִּֽי־אַרְגִּ֤יעָה אֲרִיצֶ֙נּוּ֙ מֵעָלֶ֔יהָ וּמִ֥י בָח֖וּר אֵלֶ֣יהָ אֶפְקֹ֑ד כִּ֣י מִ֤י כָמ֙וֹנִי֙ וּמִ֣י יֹעִידֶ֔נִּי וּמִי־זֶ֣ה רֹעֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד לְפָנָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnh kh'ryh y'lh mg'vn hyrdn 'lnvh 'ytn khy'rgy'h 'rytsnv m'lyh vmy bchvr 'lyh 'pqd khy my khmvny vmy y'ydny vmyzh r'h 'shr y'md lpny {s}
verses.translation: Behold, he shall come up like a lion From the thickets of the Jordan Against the strong habitation; For I will suddenly make him run away from it, And whoso is chosen, him will I appoint over it; For who is like Me? and who will appoint Me a time? And who is that shepherd that will stand before Me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן שִׁמְע֣וּ עֲצַת־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָעַץ֙ אֶל־אֱד֔וֹם וּמַ֨חְשְׁבוֹתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖ב אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י תֵימָ֑ן אִם־ל֤וֹא יִסְחָבוּם֙ צְעִירֵ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן אִם־לֹ֥א יַשִּׁ֛ים עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם נְוֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v 'tstyhvh 'shr y'ts 'l'dvm vmchshbvtyv 'shr chshb 'lyshby tymn 'mlv' yschbvm ts'yry hts'n 'ml' yshym 'lyhm nvhm
verses.translation: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, That He hath taken against Edom; And His purposes, that He hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall drag them away, Surely their habitation shall be appalled at them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּ֣וֹל נִפְלָ֔ם רָעֲשָׁ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ צְעָקָ֕ה בְּיַם־ס֖וּף נִשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: mqvl nplm r'shh h'rts ts'qh bymsvf nshm' qvlh
verses.translation: The earth quaketh at the noise of their fall; There is a cry, the noise whereof is heard in the Red Sea. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה כַנֶּ֙שֶׁר֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה וְיִדְאֶ֔ה וְיִפְרֹ֥שׂ כְּנָפָ֖יו עַל־בׇּצְרָ֑ה וְֽ֠הָיָ֠ה לֵ֞ב גִּבּוֹרֵ֤י אֱדוֹם֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כְּלֵ֖ב אִשָּׁ֥ה מְצֵרָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hnh khnshr y'lh vyd'h vyprsh khnpyv 'lbtsrh vhyh lb gbvry 'dvm byvm hhv' khlb 'shh mtsrh {p}
verses.translation: Behold, he shall come up and swoop down as the vulture, And spread out his wings against Bozrah; And the heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day Shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדַמֶּ֗שֶׂק בּ֤וֹשָֽׁה חֲמָת֙ וְאַרְפָּ֔ד כִּֽי־שְׁמֻעָ֥ה רָעָ֛ה שָׁמְע֖וּ נָמֹ֑גוּ בַּיָּ֣ם דְּאָגָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֖ט לֹ֥א יוּכָֽל׃
verses.translit: ldmshq bvshh chmt v'rpd khyshm'h r'h shm'v nmgv bym d'gh hshqt l' yvkhl
verses.translation: Of Damascus. Hamath is ashamed, and Arpad; For they have heard evil tidings, they are melted away; There is trouble in the sea; It cannot be quiet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָפְתָ֥ה דַמֶּ֛שֶׂק הִפְנְתָ֥ה לָנ֖וּס וְרֶ֣טֶט ׀ הֶחֱזִ֑יקָה צָרָ֧ה וַחֲבָלִ֛ים אֲחָזַ֖תָּה כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: rpth dmshq hpnth lnvs vrtt  hchzyqh tsrh vchblym 'chzth khyvldh
verses.translation: Damascus is waxed feeble, she turneth herself to flee, And trembling hath seized on her; Anguish and pangs have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥יךְ לֹֽא־עֻזְּבָ֖ה עִ֣יר (תהלה) [תְּהִלָּ֑ת] קִרְיַ֖ת מְשׂוֹשִֽׂי׃
verses.translit: 'ykh l''zbh 'yr (thlh) [thlt] qryt mshvshy
verses.translation: ’How is the city of praise left unrepaired, The city of my joy?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן יִפְּל֥וּ בַחוּרֶ֖יהָ בִּרְחֹבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְכׇל־אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַמִּלְחָמָ֤ה יִדַּ֙מּוּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: lkhn yplv bchvryh brchbtyh vkhl'nshy hmlchmh ydmv byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Therefore her young men shall fall in her broad places, And all the men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִצַּ֥תִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת דַּמָּ֑שֶׂק וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן־הֲדָֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhtsty 'sh bchvmt dmshq v'khlh 'rmnvt bnhdd {p}
verses.translation: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, And it shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְקֵדָ֣ר  וּֽלְמַמְלְכ֣וֹת חָצ֗וֹר אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִכָּה֙ (נבוכדראצור) [נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר] מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה ק֚וּמוּ עֲל֣וּ אֶל־קֵדָ֔ר וְשׇׁדְד֖וּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: lqdr  vlmmlkhvt chtsvr 'shr hkhh (nbvkhdr'tsvr) [nbvkhdr'tsr] mlkhbbl khh 'mr yhvh qvmv 'lv 'lqdr vshddv 'tbnyqdm
verses.translation: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote. Thus saith the LORD: Arise ye, go up against Kedar, And spoil the children of the east.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אׇהֳלֵיהֶ֤ם וְצֹאנָם֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ יְרִיעוֹתֵיהֶ֧ם וְכׇל־כְּלֵיהֶ֛ם וּגְמַלֵּיהֶ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וְקָרְא֧וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם מָג֖וֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: 'hlyhm vts'nm yqchv yry'vtyhm vkhlkhlyhm vgmlyhm ysh'v lhm vqr'v 'lyhm mgvr msbyb
verses.translation: Their tents and their flocks shall they take, They shall carry away for themselves their curtains, And all their vessels, and their camels; And they shall proclaim against them a terror on every side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֻ֩סוּ֩ נֻּ֨דוּ מְאֹ֜ד הֶעְמִ֧יקוּ לָשֶׁ֛בֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֥י חָצ֖וֹר נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּֽי־יָעַ֨ץ עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֤ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֙ עֵצָ֔ה וְחָשַׁ֥ב (עליהם) [עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם] מַחֲשָׁבָֽה׃
verses.translit: nsv ndv m'd h'myqv lshbt yshby chtsvr n'myhvh khyy'ts 'lykhm nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl 'tsh vchshb ('lyhm) ['lykhm] mchshbh
verses.translation: Flee ye, flit far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; For Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, And hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וּמֽוּ עֲל֗וּ אֶל־גּ֥וֹי שְׁלֵ֛יו יוֹשֵׁ֥ב לָבֶ֖טַח נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹא־דְלָתַ֧יִם וְלֹֽא־בְרִ֛יחַ ל֖וֹ בָּדָ֥ד יִשְׁכֹּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: qvmv 'lv 'lgvy shlyv yvshb lbtch n'myhvh l'dltym vl'brych lv bdd yshkhnv
verses.translation: Arise, get you up against a nation that is at ease, That dwelleth without care, saith the LORD; That have neither gates nor bars, That dwell alone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ גְמַלֵּיהֶ֜ם לָבַ֗ז וַהֲמ֤וֹן מִקְנֵיהֶם֙ לְשָׁלָ֔ל וְזֵרִתִ֥ים לְכׇל־ר֖וּחַ קְצוּצֵ֣י פֵאָ֑ה וּמִכׇּל־עֲבָרָ֛יו אָבִ֥יא אֶת־אֵידָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyv gmlyhm lbz vhmvn mqnyhm lshll vzrtym lkhlrvch qtsvtsy p'h vmkhl'bryv 'by' 't'ydm n'myhvh
verses.translation: And their camels shall be a booty, And the multitude of their cattle a spoil; And I will scatter unto all winds them that have the corners polled; And I will bring their calamity from every side of them, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֨ה חָצ֜וֹר לִמְע֥וֹן תַּנִּ֛ים שְׁמָמָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם לֹא־יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹא־יָג֥וּר בָּ֖הּ בֶּן־אָדָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyth chtsvr lm'vn tnym shmmh 'd'vlm l'yshb shm 'ysh vl'ygvr bh bn'dm {s}
verses.translation: And Hazor shall be a dwelling-place of jackals, A desolation for ever; no man shall abide there, Neither shall any son of man dwell therein. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא אֶל־עֵילָ֑ם בְּרֵאשִׁ֗ית מַלְכ֛וּת צִדְקִיָּ֥ה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbryhvh 'lyrmyhv hnby' 'l'ylm br'shyt mlkhvt tsdqyh mlkhyhvdh l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִ֥י שֹׁבֵ֖ר אֶת־קֶ֣שֶׁת עֵילָ֑ם רֵאשִׁ֖ית גְּבוּרָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny shbr 'tqsht 'ylm r'shyt gbvrtm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam The chief of their might.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י אֶל־עֵילָ֜ם אַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֗וֹת מֵֽאַרְבַּע֙ קְצ֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְזֵ֣רִתִ֔ים לְכֹ֖ל הָרֻח֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה הַגּ֔וֹי אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יָב֥וֹא שָׁ֖ם נִדְּחֵ֥י (עולם) [עֵילָֽם]׃
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'l'ylm 'rb' rvchvt m'rb' qtsvt hshmym vzrtym lkhl hrchvt h'lh vl'yhyh hgvy 'shr l'ybv' shm ndchy ('vlm) ['ylm]
verses.translation: And I will bring against Elam the four winds From the four quarters of heaven, And will scatter them toward all those winds; And there shall be no nation whither the dispersed of Elam shall not come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחְתַּתִּ֣י אֶת־עֵ֠ילָ֠ם לִפְנֵ֨י אֹיְבֵיהֶ֜ם וְלִפְנֵ֣י  מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵיהֶ֧ם ׀ רָעָ֛ה אֶת־חֲר֥וֹן אַפִּ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־הַחֶ֔רֶב עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתִ֖י אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhchtty 't'ylm lpny 'ybyhm vlpny  mbqshy npshm vhb'ty 'lyhm  r'h 'tchrvn 'py n'myhvh vshlchty 'chryhm 'thchrb 'd khlvty 'vtm
verses.translation: And I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, And before them that seek their life; And I will bring evil upon them, Even My fierce anger, saith the LORD; And I will send the sword after them, Till I have consumed them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י כִסְאִ֖י בְּעֵילָ֑ם וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֥י מִשָּׁ֛ם מֶ֥לֶךְ וְשָׂרִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmty khs'y b'ylm vh'bdty mshm mlkh vshrym n'myhvh
verses.translation: And I will set My throne in Elam, And will destroy from thence king and princes, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים (אשוב) [אָשִׁ֛יב] אֶת־[שְׁב֥וּת] (שבית) עֵילָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh  b'chryt hymym ('shvb) ['shyb] 't[shbvt] (shbyt) 'ylm n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: But it shall come to pass in the end of days, That I will bring back the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים בְּיַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'lbbl 'l'rts khshdym byd yrmyhv hnby'
verses.translation: The word that the LORD spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגִּ֨ידוּ בַגּוֹיִ֤ם וְהַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ וּֽשְׂאוּ־נֵ֔ס הַשְׁמִ֖יעוּ אַל־תְּכַחֵ֑דוּ אִמְרוּ֩ נִלְכְּדָ֨ה בָבֶ֜ל הֹבִ֥ישׁ בֵּל֙ חַ֣ת מְרֹדָ֔ךְ הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ עֲצַבֶּ֔יהָ חַ֖תּוּ גִּלּוּלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: hgydv bgvym vhshmy'v vsh'vns hshmy'v 'ltkhchdv 'mrv nlkhdh bbl hbysh bl cht mrdkh hbyshv 'tsbyh chtv glvlyh
verses.translation: Declare ye among the nations and announce, And set up a standard; Announce, and conceal not; Say: ‘Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed; Her images are put to shame, her idols are dismayed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עָלָה֩ עָלֶ֨יהָ גּ֜וֹי מִצָּפ֗וֹן הֽוּא־יָשִׁ֤ית אֶת־אַרְצָהּ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּ֑הּ מֵאָדָ֥ם וְעַד־בְּהֵמָ֖ה נָ֥דוּ הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'lh 'lyh gvy mtspvn hv'yshyt 't'rtsh lshmh vl'yhyh yvshb bh m'dm v'dbhmh ndv hlkhv
verses.translation: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, Which shall make her land desolate, And none shall dwell therein; They are fled, they are gone, both man and beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֨ים הָהֵ֜מָּה וּבָעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה יָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הֵ֥מָּה וּבְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו הָל֤וֹךְ וּבָכוֹ֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְאֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: bymym hhmh vb't hhy' n'myhvh yb'v bnyyshr'l hmh vbnyyhvdh ychdv hlvkh vbkhv ylkhv v'tyhvh 'lhyhm ybqshv
verses.translation: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, The children of Israel shall come, They and the children of Judah together; They shall go on their way weeping, And shall seek the LORD their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔לוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הֵ֣נָּה פְנֵיהֶ֑ם בֹּ֚אוּ וְנִלְו֣וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: tsyvn ysh'lv drkh hnh pnyhm b'v vnlvv 'lyhvh bryt 'vlm l' tshkhch
verses.translation: They shall inquire concerning Zion With their faces hitherward: ‘Come ye, and join yourselves to the LORD In an everlasting covenant that shall not be forgotten.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֹ֤אן אֹֽבְדוֹת֙ (היה) [הָי֣וּ] עַמִּ֔י רֹעֵיהֶ֣ם הִתְע֔וּם הָרִ֖ים (שובבים) [שׁוֹבְב֑וּם] מֵהַ֤ר אֶל־גִּבְעָה֙ הָלָ֔כוּ שָׁכְח֖וּ רִבְצָֽם׃
verses.translit: ts'n 'bdvt (hyh) [hyv] 'my r'yhm ht'vm hrym (shvbbym) [shvbbvm] mhr 'lgb'h hlkhv shkhchv rbtsm
verses.translation: My people hath been lost sheep; Their shepherds have caused them to go astray, They have turned them away on the mountains; They have gone from mountain to hill, They have forgotten their resting-place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מוֹצְאֵיהֶ֣ם אֲכָל֔וּם וְצָרֵיהֶ֥ם אָמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נֶאְשָׁ֑ם תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטְא֤וּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ נְוֵה־צֶ֔דֶק וּמִקְוֵ֥ה אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlmvts'yhm 'khlvm vtsryhm 'mrv l' n'shm tcht 'shr cht'v lyhvh nvhtsdq vmqvh 'bvtyhm yhvh {s}
verses.translation: All that found them have devoured them; And their adversaries said: ‘We are not guilty’; Because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, Even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֻ֚דוּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּמֵאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים (יצאו) [צֵ֑אוּ] וִֽהְי֕וּ כְּעַתּוּדִ֖ים לִפְנֵי־צֹֽאן׃
verses.translit: ndv mtvkh bbl vm'rts khshdym (yts'v) [ts'v] vhyv kh'tvdym lpnyts'n
verses.translation: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, And go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, And be as the he-goats before the flocks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֡י מֵעִיר֩ וּמַעֲלֶ֨ה עַל־בָּבֶ֜ל קְהַל־גּוֹיִ֤ם גְּדֹלִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וְעָ֣רְכוּ לָ֔הּ מִשָּׁ֖ם תִּלָּכֵ֑ד חִצָּיו֙ כְּגִבּ֣וֹר מַשְׁכִּ֔יל לֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy hnh 'nkhy m'yr vm'lh 'lbbl qhlgvym gdlym m'rts tspvn v'rkhv lh mshm tlkhd chtsyv khgbvr mshkhyl l' yshvb ryqm
verses.translation: For, lo, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon An assembly of great nations from the north country; And they shall set themselves in array against her, From thence she shall be taken; Their arrows shall be as of a mighty man that maketh childless; None shall return in vain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה כַשְׂדִּ֖ים לְשָׁלָ֑ל כׇּל־שֹׁלְלֶ֥יהָ יִשְׂבָּ֖עוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyth khshdym lshll khlshllyh yshb'v n'myhvh
verses.translation: And Chaldea shall be a spoil; All that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י (תשמחי) [תִשְׂמְחוּ֙] כִּ֣י (תעלזי) [תַעַלְז֔וּ] שֹׁסֵ֖י נַחֲלָתִ֑י כִּ֤י (תפושי) [תָפ֙וּשׁוּ֙] כְּעֶגְלָ֣ה דָשָׁ֔ה (ותצהלי) [וְתִצְהֲל֖וּ] כָּאַבִּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy (tshmchy) [tshmchv] khy (t'lzy) [t'lzv] shsy nchlty khy (tpvshy) [tpvshv] kh'glh dshh (vttshly) [vttshlv] kh'brym
verses.translation: Because ye are glad, because ye rejoice, O ye that plunder My heritage, Because ye gambol as a heifer at grass, And neigh as strong horses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּ֤וֹשָׁה אִמְּכֶם֙ מְאֹ֔ד חָפְרָ֖ה יוֹלַדְתְּכֶ֑ם הִנֵּה֙ אַחֲרִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם מִדְבָּ֖ר צִיָּ֥ה וַעֲרָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: bvshh 'mkhm m'd chprh yvldtkhm hnh 'chryt gvym mdbr tsyh v'rbh
verses.translation: Your mother shall be sore ashamed, She that bore you shall be confounded; Behold, the hindermost of the nations Shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקֶּ֤צֶף יְהֹוָה֙ לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֔ב וְהָיְתָ֥ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה כֻּלָּ֑הּ כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עַל־בָּבֶ֔ל יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְיִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל־כׇּל־מַכּוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: mqtsf yhvh l' tshb vhyth shmmh khlh khl 'br 'lbbl yshm vyshrq 'lkhlmkhvtyh
verses.translation: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, But it shall be wholly desolate; Every one that goeth by Babylon Shall be appalled and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִרְכ֨וּ עַל־בָּבֶ֤ל ׀ סָבִיב֙ כׇּל־דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת יְד֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ אַֽל־תַּחְמְל֖וּ אֶל־חֵ֑ץ כִּ֥י לַיהֹוָ֖ה חָטָֽאָה׃
verses.translit: 'rkhv 'lbbl  sbyb khldrkhy qsht ydv 'lyh 'ltchmlv 'lchts khy lyhvh cht'h
verses.translation: Set yourselves in array against Babylon round about, All ye that bend the bow, Shoot at her, spare no arrows; For she hath sinned against the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִ֨יעוּ עָלֶ֤יהָ סָבִיב֙ נָתְנָ֣ה יָדָ֔הּ נָֽפְלוּ֙ (אשויתיה) [אׇשְׁיוֹתֶ֔יהָ] נֶהֶרְס֖וּ חוֹמוֹתֶ֑יהָ כִּי֩ נִקְמַ֨ת יְהֹוָ֥ה הִיא֙ הִנָּ֣קְמוּ בָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ־לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hry'v 'lyh sbyb ntnh ydh nplv ('shvytyh) ['shyvtyh] nhrsv chvmvtyh khy nqmt yhvh hy' hnqmv bh kh'shr 'shth 'shvlh
verses.translation: Shout against her round about, she hath submitted herself; Her buttresses are fallen, her walls are thrown down; For it is the vengeance of the LORD, take vengeance upon her; As she hath done, do unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּרְת֤וּ זוֹרֵ֙עַ֙ מִבָּבֶ֔ל וְתֹפֵ֥שׂ מַגָּ֖ל בְּעֵ֣ת קָצִ֑יר מִפְּנֵי֙ חֶ֣רֶב הַיּוֹנָ֔ה אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־עַמּוֹ֙ יִפְנ֔וּ וְאִ֥ישׁ לְאַרְצ֖וֹ יָנֻֽסוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khrtv zvr' mbbl vtpsh mgl b't qtsyr mpny chrb hyvnh 'ysh 'l'mv ypnv v'ysh l'rtsv ynsv {s}
verses.translation: Cut off the sower from Babylon, And him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest; For fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, And they shall flee every one to his own land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׂ֧ה פְזוּרָ֛ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲרָי֣וֹת הִדִּ֑יחוּ הָרִאשׁ֤וֹן אֲכָלוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְזֶ֤ה הָאַֽחֲרוֹן֙ עִצְּמ֔וֹ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shh pzvrh yshr'l 'ryvt hdychv hr'shvn 'khlv mlkh 'shvr vzh h'chrvn 'tsmv nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl {p}
verses.translation: Israel is a scattered sheep, The lions have driven him away; First the king of Assyria hath devoured him, And last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֥י פֹקֵ֛ד אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְאֶל־אַרְצ֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny pqd 'lmlkh bbl v'l'rtsv kh'shr pqdty 'lmlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, As I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֤י אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־נָוֵ֔הוּ וְרָעָ֥ה הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל וְהַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּבְהַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֛יִם וְהַגִּלְעָ֖ד תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: vshbbty 'tyshr'l 'lnvhv vr'h hkhrml vhbshn vbhr 'prym vhgl'd tshb' npshv
verses.translation: And I will bring Israel back to his pasture, And he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, And his soul shall be satisfied upon the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֩ וּבָעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜יא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה יְבֻקַּ֞שׁ אֶת־עֲוֺ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְאֶת־חַטֹּ֥את יְהוּדָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִמָּצֶ֑אינָה כִּ֥י אֶסְלַ֖ח לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אַשְׁאִֽיר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bymym hhm vb't hhy' n'myhvh ybqsh 't'vn yshr'l v'ynnv v'tcht't yhvdh vl' tmts'ynh khy 'slch l'shr 'sh'yr {p}
verses.translation: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, The iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none, And the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found; For I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־הָאָ֤רֶץ מְרָתַ֙יִם֙ עֲלֵ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ וְאֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּק֑וֹד חֲרֹ֨ב וְהַחֲרֵ֤ם אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַעֲשֵׂ֕ה כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh'rts mrtym 'lh 'lyh v'lyvshby pqvd chrb vhchrm 'chryhm n'myhvh v'shh khkhl 'shr tsvytykh {s}
verses.translation: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, And against the inhabitants of Pekod; Waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, And do according to all that I have commanded thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֥וֹל מִלְחָמָ֖ה בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְשֶׁ֖בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: qvl mlchmh b'rts vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: Hark! battle is in the land, And great destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤יךְ נִגְדַּע֙ וַיִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר פַּטִּ֖ישׁ כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ykh ngd' vyshbr ptysh khlh'rts 'ykh hyth lshmh bbl bgvym
verses.translation: How is the hammer of the whole earth Cut asunder and broken! How is Babylon become A desolation among the nations!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָקֹ֨שְׁתִּי לָ֤ךְ וְגַם־נִלְכַּדְתְּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאַ֖תְּ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עַתְּ נִמְצֵאת֙ וְגַם־נִתְפַּ֔שְׂתְּ כִּ֥י בַיהֹוָ֖ה הִתְגָּרִֽית׃
verses.translit: yqshty lkh vgmnlkhdt bbl v't l' yd't nmts't vgmntpsht khy byhvh htgryt
verses.translation: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, And thou wast not aware; Thou art found, and also caught, Because thou hast striven against the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּתַ֤ח יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־א֣וֹצָר֔וֹ וַיּוֹצֵ֖א אֶת־כְּלֵ֣י זַעְמ֑וֹ כִּֽי־מְלָאכָ֣ה הִ֗יא לַאדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: ptch yhvh 't'vtsrv vyvts' 'tkhly z'mv khyml'khh hy' l'dny yhvh tsb'vt b'rts khshdym
verses.translation: The LORD hath opened His armoury, And hath brought forth the weapons of His indignation; For it is a work that the Lord GOD of hosts Hath to do in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּֽאוּ־לָ֤הּ מִקֵּץ֙ פִּתְח֣וּ מַאֲבֻסֶ֔יהָ סׇלּ֥וּהָ כְמֽוֹ־עֲרֵמִ֖ים וְהַחֲרִימ֑וּהָ אַל־תְּהִי־לָ֖הּ שְׁאֵרִֽית׃
verses.translit: b'vlh mqts ptchv m'bsyh slvh khmv'rmym vhchrymvh 'lthylh sh'ryt
verses.translation: Come against her from every quarter, open her granaries, Cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly; Let nothing of her be left.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִרְבוּ֙ כׇּל־פָּרֶ֔יהָ יֵרְד֖וּ לַטָּ֑בַח ה֣וֹי עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כִּי־בָ֥א יוֹמָ֖ם עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chrbv khlpryh yrdv ltbch hvy 'lyhm khyb' yvmm 't pqdtm {s}
verses.translation: Slay all her bullocks, let them go down to the slaughter; Woe unto them! for their day is come, The time of their visitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֥וֹל נָסִ֛ים וּפְלֵטִ֖ים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ בָּבֶ֑ל לְהַגִּ֣יד בְּצִיּ֗וֹן אֶת־נִקְמַת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: qvl nsym vpltym m'rts bbl lhgyd btsyvn 'tnqmt yhvh 'lhynv nqmt hykhlv
verses.translation: Hark! they flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, To declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, The vengeance of His temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶל־בָּבֶ֣ל ׀ רַ֠בִּ֠ים כׇּל־דֹּ֨רְכֵי קֶ֜שֶׁת חֲנ֧וּ עָלֶ֣יהָ סָבִ֗יב אַל־יְהִי־[לָהּ֙] פְּלֵיטָ֔ה שַׁלְּמוּ־לָ֣הּ כְּפׇעֳלָ֔הּ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ־לָ֑הּ כִּ֧י אֶל־יְהֹוָ֛ה זָ֖דָה אֶל־קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hshmy'v 'lbbl  rbym khldrkhy qsht chnv 'lyh sbyb 'lyhy[lh] plyth shlmvlh khp'lh khkhl 'shr 'shth 'shvlh khy 'lyhvh zdh 'lqdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Call together the archers against Babylon, All them that bend the bow; Encamp against her round about, Let none thereof escape; Recompense her according to her work, According to all that she hath done, do unto her: For she hath been arrogant against the LORD, Against the Holy One of Israel. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן יִפְּל֥וּ בַחוּרֶ֖יהָ בִּרְחֹבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְכׇל־אַנְשֵׁ֨י מִלְחַמְתָּ֥הּ יִדַּ֛מּוּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn yplv bchvryh brchbtyh vkhl'nshy mlchmth ydmv byvm hhv' n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: Therefore shall her young men fall in her broad places, And all her men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ זָד֔וֹן נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֛י בָּ֥א יוֹמְךָ֖ עֵ֥ת פְּקַדְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh zdvn n'm'dny yhvh tsb'vt khy b' yvmkh 't pqdtykh
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most arrogant, Saith the Lord GOD of hosts; For thy day is come, The time that I will punish thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָשַׁ֤ל זָדוֹן֙ וְנָפַ֔ל וְאֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ מֵקִ֑ים וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֖ה כׇּל־סְבִיבֹתָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhshl zdvn vnpl v'yn lv mqym vhtsty 'sh b'ryv v'khlh khlsbybtyv {s}
verses.translation: And the most arrogant shall stumble and fall, And none shall raise him up; And I will kindle a fire in his cities, And it shall devour all that are round about him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עֲשׁוּקִ֛ים בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל וּבְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו וְכׇל־שֹֽׁבֵיהֶם֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ בָ֔ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ שַׁלְּחָֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'shvqym bnyyshr'l vbnyyhvdh ychdv vkhlshbyhm hchzyqv bm m'nv shlchm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together; And all that took them captives hold them fast; They refuse to let them go.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּאֲלָ֣ם  חָזָ֗ק יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שְׁמ֔וֹ רִ֥יב יָרִ֖יב אֶת־רִיבָ֑ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעַ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְגִּ֖יז לְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: g'lm  chzq yhvh tsb'vt shmv ryb yryb 'trybm lm'n hrgy' 'th'rts vhrgyz lyshby bbl
verses.translation: Their Redeemer is strong, The LORD of hosts is His name; He will thoroughly plead their cause, That He may give rest to the earth, And disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֥רֶב עַל־כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְאֶל־שָׂרֶ֖יהָ וְאֶל־חֲכָמֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: chrb 'lkhshdym n'myhvh v'lyshby bbl v'lshryh v'lchkhmyh
verses.translation: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, And upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֥רֶב אֶל־הַבַּדִּ֖ים וְנֹאָ֑לוּ חֶ֥רֶב אֶל־גִּבּוֹרֶ֖יהָ וָחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.translit: chrb 'lhbdym vn'lv chrb 'lgbvryh vchtv
verses.translation: A sword is upon the boasters, and they shall become fools; A sword is upon her mighty men, and they shall be dismayed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֜רֶב אֶל־סוּסָ֣יו וְאֶל־רִכְבּ֗וֹ וְאֶל־כׇּל־הָעֶ֛רֶב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָ֖הּ וְהָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים חֶ֥רֶב אֶל־אוֹצְרֹתֶ֖יהָ וּבֻזָּֽזוּ׃
verses.translit: chrb 'lsvsyv v'lrkhbv v'lkhlh'rb 'shr btvkhh vhyv lnshym chrb 'l'vtsrtyh vbzzv
verses.translation: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, And upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her, And they shall become as women; A sword is upon her treasures, and they shall be robbed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֹ֥רֶב אֶל־מֵימֶ֖יהָ וְיָבֵ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ פְּסִלִים֙ הִ֔יא וּבָאֵימִ֖ים יִתְהֹלָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: chrb 'lmymyh vybshv khy 'rts pslym hy' vb'ymym ythllv
verses.translation: A drought is upon her waters, and they shall be dried up; For it is a land of graven images, And they are mad upon things of horror.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יֵשְׁב֤וּ צִיִּים֙ אֶת־אִיִּ֔ים וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ בָ֖הּ בְּנ֣וֹת יַעֲנָ֑ה וְלֹא־תֵשֵׁ֥ב עוֹד֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁכּ֖וֹן עַד־דּ֥וֹר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.translit: lkhn yshbv tsyym 't'yym vyshbv bh bnvt y'nh vl'tshb 'vd lntsch vl' tshkhvn 'ddvr vdr
verses.translation: Therefore the wild-cats with the jackals shall dwell there, And the ostriches shall dwell therein; and it shall be no more inhabited for ever, Neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֨ת אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־סְדֹ֧ם וְאֶת־עֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאֶת־שְׁכֵנֶ֖יהָ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹא־יֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹא־יָג֥וּר בָּ֖הּ בֶּן־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: khmhpkht 'lhym 'tsdm v't'mrh v'tshkhnyh n'myhvh l'yshb shm 'ysh vl'ygvr bh bn'dm
verses.translation: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah And the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; So shall no man abide there, Neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מִצָּפ֑וֹן וְג֤וֹי גָּדוֹל֙ וּמְלָכִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים יֵעֹ֖רוּ מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'm b' mtspvn vgvy gdvl vmlkhym rbym y'rv myrkhty'rts
verses.translation: Behold, a people cometh from the north, And a great nation, and many kings Shall be roused from the uttermost parts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְכִידֹ֞ן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הֵ֙מָּה֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָם֙ כַּיָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְעַל־סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּאִישׁ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִךְ בַּת־בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: qsht vkhydn ychzyqv 'khzry hmh vl' yrchmv qvlm khym yhmh v'lsvsym yrkhbv 'rvkh kh'ysh lmlchmh 'lykh btbbl
verses.translation: They lay hold on bow and spear, They are cruel, and have no compassion; Their voice is like the roaring sea, And they ride upon horses; Set in array, as a man for war, Against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֧ע מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־שִׁמְעָ֖ם וְרָפ֣וּ יָדָ֑יו צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְהוּ חִ֖יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: shm' mlkhbbl 'tshm'm vrpv ydyv tsrh hchzyqthv chyl khyvldh
verses.translation: The king of Babylon hath heard the fame of them, And his hands wax feeble; Anguish hath taken hold of him, And pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֠נֵּ֠ה כְּאַרְיֵ֞ה יַעֲלֶ֨ה מִגְּא֣וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּן֮ אֶל־נְוֵ֣ה אֵיתָן֒ כִּֽי־אַרְגִּ֤עָה (ארוצם) [אֲרִיצֵם֙] מֵעָלֶ֔יהָ וּמִ֥י בָח֖וּר אֵלֶ֣יהָ אֶפְקֹ֑ד כִּ֣י מִ֤י כָמ֙וֹנִי֙ וּמִ֣י יוֹעִדֶ֔נִּי וּמִי־זֶ֣ה רֹעֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: hnh kh'ryh y'lh mg'vn hyrdn 'lnvh 'ytn khy'rg'h ('rvtsm) ['rytsm] m'lyh vmy bchvr 'lyh 'pqd khy my khmvny vmy yv'dny vmyzh r'h 'shr y'md lpny
verses.translation: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan Against the strong habitation; For I will suddenly make them run away from it, And whoso is chosen, him will I appoint over it; For who is like Me? and who will appoint Me a time? And who is that shepherd that will stand before Me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן שִׁמְע֣וּ עֲצַת־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָעַץ֙ אֶל־בָּבֶ֔ל וּמַ֨חְשְׁבוֹתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖ב אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים אִם־לֹ֤א יִסְחָבוּם֙ צְעִירֵ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן אִם־לֹ֥א יַשִּׁ֛ים עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם נָוֶֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v 'tstyhvh 'shr y'ts 'lbbl vmchshbvtyv 'shr chshb 'l'rts khshdym 'ml' yschbvm ts'yry hts'n 'ml' yshym 'lyhm nvh
