verses.translation: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, That He hath taken against Babylon, And His purposes, that He hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall drag them away, Surely their habitation shall be appalled at them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּוֹל֙ נִתְפְּשָׂ֣ה בָבֶ֔ל נִרְעֲשָׁ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וּזְעָקָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֥ם נִשְׁמָֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mqvl ntpshh bbl nr'shh h'rts vz'qh bgvym nshm' {s}
verses.translation: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth quaketh, And the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ מֵעִ֣יר עַל־בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לֵ֣ב קָמָ֑י ר֖וּחַ מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny m'yr 'lbbl v'lyshby lb qmy rvch mshchyt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, And against them that dwell in Leb-kamai, a destroying wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֤ל ׀ זָרִים֙ וְזֵר֔וּהָ וִיבֹקְק֖וּ אֶת־אַרְצָ֑הּ כִּי־הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּי֥וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshlchty lbbl  zrym vzrvh vybqqv 't'rtsh khyhyv 'lyh msbyb byvm r'h
verses.translation: And I will send unto Babylon strangers, that shall fan her, And they shall empty her land; For in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽל־יִדְרֹ֤ךְ (ידרך) הַדֹּרֵךְ֙ קַשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְאֶֽל־יִתְעַ֖ל בְּסִרְיֹנ֑וֹ וְאַֽל־תַּחְמְלוּ֙ אֶל־בַּ֣חֻרֶ֔יהָ הַחֲרִ֖ימוּ כׇּל־צְבָאָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'lydrkh (ydrkh) hdrkh qshtv v'lyt'l bsrynv v'ltchmlv 'lbchryh hchrymv khltsb'h
verses.translation: Let the archer bend his bow against her, And let him lift himself up against her in his coat of mail; And spare ye not her young men, Destroy ye utterly all her host.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָפְל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וּמְדֻקָּרִ֖ים בְּחוּצוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vnplv chllym b'rts khshdym vmdqrym bchvtsvtyh
verses.translation: And they shall fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, And thrust through in her streets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹא־אַלְמָ֨ן יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ מֵאֱלֹהָ֔יו מֵיְהֹוָ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת כִּ֤י אַרְצָם֙ מָלְאָ֣ה אָשָׁ֔ם מִקְּד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy l''lmn yshr'l vyhvdh m'lhyv myhvh tsb'vt khy 'rtsm ml'h 'shm mqdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: For Israel is not widowed, nor Judah, Of his God, of the LORD of hosts; For their land is full of guilt Against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֻ֣סוּ  מִתּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֗ל וּמַלְּטוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אַל־תִּדַּ֖מּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּי֩ עֵ֨ת נְקָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה גְּמ֕וּל ה֥וּא מְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: nsv  mtvkh bbl vmltv 'ysh npshv 'ltdmv b'vnh khy 't nqmh hy' lyhvh gmvl hv' mshlm lh
verses.translation: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, And save every man his life, Be not cut off in her iniquity; For it is the time of the LORD’S vengeance; He will render unto her a recompense.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כּוֹס־זָהָ֤ב בָּבֶל֙ בְּיַד־יְהֹוָ֔ה מְשַׁכֶּ֖רֶת כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִיֵּינָהּ֙ שָׁת֣וּ גוֹיִ֔ם עַל־כֵּ֖ן יִתְהֹלְל֥וּ גוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: khvszhb bbl bydyhvh mshkhrt khlh'rts myynh shtv gvym 'lkhn ythllv gvym
verses.translation: Babylon hath been a golden cup in LORD’S hand, That made all the earth drunken; The nations have drunk of her wine, Therefore the nations are mad. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּתְאֹ֛ם נָפְלָ֥ה בָבֶ֖ל וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ עָלֶ֗יהָ קְח֤וּ צֳרִי֙ לְמַכְאוֹבָ֔הּ אוּלַ֖י תֵּרָפֵֽא׃
verses.translit: pt'm nplh bbl vtshbr hylylv 'lyh qchv tsry lmkh'vbh 'vly trp'
verses.translation: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed, Wail for her; Take balm for her pain, If so be she may be healed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רִפִּ֤אנוּ אֶת־בָּבֶל֙ וְלֹ֣א נִרְפָּ֔תָה עִזְב֕וּהָ וְנֵלֵ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ לְאַרְצ֑וֹ כִּֽי־נָגַ֤ע אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִשְׁפָּטָ֔הּ וְנִשָּׂ֖א עַד־שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.translit: rp'nv 'tbbl vl' nrpth 'zbvh vnlkh 'ysh l'rtsv khyng' 'lhshmym mshpth vnsh' 'dshchqym
verses.translation: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed; Forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country; For her judgment reacheth unto heaven, And is lifted up even to the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹצִ֥יא יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ בֹּ֚אוּ וּנְסַפְּרָ֣ה בְצִיּ֔וֹן אֶֽת־מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hvtsy' yhvh 'ttsdqtynv b'v vnsprh btsyvn 'tm'shh yhvh 'lhynv {s}
verses.translation: The LORD hath brought forth our victory; Come, and let us declare in Zion The work of the LORD our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָבֵ֣רוּ הַחִצִּים֮ מִלְא֣וּ הַשְּׁלָטִים֒ הֵעִ֣יר יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־ר֙וּחַ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י כִּֽי־עַל־בָּבֶ֥ל מְזִמָּת֖וֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֑הּ כִּֽי־נִקְמַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ הִ֔יא נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hbrv hchtsym ml'v hshltym h'yr yhvh 'trvch mlkhy mdy khy'lbbl mzmtv lhshchyth khynqmt yhvh hy' nqmt hykhlv
verses.translation: Make bright the arrows, Fill the quivers, The LORD hath roused the spirit of the kings of the Medes; Because His device is against Babylon, to destroy it; For it is the vengeance of the LORD, The vengeance of His temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־חוֹמֹ֨ת בָּבֶ֜ל שְׂאוּ־נֵ֗ס הַחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ הַמִּשְׁמָ֔ר הָקִ֙ימוּ֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים הָכִ֖ינוּ הָאֹֽרְבִ֑ים כִּ֚י גַּם־זָמַ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה גַּם־עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: 'lchvmt bbl sh'vns hchzyqv hmshmr hqymv shmrym hkhynv h'rbym khy gmzmm yhvh gm'shh 't 'shrdbr 'lyshby bbl
verses.translation: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon, Make the watch strong, Set the watchmen, prepare the ambushes; For the LORD hath both devised and done That which He spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (שכנתי) [שֹׁכַנְתְּ֙] עַל־מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים רַבַּ֖ת אוֹצָרֹ֑ת בָּ֥א קִצֵּ֖ךְ אַמַּ֥ת בִּצְעֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: (shkhnty) [shkhnt] 'lmym rbym rbt 'vtsrt b' qtskh 'mt bts'kh
verses.translation: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, Abundant in treasures, Thine end is come, The measure of thy covetousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־מִלֵּאתִ֤יךְ אָדָם֙ כַּיֶּ֔לֶק וְעָנ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִךְ הֵידָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh tsb'vt bnpshv khy 'mml'tykh 'dm khylq v'nv 'lykh hydd {s}
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by Himself: Surely I will fill thee with men, as with the canker-worm, And they shall lift up a shout against thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחׇכְמָת֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'shh 'rts bkhchv mkhyn tbl bchkhmtv vbtbvntv nth shmym
verses.translation: He that hath made the earth by His power, That hath established the world by His wisdom, And hath stretched out the heavens by His discernment;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֙יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּ֥עַל נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִקְצֵה־אָ֑רֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹצֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: lqvl ttv hmvn mym bshmym vy'l nsh'ym mqtsh'rts brqym lmtr 'shh vyvts' rvch m'tsrtyv
verses.translation: At the sound of His giving a multitude of waters in the heavens, He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; He maketh lightnings at the time of the rain, And bringeth forth the wind out of His treasuries;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִבְעַ֤ר כׇּל־אָדָם֙ מִדַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כׇּל־צֹרֵ֖ף מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: nb'r khl'dm md't hbysh khltsrf mpsl khy shqr nskhv vl'rvch bm
verses.translation: Every man is proved to be brutish, for the knowledge— Every goldsmith is put to shame by the graven image— That his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: hbl hmh m'shh t't'ym b't pqdtm y'bdv
verses.translation: They are vanity, a work of delusion; In the time of their visitation they shall perish,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־כְאֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲק֗וֹב כִּֽי־יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְשֵׁ֖בֶט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l'kh'lh chlq y'qvb khyyvtsr hkhl hv' vshbt nchltv yhvh tsb'vt shmv {p}
verses.translation: The portion of Jacob is not like these; For He is the former of all things, And [Israel] is the tribe of His inheritance; The LORD of hosts is His name. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַפֵּץ־אַתָּ֣ה לִ֔י כְּלֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִשְׁחַתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: mpts'th ly khly mlchmh vnptsty bkh gvym vhshchty bkh mmlkhvt
verses.translation: Thou art My maul and weapons of war, And with thee will I shatter the nations, And with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ ס֖וּס וְרֹכְב֑וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ רֶ֖כֶב וְרֹכְבֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vnptsty bkh svs vrkhbv vnptsty bkh rkhb vrkhbv
verses.translation: And with thee will I shatter the horse and his rider, And with thee will I shatter the chariot and him that rideth therein;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ זָקֵ֣ן וָנָ֑עַר וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ בָּח֖וּר וּבְתוּלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnptsty bkh 'ysh v'shh vnptsty bkh zqn vn'r vnptsty bkh bchvr vbtvlh
verses.translation: And with thee will I shatter man and woman, And with thee will I shatter the old man and the youth, And with thee will I shatter the young man and the maid;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ רֹעֶ֣ה וְעֶדְר֔וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ אִכָּ֣ר וְצִמְדּ֑וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ פַּח֖וֹת וּסְגָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vnptsty bkh r'h v'drv vnptsty bkh 'khr vtsmdv vnptsty bkh pchvt vsgnym
verses.translation: And with thee will I shatter the shepherd and his flock, And with thee will I shatter the husbandman and his yoke of oxen, And with thee will I shatter governors and deputies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל וּלְכֹ֣ל  יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֗ים אֵ֧ת כׇּל־רָעָתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֥וּ בְצִיּ֖וֹן לְעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshlmty lbbl vlkhl  yvshby khshdym 't khlr'tm 'shr'shv btsyvn l'ynykhm n'm yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea All their evil that they have done in Zion, in your sight; Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלֶ֜יךָ הַ֤ר הַמַּשְׁחִית֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה הַמַּשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וְגִלְגַּלְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִן־הַסְּלָעִ֔ים וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְהַ֥ר שְׂרֵפָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh hr hmshchyt n'myhvh hmshchyt 'tkhlh'rts vntyty 'tydy 'lykh vglgltykh mnhsl'ym vnttykh lhr shrph
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, Which destroyest all the earth; And I will stretch out My hand upon thee, And roll thee down from the rocks, And will make thee a burnt mountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־יִקְח֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ אֶ֣בֶן לְפִנָּ֔ה וְאֶ֖בֶן לְמוֹסָד֑וֹת כִּֽי־שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּהְיֶ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vl'yqchv mmkh 'bn lpnh v'bn lmvsdvt khyshmmvt 'vlm thyh n'myhvh
verses.translation: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, Nor a stone for foundations; But thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־נֵ֣ס בָּאָ֗רֶץ תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֤ר בַּגּוֹיִם֙ קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם הַשְׁמִ֧יעוּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת אֲרָרַ֖ט מִנִּ֣י וְאַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז פִּקְד֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ טִפְסָ֔ר הַעֲלוּ־ס֖וּס כְּיֶ֥לֶק סָמָֽר׃
verses.translit: sh'vns b'rts tq'v shvpr bgvym qdshv 'lyh gvym hshmy'v 'lyh mmlkhvt 'rrt mny v'shkhnz pqdv 'lyh tpsr h'lvsvs khylq smr
verses.translation: Set ye up a standard in the land, Blow the horn among the nations, Prepare the nations against her, Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz; Appoint a marshal against her; Cause the horses to come up as the rough canker-worm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ גוֹיִם֙ אֶת־מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י אֶת־פַּחוֹתֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־כׇּל־סְגָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: qdshv 'lyh gvym 'tmlkhy mdy 'tpchvtyh v'tkhlsgnyh v't khl'rts mmshltv
verses.translation: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, The governors thereof, and all the deputies thereof, And all the land of his dominion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ וַתָּחֹ֑ל כִּ֣י קָ֤מָה עַל־בָּבֶל֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֔ה לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־אֶ֧רֶץ בָּבֶ֛ל לְשַׁמָּ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vtr'sh h'rts vtchl khy qmh 'lbbl mchshbvt yhvh lshvm 't'rts bbl lshmh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: And the land quaketh and is in pain; For the purposes of the LORD are performed against Babylon, To make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָדְלוּ֩ גִבּוֹרֵ֨י בָבֶ֜ל לְהִלָּחֵ֗ם יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ בַּמְּצָד֔וֹת נָשְׁתָ֥ה גְבוּרָתָ֖ם הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים הִצִּ֥יתוּ מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ בְרִיחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: chdlv gbvry bbl lhlchm yshbv bmtsdvt nshth gbvrtm hyv lnshym htsytv mshkhntyh nshbrv brychyh
verses.translation: The mighty men of Babylon have forborne to fight, They remain in their strongholds; Their might hath failed, they are become as women; Her dwelling-places are set on fire; Her bars are broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָ֤ץ לִקְרַאת־רָץ֙ יָר֔וּץ וּמַגִּ֖יד לִקְרַ֣את מַגִּ֑יד לְהַגִּיד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּֽי־נִלְכְּדָ֥ה עִיר֖וֹ מִקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: rts lqr'trts yrvts vmgyd lqr't mgyd lhgyd lmlkh bbl khynlkhdh 'yrv mqtsh
verses.translation: One post runneth to meet another, And one messenger to meet an other, To tell the king of Babylon That his city is taken on every quarter;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמַּעְבָּר֣וֹת נִתְפָּ֔שׂוּ וְאֶת־הָאֲגַמִּ֖ים שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֑שׁ וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה נִבְהָֽלוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhm'brvt ntpshv v'th'gmym shrpv b'sh v'nshy hmlchmh nbhlv {s}
verses.translation: And the fords are seized, And the castles they have burned with fire, And the men of war are affrighted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּת־בָּבֶ֕ל כְּגֹ֖רֶן עֵ֣ת הִדְרִיכָ֑הּ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֔ט וּבָ֥אָה עֵֽת־הַקָּצִ֖יר לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l btbbl khgrn 't hdrykhh 'vd m't vb'h 'thqtsyr lh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing-floor At the time when it is trodden; Yet a little while, and the time of harvest Shall come for her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אכלנו) [אֲכָלַ֣נִי] (הממנו) [הֲמָמַ֗נִי] נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶל֒ (הציגנו) [הִצִּיגַ֙נִי֙] כְּלִ֣י רִ֔יק (בלענו) [בְּלָעַ֙נִי֙] כַּתַּנִּ֔ין מִלָּ֥א כְרֵשׂ֖וֹ מֵעֲדָנָ֑י (הדיחנו) [הֱדִיחָֽנִי]׃
verses.translit: ('khlnv) ['khlny] (hmmnv) [hmmny] nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl (htsygnv) [htsygny] khly ryq (bl'nv) [bl'ny] khtnyn ml' khrshv m'dny (hdychnv) [hdychny]
verses.translation: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, He hath crushed me, He hath set me down as an empty vessel, He hath swallowed me up like a dragon, He hath filled his maw with my delicacies; He hath washed me clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמָסִ֤י וּשְׁאֵרִי֙ עַל־בָּבֶ֔ל תֹּאמַ֖ר יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן וְדָמִי֙ אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֔ים תֹּאמַ֖ר יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chmsy vsh'ry 'lbbl t'mr yshbt tsyvn vdmy 'lyshby khshdym t'mr yrvshl͏m {s}
verses.translation: ’The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon’, Shall the inhabitant of Zion say; And: ‘My blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea’, Shall Jerusalem say.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִי־רָב֙ אֶת־רִיבֵ֔ךְ וְנִקַּמְתִּ֖י אֶת־נִקְמָתֵ֑ךְ וְהַֽחֲרַבְתִּי֙ אֶת־יַמָּ֔הּ וְהֹֽבַשְׁתִּ֖י אֶת־מְקוֹרָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnnyrb 'trybkh vnqmty 'tnqmtkh vhchrbty 'tymh vhbshty 'tmqvrh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: Behold, I will plead thy cause, And take vengeance for thee; And I will dry up her sea, And make her fountain dry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָה֩ בָבֶ֨ל ׀ לְגַלִּ֧ים ׀ מְעוֹן־תַּנִּ֛ים שַׁמָּ֥ה וּשְׁרֵקָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vhyth bbl  lglym  m'vntnym shmh vshrqh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: And Babylon shall become heaps, A dwelling-place for jackals, An astonishment, and a hissing, Without inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַחְדָּ֖ו כַּכְּפִרִ֣ים יִשְׁאָ֑גוּ נָעֲר֖וּ כְּגוֹרֵ֥י אֲרָיֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: ychdv khkhprym ysh'gv n'rv khgvry 'ryvt
verses.translation: They shall roar together like young lions; They shall growl as lions’whelps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחֻמָּ֞ם אָשִׁ֣ית אֶת־מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֗ם וְהִשְׁכַּרְתִּים֙ לְמַ֣עַן יַעֲלֹ֔זוּ וְיָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת־עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bchmm 'shyt 'tmshtyhm vhshkhrtym lm'n y'lzv vyshnv shnt'vlm vl' yqytsv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: With their poison I will prepare their feast, And I will make them drunken, that they may be convulsed, And sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹרִידֵ֖ם כְּכָרִ֣ים לִטְב֑וֹחַ כְּאֵילִ֖ים עִם־עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'vrydm khkhrym ltbvch kh'ylym 'm'tvdym
verses.translation: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, Like rams with he-goats.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ נִלְכְּדָ֣ה שֵׁשַׁ֔ךְ וַתִּתָּפֵ֖שׂ תְּהִלַּ֣ת כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְשַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ykh nlkhdh shshkh vttpsh thlt khlh'rts 'ykh hyth lshmh bbl bgvym
verses.translation: How is Sheshach taken! And the praise of the whole earth seized! How is Babylon become an astonishment Among the nations!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֥ה עַל־בָּבֶ֖ל הַיָּ֑ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹן גַּלָּ֖יו נִכְסָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'lbbl hym bhmvn glyv nkhsth
verses.translation: The sea is come up upon Babylon; She is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָי֤וּ עָרֶ֙יהָ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וַעֲרָבָ֑ה אֶ֗רֶץ לֹֽא־יֵשֵׁ֤ב בָּהֵן֙ כׇּל־אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹא־יַעֲבֹ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן בֶּן־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: hyv 'ryh lshmh 'rts tsyh v'rbh 'rts l'yshb bhn khl'ysh vl'y'br bhn bn'dm
verses.translation: Her cities are become a desolation, A dry land, and a desert, A land wherein no man dwelleth, Neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֨י עַל־בֵּ֜ל בְּבָבֶ֗ל וְהֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶת־בִּלְעוֹ֙ מִפִּ֔יו וְלֹא־יִנְהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו ע֖וֹד גּוֹיִ֑ם גַּם־חוֹמַ֥ת בָּבֶ֖ל נָפָֽלָה׃
verses.translit: vpqdty 'lbl bbbl vhts'ty 'tbl'v mpyv vl'ynhrv 'lyv 'vd gvym gmchvmt bbl nplh
verses.translation: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, And I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up, And the nations shall not flow any more unto him; Yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְא֤וּ מִתּוֹכָהּ֙ עַמִּ֔י וּמַלְּט֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־נַפְשׁ֑וֹ מֵחֲר֖וֹן אַף־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: ts'v mtvkhh 'my vmltv 'ysh 'tnpshv mchrvn 'fyhvh
verses.translation: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, And save yourselves every man From the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפֶן־יֵרַ֤ךְ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְתִֽירְא֔וּ בַּשְּׁמוּעָ֖ה הַנִּשְׁמַ֣עַת בָּאָ֑רֶץ וּבָ֧א בַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁמוּעָ֗ה וְאַחֲרָ֤יו בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הַשְּׁמוּעָ֔ה וְחָמָ֣ס בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֹשֵׁ֖ל עַל־מֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.translit: vpnyrkh lbbkhm vtyr'v bshmv'h hnshm't b'rts vb' bshnh hshmv'h v'chryv bshnh hshmv'h vchms b'rts vmshl 'lmshl
verses.translation: And let not your heart faint, neither fear ye, For the rumour that shall be heard in the land; For a rumour shall come one year, And after that in another year a rumour, And violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וּפָֽקַדְתִּי֙ עַל־פְּסִילֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וְכׇל־אַרְצָ֖הּ תֵּב֑וֹשׁ וְכׇל־חֲלָלֶ֖יהָ יִפְּל֥וּ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym vpqdty 'lpsyly bbl vkhl'rtsh tbvsh vkhlchllyh yplv btvkhh
verses.translation: Therefore behold, the days come, That I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon, And her whole land shall be ashamed; And all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרִנְּנ֤וּ עַל־בָּבֶל֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֔רֶץ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם כִּ֧י מִצָּפ֛וֹן יָבוֹא־לָ֥הּ הַשּׁוֹדְדִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vrnnv 'lbbl shmym v'rts vkhl 'shr bhm khy mtspvn ybv'lh hshvddym n'myhvh
verses.translation: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, Shall sing for joy over Babylon; For the spoilers shall come unto her From the north, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־בָּבֶ֕ל לִנְפֹּ֖ל חַֽלְלֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם־לְבָבֶ֥ל נָפְל֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י כׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: gmbbl lnpl chlly yshr'l gmlbbl nplv chlly khlh'rts
verses.translation: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, So at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּלֵטִ֣ים מֵחֶ֔רֶב הִלְכ֖וּ אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ זִכְר֤וּ מֵרָחוֹק֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה וִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם תַּעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: pltym mchrb hlkhv 'lt'mdv zkhrv mrchvq 'tyhvh vyrvshl͏m t'lh 'llbbkhm
verses.translation: Ye that have escaped the sword, Go ye, stand not still; Remember the LORD from afar, And let Jerusalem come into your mind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּ֚שְׁנוּ כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֣עְנוּ חֶרְפָּ֔ה כִּסְּתָ֥ה כְלִמָּ֖ה פָּנֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֚י בָּ֣אוּ זָרִ֔ים עַֽל־מִקְדְּשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bshnv khyshm'nv chrph khsth khlmh pnynv khy b'v zrym 'lmqdshy byt yhvh {p}
verses.translation: ’We are ashamed, because we have heard reproach, Confusion hath covered our faces; For strangers are come Into the sanctuaries of the LORD’S house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֖י עַל־פְּסִילֶ֑יהָ וּבְכׇל־אַרְצָ֖הּ יֶאֱנֹ֥ק חָלָֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnhymym b'ym n'myhvh vpqdty 'lpsylyh vbkhl'rtsh y'nq chll
verses.translation: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images; and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תַעֲלֶ֤ה בָבֶל֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְכִ֥י תְבַצֵּ֖ר מְר֣וֹם עֻזָּ֑הּ מֵאִתִּ֗י יָבֹ֧אוּ שֹׁדְדִ֛ים לָ֖הּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khyt'lh bbl hshmym vkhy tbtsr mrvm 'zh m'ty yb'v shddym lh n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from Me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֥וֹל זְעָקָ֖ה מִבָּבֶ֑ל וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: qvl z'qh mbbl vshbr gdvl m'rts khshdym
verses.translation: Hark! a cry from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־בָּבֶ֔ל וְאִבַּ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נָּה ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וְהָמ֤וּ גַלֵּיהֶם֙ כְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים נִתַּ֥ן שְׁא֖וֹן קוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khyshdd yhvh 'tbbl v'bd mmnh qvl gdvl vhmv glyhm khmym rbym ntn sh'vn qvlm
verses.translation: For the LORD spoileth Babylon, and destroyeth out of her the great voice; and their waves roar like many waters, the noise of their voice is uttered;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ בָ֨א עָלֶ֤יהָ עַל־בָּבֶל֙ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד וְנִלְכְּדוּ֙ גִּבּוֹרֶ֔יהָ חִתְּתָ֖ה קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֣י אֵ֧ל גְּמֻל֛וֹת יְהֹוָ֖ה שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: khy b' 'lyh 'lbbl shvdd vnlkhdv gbvryh chtth qshtvtm khy 'l gmlvt yhvh shlm yshlm
verses.translation: For the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, their bows are shattered; for the LORD is a God of recompenses, He will surely requite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הִשְׁכַּרְתִּ֠י שָׂרֶ֨יהָ וַחֲכָמֶ֜יהָ פַּחוֹתֶ֤יהָ וּסְגָנֶ֙יהָ֙ וְגִבּוֹרֶ֔יהָ וְיָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת־עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ נְאֻ֨ם־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhshkhrty shryh vchkhmyh pchvtyh vsgnyh vgbvryh vyshnv shnt'vlm vl' yqytsv n'mhmlkh yhvh tsb'vt shmv {s}
verses.translation: And I will make drunk her princes and her wise men, Her governors and her deputies, and her mighty men; And they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, Saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת חֹ֠מ֠וֹת בָּבֶ֤ל הָרְחָבָה֙ עַרְעֵ֣ר תִּתְעַרְעָ֔ר וּשְׁעָרֶ֥יהָ הַגְּבֹהִ֖ים בָּאֵ֣שׁ יִצַּ֑תּוּ וְיִֽגְע֨וּ עַמִּ֧ים בְּדֵי־רִ֛יק וּלְאֻמִּ֥ים בְּדֵי־אֵ֖שׁ וְיָעֵֽפוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt chmvt bbl hrchbh 'r'r tt'r'r vsh'ryh hgbhym b'sh ytstv vyg'v 'mym bdyryq vl'mym bdy'sh vy'pv {s}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly overthrown, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; And the peoples shall labour for vanity, And the nations for the fire; And they shall be weary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה  יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא אֶת־שְׂרָיָ֣ה בֶן־נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן־מַחְסֵיָה֒ בְּלֶכְתּ֞וֹ אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֥ת הָרְבִעִ֖ית לְמׇלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה שַׂ֥ר מְנוּחָֽה׃
verses.translit: hdbr 'shrtsvh  yrmyhv hnby' 'tshryh bnnryh bnmchsyh blkhtv 'ttsdqyhv mlkhyhvdh bbl bshnt hrb'yt lmlkhv vshryh shr mnvchh
verses.translation: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was quartermaster.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֧ת כׇּל־הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל־סֵ֣פֶר אֶחָ֑ד אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַכְּתֻבִ֖ים אֶל־בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vykhtb yrmyhv 't khlhr'h 'shrtbv' 'lbbl 'lspr 'chd 't khlhdbrym h'lh hkhtbym 'lbbl
verses.translation: And Jeremiah wrote in one book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֶל־שְׂרָיָ֑ה כְּבֹאֲךָ֣ בָבֶ֔ל וְֽרָאִ֔יתָ וְֽקָרָ֔אתָ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'lshryh khb'kh bbl vr'yt vqr't 't khlhdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah: ‘When thou comest to Babylon, then see that thou read all these words,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ יְהֹוָה֙ אַתָּ֨ה דִבַּ֜רְתָּ אֶל־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ לְהַכְרִית֔וֹ לְבִלְתִּ֤י הֱיֽוֹת־בּוֹ֙ יוֹשֵׁ֔ב לְמֵאָדָ֖ם וְעַד־בְּהֵמָ֑ה כִּֽי־שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt yhvh 'th dbrt 'lhmqvm hzh lhkhrytv lblty hyvtbv yvshb lm'dm v'dbhmh khyshmmvt 'vlm thyh
verses.translation: and say: O LORD, Thou hast spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that none shall dwell therein, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כְּכַלֹּ֣תְךָ֔ לִקְרֹ֖א אֶת־הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה תִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָיו֙ אֶ֔בֶן וְהִשְׁלַכְתּ֖וֹ אֶל־תּ֥וֹךְ פְּרָֽת׃
verses.translit: vhyh khkhltkh lqr' 'thspr hzh tqshr 'lyv 'bn vhshlkhtv 'ltvkh prt
verses.translation: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of the Euphrates;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כָּ֠כָה תִּשְׁקַ֨ע בָּבֶ֤ל וְלֹֽא־תָקוּם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ וְיָעֵ֑פוּ עַד־הֵ֖נָּה דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrt khkhh tshq' bbl vl'tqvm mpny hr'h 'shr 'nkhy mby' 'lyh vy'pv 'dhnh dbry yrmyhv {p}
verses.translation: and thou shalt say: Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise again because of the evil that I will bring upon her; and they shall be weary.’ Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַחַ֤ת שָׁנָה֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְמׇלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ (חמיטל) [חֲמוּטַ֥ל] בַּֽת־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃
verses.translit: bn'shrym v'cht shnh tsdqyhv bmlkhv v'cht 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshl͏m vshm 'mv (chmytl) [chmvtl] btyrmyhv mlbnh
verses.translation: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr'shh yhvyqm
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  עַל־אַ֣ף יְהֹוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּירוּשָׁלַ֣͏ִם וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַד־הִשְׁלִיכ֥וֹ אוֹתָ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּמְרֹ֥ד צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: khy  'l'f yhvh hyth byrvshl͏m vyhvdh 'dhshlykhv 'vtm m'l pnyv vymrd tsdqyhv bmlkh bbl
verses.translation: For through the anger of the LORD did it come to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until He had cast them out from His presence. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַשָּׁנָ֨ה הַתְּשִׁעִ֜ית לְמׇלְכ֗וֹ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי֮ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֒דֶשׁ֒ בָּ֠א נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֨ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֜ל ה֤וּא וְכׇל־חֵילוֹ֙ עַל־יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּבְנ֥וּ עָלֶ֛יהָ דָּיֵ֖ק סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh htsh'yt lmlkhv bchdsh h'shyry b'shvr lchdsh b' nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl hv' vkhlchylv 'lyrvshl͏m vychnv 'lyh vybnv 'lyh dyq sbyb
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֥א הָעִ֖יר בַּמָּצ֑וֹר עַ֚ד עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vtb' h'yr bmtsvr 'd 'shty 'shrh shnh lmlkh tsdqyhv
verses.translation: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֹ֤דֶשׁ הָרְבִיעִי֙ בְּתִשְׁעָ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בָּעִ֑יר וְלֹא־הָיָ֥ה לֶ֖חֶם לְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: bchdsh hrby'y btsh'h lchdsh vychzq hr'b b'yr vl'hyh lchm l'm h'rts
verses.translation: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבָּקַ֣ע הָעִ֗יר וְכׇל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֡ה יִבְרְחוּ֩ וַיֵּצְא֨וּ מֵהָעִ֜יר לַ֗יְלָה דֶּ֜רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר בֵּין־הַחֹמֹתַ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־גַּ֣ן הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכַשְׂדִּ֥ים עַל־הָעִ֖יר סָבִ֑יב וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָעֲרָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtbq' h'yr vkhl'nshy hmlchmh ybrchv vyts'v mh'yr lylh drkh sh'r bynhchmtym 'shr 'lgn hmlkh vkhshdym 'lh'yr sbyb vylkhv drkh h'rbh
verses.translation: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden—now the Chaldeans were against the city round about—and they went by the way of the Arabah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְדְּפ֤וּ חֵיל־כַּשְׂדִּים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיַּשִּׂ֥יגוּ אֶת־צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת יְרֵח֑וֹ וְכׇ֨ל־חֵיל֔וֹ נָפֹ֖צוּ מֵעָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyrdpv chylkhshdym 'chry hmlkh vyshygv 'ttsdqyhv b'rbt yrchv vkhlchylv nptsv m'lyv
verses.translation: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיַּעֲל֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ אֶל־מֶ֧לֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל רִבְלָ֖תָה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ מִשְׁפָּטִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytpshv 'thmlkh vy'lv 'tv 'lmlkh bbl rblth b'rts chmt vydbr 'tv mshptym
verses.translation: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he gave judgment upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחַ֧ט מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ לְעֵינָ֑יו וְגַ֛ם אֶת־כׇּל־שָׂרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה שָׁחַ֥ט בְּרִבְלָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: vyshcht mlkhbbl 'tbny tsdqyhv l'ynyv vgm 'tkhlshry yhvdh shcht brblth
verses.translation: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עֵינֵ֥י צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ עִוֵּ֑ר וַיַּאַסְרֵ֣הוּ בַֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֗יִם וַיְבִאֵ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֙ בָּבֶ֔לָה וַיִּתְּנֵ֥הוּ (בבית) [בֵֽית־]הַפְּקֻדֹּ֖ת עַד־י֥וֹם מוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v't'yny tsdqyhv 'vr vy'srhv bnchshtym vyb'hv mlkhbbl bblh vytnhv (bbyt) [byt]hpqdt 'dyvm mvtv
verses.translation: And he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַֽחֲמִישִׁי֙ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ הִ֗יא שְׁנַת֙ תְּשַֽׁע־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֑ל בָּ֗א נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב־טַבָּחִ֔ים עָמַ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vbchdsh hchmyshy b'shvr lchdsh hy' shnt tsh''shrh shnh lmlkh nbvkhdr'tsr mlkhbbl b' nbvzr'dn rbtbchym 'md lpny mlkhbbl byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֶת־בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־בָּתֵּ֧י יְרוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם וְאֶת־כׇּל־בֵּ֥ית הַגָּד֖וֹל שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyshrf 'tbytyhvh v'tbyt hmlkh v't khlbty yrvshl͏m v'tkhlbyt hgdvl shrf b'sh
verses.translation: and he burned the house of the LORD, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great man’s house, burned he with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם סָבִ֑יב נָֽתְצוּ֙ כׇּל־חֵ֣יל כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶת־רַב־טַבָּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'tkhlchmvt yrvshl͏m sbyb nttsv khlchyl khshdym 'shr 'trbtbchym
verses.translation: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִדַּלּ֨וֹת הָעָ֜ם וְֽאֶת־יֶ֥תֶר הָעָ֣ם  הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּעִ֗יר וְאֶת־הַנֹּֽפְלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽפְלוּ֙ אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת יֶ֣תֶר הָאָמ֑וֹן הֶגְלָ֕ה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־טַבָּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmdlvt h'm v'tytr h'm  hnsh'rym b'yr v'thnplym 'shr nplv 'lmlkh bbl v't ytr h'mvn hglh nbvzr'dn rbtbchym
verses.translation: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest sort of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the residue of the multitude.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִדַּלּ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ הִשְׁאִ֕יר נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֑ים לְכֹרְמִ֖ים וּלְיֹגְבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmdlvt h'rts hsh'yr nbvzr'dn rbtbchym lkhrmym vlygbym
verses.translation: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עַמּוּדֵ֨י הַנְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְבֵית־יְהֹוָ֗ה וְֽאֶת־הַמְּכֹנ֞וֹת וְאֶת־יָ֧ם הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָ֖ה שִׁבְּר֣וּ כַשְׂדִּ֑ים וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־כׇּל־נְחֻשְׁתָּ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: v't'mvdy hnchsht 'shr lbytyhvh v'thmkhnvt v'tym hnchsht 'shr bbytyhvh shbrv khshdym vysh'v 'tkhlnchshtm bblh
verses.translation: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases and the brazen sea that were in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldeans break in pieces, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַ֠סִּר֠וֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֨ים וְאֶת־הַֽמְזַמְּר֜וֹת וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקֹ֣ת וְאֶת־הַכַּפּ֗וֹת וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־כְּלֵ֧י הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר־יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם לָקָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: v'thsrvt v'thy'ym v'thmzmrvt v'thmzrqt v'thkhpvt v't khlkhly hnchsht 'shryshrtv bhm lqchv
verses.translation: The pots also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the pans, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַ֠סִּפִּ֠ים וְאֶת־הַמַּחְתּ֨וֹת וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָק֜וֹת וְאֶת־הַסִּיר֣וֹת וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹר֗וֹת וְאֶת־הַכַּפּוֹת֙ וְאֶת־הַמְּנַקִּיּ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר זָהָב֙ זָהָ֔ב וַאֲשֶׁר־כֶּ֖סֶף כָּ֑סֶף לָקַ֖ח רַב־טַבָּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'thspym v'thmchtvt v'thmzrqvt v'thsyrvt v'thmnrvt v'thkhpvt v'thmnqyvt 'shr zhb zhb v'shrkhsf khsf lqch rbtbchym
verses.translation: And the cups, and the fire-pans, and the basins, and the pots, and the candlesticks, and the pans, and the bowls—that which was of gold, in gold, and that which was of silver, in silver—the captain of the guard took away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָעַמּוּדִ֣ים  שְׁנַ֗יִם הַיָּ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְהַבָּקָ֞ר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֣חַת הַמְּכֹנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹא־הָיָ֣ה מִשְׁקָ֔ל לִנְחֻשְׁתָּ֖ם כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: h'mvdym  shnym hym 'chd vhbqr shnym'shr nchsht 'shrtcht hmkhnvt 'shr 'shh hmlkh shlmh lbyt yhvh l'hyh mshql lnchshtm khlhkhlym h'lh
verses.translation: The two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve brazen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made for the house of the LORD—the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעַמּוּדִ֗ים שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה אַמָּה֙ (קומה) [קוֹמַת֙] הָעַמֻּ֣ד הָאֶחָ֔ד וְח֛וּט שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה יְסֻבֶּ֑נּוּ וְעׇבְי֛וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע אֶצְבָּע֖וֹת נָבֽוּב׃
verses.translit: vh'mvdym shmnh 'shrh 'mh (qvmh) [qvmt] h'md h'chd vchvt shtym'shrh 'mh ysbnv v'byv 'rb' 'tsb'vt nbvb
verses.translation: And as for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers; it was hollow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹתֶ֨רֶת עָלָ֜יו נְחֹ֗שֶׁת וְקוֹמַ֨ת הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הָאַחַת֮ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּוֹת֒ וּשְׂבָכָ֨ה וְרִמּוֹנִ֧ים עַֽל־הַכּוֹתֶ֛רֶת סָבִ֖יב הַכֹּ֣ל נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְכָאֵ֛לֶּה לַעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִ֖י וְרִמּוֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhtrt 'lyv nchsht vqvmt hkhtrt h'cht chmsh 'mvt vshbkhh vrmvnym 'lhkhvtrt sbyb hkhl nchsht vkh'lh l'mvd hshny vrmvnym
verses.translation: And a capital of brass was upon it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the capital round about, all of brass; and the second pillar also had like unto these, and pomegranates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ הָרִמֹּנִ֔ים תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה ר֑וּחָה כׇּל־הָרִמּוֹנִ֥ים מֵאָ֛ה עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv hrmnym tsh'ym vshshh rvchh khlhrmvnym m'h 'lhshbkhh sbyb {s}
verses.translation: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on the outside; all the pomegranates were a hundred upon the network round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח רַב־טַבָּחִ֗ים אֶת־שְׂרָיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־צְפַנְיָ֖ה כֹּהֵ֣ן הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְאֶת־שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסַּֽף׃
verses.translit: vyqch rbtbchym 'tshryh khhn hr'sh v'ttspnyh khhn hmshnh v'tshlsht shmry hsf
verses.translation: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הָעִ֡יר לָקַח֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד אֲֽשֶׁר־הָיָ֥ה פָקִ֣יד  עַל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְשִׁבְעָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵרֹאֵ֤י פְנֵֽי־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְא֣וּ בָעִ֔יר וְאֵ֗ת סֹפֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֔א הַמַּצְבִּ֖א אֶת־עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֖ים בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vmnh'yr lqch srys 'chd 'shrhyh pqyd  'l'nshy hmlchmh vshb'h 'nshym mr'y pnyhmlkh 'shr nmts'v b'yr v't spr shr htsb' hmtsb' 't'm h'rts vshshym 'ysh m'm h'rts hnmts'ym btvkh h'yr
verses.translation: and out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war; and seven men of them that saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אוֹתָ֔ם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֑ים וַיֹּ֧לֶךְ אוֹתָ֛ם אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'vtm nbvzr'dn rbtbchym vylkh 'vtm 'lmlkh bbl rblth
verses.translation: And Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אוֹתָם֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֧ל וַיְמִתֵ֛ם בְּרִבְלָ֖ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַיִּ֥גֶל יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vykhh 'vtm mlkh bbl vymtm brblh b'rts chmt vygl yhvdh m'l 'dmtv {s}
verses.translation: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶגְלָ֖ה נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֑ר בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁ֕בַע יְהוּדִ֕ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: zh h'm 'shr hglh nbvkhdr'tsr bshntshb' yhvdym shlsht 'lpym v'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֛ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לִנְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֑ר מִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: bshnt shmvnh 'shrh lnbvkhdr'tsr myrvshl͏m npsh shmnh m'vt shlshym vshnym
verses.translation: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar, from Jerusalem, eight hundred thirty and two persons;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁלֹ֣שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֮ לִנְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר֒ הֶגְלָ֗ה נְבֽוּזַרְאֲדָן֙ רַב־טַבָּחִ֔ים יְהוּדִ֕ים נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה כׇּל־נֶ֕פֶשׁ אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bshnt shlsh v'shrym lnbvkhdr'tsr hglh nbvzr'dn rbtbchym yhvdym npsh shb' m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh khlnpsh 'rb't 'lpym vshsh m'vt {s}
verses.translation: in the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons; all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בִשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וָשֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְגָלוּת֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ן מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֔ה בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ חֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ נָשָׂ֡א אֱוִ֣יל מְרֹדַךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בִּשְׁנַ֣ת מַלְכֻת֗וֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּצֵ֥א אֹת֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית (הכליא) [הַכְּלֽוּא]׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshlshym vshb' shnh lglvt yhvykhn mlkhyhvdh bshnym 'shr chdsh b'shrym vchmshh lchdsh nsh' 'vyl mrdkh mlkh bbl bshnt mlkhtv 'tr'sh yhvykhyn mlkhyhvdh vyts' 'tv mbyt (hkhly') [hkhlv']
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ טֹב֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־כִּסְא֔וֹ מִמַּ֗עַל לְכִסֵּ֧א (מלכים) [הַמְּלָכִ֛ים] אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'tv tbvt vytn 'tkhs'v mm'l lkhs' (mlkhym) [hmlkhym] 'shr 'tv bbbl
verses.translation: And he spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁנָּ֕ה אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י כִלְא֑וֹ וְאָכַ֨ל לֶ֧חֶם לְפָנָ֛יו תָּמִ֖יד כׇּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽו׃
verses.translit: vshnh 't bgdy khl'v v'khl lchm lpnyv tmyd khlymy chyv
verses.translation: And he changed his prison garments, and did eat bread before him continually all the days of his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲרֻחָת֗וֹ אֲרֻחַת֩ תָּמִ֨יד נִתְּנָה־לּ֜וֹ מֵאֵ֧ת מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמ֖וֹ עַד־י֣וֹם מוֹת֑וֹ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'rchtv 'rcht tmyd ntnhlv m't mlkhbbl dbryvm byvmv 'dyvm mvtv khl ymy chyyv
verses.translation: And for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  בִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה בָּֽרְבִיעִי֙ בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ וַאֲנִ֥י בְתֽוֹךְ־הַגּוֹלָ֖ה עַל־נְהַר־כְּבָ֑ר נִפְתְּחוּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וָאֶרְאֶ֖ה מַרְא֥וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy  bshlshym shnh brby'y bchmshh lchdsh v'ny btvkhhgvlh 'lnhrkhbr nptchv hshmym v'r'h mr'vt 'lhym
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הִ֚יא הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֔ית לְגָל֖וּת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ יוֹיָכִֽין׃
verses.translit: bchmshh lchdsh hy' hshnh hchmyshyt lglvt hmlkh yvykhyn
verses.translation: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיֹ֣ה הָיָ֣ה דְבַר־יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה אֶל־יְחֶזְקֵ֨אל בֶּן־בּוּזִ֧י הַכֹּהֵ֛ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים עַל־נְהַר־כְּבָ֑ר וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֛יו שָׁ֖ם יַד־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hyh hyh dbryhvh 'lychzq'l bnbvzy hkhhn b'rts khshdym 'lnhrkhbr vthy 'lyv shm ydyhvh
verses.translation: the word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ סְעָרָ֜ה בָּאָ֣ה מִן־הַצָּפ֗וֹן עָנָ֤ן גָּדוֹל֙ וְאֵ֣שׁ מִתְלַקַּ֔חַת וְנֹ֥גַֽהּ־ל֖וֹ סָבִ֑יב וּמִ֨תּוֹכָ֔הּ כְּעֵ֥ין הַחַשְׁמַ֖ל מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'r' vhnh rvch s'rh b'h mnhtspvn 'nn gdvl v'sh mtlqcht vnghlv sbyb vmtvkhh kh'yn hchshml mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: And I looked, and, behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, a great cloud, with a fire flashing up, so that a brightness was round about it; and out of the midst thereof as the colour of electrum, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨תּוֹכָ֔הּ דְּמ֖וּת אַרְבַּ֣ע חַיּ֑וֹת וְזֶה֙ מַרְאֵיהֶ֔ן דְּמ֥וּת אָדָ֖ם לָהֵֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: vmtvkhh dmvt 'rb' chyvt vzh mr'yhn dmvt 'dm lhnh
verses.translation: And out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פָנִ֖ים לְאֶחָ֑ת וְאַרְבַּ֥ע כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאַחַ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'rb'h pnym l'cht v'rb' khnpym l'cht lhm
verses.translation: And every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם רֶ֣גֶל יְשָׁרָ֑ה וְכַ֣ף רַגְלֵיהֶ֗ם כְּכַף֙ רֶ֣גֶל עֵ֔גֶל וְנֹ֣צְצִ֔ים כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֥שֶׁת קָלָֽל׃
verses.translit: vrglyhm rgl yshrh vkhf rglyhm khkhf rgl 'gl vntstsym kh'yn nchsht qll
verses.translation: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (וידו) [וִידֵ֣י] אָדָ֗ם מִתַּ֙חַת֙ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רִבְעֵיהֶ֑ם וּפְנֵיהֶ֥ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֖ם לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: (vydv) [vydy] 'dm mtcht khnpyhm 'l 'rb't rb'yhm vpnyhm vkhnpyhm l'rb'tm
verses.translation: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and as for the faces and wings of them four,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֹ֥בְרֹ֛ת אִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל־אֲחוֹתָ֖הּ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֑ם לֹא־יִסַּ֣בּוּ בְלֶכְתָּ֔ן אִ֛ישׁ אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: chbrt 'shh 'l'chvth khnpyhm l'ysbv blkhtn 'ysh 'l'br pnyv ylkhv
verses.translation: their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְמ֣וּת פְּנֵיהֶם֮ פְּנֵ֣י אָדָם֒ וּפְנֵ֨י אַרְיֵ֤ה אֶל־הַיָּמִין֙ לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֔ם וּפְנֵי־שׁ֥וֹר מֵהַשְּׂמֹ֖אול לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ן וּפְנֵי־נֶ֖שֶׁר לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vdmvt pnyhm pny 'dm vpny 'ryh 'lhymyn l'rb'tm vpnyshvr mhshm'vl l'rb'tn vpnynshr l'rb'tn
verses.translation: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man; and they four had the face of a lion on the right side; and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four had also the face of an eagle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְנֵיהֶ֕ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֥ם פְּרֻד֖וֹת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה לְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁ֚תַּיִם חֹבְר֣וֹת אִ֔ישׁ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם מְכַסּ֔וֹת אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶֽנָה׃
verses.translit: vpnyhm vkhnpyhm prdvt mlm'lh l'ysh shtym chbrvt 'ysh vshtym mkhsvt 't gvytyhnh
verses.translation: Thus were their faces; and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵ֑כוּ אֶ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה־שָּׁ֨מָּה הָר֤וּחַ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽן׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'l'br pnyv ylkhv 'l 'shr yhyhshmh hrvch llkht ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtn
verses.translation: And they went every one straight forward; whither the spirit was to go, they went; they turned not when they went.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְמ֨וּת הַחַיּ֜וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶ֣ם כְּגַחֲלֵי־אֵ֗שׁ בֹּֽעֲרוֹת֙ כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַלַּפִּדִ֔ים הִ֕יא מִתְהַלֶּ֖כֶת בֵּ֣ין הַחַיּ֑וֹת וְנֹ֣גַהּ לָאֵ֔שׁ וּמִן־הָאֵ֖שׁ יוֹצֵ֥א בָרָֽק׃
verses.translit: vdmvt hchyvt mr'yhm khgchly'sh b'rvt khmr'h hlpdym hy' mthlkht byn hchyvt vngh l'sh vmnh'sh yvts' brq
verses.translation: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like coals of fire, burning like the appearance of torches; it flashed up and down among the living creatures; and there was brightness to the fire, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחַיּ֖וֹת רָצ֣וֹא וָשׁ֑וֹב כְּמַרְאֵ֖ה הַבָּזָֽק׃
verses.translit: vhchyvt rtsv' vshvb khmr'h hbzq
verses.translation: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֖רֶא הַחַיּ֑וֹת וְהִנֵּה֩ אוֹפַ֨ן אֶחָ֥ד בָּאָ֛רֶץ אֵ֥צֶל הַחַיּ֖וֹת לְאַרְבַּ֥עַת פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'r' hchyvt vhnh 'vpn 'chd b'rts 'tsl hchyvt l'rb't pnyv
verses.translation: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel at the bottom hard by the living creatures, at the four faces thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַרְאֵ֨ה הָאוֹפַנִּ֤ים וּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ כְּעֵ֣ין תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ וּדְמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ן וּמַרְאֵיהֶם֙ וּמַ֣עֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָאוֹפַ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאוֹפָֽן׃
verses.translit: mr'h h'vpnym vm'shyhm kh'yn trshysh vdmvt 'chd l'rb'tn vmr'yhm vm'shyhm kh'shr yhyh h'vpn btvkh h'vpn
verses.translation: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl; and they four had one likeness; and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־אַרְבַּ֥עַת רִבְעֵיהֶ֖ן בְּלֶכְתָּ֣ם יֵלֵ֑כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽן׃
verses.translit: 'l'rb't rb'yhn blkhtm ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtn
verses.translation: When they went, they went toward their four sides; they turned not when they went.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֨בֵּיהֶ֔ן וְגֹ֥בַהּ לָהֶ֖ם וְיִרְאָ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם וְגַבֹּתָ֗ם מְלֵאֹ֥ת עֵינַ֛יִם סָבִ֖יב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vgbyhn vgbh lhm vyr'h lhm vgbtm ml't 'ynym sbyb l'rb'tn
verses.translation: As for their rings, they were high and they were dreadful; and they four had their rings full of eyes round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְלֶ֙כֶת֙ הַחַיּ֔וֹת יֵלְכ֥וּ הָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑ם וּבְהִנָּשֵׂ֤א הַחַיּוֹת֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֖וּ הָאוֹפַנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vblkht hchyvt ylkhv h'vpnym 'tslm vbhnsh' hchyvt m'l h'rts ynsh'v h'vpnym
verses.translation: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went hard by them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the bottom, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה־שָּׁ֨ם הָר֤וּחַ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ שָׁ֥מָּה הָר֖וּחַ לָלֶ֑כֶת וְהָאוֹפַנִּ֗ים יִנָּֽשְׂאוּ֙ לְעֻמָּתָ֔ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּאוֹפַנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'l 'shr yhyhshm hrvch llkht ylkhv shmh hrvch llkht vh'vpnym ynsh'v l'mtm khy rvch hchyh b'vpnym
verses.translation: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, as the spirit was to go thither, so they went; and the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּלֶכְתָּ֣ם יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּבְעׇמְדָ֖ם יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּֽבְהִנָּשְׂאָ֞ם מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֗רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֤וּ הָאֽוֹפַנִּים֙ לְעֻמָּתָ֔ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּאוֹפַנִּֽים׃
verses.translit: blkhtm ylkhv vb'mdm y'mdv vbhnsh'm m'l h'rts ynsh'v h'vpnym l'mtm khy rvch hchyh b'vpnym
verses.translation: When those went, these went, and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְמ֞וּת עַל־רָאשֵׁ֤י הַחַיָּה֙ רָקִ֔יעַ כְּעֵ֖ין הַקֶּ֣רַח הַנּוֹרָ֑א נָט֥וּי עַל־רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: vdmvt 'lr'shy hchyh rqy' kh'yn hqrch hnvr' ntvy 'lr'shyhm mlm'lh
verses.translation: And over the heads of the living creatures there was the likeness of a firmament, like the colour of the terrible ice, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתַ֙חַת֙ הָרָקִ֔יעַ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֣ם יְשָׁר֔וֹת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחוֹתָ֑הּ לְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָהֵ֔נָּה וּלְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָהֵ֔נָּה אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vtcht hrqy' khnpyhm yshrvt 'shh 'l'chvth l'ysh shtym mkhsvt lhnh vl'ysh shtym mkhsvt lhnh 't gvytyhm
verses.translation: And under the firmament were their wings conformable the one to the other; this one of them had two which covered, and that one of them had two which covered, their bodies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־ק֣וֹל כַּנְפֵיהֶ֡ם כְּקוֹל֩ מַ֨יִם רַבִּ֤ים כְּקוֹל־שַׁדַּי֙ בְּלֶכְתָּ֔ם ק֥וֹל הֲמֻלָּ֖ה כְּק֣וֹל מַחֲנֶ֑ה בְּעׇמְדָ֖ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: v'shm' 'tqvl khnpyhm khqvl mym rbym khqvlshdy blkhtm qvl hmlh khqvl mchnh b'mdm trpynh khnpyhn
verses.translation: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of a host; when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ק֕וֹל מֵעַ֕ל לָרָקִ֖יעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־רֹאשָׁ֑ם בְּעׇמְדָ֖ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vyhyqvl m'l lrqy' 'shr 'lr'shm b'mdm trpynh khnpyhn
verses.translation: For, when there was a voice above the firmament that was over their heads, as they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּ֗עַל לָרָקִ֙יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔ם כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אֶבֶן־סַפִּ֖יר דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א וְעַל֙ דְּמ֣וּת הַכִּסֵּ֔א דְּמ֞וּת כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֛ם עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: vmm'l lrqy' 'shr 'lr'shm khmr'h 'bnspyr dmvt khs' v'l dmvt hkhs' dmvt khmr'h 'dm 'lyv mlm'lh
verses.translation: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man upon it above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֣רֶא  כְּעֵ֣ין חַשְׁמַ֗ל כְּמַרְאֵה־אֵ֤שׁ בֵּֽית־לָהּ֙ סָבִ֔יב מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה מׇתְנָ֖יו וּלְמָ֑עְלָה וּמִמַּרְאֵ֤ה מׇתְנָיו֙ וּלְמַ֔טָּה רָאִ֙יתִי֙ כְּמַרְאֵה־אֵ֔שׁ וְנֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: v'r'  kh'yn chshml khmr'h'sh bytlh sbyb mmr'h mtnyv vlm'lh vmmr'h mtnyv vlmth r'yty khmr'h'sh vngh lv sbyb
verses.translation: And I saw as the colour of electrum, as the appearance of fire round about enclosing it, from the appearance of his loins and upward; and from the appearance of his loins and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness round about him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַקֶּ֡שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה בֶעָנָ֜ן בְּי֣וֹם הַגֶּ֗שֶׁם כֵּ֣ן מַרְאֵ֤ה הַנֹּ֙גַהּ֙ סָבִ֔יב ה֕וּא מַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כְּבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֑ה וָֽאֶרְאֶה֙ וָאֶפֹּ֣ל עַל־פָּנַ֔י וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע ק֥וֹל מְדַבֵּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khmr'h hqsht 'shr yhyh b'nn byvm hgshm khn mr'h hngh sbyb hv' mr'h dmvt khbvdyhvh v'r'h v'pl 'lpny v'shm' qvl mdbr {p}
verses.translation: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֶּן־אָדָם֙ עֲמֹ֣ד עַל־רַגְלֶ֔יךָ וַאֲדַבֵּ֖ר אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm 'md 'lrglykh v'dbr 'tkh
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak with thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֧בֹא בִ֣י ר֗וּחַ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלַ֔י וַתַּעֲמִדֵ֖נִי עַל־רַגְלָ֑י וָאֶשְׁמַ֕ע אֵ֖ת מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtb' by rvch kh'shr dbr 'ly vt'mdny 'lrgly v'shm' 't mdbr 'ly {p}
verses.translation: And spirit entered into me when He spoke unto me, and set me upon my feet; and I heard Him that spoke unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־אָדָם֙ שׁוֹלֵ֨חַ אֲנִ֤י אֽוֹתְךָ֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־גּוֹיִ֥ם הַמּוֹרְדִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָרְדוּ־בִ֑י הֵ֤מָּה וַֽאֲבוֹתָם֙ פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֔י עַד־עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm shvlch 'ny 'vtkh 'lbny yshr'l 'lgvym hmvrdym 'shr mrdvby hmh v'bvtm psh'v by 'd'tsm hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to rebellious nations, that have rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me, even unto this very day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבָּנִ֗ים קְשֵׁ֤י פָנִים֙ וְחִזְקֵי־לֵ֔ב אֲנִ֛י שׁוֹלֵ֥חַ אוֹתְךָ֖ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vhbnym qshy pnym vchzqylb 'ny shvlch 'vtkh 'lyhm v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: and the children are brazen-faced and stiff-hearted, I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ אִם־יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְאִם־יֶחְדָּ֔לוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵ֑מָּה וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhmh 'myshm'v v'mychdlv khy byt mry hmh vyd'v khy nby' hyh btvkhm {p}
verses.translation: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear—for they are a rebellious house—yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָ֠דָ֠ם אַל־תִּירָ֨א מֵהֶ֜ם וּמִדִּבְרֵיהֶ֣ם אַל־תִּירָ֗א כִּ֣י סָרָבִ֤ים וְסַלּוֹנִים֙ אוֹתָ֔ךְ וְאֶל־עַקְרַבִּ֖ים אַתָּ֣ה יוֹשֵׁ֑ב מִדִּבְרֵיהֶ֤ם אַל־תִּירָא֙ וּמִפְּנֵיהֶ֣ם אַל־תֵּחָ֔ת כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm 'ltyr' mhm vmdbryhm 'ltyr' khy srbym vslvnym 'vtkh v'l'qrbym 'th yvshb mdbryhm 'ltyr' vmpnyhm 'ltcht khy byt mry hmh
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though defiers and despisers be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions; be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֶת־דְּבָרַי֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְאִם־יֶחְדָּ֑לוּ כִּ֥י מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vdbrt 'tdbry 'lyhm 'myshm'v v'mychdlv khy mry hmh {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak My words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear; for they are most rebellious.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם שְׁמַע֙ אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־תְּהִי־מֶ֖רִי כְּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑רִי פְּצֵ֣ה פִ֔יךָ וֶאֱכֹ֕ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm shm' 't 'shr'ny mdbr 'lykh 'lthymry khbyt hmry ptsh pykh v'khl 't 'shr'ny ntn 'lykh
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee: be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house; open thy mouth, and eat that which I give thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֕ה וְהִנֵּה־יָ֖ד שְׁלוּחָ֣ה אֵלָ֑י וְהִנֵּה־ב֖וֹ מְגִלַּת־סֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnhyd shlvchh 'ly vhnhbv mgltspr
verses.translation: And when I looked, behold, a hand was put forth unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אוֹתָהּ֙ לְפָנַ֔י וְהִ֥יא כְתוּבָ֖ה פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֑וֹר וְכָת֣וּב אֵלֶ֔יהָ קִנִ֥ים וָהֶ֖גֶה וָהִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyprsh 'vth lpny vhy' khtvbh pnym v'chvr vkhtvb 'lyh qnym vhgh vhy {s}
verses.translation: and He spread it before me, and it was written within and without; and there was written therein lamentations, and moaning, and woe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־תִּמְצָ֖א אֱכ֑וֹל אֱכוֹל֙ אֶת־הַמְּגִלָּ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְלֵ֥ךְ דַּבֵּ֖ר אֶל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm 't 'shrtmts' 'khvl 'khvl 'thmglh hz't vlkh dbr 'lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, eat that which thou findest; eat this roll, and go, speak unto the house of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־פִּ֑י וַיַּ֣אֲכִילֵ֔נִי אֵ֖ת הַמְּגִלָּ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: v'ptch 'tpy vy'khylny 't hmglh hz't
verses.translation: So I opened my mouth, and He caused me to eat that roll.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־אָדָם֙ בִּטְנְךָ֤ תַֽאֲכֵל֙ וּמֵעֶ֣יךָ תְמַלֵּ֔א אֵ֚ת הַמְּגִלָּ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֣ן אֵלֶ֑יךָ וָאֹ֣כְלָ֔ה וַתְּהִ֥י בְּפִ֖י כִּדְבַ֥שׁ לְמָתֽוֹק׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm btnkh t'khl vm'ykh tml' 't hmglh hz't 'shr 'ny ntn 'lykh v'khlh vthy bpy khdbsh lmtvq {p}
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee.’ Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם לֶךְ־בֹּא֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְדִבַּרְתָּ֥ בִדְבָרַ֖י אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm lkhb' 'lbyt yshr'l vdbrt bdbry 'lyhm
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with My words unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֡י לֹא֩ אֶל־עַ֨ם עִמְקֵ֥י שָׂפָ֛ה וְכִבְדֵ֥י לָשׁ֖וֹן אַתָּ֣ה שָׁל֑וּחַ אֶל־בֵּ֖ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy l' 'l'm 'mqy shph vkhbdy lshvn 'th shlvch 'lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thou art not sent to a people of an unintelligible speech and of a slow tongue, but to the house of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א  אֶל־עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים עִמְקֵ֤י שָׂפָה֙ וְכִבְדֵ֣י לָשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תִשְׁמַ֖ע דִּבְרֵיהֶ֑ם אִם־לֹ֤א אֲלֵיהֶם֙ שְׁלַחְתִּ֔יךָ הֵ֖מָּה יִשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: l'  'l'mym rbym 'mqy shph vkhbdy lshvn 'shr l'tshm' dbryhm 'ml' 'lyhm shlchtykh hmh yshm'v 'lykh
verses.translation: not to many peoples of an unintelligible speech and of a slow tongue, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, if I sent thee to them, they would hearken unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א יֹאבוּ֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלֶ֔יךָ כִּי־אֵינָ֥ם אֹבִ֖ים לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלָ֑י כִּ֚י כׇּל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חִזְקֵי־מֵ֥צַח וּקְשֵׁי־לֵ֖ב הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vbyt yshr'l l' y'bv lshm' 'lykh khy'ynm 'bym lshm' 'ly khy khlbyt yshr'l chzqymtsch vqshylb hmh
verses.translation: But the house of Israel will not consent to hearken unto thee; for they consent not to hearken unto Me; for all the house of Israel are of a hard forehead and of a stiff heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֧תִּי אֶת־פָּנֶ֛יךָ חֲזָקִ֖ים לְעֻמַּ֣ת פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֶֽת־מִצְחֲךָ֥ חָזָ֖ק לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִצְחָֽם׃
verses.translit: hnh ntty 'tpnykh chzqym l'mt pnyhm v'tmtschkh chzq l'mt mtschm
verses.translation: Behold, I have made thy face hard against their faces, and thy forehead hard against their foreheads.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּשָׁמִ֛יר חָזָ֥ק מִצֹּ֖ר נָתַ֣תִּי מִצְחֶ֑ךָ לֹֽא־תִירָ֤א אוֹתָם֙ וְלֹא־תֵחַ֣ת מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khshmyr chzq mtsr ntty mtschkh l'tyr' 'vtm vl'tcht mpnyhm khy byt mry hmh {p}
verses.translation: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead; fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, for they are a rebellious house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם אֶת־כׇּל־דְּבָרַי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ קַ֥ח בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְאׇזְנֶ֥יךָ שְּׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm 'tkhldbry 'shr 'dbr 'lykh qch blbbkh vb'znykh shm'
verses.translation: Moreover He said unto me: ‘Son of man, all My words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thy heart, and hear with thine ears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֵ֨ךְ בֹּ֤א אֶל־הַגּוֹלָה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְאִם־יֶחְדָּֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vlkh b' 'lhgvlh 'lbny 'mkh vdbrt 'lyhm v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'myshm'v v'mychdlv
verses.translation: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them: Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַ֣ע אַחֲרַ֔י ק֖וֹל רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֑וֹל בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtsh'ny rvch v'shm' 'chry qvl r'sh gdvl brvkh khbvdyhvh mmqvmv
verses.translation: Then a spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing: ‘Blessed be the glory of the LORD from His place’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְק֣וֹל  כַּנְפֵ֣י הַחַיּ֗וֹת מַשִּׁיקוֹת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אֶל־אֲחוֹתָ֔הּ וְק֥וֹל הָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְעֻמָּתָ֑ם וְק֖וֹל רַ֥עַשׁ גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vqvl  khnpy hchyvt mshyqvt 'shh 'l'chvth vqvl h'vpnym l'mtm vqvl r'sh gdvl
verses.translation: also the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְר֥וּחַ נְשָׂאַ֖תְנִי וַתִּקָּחֵ֑נִי וָאֵלֵ֥ךְ מַר֙ בַּחֲמַ֣ת רוּחִ֔י וְיַד־יְהֹוָ֥ה עָלַ֖י חָזָֽקָה׃
verses.translit: vrvch nsh'tny vtqchny v'lkh mr bchmt rvchy vydyhvh 'ly chzqh
verses.translation: So a spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָב֨וֹא אֶל־הַגּוֹלָ֜ה תֵּ֣ל אָ֠בִ֠יב הַיֹּשְׁבִ֤ים אֶֽל־נְהַר־כְּבָר֙ (ואשר) [וָאֵשֵׁ֔ב] הֵ֖מָּה יוֹשְׁבִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם וָאֵשֵׁ֥ב שָׁ֛ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים מַשְׁמִ֥ים בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'bv' 'lhgvlh tl 'byb hyshbym 'lnhrkhbr (v'shr) [v'shb] hmh yvshbym shm v'shb shm shb't ymym mshmym btvkhm
verses.translation: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river Chebar, and I sat where they sat; and I remained there appalled among them seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקְצֵ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים {פ} וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh shb't ymym {p} vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִפִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְהִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: bn'dm tsph nttykh lbyt yshr'l vshm't mpy dbr vhzhrt 'vtm mmny
verses.translation: ’Son of man, I have appointed thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; and when thou shalt hear a word at My mouth, thou shalt give them warning from Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאׇמְרִ֤י לָרָשָׁע֙ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת וְלֹ֣א הִזְהַרְתּ֗וֹ וְלֹ֥א דִבַּ֛רְתָּ לְהַזְהִ֥יר רָשָׁ֛ע מִדַּרְכּ֥וֹ הָרְשָׁעָ֖ה לְחַיֹּת֑וֹ ה֤וּא רָשָׁע֙ בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְדָמ֖וֹ מִיָּדְךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: b'mry lrsh' mvt tmvt vl' hzhrtv vl' dbrt lhzhyr rsh' mdrkhv hrsh'h lchytv hv' rsh' b'vnv ymvt vdmv mydkh 'bqsh
verses.translation: When I say unto the wicked: Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ כִּי־הִזְהַ֣רְתָּ רָשָׁ֔ע וְלֹא־שָׁב֙ מֵֽרִשְׁע֔וֹ וּמִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ הָרְשָׁעָ֑ה ה֚וּא בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת־נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ׃
verses.translit: v'th khyhzhrt rsh' vl'shb mrsh'v vmdrkhv hrsh'h hv' b'vnv ymvt v'th 'tnpshkh htslt
verses.translation: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשׁ֨וּב צַדִּ֤יק מִצִּדְקוֹ֙ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִכְשׁ֛וֹל לְפָנָ֖יו ה֣וּא יָמ֑וּת כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הִזְהַרְתּוֹ֙ בְּחַטָּאת֣וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְלֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֗רְןָ צִדְקֹתָו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְדָמ֖וֹ מִיָּדְךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vbshvb tsdyq mtsdqv v'shh 'vl vntty mkhshvl lpnyv hv' ymvt khy l' hzhrtv bcht'tv ymvt vl' tzkhrn tsdqtv 'shr 'shh vdmv mydkh 'bqsh
verses.translation: Again, when a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, I will lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die; because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה כִּ֧י הִזְהַרְתּ֣וֹ צַדִּ֗יק לְבִלְתִּ֥י חֲטֹ֛א צַדִּ֖יק וְה֣וּא לֹֽא־חָטָ֑א חָי֤וֹ יִֽחְיֶה֙ כִּ֣י נִזְהָ֔ר וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת־נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th khy hzhrtv tsdyq lblty cht' tsdyq vhv' l'cht' chyv ychyh khy nzhr v'th 'tnpshkh htslt {p}
verses.translation: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he took warning; and thou hast delivered thy soul.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֥י עָלַ֛י שָׁ֖ם יַד־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י ק֥וּם צֵא֙ אֶל־הַבִּקְעָ֔ה וְשָׁ֖ם אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אוֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vthy 'ly shm ydyhvh vy'mr 'ly qvm ts' 'lhbq'h vshm 'dbr 'vtkh
